jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

SSOE is seeking a Controls Engineer with an emphasis on supporting the design and delivery of Building Automation Systems / Building Management Systems (BAS/BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The successful candidate will combine hands-on controls software experience with engineering design, specifications, and system architecture development.

**Why Join SSOE?**

At SSOE, you'll work with amazing colleagues and be part of something big! We've consistently been named a **“Great Place to Work”** and are experiencing the most successful years in our history. Along with industry-leading salary compensation, you'll be eligible to purchase shares in the company — shares that have significantly outperformed both the S&P and Dow averages.

AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities:

**A Typical Day Might Include:**

The following duties are typical of the position but are not all encompassing. Responsibilities include those required to deliver quality service on schedule and within budget in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

* Develop BAS/BMS and EPMS designs for industrial, commercial, mission-critical, data center, and other complex facilities.
* Prepare controls drawings and documentation, including system architecture and network diagrams, control schematics, points lists, sequences of operation, panel and device layouts, and related design deliverables.
* Write and edit BAS/BMS and EPMS specifications, control narratives, sequences of operation, and related procurement or construction documents.
* Define system architectures and integration strategies using applicable protocols such as BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus TCP/RTU, SNMP, OPC UA, and other open or manufacturer-specific interfaces.
* Evaluate, select, and apply standard engineering methods and techniques on smaller projects or portions of larger projects; adapt accepted methods when project conditions require.
* Perform detailed engineering work with general direction, exercise sound technical judgment, and seek guidance for unusual or complex issues.
* Coordinate controls requirements with electrical, mechanical, process, information technology, and other project disciplines.
* Review vendor submittals, shop drawings, control logic, and software deliverables for compliance with project requirements and design intent.
* Support system testing, commissioning, functional performance testing, troubleshooting, and field verification as required.
* Participate in client meetings to define scope, present progress, resolve technical issues, and support client satisfaction.
* May direct or coordinate the work of designers and less-experienced engineers and check assigned portions of project deliverables.
* Assist with project estimates, proposals, schedules, and scope development; communicate changes, risks, and technical decisions to the project team.
* Use CADD and other digital engineering tools to develop project deliverables and remain current with evolving controls technologies, codes, and design methods.
* Job may require the use of AI or similar digital technology to perform job functions.
* Travel may be required. A valid driver’s license is required and may be waived for international assignments.

Qualifications:

**Qualifications You’ll Need on Day One:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics and Instrumentation, Control Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Three (3) or more years of related practical engineering experience is required; five (5) or more years is preferred.
* Must have direct BAS/BMS and EPMS design experience, including development of engineering drawings, sequences, points lists, integration requirements, and construction deliverables.
* Familiarity with BAS/BMS and EPMS applications, including controller logic, graphics, alarming, trending, reporting, and third-party system integrations.
* Must have experience writing BAS/BMS and EPMS specifications and developing BAS/BMS and EPMS system and network architectures.
* Working knowledge of controls networks, electrical power monitoring, HVAC control applications, instrumentation, and integration of packaged or third-party systems.
* Familiarity with applicable codes, standards, cybersecurity considerations, and industry practices for building controls and power monitoring systems.
* Ability to communicate clearly, coordinate across disciplines, manage assigned work, and produce accurate documentation with limited supervision.
* Experience with CADD and common engineering productivity tools.
* **Salary**: **$85k - $95/year** depending on location, education, experience, and certifications.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), professional development and training, generous PTO, and paid holidays.

**Preferred Experience**
========================

* Experience engineering and programming Siemens building automation platforms, including Desigo CC and Desigo PXC automation controllers, is a plus.
* Experience with Siemens SIMATIC controls using STEP 7 within TIA Portal, including S7-1200 and/or S7-1500 controllers, is a plus.
* Experience with Siemens WinCC or WinCC Unified visualization is a plus.
* Experience with mission-critical facilities, data centers, advanced manufacturing, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, or other complex industrial projects.
* Experience integrating BAS/BMS and EPMS with HVAC equipmen

jobs.title: Embedded Real Time Operating System Staff Software Engineer (QuRT OS, Zephyr)
jobs.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > DSP Architecture and Design

**General Summary:**

**General Summary**

Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS.

  

As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open-source community.

  

What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will:

* Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low-level system software components.
* Own and drive resolution of complex system-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness.
* Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment.
* Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards.
* Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration.
* Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement.
Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization.  

  

You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high-performance, low-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will:

* Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture.
* Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability.
* Own features end-to-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support.
Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality.  

  

Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will:

* Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components.
* Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers.
* Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long-term maintainability.
* Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project.
* Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices.
* Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem.
* Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration.
* Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm-maintained components.
* Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions.
Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership.  

  

**How You Work (Tools, Automation & Modern Engineering)**

Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means:

* Applying modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, when they meaningfully improve productivity or code quality.
* Leveraging automation, scripting, CI systems, debuggers, profilers, static analysis tools, and simulation environments to improve engineering effectiveness.
* Exercising strong engineering judgment regarding when automation is appropriate and when deeper hands-on investigation is required.
Continuously identifying opportunities to improve engineering workflows, developer productivity, and software quality.  

  

You are not expected to be an AI expert, but you are expected to be tool-fluent, curious, adaptable, and pragmatic.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relate

jobs.title: Industrial PLC and Safety Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Industrial PLC & Safety Controls Engineer to design, build, program, and validate industrial electrical control and safety systems, including PLCs, safety relays, contactors, and power distribution components. The role includes implementing Safety Integrity Level 3 (SIL 3) safety functions and developing, programming, and testing microcontroller-based printed circuit boards (PCBs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* + Design industrial PLC-based control and functional safety circuits, including safety functions that meet SIL 3 requirements.
  + Develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts.
  + Select and integrate electrical components, including contactors, relays, circuit breakers, power supplies, and safety devices.
  + Program and configure PLCs and safety PLCs, including interlocks, emergency-stop functions, diagnostics, and fault handling.
  + Build, wire, troubleshoot, and commission electrical control panels.
  + Develop schematics and PCB layouts for microcontroller-based control, monitoring, and interface applications.
  + Assemble and bring up PCB prototypes, perform hardware debugging, and verify circuit performance.
  + Develop and test embedded firmware and communication interfaces, including I²C and SPI.
  + Perform functional testing, fault-response testing, and safety validation; document designs, test procedures, and results.
  + Ensure compliance with applicable standards, including IEC 60204-1, ISO 13849, IEC 62061, and NFPA 79.

  
**Requirements**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience with industrial PLC programming, electrical control panel design, assembly, and commissioning.
* Demonstrated knowledge and implementation experience with SIL 3 safety requirements, including safety architectures, diagnostics, verification, and validation.
* Strong understanding of electrical safety circuits, power switching, contactor monitoring, interlocks, and emergency-stop systems.
* Experience with industrial automation platforms such as Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff.
* Proficiency in electrical CAD tools such as EPLAN or AutoCAD Electrical, and familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad.
* Practical experience with microcontroller-based circuit design, PCB prototyping, embedded programming in C/C++, and I²C and SPI communication.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and other electrical test equipment.
* Ability to independently design, assemble, program, troubleshoot, and validate industrial control systems and embedded electronics.

 **Benefits**

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k)
* Flexible spending account
* Commuter benefits
* Disability insurance

The annual salary range for this position is between $90,000 and $110,000.

We also have a perfect location for all types of commuters: AMAX is located right between I-680 and I-880. Warm Springs/South Fremont BART station and bus stops are within a 10-minute walking distance. 5 grocery stores, 6+ coffee/tea places, and numerous restaurants within 1 mile. Try the delicious fusions or grab your daily groceries after work.

**About AMAX**

Established in 1979, AMAX is a globally recognized leader in GPU-accelerated IT infrastructure, specializing in transforming standard IT systems into advanced, high-performance computing solutions. Catering to industries such as AI, cloud computing, autonomous vehicles, and high-performance computing, AMAX has set benchmarks in innovation, including pioneering liquid-cooled HPC systems for the semiconductor industry. With a global footprint spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, AMAX offers end-to-end services from design and manufacturing to deployment. Committed to addressing the growing demands of AI, AMAX delivers advanced solutions that help organizations achieve their technology goal and drive progress on a global scale. To learn more about AMAX’s advanced AI solutions, visit amax.com.

**Join Us**

Become part of a diverse and inclusive team that values your technical expertise and innovative thinking. Together, we’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible in the hardware industry.

AMAX is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants and provide equal employment opportunities regardless of age, race, gender, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
===============

Expand human ambition in the physical world.

*Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.*

**About the Role**
==================

At Watney, firmware engineers write the firmware for our robots’ mainboards and actuators, and bring up new boards with our manufacturing partners. They work with our mechanical, electrical, and ML teams as new sensors and embodiments arrive.

How far firmware can take a robot on its own is still an open question: which faults a board can recover from without a person, and how one design carries across new boards and embodiments.

The firmware you write sets how reliable and safe every robot is. The architecture bets you make carry into every robot we build after this one.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Lead board bring-up with our manufacturing partners, from specification discovery through first boot.
* Write the drivers and hardware abstraction layers that run on our microcontrollers and actuators.
* Build and run automated hardware-in-the-loop tests across embodiments.
* Build the common firmware base for mainboards and actuators, in Rust and C.
* Work with the ML and mechanical teams to prototype and validate new sensors.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You:**
=================================

* Have shipped production firmware to millions of devices.
* Have written production firmware in Rust, C, or both.
* Have debugged communication buses on real hardware.
* Have built or operated hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure.
* Have worked with contract manufacturers or OEMs to turn ambiguous requirements into a board layout.
* Have worked with electromechanical systems or cameras and optics, electrically, mechanically, or in software.
* Have working knowledge of electrical engineering and either field-oriented control or RF.

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply!

==========================

jobs.title: Production Systems Engineer, Edge
jobs.description:
Meta's Edge compute fleet - around 162,000 servers in more than 600 locations worldwide - is how our users reach us. Unlike most of Meta's hardware, this fleet doesn't run in our own data centers: it lives in Edge PoPs terminating user connections, and in ISP and cell-service-provider locations running caching for partner networks.The Edge Hardware team is the hardware engineering partner to the Traffic organization that owns this footprint. We are a key partner in hardware selection and qualification, qualify firmware across every component, investigate failures in the deployed fleet, and define the detection and remediation tooling that keeps it healthy. The work sits directly in the user path: a hardware fault we miss becomes a user-visible availability problem. You'd work day to day with an engineer being hired alongside you, and with the team in Dublin who owns the area today - plus the wider Edge and hardware reliability teams, and your Traffic partners, on both coasts.  
  
  

### **Production Systems Engineer, Edge Responsibilities:**

* As a Production Systems Engineer on Edge Hardware, you'll contribute across New Product Introduction and Sustaining work on Meta's Edge compute fleet, taking ownership of well-defined areas and growing your scope as you ramp
* Qualify successive server generations and new platforms into the fleet, and sustain existing generations for the 3–5 years they remain deployed
* Build out failure detection and remediation coverage - new checks, porting existing validation to new vendor hardware, cleaning up noisy checkers that currently create work for partner operations teams
* Help requalify components that have reached end of sale (new NICs, SSDs), unblocking Meta's ability to purchase Edge servers and replace failed parts
* Improve fleet visibility, surfacing failures we currently detect late or not at all
* Take on part of the firmware qualification cadence - NIC, BIOS, BMC, management engine, GPU VBIOS, PSU, flash
* Contribute to multi-vendor enablement - Meta's Edge fleet has run on a single server vendor for many years and we're onboarding alternatives. That means rebuilding provisioning, validation, detection and remediation assumptions that have held for years

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* 2+ years of experience in production systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, network operations, or a related hardware operations discipline
* 2+ years of experience developing automation or tooling in Python, Go, or a comparable scripting or systems programming language for infrastructure or hardware management
* Experience with server or network hardware components including switches, routers, NICs, and compute platforms, including hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis
* Experience with configuration management, fleet management, or hardware lifecycle tooling in a large-scale data center, edge, or cloud infrastructure environment
* Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure across geographically dispersed sites or points of presence

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with server BMC / iLO / Redfish, firmware upgrade frameworks, or hardware qualification workflows
* Experience working across time zones and with cross-functional partners in different sites
* Background in Edge, CDN, or distributed infrastructure. Experience working directly with OEM vendors (e.g., HPE, Dell)
* Familiarity with large-scale data analysis tools

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

jobs.title: Vehicle Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.  
  
We are scaling at a historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.  
  
Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.  
  
We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.  
  
In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea—and this is the moment to join us.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

You will own energy storage system design for a maritime autonomous vehicle. Reporting to the Vehicle Systems Lead, you will drive cell selection, module design, thermal management, and pressure-rated packaging for battery systems that must deliver ultra-long-range endurance under pressure.  
  
Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own energy storage architecture: cell chemistry selection, module design, and pack integration
* Design pressure-rated battery enclosures for full-ocean-depth operation
* Perform battery sizing, energy budget analysis, and cycle life modeling
* Drive thermal management design for safe operation across environmental conditions
* Define charging profiles and integration with external charging interfaces
* Interface with energy distribution, structural, and production teams
* Support prototype builds, testing, and design-for-manufacturability reviews
* Contribute to safety analysis for energy storage systems
* Travel up to 25% to test sites and vendor facilities

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
* 5+ years of experience in battery system design, energy storage, or power electronics
* Experience with lithium-ion or equivalent high-energy-density battery systems
* Familiarity with battery management systems and thermal management
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with marine or subsea battery systems
* Working knowledge of battery safety standards (UN38.3, IEC 62619, or military equivalents)
* Experience with pressure-rated enclosure design
* Familiarity with battery modeling and simulation tools
* Experience in defense or maritime robotics

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. We are seeking a highly motivated Electrical Engineer III/IV to join our team. As an unmanned aerial systems (UAS) company, we are looking for an individual with experience overseeing small projects and wire harness production work, The ideal candidate should have experience producing, diagnosing and troubleshooting wire harnesses circuits in UAS platforms and should be familiar with Altium for documenting wire harness designs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop and test electrical systems and components for UAS platforms
* Develop and debug microcontroller systems and circuits
* Work with mechanical and software engineers to integrate electrical systems into UAS platforms
* Develop and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, and documentation for electrical systems in UAS platforms
* Act as the Avionics liaison between engineering and the production line.

* Develop and perform electrical tests and test procedures to verify system functionality
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality electrical systems

**Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field and 5+ years of experience
* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting circuits in UAS platforms
* Proficiency in Altium for circuit board / harness design
* Knowledge of analog and digital circuits, power supplies, and CAN bus communication
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work well in a team environment

Expected outcomes:

* 3 Months: Work on existing UAS electrical systems projects, learning our development processes and systems. Participate in cross-functional teams to integrate electrical systems into UAS platforms.
* 6 Months: Take on more responsibility, including leading small electrical systems projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Take over responsibility for closing out avionics NCRs from the production line.
* 12 Months: Take over full responsibility as the liaison between the avionics design engineering team and the production line.

Pay Range by level/location:

SLO: Level III - $131,000 - $161,000; Level IV - $160,000 - $200,000

* 40 hours of sick time

* Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

* Experience with backend technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Snowflake DB, Redis, message queues, and API orchestration.

* Experience with cloud-native delivery, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, secure deployment practices, and production support.

jobs.description:
***Position Function:***

This position is responsible for maintaining and supporting the bank's infrastructure and participates in various projects to continually improve its efficiency and security. Position requires a high level of technical knowledge to perform problem identification and resolution of hardware, software, network carrier, and security issues. Operates across several computer environments and platforms.

Designs, implements, administers, and supports the Bank's enterprise server, application, and cloud platforms. Performs the core responsibilities of a Senior Systems Engineer across operating systems, application hosting and middleware, identity, endpoint management, Microsoft 365 administration, certificates, deployment, monitoring, and production support, while providing additional senior-level engineering expertise in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Serves as a senior technical subject matter expert for hybrid systems and cloud solutions. Leads design and implementation of Azure and AWS services, cloud-hosted application platforms, migrations, automation, security controls, identity integration, resiliency, and operational standards. Coordinates with infrastructure-as-a-service and network providers while retaining technical ownership of server, application, cloud, identity, endpoint, and administration outcomes.

Performs all duties and interacts with internal and external customers in a manner that is expressly aligned with the Company's Core Values of approaching all actions with a “Voyaging Spirit” and being “Positively Ohana”.   + Performs senior systems-engineering responsibilities across Windows Server and, where applicable, Linux; Active Directory; DNS; DHCP; application hosting and middleware; application deployment; service accounts; monitoring; patching; and production troubleshooting.

  + Leads server and application lifecycle work including technical design, migrations, upgrades, implementation, rollback, validation, operational transition, and root-cause analysis.

  + Supports the Microsoft 365 administration suite including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, licensing, tenant configuration, security controls, service health, and issue resolution as assigned.
  + Integrates endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, on-premises systems, SaaS, Azure, and AWS services into consistent secure-access and administration patterns.

  + Provides network service support such as building servers, switches, routers, and workstations. Performs software testing and upgrades and assisting network users with network related problems. Ensures Enterprise systems are available to internal and external customers for access 24x7 and is operating at peak performance levels. Assists in communication and coordination of network maintenance schedules, backups, and other downtime to users.
* **Cloud Engineering**
  + Designs, deploys, configures, and administers Azure and AWS services supporting enterprise applications, including compute, storage, networking, load balancing, DNS, private connectivity, backup, monitoring, and appropriate managed platform services.
  + Designs and supports cloud-hosted application architectures, hybrid integrations, landing-zone patterns, subscriptions/accounts, resource organization, tagging, policy guardrails, and standardized platform configurations.
  + Implements cloud identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, RBAC, federation, SSO, MFA, service identities, application registrations, secrets, and least-privilege access patterns.
  + Leads cloud migrations and modernization efforts, including workload assessment, dependency mapping, target-state design, migration planning, testing, cutover, rollback, optimization, and operational handoff.
  + Troubleshoots complex cloud compute, application, identity, networking, security, performance, availability, and integration issues and serves as the senior escalation point for production cloud services.
* **Automation, Security, Reliability and Technical Leadership**
  + Builds and maintains automation and infrastructure-as-code using PowerShell, Python, APIs, Terraform and/or native cloud tooling such as ARM templates, or AWS CloudFormation to deliver repeatable and auditable deployments.
  + Implements monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, high availability, disaster recovery, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, encryption, policy compliance, and recovery testing for assigned systems and cloud services.

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. * Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud

* Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact

* Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met
* Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams
* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales
* Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* BS or BA in electrical, mechanical, or computer engineering, or equivalent hardware-engineering-related experience

**Description**

SAIC is seeking an experienced FPGA/Embedded-Systems Engineer to design, verify, and integrate advanced digital processing architectures. Senior Electro-Optical Systems Engineer

KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

  
  

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.

  
  

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

KBR is seeking a Senior Electro-Optical Engineer to support the MIST Contract with NASA at Goddard Space Flight Center. The Senior Electro-Optical Engineer will work on projects from inception at the concept development stage to completion at the product space flight qualification stage. The position requires a specialist's level of knowledge in the design and laboratory testing of remote sensing systems and knowledge of radiometric modeling, radiometric calibration test techniques and algorithms, and level one data processing algorithms and techniques.

* Work with other engineers, technicians, manufacturing, and quality engineers in a team environment

* Write test procedures, plans & reports as necessary

* 12 + years of experience as an electrical and/or electro-optical engineer in the aerospace arena.

* Experience with one or more of the following: BRDF measurements, fiber optics, fiber lasers, spectroscopy, integrated photonics, laser communication systems and RF photonics.

* Strong written and oral communication skills

* Strong knowledge in using Zemax or Code V for Aerospace applications with experience in design and/or analysis of optical assemblies and precision mechanisms.

* Knowledge of detectors, detector systems, fiber optics and the design and development of laser systems is desired
* Experience in the development and qualification of Flight Electro-Optical Systems
* Comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment to develop and implement new designs or help trouble-shoot existing ones.

Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.

Overview:

The Controls Engineer is responsible for the development, validation, and release of electronic control products, software-enabled features, and supporting applications used in Hussmann equipment. This role interprets customer needs, translates them into functional control solutions, and leads cross functional activities related to new product development, customer-driven requests, and existing product improvements. * Review system‑level control assemblies including embedded PCs, PLCs, power supplies, displays, sensors, wiring harnesses, and communication interfaces.
* Analyze and validate application‑specific electronics and 3rd‑party components for system compatibility and regulatory compliance.
* Perform system‑level and component‑level validation, testing, and analysis to ensure proper control operation and customer-driven functionality.
* Support validation of software behavior in control systems, including troubleshooting and identifying improvements.
* Contribute to the development of manuals, instructions, test procedures, user documentation, and technical bulletins.

* Work closely with Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Marketing, Field Service, and other teams to support new product development and product enhancements.
* Serve as a technical resource for field technicians, sales teams, and customers regarding control system behavior and product functionality.
* Create and communicate project plans, tasks, and deliverables; present concise updates at key milestones.
* Lead and support engineering activities required to meet KPIs, timelines, and customer expectations.
* Leverage internal and external experts to incorporate emerging technologies into Hussmann products and create competitive advantages.

**Continuous Improvement & Technical Development**

* Utilize diagnostic tools, validation equipment, and instrumentation to support development and troubleshooting of electronic control systems.
* Apply a strong understanding of refrigeration system behavior to evaluate control logic, sensor usage, and system protection strategies.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Peraton has an immediate opening for a Jr./Mid-level **Software Engineer** who will join our team at the White Sands Complex in Las Cruces, NM. Your role in this position will include software requirements gathering, software design, development, troubleshooting and debugging.

  

Peraton is the prime contractor on the SENSE contract for NASA at the White Sands Complex near Las Cruces, New Mexico. Operating here are two functionally identical satellite ground terminals: The White Sands Ground Terminal, and the second TDRSS Ground Terminal. These two terminals ensure uninterrupted communications between various ground stations, NASA’s orbiting fleet of Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS), customer spacecraft (satellites), and the computer systems that support such spacecraft. * Performs systems modeling, simulation and analysis to provide appropriate telemetry, tracking, and command software solutions.

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud

jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  
​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Electrical Engineer​ to join our ​Air-to-Ground Communications (AG COMM)​ team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​on-site​ position at the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
​​The AG COMM program comprises the infrastructure, facilities, and protocols that allow air traffic controllers to communicate via voice and data with pilots in flight.​
  
  
Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  

* Be a US Citizen.
* Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Relocation Requirement
  
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
Education & Experience Requirement
  
  
All non-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate at the time of application.
  

* A ​Bachelors (ABET)​ degree in ​Engineering or related IT field, such as Physics, Aerospace, Chemistry, Computer Science, or Mathematics.​
* Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is highly desirable.​
* 3 - 6​ years of related work experience.

Required Skills
  

* Solid foundation in circuit theory, power systems, grounding, and signal integrity.
* Skilled in interpreting schematics, wiring diagrams, and system block diagrams.
* Structured troubleshooting methodology including root cause analysis and fault isolation.
* Understanding of system integration principles involving hardware, firmware, and software interaction.
* Experience with programming in Python.
* Supports field service calls and explains complex technical issues to non-technical personnel.​
* Ability to:
* Work independently, as well as on a team, in an agile environment.
* Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
* Learn on the job/willing to self-teach.
* Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.
* Write clear, structured technical documentation.

Preferred Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with industry safety standards and electrical best practices.
* Support for electrical engineering tasks in lab, field, and production environments.
* Participation in after-hours or mission-critical support when required.
* Working knowledge of Windows, UNIX, and UNIX-like operating systems (AIX, Linux).
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving experience.
* Experience with networking protocols and technologies including TCP, UDP, DHCP, SNMP, and VoIP.
* Understanding the importance of testing throughout all phases of engineering and programming.
* Ability to merge and apply technical skills across multiple environments and tasks.​

Essential Daily Job Duties
  
  

* Evaluate electrical systems, equipment, and applications.
* Take and support field service calls.
* Provide real-time troubleshooting support to field technicians.
* Document incident findings and corrective actions.
* Support remote and on-site system diagnostics.
* Participate in after-hours or mission-critical support when required.
* Contribute to system and hardware design, development, and testing.
* Create and update documentation for systems and hardware.​

Work Environment
  
  

* Standard flexible work schedule.
* Travel is ​10 - 25%​.
* Cubicle environment.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I, Manufacturing and Test
jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test**

**Reading Thermal Systems (RTS) | Reading Bakery Systems**

Put your electrical engineering knowledge to work on instruments that measure temperature, heat flux, air velocity, and humidity.

RTS is seeking an Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test to support the manufacture, testing, calibration, and improvement of thermal measurement products, including the SCORPION® data logging system. You’ll work alongside experienced engineering and manufacturing personnel, gain hands-on experience with sensors and electronics, and help ensure products meet established quality and performance requirements.

This early-career opportunity is suited to an electrical engineering graduate who enjoys hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and practical problem-solving.

**What You’ll Do**

Your primary responsibilities will be:

* **Outgoing quality assurance — approximately 50%:** Test finished products before shipment, document findings, and verify compliance with established procedures.
* **Calibration support — approximately 25%:** Calibrate customer data loggers and sensors returned for service.

The remaining 25% of your role will include:

* Investigating production issues and troubleshooting circuitry, components, firmware, and measurement systems with guidance from experienced engineering staff.
* Creating and updating test specifications, work instructions, manufacturing records, and training materials.
* Helping develop, build, and validate production test systems, fixtures, and calibration procedures.
* Conducting engineering tests and analyzing product accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Supporting the transition of prototypes into repeatable manufacturing processes.
* Assisting with component substitutions and engineering changes.
* Reviewing production and field data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Supporting product assembly, repair, and manufacturing activities as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Foundational knowledge of circuits, printed circuit boards, microprocessors, C programming, and CAD.
* Hands-on testing and troubleshooting experience from coursework, laboratory work, projects, internships, or employment.
* Familiarity with hardware and software interfaces used in test equipment or measurement systems.
* Interest in sensors, instrumentation, physics, and thermal measurement.
* Ability to interpret schematics, engineering drawings, and technical instructions.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to handle small components and perform fine-pitch soldering and rework.
* A willingness to learn, follow established procedures, and work collaboratively.

Experience with calibration, embedded firmware, data acquisition, thermal systems, or production fixtures is a plus.

**Work Requirements**

This position may require overnight domestic travel and occasional international travel. Responsibilities include regularly lifting or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds. Work may involve production baking environments with high temperatures, humidity, noise, and other manufacturing hazards. Appropriate personal protective equipment is required.

Twenty-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty-Six Defense supports those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.
  
Fueled by more than 800 talented employees and a proud 65-year legacy of night vision production excellence, Twenty-Six Defense’s Warfighter Systems business is rooted in the heart of Virginia’s Roanoke Valley. Surrounded by the scenic beauty of the Blue Ridge Mountains, you’ll find a unique blend of southern hospitality, outdoor adventure, and the energy of a thriving city – all alongside a purpose you can be proud of coming to work each day.
  
As a world leader in low-light sensor technology, the Warfighter Systems team is engineering the future of image intensifiers and night vision goggle systems as we enter a new era of the networked battlespace. Trusted by the U.S. and nearly 100 allied countries, our technology supports those in harm’s way during the most critical moments, with one goal in mind: bring them home safely.
  
The work our employees perform each day plays a direct role in national security, and our shared purpose is what truly makes Warfighter Systems so extraordinary. Join our collaborative team, where each voice is valued, and you can thrive, develop, and make a real impact!
  
  
Job Summary

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers
* Drive complex technical investigations globally and spanning multiple disciplines such as Hardware, Software/Firmware, Networking and Power & Cooling
* Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact
* Work closely with HW Engineering, Release to Production, and Systems Integration teams to take new server and storage platforms into mass production in the data centers
* Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met
* Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams
* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales
* Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities
* Move to MINIMUM\_QUALIFICATION section

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* BS or BA in electrical, mechanical, or computer engineering, or equivalent hardware-engineering-related experience
* 10+ years of experience with server hardware systems in an internet operations environment, or on a development team in design or test validation
* Experience triaging and debugging hardware platforms
* Familiarity or experience in NPI server platform development
* Familiarity with Linux or Unix Operating systems
* Experience training and mentoring technicians and/or engineers
* Demonstrated technical skills and experience creating documentation for users of all levels
* Communication experience and interpersonal skills, with the experience communicating and partnering effectively within all levels of the organization
* Experience with building relationships with customers and vendors

jobs.title: PKI Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618069

**Location:** Springfield, VA, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-16

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Systems Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** No

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Top\_Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

**Position Description:**

The Enterprise & Mission Solution Business Unit currently has an opening for a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Systems Engineer to support the Department of State (DoS) Bureau of Information Resource Management (IRM) PKI program. This program provides transparent security services in support of the Department’s goals to secure communications among Department staff and systems. The position falls under the "Vanguard 2.2.1" contract.

This is a senior-level PKI engineering position within the Vanguard 2.2.1 program’s Enterprise Engineering Office (EEO), providing PKI engineering and integration support, administering, maintaining, and deploying various PKI systems based on Entrust solutions, onsite at the various DoS Datacenters and at certain selected DoS domestic and overseas locations. The preferred candidate must possess strong skills in designing, installing, configuring, and maintaining PKI systems. Additionally the preferred candidate should have some experience in providing tier-3 level support in large enterprises.

  

**Description of Duties:**

* Providing PKI engineering support in the operation of a number of PKI systems deployed at the Department of State.
* Manage and maintain enclaved server hardware, storage, switches, server operating systems, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
* Directly working with customer to analyze requirements and then deploy security related solutions to meet those requirements.
* Providing problem analysis following any service issues to prevent recurrence
* Performing product evaluations and making product recommendations
* Identifying security risks to systems and suggest mitigations
* Developing test cases for software/hardware testing and developing test evaluation reports for stakeholders.
* Developing and updating systems documentation (e.g., ConOps, Operating procedures, systems architecture documents)

**Qualifications**

**Required Education/Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s degree or 3 years of relevant work experience with a Master’s degree
* Excellent MS-Windows Server administration & maintenance
* Familiarity with PKIs and related technologies (LDAP directories, HSMs, OCSP) and security practices
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Working knowledge of Entrust suite of PKI products (Security Manager, Administration Services, Security Manager Proxy) especially in a government setting.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
* Experience with directory products (LDAP), such as Critical Path or Active Directory
* CISSP, Security+, or similar certification
* Network device configuration – Cisco and Juniper firewalls and switches
* Network infrastructure diagnostics (TCP/IP general networking knowledge, network monitoring tools)
* Virtualization technologies (ESX/ESXi)
* Working knowledge of External storage solutions
* Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent written and oral communications.

**Desired Experience/Skills/Attributes:**

* Working knowledge of Entrust suite of PKI products (Security Manager, Administration Services, Security Manager Proxy) especially in a government setting.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
* Experience with directory products (LDAP), such as Critical Path or Active Directory
* CISSP, Security+, or similar certification
* Network device configuration – Cisco and Juniper firewalls and switches
* Network infrastructure diagnostics (TCP/IP general networking knowledge, network monitoring tools)
* Virtualization technologies (ESX/ESXi)
* Working knowledge of External storage solutions
* Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent written and oral communications.

  
Target salary range: $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

* Knowledge of manufacturing or production process workflows .

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. The **Effector Digital Products** (EDP) department designs digital electronic circuit cards and electronic units which are supported from proposal through transition to production. Our systems are subject to environments ranging from the frigid, sub-zero vacuum of space to the blistering heat of the desert floor, to the high pressures of the ocean depths.

The Digital, RF and Power Team is seeking a **Principal Digital Design Engineer** with digital electronics design and analysis skills to join our team.

This position is **100% ONSITE** in Tucson, Arizona.

**What You Will Do**

We are looking for candidates willing to collaborate, innovate, and team with our engineers to generate and utilize today’s cutting-edge technology to design digital electronics circuits that implement missile guidance, video and digital signal processing. Our technology base includes high-speed digital electronics, configurable logic, and homogeneous / heterogeneous multiprocessor designs.

The **Principal Digital Design Engineer** is responsible for the design, analysis, simulation, test, and integration of digital electronic modules and/or CCAs for Missile applications. The candidate should be experienced in all aspects of circuit card design including:

* hardware designs with processors
* FPGAs
* memory
* industry interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, and UART

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience
* Minimum of 8 years of engineering digital circuit design experience to include at least 2 of the following:
  + Development and design of electronic circuit designs, multi-assembly system/unit design
  + Ability to take a design concept from the block diagram or requirements level to development of a complete hardware design, and verification via test and integration
  + Experience with PCB design process and expertise in tools used to design (schematic capture), analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Experience with embedded test techniques, design for test, design margin analysis and design for production for complex circuit card assemblies between 16 and 32 layers
* Experience using Mentor Graphics Design Creation (Siemens EDA) tools: DxDesigner, xDX Designer VX, and Xilinx (Zynq Ultrascale, Vivado, Atrix)
* Experience using PCB electronic circuit design software: HyperLynx signal integrity, power integrity, and analog simulation, Xpedition Enterprise (xPCB)
* Constraint Editor System (CES)
* Experience with FPGA code development or software
* Experience leading a program transition from development to production
* Experience managing technical/schedule risks to identify cost reduction opportunities to meet assigned deadlines
* Experience with intellectual property generation (patents & publications)

**What We Offer**

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

* This position offers relocation

Employees who are working in **Onsite roles will work primarily onsite**. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our electrical ground support equipment group in our Chandler, AZ facility. * LabVIEW/TestStand programming and NI hardware and software products.
* Contributions to process improvement initiatives.
* CompTIA Security+ or similar certifications.
* Usage and troubleshooting of networks, Windows systems, and RHEL or other Linux distributions.
* Experience with classified test systems or systems subject to cyber security policies.

jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Mainspring Energy has fundamentally redefined onsite power generation. Our breakthrough product—the Mainspring Linear Generator (LGen)—is a completely new category of energy technology. Distinct from an engine, turbine, or fuel cell, the LGen directly converts straight-line motion into electricity using a low-temperature, non-combustion thermochemical reaction.

With only two moving parts per core, a frictionless air-bearing system, and zero-flame chemical conversions, we deliver over 46% net AC electrical efficiency. More importantly, it is the world’s only commercially available technology capable of real-time fuel-switching under load, seamlessly transitioning between natural gas, biogas/RNG, propane, hydrogen, and ammonia.

Behind this mechanical simplicity lies an incredibly complex software abstraction layer. To achieve dynamic load-following, sub-millisecond grid synchronization, and real-time thermochemical adaptive fuel mixing, our proprietary controls manage thousands of high-frequency variables simultaneously.

As a Senior Staff Software Test & Automation Engineer, you will architect the core validation and automation frameworks that ensure this distributed energy asset operates with 100% safety and utility-scale reliability. You will own the strategy for testing the intersection of real-time embedded software, predictive control loops, and multi-fuel dynamics.
