jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Software
jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 115792

**Location:** Germantown, MD

**Business Unit:** DRS RADA Technologies

**Schedule:** 9/80

**Shift:** First

  

DRS RADA Technologies, a subsidiary of Leonardo DRS, is focused on proprietary radar solutions and legacy avionics systems supporting the defense industry globally. The company is a global pioneer of AESA tactical radars for active military protection, counter-drone applications, critical infrastructure protection, and border surveillance.

**The Role:**
-------------

We are seeking a Senior Software Systems Engineer to advance our systems engineering capabilities in the US, serve as the primary interface between the systems engineering and software engineering teams, and manage our product software configurations. This role will be responsible for identifying, developing, and improving the interfaces for RADA software products and managing requirements for those products. Responsibilities will involve a mix of systems engineering and configuration management.

**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

* Define user needs, functional and product architectures, and product requirements.
* Utilize Model-Based Systems Engineering tools, such as Cameo Enterprise Architecture to capture systems engineering artifacts.
* Maintain and track system-level and product-level configurations to ensure compatibility between components within radar systems.
* Independently evaluate, test, and verify software products against requirements and document results.
* Collaborate closely with software, systems, hardware, integration, and test teams to understand system behavior and deliver working solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, documentation, and engineering process improvements.
* Lead assigned technical work, communicate technical risks and tradeoffs clearly, and provide guidance to other engineers as needed.

**What You Bring:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, plus at least five years of relevant systems engineering experience.
* Experience with version control tools such as git
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in integrated or system-level software environments.
* Ability to own technical work independently and collaborate effectively across software, systems, hardware, integration, and test teams.
* Broad systems engineering experience including thorough understanding of requirements management, functional requirements parsing, derivation, and allocation; systems design, systems integration, technical risk identification and management strategies, and Verification and Validation (V&V) principles.
* Experience developing system engineering artifacts (e.g. specifications, Interface Control Documents, Use Cases, System Architecture Descriptions, Trade Studies, etc.).
* U.S. citizenship is required, along with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

**What This Role Is Not:**
--------------------------

* This is not a software development role. While you will manage software requirements and systems configuration, the implementation will be done by the software team.
* This is not a remote position. This full-time role is based on-site in Germantown, Maryland, where close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, integration, and test teams is essential.
* This is not an entry-level engineering role. The Senior Systems Engineer is expected to work independently, lead assigned technical work, make sound engineering decisions, and provide guidance to other team members.
* You will not work in isolation. You will work within a cross-functional team and contribute to systems that must perform reliably in demanding real-world defense environments.

**What We Bring:**
------------------

At DRS RADA Technologies, your work supports technologies that help protect military personnel, critical infrastructure, and communities around the world. You will join a mission-driven team developing advanced radar technology that supports system performance and real-world defense applications.

  

We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company contribution to a health savings account; telemedicine; life and disability insurance; legal insurance; and a 401(k) savings plan. We invest in employee well-being, career growth, professional development, and skill enhancement, and offer a flexible 9/80 schedule, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.

U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

  

*The salary range for this position is* ***$107,089.00 -$144,570.00 per year****. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

Passionate about developing software and modeling complex phenomena?

Enjoy collaborating with internal and external partners to understand their needs and help solve their problems?

**If so, we're looking for someone like you to join the Air Combat and Strike Mission Analysis Group!**

We are seeking a motivated software engineer to help us build innovative modeling and simulation (M&S) applications to support the development of next-generation strike weapons, combat air vehicles and other critical capabilities. We are also exploring how emerging AI-enabled software development tools can complement strong software engineering practices and help our team work more effectively. You'll be joining our team of developers and analysts who work together to create a variety of solutions to multifaceted challenges. This approach depends on strong software engineering judgment, with experienced developers responsible for driving technical decisions, guiding the use of these tools, and critically reviewing and validating their results.

We are a large team of 50+ engineers, physicists, mathematicians, and computer scientists who perform mission-level analysis to drive acquisition decisions on important precision strike technologies. Our work is sophisticated, engaging, and frequently has significant impact on Department of Defense programs. We believe in building strong, productive teams, continually growing our capabilities, cultivating collaborative relationships and encouraging a work environment that embraces integrity, trust, confidence, teamwork, accountability, and a little bit of fun. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The Imaging team is seeking a Senior Embedded Engineer to design a new product lines. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define, complete the design and analysis, build prototypes leading to ground and flight testing, and mature the prototypes into products.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead FPGA architecture, standards, development and review processes
* FPGA Development: Designing, architecting, simulating, and integrating VHDL designs into FPGAs or Systems on Chip (SoC) for optimized performance, resource utilization, and power efficiency.
* Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (electrical engineers, software engineers, systems engineers) to ensure seamless integration of the firmware with the overall system, including processor bring-up and board support packages.
* Testing and Validation: Developing robust test benches in VHDL/Verilog and utilizing lab tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers for rigorous testing and validation of designs against functional specifications and performance requirements.
* Optimization: Optimizing the algorithms for hardware acceleration, including MIPS optimization and efficient use of on-chip bus protocols like AXI or AXI-Stream.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field is typically required.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience developing HDL firmware for FPGA devices
* Hardware Description Languages: Expertise in VHDL and/or Verilog/SystemVerilog is essential for RTL (Register Transfer Level) design.
* FPGA Tools: Experience with industry-standard FPGA design tools such as Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus.
* Debugging Skills: Strong hardware/software debugging skills using standard lab equipment.
* Version Control: Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git) for collaborative development.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated experience designing with multi-gigabit SERDES, DDR memory busses, Ethernet MAC and PHY interfaces, FPGAs, and common communication busses like SPI and I2C
* Embedded software development experience with the use of timers, interrupts, hardware peripherals such as SPI controllers and ADCs
* Knowledge of embedded Linux development, including device trees, hardware drivers, bootloaders, and basic Unix/Linux tools
* Familiar with common programming languages like Python and MATLAB
* Familiarity with infrared image sensor technology

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-Time

In Person: Boston, MA Headquarters

*Step into a foundational engineering role at a fast-growing grid intelligence company.*

We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Linux Engineer** to join our customer focused team, take charge of the Linux kernel, drivers, and bootloader beneath our current technology, and shape the embedded architecture of future generation products.

LineVision’s customers include eight of the ten largest US utilities, which rely on field deployed device sensors to run securely and reliably. You will work on ruggedized, solar-powered sensors mounted on poles away from the transmission lines they monitor. Each pairs a Linux compute module with a companion microcontroller, connects over cellular, and must run for years without a site visit.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Embedded Software Engineering, you will have broad autonomy over kernel and bootloader maintenance, security patching, board bring-up, system software improvements, and device security, including secure boot. You will bridge a hardware-focused embedded team with Data Science and Computer Vision, moving algorithms onto the device and raising the team’s software depth, delivering LineVision devices that are lean, secure, and ready for what comes next.

Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

### **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives**

* Maintain the Linux kernel and bootloader on LineVision devices, including security patching, driver development, and operating system improvements
* Lead board bring-up on new hardware platforms, from first boot through production
* Drive system software improvements across the device platform, including performance, power efficiency, and reliability
* Design hardware-level device security, including secure boot and factory-signed software, with hardware and manufacturing teams
* Work with Data Science and Computer Vision to adapt algorithms for low-footprint, on-device execution, using the NPU, GPU, and other hardware blocks where they save CPU and power
* Own the Linux BSP and build system for the platform, including device trees, OS image releases, and the kernel and bootloader upgrade strategy
* Lead root cause analysis on cross-layer problems such as kernel crashes, power and thermal behavior, and field or manufacturing failures that span hardware and software
* Influence SoC, module, and peripheral selection for future hardware, weighing Linux support, vendor BSP quality, long-term maintainability, and security features
* Set technical standards for embedded Linux through design reviews, code review, and mentoring, and act as the technical resource for engineers across hardware, firmware, and cloud application software

### **Within the first 3 months:**

* Assume day-to-day responsibility for kernel, driver, and bootloader work, with a documented security patching process
* Baseline current system performance, including boot time, shutdown time, and power draw
* Review the platform’s kernel, bootloader, and security posture and present a prioritized technical roadmap to Engineering leadership

### **Within the first 6 months:**

* Ship production system software improvements with measurable gains against the baseline
* Define the device security architecture and roadmap with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, and the security team, covering secure boot and chain of trust, signed software and updates, key management and factory provisioning, protection of debug and physical interfaces, data protection, and regulatory cybersecurity requirements such as EU RED

### **Within the first year:**

* Lead the embedded software architecture for the next generation sensor, covering OS, bootloader, update mechanism, and security, and document the decisions for the wider team
* Establish a repeatable workflow with Data Science and Computer Vision for moving models and algorithms onto the device
* Grow the team’s embedded Linux depth through design reviews, code review, and coaching, so kernel and driver work no longer depends on one person

**How to succeed in this role**
-------------------------------

### **Key Competencies**

* **Critical Thinking:** Develop frameworks for solving complex embedded problems, from kernel behavior to hardware interactions. Mentor teammates in structured debugging and root cause analysis.
* **Delivering Innovative Solutions:** Develop strategies for the device software platform, including the next generation, and guide the team in executing them.
* **Empowering Others:** Coach engineers on Linux and software practices while learning about LineVision’s hardware from teammates. Drive initiatives that develop the team.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Develop approaches for working with Data Science, Computer Vision, and hardware teams. Influence decisions on what runs where on the device.

### **Essential Skills**

* Linux kernel and device driver development in C, including device trees and common bus and camera interfaces
* Bootloader development (U-Boot or similar) and board bring-up of new SoCs or modules
* Embedded Linux security patching and maintenance over a multi-year product life, including CVE triage and kernel upgrades
* A software engineering background with strong working knowledge of hardware: reading schematics and datasheets, debugging with JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers
* Scripting in Python and Bash
* A track record of technical leadership: setting direction for a platform or subsystem and raising the bar for the engineers around you

### **What Sets the Best Candidates Apart**

* Hardware-level device security experience, including secure boot, chain of trust, key management, and secure factory provisioning
* Experience optimizing embedded Linux for boot time, power, and reliability
* Experience running workloads on NPU

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.  
  
The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range—and ideally energized by it.  
  
If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own fielded system success.** You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise—whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware—you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.  
  
**Build and maintain production services.** You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.  
  
**Support field operations.** You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.  
  
**Represent the team externally.** You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.  
  
**Maintain end-to-end system understanding.** Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail.  
  
**Collaborate across teams.** You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.  
  
Travel expected approximately 15% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in software development with meaningful production responsibility—not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship
* Strong Python and C++ skills. You don't need to be a language expert in both, but you need to be able to work effectively in either
* 5+ years working in Linux-based environments, including bare-metal hardware
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences
* Willingness to travel approximately 15% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance

**Preferred**

* Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks
* Familiarity with systems service management and observability practices on Linux
* React/JSX experience; we have a UI surface and it matters
* Familiarity with Nix or NixOS—uncommon, but genuinely valuable on our stack
* Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments

**What are Trust Fund Positions?**

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Childcare), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).

The Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory (SAO) is at the forefront, internationally, of the scientific exploration of the universe. Its programs range from ground-based astronomy and astrophysics research to space-based research, the engineering and development of major scientific instrumentation for space launch and use in large ground-based facilities, and research designed to improve science education. The research objectives of SAO are carried out primarily with the support of Government and Smithsonian Institution funds, with additional philanthropic support. Government funds are in the form of Federal appropriations or the form of contracts and grants from other agencies. In contrast, Institution funds are available to SAO through grants from the Institution's Restricted Funds, Special Purpose Funds, Bureau Activities, Business Activities, and non-Federal contracts and grants.

* Review radar system designs and implement updates within the simulation environment.
* Develop software tools and components that emulate radar system behavior.
* Conduct performance data analysis and automate workflows using MATLAB.
* Verify and validate simulation performance against fielded radar systems.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to enhance digital simulations, support multi‑mission scenario analysis, and troubleshoot radar performance issues.
* Support integration of high‑fidelity radar simulations into systems operated by other U.S. Government organizations.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience.
* Experience in Systems Engineering and/or Software Engineering.
* Experience working in an Agile environment and/or on Agile development projects

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Excellent communication, technical writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interface directly with customers and lead technical solutions.
* Prior experience with the AN/TPY‑2 system and/or broader Missile Defense programs, including work on large, complex systems.
* Strong understanding of radar systems engineering, including radar design, analysis, modeling, and hands‑on simulation experience.
* Proficiency in software development, including Python and C++, and expertise in MATLAB for data analysis and automation.

* Proven experience with current Missile defense programs with specific experience in large, complex systems.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with time-critical requirements.

jobs.title: Staff IT Systems Engineer, Endpoints
jobs.description:
**Your Impact at LILA**

Lila is hiring a **Staff IT Systems Engineer, Endpoints** to own the architecture and roadmap for endpoint management across the company. This role sits within IT & Security and supports the technology every scientist, engineer, and employee relies on, including laptops, mobile devices, specialized research compute, endpoint security, and device trust.

We treat endpoint management as a software engineering discipline. Configuration, policy, remediation, and fleet operations should move through code, CI/CD, staged rollout, observability, and automated rollback. This is a hands-on staff-level role for someone who can set technical standards, build missing tooling, mentor engineers, and lead cross-functional initiatives across IT, Security, Research Computing, and Lab Operations.

As Lila scales its workforce and physical footprint, endpoint systems need to become more automated, secure, auditable, and seamless. The right person will help employees and scientists become productive faster while reducing device risk, operational noise, and manual toil.

**What You'll Be Building**

* Own the architecture and roadmap for Lila's endpoint fleet across macOS, Windows, Linux, mobile devices, and specialized research or lab computing endpoints.
* Define standards for endpoint configuration, policy, remediation, observability, and rollout practices across the IT & Security team.
* Drive configuration-as-code adoption for MDM policies, profiles, scripts, staged rollouts, canary groups, and automated rollback.
* Design zero-touch provisioning workflows so devices arrive encrypted, configured, compliant, and productive out of the box.
* Partner with Security to integrate endpoint posture, device trust, vulnerability data, EDR, and Zero Trust access controls.
* Build automation and internal tooling using scripts, APIs, CI/CD, and AI-assisted engineering practices to reduce manual toil.
* Improve vulnerability and patch management through telemetry, dashboards, drift detection, and auditable compliance workflows.
* Support specialized computing environments, including research workstations, lab-adjacent systems, VDI, managed browsers, and remote-access patterns where appropriate.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues and mentor engineers across IT and Security.
* Partner across Security, Legal, HR, Research Computing, and Lab Operations to protect sensitive IP while keeping the employee experience seamless.

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* Deep experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with staff-level technical ownership.
* Strong experience with modern MDM or UEM platforms such as Jamf, Intune, Workspace ONE, or similar tools.
* Experience managing endpoint configuration through code, automation, version control, staged rollout, or CI/CD practices.
* Strong systems knowledge across macOS and Windows endpoint environments.
* Ability to build and maintain automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, APIs, or similar tooling.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering, LLM APIs, internal copilots, or agentic automation to reduce operational toil in IT, endpoint, infrastructure, or platform operations.
* Experience partnering with Security on endpoint hardening, device trust, vulnerability management, EDR, or Zero Trust initiatives.
* Strong troubleshooting ability across endpoint, identity, network, application, and user-experience boundaries.
* Track record mentoring engineers, setting technical standards, and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience supporting scientific, research, lab, OT, or high-performance computing environments.
* Familiarity with Okta, SAML, SCIM, device trust, SASE, EDR, or cloud access patterns.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, cloud-native infrastructure, or cloud-based endpoint telemetry workflows.
* Experience with open-source endpoint tooling such as osquery, Fleet, Munki, or similar tools.
* Experience building VDI, managed browser, call center, or contact center computing environments.
* Proficiency in Go, Swift, or another language used for custom endpoint tooling.
* Experience in a regulated, IP-sensitive, biotech, life-sciences, or research environment.

**About LILA**

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

**We're All In**

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
Vehicle Controls Engineer

**Unique Systems Design, Inc. (USDI) — Madison Heights, MI 48071**

**Location:** Madison Heights, MI 48071 **Compensation:** $75,000 – $100,000 per year

About USDI

USDI has provided engineering and technical solutions since 1987, supporting customers across embedded systems, software development, systems engineering, electrical architecture, and advanced technology programs. USDI specializes in delivering experienced engineering resources and practical technical solutions for complex development environments across automotive, industrial, defense, and high-reliability applications.

Position Summary

We're looking for a Vehicle Controls Engineer to join our team developing embedded control algorithms that run onboard vehicles, using Model-Based Design (MBD) methodology in MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow. This role is focused on real-time control software for vehicle systems — vehicle speed control, drive-by-wire, and related ECU-based functions — not industrial/factory automation or PLC-based process control. It's a great fit for someone building a career in automotive controls engineering who wants hands-on experience across the full development cycle, working alongside experienced engineers.

Responsibilities

* Develop and test embedded control algorithms for onboard vehicle systems in MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow under the guidance of senior team members
* Apply Model-Based Design methodology, from requirements through auto-code generation for deployment on vehicle ECUs
* Support calibration and validation of vehicle speed control systems
* Assist with drive-by-wire system development and testing
* Participate in bench and vehicle testing, and help troubleshoot issues found during validation
* Collaborate with systems, software, hardware, and test engineers in an agile team environment
* Track work and manage issues using Git and Jira
* Grow technical depth in automotive/vehicle controls through mentorship and applied project work

Required Qualifications

* Working knowledge of MATLAB and Simulink (coursework, internship, or project experience acceptable)
* Exposure to Model-Based Design methodology

Preferred Qualifications

* Coursework or project experience related to drive-by-wire systems
* Exposure to vehicle speed control system concepts
* Familiarity with New Eagle products or the Raptor development toolchain

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with high-voltage systems

General Requirements

* Some experience with version control and issue-tracking tools and workflows (Git, Jira)
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment
* Strong desire to learn and grow technical skills in a mentorship-supported environment

*Note: This is a vehicle/automotive embedded controls role. It does not involve PLC programming, SCADA/HMI, or factory/assembly-line automation — candidates from an industrial automation controls background without automotive/embedded experience are not a fit for this position.*

Pay: $75,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**General Responsibilities:**

The Software Design Engineer is primarily responsible for developing software component design specifications, based on the software architecture design specification. The software component design specifications are the deliverable to the software coders, so they are very detailed - specifying the static structure and the dynamic behavior of the software component.

The engineer will monitor the work of the software coders and testers, providing direction and clarification as needed, and work on the code themselves. Participate and occasionally lead code reviews, unit test reviews, and functional/integration test reviews.

The engineer will follow the lead of a Software Architect, and may support the architect in parsing customer requirements, developing sub-sections of a software requirements specification or developing sub-sections of a software architecture specification.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Includes the following (other duties may be documented and assigned by local management and some duties may not apply dependent upon the requirements of the position at each specific Astemo site and/or the strengths of the employee and the needs of the company):

* Develop software component design specifications
* Develop software unit test specifications
* Attend, and potentially lead, software design reviews
* Conduct technical impact analysis for software change requests
* Identify technical risks in the design, and develop mitigation strategies
* Assist software coders work progress; develop source code as necessary to maintain program timelines
* Participate or lead code reviews, unit test reviews, and integration test reviews
* Support development of software requirements specification (SRS) and software architecture specification sub-sections, if needed by the software architect
* Support development of integration test specification sub-sections, if needed by the software architect
* Support source code integration, diff, merge, branching, check-in, etc., if needed by the software coders
* Support unit test and integration test execution, if needed by the software testers

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years' experience in writing embedded software in C with knowledge of Eclipse IDE or similar preferred
* **Microcontrollers.** 32-bit automotive multi-core micros. Renesas E2x/RH850 family; Infineon Aurix TCxx family; NXP MPC55xx family.
* **Microcontroller Hardware.** Timers (GTM,TPU,WDT), Memory (RAM, FLASH, ECC, DMA), Peripherals (ADC,PWM,GPIO,CAN,SENT,UART,LIN,SPI), Safety (SMU, FCCU), etc.
* **Hardware IC Devices.** High side drivers, low side drivers, H-Bridge, injection drivers, knock drivers, solenoid drivers, WRAF drivers, CAN Transceivers, etc.
* **Software Design Tools.** Requirements modeling, UML modeling, AUTOSAR configuration, RTOS configuration, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
* **Software Development Tools.** Cross compilers, static code analysis, in-circuit debuggers, serial communication tools, HIL systems, measurement & calibration tools.
* **Test Equipment.** Oscilloscope, multimeter, logic analyzer, current probes, function generator, etc.
* **Software Process/Standards.** V-Model, MISRA, ASPICE, ISO26262

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Company is currently seeking a **Systems Software Engineer (Associate, Experienced or Senior)** to support our Software Development team within the **Phantom Works Network Centric Operations** team in **Berkeley, Missouri (St. Louis, MO area).** This position will focus on supporting the Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) Software Engineering organization.

  
  

Our teams are currently hiring for a *broad range of experience levels* including; Associate, Experienced and Senior Level Software Engineers.

  
  

The **Network Centric Operations Team** designs, develops, and implements platform-agnostic software capabilities that enable network operations for tactical fighter aircraft. As a Data Fusion Software Engineer, you’ll develop and prototype advanced sensor-fusion algorithms, applying mathematical and statistical techniques to track and combine data from multiple sensors and sources. You’ll evaluate algorithm performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and partner with the software architect to transition successful prototypes into production-ready capabilities.

  
  

We’re looking for a collaborative, accountable professional who is committed to customer satisfaction and continuous process improvement. The successful candidate will thrive in a multi-contract, multi-program environment and apply ingenuity and innovation to complex challenges.

  
  

You should be adaptable and eager to learn new technologies in evolving development environments. You’ll bring a strong foundation in mathematics and the ability to translate theoretical concepts into practical, real-world solutions, along with the drive to solve difficult problems and contribute to a team’s success.

  
  

**Join Us. Power the Mission.**

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Derive and quantify data fusion algorithms and techniques (Kalman Filters, Bayesian Networks, statistical modeling, etc.)
* Author and maintain technical description documents, requirements and algorithm analysis memos (AAMs) for data fusion algorithms and techniques
* Analyze data fusion techniques for accuracy and effectiveness
* Develop prototype algorithms (C++, Python, MatLab, etc)
* Partner with software architect(s) to inform effective and efficient algorithm implementation and design
* Collect, organize, synthesize, and analyze data; summarize findings; develop conclusions and recommendations from appropriate data sources

* Bachelor's Degree
* **Ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S.** Citizenship
* 2+ years' experience with sensors, sensor management and fusion, datalinks, and/or weapons and their interactions
* 2+ years' experience with data fusion engines, kinematic correlation techniques and Kalman filters
* Experience with pattern recognition, multi-modal sensor data fusion, sensor calibration and visualization technologies
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* 3 or more years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 5 or more years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* **Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance**
* **Associate** (Level 2): Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 2+ years of related work experience **OR** Bachelor’s Degree and 6+ years of directly related work experience **OR** 10+ years of related, relevant experience
* **Experienced** (Level 3): Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 5+ years of related work experience **OR** Bachelor’s Degree and 9+ years of directly related work experience **OR** 13+ years of related, relevant experience
* **Senior** (Level 4): Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 9+ years of related work experience **OR** Bachelor’s Degree and 13+ years of directly related work experience **OR** 17+ years of related, relevant experience

* Self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment
* Skill and ability to: collect, organize, synthesize, and analyze data; summarize findings; develop conclusions and recommendations from appropriate data sources
* Experience with sensor data such as Radar and various infrared sensors
* Experience developing and implementing probabilistic models to combine sensor data such as Bayesian reasoning, Kalman filtering and evidence theory
* Experience with advanced probability statistics and applying in real world scenarios

**Job Title: Software Engineer – MES Level**

**Job Code: 46280**

**Job Location:** **Camden, NJ**

**Schedule: 9/80 reg with every other Friday off**

Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level and be a part of something truly extraordinary? Join our trailblazing team in the Philadelphia metro area, where you'll dive into the thrilling world of high-assurance encryption products and programs that are pivotal to national defense. Our rapidly expanding business is not just growing—it's exploding with opportunities for innovation and impact in network and tactical encryption products and systems. Imagine working on the front lines of technology, developing state-of-the-art solutions that safeguard our nation's security. You'll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry, in an environment that champions creativity and excellence. If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges and eager to contribute to groundbreaking projects that make a real difference to our warfighters, citizens, and nation; this is your chance to shine. Apply now and embark on this exhilarating journey with us, shaping the future of defense technology!

**Job Description:**

L3Harris Integrated Mission Systems is seeking a Software Engineer. Responsibilities include the translation of requirements into working and maintainable solutions for our ntegrated Systems & Encryption division. The selected candidate will apply technical proficiency across various stages of our SDLC, gather requirements and work closely with stakeholders to prioritize and scope tasks. The selected candidate will be working as a key team member on a Scrum team and will be instrumental in setting our direction and strategy for product and infrastructure development.

**Essential Functions**

* Support the engineering team members in embedded software application development
* Investigate root cause of complex issues, and implement solutions, working independently or with a multi-discipline team
* Apply computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis concepts and principles in the development of software for the target hardware
* Work closely with cross functional members of the engineering organization to develop and evaluate interfaces between hardware and software, and operational performance requirements and design of the overall system
* Support and participate in all phases of the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, hardware-software integration, and formal test
* Develop software test plans and procedures, and other relevant technical documentation
* Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, prototype, and evaluate results
* Participate in peer reviews, identify, track and repair defects
* Utilize a variety of software languages (primarily C/C++ and Python developing code for embedded real time operating systems (VxWorks, Linux, Integrity)

**Requirements**

* U.S. citizenship with a Active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret clearance
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* 2+ years of experience debugging applications on simulated and/or target hardware
* Usage of a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS), such as Green Hills Integrity, VxWorks, or similar
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Preferred Additional Skills**

* Object-oriented design and implementation experience, with exposure to software modeling and UML tools such as IBM Rhapsody or MagicDraw/Cameo
* Experience developing device drivers and Board Support Packages for real time embedded systems
* Experience with Information Assurance and/or crytography
* Experience with NSA Type 1 certification or other SW certification such as DO-178

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $91,000 - $135,000. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. **Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**Who We Are**

Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems (RMS) delivers advanced naval combat systems, automation technologies, and mission critical solutions for the U.S. Navy and international partners. Within the Autonomy Intelligence Maritime Solutions Integrated Engineering (AIMS IE) organization, the Machinery Controls & Automation Products department provides the control system capabilities that enable safe, reliable, and efficient shipboard operations across multiple platforms and customers. Our work demands deep technical rigor, disciplined execution, and forward looking innovation.

**What We're Doing**

Within the Autonomy Intelligence Maritime Solutions Integrated Engineering (AIMS IE) organization, the Controls & Automation Products department provides essential control system capabilities that enable shipboard operations across a variety of platforms and customers.

**The Work**

The Senior Member of Engineering Staff will be supporting all of the Machinery Controls and Automation programs within RMS. This position will be responsible for coordinating with a multi-disciplinary team to meet the needs of the customer including system troubleshooting both in the Controls lab and on ship, artifact development, hardware design, and more.

Please note: Occasional travel to shipyard(s) may be required. This position requires the ability obtain and maintain a DoD government clearance at the Secret level.

**Who You Are**

You are a critical thinker with a passion for complex system integration, disciplined engineering, and solving multi-domain technical challenges. You thrive in environments where mechanical, electrical, software, and control systems intersect. You bring strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to drive clarity in complex technical spaces. You are motivated by mission impact and energized by engineering challenges that matter.

**Why Join Us**

Join a mission-driven organization where your leadership will directly impact the future of naval technology and national security. At Lockheed Martin RMS, you will work on high visibility programs that shape the future of naval automation. You will collaborate with seasoned engineers, controls experts, and ship integration specialists who are committed to mentorship, technical excellence, and innovation. Our benefits are built to match the caliber of your work—reliable, high performing, and mission ready. You will enjoy competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, and a culture that values integrity, innovation, and collaboration.

------------------------

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant hardware engineering experience in controls, automation, industrial machinery, robotics, maritime, aerospace, defense, or other complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience with control-system hardware architecture and design, including controllers, I/O, sensors, actuators, motor/drive interfaces, power distribution, and communications.
* Hands-on experience with PLCs, embedded controllers, industrial computers, or real-time control hardware.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols/interfaces such as Ethernet/IP, CAN/CANopen, or equivalent.
* Experience developing and reviewing schematics, wiring diagrams, interface drawings, cable/harness designs, and bills of material.
* Demonstrated ability to perform hardware integration, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, verification, and qualification testing.
* Experience translating system/customer requirements into hardware requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification methods.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret level clearance

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with machinery control and automation systems, particularly propulsion, pumps, valves, motors, generators, hydraulics, pneumatics, or other large electromechanical equipment.
* Experience with Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, or comparable industrial control platforms.
* Knowledge of functional safety, fail-safe/fault-tolerant design, redundancy, interlocks, and degraded-mode operation.
* Experience with Fault-tree analysis, reliability analysis, etc. and design assurance.
* Strong technical communication skills and ability to work across Systems, Software, Mechanical, I&T, Manufacturing, and suppliers.
* Experience designing for harsh environments involving shock, vibration, temperature, humidity, salt/fog, EMI/EMC, or other environmental constraints.
* Familiarity with applicable MIL-STD, IEEE, NAVSEA, …etc or maritime/defense standards.
* Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), automated test equipment, simulation, or digital-twin-based verification.
* Experience supporting system-level integration and test, including troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues.
* Experience with cyber-resilient control-system architectures and segmentation of operational technology/industrial control networks.
* Experience managing COTS hardware selection, obsolescence, lifecycle, configuration management, and supplier technical performance.
* Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS and engineering tools such as Cameo, MATLAB/Simulink, AutoCAD Electrical, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of analog/digital I/O, signal conditioning, grounding, shielding, EMI/EMC, power, and electrical interfaces.
* M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Controls, Robotics, or related field.
* Previous experience serving as a Hardware Lead, Control-System Architect, or technical lead on a complex program.

* $91000.00 - $181113.00

**Purpose**

The Lead Software Engineer will accept ownership of the end user experience through integration between different software/web-based applications, including those of other team members, being designed and modified to support a project. The Lead Software Engineer will be responsible for the technical adequacy of the project software.

As a lead, demonstrate a willingness to coach and provide effective and appropriate feedback to others in the department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Meet with the project team leader and other key individuals and departments associated with the project to determine the status of the project and where this position fits into the overall scope of the project. Learn everything necessary to complete the integration through software module assigned to this position and demonstrate an understanding.

Develop and/or review a project plan for development of the software integration assigned to this position, outlining key project milestones and time to completion. This includes identifying user requirements, preparation of use cases, development of critical paths and dependency relationships, and project challenges. Incorporate these into the plan.

Lead discussions with the design team and vendor team in order to develop and submit a comprehensive design concept for formal review. This includes end user experience, layout best integration approach, objects, and process map. This plan needs to meet key functional requirements.

Review existing integration method and its impact on end user experience for the project and recommend modifications for upgrading and improvement. Develop a time-phased plan of action to complement the proposed changes.

The integration should be optimal in terms of the best digital end user experience, system performance, and the use of the system resources. This includes unit testing and preparation of complete design documentation. Inform the project sponsor ahead of time if the project deadlines cannot be met.

Expect major technical issues and challenges in this position. Be in a position to present a series of alternative approaches and lead the product design reviews. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

People leadership, security mindset, member empathy, data-driven decision making, calm under pressure, and cross-department collaboration.

The Engineer documents requirements, establishes scope, establishes objectives and determines strategy for implementing IT systems to achieve business goals. The role partners with IT business functions to understand operations, reliability, business value and technical requirements and align them with IT functional and non-functional business requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer-scale transistors to micron-level die-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient.

**Job Summary & Responsibilities**

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, integration, and validation of complex systems for advanced semiconductor Films and OCD metrology equipment. This role requires deep technical leadership across multidisciplinary domains, including optics, mechanics, electronics, software, and controls.

The Principal Systems Engineer will define system-level requirements, ensure cross-functional alignment, and drive technical execution from concept through production. This individual serves as the technical authority and plays a critical role in solving complex system-level challenges impacting performance, reliability, and scalability.

**Key Responsibilities**

System Architecture & Technical Leadership

* Define and own system architecture for complex, high-precision equipment.
* Translate product requirements into detailed system specifications and subsystem requirements.
* Lead trade studies, system partitioning, and design decisions across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Serve as the technical lead and decision-maker for system-level design reviews.

Requirements & Interface Management

* Develop, manage, and maintain system requirements, including traceability and validation.
* Define and control system interfaces (mechanical, electrical, optical, software).
* Ensure alignment between subsystem designs and overall system performance requirements.

Integration & Validation

* Lead system integration efforts, identifying and resolving cross-domain issues.
* Develop system-level test plans, validation strategies, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive root cause analysis and resolution of system performance issues.

Performance & Reliability Engineering

* Establish system error budgets, performance models, and sensitivity analyses.
* Ensure system stability under environmental conditions (thermal, vibration, contamination).
* Lead design for reliability, maintainability, and manufacturability at the system level.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate with optical, mechanical, electrical, and software engineering teams.
* Interface with product management, manufacturing, quality, and field service teams.
* Mentor junior engineers and influence technical direction across the organization.

Program Execution

* Support project planning, risk assessment, and milestone delivery.
* Identify technical risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support customer engagements and translate application needs into system capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, Physics, or related field).
* 10+ years of experience in complex system design and integration.
* Proven experience in systems engineering within semiconductor equipment, photonics, aerospace, or precision instrumentation industries.
* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary systems (mechanics, optics, electronics, controls, and software).
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with semiconductor metrology, inspection, or lithography systems.
* Knowledge of precision motion systems, optics, vacuum systems, or laser-based instrumentation.
* Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink).
* Experience defining system error budgets and performance modeling.
* Exposure to cleanroom environments and high-reliability systems.

Key Competencies

* Strategic thinking with strong system-level perspective.
* Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills in complex systems.
* Strong leadership and technical mentorship capabilities.
* Effective communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive decisions in complex environments.

Why Join Onto Innovation?

At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Design the circuit boards that go inside radios operators trust with their lives

At Persistent Systems, our Wave Relay® MANET technology keeps warfighters, first responders, and critical missions connected in the most contested environments on earth. We're looking for a Hardware Engineer with deep experience in battery-powered, high-speed (GHz) digital circuit design. This role is for someone who wants their boards to end up in the field, not in a reference kit.

You'll design, develop, and prototype the electronic assemblies inside our next-generation radios and the upgrades to our current products. Your work spans concept through DVT, and into direct technical support for manufacturing. This lead engineer will set design direction across a project or small set of related projects and serve as a technical resource for others.

**What you'll work on**

* Defining system- and circuit-level requirements for next-generation radio products
* Designing circuits, running analysis and simulations, and producing schematics and BOMs
* Identifying all components and equipment needed to support the product design process
* Providing PCB layout guidance and working closely with layout engineers to complete PCB designs

* Serious lab infrastructure. Full RF and digital lab: high-bandwidth scopes, spectrum and vector network analyzers, thermal chambers, and the fixtures to characterize what you build.
* Direct hand-off to manufacturing. In-house manufacturing support, so the feedback loop from board bring-up to production issues is fast.

* You own boards from end-to-end. Concept, schematic, layout guidance, bring-up, DVT, and production support, one engineer, one board, real accountability.
* Independent, not a subsidiary. Product direction gets made by the people building the radios, not filtered through a Fortune 500 parent's roadmap review.

* Resolve complex technical challenges across projects

* Exposure to Embedded Firmware Development in Assembly, C and/or C++

* Knowledge of military qualification testing

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent task management skills

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna uses simulation to train robots, evaluate their behavior, and develop new capabilities before deploying them in the real world. We’re looking for a Simulation Software Engineer to build the environments, tools, and systems that make this possible—from generating diverse virtual worlds to testing robot behavior and running simulation at scale.
  
  
You’ll partner with scientists, robotics engineers, and technical artists to expand what robots can experience in simulation and what our teams can build with it. Your work could span procedural scene generation, automated evaluation, interactive experiences, and remotely hosted simulation. We welcome backgrounds in robotics, real-time systems, simulation, and scalable data infrastructure.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop workflows for generating, configuring, and managing diverse scenes, assets, and scenarios.

  

* Extend simulation to support robot capabilities and interactions among robots, people, and dynamic environments.

  

* Make simulation experiments reproducible and easy to inspect, with tools for automated evaluation, debugging, and regression testing.

  

* Build reliable pipelines for generating, processing, and managing simulation data.

  

* Scale simulation through automation, workload orchestration, and remote hosting, supporting both batch workloads and interactive use.

  

* Partner with scientists and technical artists to improve simulation performance, usability, and fidelity to real robot behavior (sim2real).

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
  
  
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’d like to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience developing robotics software, simulation systems, real-time applications, or scalable data pipelines.
* 2+ years of non-internship experience designing or architecting new and existing systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with robotics simulation frameworks or real-time 3D engines, such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Unreal Engine, or Unity.

* Familiarity with sim2real transfer, domain randomization, or evaluating robot capabilities across varied environments.

jobs.description:

Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

  
  

**Job Title** :

Test Equipment Controls Engineer

**Reporting To:**

Mgr., Engineering

**Work Schedule:**

Onsite – Buffalo, NY  
  
  

Our team in Industrial Group is looking for a hands-on Test Equipment Controls Engineer to take ownership of the systems used to validate our products while driving the modernization of our testing capabilities through automation, controls, instrumentation, and software development.

  
  

As a Test Equipment Controls Engineer, you'll serve as the technical owner of production and engineering test systems, ensuring reliable operation of existing equipment while leading efforts to enhance and modernize testing capabilities.

  
  

This role combines the responsibilities of a controls engineer, automation engineer, and test systems engineer. You'll play a critical role in maintaining and improving the production and development test equipment used to support both manufacturing and new product development. If you're energized by troubleshooting complex systems, modernizing legacy equipment, developing automation solutions, and improving how products are tested, this is an opportunity to make a direct impact across Moog's Industrial Group.

  

**To be considered for Test Equipment Controls Engineer, here’s what you’ll typically bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of experience supporting, designing, developing, or maintaining industrial test equipment, automation systems, controls systems, or complex manufacturing equipment.
* Experience programming, troubleshooting, and commissioning PLC-based control systems.
* Experience with industrial instrumentation, sensors, signal conditioning, measurement systems, and data acquisition hardware.
* Hands-on experience supporting electromechanical, hydraulic, servo-controlled, or automated systems.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  

**It’s preferred if you bring:**

* Experience developing or supporting PC-based test software, HMI applications, or graphical user interfaces.
* Experience with National Instruments hardware and LabVIEW.
* Experience integrating PLCs, HMIs, motion control systems, instrumentation, and data acquisition platforms.
* Experience supporting manufacturing test equipment, automated test stands, or production testing environments.
* Experience modernizing legacy equipment through controls, automation, and software upgrades.
* Familiarity with servo motors, motion control, closed-loop control systems, and industrial automation technologies.
  

**As a Test Equipment Controls Engineer, you will:**

* Own the reliability, performance, configuration management, and continuous improvement of production test stands used to validate complex electromechanical, hydraulic, and motion control products.
* Troubleshoot and resolve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, instrumentation, controls, and software-related issues to minimize downtime and support manufacturing operations.
* Design, build, modify, and upgrade production and engineering test equipment, including test stands, control panels, instrumentation systems, and data acquisition hardware.
* Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC-based control systems, automated machine logic, and integrated test equipment controls.
* Create, maintain, and enhance operator-facing HMI and GUI applications that improve usability, efficiency, and data visibility.
* Select, install, calibrate, and maintain sensors, transducers, instrumentation, signal conditioning hardware, and measurement systems used for product testing and validation.
* Integrate PLCs, instrumentation, data acquisition systems, servo drives, motors, and other control hardware into automated test environments.
* Support engineering development, qualification, and performance testing by configuring test setups, implementing instrumentation plans, and developing test methods.
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions related to test equipment failures, measurement issues, and system performance concerns.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including electrical schematics, control logic, operating procedures, calibration requirements, preventive maintenance plans, and software revision records.
* Drive modernization initiatives that improve automation, test capability, repeatability, safety, throughput, and overall equipment effectiveness through hardware and software enhancements.
* Partner closely with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Quality, and Maintenance teams to ensure test systems effectively support both production and product development activities.
  

**How we care for you:**

* Financial Rewards: great compensation package, bonus opportunities **,** matching 401k, and the ability to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan (select locations), Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
* Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, holidays and parental leave program, relocation assistance.
* Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
* Professional Skills Development: Tuition Assistance, mentorship and coaching opportunities, leadership development and other personal growth programs
* Culture: Warm, respectful, family-like environment driven by our 12 core values. Multiple Employee Resource Groups led by our employees, open and welcoming to all.

jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description:** Open Energy Solutions Inc. (OES) is an early-stage services and software development company that is enabling utilities and utility vendors to enhance power system operations through the development and implementation of distributed intelligence and enabling technologies. OES is modernizing the electric grid through real‑time simulation, advanced distribution modeling, and cutting‑edge DER integration.

**Role Description:** OES is seeking a Power Systems Engineer to bring technical skills and utility-industry expertise to operational technology projects. OES’ primary functions are around technology solution development and utility consulting services, and this individual will play an instrumental role on a multidisciplinary team of IT/communications specialists, developers, electricians, and project managers, providing technical expertise and industry acumen.

This role sits at the intersection of research and practical field application, offering a rare opportunity to be a valuable contributor in cutting-edge power systems work deployed in real utility environments. In the role, the candidate is expected to wear several hats: technical solution designer, client subject matter advisor, power systems analyst, and modeling/simulation engineer. This is a fast-paced, dynamic environment, so the individual must be responsive, creative, and able to manage priorities across multiple projects.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support power systems engineering operations, including distribution feeder modeling, equipment wiring, and fault analysis
* Develop, configure, and parameterize simulation models representing distribution feeders including microgrids and DER inverters
* Perform power system transient studies and detailed equipment modeling using industry-standard software tools
* Provide technical support for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulations, applying power systems engineering fundamentals
* Apply IEEE 1547 (Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources with Associated Electric Power Systems Interfaces) requirements to DER interconnection studies and testing
* Support operation of medium voltage devices including reclosers (one and three phase), voltage/current sensors and capacitor banks with voltage zero-crossing switching
* Perform distribution capacity planning, system design, and peak demand forecasting
* Clearly communicate results to internal stakeholders and clients by preparing detailed written reports/presentations describing analyses performed and proposed solutions developed
* Apply power systems expertise to design, develop, and test solutions from proof of concept through production

**Qualifications:**

* BS in Electrical Engineering with 2-4 years of relevant experience or a MS or PhD in electrical engineering with an emphasis on power systems. A master’s degree may substitute for two years of experience.
* Programming skills and experience (preferably in Python, Rust, and/or C)
* Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Eagerness to learn new skills and build industry and product knowledge
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and ability to effectively present information to team members and clients
* Strong work ethic and positive attitude
* Ability to work independently AND in a team environment
* Fluency in written and spoken English
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Charlotte or Detroit metropolitan area

**Preferred Experience:**

* Utility industry: hands-on experience at a utility, software vendor, or consulting firm is preferred over primarily research-based experience
* Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation, especially with Typhoon HIL, RTDS, or OPAL-RT
* Protective relays, controllers, and common OEM software
* Any activity or function associated with microgrid protection and control
* Distribution circuit analysis (load flow, short circuit) using CYME and/or PSCAD
* Communication protocols such as GOOSE, DNP3, and Modbus

*We’re looking for a Power Systems Engineer who wants to innovate and build that future. Join us to be part of a forward-thinking team dedicated to innovative electrical grid solutions!*

-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

----------

DUTY 1: The Principal Intelligence Analyst (PIA) will proactively lead the analytic enterprise for the assigned mission area & define the scope of the intelligence Program of Analysis (POA) for their analytical team.

DUTY 4: The PIA provides analytical leadership and professional coaching to their team. **Requirements**
----------------

This is a GG-14 position in the Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS).
