The selectee's salary will be set within the 14 grade equivalent to a GS/GG grade based on the selectee's qualifications in relation to the job.
  
  
In order to qualify, you must meet the specialized experience requirements described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Professional and Scientific Positions.
  
  
**BASIC REQUIREMENT:**
  
**A.** **Degree: Engineering.** To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.
  
**OR**

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer - AI System/OpenBMC
jobs.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

**Job Description**

Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Senior role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry.
* **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams.
* **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements.
* **Bring-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system-integration domains.
* **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale.
* **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred.
* **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C++ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT.
* **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows.
* **Communication:** Able to lead cross-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives.

Compensation: $120,000 to $240,000

Benefit Insurance

* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement

Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a unique, mission-driven organization that develops in-house nuclear reactor instrumentation and control systems for the U.S. Navy's aircraft carriers, submarines, and future platforms. Within NNL, the System Verification and Validation Unit is seeking a highly motivated Electrical Engineer with a strong interest in testing and troubleshooting hardware and software. You will be placed at the cutting edge of naval nuclear control suites to ensure operational excellence by qualifying reactor plant embedded systems. This role is well suited for an engineer who thrives in a collaborative setting and wants hands-on experience operating prototypic shipboard equipment in a laboratory environment.

Typical roles and responsibilities include:  

* Developing test procedures and automated methods for hardware and software qualification
* Performing hands-on and automated testing to verify the technical adequacy of designs
* Troubleshooting issues discovered during test and fleet operation
* Becoming a subject matter expert in the design, operation, and maintenance of I&C systems

**Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill**
-----------------------------------------------

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience; or Currently an Intermediate Reactor Training Engineer, Refueling Engineer, or Field (RPCO) Engineer at the Company.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Prior testing and troubleshooting experience in microprocessor-based embedded control systems
* System or operational experience on naval or commercial nuclear reactor plants
* Strong Academic performance - Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above on a 4.0 GPA Scale
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to communicate information in a clear and concise manner

$78,700.00 - $120,500.00 annually

**What you will do**:

This role combines engineering design, controls programming, project execution, and hands-on support of manufacturing equipment. The Automation Engineer will help define equipment requirements, develop technical specifications, manage automation projects, and support the successful startup and operation of manufacturing systems.

**How you will do it**:

* Work with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Engineering teams to identify manufacturing challenges and develop automation solutions that improve safety, quality, productivity, and equipment reliability.

* Develop manufacturing test equipment, fixtures, and specialized tooling used for product validation, quality verification, and process control.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation including control narratives, software backups, operating procedures, equipment standards, and project records.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives through equipment upgrades, process improvements, cycle time reduction, labor optimization, quality improvements, and waste reduction.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to technicians, maintenance personnel, and engineers during equipment design, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure all automation systems and equipment comply with company safety standards, applicable codes, industry best practices, and established engineering principles.

**Requirements**:

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, with 3+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting automation systems in a manufacturing environment.
* Hands-on experience with industrial automation technologies including PLCs, HMIs, robotics, machine vision systems, industrial networks, and integrated manufacturing equipment.
* Strong technical aptitude including automation system design, controls programming, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and the ability to interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.
* Experience leading automation or capital projects, including development of equipment specifications, supplier management, project execution, commissioning, and startup activities.

* Supporting technology transition activities, including technical maturation, cost and manufacturability assessments, qualification testing, field demonstrations, and documenting designs for transfer to internal or external manufacturing organizations

jobs.description:
ARA's Engineering Science Division is seeking a highly skilled and innovative robotics engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in C++, Java Script, and Python development, coupled with experience in robotics. This full-stack role involves developing robust frontend and backend software for virtual simulation.

This is an on-site position located in San Antonio, TX.

U.S. citizenship is required. Candidates selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

**What you will do as a principal robotics engineer:**

* Architect, develop, and maintain backend systems using C++, Python, ROS/ROS2, and containerized deployment environments (Docker).
* Implement scalable and maintainable build and CI/CD workflows using Git and automated pipelines.
* Develop front-end user interfaces and tools using JavaScript, Java-based GUI frameworks, REST APIs, and cloud-based technologies.
* Design and implement APIs and data exchange layers supporting simulation systems, autonomy behaviors, and sensor modeling.
* Contribute to high-fidelity simulation environments representing UUV dynamics, environmental conditions, sensor modalities, and mission workflows.
* Collaborate with autonomy and systems engineers to integrate perception, navigation, and control capabilities.
* Perform code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to software engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot and optimize software performance across distributed systems and heterogeneous hardware environments.
* Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker in development and production environments.

**Principal robotics engineer requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience. Advanced degree may serve in partial fulfillment of the experience requirement.
  + Expert-level proficiency in C++, Python, and JavaScript for backend and frontend systems development.
  + Demonstrated experience with robotics software stacks including ROS/ROS2, simulation environments, and sensor or autonomy integration.
  + Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed system architectures.
  + Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across complex software and hardware environments.

**Preferred experience:**

* Azure cloud services and cloud-native application development.
* Jira and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and Agile workflow management.
* Experience building software for scalability, modularity, and long-term maintainability.
* Knowledge of physics‑based modeling, environmental simulation, or digital twin concepts.

**About ARA:**

ARA is an employee-owned international research and engineering company recognized for providing technically superior solutions to complex and challenging problems in the physical sciences. The company, founded in Albuquerque, NM, in 1979, currently employs more than 2,000 professionals and continues to grow. ARA offices throughout the United States and Canada provide a broad range of technical expertise in computer software and simulation, environmental technologies, defense technologies, systems analysis, civil technologies, and testing and measurement. The corporation also provides sophisticated technical products for robotics, environmental site characterization, and pavement analysis.

At ARA, employees are our greatest assets. The corporation realizes that employee ownership spawns greater creativity and initiative along with higher performance and customer satisfaction levels. ARA gives its employees the tools, training, and opportunities to take more active roles as owners. The culture is challenging; innovation and experimentation are the norm. Employees are eligible for contributions which not only add to the company’s success, but also their own through the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform
jobs.description:
**About Atmosphere TV**

Atmosphere is the leading streaming TV platform built specifically for businesses. Unlike ad networks or signage companies, Atmosphere is the only true TV company whose first priority is to entertain television audiences outside of the home. Our content is designed to be fun, engaging, and worth watching, transforming gyms, bars, airports, and restaurants into better experiences for customers and better businesses for owners.

We are the first and only company to think about both the business owner and their customers when creating TV content. With 55,000+ venues and a global audience of over 160 million monthly viewers, Atmosphere is redefining what TV means outside the living room.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to champion our platform engineering initiatives and own the foundation our engineering teams build on: the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and observability tooling behind a streaming platform serving 60,000+ businesses and over 150 million monthly viewers. You're a software engineer first. You understand how applications are built, how services talk to each other, and how the different parts of a system depend on one another. You also care about how software gets built, shipped, and run, and you want to own it. You'll partner closely with every engineering team, and your impact will show up in how quickly and confidently they're able to ship. AI is central to how you'll work: you'll use it heavily to execute platform initiatives and move faster than a platform team twice the size.

*This position will report to the VP, Engineering, and is on-site in Austin, TX! Availability to be in-office 4-5 days a week is required.*

**What you'll do**

* Use AI as a core part of how you plan, build, and ship.
* Be motivated, naturally curious, and enjoy solving new problems alongside other engineers.
* Build the tooling that makes AI effective for every other engineer.
* Own our infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD: module design and standards, keeping declared state and reality converged, and a fast, reliable path from commit to production.
* Define observability and resilience patterns across the org: every service measurable, debuggable, and alertable by default, safe deploy patterns, and incident response focused on root-cause fixes.
* Lead upgrades of datastores, runtimes, frameworks, and SDKs ahead of end-of-life deadlines, including the application-code changes they require, and automate away recurring toil like dependency upgrades and environment provisioning.
* Drive security remediation: triage cloud security findings, harden identity and network configuration, and close authentication gaps.
* Champion simplification by decommissioning unused infrastructure, deleting dead code, and keeping our footprint (and cloud bill) no larger than it needs to be.
* Work cross-functionally to prioritize infrastructure investments by impact.

**Qualifications**

* Bias towards simplicity
* Computer science degree or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, building and shipping production services
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Strong fundamentals in how software works: APIs, service-to-service communication, authentication, data stores, caching, and system design
* Some hands-on experience with infrastructure and delivery tooling: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure
* Security-minded by default: identity, network exposure, authentication boundaries, and vulnerability remediation
* Heavy, effective daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), including agentic workflows, skills, plugins, or MCP integrations

**Nice to Haves:**

* Experience with Terraform (or similar): module design, state management, and catching drift
* Experience building CI/CD across many services
* Experience running containerized and serverless workloads on AWS (ECS, Lambda) in production
* Experience leading a major upgrade (database, runtime, or framework) end to end
* Experience building AI tooling other engineers use: skills, plugins, MCP servers, or agent workflows
* Experience with streaming media, ad tech, or large device fleets

**Compensation & Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary
* Company Equity
* Company 401(k) with employer matching
* Competitive insurance plans
* Flexible Time Off Policy

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer sponsorship now or in the future.

**Don't meet every single requirement?** Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet all the criteria. At Atmosphere, we're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where creativity, innovation, and teamwork matter most. If you're passionate about this role but your experience doesn't check every box, we still want to hear from you. You might just be the right fit for this or another role on our team.

**Job Description**

Vermont State University invites applications for **full-time, tenure-track faculty positions in Electrical Engineering Technology** . The University is currently seeking candidates for positions beginning in **Spring 2027** and anticipates hiring multiple faculty members as programmatic needs, enrollment, and course offerings evolve. The successful candidates will join the Department of Engineering and contribute to the delivery and continued development of applied, career-focused engineering technology programs.

  

The position is based at the University's Randolph Center and Williston campuses, home to longstanding engineering technology programs with a strong tradition of hands-on laboratory education, close connections with industry, and preparation of graduates for professional engineering and technical careers.

  

We seek enthusiastic educators who value applied learning and are committed to helping students develop strong technical, analytical, laboratory, design, and professional skills. Faculty will teach undergraduate courses in electrical and electronics engineering technology, participate in curriculum and laboratory development, advise and mentor students, contribute to program assessment and accreditation activities, and engage with industry and the broader University community.

  

**Hiring will occur based on evolving programmatic priorities, enrollment, and instructional needs.** Applicants may be considered for current or anticipated openings within the Electrical Engineering Technology program.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Teach undergraduate lecture and laboratory courses in Electrical Engineering Technology and related engineering areas.
* Teach courses that may include electric circuits, electronics, digital systems, instrumentation and measurement, electrical machines, industrial controls, programmable logic controllers, embedded systems, microcontrollers, renewable energy systems, communications, and related topics depending on the candidate's expertise and program needs.
* Develop and maintain engaging laboratory experiences emphasizing practical application, experimentation, troubleshooting, design, and modern engineering tools.
* Advise and mentor students regarding academic progress, career pathways, internships, and professional opportunities.
* Participate in curriculum development and continuous improvement of engineering technology programs.
* Contribute to student learning assessment and program accreditation activities, including work associated with ABET accreditation.
* Participate in departmental, school, and university service.
* Build and maintain connections with employers, industry partners, professional organizations, and other external stakeholders.
* Support student recruitment, retention, and outreach activities.
Engage in appropriate professional development, scholarly activity, applied research, consulting, industry collaboration, or other forms of professional practice consistent with the University's mission and expectations for tenure and promotion.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

Applicants must have:

* A master's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field by the time of appointment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of electrical and electronic systems and the ability to teach undergraduate engineering technology courses and laboratories.
* A commitment to applied, hands-on education and student-centered teaching.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
The ability to work effectively with students, faculty, staff, industry partners, and other stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following:

* Professional experience in electrical engineering, electronics, manufacturing, automation, controls, energy systems, embedded systems, or a related technical field.
* College-level teaching experience, particularly in engineering or engineering technology.
* Experience developing and teaching laboratory-based courses.
* Knowledge of industrial automation, programmable logic controllers, electrical machines, power systems, renewable energy, embedded systems, instrumentation, or related emerging technologies.
* Experience with industry-standard engineering software, instrumentation, data acquisition systems, or electrical/electronic test equipment.
* Experience with ABET-accredited programs, outcomes assessment, or continuous program improvement.

**Hardware Electrical Engineer – Space Systems (U.S. Citizen or Perm. Res. required)**

*Location:* Onsite in Sterling, VA

*Duration:*  12 months to 3 years with potential for extension(s)

\*\*\* ITAR required so must be U.S. Citizen, National, or Green Card Holder

**Position Summary**

The Hardware (Compute) Electrical Engineer will support digital electronics for a space-computing system built around processors, supporting devices, memory and complementary circuit cards. The role covers the full hardware lifecycle, but the immediate need is weighted toward analyzing and documenting existing designs, making controlled revisions, supporting production readiness, and debugging hardware. Design may represent only 10-15% of the near-term work; the engineer must be equally comfortable proving why the design works, documenting it and helping it succeed in test and production.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with **digital or mixed-signal hardware, processors, memory devices, embedded compute platforms or related circuit-card assemblies**.
* Experience **reading and revising schematics using Cadence/OrCAD/Allegro, Altium or similar professional ECAD tools**.
* Experience performing or reviewing **electrical analysis such as part-stress, worst-case, reliability, FMECA or signal-integrity analysis**.
* Hands-on **board bring-up, benchtop test** **and root-cause debugging experience**.
* Ability to write and execute **test procedure**s and produce configuration-controlled engineering documentation.
* Strong fundamentals, positive and collaborative attitude, and ability to describe technical work with appropriate depth even when prior programs were classified.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 4+ years of relevant electrical hardware experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand, maintain and revise processor-, memory- and digital-interface circuit-card designs for space and defense applications.
* Perform or support part-stress, worst-case, reliability and other circuit analyses that substantiate the design.
* Support radiation analysis and radiation-mitigation activities; prior radiation-effects experience is a major advantage, but the team can teach the domain.
* Read existing schematics, select components, make controlled CAD changes and re-release drawings and design packages.
* Support high-speed digital interfaces, including Ethernet and related waveform/signal-integrity considerations where applicable.
* Develop and execute hardware test procedures; use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and other laboratory equipment to diagnose failures.
* Write short Python scripts to communicate with hardware, automate tests and exercise functions such as memory testing.
* Use Linux to understand, bring up and troubleshoot the computing system and its hardware/software interfaces.
* Create and maintain requirements, drawings, bills of material, test procedures, analysis reports and production documentation.
* Collaborate closely with FPGA, embedded software, firmware, mechanical, RF, systems, test and program personnel.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Space, aerospace, defense or other high-reliability electronics experience.
* Radiation-effects analysis or design for radiation environments; candidates with this background should receive priority consideration.
* Python scripting for instrument control, test automation or hardware diagnostics.
* Linux experience for system bring-up and troubleshooting.
* High-speed digital design, Ethernet, memory interfaces, signal integrity, HDI PCB/PCA development or controlled-impedance design.
* Experience helping establish or improve a production line for complex electronics.

**Ideal Candidate:**  
Digital hardware EE with **4–8 years of experience** working with **processors, memory, embedded compute, and circuit-card hardware**. Strong at schematic/design work, engineering analysis, board bring-up/debug, and documentation, with enough **Python/Linux** knowledge to interact with and troubleshoot the compute platform.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in **Reston, Virginia**. In this role, you will be responsible for full cycle PCB design including collecting requirements, schematic design, component selection, supervision or completion of layout, bring-up, test, debug and integration with the system. You will:

* Work with a cross-functional team to design market leading hardware products.
* Drive product maturity through rapid prototyping, design verification, and qualification activities.
* Apply modern design standards and guidelines to create high-reliability, highly manufacturable assemblies.
* Implement combinations of high-speed digital, precision analog, RF, and high-power designs.
* Lead the team in establishing internal guidelines for design for manufacturing (DFM) and quality fabrication and assembly outputs.
* Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews.
* Low level firmware development for bring-up and test.
* Root cause analysis in support of production operations.
* Work in a fast-paced environment, having to juggle multiple concurrent projects and customers.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years of professional experience in hardware product development.
* Full understanding of PCB Layout techniques to meet mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing requirements.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics and apply best practices appropriate for each design.
* Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, etc.
* Familiarity with common MCU, CPU, FPGA devices and technologies.
* Knowledge of modern analog and digital electronics and electronic circuits.
* Ability to determine work priorities based on broad direction from management.
* Experience using Altium Designer or equivalent E-CAD tools.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with others.
* Ability to work within our company and team culture.
* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Understanding of MIL-STD-810 and relevant military environmental qualification standards.
* Understanding of MIL-STD-461 and relevant military electromagnetic compatibility standards.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Who we are

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions. Our Manassas campus is a thriving center of engineering expertise, fostering a culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the creation of exceptional products. Our team is made up of dedicated professionals who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

What We’re Doing

At Lockheed Martin, we're at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and innovation. Our campus in Manassas, Virginia is a hub for engineering excellence, where we tackle some of the world's most challenging engineering problems. We pride ourselves on our culture of creativity, excellence, and product innovation.

The Work

Researches, develops, designs, and tests electrical components, equipment, systems, and networks. Designs electrical equipment, facilities, components, products, and systems for commercial, industrial, and domestic purposes.

Opportunity for candidates experienced in Electrical Engineering or related disciplines interested in putting their skills to work as an Electrical Engineer.

Position spans the technology development life-cycle, including requirements generation, system design and implementation, hardware procurement, integration, test, and installation across lab facilities and at-sea platforms.

Responsibilities include research, selection, test, and integration of electronic components and equipment in a military environment. Candidate will analyze, define and design mainly COTS equipment for new or existing systems or subsystems. Additional responsibilities include drawing creation, troubleshooting issues, test planning; test development; and test execution.

Specific responsibilities may include:  
1. Specification, analysis, and selection of COTS, ROTS, NDI and / or custom components  
2. Requirements review  
3. Cable Design for rack/stack system  
4. Interconnect Diagrams and Cable Run Sheets  
5. Test Procedure Development and Execution  
6. System Verification and Validation  
7. Support of limited Environmental Test and Analysis  
8. End-of-Life assessment and evaluation

Why Join Us  
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life  
Joining Lockheed Martin means becoming part of a team that's making a significant impact in the field of engineering. When you choose to work with us, you'll enjoy:  

* An excellent working environment equipped with state-of-the-art tools.
* The opportunity to work alongside industry leaders and top-notch professionals.
* A chance to be a part of solving some of the world's most challenging engineering problems.
* A culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the development of remarkable products.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level, work on groundbreaking projects, and be a part of a team that thrives on innovation, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our mission.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Systems Engineering from an accredited college, related discipline and/or equivalent experience/combined education, with 2 years of professional experience  
  
Knowledge of computer system design (servers, switches, power, packaging)  
  
Effectively communicate with multiple levels of stakeholders.  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple simultaneous tasks  
  
Must have interim secret clearance to start

**Desired Skills**
------------------

Experience with selection and integration of network servers, switches, fabric extenders, memory, power supplies, etc.  

* Experience in cable design and interconnect diagrams using Zuken E3 a plus.
* Some military design experience is a plus
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple simultaneous tasks.
* LabVIEW experience and knowledge are a plus.
* Motivated and self-starter with excellent communications skills.

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $79300.00 - $147300.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

**Meet HII’s Newport News Shipbuilding**
  
With more than 25,000 employees – including third-, fourth- and even fifth-generation shipbuilders – HII’s Newport News Shipbuilding (NNS) division is the largest industrial employer in Virginia. We’re the sole designer, builder and refueler of U.S. Navy nuclear aircraft carriers and one of two providers of U.S. Navy nuclear submarines. Our diverse and innovative team of professionals ranges from skilled trades to project managers, engineers and software developers to solution architects, technical subject matter experts, and system users. We collaborate together at the forefront of technology, manufacturing, and integration of the most powerful and survivable naval ships in the world. Want to be part of the team? Apply today! We look forward to meeting you.

**The Role**
------------

Newport News Shipbuilding (NNS) is seeking a skilled and experienced Systems Engineer to lead the development and implementation of Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) on the SSNX Program. The SSNX program is a future class fast-attack nuclear powered submarine being designed to replace the Virginia Class and Seawolf Class boats.
  
Key Responsibilities:
  

* Lead the implementation of systems engineering on SSNX future class fast-attack nuclear powered submarine across the systems lifecycle including requirements development and management, verification and validation, and systems architecting.
* Lead the development and refinement of MBSE processes, frameworks, and best practices to be applied on the SSNX program.
* Collaborate with discipline engineering teams, program management, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with customer needs.
* Drive the adoption and execution of MBSE methodologies across programs to enhance efficiency and decision making.
* Collaborate and perform within a cross-functional team with other Engineers/Designers across Departments.
* Mentor early career systems engineers.

  

Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

**Must Have**
-------------

Bachelor's Degree and 9 years of relevant exempt experience;
  
Master’s Degree and 7 years of relevant professional experience;
  
Ph.D. and 4 years of experience.

Newport News Shipbuilding requires a Bachelor's Degree in engineering from an ABET accredited program.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Proficiency with MBSE Tools (Cameo, Cradle, DOORS, etc.).
* Experience with program management and maintaining cost, schedule and performance goals.
* Experience with digital engineering practices, data integration and model management processes.
* Systems Engineering certifications: INCOSE Associate Systems Engineering Professional (ASEP), OMG Certified Systems Modeling Professional (OCSMP), etc.
* Interested in solving challenging problems
* Self-starter, proficient communicator, and active listener
* Persistent in the pursuit of achieving successful results
* Active contributor – facilitating larger system outlook and solutions
* Contributes to a methodical problem solving approach
* Significant interest in learning from others.
* Significant experience working within a team, collecting and organizing multiple contributions.

**Why HII**
  
We build the world’s most powerful, survivable naval ships and defense technology solutions that safeguard our seas, sky, land, space and cyber. HII’s diverse workforce includes skilled tradespeople; artificial intelligence, machine learning (AI/ML) experts; engineers; technologists; scientists; logistics experts; and business administration professionals.

  

Recognized as one of America’s top large company employers, we are a values and ethics driven organization that puts people’s safety and well-being first. Regardless of your role or where you serve, at HII, you’ll find a supportive and welcoming environment, competitive benefits, and valuable educational and training programs for continual career growth at every stage of your career.

  

Working at HII is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to build a future. We offer comprehensive benefits including: medical, prescription drug, dental and vision plan choices, on-site health centers, tele-medicine, wellness resources, employee assistance programs, savings plan options (401K), financial education and planning tools, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, early childhood and post-secondary education scholarships, and more. Some benefits may vary depending on your specific division or work location.

  

**Together we are working to ensure a future where everyone can be free and thrive.**

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employ

Amentum is seeking a Top‑Secret cleared Systems Engineer to join a high‑impact team dedicated to accelerating operations through data innovation and advanced analytical insights. This mission‑driven organization leverages agile practices to deliver enhanced reporting, global search capabilities, and improved task management—supporting national intelligence priorities while ensuring the protection of sensitive data, sources, and methods.

In this role, you will help lead large‑scale data analysis efforts and contribute to the design and delivery of both on‑premises and cloud‑based applications. As a Systems Engineer, you will provide hands‑on support for daily network operations, including evaluating system utilization, monitoring performance, and serving as a primary responder for operational issues and system anomalies.

This position is responsible for project management and controls engineering project support involving PLC/SCADA/HMI programming, instrumentation, check out support and start-up assistance. This engineering position is to provide support to all customers, as well as to junior engineers for all aspects of projects. Responsibilities also include:

**Project Management Responsibilities** Project execution, task identification, task prioritization and scheduling, task ordering, time tracking and reporting, financial tracking and reporting, early problem identification and conflict resolution, hardware requisition, supporting other engineers in group, and attending project status meetings. Also includes overseeing daily operations and activities of a project(s) ranging in size up to $1.5M. This position is responsible for ensuring overall profitability of the project.

* Develops and executes engineering implementation plans for the project
* Responsible for detailed knowledge of scopes of work
* Assigns work to project teams as required meet overall project deadlines.
* Ensures that all project team members clearly understand the scope of WM engineering responsibilities
* Develops engineering schedules for W-M team and customer requirements
* Evaluates progress on project(s) and details changes
* Provides auxiliary Quality Engineering duties to ensure compliance with the W-M Quality Assurance Manual
* Responsible for engineering related purchasing and subcontractor requirements
* Responsible for initial project costing and further development of costs and resultant proposals for change orders to match a contract’s scope
* Develops and implements a cash flow plan for the project including A/R collections
* Responsible for project invoicing to the customer if no other PM is assigned
* Serves as a W-M engineering interface with the customer and other W-M offices during the implementation phase of the project
* Ensures compliance with all regulations, codes etc. as they apply to the contract and project(s)
* Provide cyber security guidance to other engineers, as well as, ensuring the following of cyber security methodologies in projects
* Some sales and marketing is involved. This includes the ability to identify sales opportunities, confidence to suggest scope changes with justifications, ability to network across targeted industries, vision to try new marketing approaches, and willingness to take on new marketing responsibilities as needed

**Engineering Responsibilities**

* Controls engineering design, development, and implementation including software (PLC layout, RTU, HMI approaches, Ladder concepts, Scripted languages), IED, hardware (systems integration, instrumentation callout, panel layout, and construction), and systems design (integration of the various components on any given project)
* Technical writing including project definition and requirements, quality and project plans, clearly delineated status reporting, process control sequence of operations, functional specifications, detail specifications, standard practices and procedures, scope of supply, test plans, requests for information, customer correspondence, and code commenting
* Project documentation: task/periodic status reporting, percent complete estimating, production and assembly of required project manuals, organization and maintenance of current network based project files, phone transcripts, meeting minutes, I/O lists, preparing purchase orders, specifying instrumentation, preparing price quotes, etc.
* Programming Control systems, [i.e. Siemens S7, GE Fanuc PLCs (Proficy Machine Edition), Allen Bradley PLCs (Rockwell 5, 500, 5000), Device Net, Point I/O, ABB VFDs and Allen Bradley VFDs, Schneider Unity Pro], scripted control languages, HTML, graphics construction, instrumentation and various control device configurations, database configuration, and intuitive ability to program an otherwise difficult device
* SCADA programming and their applications [i.e. Ignition, GE Fanuc (Cimplicity), Wonderware, iFix, Power SCADA]
* Experience with PID loop tuning (Open and Closed Loops)
* Experience with AutoCAD
* General administration such as paperwork, copying, printing, faxing, and using a computer
* Ability to travel up to 50%

**Minimum Requirements**

**Education** BA/BS degree in engineering or related discipline (BSEE degree preferred). An equivalent degree and/or experience may be substituted.

jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a **Senior Software Engineer** on the **Software Defined Network (SDN) and Network Observability Team** , you will design and develop the software systems that manage, route, and monitor Blue Origin's dynamic satellite network in real time. You will build distributed services that enable network planning, orchestration, telemetry processing, and observability across thousands of user terminals, satellites, and terrestrial infrastructure. Working closely with spacecraft, user, and ground systems engineers, you'll help build resilient software that keeps the constellation operating reliably under constantly changing orbital conditions.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Design and develop highly available, low-latency distributed services supporting network orchestration, telemetry collection, and control plane operations across the TeraWave constellation.
* Build software that plans, disseminates, and coordinates state across terrestrial infrastructure, orbital assets, and users while maintaining reliability and consistency under dynamic network conditions.
* Develop scalable data pipelines capable of ingesting and processing high-volume telemetry streams to improve network visibility and operational responsiveness.
* Design efficient data models and storage solutions using relational, NoSQL, search, and streaming technologies to support real-time operational workflows.

jobs.description:
Zoox is on a mission to reimagine transportation and build ground-up autonomous robotaxis that are safe, reliable, clean, and enjoyable for everyone. We’re still early in deploying on public roads, so this is a great time to join and have a significant impact. The ML Platform team enables innovation in large-scale Foundation models, VLMs, and VLAs to make autonomous driving as seamless as possible.

**The Opportunity**  
Are you excited to own ML training performance at Zoox and make the models that power autonomous driving train faster, cheaper, and at greater scale? You’ll set technical direction for distributed training, parallelism strategies, mixed-precision training, and RL on SOTA accelerators, especially for multi-modal VLA and VLM models. You’ll partner with all Autonomy teams (Perception, Prediction, Planner, Simulation, Collision Avoidance) and act as a force multiplier for our internal customers, while mentoring engineers and shaping the team’s roadmap as we expand into new ML domains. If you want to learn more about our stack behind autonomous driving, please look here. If you want to learn more about our ML Infrastructure, here is one of our past talks at re:Invent.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and operation of training performance optimizations (data/tensor/pipeline parallelism, mixed precision, gradient checkpointing, GPU kernels) to scale VLM, VLA, and Foundation model training.
* Own the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for RL framework and RL performance optimization for driving foundation models.
* Drive profiling and root-cause analysis of throughput bottlenecks across the compute, compiler, framework, and cluster-networking stack.
* Partner with ML researchers, data engineers, and hardware engineers to define requirements and make architectural decisions for large-scale training infrastructure.
* Build custom kernels and benchmarks that track and validate performance gains across the stack.
* Mentor engineers and raise the team’s technical bar through design reviews and best practices.

### **Qualifications**

Note: **You do not have to meet all the requirements** below to be considered for this position:

* 7+ years of total experience, including 4+ years on large-scale model training platforms, with a record of leading projects end to end.
* Deep experience with distributed training frameworks (Megatron-LM, TorchTitan) and efficiently utilizing GPU/accelerator clusters at scale.
* Experience with RL frameworks (Verl/MILES) and algorithms (GRPO, PPO).
* Experience with collective communication libraries (e.g., NCCL) and optimizing communication/compute overlap in multi-node training.
* Strong command of profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, or XLA/JAX profiling) to find and resolve training bottlenecks.
* Proficiency in Python or C++.
* Experience with ML compilers, performance tooling, or hardware/software co-design (GPU/TPU/accelerator architectures).
* Ability to influence across teams and communicate technical tradeoffs to both researchers and engineers.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

-----------------

Our dynamic team consists of 10 companies united in a single mission: to venture from Moon to Mars and beyond. Join us on this extraordinary adventure!

**This position has been aligned with Amentum Space Exploration Division. To learn more, click** **here**

**Description of Duties:**

The **Senior Systems Engineer** supports SLS Program / NASA systems on the Amentum ESSCA contract.

The key purpose of the position is to plan and perform systems engineering, development, assembly, test, verification, certification, integration activities specifically for the SLS Upper Stage for Artemis IV and beyond. Provide support to implement additional requirements for the ARTEMIS and MAESTRO software including design, development, integration and testing with Upper Stage partner(s). Facilitate integration as needed between SLS Core Stage test & integration facilities and Upper Stage test & integration facilities.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Systems Engineer will provide systems engineering support to the NASA SLS Upper Stage program office at MSFC. The skills needed to support the Core Stage consists of all the skills provided to the ES53 IATF, including Simulations software developers, systems engineers, integration and test engineers, and mechanical and electrical technicians.

Additional responsibilities are defined below:

* Perform or coordinate systems engineering activities including Trade Studies and Analysis, Requirements Definition and Traceability, Requirements Allocation and Verification, Interface Definition, System Integration and test, and Design Verification and Validation. Also ensure requirements and specifications can be verified and validated, including risk mitigations, usability and NASA requirements.

* Work closely with SLS Upper stage program office and IATF software, hardware, and facility development personnel during development, understanding of configurations in development, operation, verification, and validation of IATF systems and emulators.

* Assist the project verification and validation team by defining and delivering verification and validation project deliverables.

* Identify the data that will be required to show objectively that all configurations of the product meet their requirements, as well as customer needs.

* Ensure that all test systems and equipment are appropriately validated and controlled.

* Review and analyze IATF system test data and record pass/fail results and conclusions. Ensure that results are traced to requirements.

* Measure and report on progress toward completion of verification and validation, and summarize the verification and validation performed, the data reviewed, and conclusions reached in compliance.

* Support completion of development testing, to characterize designs and understand trade-offs.

* Create or contribute to project deliverables which may include verification and/or validation plans, protocols, and reports; execution of the plans and protocols; and resolving deviations.

* Manage timeline for verification and validation activities and generate status reports.

These activities will continue as the launch vehicle architecture matures and the SLS program completes program phases, reviews and schedule milestones.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 14 days. If a candidate has not been selected at that time, it will continue to be posted until a suitable candidate is selected or the position is closed.

Office environment. Requires ability to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely communication, both verbally and in writing (100%). Requires ability to interact professionally with co-workers, management, and client (100%). Requires travel in the domestic USA (5%). Requires ability to work at a computer for long periods of time (100%).

Requires ability to operate a personal computer, a telephone, fax machine, copier, calculator, and other general office equipment (100%).

Normal workday 7:30-4:30, Monday thru Friday. Minimal overtime may be required (10%) to meet schedule milestones and to support technical demands of the job. Regular attendance is a necessity, and adequate arrangements for delegating duties during absences are required.

**Other Essential Functions:**

You will work across a large enterprise environment spanning 28 IT engineering disciplines, helping solve complex operational problems, develop new capabilities, automate processes, and improve the effectiveness, security, and compliance of systems supporting tens of thousands of devices and users.

**Job Description: Systems Engineer – Energy Systems & Embedded Software**

**Company:** NAVIA Energy Inc.  
**Location:** San Jose, California (with customer-site travel)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Travel:** Required, including vendor facilities, customer sites, and energy system deployment locations  
**Work Authorization:** U.S. Citizenship Required

**About NAVIA Energy**

NAVIA Energy is developing an AI-powered autonomous energy operations platform that integrates solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), inverters, smart load controllers, and grid-connected energy assets. Our technology helps commercial and industrial facilities, microgrids, and mission-critical installations improve energy efficiency, reliability, resilience, and operational performance.

**Position Overview**

NAVIA Energy is seeking a versatile, hands-on Systems Engineer to support the integration, installation, commissioning, testing, and optimization of distributed energy systems. The ideal candidate combines practical knowledge of solar and battery systems with embedded software development, industrial communication protocols, system performance monitoring, and field engineering.

The engineer will work closely with NAVIA's engineering team, equipment vendors, installation contractors, and customers to develop, integrate, test, and deploy complete energy management solutions at customer sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Energy Systems Integration and Deployment**

* Support the design, integration, installation, and commissioning of solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), inverters, smart load controllers, meters, and associated electrical equipment.
* Coordinate with solar EPCs, battery suppliers, inverter manufacturers, electrical contractors, and other technology vendors.
* Support grid-connected and microgrid deployments, including grid import/export configurations, energy flow management, and load control.
* Assist with electrical system integration, equipment configuration, functional testing, troubleshooting, and site acceptance testing.
* Work with engineering teams to translate system designs into reliable field deployments.

**2. Embedded Software and Communication Protocols**

* Develop, configure, test, and debug embedded software for energy monitoring, control, and edge computing systems.
* Implement and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols, particularly **Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP**.
* Integrate communication interfaces with inverters, BESS controllers, meters, sensors, and smart load controllers.
* Develop device drivers, communication interfaces, configuration utilities, and diagnostic tools as needed.
* Support hardware-software integration, firmware validation, and system-level debugging.

* Install, configure, and maintain NAVIA software on edge computers, gateways, and customer-site systems.
* Support software deployment, firmware updates, device provisioning, network configuration, and remote connectivity.
* Validate data acquisition and communication between field devices and NAVIA's energy management platform.
* Document installation procedures, configuration settings, troubleshooting steps, and software release versions.

* Establish and track performance metrics for solar PV, BESS, inverters, grid interaction, and controllable loads.

* Develop performance dashboards, test reports, and system validation procedures.
* Identify performance deviations, communication failures, energy losses, and equipment integration issues.
* Support testing and validation of energy management algorithms, automated controls, and AI-based optimization functions.

jobs.title: Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Proteus Space is a Los Angeles-based spacecraft technology company established to capitalize on a rapidly evolving space landscape and the urgent need to deliver resilient orbital capabilities to maintain and increase our national science and security interests. We combine serious space flight experience with an open minded, first-principles approach, leveraging advanced computational design and Industry 4.0 practices to deliver custom spacecraft and mission solutions with industry leading speed, precision, and reliability. We seek to enable every payload and mission with a fully custom, purpose-built spacecraft bus, designed and delivered using Proteus™, our patent-pending, automated computational design platform, with industry leading reliability.

**Role Description**

We are seeking a Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer to join our flight program team. This is a full-time, in office role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of hands-on work across spacecraft flight software (FSW). In this role, you will design and implement the software architecture that controls everything from core telemetry and bus communications to complex boot behaviors and memory management. You will bridge the gap between high-level logic and low-level hardware, ensuring our spacecraft operates with industry-leading reliability in the harsh environment of space.

**Key Responsibilities**.

● Build and maintain spacecraft FSW architecture.

● Implement new software components and communication protocols to support mission-specific payload requirements.

● Ensure the smooth operation of core system tasks, including telemetry collection, precise time-stamping, rate group scheduling, and robust bus communications.

● Develop drivers and logic for interfacing with FPGAs and GPIOs to control spacecraft hardware.

● Design and manage memory storage solutions, making critical design decisions regarding volatile vs non-volatile memory to ensure data integrity.

● Develop and implement critical boot behaviors, partition swapping logic, and fail-safe recovery modes.

● Manage the codebase using Gitlab, including the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and development.

● Execute comprehensive test campaigns on flatsat testbeds and flight units to verify software performance under flight-like conditions.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate subsystems with the spacecraft main compute element.

● Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

● Document design processes, test results, and system performance.

● Provide technical guidance on FSW architectures to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or similar field.

● 5-7 years of flight software experience in aerospace or related fields, with heavy emphasis on hands-on spacecraft code development and testing

● Proficiency in Python, C/C++, and embedded Linux.

● Strong proficiency with Gitlab and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

● Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

● Must possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance.

**Desired Qualifications:**

● Proficiency in frameworks such as FPrime or CFS, and strong grasp of core computer architecture principles including operating systems, memory architecture, and I/O interfaces

● Demonstrated expertise with hardware-level protocols (I2C, CAN, UART, RS485, etc.) and interfacing with FPGAs and GPIOs.

● Experience working in clean room environments and adhering to ESD protocols.

● Experience with memory management, file systems, and bootloader development for embedded systems.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $225,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* On-site gym
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* RSU
* Stock options
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance?
* How many space missions have you developed flight software for?
* How many years experience do you have with flight software frameworks such as FPrime, CFS, MAX?

* Do you have at least 5 years of hands-on flight software experience with a primary focus on high-level application software, mission management logic, or onboard autonomy?
* Do you have any experience with GDS or operations?

jobs.title: Principal Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At **d-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.**

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI.

**Principal Test Automation Engineer**

**Location:** Santa Clara, Ca / Remote, US

**Role Overview**

d-Matrix is hiring a Principal Software Engineer to define and build how we use AI-enabled automation across the software development lifecycle, from build and CI through testing and release. Our codebase spans a kernel compiler, firmware, device drivers, and an inference serving stack running on silicon we designed ourselves. Tests require real hardware, correctness is numerical rather than pass/fail, and failures can originate in any of several layers. You will set the technical direction for AI-enabled workflow automation and build the foundations other engineers rely on, including the agent harness, integrations into GitLab, Jira, test results, and logs, guardrails, and evaluation methods that show whether an automation actually helped. You will stay hands-on and ship the hardest pieces yourself, working alongside a Senior/Staff engineer in the same area while raising the bar for how the broader engineering organization uses AI in its daily work.

**What You Will Do**

* Set the technical direction for AI-enabled workflow automation across build, CI, test, and release.
* Build the shared foundation, including the agent harness and tool integrations into GitLab, Jira, test results, logs, and observability data.
* Develop evaluation methodology to measure whether an automation saves time and preserves correctness.
* Define guardrails and standards for where AI acts autonomously, where it proposes and a human decides, and how every change stays auditable.
* Deliver the first Quality Engineering automations, including cross-layer failure attribution, failure clustering and defect deduplication, coverage-gap analysis, and release-readiness summaries.
* Raise the bar across engineering through shared patterns, design reviews, and mentoring.
* Determine when an agent, a deterministic tool with a narrow model step, or a simple script is the right solution, and teach that judgment to others.

**What You Will Bring**

* Extensive production software engineering experience, with strong Python skills.
* Enough Rust and/or C++ experience to understand build flows and diagnose compiler errors.
* Experience shipping AI-enabled tools or automation that others relied on in production, beyond demos.
* Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agent harnesses, tool integration, and context engineering.
* Experience designing evaluations for nondeterministic systems, showing that an automation helped without breaking something else.
* Sound judgment about when AI is the right tool, including examples of choosing not to use it.
* Strong fluency across the development lifecycle, including CI/CD, testing, and release processes.
* A track record of setting technical direction across teams that do not report to you.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to compilers, firmware, or hardware-in-the-loop test environments.
* Experience building tool integrations with MCP or similar protocols.
* Experience working with GitLab, Jira, or Prometheus APIs.
* Experience managing cost and latency in LLM-based systems.
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, with well-formed opinions on where they help and where they do not.

**Equal Opportunity Employment Policy**

**d-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

**d-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Compensation Range: $195K - $285K

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Machina Labs:**

Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

### **Job Description:**

Machina Labs is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to serve as both individual contributor and technical lead for the electrical systems behind our robotic manufacturing platforms.

You will own electrical design across the production cell and the platforms that follow, along with the architecture, standards, interfaces, and supplier relationships those machines depend on. You will make consequential calls on cost, schedule, compliance, and production readiness, lead technical engagement with suppliers, certification bodies, and customers, and set the bar for electrical work across Mechanical, Robotics, Automation, and Manufacturing.

The ideal candidate has led the electrical design of industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment across more than one machine or program, has taken machinery through compliance, and still wants to be hands-on while we grow the team.

### **What you will own:**

**Electrical architecture across platforms:**

* Own electrical design across the production cell and future platforms, including the electrical record: schematics, interconnect diagrams, panel layouts, and harness drawings, released and revision-controlled in PDM.

* Set the electrical architecture and documentation approach that can be reused across platforms.

* Define and govern interfaces between robot controllers, PLC panels, end effectors, and instrumentation under change control, and make the architecture, protection, and interface calls that affect cost, schedule, and production readiness.

* Perform, document, and set the practice for power distribution, grounding and bonding, and signal integrity analysis for 480VAC and 24VDC systems, drives, sensors, and I/O.

* Partner with the controls and software team, who own PLC and robot programming, on I/O, safety logic, and industrial network architecture.

* Lead investigation of complex and intermittent electrical problems across power, controls, and integration, and deliver root causes.

**Suppliers and production:**

* Own the technical relationship with outsourced panel and harness suppliers: release packages, approve deviations, drive quality issues to root cause, and prepare the supply base to build repeatably at production volume.

* Correct how panels and harnesses are built in-house today and set the build and inspection standard both in-house and supplier builds are held to.

* Design and review PLC and control panels for manufacturability and serviceability.

* Resolve the electrical problems that have resisted resolution, including those that cross disciplines, suppliers, and field installations.

**PCBAs and instrumentation:**

* Design and review custom PCBAs and instrumentation, and set the review, bring-up, and production release practice for board-level work.

**Compliance and machine safety:**

* Own the compliance approach for our machines against UL/IEC and machine safety requirements, and lead hardware through it.

* Lead technical engagement with certification bodies and customers on electrical matters.

* Anticipate systemic electrical and safety risk across programs and establish the design review practice that stops it before it reaches the floor.

**Technical leadership:**

* Set the technical standard for electrical work across the hardware team, including design standards, symbol libraries, and review checklists.

* Lead electrical design reviews across Mechanical, Robotics, and Manufacturing, and mentor and develop the engineers doing electrical work.

* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this role. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

### **Required Background & Experience:**

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

* 7+ years of electrical engineering on industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment, including end-to-end ownership of electrical design across multiple machines or a platform.

* Experience setting electrical standards, running design reviews, and developing other engineers.

* Electronic system, device, or instrumentation design, including PCBA schematics, bring-up, test, and validation.

* 480VAC power distribution and 24VDC control: panel design, drives, PLC I/O, safety circuits, grounding.

* Industrial network design (EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET).

* Diagnosing or mitigating EMI/EMC issues on servo drives and sensor wiring in high-noise industrial environments (shielding, grounding, cable routing).

* Fluency in electrical CAD (EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar) and producing release-quality schematics and harness drawings.

* Experience as the engineering owner for contract electrical system builds such as panels or harnesses.

* Strong documentation and change control discipline.

* Must be a U.S. person as defined under ITAR, due to access to export-controlled information.

* Able to work onsite in Chatsworth, CA, with occasional travel to suppliers, customers, or additional Machina factory sites.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience taking industrial machinery through compliance (UL 508A, NFPA 79, NFPA 70 (NEC), IEC 60204-1, IEC 62061, or equivalent).
