jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with omniscient systems purpose-built for today's realities. Designed and built by top U.S. military veterans and Silicon Valley innovators, CHAOS Industries' products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. In a world where technological threats move at unprecedented speed, CHAOS Industries delivers advanced sensing and detection solutions that give the ultimate advantage: time.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised $1B in total funding from leading investors including 8VC, Accel, and NEA. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

  

### **The Role**

You'll join a small, highly collaborative team in San Francisco building the software behind some of the world's most advanced radar systems.  
Working alongside software, hardware, and systems engineers, and the teams who take these systems into the field, you'll design the backend services and data pipelines that turn raw sensor data into decisions people can act on.  
We're looking for builders who learn quickly and enjoy hard distributed systems and real-time data problems.

### **What You'll Build**

* Edge-to-Cloud Data Delivery - robust, low-latency systems that move sensor data from radars in the field, often over constrained bandwidth, to the services and operators that depend on it.
* Backend Services - high-performance Python (FastAPI) services that ingest, process, and distribute real-time sensor data reliably and securely at scale.
* Live and Replay Data - the streaming, storage, and replay of detections, tracks, and telemetry that power high-speed live views and playback of 3D geospatial data fused from multiple sensors.
* Fleet Orchestration - the coordination and decision-making layer that optimizes how a growing fleet of sensors operates as conditions in the field change.
* Platform Architecture - help shape the technical direction of the platform, making architectural decisions that support new capabilities, increasing scale, and long-term maintainability.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for exceptional software engineers who are excited by hard technical problems and building systems that matter. Beyond our core stack, we care more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly than about any specific technology.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

* Have strong production experience building backend services in Python (FastAPI or similar).
* Have built real-time or streaming data systems - message queues, WebSockets, time-series data - and enjoy hard distributed systems problems.
* Have owned a production system end to end - designed it, shipped it, and fixed it when it broke.
* Are eager to learn new technologies and adapt to new technical domains.
* Care deeply about reliability, security, and scalability.
* Get real leverage from AI coding tools, with a considered view on what to delegate to them and what not to.
* Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams.

Experience in any of the following is a plus:

* Building geospatial or 3D data visualizations in TypeScript and React.
* Edge computing, or moving data reliably over constrained or unreliable networks.
* Azure or another major cloud platform.
* Hardware, sensors, robotics, telemetry, or defense systems.

### **Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen or permanent resident), as required for access to controlled technology.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, the San Francisco Bay Area. This role is onsite in our SF office.

  

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***$140k-240k***

*The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Storage
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role**

The Cloud Storage team at Crusoe is seeking a **Senior Staff Software Engineer** to serve as a primary architect and visionary for our storage strategy. While a Staff Engineer leads features, a Senior Staff Engineer defines the multi-year technical roadmap that underpins our AI-scale infrastructure. You will be a multiplier, responsible for the architectural strategy, integrity and global scalability of our bespoke storage services. You will work at the physics of the stack, bridging the gap between high-performance NVMe hardware and globally distributed, S3-competitive object stores.

**What You’ll Be Working On**

* **Architectural Vision & Strategy:** Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for Crusoe’s storage engine. Identify industry trends (e.g., CXL, NVMe-oF) and integrate them into a cohesive roadmap.
* **System Programming Expertise:** Leverage proven experience in system programming with languages such as **C, C++, Go, and/or Rust** to build the foundations of our V2 storage re-architecture.
* **Storage Protocols:** Architect and implement solutions utilizing industry-standard storage protocols such as **NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe/TCP.**
* **Open Source Stewardship:** Drive and maintain a track record of contributions to the open-source community (e.g., **Ceph, GlusterFS, Lustre, Spectrum Scale, OpenEBS**).
* **Technical Authority:** Serve as the final arbiter for critical architecture decisions across the Foundations organization. Lead complex design reviews that intersect storage, networking, and virtualization.
* **Deep Performance Engineering:** Lead "tiger teams" to solve the most ambiguous and difficult bottlenecks in the stack—from kernel-level IO context switching to global tail-latency in distributed clusters.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Work closely with Executive Leadership and Product to align technical capabilities with business milestones, such as our imminent path to IPO.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* **Cloud Storage Expertise:** 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale, complex distributed cloud computing infrastructure products.
* **Troubleshooting & Tuning:** Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills; ability to profile and optimize the entire IO path.
* **High-Drive Mindset:** Self-motivation to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and minimal supervision.
* **Masters of Consistency & Durability:** Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of distributed state and data protection at petabyte scale.
* **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Mastery of professional software engineering practices for the full SDLC, including coding standards, build processes, and testing.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Ability to champion and lead initiatives across the engineering organization, such as tech talks and technical reading groups.

**Bonus Points**

* **Public Cloud & AI/ML:** Expertise in one or more Public Cloud offerings (**AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI**) and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (**PyTorch, Tensorflow, JAX**) and MLOps.
* **High-Throughput I/O:** Experience with cutting-edge I/O architectures like **DAOS or SPDK**.
* **Networking Foundations:** Background in **RDMA** and high-performance networking, including **SmartNICs and RoCEv2**.
* **Distributed Systems Mastery:** Experience with highly available and scalable systems such as **Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka**.
* **Theoretical Depth:** Strong knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals including **CAP Theorem, Paxos/RAFT, consistent hashing, and sharding strategies**.
* **Education:** Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $245,000 - $290,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

**THE ROLE**

The Hyperscale Line of Business builds and ships products to hyperscale customers at exabyte scale, with an emphasis on speed, reliability, and operational excellence. The Build Environments and Tools team owns developer productivity infrastructure related to build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments that engineers rely on daily to build and test software.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join this team and help build fast, reliable, and reproducible build infrastructure at scale. You'll work hands-on with build orchestration, build-system internals, and containerized build environments — including large-scale C/C++ builds — while partnering with tech leads and engineers across the Hyperscale org to remove friction from everyday developer workflows.

* Own and evolve containerized build environments, ensuring consistent, isolated, and reproducible build images

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - ML/AI

Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51+ million homes, and 14 million+ people rely on the myQ® app daily.

This role is central to our mission of enhancing everyday intelligence in connected systems. This role will be responsible for building robust pipelines that analyze temporal behavior, identify anomalies, and trigger intelligent alerts.

Job Responsibilities:

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for detecting anomalies in time-series data from connected devices (e.g., cameras, door sensors, access logs).
* Build pipelines that analyze historical patterns and identify deviations using a combination of statistical, classical ML, and deep learning approaches.
* Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure real-time model inference, stream processing, and alert triggering

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of applied AI and full-stack engineers.
* Guide career development. Hire top talent and build a strong, collaborative team culture.

* 10+ years of experience software engineering experience with 5+ in ML engineering or data science with a focus on real-time systems, behavior modeling, or time-series data.
* Proven experience building and deploying anomaly detection systems in production.

Other:

* Experience in IoT, software services, video, and AI
* Analytical and systems thinker who can reason about behavioral patterns over time
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data integrity and alert quality
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and building 0-1 systems
* Effective communicator — able to explain models, metrics, and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with consumer electronics, smart home companies will be beneficial

jobs.description:
**R&D Electrical Engineer**

**Research & Development**

**Caldera Medical’s Mission - To Improve the Quality of Life for Women!**

**About Caldera Medical**  
Caldera Medical is committed to improving the quality of life for women worldwide through innovative pelvic health and neuromodulation solutions. Our growing R&D team is developing the next generation of connected device technology while continuing to advance the surgical products clinicians rely on today.

Headquartered in Westlake Village, CA, with international operations in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, Caldera combines clinical insight with engineering excellence to bring meaningful therapies to market.

**The Opportunity**  
Want to own the electrical design of products that change women's lives — not just a single subsystem? We're looking for a hands-on Electrical Engineer to lead electrical work across two product lines: Gynesis, our wearable neuromodulation platform on its way to market, and an established surgical product line already in physicians' hands.

You'll design what's next and make what's proven even better. As part of a small, collaborative R&D team, you'll have real ownership, visible impact, and a direct voice in design decisions.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead component-level electrical design for new product development, partnering with external engineering resources to bring it to market.
* Drive design improvements and design-for-manufacturing initiatives on an in-market product.
* Define and coordinate electrical interfaces across connectors, boards, and components.
* Collaborate with Systems and Mechanical Engineering on cross-functional design decisions.
* Own electrical verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution.
* Support design documentation, risk management, and IEC 60601 safety and EMC testing.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* BSEE, BSECE, or equivalent.
* 5–7 years of hands-on electrical engineering experience; medical device experience strongly preferred.
* Experience working with external design partners or vendors on component-level design.
* Experience with design improvement or cost reduction (DFM/VAVE) and electrical V&V.
* NMES/electrostimulation or wearable electronics experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with IEC 60601, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and FDA design controls is a plus.

*Don't meet every requirement? If you have strong component-level design experience and most of the above, we encourage you to apply.*

**Why This Role Matters**  
This is a chance to put your name on the electrical design of a new therapy and shape the future of a proven one. Your work will go from schematic to the women who rely on it.

**Competitive Compensation, Comprehensive Benefits, and more!**  

* Relocation assistance available for this role
* Medical and Dental Benefits
* Vision Coverage
* 401(k) with 4% matching contributions after 90 days of employment
* Basic Life and AD&D

Caldera Medical is dedicated to improving the quality of life for women through innovative surgical solutions for stress urinary incontinence, pelvic organ prolapse, polyps, and fibroids.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a **Sr. Software Development Engineer II** (SDE) role in the **CTIO** team that is bringing multiple AI-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.

The **CTIO** team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
* Conceptualize and develop new product features.
* Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
* Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
* Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

**What You’ll Need:**

  

* Deep knowledge of C/C++; Swift experience required for macOS-focused candidates; Windows OS Kernel and Driver Development experience required for Windows-focused candidates.
* Hands-on experience operationalizing machine learning models on the endpoint, including building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference.
* Extensive, fundamental understanding of internals for your primary platform (macOS, Linux, or Windows)
* Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases.
* Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.

**Bonus Points:**

  

* Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light-weight, and highly performing systems
* In-depth OS system expertise regarding core concepts and subsystems
* Familiarity and experience utilizing Agile methodologies
* Knowledge of security principles
Experience with eBPF

* Design, implement, test and document complex software applications using C/C++ for use in embedded systems

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer - 1691
jobs.description:
Scientific Applications & Research Associates, Inc. (SARA) is a world-class Defense Research and Development enterprise, with a charter to create new and emerging technology innovations in support of Commercial & Government organizations. We have expertise in RF, EMP, Pulsed Power, Acoustics and Threat Warning Systems, and we prioritize partnering with our customers to address real-world problems with cost-effective solutions… that work.

The SARA High Power Electromagnetics Division (HPEM) is looking for a remarkably talented, motivated, and imaginative **Senior** **Electronics Hardware Design Engineer** to support research and development activities and transition innovative technologies to the DoD, DoE, and their contractors in Colorado Springs, CO. The candidate will have the opportunity to grow and learn with talented engineers, physicists, and technicians on long-standing programs and new programs supporting our customers. Our small group will allow the candidate to experience, contribute, and collaborate in a multidisciplinary nature from conception all the way through to operation.

The **Senior** **Electronics Hardware Design Engineer** will be responsible for electrical system architecture, schematic capture, layout design, and prototype or delivery testing of complex research and development-oriented electronics. Further design implementation, maintenance, and improvement will be a standard practice for all developed circuit designs. This position demands a high degree of understanding in electrical engineering fundamentals, and the ability to directly apply engineering skills and practices into real products and designs. This is a hands-on design role for someone who thrives on creating new solutions and seeing them through to completion. The ideal candidate combines creative design thinking with rigorous technical implementation skills.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Design and architect new electronics systems from concept through implementation, including system architecture, PCB design, and validation
* Developing quality control and testing procedures to be incorporated into regular design process
* Writing detailed technical reports on designs, test results, and intended testing & operating procedures
* Supporting highly technical engineering and scientific teams on field test activities when necessary
* Providing technical mentoring and support to develop the skill sets within the team

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field
* 12 – 15 years of design experience in the field of Electrical Engineering
* Excellent written & verbal communication, attention to detail, and multitasking skills
* Adaptability to work in a highly flexible, fluid, and fast-paced team environment
* Willingness to participate in roughly 5%-time travel for customer briefings and testing events
* US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance
* May require light physical effort, involving standing, sitting and use of hands while performing duties, carrying or lifting up to 50 pounds
* Working environment is indoor, moderately quiet, reasonably clean, well-lighted and well-ventilated, moderate physical hazards may exist

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of design experience in the field of Electrical Engineering
* Active DoD TS/SCI Security Clearance
* Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering + 10 years or Bachelor’s Degree + 12 years of experience in a specialized EE field
* Deep experience in analog, digital, high voltage, data integrity, or power & protection circuit design

**Example Desired Proficiencies:**

* Strong portfolio demonstrating innovative and novel electrical system designs
* Extensive experience in high power solid-state switching design and system architecture
* High voltage system design and improvements
* Complex power generation
* Gate drive circuitry and architecture
* Snubber and protection circuitry and architecture
* STM32 Microcontroller based control systems
* Data acquisition and processing circuitry

**SARA offers a competitive benefits package to include:**

* Medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; and other supplemental programs
* A generous PTO program (vacation, sick, holiday)
* Tuition & certification reimbursement
* Flexible work schedules
* Discretionary Employee bonuses
* 401(k) match/profit sharing
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)

Pay Range

Salary at SARA is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $125,000 to $175,000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of SARA’s total compensation package for employees. Positions are on-site, unless indicated otherwise.

Application Deadline: November 13, 2026

SARA is an equal employment opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Associate Laser Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Infleqtion we solve the world’s most challenging problems using cutting-edge quantum technology. Our mission is to commercialize atom-based quantum products that provide orders of magnitude improvements in sensing and computing applications. We are proud to work tirelessly to create and lead the quantum ecosystem towards meaningful advancements today and set the technology roadmap for tomorrow.

POSITION SUMMARY

Within Infleqtion’s Quantum Computing Product Group, the Hardware Engineering Team is seeking an Associate Laser Systems Engineer for neutral-atom quantum computing hardware. You will carry out well-defined laser assembly, characterization and control tasks, building practical judgment through laboratory work and design reviews. You’ll have dedicated time for technical learning and hands-on training, supported by regular guidance from experienced engineers.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Typically, you will be entrusted with:

 Assemble and align assigned laser paths using reviewed layouts and laser-safety procedures.

 Calculate expected power levels and frequency shifts for assigned setups, and compare predictions with measurements.

 Measure laser power, polarization, beam profiles and short-term stability against provided acceptance criteria.

 Set up detectors, modulation stages and feedback controls using reviewed procedures; record their response and operating settings.

 Work with engineers to isolate alignment, signal or lock problems, test fixes and flag issues beyond the assigned scope.

 Record setup changes, measurements and test conditions so others can reproduce the work; submit procedure improvements for review.

 Plan assigned tasks, report progress and blockers, and incorporate feedback from design and test reviews.

 **Requirements**

WE HOPE YOU HAVE:

 Bachelor’s degree in optical engineering, physics, electrical engineering or a related field. Prior industry experience is not required.

 Understanding of laser and optical fundamentals, with practice explaining beam propagation, polarization, interference and frequency.

 Hands-on practice assembling an optical or electro-optical setup and taking measurements while following laboratory safety procedures.

 Practice interpreting detector signals and explaining how gain, noise and negative feedback affect a measurement or control loop.

 Experience analyzing measurements, comparing them with predictions and explaining differences using calculations, spreadsheets or scripts.

 Experience keeping accurate setup and measurement records, checking work for errors and flagging unexpected results.  Experience explaining technical work clearly, raising questions or problems early, and incorporating feedback.

WE HIGHLY VALUE:

 Project experience with laser characterization, optical modulation or feedback control.

 Experience using Python or comparable tools to collect and analyze laboratory data.

 Experience with atomic spectroscopy, optical resonators or low-noise photodetection

Coursework, laboratory classes, research, internships and projects can demonstrate these skills. Preferred qualifications are helpful, not required.

NOTE

 Job responsibilities and requirements are illustrative, other responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

TRAVEL Up to 10% travel may be required.

WORKING CONDITIONS and PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Work will normally be performed in an office and laboratory environment and around technical equipment including computers and lasers. Able to sit, stand, bend, lift and carry up to 40 pounds without assistance. Able to efficiently use automated office equipment such as laptops, copiers, and printers; able to effectively engage in communications (via phone, computer, or in-person). Any required Personal Protective Equipment will be provided and must be properly used in accordance with company requirements

 **Benefits**

* 100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, short/long-term disability

* Unlimited PTO
* 401(k) match

Defibtech is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Software Engineer responsible for production tools, databases, platforms, and test station software used in the manufacture of medical devices, which are deployed both on site and at Defibtech’s contract manufacturers. * Supports and implements updates on-site and at contract manufacturing sites to support Defibtech production systems.
* Develops and maintains production tools and systems, which are used to interface with Defibtech devices and test equipment, program and test the devices, generate labels, and automate recording of test data. Software development is inclusive of coding, sandbox testing, documentation, writing and executing test protocols, and managing release of the code through the Engineering Change process, all according to quality and regulatory requirements.

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

What We’re Doing

At Lockheed Martin, innovation and integrity drive everything we do. Within Rotary and Mission Systems, our teams develop advanced avionics and mission-critical solutions that power modern defense platforms. We value your skills, education, and ideas—and give you opportunities to think big, grow, and build technology that matters.

The Work

We are seeking an Staff Software Engineer to join a Mission Systems team that develops software applications supporting critical business and mission objectives. The incumbent will execute all phases of the software development lifecycle—requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation—under very general supervision. Success requires strong teamwork, clear communication, and the ability to coordinate with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Program Management, and the Software Architecture group. Familiarity with Agile development, DevSecOps, DO‑178C, C/C++, Python, Linux, GitLab, and Atlassian tools is desired.

Who We Are

We’re a collaborative team of engineers and innovators developing high-performance avionics systems. Our work combines systems, software, hardware, and integration expertise to deliver reliable capabilities for critical aerospace and defense missions.

Who You Are

You’re a detail-oriented engineer who enjoys turning complex problems into a structured, well designed software product. You communicate effectively, collaborate across disciplines, and are motivated to understand how software, hardware, and systems work together.

You bring:

* A foundation in systems engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with software development and management tools.
* Understanding of embedded software and hardware/software integration.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Why Join Us

Build your career while contributing to cutting-edge avionics and mission systems. At Lockheed Martin, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers, grow your technical skills, and help shape technologies that support critical missions.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, and 9 years of professional experience or a Master’s degree with

* 7 years of experience.
* Demonstrated expertise in embedded software‑systems engineering, full‑life‑cycle development, hardware‑software integration, and software architecture/design.
Ability to travel occasionally (* 4‑6 times per year) and to communicate effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Expertise in multiple programming languages (C/C++, Python, C#) and software‑architecture patterns.
* Strong background in Agile Scrum, serving as Scrum Master or Product Owner (certification preferred).
* Experience with DO‑178C, safety‑critical development, and model‑based engineering (MBSE, SysML/UML).
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead small development teams.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and presentation skills for inter‑organizational and customer engagements.
* Background in MBSE, SysML/UML, and modeling tools (Cameo, Rhapsody).
* Hands‑on DevSecOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, static code analysis, unit testing, automated test environments, and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).
* DO‑178C compliance, safety‑critical development, and automated testing for embedded systems.
* Proven technical leadership of multi‑site, multidisciplinary software teams; Scrum Master/Product Owner certifications preferred.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and customer‑relationship management skills; experience with CAM/proposal development a plus.

Full-Time Salary Range: $135700.00 - $251900.00

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**Job summary**

**This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert**

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI-assisted features and internal tooling.

You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

**What you will do**

* Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.

* Integrate third-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
* Use AI-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
* Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI-generated code alike.
* Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

  

**What you will have**

* Comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence-led debugging in production.
* Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a design, a trade-off, or an incident to engineers and non-engineers.

  

**Nice to have**

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.
  
9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

Program areas include sUAS, Counter UAS systems, and Autonomy Algorithms. Typically, the Unmanned Systems Integration Branch integrates hardware into low cost commercially available surrogate platforms for demonstration purposes. Primary sponsors are from the US military research and development community.

The responsibilities of the branch chief include development of junior research faculty into project leaders, conducting performance appraisals, actively developing sponsor relationships, and executing research programs. This position is expected to consume approximately 30%-50% time. The remaining time is anticipated to come from sponsored research. The branch is located in Smyrna, GA on the Georgia Tech Cobb County Research Facility (CCRF). Travel is required in conducting GTRI research, developing business, meeting with customers and demonstrating applied solutions.

### **Job Purpose**

jobs.title: Mechatronics Controls Engineer for Cartesian Robotics
jobs.description:
**Mechatronics Controls Engineer for Cartesian Robotics**
=========================================================

**Build motion that moves industries**
--------------------------------------

Picture this: a manufacturer needs a cartesian robot to speed up precision handling. You review their requirements, select an actuator with profile rail and a ball/lead screw, size a servo and drive with accurate load calculations, and implement safety, sensors, and controls. You program the PLC in IEC 61131-3, tune the axes for crisp performance, and wire a clean, well-labeled panel. When testing reveals a hiccup, you read the schematics, troubleshoot the panel, and iterate until it runs flawlessly. Along the way, you coordinate with vendors, customers, sales, and fellow engineers—and when the application demands something new, you help shape the next PBC Linear product.

**Your impact**
---------------

* Serve as a technical authority for linear motion systems, components, and actuators.
* Own design, component selection, and troubleshooting using stepper motors, servo motors, drives, sensors, and safety equipment.
* Analyze loads to properly size motors and drives.
* Tune servo/stepper-driven linear motion systems to meet demanding motion profiles.
* Program PLC systems with IEC 61131-3 languages; integrate drives and field devices.
* Install and wire electrical components into control panels; read and produce electrical control schematics.
* Diagnose and correct faults in existing electrical panels.
* Support customer applications and linear motion test stands—from design and construction through operation and troubleshooting.
* Communicate effectively with engineering colleagues, vendors, and customers on controls opportunities and issues.
* Apply broad mechatronics knowledge across controls, software, and mechanical actuator systems.
* Use electrical design software to document and validate control architectures.
* Partner with sales and customers to translate requirements into the right PBC Linear products—or assist in creating new solutions where gaps exist.
* Enhance tooling and tests with optional C++, C#, or Visual Basic skills.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Proven, hands-on understanding of servo and stepper motor dynamics, PLCs, controls, and drive systems.
* Exposure to linear motion elements including actuators, profile rail, ball screws, lead screws, and linear bearings (preferred).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related 2-year technical degree; preferred fields include Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or Mechatronics.

**Life at PBC Linear**
----------------------

PBC Linear (A Pacific Bearing Company) is a global leader in linear technology and a proud local manufacturer committed to our associates and our community. We thrive on challenge and move fast in a dynamic environment. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, STD, LTD, AD&D, and Aflac.

**Equal Employment**
--------------------

PBC Linear is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.

* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.

* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

You should be proficient in:

* PLC Programming Experience
* SCADA Experience

jobs.title: Principal – Electrical & Controls / Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Principal – Electrical & Controls / Automation Engineer is a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert responsible for providing enterprise-level technical leadership across electrical, controls, industrial networking, PLC, SCADA, and automation systems. This position serves as one of Engineering’s highest technical authorities for complex automation and electrical systems. The Principal Engineer is expected to personally solve the organization’s most difficult technical problems while establishing technical standards, mentoring engineering and technician resources, and improving the reliability, maintainability, and performance of automated manufacturing equipment.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

**Technical Leadership & Troubleshooting**

* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex electrical, controls, PLC, SCADA, networking, and automation issues across manufacturing operations.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of difficult or recurring equipment failures that cannot be resolved through normal maintenance and engineering escalation paths.
* Diagnose complex interactions between electrical systems, PLC logic, industrial networks, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, safety systems, SCADA, and equipment controls.
* Use a structured, data-driven troubleshooting methodology to identify root causes rather than relying on component replacement or trial-and-error troubleshooting.
* Provide hands-on technical support during critical equipment failures and high-impact production events.
* Identify systemic technical weaknesses and develop permanent corrective actions that improve equipment reliability and reduce repeat failures.

**PLC & Controls Systems**

* Serve as a senior technical resource for industrial electrical systems and machine-control hardware.
* Troubleshoot complex electrical problems involving control power, power distribution, motors, VFDs, servo systems, safety circuits, sensors, instrumentation, grounding, noise, and communication systems.
* Troubleshoot, modify, optimize, and validate complex PLC programs and machine-control architectures.

**Industrial Networking**

* Serve as a technical authority for industrial networking and OT communications.
* Troubleshoot complex network and communication failures involving PLCs, SCADA systems, HMIs, drives, remote I/O, vision systems, instrumentation, servers, and manufacturing equipment.
* Demonstrate expert-level understanding of Ethernet/IP, industrial Ethernet, TCP/IP, VLANs, managed switches, network segmentation, routing fundamentals, addressing, communication diagnostics, and industrial network architecture.
* Work collaboratively with IT and cybersecurity teams to maintain secure, reliable connectivity between operational technology and enterprise systems.

**SCADA, HMI & Manufacturing Systems**

* Provide technical leadership for SCADA and HMI architecture, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration.
* Troubleshoot communication and data-flow issues between equipment controls, SCADA, historians, databases, and manufacturing information systems.
* Support development of standardized approaches for equipment connectivity, tag structures, alarms, data collection, and system integration.
* Partner with Digital Transformation and Manufacturing Intelligence resources to enable reliable acquisition and use of equipment data.

**Reliability & Root Cause Engineering**

* Partner with Reliability Engineering and factory engineering teams to identify recurring failure modes using downtime, alarm, maintenance, and equipment-performance data.
* Develop engineered solutions that eliminate failure modes rather than repeatedly restoring equipment to operation.
* Identify opportunities for condition monitoring, predictive diagnostics, improved alarming, and automated fault detection.

**Technical Mentorship**

* Serve as a technical mentor to Controls Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Controls Technicians, Engineering Technicians, and other engineering resources.
* Develop the troubleshooting capabilities of plant engineering teams through structured coaching and hands-on problem solving.
* Transfer knowledge from complex troubleshooting events into documented standards, troubleshooting guides, and lessons learned.
* Help establish technical competency expectations and training requirements for controls and electrical disciplines.
Promote disciplined engineering practices and a culture of technical excellence.  

  

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls or Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or mechanical Engineering with demonstrated competencies strongly preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and extensive demonstrated industrial controls expertise may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 6(+) years of progressive experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, electrical engineering, or related manufacturing engineering disciplines.
* Extensive hands-on experience supporting highly automated manufacturing equipment.
* Demonstrated history of personally resolving complex controls, electrical, networking, and automation problems.
* Experience serving as a senior technical authority, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Lead Engineer, or equivalent technical SME strongly preferred.
Experience in high-volume, highly automated man

**About the Department**

The University of Chicago Research Computing Center (RCC), a unit within the Office of Research, provides advanced research computing resources and expertise to support computational and data-intensive research across the University. RCC enables research through centrally managed high-performance computing (HPC), storage, visualization, and AI infrastructure, along with scientific consulting, user support, education, and training. RCC also helps researchers leverage local, national, and cloud-based computational resources.  
  
The Office of Research oversees sponsored research administration, research development, and contract management across the University.

**Job Summary**

The job participates in the design of automated, scalable, and rapidly deployable solutions to systems infrastructure and server configuration. Installs, configures, and maintains operating systems, monitoring and alerting systems, utility software, and firewalls. Plans and executes hands-on maintenance for production servers as well as Windows and Linux servers.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - ML/AI
jobs.description:
Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51+ million homes, and 14 million+ people rely on the myQ® app daily.

This role is central to our mission of enhancing everyday intelligence in connected systems. This role will be responsible for building robust pipelines that analyze temporal behavior, identify anomalies, and trigger intelligent alerts.

Job Responsibilities:

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for detecting anomalies in time-series data from connected devices (e.g., cameras, door sensors, access logs).
* Build pipelines that analyze historical patterns and identify deviations using a combination of statistical, classical ML, and deep learning approaches.
* Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure real-time model inference, stream processing, and alert triggering
* Tune models for low false positives and high sensitivity while maintaining operational efficiency.
* Develop and manage ML Ops pipelines for training, testing, deployment, and monitoring of anomaly detection systems
* Implement robust monitoring and feedback loops to adapt to behavior drift or seasonal variations.
* Contribute to overall AI system architecture and collaborate with engineers working on LLM-based assistants and agentic AI to ensure seamless integration.
* Work across product, engineering, and AI research teams to ensure scalable and performant deployment of models
* Drive decision-making around tooling, infrastructure, observability, and production-readiness.
* Mentor engineers across the org in AI-native engineering patterns, architecture, and LLM ecosystem evolution
* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of applied AI and full-stack engineers.
* Guide career development. Hire top talent and build a strong, collaborative team culture.
* Comply with health and safety guidelines and rules; managers should also ensure compliance across their teams.
* Protect Chamberlain Group’s reputation by keeping information confidential.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
* Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science
* 10+ years of experience software engineering experience with 5+ in ML engineering or data science with a focus on real-time systems, behavior modeling, or time-series data.
* Proven experience building and deploying anomaly detection systems in production.
* Hands-on experience with time-series libraries (e.g., Prophet, Darts, GluonTS, Kats, Merlion).
* Experience working with event-driven architectures, edge devices, or smart home / IoT environments is a plus.
* Familiarity with vector databases or integration with LLMs

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Strong understanding of time-series analysis, including: Trend/seasonality decomposition, Statistical anomaly detection methods (ARIMA, z-score, moving average), Classical ML techniques (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, clustering-based approaches), Deep learning for sequences (LSTM, GRU, TCN, Transformers)
* Experience in streaming data processing and building pipelines that operate on live or near-real-time data.
* Knowledge of change point detection, event modeling, and alert systems.
* Ability to design interpretable anomaly detection systems with threshold tuning, confidence scoring, and alert escalation.
* Understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML, versioning, and retraining strategies.
* Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
* Proficient in data handling and engineering tools such as Pandas, NumPy, Kafka, Spark, or Flink

Other:

* Ability to travel up to 10% of the time domestically and internationally

Preferred Job Requirements:

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Experience in IoT, software services, video, and AI
* Analytical and systems thinker who can reason about behavioral patterns over time
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data integrity and alert quality
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and building 0-1 systems
* Effective communicator — able to explain models, metrics, and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with consumer electronics, smart home companies will be beneficial

The pay range for this position is $148,912.00 - $254,054.00; base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. **Position Overview**

In this role, you will build and modernize **Human-Machine Interface (HMI)** desktop applications that control and monitor complex CNC machining systems. You will use **C#** to drive high-performance, real-time desktop UIs and **Python** to deploy predictive machine learning models at the edge. This role is critical to transforming raw machine telemetry into actionable, intelligent automation on the shop floor.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Next-Gen HMI Development:** Design, scale, and optimize high-performance desktop interfaces that connect operator control systems directly with CNC machinery.

* **Edge Machine Learning Integration:** Deploy, test, train, and optimize PyTorch and **TensorFlow** models inside production environments to handle anomalies, predict tool wear, and automate vision-based quality control in addition to predicting part deviations.
* **Hybrid Data Architecture:** Build and manage data layers that combine structured configuration/part logs with scalable NoSQL (**MongoDB**) for high-frequency time-series sensor data.
* **Hardware-Software Synthesis:** Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and automation engineers to ingest CNC controller data seamlessly into your application workflows.

* **WinUI & Avalonia:** Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of building fluid Windows 11 apps and cross-platform desktop interfaces (Windows/ UI deployment).

**Machine Learning & Intelligence (Python)**

* **PyTorch & TensorFlow:** Practical experience deploying and inferencing machine and deep learning models in real-world environments.
* **Python Engineering:** Mastery of Python for analytics pipelines, sensor data preprocessing, and scripting to communicate with C# backends.

**Databases & Telemetry**

* **SQL:** Strong proficiency in relational database schema design, indexing, and complex queries (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
* **MongoDB:** Solid understanding of NoSQL concepts for managing semi-structured telemetry, time-series data, and machine logs.

**Qualifications & Preferred Skills**

This role leads the assessment, integration, deployment, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and sustainment of hardware across geographically distributed and highly secure environments. jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium-lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high-assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will provide a cost-effective and reliable launch solution by leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program. If you're interested in joining a high-performing team and pushing the boundaries with a clean-sheet development of a reusable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

**SENIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – MARINE OPERATIONS**

We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineer based out of Rocket Lab's Space Structures Complex in Middle River, Maryland. You will be responsible for the design, specification, analysis, and execution of power distribution, navigation systems, controls, and communications systems on our recovery vessel.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Serve as the electrical engineering technical expert within the Marine Operations team, enabling recovery and reusability of Neutron

* Design critical electrical infrastructure, including schematics, layout, and routing for power, lighting, navigation, instrumentation, propulsion, and communications systems

* Coordinate with other Rocket Lab engineers to ensure electrical systems are well integrated with the other vessel systems

* Ensure all systems meet regulatory requirements (ABS, USCG, IEC, NFPA, FCC)

* Conduct design reviews to ensure systems meet requirements, identify risks, resource needs, and schedule estimates

* Work onboard the vessel during construction, ensuring build-out meets engineering specifications, and drive future modifications to enable more efficient mission execution

* Collaborate with the marine engineering group for commissioning and sea-trials test planning

* Troubleshoot and validate electrical systems during commissioning

* Oversee the operation, sustainment, troubleshooting, and repair of critical electrical power and control systems

* Build and manage electrical and electronic spares inventory and maintain minimum inventories of those onboard parts and components.

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or marine engineering

* 3+ years of experience as an electrical engineer, preferably in the maritime industry, with exposure to large vessels and autonomous or automated vessel systems

* Technical project management experience and the ability to liaise with external suppliers

* Advanced understanding of systems design principles

* Proficient in using EPLAN or comparable electrical CAD software for developing detailed schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts

* Advanced ability to analyze systems, troubleshoot and solve problems, and select and source equipment

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Project management experience in a fast-paced prototype environment

* Detailed knowledge of Siemens NX or similar CAD and PLM packages.

* Experience with hands-on projects, including the use of hand tools

* Knowledge of modern industrial communication protocols and network layers, including experience with Modbus (RTU/TCP), Profibus, Ethernet, and serial interfaces (RS-232/RS-485) for control systems

* Experience integrating marine components (hoists, thrusters, winches, radar, etc.)

* Valid and current training certifications as an Electrical or Electronic Technician issued by a recognized authority.

* At least two years of experience working on vessels of comparable size and mission duration, or in a similar industrial setting requiring equivalent qualifications and operational expertise.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

**FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:**

*To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR* *here**.*

We are seeking a motivated and skilled professional to join our growing team in our Woburn, MA office.

Join our ATCoach product team!

We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer with 7 or more years of experience to join our ATCoach product team supporting the FAA STARS, ERAM, and other customer programs. ATCoach is a high-fidelity approach and en route air traffic control simulator that is the choice of leading air navigation service providers, military organizations, and universities worldwide. We provide advanced standalone and embedded simulation solutions that enhance the training and operational capabilities of our customers, and contributing to safer aviation. As part of our team, you will develop and maintain simulation software, user interfaces, and support system integrations to enhance the training experience for air traffic controller clients. If you are a skilled and motivated software professional who is passionate about contributing to innovative projects and delivering tailored solutions, we invite you to apply and join our team.

What You'll Do:

* Design, develop, test and maintain new capabilities in our core simulation product and user interfaces.

* Integrate new features and troubleshoot system issues to ensure optimal performance and functionality.

* Translate customer requirements into effective software solutions across multiple applications.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Collaborate with colleagues and clients in North America and Europe.

Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**About the Role**
------------------

Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next-generation physical-world sensing and AI-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products.

As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi-product suite. You will also set patterns the rest of the team builds on. AI-native tooling is expected to be embedded in your workflow.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Design and build the sensing-platform connector/adapter layer that maps LiDAR- and imagery-derived asset detections into OpenGov Products
* Architect the automated detection-to-case pipeline that turns a sensing detection into a properly routed record in the right product's workflow engine, complete with photo evidence, GPS coordinates, and a severity score.
* Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer-vision and LiDAR-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd-capture).
* Design the data model and storage layer for a continuously updated spatial data that all five Community Operations products read from and contribute to.
* Own the technical design for a tiered sensing-ingestion model (satellite, fleet-vehicle camera, full LiDAR survey) supporting different refresh cadences, accuracy levels, and price points.
* Partner with engineering and product leads across OpenGov products to sequence the sensing layer's roadmap against each product's asset taxonomy and compliance requirements.
* Write clear technical design docs that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit.
* Establish testing, monitoring, and data-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-system integrations end-to-end in a production SaaS environment.
* Experience building or integrating computer-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data-processing pipelines; comfort with point-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus.
* Strong data-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one-off custom logic.
* Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred.
* Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build-vs-integrate calls.
* Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan.
* A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public-sector systems) is a strong plus.
* Proficient in AI-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness.
* Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**How This Level Is Differentiated**
------------------------------------

The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones:

* Owns a technical domain end-to-end with full accountability for outcomes, from architecture through production operation.
* Operates with strategic awareness across multiple downstream product teams; makes strong technical calls with incomplete vendor and data information.

* Expected to embed AI-native tooling in their own workflow and model its effective use for teammates joining the team.

jobs.title: RF Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About VectorWave**

VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio-frequency waveforms pre-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog.

We are a venture-backed MIT spinout translating award-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications!

**The role**

The RF embedded firmware engineer role entails designing and developing the programmable systems for VectorWave’s APU. In a multi-disciplinary effort, you will work closely with the analog hardware RF engineers and RF machine learning engineers to create subsystems that enable the APU to execute programmable signal processing operations and AI functionalities for wireless edge compute. Your work will be integrated with that of the other subsystem designers to advance the APU.

**Location:** This is an in-person, full-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences.

**What you'll do**

* Design subsystems for the APU’s programmable edge compute
* Choose the components and design circuit systems integrating RF components, memory, and microprocessors
* Program the control scheme and interface for the programmable APU subsystem
* Evaluate the performance of the programmable APU subsystem against internal and customer KPIs
* Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter-system compatibility

**What you bring**

* Expertise programming and interfacing with ADCs, DACs, and on-board memory
* Experience programming microprocessor units (MPUs) and/or RF system-on-chips (SoCs) and/or edge FPGAs
* Experience designing and implementing system-level interfaces between components
* Mathematical maturity and mastery of the physics of designed circuits
* Experience designing and implementing methods of analog system characterization
* Experience implementing environmental hardware stabilization as necessary
* A BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field

**Nice to have**

* An MS or PhD in a relevant field
* Published experimental demonstrations of any scalable analog circuitry (e.g. AI hardware accelerators, photonic integrated circuits, quantum hardware)
* Development board design experience
* Robust system documentation experience
* Experience using RF signal processing devices & components
* In-situ/physics-aware/back propagation-free machine learning for AI hardware accelerators
* Experience developing physically accurate digital twins to validate hardware designs through math and simulation
* Understanding of RF signal processing techniques
* RF PCB design & impedance matching experience

**How we work**

* **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details.
* **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them.
* **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non-technical helps us solve problems together.
* **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve.
* **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust.
* **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie.

**Compensation and benefits**

Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus:

**The basics**

* Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits.
* Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included.
* Vision: Guardian.
* Unlimited PTO.

**Family matters**

* We offer 95% dependent premium coverage.
* Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning.
* Coming soon: Twenty-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non-birthing, adoptive, and foster.

**For life beyond work**

* 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar.
* Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit.

**Equal opportunity**

VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
