jobs.description:
Oracle is seeking a Senior Power Engineer to join the team that designs and supports power solutions for its server architectures. The role spans the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through qualification, production, and sustaining engineering. Key products include AC/DC power supplies, battery backup units (BBUs), BBU shelves, and rack-mounted power distribution units (PDUs), with particular emphasis on ORv3-based systems.

The engineer will design and integrate electrical subsystems that meet functional, performance, efficiency, security, and reliability requirements. Responsibilities include component selection and qualification, schematic capture, FPGA design where applicable, and the testing and validation of analog and digital power-control systems. The role also involves developing specifications, test plans, test reports, signal integrity constraints, and bills of materials; investigating product issues; and working across engineering teams to bring designs into production and support them over time.

The successful candidate will bring deep experience in power electronics, strong knowledge of analog and digital power control, clear technical communication skills, and familiarity with relevant industry standards, tools, and design practices.

The role will be based in Burlington Massachusetts and is not a remote position.

  

**Key Responsibilities — Senior Power Engineer**

* Lead the design, development, and integration of power supplies, converters, battery backup units (BBUs), BBU shelves, and power distribution units (PDUs) for Oracle server and rack-level systems. Translate system requirements into designs that meet performance, efficiency, reliability, cost, and schedule targets.
* Bring up prototypes and lead hands-on lab characterization, testing, and debugging across operating loads and environmental conditions.
* Develop test plans and validation methods to confirm that power products operate reliably and integrate correctly with Oracle server architectures. Build and maintain validation automation where appropriate.
* Partner with firmware, software, diagnostics, and system engineering teams to implement power controls, monitoring, fault reporting, and system-level diagnostics.
* Work with component suppliers and power-product vendors to define requirements, verify performance, resolve technical issues, and qualify designs and alternate sources.
* Lead sustaining engineering investigations, including customer escalations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and component end-of-life issues.
* Prepare specifications, lead design reviews and communicate technical trade-offs and results to cross-functional teams.
* Apply relevant power-conversion, safety, EMC, and environmental standards throughout development. Lead pre-compliance activities and coordinate with test teams and external laboratories to support global certifications.
* Mentor junior engineers and identify design, test, and process improvements for future power products.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 10 years of power electronics experience, or a master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 7 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of switch-mode power supplies and rack-level battery backup systems.
* Experience with I²C and PMBus communications, and analog and digital PWM control architectures.
* Proficiency with power electronics lab equipment, including bench power supplies, AC sources, oscilloscopes, current probes, and high-voltage probes.
* Working knowledge of C++ and Python.
* Familiarity with applicable safety standards and global compliance requirements. Basic knowledge of network communications is a plus.

**Soft Skills and Leadership**

* Communicates technical findings and decisions clearly with engineers, stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.
* Uses sound analytical judgment to investigate complex problems, document findings, recommend solutions, and escalate critical issues when needed.
* Works independently while collaborating across teams, listening to different perspectives, and aligning solutions with product and customer needs.
* Plans and prioritizes work across multiple projects, delegates effectively, and adjusts execution as requirements, resources, or schedules change.
* Coaches junior engineers, shares technical knowledge, and seeks feedback to strengthen individual and team performance.

* Experience using electrical test equipment, including waveform/function generators, oscilloscopes, and digital multimeters.

* Exposure to MRP/ERP systems is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and manufacturing teams.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and develop professionally under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Opto22 programming experience is a plus but not required.

Technical project leadership experience, including project scheduling, cost management, or Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS).

At **Legion Technical Solutions**, we recognize that exceptional engineers want more than just another assignment. They want challenging technical work, opportunities to apply their expertise, and professional relationships built on trust and respect.

* **Work on advanced technology:** Contribute to sophisticated aerospace and defense systems with real-world impact.

Take the Next Step in Your Engineering Career

jobs.title: Senior Precision Analog/Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

**Job Description Summary:**

A Senior Precision Analog/Power Electronics Engineer designs, specifies, develops, and tests analog/ power electronics for a wide array of applications, such as switched-mode power conversion, battery management circuitry, distributed power architectures, wireless power transfer, radiation hardened designs, motor controllers, low noise power conditioning for precision instrumentation, analog front ends, signal conditioning, analog-to-digital conversion, precision feedback systems, and dc/dc conversion. The engineer develops the architecture, designs these circuits, performs simulations, implements the physical layout, verifies and tests designs. They also perform a variety of engineering activities throughout the life cycle to support planning, design, test, deployment, and sustainment.  
  
Applicant will be responsible for carrying out circuit simulations to verify custom spice models against component specifications. The engineer will collaborate closely with the part designer and model designers to verify and modify both as necessary.

**Job Description:**

**Duties/Responsibilities**

* Optimizes system designs for reduced size, weight, and power.
* Designs new products and develops technical specifications for their production.
* Analyzes hardware configuration and processing solutions and tests hardware conformance to specifications.
* Independently drives solutions to complex problems - develops requirements, proposes ways forward when customer requirements are unclear or incomplete, and adapts appropriately to changes in requirements.
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) able to develop advanced architectures and designs for complex electronics.
* Involved in business development and proposal activities.
* Identifies program/system-level technical risks and develops and executes mitigation strategies.
* Ability to manage multi-disciplinary tasks with a cross functional team and effectively communicates status to project leadership and customers.
* Develops, documents, and teaches best practices to less experienced teammates.
* Demonstrates strong organization, planning, and time management skills to achieve program goals.
* Support business development and proposal activities.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Proficient with schematic capture and printed circuit board layout.
* Ability to perform circuit simulation using Spice or other simulation tools.
* System modeling and analysis experience using MATLAB, Simulink, or other comparable tools.
* Ability to prioritize tasks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.

5-10 years of experience in electrical engineering or related field.

Applicants selected for this position will be required to obtain and maintain a US government security clearance.

jobs.title: Controls Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Controls Engineering Manager is responsible for the overall operational, technical, and strategic leadership of the Controls Engineering Department. This position directs the development of electrical schematics, control panel designs, PLC/HMI software development, robotics, machine vision, and commissioning for custom automated assembly systems.

This role provides technical governance, resource planning, and team mentorship. The ideal candidate brings extensive background in custom assembly automation, mastery of Allen-Bradley architectures, direct integration experience with Fanuc robotics and industrial vision systems, and the ability to drive customer design reviews and project schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Department Leadership & Operational Execution**

* **Resource Allocation & Scheduling:** Direct daily operations of the controls engineering team. Plan, schedule, and balance engineering hours across active build cycles (schematic design, panel build support, programming, shop-floor debug, and runoff).

* **Team Development & Mentorship:** Supervise, evaluate, and mentor controls engineers and programmers. Serve as the primary technical sounding board and escalation point to unblock team members during machine debug.

* **Standardization & Best Practices:** Develop, implement, and maintain departmental standards for 2D AutoCAD drafting (symbol blocks, drawing templates, layer structures) and Rockwell/Fanuc/vision programming architectures.

* **Process Improvement:** Identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks between electrical design, mechanical engineering, panel build, and shop-floor assembly.

**2. Technical Governance & Integration Oversight**

* **Schematic & Design Approval:** Review and sign off on all multi-sheet electrical, pneumatic, and safety circuit drawing packages generated in standard 2D AutoCAD. Ensure accurate manual cross-referencing, proper wire/device labeling, and rigorous BOM generation.

* **Core Automation Platforms:** Govern all software development within the **Rockwell / Allen-Bradley** environment (Studio 5000, ControlLogix, GuardLogix safety routines, FactoryTalk View ME/SE, EtherNet/IP, and Kinetix motion).

* **Robotics & Machine Vision:** Oversee the integration, programming standards, and troubleshooting of **Fanuc robotics** (handling/assembly applications) and machine vision systems (**Keyence** and **Cognex** inspection, guidance, and identification systems).

* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all machine wiring, control panels, and safety interlocks strictly comply with NFPA 79, NFPA 70 (NEC), and UL 508A requirements.

**3. Commercial Alignment & Customer Interfacing**

* **Customer Design Reviews:** Lead customer controls design reviews, establishing technical authority and securing formal sign-offs on drawings, safety concepts, and sequences of operation.

* **Scope & Change-Order Management:** Defend project scope against creep. Identify, document, and price out-of-scope customer requests to ensure engineering change orders are executed.

* **Quoting & Estimation Support:** Review customer RFQs and specifications to develop accurate controls engineering hours, hardware component costs, cycle-time feasibility assessments, and technical risk evaluations.

Join us as a Controls Manager to help shape a resilient financial environment built on transparency, compliance, and operational excellence!

Pay: From $90,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** United States - Minneapolis, MN

**Pay:** $97,500 - $150,600

  

With more than $1B in revenue, Tennant Company is a globally recognized leader in the cleaning equipment industry. For the past 150 years, we have been passionate about developing and manufacturing innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. At Tennant Company, we are committed to stewardship and creating a cleaner, safer and healthier world. With manufacturing, operations and sales, service, and support functions across the globe, your journey at Tennant can take you places you never expected.

  

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the Tennant Company (TNC) Robotics Product Development organization. This role combines strong hands-on systems engineering execution with emerging technical leadership responsibilities, supporting the definition, integration, and delivery of complex electro-mechanical, electrical, and software-enabled robotic systems.

  

The Senior Systems Engineer contributes to system-level design and integration while owning key subsystems or technical areas end-to-end. This role partners closely with Electrical, Software, Mechanical, and Manufacturing teams to translate product and business requirements into well-defined, verifiable system solutions, while beginning to influence architectural direction, technical decisions, and engineering best practices.

Success is measured by technical quality, execution reliability, system integration effectiveness, and the ability to guide work, reduce risk, and elevate team performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

Systems Engineering & Emerging Architecture Ownership

* Own development and delivery of subsystem architectures and system features, ensuring alignment with overall system design.
* Lead requirements decomposition, allocation, and verification for assigned systems and subsystems.
* Establish functional requirements and performance targets for electrical and control subsystems, including power, communications, and safety.
* Create and maintain system documentation including requirements, interface definitions, and verification artifacts.
* Contribute to system-level architecture discussions, providing technical input on tradeoffs, scalability, and maintainability.
Utilize requirements and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jama, Visure, or similar.  

Electrical Integration & Controls Engineering

* Lead integration of electrical subsystems, including:
* Wiring harnesses, connectors, and cable routing
* Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs)
* Controllers and embedded software interfaces
* Power distribution and protection (fuses, circuit breakers)
* Contribute to definition and implementation of machine control systems, including closed-loop control strategies.
* Support and guide integration of communication interfaces such as CAN, RS-232, Ethernet, and USB.
Troubleshoot complex electrical and controls issues across development, validation, and production environments.  

Verification, Testing & Technical Rigor

* Define and execute verification strategies for assigned systems to ensure requirements traceability and performance.
* Apply design risk assessment tools such as DFMEA and HARA to identify and mitigate system-level risks.
* Support and influence compliance activities, including UL, IEC, EMC, and related standards.
* Utilize modeling or analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB, Simulink, MathCad, PSpice) as appropriate to validate system behavior.
Drive structured root cause analysis and resolution of integration issues.  

Execution, Prototyping & Product Development

* Own delivery of complex subsystems or integration workstreams within New Product Development (NPD).
* Lead and execute Proofs of Concept (POCs) and prototype builds to validate design assumptions and de-risk development.
* Break down technical challenges into structured tasks and milestones with clear outcomes.
* Actively lead or contribute to design reviews with a strong system-level perspective.
Support product launches by ensuring designs are robust, manufacturable, and serviceable.  

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Provide technical guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers.
* Drive alignment across teams on system interfaces, integration strategies, and technical decisions.
* Collaborate closely with Systems, Electrical, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and external partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Influence best practices in requirements management, integration, and system validation.
  

**Education & Experience**

Required

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, electrical engineering, or controls-focused roles.
* Strong hands-on experience in electrical system integration and testing for complex products.
* Experience owning subsystems or significant technical workstreams.
* Experience with requirements development, decomposition, verification, and technical documentation.
Proven experience working on cross-functional engineering teams.  

Preferred

* Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or complex electro-mechanical products.
* Experience with batteries, chargers, power electronics, or control systems.
* Familiarity with model-based design and simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, PSpice, MathCad).
* Experience with an object-oriented programming language (C#, Python, or C++).
* Exposure to production support, manufacturing ramp-up, or end-of-line testing.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., code generation, test automation, requirements management, or data analytics) to accelerate development.
* Experience with motion control systems, including the specification, integration, tuning, and troubleshooting of electric motors, motor

We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

  

This role sits in the development organization responsible for Blue Origin's battery products. We take energy storage from concept through qualification and into volume production, and we do it for every program in the company.

As part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will develop the embedded software that makes our batteries safe, smart, and flight-ready. Our battery management systems monitor and protect every cell, estimate state of charge and health, control contactors and power paths, detect and respond to faults, and communicate with the host vehicle.

  

We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer to design, implement, and verify battery management system software for mission-critical spaceflight systems, working directly with battery electrical, mechanical, and systems engineers. jobs.title: Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
We are looking for you to join our team as Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer at our Portageville, Missouri facility!
  
  
Your Job
  
You will help transform our Portageville operation into one of the most advanced manufacturing facilities in North America.
  
This is an opportunity to design the future state of manufacturing from the ground up by developing factory layouts, optimizing material flow, deploying advanced simulation tools, and creating the infrastructure required to support our Overall Automation Maturity Index (OAMI) strategy and Lights-Out Manufacturing roadmap. You will work at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, robotics, logistics, and digital engineering to create highly efficient production systems that maximize productivity, minimize waste, and support autonomous operations.
  
If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges, visualizing the factory before it is built, and creating innovative solutions that redefine manufacturing performance, this role was built for you.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Develop and optimize plant, department, and production layouts using AutoCAD and advanced 3D modeling tools.
* Create digital factory models and simulations to validate future manufacturing concepts before implementation.
* Design material handling routes that maximize efficiency while supporting robotic, AGV, and AMR operations.
* Analyze and optimize product flow, inventory flow, and information flow throughout the facility.
* Lead value stream mapping and factory optimization initiatives to reduce waste and improve productivity.
* Support the deployment of advanced automation systems by ensuring proper equipment placement, flow paths, and operational integration.
* Develop capacity models and scenario analysis to support growth, expansion, and future-state planning.
* Partner with robotics, controls, manufacturing, quality, maintenance, and operations teams to execute transformation projects.
* Utilize simulation and modeling software to evaluate throughput, bottlenecks, labor utilization, and system performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that advance OAMI maturity and support increasing levels of autonomous manufacturing.
* Establish factory standards for layout design, material movement, storage strategies, and operational excellence.
* Support brownfield projects from concept development through implementation.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* BS/MS in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, industrial engineering, or operations optimization.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD for facility and manufacturing layout development.
* Experience in creating detailed plant layouts, workstation designs, and facility flow plans.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing, value stream mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and project management abilities.
* Ability to visualize and design complex manufacturing systems.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience with 3D factory simulation and modeling software.
* Experience with FlexSim or similar simulation platforms.
* Knowledge of AGVs, AMRs, automated storage systems, and autonomous material handling.
* Experience developing warehouses and production material flow strategies.
* Understanding of robotic manufacturing systems and automation integration.
* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0, digital twins, smart factories, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Join the Team Shaping the Next Generation of Manufacturing
  
At RESRG Automotive, we are investing in technologies, people, and ideas that will define the future of manufacturing. As a Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer
  
in Portageville, you will have a unique opportunity to create the layouts, material flow strategies, simulation models, and operational systems that enable our journey toward Lights-Out Manufacturing.
  
  
About the Company
  
We are a fast-growing global manufacturer with a strong internal culture that values respect, diversity, and purposeful work. We offer career paths that enable professional growth, a team-focused environment, and a commitment to safety and wellness.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee and their family to live fulfilling and healthy lives. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, AD&D, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave, and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria are set by the applicable Summary Plan Description. Speak to your recruiter for details on benefits that apply to you.
  
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

*Connecting Continents. Impacting Communities.*

The backbone of the Internet is a series of high-tech subsea fiber optic cables deployed throughout the globe - SubCom has deployed over 50% of them. Our employees ensure data communications networks are engineered, manufactured, deployed to the highest standards, enabling faster and more reliable connectivity to communities worldwide. Every member of the SubCom team plays a role in an end-to-end process that is critical to enterprises, governments, big cities, and rural towns.

The Principal Electrical Design Engineer is an established and experienced lead engineer on a team of outstanding engineers that research, develop, design, test, and transfer to manufacture our next generation of high-reliability opto-electronic network elements. The primary job activity provides novel high reliability and fault tolerant circuit designs, including analog and digital circuits that may involve microcontrollers and FPGAs, as well as other electro-optic components like photo diodes, modulators, EDFAs, VOAs and lasers. The role involves high level planning, platforming, and innovation across multiple network elements, as well as the development of product, system and firmware requirements. The role reports to the Director of Network Element Electrical Design.

**Responsibilities**

----------------------------

**What We’re Doing**  
  
At Lockheed Martin, our team at the Mount Laurel, NJ site supports the SEMS (Systems Engineering, Modeling & Simulation) Ship Integration Engineering organization. We design, develop, and maintain advanced combat system cabling solutions that enable seamless integration of mission-critical naval and land-based systems. Our work ensures reliable connectivity, interoperability, and performance across complex platforms supporting the U.S. Navy and allied forces.  
  
**The Work**  
  
Generate and maintain Combat System Cable Block Diagrams (CBD) and Cable Installation / Interconnection Drawings (CIID), including:  
  
Cable Running Sheets (CRS), Minimum Data Sets (MDS), Cable Impact Statements (CIS), Network Maintenance Diagrams (NMD), and Electrical Interface Control Drawings (EICD).  
  
Serve as the responsible engineer for the development of cable products and associated deliverables within the SEMS Ship Integration Engineering team.  
  
Review PARM, OEM, and vendor Installation Control Drawings and Technical Data Package (TDP) products for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with program requirements.  
  
Provide engineering support across multiple ship classes and land-based test sites.  
  
Conduct ship checks to assess existing conditions and deliver on-site engineering support during installation and testing of new equipment and systems.  
  
Lead peer engineers and engineering aides, ensuring customer requirements and project schedules remain the top priority.  
  
Please note:
  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearance at the Secret level.
  
  
This position is fulltime onsite in Mount Laurel, NJ.  
  
This position requires the ability to travel up to 5%.
  
  
**Who We Are**  
  
We are part of Lockheed Martin’s SEMS Ship Integration Engineering organization based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Our team specializes in integrating complex combat systems, ensuring that hardware, software, and cabling architectures function as a cohesive, mission-ready solution. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a strong commitment to supporting national defense.

Joining Lockheed Martin in Mount Laurel, NJ means becoming part of a world-class engineering organization at the forefront of naval combat system integration. Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Engineering Technology, or Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience in a Engineering discipline with 2+ years of related professional experience.
  
  
Familiarity of various network types.
  
  
Familiarity with cable interface design.  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearance at the Secret level.
  
  
This position is fulltime onsite in Mount Laurel, NJ.  
  
This position requires the ability to travel up to 5%.

------------------

Systems engineering background.  
  
Knowledge of various network types, current commercial trends in this field, as well as the cabling materials required to support.  
  
Basic level of knowledge of both military and commercial electrical interface protocols, Combat System integration criteria, equipment interaction methods, major signal flows, as well as, USN and commercial Shipbuilding Specifications.

Eastern Communications, Ltd. is a critical communications provider based in Long Island City, Queens, NY. Founded in 1976, and acquired from original ownership in 2020, Eastern provides infrastructure, technical services, field replacement parts, and maintenance to a range of end users including public safety, transportation, utilities, and the federal government. The company has earned its exceptional reputation for delivering the highest quality products and services over its 40+ year history. In November 2025, Eastern acquired Hazlet, New Jersey-based PMC Wireless, and now comprises 230 employees across 17 locations nationwide.

**Role Overview**

Reporting to the System Engineering Manager, the role of the Systems Engineer is to conduct systems engineering aspects of design, configuration, implementation and testing for projects of Land Mobile Radio wireless communications systems and dispatch center technologies for Public Safety, Transportation and Utility Customers.

* Present project-specific technical information in meetings and contribute to proposal development
* Adapt procedures and coordinate work across engineering and field teams

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar technical degree with a minimum 3-5 years of prior relevant experience
* Position based in Hazlet, NJ with potential for remote work

### **Preferred Skills**

* Two way radio systems including P25 and DMR multi-site conventional simulcast and trunking systems
* Networking, dispatch systems and telephony systems
* RF antenna systems
* Experience working with RF, system design, networking configuration, system programming
* Familiarity with technologies including Fiber Optics, MPLS, Microwave, VM servers, Windows/Linux OS
* The ability to program, troubleshoot, and perform system diagnostics on simple and complex electronics systems
* Strong self-management skills and communication skills to work closely with PMC customers as well as PMC Technical and Project Management teams
* Strong presentation skills

### **Benefits We Can Offer You**

* Health, dental and vision insurance
* 401k and company match
* Annual Performance Review and Accompanied bonus
* Paid holidays, vacation and sick days
* Ongoing technical training

jobs.description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

**About the Role**

  

We are seeking a Vice President to build and lead our Modern Management Platform function: the shared engineering team that owns how every Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and cloud PC endpoint in the enterprise is configured, secured, updated and measured. You will treat Microsoft Intune and its surrounding control plane as a product, delivering a reliable, well-governed platform that multiple endpoint, mobility and virtualization teams build on.

This is a new function in a highly regulated, multi-entity environment. The successful candidate will set the standards, operating model and team that the broader workplace engineering organization depends on.

Key Responsibilities

  
  

Platform & Tenant Ownership

* Own the Intune tenant as a platform, including tenant configuration, RBAC, scope tags, administrative units and change control.

* Govern a consistent multi-entity, multi-tenant management model, including tenant-to-tenant migration patterns and configuration parity.

* Serve as the accountable technical owner for the platform in audits, regulatory examinations and incident reviews.

Policy Architecture

* Design and govern endpoint policy across Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS and Android: configuration profiles, security baselines, compliance policies, update rings and app protection.

* Act as design authority for device-based Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security.

* Assess the platform impact of security and baseline changes before enterprise-wide rollout.

Application Deployment

* Own the Intune application deployment plane: assignment model, deployment rings, supersedence, dependencies and delivery telemetry.

* Define packaging standards and acceptance criteria, and partner with software and vulnerability management teams on remediation and upgrade campaigns.

Automation & Engineering Practices

* Build automation using Microsoft Graph, PowerShell and Power Automate to eliminate manual configuration, reconciliation and reporting.

* Establish configuration-as-code with source control, peer review and dev-to-production promotion for all policy and script artifacts.

Compliance, Telemetry & Reporting

* Define endpoint compliance baselines and measure drift against them.

* Deliver an authoritative device and configuration dataset and Power BI reporting for operations, audit and executive audiences.

Leadership

* Build, lead and develop a team of platform engineers

* Set and enforce engineering standards across peer teams, and run a clear intake and prioritization model for platform requests.

Chair a cross-team configuration review forum and maintain documentation, runbooks and roadmap.  

  

**Qualifications**

  

Required

* 8+ years in endpoint, platform or systems engineering, including 3+ years leading engineers.

* Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Entra ID, including RBAC, scope tags, Conditional Access and multi-tenant patterns.

* Proven ownership of endpoint policy and security baselines at enterprise scale (10,000+ devices).

* Strong automation skills with Microsoft Graph, PowerShell and REST APIs, with source-control discipline.

* Application deployment and packaging-standards experience across Win32, MSIX and macOS.

* Experience delivering operational reporting in Power BI or a comparable tool.

* Demonstrated ability to influence and set standards across teams without direct authority.

Preferred

* Financial services or other regulated-industry experience, including audit and exam support.

* Familiarity with control frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

* Experience with tenant-to-tenant migrations, Windows Autopilot, Autopatch and Windows 365.

Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, SC-300 or AZ-104.  

  

**Education:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline, or equivalent in professional experience

* New York / New Jersey: $120k - $171k
Non-/New York/ New jersey: $120k - $154k

Are you an early to mid-career electrical engineer looking to take on high-impact, real-world challenges? As a Utility Electrical System Engineer, you'll play a key role in managing and maintaining LANL's high-voltage electrical infrastructure.

jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We're looking for passionate & experienced technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be proficient in frontend engineering with ability to contribute to backend when necessary. We're looking for the confidence to propose pragmatic solutions to complex problems and be eager to learn from and educate others as a Senior Software Engineer working for our Sportsbook domain.  
  
You will be working with the FanDuel Sportsbook application, providing our customers with a best-in-class experience as a frontend proficient Software Engineer. You'll play a pivotal part in making our platform highly usable and will write clear, scalable, and high-quality code. You will work continuously to improve architecture and processes to improve quality and efficiency. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them and when it is not. Your solutions are pragmatic. You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an Engineer unfamiliar with the system can understand. You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc).

* You work on project ideas with stakeholders, and peers.
* You own parts of product and technology and strive to become a subject matter expert.
* You write simple and extendable code following standards and best practices. You test your code thoroughly.
* You utilize AI-powered tools to maximize efficiency.
* You help balance customer requirements with the team requirements.
* You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric/COE reviews.
* You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with FanDuel policies.
* You track security risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner.
* You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions.
* You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve the team software and processes.
* You work to resolve the root cause of complex problems, leaving software better and easier to maintain than when you found it.
* You mentor and help new team-mates on how your team's software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
* You foster a constructive dialogue and seek resolutions in a professional way.
* You help recruit and interview for your team.
* You estimate stories/tasks accurately and deliver them in time.
* On-call rotation where required. You provide excellent customer support on behalf of Technology.
* You keep yourself up to date with market standards, and open-source frameworks.
* Most importantly, you are: humble, pragmatic, self-managed, thirsty for knowledge, never satisfied and always challenging the norm. You demonstrate responsibility for the state of the code you both inherit and produce.

  

**THE STATS**

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5 or more years of Software Development experience in creating and maintaining mobile applications with experience in React and React Native.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and core web technologies (HTML and CSS)
* A fundamental understanding of data structures and algorithms with experience working with backend for frontend (BFF) architectural patterns.

* Experience with unit testing, testing tools, integrating testing and best-quality practices into an SDLC.

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**What We’re Doing**

At Lockheed Martin Rotary Mission Systems, we develop advanced technologies that support critical defense and aerospace missions. Our Owego, NY engineering teams deliver innovative Digital and RF solutions designed for demanding mission environments.

**The Work**

As a Power Engineer, you'll provide vital technical support for our Digital and RF programs, focusing on unit level power systems. You'll be responsible for analyzing and troubleshooting power distribution circuits at the circuit card assembly (CCA) and unit levels. You will interpret requirements and develop pass/fail criteria to conduct root-cause analysis and recommend engineering changes. In addition, you will assist senior engineers in circuit designs. In this role you will also develop power test procedures, execute power qualification tests, and write detailed reports to show adherence to the applicable power standards (MIL-STD-704).

Please note:

This position is located Owego, NY and is fulltime onsite.

This position requires the ability to travel up to or less than 10%.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD government clearance at the Secret level.

**Who We Are**

Rotary Mission Systems in Owego, NY develops mission-critical technologies for advanced defense systems. Our engineers work across the product lifecycle, from requirements and design through integration, qualification, and production.

**Who You Are**

You’re a power engineer who enjoys solving complex hardware challenges and turning requirements into reliable, testable designs. You bring expertise in power distribution, power conversion, circuit analysis, and hardware troubleshooting, along with strong technical communication skills and the ability to mentor others.

**Why Join Us**

Join Lockheed Martin in Owego, NY and apply your power engineering expertise to advanced Digital and RF systems. You’ll solve challenging technical problems, collaborate with experienced engineers, and influence designs from requirements through qualification while supporting technologies built for critical missions.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 2 years related experience, or Master's degree in engineering
* Experience using component layout, board layout, and schematic capture tools
* Ability to secure a Secret clearance.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with analyzing and designing isolated and non-isolated DC/DC converters, switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), and Point-of-Load (POL) regulators
* Experience programing and utilizing programmable power supplies
* Knowledge of MIL-STD-704 and MIL-STD-461
* Knowledge of VITA specifications
* Experience with specifications writing and review, and tracking requirements through product lifecycle management tools to ensure full compliance with customer requirements
* Proficiency using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and benchtop power supplies and other basic lab equipment

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $70500.00 - $130900.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

**Date:** Oct 15, 2026

  

**Location:** Fairport, NY, US, 14450

  

**Company:** Corning

  

Requisition Number: 78728

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions
  

**Scope of Position:**

The Electrical Engineering Technician – Systems Test provides hands-on electrical and electromechanical support for optical assembly and test operations across both Class 100 (Molecular Cleanroom) and Class 10,000 cleanroom environments. This role is responsible for troubleshooting and resolving motor control, cabling, wiring harness, and instrumentation issues on custom metrology benches and production equipment. The technician will support daily production and test bench operations, occasionally assist with new product introduction (NPI) and new bench builds, and provide infrequent support to other departments.

  

**Day to Day Responsibilities:**

* Provide hands-on electrical technical support for daily production and test bench operations, including rapid response to motor control, cable, and wiring harness issues
* Troubleshoot and repair servo/stepper motor systems, motion controllers, encoders, and feedback devices
* Diagnose circuit-level issues on production and test equipment
* Fabricate, modify, and repair cable and wiring harness assemblies
* Perform cable testing including continuity, hi-pot, and insulation resistance verification
* Create and redline wiring diagrams, schematics, and pinout documentation
* Support new bench builds and NPI activities requiring electrical assembly, integration, and validation
* Troubleshoot data acquisition and instrumentation interfaces (GPIB, RS-232/485, USB, Ethernet/TCP-IP, EtherCAT)
* Support PLC troubleshooting (Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff, or similar) and interpret ladder logic as needed
* Perform soldering and rework activities to IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001 standards
* Address power distribution, grounding, shielding, and EMI/ESD mitigation concerns
* Provide occasional electrical support to other departments as needed
* Collaborate closely with assemblers, test technicians, engineers (electrical, mechanical, optical, software), and production leadership
* Maintain housekeeping standards and support autonomous maintenance of work areas and equipment
* Demonstrate flexibility to support off-shift production needs when required
* Follow and promote safe work practices, cleanroom protocols, ESD controls, and laser safety practices (ANSI Z136) where applicable
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering Technology (or equivalent military/technical training)
* 3+ years of hands-on electrical technician experience, preferably in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing or R&D environment
* Strong circuit troubleshooting skills using multimeters, oscilloscopes, function generators, and logic analyzers
* Proficiency with soldering and rework, including through-hole, surface mount (SMT), and fine-pitch work
* Working knowledge of AC/DC power distribution, grounding, shielding, and EMI/ESD mitigation
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting servo and stepper motor systems including drives, encoders, and controllers
* Familiarity with motion controllers such as Galil, Newport, and similar (Aerotech, ACS, Delta Tau, etc.)
* Experience with motion feedback devices — encoders (incremental/absolute), resolvers, limit/home switches
* Working knowledge of PID tuning, homing routines, and diagnosing following errors
* Understanding of linear stages, rotary stages, and piezo actuators used in optical setups

**Position Summary:**

The Controls Engineer, entry level, supports the configuration, programming, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of industrial control systems, automated visual inspection (AVI) systems, and machine vision equipment used in manufacturing operations. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, this role applies foundational knowledge of controls, electronics, programming, and computer science to improve equipment reliability, inspection performance, data integrity, and production efficiency.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Support the programming, configuration, testing, and maintenance of programmable logic controllers, human-machine interfaces, industrial computers, and related control equipment.
* Assist with the setup, calibration, optimization, and validation of automated visual inspection and machine vision systems.
* Review images, inspection results, alarms, system logs, and production data to identify defects, equipment faults, and improvement opportunities
* Support integration among AVI equipment, machine vision software, PLCs, and, manufacturing systems.
  
* Document software revisions, control configurations, test results, troubleshooting activities, and technical findings.
* Work closely with validation and quality to determine the boundaries between accept and reject product.
* Continuously improve the vision system applications to improve defect detectability while also reducing the percent of false rejects.
* Create and update standard operating procedures, work instructions, electrical documentation, and training materials.
* Participate in change controls, corrective actions, preventive maintenance, backups, and continuous improvement projects.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, IT, Maintenance, and equipment vendors to resolve technical issues
* Follow current Good Manufacturing Practices, data integrity requirements, cybersecurity practices, safety procedures, and Good Documentation Practices
* Other duties and tasks assigned by management.

**Required Skills:**

* Foundational knowledge of industrial controls, automation, PLCs, human-machine interfaces, and input/output systems
* Foundational knowledge of machine vision concepts, including cameras, lenses, lighting, image acquisition, inspection tools, and defect detection
* Understanding of electronics, digital and analog circuits, sensors, control panels, and computer hardware
* Understanding of computer science concepts, including software logic, data structures, databases, operating systems, and networking fundamentals
* Ability to read basic electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control narratives, technical drawings, and equipment manuals
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, analyze data, document findings, and follow technical problems through resolution
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, SQL, version control, robotics, or machine vision software is preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical disciplines
* Ability to learn regulated manufacturing practices, including current Good Manufacturing Practices, data integrity, change control, and cybersecurity requirements

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered
* Zero to two years of relevant experience, including internships, co-op assignments, academic projects, laboratory work, or entry-level technical employment
* Coursework or project experience involving PLC programming, industrial automation, electronics, embedded systems, machine vision, robotics, or computer-based controls is preferred
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment is helpful but not required

**Position Overview:**

The Controls Engineer II is a mid-level engineering professional responsible for leading the design, development, implementation, and optimization of control systems for industrial automation and manufacturing processes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software systems, troubleshooting automation issues, and ensuring system reliability, safety, and compliance with regulatory standards. The Controls Engineer II is expected to mentor junior engineers, manage automation projects, and contribute to the strategic direction of control system architecture. The role requires experience in PLC/HMI programming, motion control, robotics, and customer support. Strong project management skills, the ability to work independently, and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities

* Develop, design and support custom control systems and automation processes
* PLC/VFD programming and troubleshooting.
* Design HMI screens for process monitoring and control.
* Integrate automation systems with other equipment, sensors, instrumentation, network communication protocols, and robotic cells.
* Perform system testing and validation to ensure all systems meet technical specifications and safety standards.
* Diagnose and resolve issues, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum productivity.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation including system schematics, BOMs, programming code, sequence of operations, and user manuals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including mechanical engineering, assembly, inventory, and field service.
* Identify areas for improvement in existing systems and processes and recommend automation solutions to enhance efficiency, safety, and performance.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Specific Skills/Requirements:**

* Proficiency with PLCs and HMIs (Allen Bradley, Siemens).
* Experience with industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, ProfiNet).
* Understanding of electrical systems, integration, and industrial automation.
* Proficiency with servo and VFD motor control, sensors, and instrumentation.
* Electrical schematic design and panel layout experience (AutoCAD Electrical).
* Understanding of hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems integration.
* Familiarity with industry standards (NEC, NFPA 70, UL 508A).

* Ability to travel 10–20%, including international travel.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Automation Engineer**
=======================

Easton, PA – Engineering Laboratory

Full-Time

Engineering – Research & Development Laboratory

No immigration sponsorship available

**About Victaulic**
-------------------

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.

### **An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation**

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

**Let’s Build a Better World Together.**

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

* We build from within.
* We stand behind our people.
* We foster an environment for constant learning.
* We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

**Your Impact Starts Here**
---------------------------

We’re looking for an Automation Engineer to join our Engineering Laboratory team in Easton, PA, reporting to the Engineering Lab Technical Lead – Automation. In this role, you’ll design, build, and maintain the control, automation, and data acquisition systems used to test and evaluate components and prototypes for new product and process introductions. You’ll work closely with design engineers, operations engineers, purchasers, and other internal partners to keep projects on schedule and make sure every standard and requirement is met during prototype development. This is an opportunity to apply creative problem-solving early in the product lifecycle, when prototype specifications are often still taking shape, and to own equipment projects from concept through commissioning.

**What You’ll Build & Own**
---------------------------

* Design, maintain, and improve lab data systems so test data is organized, accessible, and delivered efficiently to the Victaulic Engineering Department
* Plan and execute equipment builds from concept through commissioning, including scope, schedule, purchasing, and vendor coordination
* Troubleshoot, maintain, and modify existing control, automation, and data acquisition systems to keep testing on schedule
* Develop and maintain PLC and HMI programs that support lab automation systems
* Design, commission, and troubleshoot servo, stepper, and VFD motion control systems for lab test equipment
* Design, build, and wire electrical control panels and enclosures for lab test systems and automation projects, adhering to applicable electrical safety standards
* Configure and troubleshoot industrial communications protocols, including EtherCAT, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, and OPC-UA
* Maintain version control and change management for control system code and configuration files, and create a standardized documentation package for each piece of lab equipment and data collection system
* Maintain asset inventory, configuration records, and test data, and verify that instrumentation remains NIST-traceable and compliant with ISO requirements
* Support hands-on testing, including installing instrumentation and data loggers, setting up fixtures, operating hydrostatic, pneumatic, cycle, flex, and fire suppression tests, and inspecting products and components against engineering specifications and drawings
* Use lab fabrication and shop equipment to prepare fixtures, components, and test materials
* Manage assigned work orders and priorities, estimating and logging hours and maintaining accurate project status in Monday.com
* Drive continuous improvement in the lab using Lean principles, and keep the work area organized, professional, and clean
* Follow all company safety requirements and procedures, and participate in testing safety reviews
* Work independently with minimal oversight, owning the quality, timeliness, and results of all assigned work

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering preferred
* 4+ years of controls or automation experience
* Proficiency in maintaining and troubleshooting automation equipment
* PLC programming experience (ladder, structured text, function block diagram)
* Experience with motion control systems (stepper, servo, VFDs), including drive configuration, encoder feedback, and motion profiles (gearing, camming)
* Experience managing equipment projects from design through commissioning
* Proficiency in blueprint reading, shop math, and use of precision instruments
* Working knowledge of process instrumentation (sensors, transmitters, pressure, flow, and temperature devices)
* Working knowledge of piping and fluid systems (water and compressed air), including pumps, control and solenoid valves, pressure regulation and relief, and flow and pressure measurement, with the ability to read and interpret P&IDs
* Strong problem-solving, creative thinking, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills, with excellent verbal and written communication
* Ability to stand, bend, and kneel for extended periods in a laboratory environment; lift and carry up to 50 lbs unassisted (heavier items with mechanical assistance); and work in environments with moderate noise levels, temperature variation, and exposure to test fluids o

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

**Company Overview**

Teledyne Judson Technologies (TJT) is a global leader in detectors from the Visible to Long Wave Infra-red spectrum, offering an extensive range of single element infrared detectors. Two-dimensional focal plane arrays (InGaAs, InSb, and HgCdTe) and Integrated Dewar Cooler Assemblies (IDCA) complement our detector portfolio. The high performance of our detectors makes them highly valued in both commercial markets and critical space applications.

**Position Summary**

TJT is seeking a Systems Engineer to design, develop, and characterize packages and integrated dewar cooled arrays for infrared detectors. The successful candidate will be well versed in Solidworks and Ansys, and can prepare, generate and analyze structural (including factors of safety), thermal (computational fluid dynamics), and vibrational simulations. Previous experience with photodetectors/cameras and/or in optical design/modeling is considered a plus. The candidate will generate models and technical drawings, and support part procurement, product assembly, and product test as needed. The candidate must be able to work both independently and in collaboration with a cross functional team as necessary to ensure successful development of new products.

The ideal candidate has significant experience in ultra-high vacuum processing, including but not limited to loading and unloading devices onto a vacuum manifold, getter activation and degas, pinch-off, and leak check. Experience with laser welding, and metrology is desired.

**Essential Duties and** **Responsibilities**

* Evaluates customers’ requirements and designs/specifies the detector focal plane packaging and cooling options. Applications range from commercial/industrial to high-reliability space/military
* Provides analysis related to the design, development, and implementation of parts, components, and other materials for mechanical assemblies
* Generates necessary technical content (including models, drawings, calculations and simulation results) to review customer specification and prepare charts accordingly for internal- or customer-facing technical reviews
* Prepares cost models and generates project schedules. Prepares risk analysis and generates risk matrix
* Leads other designers to detail component parts and/or assist with system development
* Performs first-order analysis of heat transfer, structural, random vibration, and fastener pre-loads
* Performs Finite Element Analysis
* Supports material selection, including but not limited to sizing of TECs, cryo-coolers, and getters
* Develops test strategies, fixtures, and tooling. Prepares test procedures and test reports as necessary to document designs, procedures, and results
* Manually calculates stress on components
* Calculates vacuum life (based on package design, component selection, free volume, and other required inputs)
* Conducts failure analyses and supports identification of failure root cause and appropriate solutions
* Follows import/export requirements, consulting with facility trade compliance personnel
* Comfortable leading a project team and work

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* M.S. or Ph. D degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field and >15 years of directly related experience and/or training (>10 years for Ph.D) in a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of demonstrated detector packaging with an emphasis on vacuum Dewar design
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to organize data and write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients and customers.
* Significant experience in high vacuum processing, including but not limited to loading and unloading devices onto a vacuum manifold, RGA analysis, getter activation and degas, pinch-off, and leak check (Helium). Experience with laser welding and metrology.
* Experience with design/modeling and simulations in Ansys and Solidworks. Familiarity with Zemax considered a plus. The candidate should also have knowledge of applicable database and ERP software and office productivity applications.
* Experience with GD&T (General Dimensioning and Tolerancing), ASME Y14
* Experience conducting Design of Experiments

**Other Skills and Abilities**

* Basic Knowledge of ISO and/or AS9100.
* HALT/HASS Testing
* Familiarity with MIL-STD 883
* LabView, MS Visio, MATLAB

**Employment eligibility**

* Due to the type of work at the facility and certain access restrictions, successful applicants must be a U.S. Person.

***What can Teledyne offer YOU?***  
A Competitive Salary & Benefits Package  
Excellent Health, Dental, Vision  
Paid Vacation Time  
Paid Sick Time  
Life Insurance Benefits  
Paid Holidays  
401(k) Eligibility  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan  
Educational Tuition Reimbursement

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

====================================

Founded in 1999 in the beautiful Smoky Mountains of East Tennessee, Cadre5 provides innovative technical solutions to our customers locally and nationally. Our Cadre5 Lab Partners division has partnered with The Research Systems Engineering Team (RSE) in the Information Technology Services Division (ITSD)at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) to recruit a talented Linux and Windows Systems Engineer to design, install, configure and maintain systems for multiple research projects. In this position, this individual will be embedded with RDSE customers providing Linux support as the primary focus, while also supporting Windows systems, storage, virtualization, networking and related services. ORNL delivers scientific discoveries and technical breakthroughs needed to realize solutions in energy and national security and provides economic benefit to the nation. This premier research institution located near Knoxville in Oak Ridge, TN, addresses national needs through impactful research and world-leading research centers.

**This is a full-time, permanent position that requires on-site work in Oak Ridge, TN.**

**Why Cadre5?**
===============

* Working with highly talented team members
* 3 weeks’ vacation
* Excellent medical insurance, including employer-paid benefits

**What will you be doing?**

The R&D Systems Engineering Group focuses on support researcher’s IT needs. Staff charge directly to projects or programs, and not to a centralized budget. Our goal is to enable research while protecting ORNL assets, especially from cyber incidents.

As a Linux and Windows Systems Engineer in the RDSE group, you will have the opportunity to work directly with researchers to provide for their IT needs. As an IT professional you will help enable the research, while also protecting ORNL assets, data, and research discoveries.

In this position, support will be primarily for Linux server, storage, and application environments, while also providing Windows systems administration, virtualization, backup, and networking support for research projects and specialized technical environments. jobs.title: Lead Automation & Controls Engineer (Siemens TIA)
jobs.description:
**About EH Group Engineering**

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

**Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply.** This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems
* Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs
* Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7
* Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems
* Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic
* Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products
* Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures
* Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management
* Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements
* Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization
* Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

**Skills and Experience Required:**

* BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory
* Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role
* **Skill 1 :** Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus
* **Skill 2 :** Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements
* Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions
* Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management
* Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements
* Proven team player, with the ability to:
    
  *(i)* Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing **Skill 1** and **Skill 2** across the team  
  *(ii)*Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams
* Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

* Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus
* Professional working language is in English.

**Start date: Immediately**
