jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer, Signal-Path Performance & Modeling
jobs.description:
**About Neurophos**
===================

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

Join us and shape the future of computing!

**Location:** Austin, TX. Full-time onsite position.

**Reports To:** Chief Systems Engineer

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer to own the quantitative, end-to-end performance model of our optical vector-matrix multiplication (OVMM) engine. This role is the technical center of Systems Engineering's performance-modeling focus area: you will lead the end-to-end modeling, analysis, and architectural definition of high-speed communication and signal-processing systems. In this role, you will build and maintain the link and power budgets; quantify impairments and non-idealities across the optical, analog, and digital domains; develop mathematical and behavioral models; define the hardware and algorithmic techniques required to meet aggressive system-level performance targets; and determine how accuracy, throughput, and power trade against one another as the architecture evolves.

You will spend most of your time running system-level simulations and translating them into defensible allocations the rest of the organization can design against. If you have deep communication-theory and signal-processing intuition, are fluent in turning a signal chain into a quantitative model, and want to be the person who can answer "where does the system actually lose its margin," this role will let you define the performance envelope of a first-of-its-kind computing platform.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Signal-Path Architecture Ownership:** Own and define the architecture of the high-speed communication and signal-processing system that converts the digital data stream into an optical signal and back—spanning digital signal processing, D/A and A/D conversion, and the analog/optical signal conditioning surrounding them on both the transmit and receive sides. Define the blocks and processing stages that comprise this system and specify the requirements for each. Negotiate block-level requirements with the photonic and mixed-signal implementation teams who build to this architecture.
* **Link & Power Budget Ownership:** Own and maintain the end-to-end optical and electrical link/power budget for this signal path, keeping it synchronized with the as-designed and as-measured hardware as the architecture evolves.
* **Signal-Path Modeling:** Build and maintain the reference behavioral model of the full TX–channel–RX signal path, capturing optical, analog, quantization, and algorithmic effects with the fidelity needed for architecture decisions and requirements allocation.
* **Accuracy & Performance Allocation:** Allocate NMSE/SNR/SNDR targets across optics, analog, quantization, and algorithmic domains, and update those allocations as component and architecture choices change.
* **Impairment Analysis:** Characterize and model optical, analog, and digital impairments—noise, distortion, jitter, quantization effects, crosstalk, mismatch, and nonlinearity—and quantify their impact on system-level accuracy.
* **Throughput & Efficiency Trade Studies:** Analyze the impact of TX/RX channel configurations and architectural options on TOPS, TOPS/W, and latency. Balance the complexity, risk, and time-to-market of proposed architectural solutions.
* **Monte Carlo & Time-Domain Simulation:** Develop and run statistical (Monte Carlo, corner) and time-domain simulations to quantify design margin and manufacturing robustness.
* **Model-to-Measurement Correlation:** Correlate model predictions with laboratory and silicon measurements; when measured performance does not match simulation, isolate the source of the discrepancy and refine the architecture, model, and allocations accordingly.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Medium Voltage - Power Distribution & Control Products
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Integrated Circuit Solutions (ICS) is seeking a Medium Voltage Electrical Engineer to provide engineering expertise and product application support for medium-voltage electrical power distribution, protection, and control solutions. This role supports the design, application, analysis, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of medium-voltage power distribution systems.

The engineer will help select equipment, support proposals and procurement, evaluate vendors, and contribute to project execution. Working with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams, this role helps deliver safe, reliable, code-compliant, and cost-effective electrical solutions.

**Areas of Technical Expertise**

* Medium-voltage metal-clad and metal-enclosed switchgear and circuit breakers
* Load-break and disconnect switches
* Transformers, motor control centers (MV MCCs), VFDs, and soft starters
* Protection and control systems, protective relays, metering, and power monitoring
* Automatic and manual transfer schemes
* Grounding systems and equipment
* E-Houses, power distribution centers (PDCs), and integrated power racks/skids
* Capacitor banks and power factor correction equipment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product and Application Engineering
* Review customer requirements, specifications, and project documentation to develop medium-voltage power distribution solutions.
* Select and apply medium-voltage equipment, including switchgear, transformers, motor control equipment, protective relays, and associated components.
* Determine equipment ratings and configurations based on system requirements, applicable standards, and project objectives.
* Develop and review electrical drawings, technical documentation, and equipment layouts.
* Evaluate equipment and system designs for safety, reliability, maintainability, and code compliance.

**Technical Support and System Design**

* Review system voltage, load requirements, available fault current, equipment ratings, protection requirements, grounding methods, and coordination considerations.
* Perform or review power system studies, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, load-flow, arc-flash, motor-starting, and voltage-drop analyses.
* Develop and review protection schemes for feeders, transformers, motors, buses, and other medium-voltage equipment, including protective relays, CTs, PTs/VTs, metering, and relay settings.
* Support system design, equipment integration, reliability, maintainability, selectivity, and overall performance.
* Support integration of switchgear, transformers, MV MCCs, VFDs, soft starters, protective relays, PLC/control systems, SCADA, metering, and communication networks.
* Support installation, startup, energization, testing, and commissioning; assist with troubleshooting relay operations, nuisance trips, control issues, communication failures, and other system events.

**Protection, Control, and Automation**

* Develop and review medium-voltage protection and control philosophies and protective relay functions.
* Develop and review breaker control, interlocking, transfer, permissive, synchronization, and trip schemes.
* Review DC control power systems, including batteries, chargers, UPS systems, and associated distribution.
* Support integration of protective relays and intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) with PLC, SCADA, DCS, and power management systems.
* Review communication architectures and protocols, including Modbus, IEC 61850, DNP3, and Ethernet/IP.
* Support control narratives, sequence-of-operations documents, cause-and-effect matrices, interlocking logic, and system testing.

**Codes, Standards, and Power System Studies**

* Apply applicable NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, IEEE, ANSI, NEMA, UL, customer specifications, and local codes.
* Review equipment interrupting and short-time withstand ratings, momentary ratings, BIL, insulation levels, enclosure ratings, environmental requirements, and electrical clearances.
* Evaluate arc-resistant equipment requirements and accessibility classifications where specified.
* Review power system studies and evaluate results to verify equipment ratings, protection requirements, and system performance.
* Identify specification deviations, exceptions, and technical risks and coordinate design changes.

**Project, Manufacturing, and Customer Support**

* Support projects from quotation and order entry through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing, shipment, installation, energization, and commissioning.
* Review engineering drawings, bills of material, technical submittals, protection schemes, relay settings, equipment configurations, and vendor documentation.
* Coordinate technical requirements with switchgear, transformer, relay, MV drive, and other equipment suppliers.
* Support manufacturing teams in resolving technical and production issues.
* Participate in design reviews, factory acceptance tests (FATs), customer inspections, relay testing, equipment functional testing, and technical meetings.
* Investigate non-conformances, field issues, equipment failures, nuisance trips, and protection or application concerns; recommend corrective actions.
* Support sales and proposal teams with quotations, equipment selection, system configurations, technical specifications, customer discussions, and value engineering.

***Required Qualifications***

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* Experience with medium-voltage power distribution systems, including switchgear, substations, motor control, protection, or engineered electrical equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of medium-voltage power distribution, protection, and control systems.
* Ability to develop, read, and review one-line and three-line diagrams, schematics, AC/DC control diagrams, wiring diagrams, equipment layouts, and technical specifications.
* Working knowledge of power system fundamentals, including short-circuit calculations

Embedded directly with program leadership, you will partner with the Government Technical Director to steer future weapon capability, analyze real-world operational feedback from the Fleet, and translate emerging threat intelligence into actionable science & technology (S&T) roadmaps for the next generation of surface munitions and ship self-defense capabilities.

**YOU MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE DOD SECRET CLEARANCE / TOP SECRET PREFERRED**

**Responsibilities**

The selectee will serve as the Decision Technologies Lead Systems Engineer for U.S. Navy Terminal Defense Systems engineering support. In this capacity, you will drive top-level engineering analysis, architectural roadmapping, and operational alignment across the portfolio:

* **Strategic Planning & S&T Roadmapping:** Lead technical, programmatic, and architectural roadmapping across the entire IWS 11 portfolio. Identify, evaluate, and transition emerging Science & Technology (S&T) and R&D solutions to formulate future weapon system upgrade evolutions.
* **Operational Fleet Feedback & Threat Analysis:** Serve as the trusted technical advisor to the Government Technical Director, keeping a constant pulse on real-world operational challenges, Fleet feedback, and live combat engagements to rapidly inform near-term CONOPS and long-term capability baselines.
* **Threat vs. Weapon Systems Requirements Analysis:** Analyze cutting-edge threat intelligence and emerging adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) against current and planned surface weapon capabilities to identify gaps, update weapon specifications, and drive survivability solutions.
* **Combat System & Weapon Integration:** Direct system-of-systems (SoS) integration studies and interface definitions linking terminal defense weapons (e.g., RAM, CIWS) into ship combat systems (such as SSDS and Aegis) and advanced sensor suites (e.g., SPY-6 EASR).
* **High-Level Stakeholder & Enterprise Alignment:** Interface at the senior executive and Flag/SES levels across PAE Munitions, PAE Mission Systems, OPNAV, warfare centers (NSWC Dahlgren, NSWC Port Hueneme, NAWC China Lake), international cooperative partners, and national security leadership.
* **Digital Engineering Leadership:** Guide the program office’s model-based transition by applying Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) frameworks (SysML, Cameo/MagicDraw), digital threads, and Agile/DevSecOps practices to weapons modernization lifecycles.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** *Master’s Degree* in a science, engineering, technology, or mathematics (STEM) discipline (or *Bachelor’s Degree* with equivalent demonstrated experience directly with U.S. Navy surface weapon systems or combat systems).
* **Experience:** 10 years of systems engineering experience with U.S. Navy surface weapon systems, surface combat systems (e.g., SSDS, Aegis), or naval guided munitions.
* **Clearance:** Active DoD **SECRET** clearance required (Top Secret eligible preferred); ability to access SIPRNet and handle classified intelligence/threat briefings.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in a science, engineering, technology, or math discipline.
* Direct technical experience with Navy terminal defense elements, including the **Rolling Airframe Missile (RAM)** and **Close-In Weapon System (CIWS)** weapon systems, launchers, and guided missile rounds.
* Proven track record leading requirements analysis, weapon specification development, and System Engineering Technical Reviews (SETR) according to the NAVSEA Technical Review Manual (TRM).
* Practical familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and architectures (e.g., Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, SysML, DoDAF).
* Working knowledge of weapon-to-combat system interface documentation (ICDs, IRSs), firing policies, and combat system designation loops.
* Excellent executive briefing, written communication, and cross-functional leadership skills with the poise to advise military program managers, technical directors, and international steering committees.

**Travel Requirements**

* Limited travel required (~10%), primarily to warfare centers, test facilities, or OEM plant locations (e.g., Dahlgren, VA; Port Hueneme, CA; China Lake, CA; Tucson, AZ).

Compensation at Decision Technologies, Inc. is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – C4IT Systems Engineering & Integration
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support the engineering, development, integration, installation, testing, and sustainment of complex Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Information Technology (C4IT) systems.

The Systems Engineer will provide technical leadership and engineering expertise across multiple system lifecycle activities, ensuring that hardware, software, network, and peripheral components operate together to meet operational and mission requirements.

This position requires strong technical analytical skills, experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities, and the ability to address complex system integration and operational challenges.

The successful candidate will collaborate with Government representatives, project managers, software developers, test engineers, technicians, cybersecurity personnel, and external vendors.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*Systems Engineering and Architecture*

* Perform systems engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle.
* Develop and evaluate system requirements, designs, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Analyze system architectures and identify opportunities for improved functionality, interoperability, and reliability.
* Support hardware and software integration activities.
* Analyze system interfaces, data flows, and communications requirements.
* Perform technical analyses to evaluate proposed system designs.
* Identify engineering constraints and recommend feasible technical solutions.
* Support engineering trade studies and technology assessments.

*Requirements Engineering*

* Analyze operational, functional, performance, interface, and system requirements.
* Translate Government operational needs into engineering requirements.
* Develop and maintain technical requirements documentation.
* Support requirements verification and validation.
* Identify conflicting, incomplete, or technically infeasible requirements.
* Maintain engineering traceability between system requirements, designs, and verification activities.

*Systems Integration and Installation*

* Plan and coordinate integration of hardware, software, communications, and peripheral systems.
* Evaluate compatibility between system components.
* Support equipment configuration and system installation activities.
* Coordinate with technical personnel to resolve integration issues.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex system-level problems.
* Support installation and operational readiness activities.
* Participate in system demonstrations and acceptance events.

*Test and Evaluation*

* Develop or oversee development of system test and evaluation plans.
* Coordinate engineering verification activities.
* Participate in integration, functional, performance, and operational testing.
* Analyze test results and identify deficiencies.
* Recommend engineering corrections and system improvements.
* Support test readiness reviews and technical milestone events.
* Document verification results and engineering recommendations.

*Technical Project Coordination*

* Provide technical guidance and direction across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Coordinate technical activities with project managers and Government stakeholders.
* Support technical planning, engineering schedules, and task execution.
* Provide input into project estimates, budgets, and technical resource requirements.
* Support technical reviews and engineering presentations.
* Monitor and report progress against technical milestones.
* Coordinate vendor and subcontractor technical activities when assigned.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation recommendations.

*System Sustainment and Troubleshooting*

* Support system maintenance, modernization, and technology refresh activities.
* Investigate complex hardware, software, or communications failures.
* Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
* Evaluate system changes for impacts on performance and interoperability.
* Support configuration control and technical baseline management.
* Assist with operational troubleshooting and system restoration.

*Engineering Documentation and Reporting*

* Develop and review system engineering documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, engineering analyses, and design recommendations.
* Maintain system interface and configuration documentation.
* Prepare technical presentations and Government briefings.
* Document technical decisions, risks, resolutions, and lessons learned.
* Communicate engineering findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

*Education*

Bachelor's degree in one of the following fields:

* Systems Engineering
* Computer Science
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering

*Experience*

Minimum seven (7) consecutive years of experience in C4IT or Systems Engineering.

Experience must demonstrate progressively responsible engineering activities involving:

* Systems engineering and technical analysis.
* Hardware and software system integration.
* System requirements and design.
* Technical troubleshooting.
* Test and evaluation support.
* Engineering documentation.
* Multidisciplinary technical coordination.

*Security Requirements*

* U.S. Citizenship required for eligibility for the required security clearance.
* Secret security clearance required.
* Ability to maintain the required clearance throughout employment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

*Government and Military Systems*

Experience supporting:

* U.S. Coast Guard programs.
* Department of Defense programs.
* Department of Homeland Security programs.
* C4ISR systems.
* Maritime communications systems.
* Command-and-control environments.
* Government system modernization and sustainment programs.

*Technical Knowledge*

Knowledge of:

* Systems engineering lifecycle processes.
* Systems integration methodologies.
* Network and communications architectures.
* Windows and Linux environments.
* Hardware

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions. Our Manassas campus is a thriving center of engineering expertise, fostering a culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the creation of exceptional products. At Lockheed Martin, we're at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and innovation. Our campus in Manassas, Virginia is a hub for engineering excellence, where we tackle some of the world's most challenging engineering problems. We pride ourselves on our culture of creativity, excellence, and product innovation.

**The Work**

Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking a full-time Systems Engineer. This Systems Engineer will support the United Kingdom (UK) Tactical Tomahawk Weapons Control System (TTWCS) program within our C6ISR market segment at our Manassas, Virginia location. This individual will be part of a small team responsible for maintaining UK customer requirements, system hardware requirements, and interface specifications, for addressing a variety of systems engineering tasks, and defining and executing a test and acceptance program for the Tomahawk Weapon System (TWS) onboard UK Astute-class submarines.

This position involves frequent interaction and collaboration with customers and end-users. This Systems Engineer must also participate in the full System Engineering life cycle, including system and hardware requirements development, hardware stand-up, system integration, test definition, test planning, system certification and sell-off, and system delivery and production support. This position requires occasional international travel to the UK for several weeks at a time, as well as occasional local and domestic travel.

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Product
jobs.description:
**About Tin Can**
=================

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.

We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on two engineers to help make it happen.

**The Role**
------------

A Tin Can earns its spot on the kitchen counter when a kid keeps picking it up. Because we build both ends of the call, we get to make things no other phone can, and the next ones are the kind families ask us for: an easier way to fill the contact book, even more speed dials, more a kid can do without waiting on a grown-up. We’re hiring two Software Engineers to own the core product — the features that give a kid someone to call, a reason to call, and an easy way to do it.

You’ll build across the whole product: the app parents live in (Flutter), the TypeScript services on AWS Lambda behind contacts, plans, call logs, and voicemail, and the call-routing service that gates every call. You’ll sit with the Head of Product and the core experience’s PM and designer, alongside the engineers who own our voice platform, firmware, and account portal. When a feature reaches into the call path — a new hotline number, the voicemail menu — you’ll go there, with our voice engineers reviewing anything on the SIP and media plane.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Make it easier to hear who called and call them back — on the phone itself, in our services, and in the parents’ app
* Give kids more of the phone: even more speed dials, and more a kid can set up alone, with a parent’s say-so
* Make the first week count — improved contact syncing, faster contact approvals, and a first run that has a family calling on day one
* Build the fun, weird features no other landline can, the kind a kid tells their friends about
* Own the call-routing rules a feature needs — what a speed dial or a hotline number does, who a kid can reach — in the service every call goes through
* Build the tooling behind hotlines — scheduling, uploading, playback — with the engineers who own our voice platform
* Spec and build the service side of features whose other half is firmware — what the phone plays, how it rings — with the firmware engineer
* Instrument what you ship — event schema, dashboard, alarm — so we can see kids calling more, week by week
* Take a turn in our on-call rotation, because nobody knows a feature like the person who built it

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3+ years building user-facing software, including a feature you took from idea to production and kept running
* Strong TypeScript; you’ve built and run an API in production (ours run on AWS Lambda with Postgres) and can model contacts, permissions, and call history
* You’ve shipped a mobile or web client people use every day; our app is Flutter, and we’ll teach you Dart
* You think about the kid and the parent at once — what a kid can do alone, what needs a grown-up, and how fast “no” takes effect
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have
* Hands-on and scrappy; you’d rather prototype the flow on a real Tin Can than wait for a perfect spec
* A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Based in Seattle and ready to work from our office Monday through Thursday; this isn’t a remote role
* **Bonus:** Flutter or Dart; curiosity about telephony (dial plans, IVRs, text-to-speech); a product for kids or families; or Stripe, Shopify, or IoT integrations

**Why Join Tin Can**
====================

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll own the reason a kid picks up the phone:** Reliability makes a call connect; you’ll build what makes a kid want to make one — easier ways to call back, more speed dials, more to do when no one’s around — and see it in how often families call.
* **Small, high-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you’re excited by making a Tin Can the thing a kid reaches for when they’ve got something to tell someone — and building what makes that call easy to make and return — we’d love to meet you.

Compensation Range: $145K - $175K

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
About Luxer One
---------------

Luxer One designs and deploys smart locker and access systems across multifamily properties, commercial enterprises, retail chains, and food delivery networks across North America. An Assa Abloy company, our products span cloud, mobile, and physical hardware — connected through firmware that runs in the field, at scale, around the clock. We manufacture control boards, IoT gateways, access hubs, and connected locker systems, and the firmware powering those devices is what makes all of it reliable.

Why This Role Matters
---------------------

When firmware works, nobody notices. When it doesn't, a deployed device goes dark, a locker doesn't open, or a fleet of devices stops reporting health to the cloud. At Luxer One, firmware is not a support function — it is the reliability foundation of everything we ship. We are actively scaling our embedded portfolio: next-generation control boards, IoT-connected gateways, BLE and WiFi-enabled locker hardware, mesh access systems, and temperature-managed storage devices. Each program is a real production deployment with real uptime expectations and real customers on the other end.

We need a Senior Firmware Engineer who can own programs end to end — from hardware bring-up and architecture through production firmware, OTA update pipelines, and field reliability — and who brings genuine seniority to the embedded systems decisions that define product quality at scale.

Who You Are
-----------

You are a firmware engineer who is equally comfortable writing embedded C at the register level and presenting a hardware architecture decision to a cross-functional team. You do not wait for specs to be perfect before you start, and you do not consider a program done when code ships — you own it through field deployment and into production operations.

You are:

* A low-level builder — you write production C/C++ on microcontrollers, understand memory models, peripheral drivers, and timing constraints, and can debug a device in the field with an oscilloscope and a logic analyzer as readily as in a simulator
* Reliable in production — you treat uptime as a personal accountability; you build telemetry in, design OTA update paths that fail safely, and watch the fleet after launch
* A cross-discipline collaborator — you work directly with electrical engineers on schematic review and hardware bring-up, and with manufacturing partners on NPI readiness and production tooling
* A technical decision-maker — you author architecture docs and hardware specifications that others build from, not just code that implements what someone else decided
* AI-fluent — you actively use AI tools in your engineering workflow: for documentation, code review, debugging analysis, status reporting, and technical communication. You move faster and produce higher-quality artifacts because of it, and you are interested in the broader frontier of AI-assisted embedded development
* Operationally minded — you understand that embedded systems in a commercial IoT product live in the real world, subject to network outages, power interruptions, hostile environments, and user error. You design for that reality, not the happy path

And you bring:

* A track record of shipping embedded firmware for IoT or connected hardware products into production at meaningful scale
* Experience with the full embedded development lifecycle: architecture, bring-up, driver development, application firmware, manufacturing tooling, OTA, and field maintenance
* Hands-on experience with BLE, WiFi, or cellular connectivity in embedded products
* Comfort owning multiple concurrent hardware programs with limited supervision

What You'll Do
--------------

* Own firmware architecture and delivery for Luxer One's embedded hardware portfolio — including locker control boards, IoT gateways, BLE/WiFi-connected access hardware, and next-generation platform programs
* Design and implement firmware from the ground up on new hardware programs: architecture decisions, peripheral bring-up, RTOS integration, application layer, and production readiness
* Build and maintain OTA update pipelines and device management integration — including MDM enrollment, provisioning workflows, and fleet telemetry
* Partner with electrical engineers and manufacturing partners (including Ansync) on hardware design review, design for manufacturability, NPI readiness, and production validation
* Write and maintain hardware specifications, architecture decision records, and technical documentation that inform roadmap decisions and manufacturing commitments
* Maintain and improve the reliability of devices in the field — monitoring telemetry, identifying failure patterns, shipping patches, and owning uptime metrics on deployed fleets
* Contribute to firmware quality standards: code review, CI pipeline health, automated test coverage, and escape defect rates from QA
* Actively use AI tools in your workflow — for documentation generation, debugging analysis, status reporting, and code review — and help the team develop best practices for AI-assisted embedded development
* Represent embedded systems in cross-functional planning — product roadmap, NPI programs, commercial partner engagements — as the authoritative technical voice on firmware capabilities and constraints

### **Requirements**

What We're Looking For
----------------------

* Five or more years of firmware or embedded software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production IoT or connected hardware programs
* Strong C/C++ in an embedded context — microcontrollers, peripheral drivers, RTOS (FreeRTOS or similar), memory management
* Experience with wireless connectivity in embedded products — BLE, WiFi, or cellular — including protocol handling, reliability design, and power management
* OTA update design and implementation experience — including safe rollback, version management, and fleet-scale deployment
* Experience with hardware bring-up: schematic

**Job Details**
===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** performs scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics. The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a highly motivated and experienced **Flight Telecom Systems Engineer II** to join their Communication System Engineering and Operations Group. As a member of this Group, you will have an opportunity to be involved in all phases of product development from early concept and mission formulation, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support. In this role, you will perform complex and varied engineering tasks within the telecom discipline, partnering with senior engineers across all phases of the product lifecycle.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

  

* Provide telecom system engineering support on various flight telecom subsystems for deep-space interplanetary missions, Earth-orbiting missions, and lunar/Mars relay networks.

* Contribute new ideas and concepts toward the improvement of existing telecom products and technologies.
* Present analyses and technical results at peer-level design and technical reviews.
* Contribute technical content, data, and graphics to proposal and Concept Study Report (CSR) development efforts.

jobs.description:
**About SirenOpt**

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. It starts with our live induction program that serves as an incubator for cross-functional team building, an immersion in Procept’s history, jam-packed interactive sessions with executive leadership and a crash-course in the mission and purpose of what we do. It continues with our one-of-a-kind management program designed to build the best managers in the industry, where our people managers across functions come together to exchange ideas and grow, as both managers and learners, in an environment that challenges, supports and broadens.

We are fueled by the opportunity to give people their lives back. And we believe that it begins with YOU! At Procept, we push beyond just finding a work/life balance, we strive to find a work/life blend, a professional world that you are honored and impassioned to belong to, one that you can proudly share with your family, friends, and acquaintances.

An opportunity at PROCEPT BioRobotics won’t just be about finding a job. It will be an opportunity for you to join a community devoted to making a difference in this world!

**Company Overview**

Embark on an enriching journey with PROCEPT BioRobotics, where our vision, mission, and values guide everything we do as a company. At PROCEPT, we put the patient first in everything we do and are committed to revolutionizing treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH, otherwise known as prostate gland enlargement) through innovation in surgical robotics. As our company succeeds and grows, we improve the quality of life of patients, provide more effective treatment options for surgeons, uphold the trust of our shareholders. That starts with a commitment to our People with a focus on creating an evolving landscape for your career, brimming with transformative opportunities that provide continuous career growth opportunities.

**The Opportunity That Awaits You:**

This position is for the relentless learner who gets energized by the unknown! You will work alongside seasoned engineering leaders and talented peers to demonstrate and elevate your technical skills in electrical design and electromechanical systems for PROCEPT’s current and future products. The Staff Electrical Engineer position is part of the Electrical Engineering group within the R&D Capital Equipment department, and will be a key contributor in electrical design, feasibility, requirements definition, design verification, test system development, manufacturing procedure development, and production transfer activities at various stages of the product development cycle. Join our talented team and help us build a product that will transform the health and quality of life for men suffering from BPH.

jobs.description:
**About the team**

At Q-CTRL, Quantum Computing Engineering is a global team of software engineers and infrastructure experts, combining deep technical expertise with a startup mindset to deliver real impact through software innovation. Our work is underpinned by robust standards, and by embracing the three virtues. Our team excels in areas across back-end, front-end, machine learning, and platform engineering.

We transform Q-CTRL’s world-leading technological breakthroughs into commercial software products with applications across defense, research, and industry. We work closely with Product, Design, and Research teams to accelerate the path to quantum advantage worldwide.

### **About the role**

The Q-CTRL Infrastructure team is part of the backbone of our software platform and hardware initiatives. Guided by our vision to make the right way the easy way, our mission is to build reliable, secure and maintainable infrastructure that enables Q-CTRL to scale its revolutionary quantum technology.

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role supporting our Kubernetes-based SaaS platform, our growing hardware division and embedded deployments. You will help build infrastructure across diverse workloads, ensuring our end-to-end processes are fully code-driven, automated and optimized to keep operational complexity low.

Based in our Santa Monica office, you will collaborate closely with the bulk of our team located in Sydney, Australia. Joining an established team that offers strong support and values an open culture, you will drive continuous improvement by leveraging Infrastructure as Code and establishing golden paths that empower engineering teams to ship safely and autonomously.

### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Providing in-hours support for US-based research and engineering teams, while authoring clear technical proposals, ADRs and documentation to drive asynchronous alignment with our Sydney team.
* Getting up to speed on our software stack, integrating insights from your experience into our platform architecture, updating code where needed and driving tech choices to hit our platform goals.
* Ensuring Q-CTRL stays current with cloud best practices, advocating for a strong DevOps culture and actively contributing to innovation across our engineering workflows.
* Developing toolchain support including CI/CD pipelines, operators such as those for GitOps, ephemeral environments, vulnerability scanning and automated Infrastructure as Code deployment tooling.
* Helping ensure our applications are scalable, highly available, cloud-agnostic and accessible via Zero Trust networking across public clouds as well as embedded client infrastructure.

### **Ideally you’ll have:**

* 5+ years of industry experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering or equivalent.
* Experience running Kubernetes in production and deep familiarity with everything needed to provision production-grade clusters.
* Expert knowledge of public clouds using Infrastructure as Code to build intuitive, self-service golden paths that enable engineering teams to ship safely and autonomously.
* Hands-on experience with a variety of Linux distributions and strong system-level troubleshooting skills.
* Proficiency in software development (primarily Go and Python) with the ability to quickly understand application behavior from codebases with minimal context.
* A pragmatic approach to system design that balances curiosity with maintainability, choosing simple, sustainable patterns that keep long-term operational debt low.

### **It would be fantastic if you have these skills/experience but not essential:**

* Relevant Kubernetes certifications such as CKA, CKAD, or CKS.
* Relevant public cloud certifications such as AWS SAA/SAP or GCP ACE/PCA.
* Familiarity with the CNCF and its various projects.
* Experience using GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux CD.

**Salary**

The targeted base salary range for this position is between $150,000 - $225,000 and will ultimately be determined by specific job-related skills, experience, level, location and other contributing factors. Depending on the position offered, this role may be eligible for annual discretionary bonuses, equity and other forms of compensation outside of the targeted base salary range. For more information on benefits at Q-CTRL, please visit our careers page at https://q-ctrl.com/careers.

Should you have any questions related to the compensation package, please speak directly with the Talent Acquisition representative.

**About Q-CTRL**

Q-CTRL is the global leader in AI-powered quantum control infrastructure software. We build the tools that make quantum technology useful, solving the hardest challenges in quantum computing and quantum sensing to deliver real-world impact.

Founded in 2017, we operate globally with offices in Sydney, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Huntsville, Berlin, and Oxford. Our teams bring together technical and multi-disciplinary expertise across the product lifecycle, and we’re hiring talent to help scale every part of the business. We work quickly to turn cutting-edge science into deployable technology.

In 2024 we raised US$113 million in Series B funding, the largest aggregate investment for a quantum software company. Six months later we delivered the first commercial quantum advantage with Ironstone Opal, our field-validated quantum navigation solution for defense and industry.

At Q-CTRL, we prioritize outcomes over hours. We offer flexibility, equity potential, and competitive benefits that reflect our high-performance culture. If you’re ready to help shape the future of quantum, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer, Manufacturing Software (ArsenalOS Deployment)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer on the ArsenalOS Deployment initiative, you will build the full-stack web applications that power daily planning, work assignment, and team-lead dashboards on the factory floor. You will develop offline-capable, mobile-friendly interfaces that factory operators depend on in network-constrained environments where reliability and usability are non-negotiable.
  
  
You will Own Maritime-specific manufacturing software requirements end to end. As well as the build-vs-extend decision for each ask. Today that's centered on shop-floor execution (scheduling capability in our MES); the mandate extends to whatever MES, ERP, and adjacent manufacturing capabilities Maritime needs next. Design, develop, deploy and operate across Maritime's factories.

  

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Build full-stack web applications for daily production planning, work assignment, and team-lead operational dashboards that drive real-time factory execution.
* Develop offline-capable and mobile-friendly interfaces designed for the factory floor, ensuring operators can work seamlessly in network-constrained or intermittent connectivity environments.
* Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements.
* Write production-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions.
* Design and implement robust offline-first architectures using service workers, local storage, and background sync to ensure application functionality regardless of network conditions.
* Build responsive, touch-optimized mobile interfaces that work on tablets and mobile devices in harsh manufacturing environments (gloves, low light, vibration).
* Architect and implement data synchronization strategies that handle conflict resolution and maintain data integrity between edge devices and backend systems.
* Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks.
* Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices.
* Join an on-call rotation supporting production factory systems.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with backend engineers, data engineers, factory systems teams, and operations to ensure seamless integration with MES, data pipelines, and enterprise systems.
* Set technical direction and mentor junior engineers on best practices for building resilient, user-centered manufacturing software.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of experience in a software engineering role building production systems, ideally in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in full-stack web development, with demonstrated mastery of both frontend and backend systems.
* Strong technical fluency in modern software architectures, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, and cloud or edge infrastructure.
* Proficiency with web-based technologies including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and modern web frameworks.
* Experience building offline-capable web applications using service workers, IndexedDB, local storage, and progressive web app (PWA) patterns.
* Experience building systems that must operate reliably under real-world operational constraints (high availability, low latency, or constrained environments).
* Experience working with large enterprise applications and platforms with high availability requirements.

**Systems Engineer**

We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**About First Advantage**

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.

**What You'll Do**

The ideal **Systems Engineer** brings deep technical expertise across the Microsoft ecosystem (Entra ID, On-Prem AD, Exchange Hybrid, Intune/Autopilot), advanced scripting proficiency (PowerShell, Azure Automation, Microsoft Graph API), and hands-on experience integrating ITSM platforms like Jira Service Management (JSM).

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking GITS Systems & Automation Engineer to drive our IT operational transformation. In this role, you will bridge identity governance, cloud/hybrid infrastructure, and service management by designing and implementing zero-touch provisioning pipelines, automated Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) workflows, and AI/Virtual Agent self-service integrations.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Identity & Access Lifecycle Automation (JML):**

* Design, build, and maintain end-to-end automated workflows for employee onboarding, role transitions, and offboarding across On-Prem AD, Entra ID, Exchange Online, and SaaS business applications.
* Implement dynamic group rules, attribute-based access control (ABAC), and Entra ID governance policies to ensure scalable, policy-driven access.
* Ensure strict UPN/primary SMTP synchronization and casing rules to eliminate duplicate cloud objects and sync errors.

**2. Hybrid Infrastructure & Cloud Administration:**

* Administer and optimize hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft 365 environments, including **Exchange Hybrid cutover/migrations, E5 license provisioning, Teams, and SharePoint.**
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and Windows Autopilot zero-touch deployment pipelines**.**

**3. Scripting & Workflow Orchestration:**

* Author enterprise-grade, modular PowerShell scripts and Azure Automation Runbooks utilizing Managed Identities and Azure Key Vault for secure secret management.
* Build REST API integrations using Microsoft Graph API and webhooks to connect ITSM tools with identity platforms.

**4. Conversational AI & ITSM Integration:**

* Partner with IT leadership to integrate Virtual Agents / Conversational AI with Jira Service Management (JSM) to enable automated ticket triage, self-service access fulfillment, and Knowledge Base deflection.
* Build automated runbook triggers initiated from JSM service requests and approval gates.

**5. Security, Compliance & Governance:**

* Enforce Zero Trust principles using Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) / Just-In-Time (JIT) access.
* Conduct automated audits of mailboxes, privileged roles, distribution lists, and access logs to maintain audit readiness (SOX/ISO).

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science or a related field
* Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration and IT Operations with a strong focus on identity management and automation.

**What You May Need to be Successful:**

  

* Microsoft Cloud & Hybrid Stack: Expert knowledge of Entra ID (Azure AD), Hybrid Active Directory, Group Policies (GPO), and Microsoft 365 (E5) Suite. Proficient in Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Exchange Hybrid / EAC, Conditional Access, and Entra PIM.
* Automation & Scripting: Advanced PowerShell scripting (modular scripting, error handling, remote execution). Hands-on experience with Azure Automation (Hybrid Workers, Runbooks) and Microsoft Graph API / REST APIs.
* ITSM & Workflow Tooling: Experience with Jira Service Management (JSM) automation rules, webhooks, and asset management. Exposure to Virtual Agents, AI Chatbots, or conversational self-service workflows.
* Security & Best Practices: Proven experience managing credentials securely (Azure Key Vault, enterprise password managers). Strong understanding of RBAC, least privilege, and compliance auditing standards.
* Preferred Certifications: SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator Associate), MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate).

**Why Join Us at First Advantage?**

At First Advantage, team members are united around a noble purpose: helping organizations to safeguard their workplaces and manage risk. The company’s culture is shaped by its core values — Authenticity, Curiosity, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer-Inspired — empowering team members to bring their best ideas forward, collaborate across departments, and make a real impact.

Additional benefits offered include:

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. **Cloud Software Engineer 3**

**Location:** Annapolis Junction, MD, US, 20701

**Job Category:** Software Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Security Clearance Required:** Active TS/SCI with a current polygraph

### **Position Overview**

The Cloud Software Engineer develops, maintains, and enhances complex and diverse Big-Data Cloud systems based upon documented requirements. You will directly contribute to all stages of back-end processing, analyzing, and indexing, and provide expertise in Cloud Computing, the Hadoop Eco-System, Java applications, Distributed Computing, Information Retrieval (IR), and Object-Oriented Design.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Work individually or as part of a team to review and test software components for adherence to design requirements, document test results, and resolve software problem reports.
* Utilize software development and design methodologies appropriate for the development environment.
* Provide specific input to system design components, including hardware/software trade-offs, software reuse, COTS/GOTS integration, and requirements analysis/synthesis from system level down to individual software components.

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** Twelve (12) years of experience in software engineering programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.
* **Education:** A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university.

  + *Note:* Four (4) years of experience in programs utilizing Big-Data cloud technologies and/or Distributed Computing may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline may be substituted for two (2) years of experience. A Cloudera Certified Hadoop Developer certification can substitute for one (1) year of Cloud experience.
* **Big-Data & Cloud Experience:** Four (4) years must be in programs utilizing Big-Data cloud technologies and/or Distributed Computing. Specific cloud-related experience must include:

  + Two (2) years of Cloud and/or Distributed Computing Information Retrieval (IR).
  + One (1) year of implementing code that interacts with Cloud Big Table, Cloud Distributed File System, and Cloud Distributed Coordination Frameworks.
  + One (1) year of implementing complex MapReduce analytics.
  + One (1) year of architecting Cloud Computing solutions.
  + One (1) year of debugging problems with Cloud-based Distributed Computing Frameworks.
  + One (1) year of managing multi-node Cloud-based installations.
* **Computer Network Operations:** Utility Computing, Network Management, Virtualization (VMWare or VirtualBox), Cloud Computing, and multi-node management/installation using Python, CFEngine, Bash, Ruby, or related technologies.
* **Information Assurance:** Securing cloud-based and distributed applications through standard techniques (Firewalls, PKI Certificates, Server Authentication) alongside corporate authentication service experience.
* **Information Technology:**

  + Object-Oriented Design and Programming, Java, Eclipse (or similar), Maven, and RESTful web services.
  + Cloud/Distributed computing tech (YARN, J2EE, MapReduce, Zookeeper, HDFS, HBase, JMS, concurrent programming).
  + Information retrieval components (HDFS, HBase, Apache Lucene, Apache Solr, MongoDB).
  + Data ingestion, parsing, and analysis of disparate sources/formats (XML, JSON, CSV, binary formats, sequence/map files, Avro).
  + Aspect-Oriented Design and Development, JVM memory management, and application profiling.
  + UNIX/LINUX and CentOS.
* **SIGINT Experience:** Background in at least one SIGINT collection discipline (FORNSAT, CABLE, Terrestrial/Microwave, Overhead, ELINT), geolocation, emitter identification, signal applications, joint collection platforms, dataflow architectures, and signal characterization analysis.
* **Other Requirements:** CentOS, Linux/RedHat, and configuration management tools (Subversion, ClearQuest, Razor).

### **Desired Skills**

* Provide in-depth Information Retrieval knowledge to assist teams in designing, developing, and testing cloud IR systems.
* Implement complex workflows managing Cloud MapReduce analytics and interact with Cloud Distributed Coordination Frameworks.
* Oversee software development tasks, ensure process adherence, and make recommendations for process and documentation standard improvements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Cloud Computing and Hadoop technologies.
* Delegate programming/testing responsibilities, monitor performance, and select development processes alongside customers and system engineering.
* Recommend new technologies/processes and ensure overall quality control.
* Architect solutions for complex Cloud Software Engineering problems (e.g., efficient processing/retrieval of large-scale data).

### **Compensation & Total Rewards**

* **Target Salary Range:** $203,000 – $230,000 *(Estimated base compensation determined by experience, geographic location, education, specific role responsibilities, and contractual requirements)*.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package:**

  + Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  + Basic Life Insurance and Disability Insurance
  + Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO)
  + Paid Parental Leave
  + Tuition Reimbursement
  + 401(k) Plan with company match

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies or storage.
* Experience in storage systems, large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience with data analytics.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience in technical leadership.
* Experience in concurrency, multi-threading and synchronization.
* Experience with low-level system software (Linux kernel, filesystems, networking).
* Experience with performance optimization.
* Strong coding skills; preferably C++.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

D is the foundational layer of Google’s storage stack. It is a low-level storage system that stores bytes directly to disk or flash and serves the majority of Google’s data. It is the critical mediation layer between higher-level storage systems and data center management facilities.

We're looking for engineers to help us build and scale this critical distributed control plane. You'll get to rethink how storage capacity is provisioned, isolated, and made available at Google scale.

This is an exciting time in the evolution of Google's core storage architecture, as we strive to maximize the utilization and efficiency of our storage resources fleetwide. By improving how we balance load, manage failure domains, and automate device lifecycles, you'll directly impact the reliability and cost-effectiveness of Google's global storage infrastructure.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Austin Sensing Company**
--------------------------------

Austin Sensing Company builds radar, acoustic, and RF sensors for defense, public safety, critical infrastructure, and autonomous systems. We design and manufacture our hardware in Austin, Texas, with a focus on making high-performance sensing reliable, affordable, and widely available.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring an Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the firmware and embedded software that operate our sensing hardware. You’ll own code that brings up boards, controls peripherals, moves sensor data, and keeps deployed systems running reliably.

You’ll work closely with electrical, RF, FPGA, and software engineers, taking systems from initial board bring-up through production and customer deployment. We’re looking for someone who understands the hardware beneath their code and can diagnose problems at the bench and in the field.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Develop embedded firmware and software for microcontrollers and processors across our sensing products.
* Bring up new boards, configure peripherals, and develop drivers alongside electrical engineers.
* Implement sensor control, data acquisition, and communications between hardware and application software.
* Build interfaces using protocols such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, and Ethernet.
* Develop reliable startup, configuration, fault handling, and recovery behavior.
* Implement firmware updates, diagnostics, and system health monitoring for deployed devices.
* Debug issues involving interrupts, timing, memory, communications, and hardware interactions.
* Optimize software for compute, memory, power, and latency requirements.
* Build automated tests and tools for hardware validation, production testing, and field troubleshooting.
* Document interfaces and system behavior, and use field feedback to improve reliability.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience developing embedded firmware or software for deployed hardware products.
* Proficiency in C or C++ and familiarity with Python or a similar language for testing and automation.
* Strong understanding of microcontrollers, processors, interrupts, memory, and peripheral interfaces.
* Experience with bare-metal development, real-time operating systems, or embedded Linux.
* Hands-on board bring-up and debugging skills using JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Experience diagnosing problems across firmware, hardware, and communications.
* Familiarity with version control, automated builds, and software testing.
* Clear technical communication and attention to reliability and maintainability.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience with radar, RF, acoustic, or other sensor systems.
* Experience developing Linux device drivers, board support packages, or bootloaders.
* Familiarity with DMA, high-speed data acquisition, and interfaces to FPGAs.
* Experience with networked devices, time synchronization, and precise timestamping.
* Experience implementing secure boot and reliable remote updates.
* Experience supporting production testing and troubleshooting deployed systems.
* A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.

**Benefits**
------------

* 401(k)
* Insurance benefits
* Lunch and dinner served daily

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer to design the circuit boards behind our sensing systems. You’ll own designs from requirements and component selection through schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring-up, validation, and production.

You’ll work closely with RF, FPGA, embedded systems, and mechanical engineers to build boards that perform reliably and can be manufactured consistently. We’re looking for someone who can make sound design decisions, debug their own hardware, and carry a board through multiple revisions into a finished product.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuits for sensor interfaces, processing, communications, and power distribution.
* Own component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing documentation.
* Define board stackups, placement, routing constraints, grounding, and power distribution with attention to signal integrity and noise.
* Integrate microcontrollers, processors, FPGAs, memory, data converters, and communications interfaces.
* Work with RF engineers on interfaces between RF circuitry and supporting electronics.
* Bring up new boards and verify power rails, clocks, interfaces, and functionality.
* Diagnose failures using measurements, schematics, and controlled tests. Identify root causes and implement fixes.
* Evaluate power consumption, thermal behavior, and electrical margins across operating conditions.
* Design for manufacturability and testability, including programming access, test points, and production test requirements.
* Work with manufacturing and suppliers to resolve assembly issues, qualify component alternatives, and improve board yield.
* Maintain design files, bills of materials, revision history, and validation results.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience designing PCBs from initial requirements through bring-up and production.
* Proficiency in Altium Designer or a comparable PCB design tool.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, power supplies, grounding, and circuit protection.
* Experience designing multilayer boards and applying signal integrity and power integrity principles.
* Familiarity with embedded processors, FPGAs, memory, and peripheral interfaces.
* Hands-on debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and electronic loads.
* Experience preparing board fabrication and assembly files and reviewing designs with manufacturers.
* The ability to explain design tradeoffs and work through issues with firmware, RF, and mechanical engineers.
* Careful documentation and a willingness to take responsibility for a design through production.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience with radar, RF, acoustic, or other sensing hardware.
* Experience with high-speed interfaces such as DDR, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, or JESD204.
* Experience with low-noise analog circuits, ADCs, DACs, and sensor signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with EMI/EMC testing and improving designs based on test results.
* Experience designing for outdoor environments, temperature extremes, and electrical transients.
* Experience supporting production testing and troubleshooting field failures.
* A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.

* 401(k)
* Insurance benefits
* Lunch and dinner served daily

Responsibilities span the full hardware development lifecycle, from requirements definition and circuit design through fabrication, assembly, integration, and testing.

* Experience with electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, cable harness design, printed circuit boards, and electronic assemblies.
* Knowledge of DC-to-DC power conversion, DC power filtering, and electrical power distribution.

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**Your Impact**

You will be part of a high-impact engineering team that develops embedded software for Axon devices, ensuring critical evidence is captured during mission-essential moments for our customers. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented software and firmware engineers and contribute to the creation of next-generation public safety products, including body-worn cameras, in-car audio-video systems, TASERs, wireless microphones, and more.

As a Firmware Validation Engineer I, you are a key quality voice for one or more Axon products, partnering with firmware, software, and hardware engineering to ship products customers can trust. You'll own testing for your product area with increasing independence, contribute to departmental testing standards, and help leadership make informed calls on coverage, bug severity, and release risk.
