jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

**Hardware Engineer – New Product Development**

**Location: Chandler, AZ (Onsite)**

**Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract-to-Hire**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Hardware Engineer to design and develop next-generation electronic products for defense and rugged commercial applications. The ideal candidate does their own schematic capture and PCB layout end-to-end; this is not an architecture-only or oversight role. The right person has taken boards from concept through production, debugged them when they broke, and learned from it.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own hardware design end-to-end: schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, board bring-up, and debug through production release.
* Design circuit boards for rugged, industrial, commercial, or defense-adjacent applications (not high-volume consumer electronics).
* Work with microprocessor-based designs, including digital interfaces (GPIO, ADC, high-speed buses) and general digital/mixed-signal circuit design.
* Design power electronics in the 1-5kW range (not low-power audio/amplifier-scale work).
* Design hardware in a way that supports the embedded/firmware team's work, even without writing firmware directly. Prior firmware exposure is a plus.
* Collaborate with mechanical and systems engineers to integrate hardware into full electro-mechanical products.
* Participate in client-facing design reviews and program updates.
* Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., for design review) as part of the standard workflow; comfort with this is expected, not optional.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Enough experience to have been through a full product cycle, from design through production through field issues, but not so specialized that the candidate has only worked on isolated pieces of larger programs.
* Ground-up PCB design experience is required. Candidates who have only worked at large companies with dedicated layout technicians (i.e., don't do their own layout) are not a fit.
* Proficiency with Altium Designer preferred. Candidates with only KiCad/Eagle experience will be viewed as more hobbyist-level; Altium experience is a plus but not a strict filter if the rest of the background is strong.
* Experience with microprocessor-based digital design and high-speed routing/bus design.
* Power electronics experience (battery or power supply design in the 1-5kW range) is valued.
* Strong hands-on debugging ability. Candidates should be able to bring past board work to an interview and walk through what went wrong and how they fixed it.
* No fear of or resistance to AI tools in the engineering workflow. This has become a real culture filter for the team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in rugged product design for automotive, medical, industrial, or defense/aerospace applications. Defense/aerospace background is a plus but not required.
* Familiarity with relevant MIL-STDs (461 EMI, 810 environmental) or equivalent rugged design standards from automotive/medical work.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline preferred, not a hard requirement if experience supports the above.

**Soft Skills / Culture Fit (Critical)**

* High emotional intelligence and comfort working directly with clients.
* Strong accountability and humility around design mistakes; the team wants to see how a candidate responds when something breaks, not blame-shifting or overconfidence.
* Comfortable in a culture that includes firearms and alcohol on-site.
* Well-presented and professional in appearance.

**Certifications / Clearance**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen (born or naturalized). Green card holders and other work-authorized non-citizens are not eligible. No sponsorship available.
* No active clearance required. Candidate must be eligible to become ITAR-compliant.

Key changes from the old JD:

* Removed "5+ years" as a hard requirement, replaced with the "seen a full product cycle" framing since that mattered more to Andy than a specific number.
* Cut OrCAD/Mentor Graphics mentions and centered on Altium as the real preference, with the KiCad/Eagle nuance Andy raised.
* Removed system-architecture framing from the intro and responsibilities. Andy was explicit: no system architects, this is a layout/bring-up/debug role.
* Removed DFM/DFT, UL/CE/FCC/ISO regulatory language, and EMI/EMC compliance detail as formal requirements since none of that came up as a priority on the call.
* Added the AI-tool comfort requirement, since Andy flagged this as an active screening factor now.
* Added the same culture-fit section as the ME role (client-facing, humility, guns/alcohol comfort, presentation) since Andy made clear this applies identically to both hires.
* Fixed citizenship language to match the ME JD: US citizens only, no green card sponsorship.

Duties will be developmental in nature when filled below the full performance level.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen or National.
* Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication.
* Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
* Direct Deposit participation required.
* Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more, visit https://www.e-verify.gov/.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**SENIOR SOFTWARE SYSTEMS ENGINEER II**

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Senior Software Systems Engineer II based at our Optical Systems site in Tucson, AZ, you will have the opportunity to design, develop, and test space-based electro-optical sensors. Systems engineers are responsible for the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process. They also work hands-on with flight software and drive the technical development of our Space Systems missions.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Design, integrate, and develop software for space-based optical instruments, subsystems, and payloads for airborne and space platforms
* Understand and interpret overall system architecture, deriving and allocating software and firmware requirements to ensure consistency across interfaces and subsystems
* Understand the software/firmware development pipeline and SW/FW development process, from requirements through build, integration, test, and release
* Develop and maintain:
* + Technical budgets for vehicle performance
  + Software System requirements and verification techniques
  + Simulations and analysis across vehicle functions
  + Test methods and data analysis
* Provide technical oversight of system software architecture, interfaces, mission assurance, and compliance
* Assist with programs and product management
* Develop, in collaboration with team members, interface specifications, CONOPS definition, and other design documents
* Support the development and testing of space payloads to be integrated on spacecraft platforms
* Execute software verification test campaigns on the flatsat, development unit, or flight unit, including test setup, dry runs, and formal verification runs
* Verify the correct software build and configuration are under test, confirming the as-tested configuration matches the intended verification
* Support authoring, derivation, and verification of software and firmware requirements, and maintain requirements traceability throughout the development lifecycle, addressing conflicts or gaps
* Participate in technical interchange meetings (TIMs) and represent the organization in project discussions with internal stakeholders and external partners
* Mentor other engineers on systems engineering, requirements, and verification and validation (V&V) methodologies
* Ability to support travel or off-site work, as needed

**QUALIFICATIONS YOU'LL BRING AS SENIOR SOFTWARE SYSTEMS ENGINEER II:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (software or computer engineering)
* Active Clearance
* 8+ years of engineering experience in the aerospace industry; with 2+ years directly supporting software development projects and 1+ years in project or team leadership
* A strong knowledge of how to interpret organizational, software, and hardware technical documents
* Demonstrable experience in systems software engineering, with a strong focus on developing, testing, and integrating with space or airborne instruments
* Experience with requirements management, workflow, and modeling tools such as JAMA, DOORS, JIRA, or Cameo
* Experience supporting development programs
* U.S citizenship is required, due to program requirements

**NICE TO HAVES:**

* Active TS/SCI clearance
* Master's or PhD in engineering (software or computer engineering)
* EO/IR payload integration experience
* Proficiency in system modeling and analysis tools such as Cameo, MATLAB, Simulink, or equivalent
* Experience with the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) from requirements development through systems operations and maintenance
* Knowledge of software interfaces and communications protocols
* Hands-on expertise leading troubleshooting and resolution of system-level issues
* Demonstrated experience working with minimal supervision in complex projects
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and explain complex implementation processes to other organization members

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

About Us

We’re a stable, privately-owned company where people enjoy what they do — and who they do it with. Our team sticks around, with an average tenure just shy of 10 years. That kind of loyalty doesn’t happen by accident.

We are rooted in a strong culture and shared core values. We care about our team, our customers, and each other. If you’re someone who has a passion for advancing business and improving lives through technology, values trust, integrity, and a place where your contributions matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

Purpose of the Position

The official title for this role is Technical Alignment Manager (TAM). The TAM is responsible for understanding the client’s environment, what they do, how they use their technology to enable their business, and, from a technical perspective, maintaining that relationship with them. Establishing a technical relationship with the clients allows the TAM to communicate from a hands-on level. They dig deep into a client’s operations to figure out how they work and apply technology solutions that help them work better, smarter, faster, and more efficiently while also helping reduce costs. A person in this position will continually analyze a client’s technology against the applicable company Standard(s), and/or compliance requirements, uncovering technical gaps and risks.

Because they have an in-depth knowledge of their assigned client’s IT environment, the TAM can recommend enhancements to their systems that will uphold best practices regarding cybersecurity, overall system performance, user experience, and more. The TAM’s combined knowledge of the industry and client infrastructure makes it possible for them to identify and proactively address technical risks and issues before they become bigger problems. A TAM is the technical lead for proactive service, maintenance, and planning— driving down the need for, cost, and time sink inherent in reactive support.

A successful person in this position will be highly technical, a natural troubleshooter, client-focused, and have a proactive mindset. They must be a detail-oriented self-starter who takes ownership for their responsibilities, meets deadlines, and communicates effectively with teammates, clients, and vendors.

**Embedded Software Engineer**
==============================

**The Company**
---------------

AnySignal is developing the next generation of RF products and services for some of the most demanding space and defense missions. We’re building a flexible, high-performance platform that’s easy to deploy, monitor, and scale, enabling customers to bring advanced radio technologies to life faster than ever before.

**The Role**
------------

As an Embedded Software Engineer on AnySignal's Space Software team, you'll take ownership of mission-critical embedded systems, from design and implementation through testing and deployment on customer missions. Your work will span the embedded software stack, from low-level RF integrated circuit drivers and high-speed FPGA interfaces to embedded Linux, networking, and fault-tolerant software architecture.

Your work will support reliable communications and sensing capabilities across demanding space and defense missions, where software must anticipate failures and operate reliably in environments where physical intervention is limited.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the development of mission-critical embedded systems, driving overall product success beyond the scope of software.
* Design, develop, and test reliable C++ code running on Linux-based embedded systems.
* Build software across our stack, including low-level RF integrated circuit drivers, high-speed FPGA interfaces, and fault-tolerant system failure recovery.
* Support hardware bring-up, schematic reviews, and debugging embedded radio platforms.
* Build automated hardware-in-the-loop tests to validate system performance and reliability.
* Work directly with our customers to integrate our products into their flight systems, debug RF links, and ensure mission success.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* Ability to own a complete system, including software and everything that it interfaces with.
* Proficiency in C++.
* Experience developing embedded software on Linux platforms.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across embedded hardware and software systems.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with network programming, including TCP/IP, UDP, and socket programming in embedded Linux environments.
* Working knowledge of digital signal processing, modem design, and RF communications concepts.
* Experience developing fault-tolerant software for mission-critical applications, especially in radiation environments.
* Experience with board bring-up, schematic review, and troubleshooting hardware.
* Hands-on experience testing and debugging RF hardware in a lab environment using spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, and other RF test equipment.
* Experience developing for Xilinx MPSoC-based devices.
* Experience with embedded Linux platform development, including Buildroot, U-Boot, and Xilinx FSBL creation.
* Experience writing RTL for FPGAs or software that interacts with the FPGA fabric.
* Experience with Python, build systems (CMake, Make, Bazel), and CI pipeline development (GitLab).

----------------

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The Space Imaging team is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join the team. The Space Imaging team is responsible for all aspects of spaceborne EO/IR system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define the electrical architecture of space-qualified EO/IR sensor payloads — including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, EMI/EMC protection, and high-speed communication interfaces — build and test prototypes, and mature designs into flight hardware products. As needed, you will also lead small teams of engineers from concept through system definition and development.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Electrical Architecture: Define and own the electrical architecture for EO/IR sensor payload assemblies, including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, grounding/bonding schemes, and communication interfaces.
* Power Electronics Design: Design, analyze, and test isolated power conversion, EMI filtering, inrush current limiting, and over-voltage/reverse-polarity protection circuitry for low-voltage DC payload power systems.
* Interface & Harness Design: Select connectors, define pin assignments, perform wire/cable and component derating analyses, and establish shielding, bonding, and isolation schemes to meet EMI/EMC requirements.
* Communication Interfaces: Design and support high-speed Ethernet (10GbE) and discrete I/O (RS-422, I2C, SPI) interfaces between sensor electronics and host avionics.
* EMC/ESD: Support EMI/EMC qualification testing (MIL-STD-461/464), and ESD protection design.
* Radiation Compliance: Radiation-tolerant (TID/SEU) component selection for space and tactical environments.
* Parts Stress & Reliability Analysis: Perform EEE parts stress/derating analyses and support hybrid microelectronics selection to ensure reliable operation across mission life.
* Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborate with firmware, mechanical, optical, and systems engineers to integrate electrical designs into sensor payload assemblies, including bring-up and verification testing.
* Testing and Validation: Develop and execute test procedures using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, network analyzers, EMI test gear) to validate designs against functional and performance requirements.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field is typically required.
* Experience: 8+ years of experience designing power, interface, or mixed-signal electronics for space, airborne, or other harsh-environment defense systems.
* Power Electronics & Circuit Design: Experience designing isolated DC/DC power conversion, EMI filters, and transient/over-voltage protection circuits for low-voltage DC systems.
* EMI/EMC Standards: Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 (or equivalent) EMI/EMC design and test methods.
* Interface/Harness Design: Experience with connector selection, pin/harness definition, and parts/wire derating analysis (e.g., per MIL-HDBK-1547A or equivalent).
* Debugging Skills: Strong hardware debugging skills using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic/protocol analyzers).
* Analysis Tools: Proficiency with schematic capture/circuit simulation tools and worst-case stress/derating analysis.
* US Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

* Experience designing radiation-tolerant electronics and performing TID/SEU analysis for space systems
* Experience with high-speed digital/communication interfaces (10GbE, SERDES) and signal integrity analysis

**Job Details**
===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** perform scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics. The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a **Software Engineer III** to join their **Software Defined Radios Group** to support flight software development and implementation for the **Polar Rover for Observation, Mapping, and In-Situ Exploration** (PROMISE) telecom subsystem. The Group leads the development of software / firmware defined digital flight electronics for telecom, radio metrics, and radar support applications. Work includes development and implementation of flight signal processing algorithms, complex spacecraft interfaces, and various data transfer and communications protocols that enable and support telecom, radar science, instruments, and spacecraft safety and health. Group members work on all phases of product development from early concept, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support.

PROMISE is a NASA lunar rover mission intended to explore the lunar south pole as part of the Moon Base program. As the PROMISE telecom Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the development, implementation, test, and delivery of the Boot Code Software and the Application Software designs that are part of the Universal Space Transponder (UST) radio family. You will be a member of the multidisciplinary implementation team consisting of approximately 7 full-time equivalent employees, industry partners, and subcontractors. You will report programmatically to the PROMISE Telecom Product Delivery Manager or the PROMISE Radio Cognizant Engineer and administratively to the Group Supervisor of the Software Defined Radios Group (362B).

* Support Spacecraft interface compatibility testing
* Own the software side of the interface to FPGA and mixed-signal hardware

* Support or lead flight software reviews and Software Readiness Certification Records (SRCRs)
* Generate software End Item Data Package (EIDP) and prepare software flight releases

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree in Electrical Engineering with a minimum of 6 years of related work experience, MA/MS degree in a related discipline with a minimum of 4 years of related work experience, PhD in a related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related work experience
* Strong C/C++ and working proficiency in Python

The System Software team owns the foundational OS layer — AlmaLinux-based embedded servers called Mobility Access Servers (MAS) — that powers inflight WiFi and streaming content on the world's leading airlines. You'll work on the software stack from bootloader to application services: storage health, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, security hardening, and field incident investigation. When something goes wrong on a production aircraft, your team is the one that figures out why and ships the fix.

This is a site-based role; employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five-day workweek.

  
  
**The day-to-day**  
  
  

- Software engineering as part of an agile development team

- Actively design and drive software architecture involving a Linux-based operating system with custom support applications involving REST, HW interfaces, ARINC controllers, cellular device controllers, and other low-level driver support

- Participate in the design, development, and testing of software products we support

- Maintain and improve our current setup for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, with a focus on applying GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Vault, and GitHub

- Improve and implement testing, both virtual and on bare metal hardware, to improve software quality by catching issues before they reach production

- Manage and maintain ZFS storage pools, disk health monitoring, and storage subsystem reliability

- Hands-on experience with Object Oriented methodology and development

- Proficiency with Linux system administration: systemd service lifecycle, boot process debugging, and log-based forensics (journalctl, syslog)

- Experience with container technologies (Docker) and/or container orchestration (Kubernetes/k3s)

- Experience investigating and debugging field incidents and production system failures, including reading system logs, correlating events across services, and driving to root cause

- Experience with developing and delivering software using CI/CD and DevOps practices

- Familiarity with common development and infrastructure tools including Git, GitHub, Docker, HashiCorp Vault, and artifact management platforms (e.g. Artifactory)

- Ability to champion modern software practices and uphold software quality standards in all phases of development

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate software architecture & design, including existing codebases

- Performing tests following a requirement-based testing approach

- Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development

- Experience working with Linux distributions and embedded optimized frameworks (e.g. AlmaLinux, OpenWRT, Yocto, Buildroot)

- Deep understanding of the bootloader and application bring-up process

- Experience orchestrating and optimizing resources (CPU, memory, disk) using tools such as cgroups and MGLRU

The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance forour customers' demanding workloads. jobs.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - Deep Learning Solutions
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in physical AI, powering self-driving cars, humanoid robots, intelligent environments, and medical devices. Our software platforms are central to this mission. We help innovators build products that save lives, enhance working conditions, and improve living standards globally!

We are hiring a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team as a technical expert focused on optimizing deep learning inference for autonomous vehicles and robotics on edge devices. This role requires a hands-on specialist who can examine model architectures at the operator level. They will locate performance issues through kernel trace analysis and evaluate modern architectures (transformers, vision-language models, diffusion/flow matching, state space models) on GPU and SOC. This work directly enhances autonomous vehicles’ and robots’ ability to perceive and respond in real time, yielding immediate benefits. The group works on some of the hardest optimization challenges in the industry, positioned at the convergence of model frameworks, compiler technology, and embedded hardware. We maintain strong collaboration with automotive OEMs, robotics colleagues, and internal hardware teams to extend edge device capabilities.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Address customer and partner optimization challenges: Engage directly with prominent automotive OEMs and robotics associates to analyze, debug, and improve their deep learning models on NVIDIA platforms. We emphasize delivering solutions rather than just recommendations.
* Own performance benchmarking: Drive efforts to achieve leading results on MLPerf Edge and industry benchmarks, as well as closed-source engagements with key partners. Define methodology, ensure reproducibility, and turn results into actionable optimization priorities.
* Evaluate emerging model architectures: Investigate new DL architectures, including vision encoders, multi-modal VLMs, hybrid SSM-Transformer backbones, diffusion/flow matching decoders, and multi-camera tokenizers, regarding compilation feasibility, memory footprint, and latency on target SOCs.
* Collaborate across teams: Work alongside our compiler, runtime, and hardware groups to link model-level insight with platform capabilities.
* Contribute to build reviews and help develop internal roadmap priorities based on real customer workload patterns.
* Represent NVIDIA externally: Share our deep learning optimization expertise at conferences, webinars, and partner events. Help elevate the broader team by bringing back insights and establishing guidelines.
* Deliver TensorRT and compiler-stack solutions for edge: Build and deploy inference solutions on Jetson, DRIVE, and GPU + ARM platforms for AV and robotics workloads. Develop Proofs of Readiness (PORs) and collaborate closely with our compiler team on Torch-TRT, MLIR-TRT, and related frameworks to bridge performance gaps.

**What we need to see:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Over 12 years working in the industry, including at least 8 years specializing in deep learning model optimization, inference engineering, or neural network compilation. Proficiency in understanding and reviewing model architectures at the operator/kernel level, not merely handling their operation, is required.
* Over 5 years of validated expertise in embedded/edge software, with experience delivering production inference solutions within power-limited, latency-sensitive deployment environments.
* Comprehensive knowledge of contemporary DL architectures: transformers, attention variants, vision encoders (ViT), multi-modal/vision-language model frameworks, as well as experience with diffusion models and/or state space models.
* Expert knowledge of GPU architecture fundamentals, CUDA, and low-level performance optimization using heterogeneous computing. Experience with TensorRT, compiler IRs, or equivalent inference optimization toolchains.
* Solid understanding of embedded operating system internals (QNX/Linux), memory management, C/C++, and embedded/system software concepts.
* Background in parallel programming (e.g., CUDA, OpenMP) and experience reasoning about memory hierarchies, data movement, and compute utilization.
* Demonstrated capability to collaborate directly with external partners and customers in a deep technical role. You solve their workload issues, identify performance problems, and provide solutions within production limitations.

**Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:**

* Experience with ML compiler frameworks (TVM, MLIR, XLA, Triton) or contributing to inference runtime development.
* Production deployment experience with autonomous vehicle perception or planning stacks, understanding the full pipeline from sensor input through trajectory output.
* Familiarity with the Physical AI model landscape: VLM + action expert architectures, end-to-end driving models, or robot foundation models.
* Contributions to MLPerf benchmarks and large-scale industry performance optimization efforts.
* Experience with automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, SOTIF) and their implications for inference system development.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer - Test Development
jobs.description:
Zoox is building a purpose-built, fully autonomous robotaxi, and every electronic control unit (ECU) on it has to be proven before it reaches a vehicle. The Autonomy Hardware Validation team in Robot Platform Verification & Validation runs the design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) testing that shows our ECUs meet their requirements across temperature, power, vibration, EMC and lifetime stress.

As a Hardware Engineer on our Test Development team, you will be the hands-on engineer who gets testing done in our Foster City labs. You will build test setups and automation, run tests, and help find the root cause of failures. You will move between projects as needs shift, including next-generation vehicle platforms, production validation for our current robotaxi, and cold-weather qualification. You will use AI tools and automation to build and run tests faster.

### **In this role, you will:**

Build, debug and maintain test setups for vehicle ECUs, including fixtures, test carts, harnesses, fault injection racks, power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition and thermal chambers.

Run electrical, environmental and reliability tests in our Foster City labs and at local test labs, and document the results clearly.  
Write test automation and tools in Python, and use AI tools to review specifications and test procedures, synthesize results and speed up test development.

Support root cause analysis of test failures with validation, design, firmware and supplier quality engineers, and track issues to closure in Jira.

Add capacity where it’s needed most, working with validation leads to turn their validation plans into working test setups and procedures.

### **Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in hardware test, hardware validation or electrical engineering, and a BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs and data acquisition systems.
* Experience building or modifying test setups such as harnesses, fixtures or instrumentation, and reading schematics to debug board-level issues.
* Working proficiency in Python for test automation or data analysis.
* Comfortable using AI tools to review documents, synthesize information and build test tooling, and checking their output critically.
* Experience with fault injection, hardware-in-the-loop or automated test equipment for electronics.
* Experience with automotive validation standards such as ISO 16750, CISPR 25 or ISO 11452, including EMC or cold-weather testing.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Agentic Development for Safety-Critical Systems
jobs.description:
The software behind autonomous vehicles, medical robots, and humanoids has to do more than work—it has to earn the trust of the people who depend on it. NVIDIA platforms help bring these machines into the world, and the correctness, security, and reliability of their underlying systems software can have real human consequences. Producing software at this level requires rare systems expertise, painstaking validation, and disciplined engineering across every subsystem. We are building a new kind of agentic engineering system to make that rigor repeatable: translating precise specifications into production-ready C/C++ and Rust software, continuously challenging and validating the result, and producing the evidence engineers need to understand why it is ready to ship.

NVIDIA is seeking a deeply technical engineering manager to lead the core team building this capability. You will combine AI agents, systems engineering, deterministic validation, security, and functional-safety practices into a production platform. You will prove it against real driver-development work, then scale what succeeds across Graphics, Camera, Multimedia, PVA, and other DRIVE OS teams.

**What you will be doing:**

* Lead a high-impact core team building the future safety-ready agentic workflow for complex C/C++/Rust systems software and drivers.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

* With a focus on embedded software and hardware designs, collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and operations teams to establish product requirements, define technical roadmaps, and drive successful execution.
* Support spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations, troubleshooting software and ensuring critical flight systems remain functional and reliable throughout critical mission activities.

* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access and SAP eligibility
* 8+ years writing C/C++ for embedded systems, ideally in spacecraft, robotics, automotive, or other hardware that interacts with the physical world

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

**About the Role**
==================

As a member of the Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software that brings our spacecraft to life. You will tackle the hardest problems in autonomous systems and build robust software that enables reliable spacecraft operation 24/7, across every phase of a mission. You will work closely with our mission operations, GNC, and hardware teams to architect new systems, prototype ideas, and turn them into mission-critical software that ultimately flies.

Experience in the space industry is not necessary to thrive at Apex. Instead, we are looking for motivated engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, balance technical rigor with practicality, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Flight Software team is composed of three interconnected teams: high-level application software, operating system software, and embedded software. There is significant collaboration and crossover across these teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and own mission-critical software for satellite systems throughout the full software lifecycle, from initial architecture and development through deployment and operations.
* Develop rapid, iterative software to support bench and development testing, as well as robust, rigorously reviewed and validated software delivered to manufacturing and flight systems.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing of satellite components, diagnosing and resolving defects to ensure software quality, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and operations teams to establish product requirements, define technical roadmaps, and drive successful execution.
* Support spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations, troubleshooting software and ensuring critical flight systems remain functional and reliable throughout critical mission activities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* U.S. Citizenship (must possess the ability to access export-controlled data)
* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access and SAP eligibility
* 8+ years of total flight software experience
* Bachelor’s degree in CS, EE, or equivalent
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, or Rust

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience developing, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting mission-critical satellite software from prototyping through flight operations.
* Experience with real-time software on distributed hardware platforms across multiple satellite products.
* Knowledge of embedded and real-time operating systems (e.g., Embedded Linux, Yocto, Buildroot, FreeRTOS, VxWorks).
* Experience writing and debugging low-level device drivers for hardware interfaces (e.g., SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, CAN, SpaceWire).
* Familiarity with satellite communication standards and protocols (e.g., CCSDS, ECSS).
* Familiarity with networking and secure communications (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, TLS), data serialization (e.g., Protobuf, JSON, MessagePack), and encryption (e.g., AES, RSA).
* Experience translating requirements into technical solutions, defining technical roadmaps, and coordinating with cross-functional engineering teams to support project execution.
* Experience supporting spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations.
* Experience with version control, configuration management, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines for software build, deployment, and release.

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Engineer - Robot Intelligence
jobs.description:
**Lab Summary:**

The Robot Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America is a new facility dedicated to advancing the field of robotics through cutting-edge research and development. The lab's mission is to develop advanced technologies to power intelligent robotic systems capable of manipulation, navigation, and complex reasoning for a variety of high-impact application areas. To achieve this mission, the lab collaborates closely with external entities such as universities, startups, and government labs, as well as with several Samsung Product and Advanced Research labs.

**Position Summary:**

Samsung Research America is looking for a Senior Robotics Systems Engineer to own the end-to-end software architecture for our robot platform, driving technical decisions that shape how hardware and software integrate at scale. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role: you won't inherit a mature codebase—you'll *build* the foundations that make it possible.

As an early team member, you'll work directly across software teams (reasoning, dexterity, perception, simulation) to integrate their work into a cohesive platform. You'll establish the architectural patterns, engineering practices, and infrastructure that allow rapid iteration today and maintainable growth tomorrow. This includes defining component interfaces, building CI/CD pipelines, containerizing environments, and implementing package management and deployment strategies—essentially, laying the technical groundwork for a production robotics system.

Samsung's unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on AI and robotics will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience. By leveraging Samsung's vast product ecosystem to deliver novel user experiences, your work will define Samsung's future in robotics and significantly impact real-world users.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Guide cross-platform robotics software architecture, including component interfaces, dependencies, and integration across software and hardware.
* Establish practical guidelines for maintaining the codebase, including repository organization, coding standards, code reviews, testing, and documentation.
* Develop and integrate Python and C++ software within ROS/ROS2-based systems.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated integration tests for simulation and physical robots.
* Maintain Docker-based development and runtime environments across x86-64 (Intel/AMD) and ARM platforms.
* Improve software deployment, logging, and troubleshooting workflows for robot computers and shared lab systems.
* Support reproducible AI development environments and cloud-based training workflows in collaboration with researchers.

**Required Skills:**

* MS degree in CS/EE/Robotics, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
* 5+ years of experience conducting state-of-the-art robotics R&D
* Proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and maintaining Linux-based software.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2 and hands-on integration with robotics hardware.
* Experience designing software components and defining clear interfaces within complex systems.

jobs.title: Sr. Sensor Hardware Engineer, Sensor Fusion
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The best rides feel effortless and rejuvenating. The cabin is prepared for you before you notice: the freshness of the air, the atmosphere, the temperature, and the humidity. The vehicle seems to know when you need warming up, when you are heating up, when you are feeling unwell, and when you are ready to rest. None of it happens because someone pressed a button. It happens because the car quietly senses how its passengers are doing and responds.

Think of automatic climate control, or air recirculation that reacts to what is in the air outside. We are building the next generation of that technology, to go with Tesla's industry-leading FSD vehicles.

Passengers never tell a vehicle how they feel, and no single sensor tells the whole story. Body heat, comfort, and drowsiness show up across many signals, and the vehicle understands them best when a well-chosen set of sensors works together.

As a sensor fusion hardware engineer on the Sensing Hardware Team, you will design that set. You'll decide which sensors the vehicle needs, where they go, and how their signals come together. Then you'll build prototypes, study the data, and refine the suite until it is as simple, robust, and affordable as it can be. You'll work closely with the algorithm team, and you're welcome to shape the algorithms yourself.

As FSD frees people from the wheel, the ride itself becomes the product. You'll own a focused part of it, from first prototype to high-volume production, on one of the most visible products in the world.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own your subsystem end to end, from requirements through production, and be accountable for how it performs in the field
* Architect the sensor suite for passenger comfort and state: choose sensing principles, quantity, and placement, and decide where signals are combined
* Choose sensors with data: instrument prototypes with candidate sensors, analyze what each one adds, and cut to the smallest suite that meets the goal
* **Electrical:** design and build sensor prototypes, including schematics, PCB layout, low-noise analog front-ends, and bring-up
* **Mechanical:** design sensor housings, mounting, and interior integration in CAD, working with HVAC and design teams
* **Software and algorithms:** collect and analyze multi-sensor data, and design and validate fusion algorithms with the algorithm team
* Run test campaigns with people and in vehicles, and turn the results into clear hardware decisions
* Work with suppliers and manufacturing to take the design from prototype to production

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in related field or equivalent experience
* A proven record of building a feature or product from the ground up and taking it to commercial production
* Hands-on sensor hardware experience in any domain, such as thermal, climate, air or gas, optical, MEMS, biometric, wearable, medical, consumer, industrial, appliance, or robotics, and the curiosity to learn a new one
* Experience combining multiple sensors and showing that the combination beats any one of them
* Strong PCB and analog design, with working knowledge of CAD and mechanical integration
* Strong data analysis (Python, MATLAB, or similar), with comfort using statistical or machine-learning methods
* Familiarity with common cabin and environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, VOCs) and how people affect them, plus the basics of human thermal comfort
* Clear communication, sound judgment with incomplete information, and the ability to bring people along with data

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$100,000 - $354,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience; OR Master's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in panel design SW EPLAN or equivalent

* Hands-on experience in testing with high-voltage testing procedures and associated safety protocols
* Strong working knowledge of branch protection coordination, wire sizing, and power conversion device integration
* Experience managing third-party panel fabrication vendors through design, build, and acceptance phases
* Familiarity with the SW including PLM (e.g. Arena or Team Center), product development SW (e.g. JIRA) and requirement management tools (e.g. JAMA)

jobs.title: Software Engineer (High Performance/Distributed Computing)
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Company Overview**

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Spacecraft Mission Software Engineer** is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own Ground Segment Services:** Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.
* **Mission Control Interfaces:** Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.
* **Simulation and Test Automation:** Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.
* **Build the Mission Platform***:* Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.
* **Deployments Across Environments:** Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
* 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - AI Security to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in San Jose, CA, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Engineering department. We are building security products that enable organizations to adopt AI applications and agents safely and at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of complex engineering challenges, build secure and scalable systems, and raise the technical bar through hands-on execution and collaboration.

* You are driven by innovation. You possess a deep curiosity for how systems work and are energized by solving technical challenges at the cutting edge of AI security.

* 5+ years of software-engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex production systems
* Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and Python, with deep expertise in systems engineering, security engineering, and backend platforms

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team of engineers and researchers to work on exciting projects that have significant impact, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, iOS Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build innovative application experiences
* Implement custom user interfaces using latest programming techniques and technologies
* Analyze and optimize code for quality, efficiency, and performance, and provide feedback to peers during code reviews
* Set direction and goals for teams, lead major initiatives, provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, and help onboard new team members
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt
* Work on a variety of coding languages and technologies
* Establish ownership of components, features, or systems with expert end-to-end understanding

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building maintainable and testable code bases, including API design and unit testing techniques
* Shipped at least one large-scale product to production, supporting millions of active users
* 2+ years of experience building complex applications for the iPhone or iPad using Objective-C/C++/Swift with the iOS SDK and other frameworks
* Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are seeking a curious, motivated Systems Engineer II to support the implementation of end-to-end power subsystem solutions, including supporting the delivery of power hardware and operations. As a systems engineer, you will be involved in all phases of the mission life cycle including technical concept development, hardware implementation, delivery, and operations. A systems engineer is highly motivated and creative with the ability to oversee, balance and integrate technical and program-related issues in an end-to-end manner to ensure that the total system satisfies the project and mission requirements.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

* Develop and manage power system and electrical system requirements.
* Develop and execute V&V plans on JPL lead projects/missions.
* Develop power system architectures and power subsystem definition on new mission proposals.
* Perform power system sizing & resource management.
* Develop and document electrical interfaces across a spacecraft to ensure a self-compatible, robust design implementation and to support the fabrication of flight harnesses.
* Work effectively with power designers in defining optimum architectures.
* Perform architectural trades to optimize systems across technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
* Develop grounding diagrams in support of a compliant EMI/EMC approach.
* Produce detailed, complex, and accurate design products in support of hardware development and to document the as-built configuration.
* Present complex power system concepts to different levels of line management and project teams.
* Understand and follow standards for power and electrical systems engineering architecture, design, and execution including clear expectations for quality.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**Company Overview**

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

**SENIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER**

**Designing next-gen gaming for fighter pilots. Except the jet is real, the G's are real, and the mission is real.**

Red 6 is a startup doing something that's never been done: bringing fully immersive 3D synthetic worlds into real aircraft in real flight. Pilots see the actual sky around them, with realistic adversaries, wingmen, terrain, and tankers layered into their view in real time. It replaces decades-old training methods that depend on costly live aircraft or ground simulators. Warfighters get more realistic, repeatable training at a fraction of the cost, and they show up to the fight better prepared.

We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer that is excited to join a growing team and bringing a product to life.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* You'll support the creation of next generation real-time hardware for a first-of-its-kind airborne augmented reality system.
* Technically challenging electrical designs including power systems, FPGAs, high speed communication buses, and embedded computer systems.
* Test systems to ensure the product design meets all performance, quality, and reliability requirements.

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking an experienced Optical Systems Engineer with expertise in lasers, optical systems, and hands-on laboratory development to mature advanced optical technologies from early-stage R&D prototypes into robust, field-deployable systems. You'll combine your strong technical knowledge of laser systems, optical architectures, opto-mechanical integration, alignment, controls, and optical measurements with the ability to lead engineers and technicians through system development, integration, testing, and transition to production. This position serves as a critical bridge between R&D and engineering and product development, translating emerging technologies into reliable, manufacturable, maintainable, and field-ready systems with progressively higher Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs). The successful candidate will work directly in the laboratory, troubleshoot complex optical systems, develop experimental methods, guide technical teams, and establish processes for transitioning research concepts into operational systems across Laboratory, Engineering, R&D, and Product and Field environments.

  

**What You'll Work On:**

* Lead the design, integration, characterization, and testing of complex optical and laser systems.
* Define system architectures, requirements, specifications, and performance metrics.
* Develop test configurations, and verification methods.
* Troubleshoot and improve optical subsystems and integrated systems with R&D team
* Translate research results into engineering requirements and development plans.
* Mature prototypes from laboratory demonstrations through engineering development and field deployment.
* Assess performance, reliability, manufacturability, maintainability, and deployment readiness.
* Identify technical risks and establish mitigation strategies.
* Lead design reviews, verification planning, acceptance testing, and technology transfer.
* Provide technical direction to engineers, scientists, technicians, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Assign tasks, set priorities, and coordinate resources with the technical director.
* Establish best practices for optical design, testing, documentation, configuration management, and integration.
* Convert mission requirements into measurable subsystem specifications.
* Collaborate with electrical, RF, mechanical, software, firmware, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Apply design-for-reliability, manufacturability, and maintainability principles.
* Support qualification, reliability, calibration, acceptance testing, deployment, and field troubleshooting.
* Create system specifications, interface-control documents, test procedures, alignment guides, troubleshooting guides, and verification documentation.
  

Join us. The world can't wait.

  

**You Have:**

* 10+ years of experience developing optical, laser, photonic, or electro-optical systems
* Experience with optical alignment, characterization, troubleshooting, and integration
* Experience with photodiodes or APDs, optical power measurement, spectroscopy, beam characterization, and optical noise measurement
* Experience with fiber-optic and free-space optical systems
* Experience transitioning experimental prototypes into mature engineering systems or products
* Experience leading and collaborating with engineers, scientists, and technicians in laboratory and system-engineering environments
* Knowledge of laser linewidth, frequency and power stability, frequency and intensity noise or RIN, mode behavior, and wavelength stability

* Experience with atomic, quantum, spectroscopy, sensing, or photonic systems.

* Experience in government, defense, aerospace, or other high-reliability environments
* Experience with Pound–Drever–Hall (PDH) and offset phase locking
* Experience in continuous-wave and ultrastable lasers, frequency stabilization, linewidth and frequency-noise reduction, RIN, beam delivery, optical modulation, fiber optics, nonlinear optics, and optical detection
* Doctorate degree in an optical engineering, photonics, physics, or electrical engineering field

We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

**How We Operate:** Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

**Who We're Looking For:** Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You'll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn't feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

* Contribute to the design and development of Albedo's VLEO spacecraft, driving system-level architecture, requirements definition, interface management, and technical trade studies from early mission development through on-orbit operations

* Develop, analyze, and maintain critical spacecraft performance budgets, including pointing accuracy, power, thermal, and data throughput, to inform design decisions and validate system performance
* Support spacecraft integration, verification, and testing, including functional, performance, and environmental testing, troubleshooting, and post-test analysis
* Own and maintain system requirements, interface documentation, and verification traceability, ensuring technical consistency across spacecraft platforms and missions
* Identify and resolve system-level technical challenges and integration risks, particularly those unique to VLEO operations, including atmospheric drag, atomic oxygen exposure, and high-precision pointing requirements
* Partner with customers, payload providers, and vendors to define technical interfaces, align requirements, and support successful mission execution
* Help shape and scale Albedo's systems engineering processes with opportunities to influence spacecraft design decisions and own systems engineering execution across the full mission lifecycle

### **Your Ideal Skills and Experience:**

* Familiarity with spacecraft subsystems (avionics, power, thermal, GNC, payload) and how they interact at the system level
* Experience developing and running system level analysis and test to meet mission objectives
* Exposure to integration and test campaigns: environmental testing, functional testing, or cross-subsystem bring-up
* Familiarity with modeling tools (e.g., MATLAB, Simulink, or Python-based frameworks) and an interest in expanding simulation skills
* Strong organizational and communication skills with attention to detail
* Curiosity and eagerness to learn, with the drive to take ownership of problems and deliver results in a fast-moving environment
* Regularly uses AI tools as essential leverage to accelerate work, improve clarity, and multiply output
