jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer – Safety & Reliability
jobs.description:
**The future of aerospace and defense starts here.**

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major is seeking a **Staff Systems Engineer** within the SMS Systems Engineering Team to creatively drive safety, reliability, and risk management solutions for our propulsion systems. This role is responsible for the safe design and operation of our rocket motors to ensure they meet the highest standards of performance and safety. You will work cross-functionally with systems engineering, mission operations, design, test, manufacturing, and program teams to develop robust product safety strategies and ensure successful mission execution. You will also own the relationship between Ursa Major and DoD Safety Review Boards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement mission assurance processes to ensure product reliability, safety, and performance

* Own the Ursa Major relationship with branch specific Weapon Safety Boards and assist with authoring & presenting motor qualification plans & test reports for WSESRB, JSWRB, etc. approval

* Own technical inputs to Interim Hazard Classification (IHC) & Final Hazard Classification (FHC) planning, execution and approval for motor shipments and fielding

* Establish and maintain best practices for risk register management across different programs and products; present both internally and externally as required

* Work with design and product teams to find creative and efficient solutions to engineering challenges that ultimately reduce product risk; develop system safety requirements for product design

* Perform system-level failure assessments (Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Hazard Analysis (FHA), etc.) to inform system design and risk tracking

* Establish plans for end-to-end product lifecycle, including but not limited to any required handling restrictions, demilitarization, and disposal

* Assist with flight test range safe execution planning

* Lead failure investigations

* Perform reliability assessments for motor products

* Other duties as assigned

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field

* 8+ years of experience in system safety, mission assurance, or systems engineering

* Experience with solid rocket motors, ignition systems, propulsion systems, launch vehicles, or defense aerospace programs

* Experience with risk analysis methods (FMEA, FHA, probabilistic risk assessment)

* Experience with aerospace industry standards (MIL-STD-882, etc.)

* Experience working with cross-functional teams, interfacing with internal/external customers

* Demonstrated ability to break down complex problems, strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced development environment

* **This position requires that the employee be eligible and maintain eligibility for a Secret Clearance**

  

**Desired Experience**

* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline

* Comprehensive knowledge of systems engineering processes, including requirements development and verification

* Hands-on experience with testing and validation of high-performance hardware

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems, Multi-Domain Operations, and Missile Defense Integration Business Unit (BU), Advanced Programs group has an exciting career opportunity for an **Algorithms Development Software Engineer Lead – Level 3 or 4** to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. Our team is chartered with providing innovative technologies to develop, design, and produce optimized product lines across multiple customers while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter. We are excited for you to join our team working on challenging and diverse assignments in a collaborating research and development environment. **The position is located on-site in Boulder, CO. Boulder is nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, and only 25 miles from downtown Denver.**

**Position Overview:**

As an Algorithms Developer / Software Engineer Lead – Level 3 or 4, you will be responsible for leading a team of 2-4 people. We are a smaller team of ~15 people working on cutting edge missile tracking and interception capabilities. Designing, developing, testing, documenting, debugging software and mathematical algorithms used to identify different threats. This fast-paced and cutting-edge research and development environment will rely on your familiarity with modern software practices, physics principles, and mathematics.

**Essential Functions:**

  

* Performance analysis of tracking and state estimation algorithms
* Tool and prototype development using modern C++ v20+
* Algorithm defect tracking and resolution
* Analysis tool development (Python)
* Technical documentation input as required
* Input to customer-facing presentations
* Collaborate with Chief Architect, Program Management and Team Lead peers to set technical vision for the tracker team
* Provide tasking and mentorship to 2-4 Tracker team members

The selected candidate should thrive in a fast-paced work environment with high expectations, significantly diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels.

**This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on qualifications listed below.**

This requisition may be filled at either a Principal Software Engineer – Level 3 or a Sr. Principal Software Engineer – Level 4.

**Basic Qualifications:**

**Job Description**

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Robotics Software Engineer** at UL Research Institutes , based in our Skokie, IL office.

  

The **Robotics Software Engineer** will design and maintain the software infrastructure that connects laboratory automation, robotics, scientific instruments, data systems, and decision tools into integrated autonomous workflows. The role will work closely with scientists, automation engineers, robotics engineers, and data scientists to build scalable, reliable software for experimental orchestration and closed-loop research.

  

**UL Research Institutes:**

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Pursuing materials that will help produce transformational safety breakthroughs, MDRI harnesses the power of advanced computing and high-throughput experimental methods to create innovative materials that will produce resilience for a sustainable future and protect individual and societal health.

The selected engineer will apply practical electrical engineering experience across RF and radar performance assessment, digital signal processing, target identification parameters, electrical power interfaces, thermal and environmental stability, built-in test, diagnostics, reliability metrics, and system-level verification. The ASR Group® family of companies make up the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar. The companies produce a full line of grocery, industrial, foodservice and specialty sweetener products. Across North America, ASR Group® companies operate five sugar refineries, located in California, Maryland, Louisiana, Canada and Mexico. In Europe, ASR Group® companies operate sugar refineries in the United Kingdom, Portugal, and, with a joint venture partner, Italy. The companies also farm sugarcane and own sugar mills in Mexico and Belize. The ASR Group® portfolio includes the leading brands Domino®, C&H®, Florida Crystals®, Redpath®, Tate & Lyle®, Lyle's®, Sidul® and Whitworths®. ASR Group® companies also produce and market Tellus®, a single-use, compostable tableware and foodservice product made from plant fibers, including sugarcane.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Senior Controls Engineer is the refinery’s technical authority for automation, instrumentation, industrial networking, and process control systems. This role ensures reliable, secure, and sustainable control infrastructure that supports production, quality, safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence.

The position partners with Corporate Controls Engineering, leads controls lifecycle and modernization strategies, and advances the site from reactive maintenance toward preventive, condition-based, and predictive practices.

  

**DETAILED ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as the site technical authority for controls, instrumentation, industrial networks, and process automation.

* Lead system implementations, upgrades, and modifications in accordance with company, ISA, functional safety, cybersecurity, and hazardous-area requirements.

* Establish and govern programming, alarm management, architecture, documentation, testing, validation, and cybersecurity standards.

* Develop and execute a multi-year controls and automation roadmap aligned with operational, maintenance, and capital priorities.

* Manage the lifecycle of PLCs, HMIs, historians, servers, operating systems, networks, instrumentation, and automation hardware.

* Identify obsolescence and criticality risks; develop modernization, replacement, stocking, replenishment, and vendor-supported spare-parts strategies.

* Use plant data and analytics to identify degradation, improve reliability, and develop asset-health KPIs and dashboards.

* Lead root-cause investigations for controls and instrumentation failures and implement sustainable corrective actions.

* Partner with IT, OT, Maintenance, Procurement, and Corporate Controls Engineering to improve system performance, cybersecurity, data access, and asset visibility.

jobs.title: Director, Embedded Engineering
jobs.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

Bevi is looking for a Director of Embedded Engineering to lead the team that builds the electronics and firmware at the heart of every Bevi machine. From the boards that drive our pumps, valves, sensors and chillers, to the firmware and embedded Linux/Android platform that keep thousands of connected machines running reliably in the field, this team makes the hardware come alive.

You will own and manage the electrical and firmware engineers who design, bring up, and sustain our products, and you'll be the person who makes sure the boards, the code, and the system architecture fit together as one platform across our current fleet and our next generation of machines. This is a technical and people leadership role in equal measure. You'll set the embedded architecture and engineering standards, and you'll build and lead a team that needs both a strong technical leader and a strong people manager.

This role reports to the VP of Engineering and sits on the engineering leadership team. It will operate in close partnership with Mechanical, Software, Systems, Quality, Manufacturing, and our contract manufacturing and design partners. As Bevi's product portfolio grows, there's room for this role to grow with it.

### **Your Day to Day**

### **Embedded Architecture & Technical Direction**

* Own the embedded system architecture across Bevi's products: the multi-board electrical design, the single-board computer and SoM platform, the microcontroller firmware, and the interfaces that tie them together.
* Set the technical roadmap for embedded, including platform consolidation, next-generation compute and control boards, and reuse across product lines so each new machine is not a clean-sheet effort.
* Make the hard tradeoff calls on reliability, cost, component availability, and speed of development, and bring a clear point of view to the engineering leadership team.
* Stay hands-on enough to review schematics, layouts, and firmware architecture, and to dig into a field failure with the team when it matters.

### **New Product Development & Sustaining**

* Lead EE and FW execution on new product programs from concept and prototype through board bring-up, design verification, regulatory certification, and production release.
* Own the health of embedded systems in the field: firmware releases, fleet diagnostics, remote management, and fast root-cause analysis and corrective action when issues reach customers.
* Drive component lifecycle management, second sourcing, and design changes that protect supply continuity and margin for products already in production.
* Partner with Quality and Manufacturing on test strategy, end-of-line testing, and test fixtures so what we design can be built and verified at scale.

### **Team Leadership**

* Manage and grow a team of Electrical Engineers and Firmware Engineers, giving each discipline what it needs to do great work while keeping both aligned to one platform.
* Hire, coach, and develop engineers on technical depth and career growth, and build a team that can scale with Bevi's product roadmap.
* Build clear ownership, documentation, and knowledge sharing so critical systems never depend on a single person.

### **Cross-Functional & Partner Leadership**

* Work directly with Mechanical, Software, and Systems Engineering to define system requirements and protect design integrity from concept through production.
* Manage external design partners, contract manufacturers (domestic and overseas), and component suppliers. Own design for manufacturability, NPI handoff, and production support for electronics at volume, including test coverage, yield, and corrective actions.
* Represent embedded in program reviews, design reviews, and risk reviews, making sure embedded constraints shape decisions early rather than surfacing late.
* Own embedded regulatory and compliance readiness (e.g., UL, FCC, CE/UKCA, EMC) in partnership with Compliance and Quality.

### **Process & Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and enforce standards for schematic and layout reviews, firmware code reviews, version control, release management, and documentation.
* Build out hardware-in-the-loop testing, unit test frameworks, build automation, and CI/CD for firmware.
* Champion the use of AI across the embedded team to accelerate design, code generation, testing, and debugging, and define how we integrate it responsibly into our workflows.

### **Requirements**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; MS is a plus.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The Space Imaging team is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join the team. The Space Imaging team is responsible for all aspects of spaceborne EO/IR system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define the electrical architecture of space-qualified EO/IR sensor payloads — including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, EMI/EMC protection, and high-speed communication interfaces — build and test prototypes, and mature designs into flight hardware products. As needed, you will also lead small teams of engineers from concept through system definition and development.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Electrical Architecture: Define and own the electrical architecture for EO/IR sensor payload assemblies, including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, grounding/bonding schemes, and communication interfaces.
* Power Electronics Design: Design, analyze, and test isolated power conversion, EMI filtering, inrush current limiting, and over-voltage/reverse-polarity protection circuitry for low-voltage DC payload power systems.
* Interface & Harness Design: Select connectors, define pin assignments, perform wire/cable and component derating analyses, and establish shielding, bonding, and isolation schemes to meet EMI/EMC requirements.
* Communication Interfaces: Design and support high-speed Ethernet (10GbE) and discrete I/O (RS-422, I2C, SPI) interfaces between sensor electronics and host avionics.
* EMC/ESD: Support EMI/EMC qualification testing (MIL-STD-461/464), and ESD protection design.
* Radiation Compliance: Radiation-tolerant (TID/SEU) component selection for space and tactical environments.
* Parts Stress & Reliability Analysis: Perform EEE parts stress/derating analyses and support hybrid microelectronics selection to ensure reliable operation across mission life.
* Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborate with firmware, mechanical, optical, and systems engineers to integrate electrical designs into sensor payload assemblies, including bring-up and verification testing.
* Testing and Validation: Develop and execute test procedures using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, network analyzers, EMI test gear) to validate designs against functional and performance requirements.

* Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field is typically required.
* Experience: 8+ years of experience designing power, interface, or mixed-signal electronics for space, airborne, or other harsh-environment defense systems.
* Power Electronics & Circuit Design: Experience designing isolated DC/DC power conversion, EMI filters, and transient/over-voltage protection circuits for low-voltage DC systems.
* EMI/EMC Standards: Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 (or equivalent) EMI/EMC design and test methods.
* Interface/Harness Design: Experience with connector selection, pin/harness definition, and parts/wire derating analysis (e.g., per MIL-HDBK-1547A or equivalent).
* Debugging Skills: Strong hardware debugging skills using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic/protocol analyzers).
* Analysis Tools: Proficiency with schematic capture/circuit simulation tools and worst-case stress/derating analysis.
* US Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience designing radiation-tolerant electronics and performing TID/SEU analysis for space systems
* Experience with high-speed digital/communication interfaces (10GbE, SERDES) and signal integrity analysis
* Familiarity with machine-vision/sensor communication protocols (e.g., GigE Vision)
* Experience with hybrid microelectronics packaging (MIL-PRF-38534) or similar high-reliability component standards
* PCB layout experience (e.g., Altium, Cadence) for mixed-signal or RF boards
* Familiarity with electro-optical/infrared sensor payload electronics (detector bias/readout, cryocooler drive electronics)
* Familiarity with embedded Linux/firmware interfaces to support electronics bring-up

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

**Position Summary**

Support the definition, documentation, integration, and verification of system behavior for the ARIES (Autonomous Robotics & Imaging Ecosystem for Stroke) program, a multi-institutional, federally funded advanced medical technology initiative combining robotics, imaging, AI, autonomous control systems, neurovascular devices, and safety-critical software. This role works closely with system architects, software engineers, electrical engineers, robotics engineers, and external consortium partners to translate architectural concepts into clear system specifications, especially for interfaces, component communication, system states, and expected behavior during interface use.

The Systems Engineer will help define system state machines, document how components shall interact under nominal and fault conditions, create verification test cases, and implement tests in simulation and hardware environments to confirm that the system adheres to its specifications.

As a **Systems Engineer** you will be responsible for:

* Collaborate with system architects and engineering teams to translate system architecture into clear requirements, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Define and maintain interface specifications that describe data exchange, commands, status information, error handling, timing expectations, and communication behavior between system components.
* Specify system behavior when interfaces are used, including nominal workflows, degraded modes, fault conditions, recovery behavior, and safe-state transitions.
* Define and document system state machines, including allowed states, transitions, triggers, guards, outputs, and expected behavior across interacting components.
* Create, review, and maintain verification test cases that demonstrate whether system behavior, interfaces, and communication between components meet the defined specifications.
* Implement and execute test cases in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and real hardware environments to verify that components and integrated systems adhere to their specifications.
* Coordinate interface and behavior specifications with external consortium partners to ensure that partner components, internal components, and communication pathways remain compatible and aligned.

**Required experience** to have for the success of this role:

* Demonstrated experience in systems engineering for complex technical systems, preferably involving robotics, distributed software, real-time control, medical technology, or safety-critical environments.
* Strong experience creating technical documentation, system specifications, interface descriptions, requirements, and verification artifacts.
* Experience defining system behavior across interfaces, including command flows, status reporting, component communication, fault handling, recovery behavior, and safe-state behavior.
* Practical experience with state machines, workflow logic, system modes, and behavior modeling for interconnected hardware and software components.
* Experience developing and executing test cases in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, or real hardware setups to verify requirements, interfaces, and system behavior.

**Preferred Experience**

* At least 3 years with systems engineering methodologies, interface management, requirements decomposition, behavior modeling, verification planning, traceability, and design reviews.
* At least 3 years supporting complex cyber-physical systems, autonomous robotic systems, medical robotic platforms, image-guided therapy systems, or distributed control systems.
* At least 2 years with medical device development, regulated product development, or safety-critical software and hardware integration.
* Experience with advanced healthcare technologies involving robotics, imaging, AI/ML, autonomous systems, or neurovascular applications.
* Familiarity with requirements management, interface documentation, system modeling, test management, issue tracking, version control, and simulation or hardware-in-the-loop test tools is preferred. Examples may include Helix ALM, Polarion, Jira, Git, and related engineering collaboration platforms.
* Familiarity coordinating technical specifications with external partners, subcontractors, or consortium members to ensure component compatibility and integration readiness.
* Familiarity with federally funded programs or with multi-institutional research collaborations.

**Education Required**

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
We have an opportunity for a hands-on, detail-driven person to join our forward thinking team as an Electrical Engineer I. In this role you will work directly under our Senior Electrical Engineer, supporting electrical design across both our standard production line and our custom team. Your focus will be the work that keeps our electrical documentation accurate and our builds clean; drawing revisions, engineering change orders, legacy drawing modernization, BOM accuracy, panel evaluation, and floor wiring support. You will be brought into real projects for industry leading clients, reviewed closely, and given progressively more scope as your judgment develops, all with the latest technology and the full support of engineering, manufacturing, and service.

***Who we are***

We are an innovative manufacturing company that focuses on growth and technology and enjoys having fun along the way. We have built an extensive and loyal customer base spanning aerospace, electronics, and automotive with significant involvement in the global expansion of the battery industry. We work with many of the major tech companies as well as brands such as Tesla, Rivian, Lucid, Meta, Google, and Harley Davidson.

***Primary responsibilities***

* Execute redlines and revisions to wiring diagrams in SolidWorks Electrical, following all AES, ANSI & IEC standards.
* Generate and execute engineering change orders, and verify each change propagates completely; drawings, BOM, ERP, and the active job folder.
* Update and correct legacy drawing packages: terminal labeling, wire numbering, revision data, and callout accuracy brought to current AES standards.
* Populate and verify electrical content on the Bill of Material against customer specifications and system specifics.
* Support Electrical Load Analyses (ELAs) on single, dual, and 3 phase applications; verify FLA figures against component nameplate and manufacturer data.
* Evaluate existing and legacy control panels, document as-built configuration, identify deviations from print, and recommend replacement or updated components.
* Support control panel and electrical device layout, including dimensional layout, wire duct and routing strategy, and component placement for serviceability.
* Maintain voltage variant documentation (208V vs 480V) so drawings, BOMs, and component selections stay consistent across configurations.
* Support cable and wire harness design, including pinouts, connector selection, and routing documentation.
* Assist in debugging floor wiring issues with electricians; fault tracing, wire ID mismatches, continuity issues, and terminal errors, and document findings so the same issue does not recur.
* Participate in Electrical Peer Reviews as a contributing reviewer, commenting on schematics, load calculations, and component selections.
* Verify manufacturer part data, and work with purchasing for part availability and cost, including identifying alternates when a component is constrained.
* Support compliance verification against IEC, NEC, CE, and IPC requirements, including UL 508A & UL 61010.
* Create and maintain work procedures and floor-usable wiring documentation — terminal overviews, routing references, and visual aids, not schematics alone.
* Provide electrical troubleshooting support to service technicians and customers.

***Required Experience***

* Two or more years of SolidWorks Electrical. Comparable 2D electrical CAD with a demonstrated ability to convert will be considered.
* Four or more years of electrical design experience in industrial machinery, control panels, or equipment manufacturing.
* Two or more years of cable design experience.
* Working knowledge of 3 phase power distribution and low voltage control circuits.
* PLC and control component knowledge; able to read logic, identify I/O, and explain what a component does and why it is there.
* Sound component selection reasoning; able to justify why a given sensor, switch, or transducer is right for an application.
* Knowledge of electrical codes including NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 79, and UL 508A.
* This position requires a hands-on approach. Comfortable in the panel, on the floor, and behind a meter, not documentation only.
* Great attention to detail. Wiring and documentation accuracy directly drive our test first pass yield.
* Great communication skills across engineering, operations, service, and purchasing.
* Good mechanical aptitude and knowledge.
* A four year degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent industry experience.

***Preferred Skills***

* SolidWorks Mechanical knowledge.
* Solidworks Electrical 3D knowledge.
* Experience building industrial machine and control panel assemblies.
* Exposure to automated panel build machinery (automated wire cut, prep, and labeling systems).
* Familiarity with refrigeration system components — compressors, valves, pressure and temperature sensors, defrost and safety circuits.
* Familiarity with DFM and serviceability concepts.
* Familiarity with current electrical engineering trends.
* An innovative mindset and positive attitude.

***What do we offer:***

* A truly collaborative environment with a Senior Management Team where you will help to shape the future of the Company.
* Direct mentorship from a senior electrical engineer, with a defined path from support work to full design ownership.
* Competitive salary and benefits.
* Tuition reimbursement.
* A casual dog friendly work environment with a small company atmosphere! Check out our website and facebook for a look at our company culture and our four legged team members.

jobs.title: Senior BMS Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Senior BMS Hardware Design Engineer leads the design, development, integration, and validation of Battery Management System (BMS) hardware for advanced energy storage and electrification applications. This role owns technical direction and design decisions for assigned BMS programs, spanning requirements definition and architecture through schematic design, PCB layout, hardware bring-up, bench and system-level validation, and production release. The Senior Engineer serves as a technical authority on lithium-ion battery pack electronics, resolves complex system-level failures, and drives design maturity to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable operation. This role partners closely with embedded software, systems, cell, manufacturing, and test engineering teams, mentors engineers, and establishes design standards and best practices across the BMS group.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the design and architecture of BMS hardware, including cell sensing, protection, control, and interface circuitry.
* Develop, review, approve, and release electrical schematics, component selections, and electrical interfaces for battery packs.
* Lead Printed Circuit Board (PCB) layout reviews and board-level hardware bring-up, including initial power-on, electrical measurements, debugging, and rework.
* Direct the integration of BMS hardware with battery cells, contactors, sensors, and pack-level components.
* Define and document BMS hardware requirements, design specifications, and interface control documents in coordination with systems engineering.
* Conduct design risk assessments, including Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), tolerance stack-up, and worst-case circuit analysis.
* Evaluate component technologies and serve as technical lead in supplier design reviews and component selection decisions.
* Define and execute the BMS hardware validation strategy, including functional verification, protection feature testing, and fault-injection testing.
* Develop, review, and approve electrical and functional test plans, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability to verify BMS performance.
* Perform signal integrity, power integrity, and noise immunity evaluations.
* Direct environmental, endurance, abuse, and fault-case testing, and interpret results to drive design decisions.
* Lead root-cause analysis and failure analysis of complex BMS hardware, interface, and pack-level issues, and drive corrective actions through validation and closure.
* Diagnose and resolve interface issues between embedded software and BMS hardware, including Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC), Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI), Inter-Integrated Circuit (I2C), Controller Area Network (CAN), and General Purpose Input/Output (GPIO) interfaces.
* Partner with embedded software teams to lead hardware bring-up and system-level debug activities.
* Support development, tuning, and validation of State of Charge (SOC), State of Health (SOH), and State of Power (SOP) algorithms, and correlate model predictions with bench, system, and field test data using MATLAB/Simulink.
* Maintain complete technical records that capture design decisions, test results, validation evidence, and lessons learned for production release and future development.
* Lead cross-functional technical reviews, align engineering teams on design decisions and dependencies, and remove barriers affecting BMS program execution.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for production, manufacturing, and field issue investigations.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers, including design review feedback and development of technical skills.
* Establish and continuously improve BMS design standards, engineering processes, and best practices.
* Present technical status, design trade-offs, and recommendations to engineering leadership, program teams, and customers.
* Adhere to federal and state regulations.
* Adhere to all company policies, processes, and procedures.
* Performs other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.
* Predictable and reliable attendance.

**Position Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline; or a bachelor’s degree and two (2) years of equivalent experience in BMS, battery systems, embedded hardware or power electronics.
* Minimum of five (5) years of engineering experience in BMS, battery systems, embedded hardware, or power electronics, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading schematic design, hardware bring-up, and electrical debugging.
* Experience designing high-voltage and low-voltage battery systems and their communication interfaces.
* Demonstrated experience taking BMS or comparable electronic hardware from concept through production release.
* Experience leading BMS validation testing, fault-case analysis, and safety mechanism verification.
* Proficiency with PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, or equivalent.
* Experience in automotive, commercial vehicle, energy storage, or industrial electrification applications.
* Familiarity with SOC estimation methods such as Coulomb counting, Open Circuit Voltage (OCV) correlation, and observer-based or Kalman filter techniques.
* Working knowledge of functional safety and battery safety standards such as ISO 26262, UL 2580, UL 1973, or UN 38.3.
* Strong working knowledge of embedded interfaces such as CAN, SPI, I2C, Universal Asynchronous Receiver-Transmitter (UART), and ADCs.
* Proficiency using MATLAB/Simulink for modeling, algorithm support, and data analysis.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to travel and work flexible hours as needed (less than 10% travel on average).

* **Influences Others:** Has personal and organizational impact built on mutual trust, fairness, and honesty. Flexes their style to direct, collaborate, or empower as the situation requires.
* **Focuses on Quality:** Dri

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Bring hands-on controls expertise to a manufacturing environment where your work directly supports safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. As a Controls Engineer on third shift, you will combine real-time troubleshooting with automation improvements, equipment upgrades, and longer-term controls projects across the facility.

You will work independently on the plant floor, partner with maintenance and engineering teams, and help strengthen controls knowledge across the site. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning manufacturing processes, and seeing the impact of their work firsthand.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Program, troubleshoot, and improve Rockwell Automation PLC systems across process, packaging, and utility equipment.
* Design, program, and update Rockwell FactorySuite HMI interfaces and related controls applications.
* Diagnose day-to-day production issues and complete minor modifications to controls server systems.
* Set up and tune PID loops, and select, install, troubleshoot, and maintain instrumentation for flow, level, temperature, and weight.
* Support Rockwell communication networks and electrical hardware, including ControlLogix, Ethernet, DeviceNet, ControlNet, RIO, PowerFlex VFDs, servos, MCCs, and E3 Plus overload relays.
* Maintain electrical control programs, documentation, drawings, and plant controls standards.
* Analyze process and equipment performance data to improve product quality, operating reliability, and cost performance.
* Manage controls and automation capital projects, including equipment upgrades completed during planned outage windows.
* Train and support maintenance personnel and collaborate with engineers to share best practices and standards.
* Support electrical infrastructure maintenance, monitoring, metering, and safe plant power distribution practices.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

* Own meaningful troubleshooting and improvement work across the full facility during third shift.
* Balance hands-on plant support with automation programming, HMI updates, equipment modernization, and project work.
* Work with a range of Rockwell PLC generations and manufacturing technologies.
* Build visibility and credibility through dependable, high-impact support with fewer routine daytime meetings.
* Grow toward future shift opportunities or a Controls Lead path.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* Third-shift schedule is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., with overlap for a nightly report-out to first shift.
* Occasional travel is required.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Required Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with PLC controls, HMIs, industrial networks, and manufacturing equipment troubleshooting.
* Experience reading and interpreting electrical and control schematics, P&IDs, and technical documentation.
* Working knowledge of motors, drives, associated circuitry, and electrical machine-control technologies.
* Knowledge of applicable NEC, ANSI, OSHA, and NFPA standards.
* Ability to work independently and provide plant-wide controls support during third shift.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Five or more years of manufacturing experience with exposure to maintenance and engineering functions.
* Experience with Rockwell Automation systems, including multiple PLC generations and FactorySuite.
* Experience with PowerFlex VFDs, servos, FANUC equipment, or related automation technologies.
* Experience with power distribution systems up to 4,800 VAC, including substations, switchgear, and power-factor correction equipment.
* Experience leading controls, automation, or electrical capital projects.

**Success in This Role**

* Uses structured troubleshooting and sound judgment to identify root causes, including when an issue is not controls-related.
* Builds trust through dependable follow-through, clear communication, and a visible plant-floor presence.
* Works effectively with limited supervision while collaborating across maintenance and engineering teams.
* Organizes competing priorities and communicates technical information clearly to varied audiences.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to pair strong automation skills with hands-on plant support, bring your ambition to Post Consumer Brands. Here, you can help keep a complex manufacturing operation moving while building solutions that make a lasting difference.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer**

Elucent Medical | ***Eden Prairie, MN***

*Elucent's electromagnetic positioning system tells a surgeon exactly where the target is. You will help build the electronics behind it and keep them running, from troubleshooting boards with the operations team to testing the next-generation system.*

Department: Research and Development

Reports to: Director of Hardware Engineering

**Work location:** On-site in Eden Prairie, MN. Hands-on lab work is done in person, with flexibility outside of lab time.

**Position type**: Full time, Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week

**Pay range**: Base salary based on experience, plus an annual bonus.

**Work authorization:** US work authorization required, no sponsorship

**About Elucent Medical**

Elucent Medical is a medical device company building surgical navigation technology for cancer surgery. Its systems turn standard surgical instruments into smart tools, so surgeons can locate and remove tissue with more precision.

Elucent has about 140 people and commercial revenue, and it still moves like a small team. Quality, operations, and supply chain sit right next to engineering, so decisions get made fast.

**About the role**

This is a dual role. You will split your time between two areas, with mentoring from a senior electrical engineer and your manager.

* Operations support. Troubleshoot components at the board level on nonconforming material reports (NCMRs), do the deep research, and act as the subject matter expert for the operations team. Work with vendors to resolve issues.
* Product development. Support board and electrical system design for Elucent's next-generation platform, then characterize and test it. You will not lead the program. A senior engineer leads the electrical work and you will support it.

Day to day, you will work in an electrical lab with waveform generators, oscilloscopes, and other test equipment. Signal-to-noise is very sensitive, so a lot of the work is tracing where interference comes from. If you see a better way to do something, say so.

Supervisory responsibilities

None.

**What you will do**

* Troubleshoot electrical and board-level issues on NCMRs and support the operations team as a subject matter expert
* Work with vendors to resolve component and board issues
* Design new schematics and board layouts, and maintain the existing ones
* Characterize and test boards and systems, and run engineering studies to confirm performance
* Assemble, evaluate, and test prototypes
* Run formal verification testing and prepare test protocols, reports, and supporting documentation
* Carry out component qualifications
* Help build pilot and low rate production EnVisio systems
* Communicate status and results clearly to the project team
* Recommend improvements to the design and to how the work gets done

**What you bring**

Required

* BA, BS, or Master's degree in electrical engineering or a related field
* 2 to 3 years of electrical engineering experience. Medical device experience is a plus. Two years of EE plus one year in medical device works well.

**Experience that helps**

* Electrical systems development, troubleshooting, documentation, and testing, ideally in a regulated industry
* Hands-on experience deploying electrical systems to medical device targets
* Experience with electronics schematic capture and layout tools
* A track record of starting something on your own and finishing it

**Skills and abilities**

* Strong documentation and writing skills
* Strong verbal and written communication
* Strong knowledge of electrical development practices
* Works well with team members and functional area representatives
* Collaborates across teams and departments to hit project targets and objectives
* Generates and protects intellectual property through innovation and proper use of procedures and documentation
* Ensures compliance with company policies and procedures
* Strong knowledge of current applicable software regulations and standards

**Who will thrive here**

* A self-starter who does not wait for direction. When you get an assignment, you go find the answer and come back with what you want to do.
* Someone who likes speed. Elucent has no layers of approval. If you come from a large, hierarchical company and want this pace, we want to hear from you.
* A collaborator. There are no silos here, and people work through conflict openly and with humility.
* Someone who finishes. Activity does not count until something is done.

**What success looks like in 6 to 12 months**

▸ You are a subject matter expert on how the system works

▸ You have closed out one or two NCMRs, such as vendor issues or electrical design fixes

* Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills with a willingness to learn.
* Ability to work on-site in Rochester and/or Rush, NY, with travel to customer facilities as needed.

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands-on manufacturing, automation, controls, or instrumentation experience.
* Exposure to multiple PLC platforms or industrial communication networks.
* Creative, practical approach to engineering challenges.

***Job Code:*** ***45783***

**Job Description:**  
  
As a member of the MCC Engineering Field Test Validation Team, this engineer will contribute to the company’s success by ensuring L3Harris product and system requirements are comprehensively verified and validated with a user-focused approach across both bench-top and over-the-air operational environments. This role is responsible for planning, developing, and executing verification and validation activities for complex integrated systems, including advanced networking technologies, in representative mission and operational scenarios. Responsibilities include bench-top validation of hardware, software, and system-of-systems implementations; development of test architectures, tools, automation, and methodologies to enable rigorous product and system qualification; and identification and implementation of innovative solutions that support release readiness, often supplementing or replacing field validation where technically appropriate. The position requires thorough evaluation of system performance, interfaces, interoperability, and mission effectiveness to ensure products and systems are qualified for deployment and meet customer, program, and quality requirements.

**Essential Functions:**  
The role will have responsibilities consisting of (but not limited to):

* Designing and configuring lab-based test environments to accurately emulate operational, mission, and field conditions for product and system qualification.
* Identifying, creating, and implementing test tools, automation frameworks, scripts, and innovative validation methods to improve coverage, repeatability, efficiency, and technical rigor
* Performing integration, regression, stress, negative, and troubleshooting test activities to characterize system behavior, identify defects, and assess release readiness
* Collaborating with systems, software, and hardware engineering and field test team members to ensure bench-top validation effectively supplements or, where appropriate, replaces field validation

jobs.title: Lead Embedded Firmware & FPGA Engineer
jobs.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is seeking a Lead Embedded Firmware & FPGA Engineer to join our innovative engineering team in Youngsville, NC. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture, design, development, verification, and release of FPGA-based solutions supporting next-generation power management products. Working alongside global, cross-functional teams, you will play a key role in bringing new products to market, including advanced silicon carbide (SiC)-based three-phase power conversion systems that deliver reliable power for mission-critical applications such as data centers.

  

The expected annual salary range for this role is $105000 - $154000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Work as part of an engineering team to architect, develop, verify, test, and release FPGA-based designs in support of new product development. Collaborate with global cross-functional teams to support the launch of new products, including SiC-based three-phase power conversion systems designed to support critical loads such as data centers.
* Review product requirements and collaborate with systems, firmware, controls, power electronics, and hardware engineers to translate system-level specifications into FPGA architecture and detailed design requirements.
* Evaluate alternative FPGA architectures and implementation approaches to meet customer and product development requirements while considering performance, resource utilization, cost, reliability, and schedule.
* Design, develop, review, and maintain synthesizable RTL using Verilog, SystemVerilog, and/or VHDL.
* Develop FPGA logic for functions such as PWM generation, digital control, protection and fault management, high-speed data acquisition, sequencing, state machines, digital filtering, and processor/peripheral interfaces.
* Develop modular and reusable FPGA design components and establish effective FPGA coding and design practices.
* Develop testbenches and perform RTL simulation and functional verification to ensure designs meet functional and system requirements.
* Perform synthesis, place-and-route, static timing analysis, and timing closure using industry-standard FPGA development toolchains.
* Analyze and resolve FPGA implementation challenges related to timing, resource utilization, clock distribution, reset architecture, and clock-domain crossing.
* Design and integrate communication interfaces between FPGAs, microcontrollers, DSPs, ADCs, DACs, and other system components using interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, and parallel interfaces, as applicable.
* Support board-level bring-up, integration, and debugging of FPGA-based systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and embedded FPGA debugging tools.
* Participate in design reviews, RTL code reviews, verification reviews, and root-cause investigations.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution with 5 years of experience in embedded software or firmware development OR
* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution with 4 years of experience in embedded software or firmware development OR
* PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution with exact lab work.
* Professional experience developing synthesizable RTL using VHDL, Verilog, and/or SystemVerilog.
* Experience with FPGA design workflows including RTL development, simulation, synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware validation.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Design experience with power electronic, industrial control, energy conversion, or other real-time embedded products.
* Experience implementing digital control algorithms, PWM generation, modulation techniques and high-speed deterministic control functions in FPGA.
* Experience with FPGA development toolchains such as Intel Quartus, and ModelSim/Questa.
* Experience integrating FPGA designs with microcontrollers, DSPs, ADCs, DACs, and mixed-signal embedded systems.
* Experience implementing communication interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, and high-speed serial or parallel interfaces.
* Experience with embedded firmware development and programming in C/C++.
* Experience using hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation for system integration and validation.

**Skills:**
-----------

* Strong knowledge of digital logic design, synchronous design principles, finite-state machines, pipelining, clocking, reset architectures, and FPGA resource optimization.
* Understanding of three-phase electrical power systems and power conversion concepts is preferred.
* Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, component datasheets, interface specifications, and timing diagrams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and geographically distributed engineering teams.
* Self-motivated, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of independently driving technical activities to meet project schedules.
* Ability to work in a laboratory environment around high-voltage equipment where strict adherence to safety practices is critical.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer- Model Based Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
TDI Technologies is seeking an early- to mid-career **Systems Engineer specializing in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)** to support Navy ship design, engineering analysis, and systems integration activities at the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard. The engineer will support the development, integration, and maintenance of system models for complex shipboard Hull, Mechanical, and Electrical (HM&E) systems, with emphasis on Integrated Power Systems (IPS), electrical and mechanical systems, and control systems.

The successful candidate will collaborate with government engineers, design teams, MBSE specialists, and program stakeholders to develop system models that support design analysis, requirements development, system integration, and engineering decision-making. Responsibilities include developing system architecture and behavior models, integrating component models, maintaining requirements traceability, supporting modeling and simulation (M&S), and preparing technical reports and briefings.

This position is ideal for a systems engineer with strong hands-on modeling experience who can translate complex engineering requirements and system designs into accurate, integrated models. Experience with Cameo Systems Modeler and the Object Management Group (OMG) Certified Systems Modeling Professional™ (OCSMP) Intermediate certification is highly desirable.

This is a full-time, on-site position at the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard.

**Benefits**

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, 401K, Tuition Assistance, Paid Vacation, Paid Holiday, and Paid Sick Leave.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Model-Based Systems Engineering**

* Develop, modify, and maintain system models representing complex shipboard HM&E systems and associated engineering functions.
* Use Cameo Systems Modeler or similar MBSE platforms to develop structural, behavioral, requirements, and parametric models and diagrams.
* Develop and maintain logical and physical system models, requirements definitions, viewpoints, and traceability relationships.
* Support verification and validation (V&V) model development and ensure models accurately reflect current system designs and requirements.
* Apply appropriate modeling frameworks, schemas, data dictionaries, and standards to maintain consistency across the modeling environment.
* Research existing shipboard and land-based engineering designs to capture essential system characteristics, interfaces, and behavior within system models.
* Contribute to the development of shipboard HM&E ontologies, schemas, and modeling frameworks.

**System Modeling, Integration, and Analysis**

* Develop real-time and non-real-time system models to support IPS design analyses and engineering evaluations.
* Integrate component-level models into system-level models, including electrical power components, supervisory control systems, and HM&E equipment.
* Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, controls, and systems engineers to ensure model accuracy and consistency.
* Execute modeling and simulation activities to evaluate system performance, design alternatives, and interactions among system components.
* Support IPS and Land-Based Engineering Site (LBES) model integration, engineering analyses, and associated technical deliverables.
* Develop or modify models and analytical tools to support engineering tradespace studies and design evaluations.
* Identify model gaps, integration issues, and inconsistencies that may affect system-level analyses.
* Support ship-level systems engineering, digital engineering, and related program activities.

**Engineering Tools and Automation**

* Develop or modify code using Java, Python, or similar programming languages to support modeling, analysis, and automation.
* Develop tools and scripts to improve model integration, engineering data management, and analytical workflows.
* Support the exchange of engineering information across modeling environments and interfaces with product lifecycle models.
* Apply appropriate data structures and modeling conventions to improve consistency, reuse, and integration of engineering information.

**Technical Documentation and Program Support**

* Prepare technical reports documenting model development, analytical methods, assumptions, results, and conclusions.
* Support IPS and LBES design analysis reports, integration documentation, requirements documents, and acquisition-related technical deliverables.
* Brief modeling and analysis results to engineering teams, design working groups, and program stakeholders.

* Coordinate modeling and analysis deliverables with broader program schedules and engineering milestones.
* Collaborate with government and contractor personnel to address technical questions, evaluate design alternatives, and support program objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET-accredited college or university.
* Minimum of five (5) years of system modeling experience.
* Demonstrated experience developing, modifying, or maintaining system models in an MBSE environment.
* Experience with system architecture, requirements modeling, system structure, behavior, interfaces, or parametric modeling.
* Experience using Cameo Systems Modeler or comparable systems modeling platforms.
* Understanding of systems engineering principles and the application of model-based methods to complex engineering systems.
* Ability to interpret engineering requirements, technical specifications, system architectures, and engineering documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Ability to work on-site at the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard.

* OMG Certi

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------

**Our Mission**

Securing the materials to build our future. Materials underpin the technologies that will define tomorrow—from artificial intelligence and advanced electronics to energy and national defense. Principal Mineral builds the systems, capabilities, and markets that strengthen domestic industrial capacity and secure the critical materials supply chain for generations to come.

Principal Mineral is creating an integrated global manufacturing platform by acquiring industry-leading businesses, including Camden Copper, Isola Group, and Conductive Composites.

Principal Mineral is seeking an **experienced Electrical Engineer** to join the Engineering Team delivering plant modernization and capital improvement projects. This is an **onsite** role located in **Camden, South Carolina**. You’ll apply deep technical expertise and hands-on practical experience to ensure electrical system designs, specifications, vendor deliverables, and field execution plans are technically sound, safe, and cost-effective.

**What You’ll Do**

As the **Electrical Engineer**, you will lead the design, specification, procurement support, installation oversight, and commissioning of electrical equipment and systems—from early concept through final startup. You’ll also design, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize plant electrical infrastructure, including PLCs, motors, drives, and power distribution equipment. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you’ll help deliver projects that improve reliability, safety, and performance across the plant.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Design and Review:** Create and review electrical engineering deliverables, including one-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, medium-voltage (MV) and low-voltage (LV) power distribution transformers, switchgear, and motor control centers (MCCs).
* **Engineering Calculations:** Perform short-circuit calculations, load projections, cable sizing, voltage drop analysis, busbar design, and protection coordination studies.
* **Automation and Controls:** Program, update, and troubleshoot PLCs, HMIs, and sensor networks to support safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations.
* **Equipment Specification:** Specify, select, and evaluate industrial electrical equipment and control systems, including panels, motors, drives, transformers, and associated controls, based on operational needs and safety requirements.
* **Project and Cost Management:** Support capital projects by managing scope, cost estimates, material lists, schedules, and vendor/contractor performance against budget targets.
* **Code Compliance:** Review drawings and specifications to ensure electrical systems meet all applicable requirements, including the National Electrical Code (NEC), NFPA 70E, OSHA, and relevant international standards such as IEEE and UL.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with mechanical and process engineers, contractors, EPC teams, and regulatory stakeholders to execute plant improvement and capital projects successfully.
* **Technical Documentation:** Develop and maintain electrical drawings, specifications, and project documentation.
* **Budget and Timeline Management:** Monitor project cost and schedule performance to ensure alignment with capital expenditure plans.
* **Commissioning and Safety Reviews:** Conduct site walkdowns, resolve RFIs and non-conformance reports (NCRs), support Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSRs), and help ensure safe energization and transition of new installations into active operations.
* **Maintenance and Reliability:** Lead preventive maintenance planning and continuous improvement for electrical machinery and critical systems, including DC rectifiers, transformers, switchgear, and emergency backup systems to minimize downtime.

**Key Qualifications and Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited institution.
* **Experience:** 3–5 years of practical electrical engineering experience in heavy industrial, chemical processing, or manufacturing environments.
* **Electrical Systems Knowledge:** Working familiarity with 480/277 VAC and 208/120 VAC power distribution.
* **Automation Experience:** Hands-on experience with industrial automation and PLCs (for example, Allen-Bradley and Siemens), as well as SCADA and DCS systems.
* **Software Proficiency:** Familiarity with ETAP, AutoCAD, and/or EPLAN for design and analysis.
* **Attention to Detail:** Experience spanning concept design through procurement, fabrication, construction support, commissioning, and Management of Change (MOC) for capital projects.
* **Communication and Organization:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and business audiences.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

Camden Copper, part of Principal Mineral, is North America’s only manufacturer of electrodeposited copper foil. Since 1991, we’ve been proud to support the Camden, SC community by producing high-quality copper foil used in a wide range of applications, including printed circuit boards that rely on copper’s excellent electrical conductivity. As a technical team member, you’ll help support essential work that keeps our operations running and our products performing—making Camden Copper a great place for detail-oriented, hands-on professionals to build a career.

jobs.description:
### **WHO WE ARE**

Kunin Technologies is revolutionizing the critical mineral supply chain by implementing advanced separation technologies to capture value from overlooked resources.

Metals are everywhere, in solar panels, smartphones, electric vehicles, but as ore grades plummet globally, traditional extraction methods are failing. China dominates critical minerals markets by developing superior separation technologies that extract value from materials American mines discard as waste.

Utilizing Kunin Technologies' breakthrough performance, ion-exchange media significantly more value can be produced from each resource, reducing waste, and unlocking metal abundance.

To achieve metal abundance, humanity must bring separation science down its own Moore’s Law: fix the idiot cost index for micro and nano scale separation materials. This requires mass manufacturing novel ion-exchange media form factors which previously struggled from high costs.

### **THE ROLE**

We are automating the roll-to-roll processing of ion-exchange media. This is a similar serial production challenge to battery electrodes. You are responsible for making three-unit operations one coherent line: web transport, drives and tension control, unwind and rewind stands, and the controls and automation layer (PLC, HMI/SCADA, recipes, data logging) that ties it together. Battery electrode coating experience maps directly: fragile-web transport, wet steps, drying, precision tension, modern automation.

You are part of a team of ten in Chattanooga, TN delivering this line by the end of 2027.

This demonstration line becomes the basis of a greenfield manufacturing facility in Series A – B, at 10X the scale, with automated material handling and integrated back–end exchange media equipment packaging.

By 2030, we want to be the world’s largest volume producer of ion-exchange media.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Line architecture: unwind and rewind stands, roll transfer between unit operations, accumulator and festoon strategy, and splice stations
* Web transport and tension control for low-basis-weight nonwovens: drive sizing, load cells and dancers, tension zones through nips, baths, the beam shield labyrinth, and dryers
* Controls and automation: PLC programming, drive coordination and draw control, HMI/SCADA, recipe management, and interlock coordination with the beam systems engineer
* Line data: sensor selection and logging of speed, tensions, temperatures, bath parameters, and dose records – captured from day one
* Commissioning leadership when unit operations physically connect; line-level safety: e-stops, guarding, LOTO

### **QUALIFICATIONS AND PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering field - electrical or chemical engineer preferred.
* 3+ years on roll-to-roll production or pilot lines with hands-on drives, tension, and controls work - battery electrode coating background preferred.
* PLC and HMI programming experience (Rockwell/Allen-Bradley or Siemens class) with servo and VFD drive commissioning.
* 1+ years of experience using software tools such as Matlab, C++ or Python.
* Ability to work in fast paced and demanding atmosphere
* Experience trouble shooting sensors, actuators, and electrical components
* Creative problem solving that brings together reactive chemistry, radiochemistry, material handling, fluid mechanics disciplines.

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Position located in Chattanooga, Tennessee. Travel to partners' facilities may be intermittently required.
* Must be a U.S. citizen.
* Extended hours and weekends frequently required to support critical project milestones.

*"The Whole World Is Ion-Exchange And The Rest Are Merely Details!"*

Dr. Robert Kunin of Rohm and Haas, The Pioneer of the Ion-Exchange Industry, 1951

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Customer Terminals Software, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world — from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies.  
The Customer Terminals Software team owns the full software stack that powers the customer based ground terminals. This is a unique engineering challenge at the intersection of embedded systems, wireless communications, and high-volume consumer hardware. Our team is responsible for low-level device drivers, board support packages, Linux kernel, secure manufacturing, MAC and PHY interactions, data plane, control plane, networking, device management, and user-facing applications.  
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as the technical leader for Customer Terminals Software — someone who can define the architecture, raise the engineering bar, and drive technical excellence across the full embedded software stack. This role offers high autonomy to shape both the technology and the engineering culture of a team building a new category of infrastructure at planetary scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Technical Vision & Architecture: Own the long-term software architecture for customer terminals, spanning board bring-up, BSP, kernel, networking stack, device management, and application layers. Define architectural patterns that ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability across product generations.
* Cross-Functional System Design: Partner with hardware, silicon, RF, antenna, networking, and product teams to drive hardware/software co-design decisions across SoC selection, RF integration, power management, thermal constraints, and satellite link optimization.
* Technical Leadership & Force Multiplication: Serve as the technical lead on the most demanding, cross-functional problems. Exert influence across multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing deep knowledge and experience. Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions.
* Engineering Excellence: Define best practices for the software development lifecycle — design, implementation, testing, and operations. Drive quality metrics, code review standards, and operational excellence mechanisms across the organization.
* Embedded Systems Delivery: Lead architecture and delivery of mission-critical embedded software for high-volume consumer devices operating in diverse and challenging environments worldwide. Ensure robustness in connectivity, performance, OTA updates, fleet observability, and lifecycle management.

  
A day in the life  
You will own significant portions of the customer terminal software architecture, partnering with Senior stakeholders across Amazon Leo's hardware, ASIC, RF, electrical, thermal, power, and software teams. You'll define interfaces between subsystems, resolve cross-cutting architectural challenges, and work hands-on with engineers as a force multiplier. You'll operate in productive ambiguity — where problems are not always clear and solutions need to be invented — while delivering systems where software meets physics, with signals traversing thousands of kilometers to satellites moving at orbital velocity.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct.
