People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

**Senior Director, Platform Engineering**

**Location: Dallas, TX or Akron, OH (Hybrid)**

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

The Senior Director, Platform Engineering will define, build, and scale the technical foundation beneath Signet Jewelers' eCommerce storefronts and the order management estate. This leader will own solution architecture, cloud platform direction, AI in the software development lifecycle, build and release pipelines, the integration platforms, environment and performance engineering, edge delivery, and security engineering across the commerce and order management portfolio.

The role supports an operating model of central standards and federated delivery by ensuring platform capabilities are built as reusable, governed, secured, production-ready services used across every brand rather than solved separately by each delivery team.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Define and own the enterprise solution architecture for commerce and order management, including current state and future state views, domain reference architectures, and one set of standards applied across all storefronts.
* Build and scale platform engineering capabilities, including reusable services, shared APIs, integration frameworks, orchestration patterns, developer tooling, templates, and production-grade components used across multiple delivery teams and brands.
* Own cloud platform direction on AWS, and own AI in the software development lifecycle, including the tooling standard, the cost per team, and the measures that show whether it is working.
* Define and mature build and release pipelines, CI/CD, DevSecOps, test automation, and the integration platform so there is one release path rather than one per team.
* Own environment management, performance engineering, edge delivery, and pre-render, including capacity, readiness, and stability through peak trading.
* Establish engineering standards, platform guardrails, reference implementations, and reusable accelerators that enable secure, scalable, interoperable, and cost-effective delivery.
* Lead security engineering as the engineering counterpart to the Information Security function, embedding policy and controls into pipelines, environments, and platform services.
* Lead a permanent team of engineers and architects, including a Director leading the architecture practice, and direct the contract architecture, DevOps, and environments capacity onshore and offshore.
* Own the partner relationships and the standards those partners work to, with a view on what is better held internally over time.
* Provide senior technical leadership to transformation programs and brand initiatives, and influence senior stakeholders by evaluating emerging technology and making transparent trade-offs across scalability, risk, performance, cost, speed, and business value.
* Partner with Information Security, Data, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and business technology leaders to embed governance, security, compliance, and cost optimization directly into engineering workflows and platform services.

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**:

* 15 or more years of progressive technology leadership experience across software engineering, platform engineering, architecture, cloud, or enterprise technology organizations.
* 7 or more years leading large-scale engineering teams responsible for platform engineering, cloud platforms, architecture practices, or production technology capabilities.
* Proven experience building and scaling platforms, including reusable services, shared capabilities, APIs, integration frameworks, developer tooling, and production-grade systems used across multiple teams or business units.
* Hands-on experience owning environments, release pipelines, and performance engineering, not architecture and design alone.
* Experience leading architects and engineers who do not report directly to the role, with influence across teams embedded in delivery.
* Experience moving capability from a systems integrator or managed service back in house, including deciding what stays outsourced and holding the standard through the transition.
* Experience in high-volume consumer eCommerce, retail, or another business with a seasonal traffic peak and a change freeze around it.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Preferred experience in a multi-brand or multi-storefront commerce estate operating in more than one country.
* Preferred experience with a move toward headless or composable commerce on an established platform.

**Technical Skills:**

* Commerce platforms: SAP Commerce (Hybris), composable and headless commerce patterns

We are seeking a Security Software Engineer to design, implement, and harden the security controls across Saronic's autonomous surface vessel fleet. This role spans three layers: edge compute on the vessels themselves, the networks that enable vessels to communicate with each other and with the cloud, and the cloud orchestration layer that manages the fleet at scale. jobs.description:
As **International Motors** continues to grow in San Antonio, we are expanding our production operations with the introduction of a night production shift. The night shift is **Monday through Thursday from 5:30 PM to 4:00 AM**, with production planned to begin in early 2027. This is a salaried position supporting a manufacturing operation. While the primary schedule aligns with the designated production shift, employees are expected to provide operational support as needed to meet business objectives. This may require working outside normal production hours, including extended shifts, production startup activities, recovery efforts, and occasional weekend support based on operational requirements.

**Shift Differential:** 10% differential upon transitioning to Night Shift work schedule.

We are seeking experienced **Senior Lead Controls Engineers - Night Shift** to provide technical leadership and hands-on support for our night shift manufacturing operations. This position serves as the primary escalation point for complex automation and controls issues affecting production equipment, material handling systems, robotics, and plant-wide control systems.

The ideal candidate is a highly skilled automation professional with extensive experience in Rockwell Automation platforms, Ignition SCADA, industrial networking, robotics, and troubleshooting high-volume manufacturing systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, rapid decision-making, and the ability to support multiple production areas in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities**

**Production Support & Troubleshooting**

* Lead troubleshooting efforts for automation-related production disruptions.
* Provide rapid response and root cause analysis for controls, electrical, network, robotics, and system integration issues.
* Support production, maintenance, quality, and operations teams in resolving equipment failures and process abnormalities.
* Minimize downtime through effective diagnostic and corrective action practices.

**Automation Systems**

* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot:- Allen-Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC systems
  + FactoryTalk software applications
  + Ignition SCADA and HMI applications
  + Industrial Ethernet networks
  + Variable Frequency Drives (PowerFlex, SEW and equivalent)
  + Fanuc robotics systems
  + Vision systems and barcode tracking solutions
  + SQL-based manufacturing databases and reporting systems

**Material Handling & Plant Infrastructure**

* Support automated conveyor systems and material transport equipment.
* Support AGV/AMR deployments and fleet management systems.
* Maintain and improve overhead crane automation and monitoring systems.
* Support manufacturing execution, production monitoring, and plant visualization systems.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and implement controls improvements that increase safety, reliability, throughput, and maintainability.
* Analyze downtime trends and develop permanent corrective actions.
* Lead modernization and upgrade projects for aging automation systems.
* Standardize controls architectures, coding practices, and SCADA/HMI development standards.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the senior technical resource for night shift maintenance and operations teams.
* Mentor Controls Engineers, Electricians, and Automation Technicians.

**Cybersecurity & Compliance**

* Support industrial cybersecurity initiatives and secure architecture practices.
* Ensure compliance with company engineering standards and machine safety requirements.
* Maintain system backups, disaster recovery procedures, and change management documentation.

jobs.description:
**Job ID: 9802**  
**Date Posted:** **October 14, 2026**  
  
Join the Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) team, where you'll contribute to groundbreaking innovations! SDL is a University Affiliated Research Corporation that performs cutting edge research and development for the Space Force and associated government agencies, specializing in developing new and untested space-based technologies. We are seeking a GNC Controls Engineer to join our Strategic & Military Space Division and lead the development, test, and deployment of control systems for satellites and space-based components. The ideal candidate would have experience leading the design of satellite control systems including analysis, requirements derivation, algorithms, electrical, and mechanical, as well as contribute to teams working software, and systems engineering. This is an opportunity to play a strong technical design and leadership role and oversee controller designs in support of important, space-based US government missions.  
  
The Strategic & Military Space Division delivers advanced satellite and sensor systems that support the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Our division is a key component of national security, providing technological solutions and expert mission support. Become part of a team dedicated to making a tangible contribution to our nation’s defense capabilities.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Owns the controller component of a major spacecraft subsystem (e.g., Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS), propulsion, or gimbaled instruments) on satellites developed by SDL or external vendors
* Develops and maintains a comprehensive, multidisciplinary understanding of the owned component, including its design, functionality, interfaces, and integration within the broader spacecraft system
* Develops, interprets, and manages technical requirements to ensure the component meets mission objectives and overall system requirements
* Oversees controller and associated avionics development activities to ensure compliance with technical requirements, performance expectations, and program objectives.
* Collaborates across engineering disciplines to ensure component designs, interfaces, and implementations meet the rigorous performance and reliability standards required for spaceflight
* Performs design changes and analysis as needed
* Tracks issues using JIRA and works with programs to implement improvements
* Participates in mission and systems level program reviews providing technical expertise, design assessments, and status updates
* Prepares, reviews and presents technical documentation, including analyses, design documentation, development plans, and other engineering deliverables

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master’s or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent qualifications and experience
* At least 7 years of experience in controller design and implementation, including a minimum of 4 years of experience serving as a component (i.e., box) owner
* Demonstrated experience designing controllers for aerospace applications
* Experience overseeing the full controller development lifecycle, including algorithms, modeling, electrical design, software development, mechanical design, systems engineering, integration, and checkout
* Experience integrating controllers into larger products or systems as a subsystem-level component
* Experience designing and implementing high bandwidth real time control systems
* Experience developing, documenting, and overseeing the implementation and verification of requirements for controllers and related aerospace systems
* Experience using MATLAB/Simulink for controller design, modeling, simulation, and technical analysis
* Working knowledge of classical spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) principles
* Working knowledge of current hardware technologies and controller design approaches used in space systems
* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information effectively, both verbally and in writing, with program management, customers, contractors, and cross-functional engineering teams
* U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain a government security clearance
* Ability to travel occasionally to contractor and customer facilities

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering with a concentration in Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) or Controls, or a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a background in aerospace engineering
* At least 10 years of experience in space-based control systems, including a minimum of 5 years of experience serving as a component (i.e., box) owner
* Experience in one or more of the following technical areas:
  + Propulsion
  + Astrodynamics / Orbital Mechanics
  + Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO)
  + Attitude Dynamics and Controls (ADC)
  + Spacecraft Navigation / Orbit Determination
  + Spacecraft Guidance / Optimization
  + Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Simulation and Test
* Experience with Atlassian tools, including Confluence, JIRA, and Bitbucket
* Knowledge of software implementation on FPGAs
* Experience with software development using C++
* Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance
* Experience developing controllers for the Department of War (DoW) or other government agencies

  
**Salary Range**

* $105,000 - $180,000
  + Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience

This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. We have nearly 70 years of proven expertise and excel in space superiority, hypersonic defense and nuclear deterrence, digital transformation, and surface and undersea warfare domains. jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Simulation Platform team owns the core architecture and infrastructure of Anduril's high-fidelity, multi-domain military mission simulator. It models hundreds of entities-aircraft, ships, submarines, satellites, ground vehicles-moving, sensing, communicating, and engaging across realistic physical environments. The simulator powers training, mission planning, autonomy development, and hardware-in-the-loop testing across Anduril's product portfolio. It connects to live systems, integrates with Anduril's Lattice platform, and runs inside a GUI for interactive scenario authoring. Mission Sim is a large, mature C++20 codebase with an Entity-Component-System architecture, a stable C ABI plugin system, embedded scripting, and a variety of physics-based models. Keeping this system fast, correct, extensible, and pleasant to develop against at scale, with a growing team of model developers is our job.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Model authoring tools — an early effort you will help stand up to extend the Sim frontend with UI for authoring and tuning Mission Sim models. You will negotiate extension APIs with the GUI team and build an ergonomic UI atop them, working alongside Simulation Modeling engineers.
* Custom Entity-Component-System architecture that underpins the entire simulator: entity lifecycle, component storage, and the update loop
* Plugin and SDK development - maintaining a versioned C ABI, which enables external teams to extend the simulator
* Performance and scale — keeping the simulation loop fast enough for real-time and faster-than-real-time execution with hundreds of concurrent entities; reasoning about memory layout, cache behavior and contention, as entity counts grow
* Integration architecture — gRPC services, DIS protocol interoperability, networking messaging, and file recording for analysis and playback
* Support domain experts in integrating new and enhancing existing capability models

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3 years of professional experience with C++20 and strong C++ skills; you should be comfortable with templates, move semantics, smart pointers, and the kinds of design decisions that show up in framework code
* Experience designing internal APIs and frameworks that other engineers build on, with focus on backwards-compatibility and ergonomics
* Solid understanding of systems programming fundamentals: memory management, shared libraries, ABI stability, linking, interfacing with the operating system
* Comfort with linear algebra and applied math
* Familiarity with Linux-based C++ development toolchains
* Ability to reason about performance-sensitive code — cache behavior, memory layout, algorithmic complexity
* Clear technical communication and ability to work in a large, shared codebase and negotiate architectural decisions that affect a growing team
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of professional experience with C++20
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers on a project — setting technical direction and bringing others along
* Comfort operating in ambiguity — scoping the problem, the approach, and the interfaces when none exist yet, and driving them to a decision
* Experience with military simulation, defense modeling & simulation, or related domains
* Experience with Entity-Component-System architectures or game engine design patterns
* Experience in designing and implementing GUI-supported workflows
* Familiarity with gRPC, DIS (IEEE 1278.1) distributed simulation standard
* Experience with Python/C++ interop (pybind11, embedded interpreters)
* Familiarity with behavior trees or autonomous agent architectures
* Developing in Nix
* Experience with numerical simulation, physics modeling, or scientific computing

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The Power Systems Engineer is a customer-facing technical role at the intersection of system-level power architecture and connector/cable interconnect engineering. Working directly with hyperscalers, GPU/CPU partners, infrastructure partners, and Rack Power ODMs to understand current and future power delivery architectures and turn that insight into connector and cable power solutions. The role sits between the customer's engineering teams and internal product development engineering, R&D, and applications engineering, acting as the primary technical liaison who gathers technical requirements, aligns architecture with product capability, and presents solutions back to the customer.

Power Systems Engineer works under the guidance of senior team members supporting key customers and/or key programs, while building fluency in power architecture and connector/cable technology.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technical Requirements:** Engage with customer engineering teams to capture requirements to develop power interconnect solutions.
* **Architecture translation:** Translate system-level power architecture (e.g., 800V bus conversion, sidecar or vertical power delivery, busbar distribution) into connector and cable technology requirements to define product development.
* **Customer-facing solutioning:** Serve as the front-facing technical point of contact for power architecture discussions, presenting connector/cable solution options, trade-offs, and roadmap alignment directly to customer engineering teams.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** Partner with product engineering and manufacturing site to develop and deliver power interconnect solutions.
* **Specification development:** Develop technical requirement documents and specification inputs that drive new product development and design-in activities.
* **Design-in support:** Support qualification, validation, and design-in activities for new power interconnect solutions at customer sites.
* **Industry Standards:** Track relevant industry standards and consortia (e.g., OCP, hyperscaler-specific specifications) that shape power delivery and interconnect roadmaps.
* **Voice of customer:** Deliver customer and market insight back into internal roadmap and new product development.
* Support senior team members in customer engagements.
* Build working knowledge of the company's connector and cable product portfolio as applied to power delivery use cases.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At minimum Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related engineering technical field.
* Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree with 1+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Foundational understanding of connector development and power architecture concepts.
* Ability to read and interpret system-level requirements and specifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable participating in customer-facing meetings alongside senior colleagues.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct exposure to data center power architecture with strong critical thinking skills.
* Familiarity with the connector and cable industry landscape and their power interconnect product lines.

As a contributor in the APX platform engineering organization on the CloudNet team, you focus on solving real-time problems for mission-critical cloud-native services—and on the quality and reliability our customers expect. In this role, you'll ship automation and reliable cloud-based platforms (we have no data centers, so there is no rack-and-stack in this role).

**Work Location:** This role is based out of our Seattle office and follows a hybrid schedule. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success

### **What You'll Do**

* Advance Axon's use of Istio-style service mesh patterns that underpin how we scale—building features, hardening what runs in production, and improving how we roll out change.

* Advise software engineers through design reviews, ad hoc questions, and pair programming when connectivity, ingress, mesh, or TLS behavior is on the critical path.
* Automate operations so the platform stays highly available (targeting four-nines-class reliability for these components). Example: TLS certificate management and automation at scale—where small mistakes can become customer-visible outages if left manual.

### **What You Bring**

* + Six or more years working on globally diverse, 24/7, high-volume production systems.
  + Bachelors Degree in Computer Science
  + **At least one** strong track record from the following (we do not expect every candidate to match every item):
  + - Operating critical components or services in Kubernetes clusters at meaningful scale (ingress, gateways, mesh, or similar).
    - Infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery on public cloud (Axon uses Azure; other major clouds are fine).

    - Production ownership of service mesh, ingress, TLS/certificate automation, DNS or public-edge patterns, or secure east-west traffic in cloud environments.
  + Excellent problem-solving skills debugging cloud-native distributed systems (HTTP/TLS, DNS, load balancing, Kubernetes networking).

It is a weaker match if your experience is primarily traditional enterprise network operations (for example campus switching or appliance-only administration) without substantial Kubernetes operations, software delivery, or infrastructure-as-code.

jobs.title: Staff Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Staff Hardware Engineer serves as a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, integration, validation, and lifecycle support of complex embedded electronic hardware systems used across Generac products. This role leads new product development initiatives involving embedded controls, power electronics, analog and digital circuitry, and microprocessor-based systems. The position provides technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines, drives innovation and continuous improvement, ensures compliance with quality and regulatory requirements, and mentors engineering talent while delivering solutions that meet performance, reliability, manufacturability, schedule, and cost objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, integration, verification, and validation of complex embedded electronic hardware systems for new product development and technology initiatives.
* Define system and hardware requirements, design specifications, verification plans, and acceptance criteria while maintaining traceability throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Provide technical leadership for complex programs involving multiple subsystems, ensuring achievement of quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives.
* Lead hardware design activities involving microprocessors, microcontrollers, analog and digital circuitry, communication interfaces, and power electronics technologies.
* Drive design reviews, component selection, DFMEA/FMEA activities, risk assessments, root-cause investigations, and resolution of complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with firmware, software, mechanical, manufacturing, sourcing, supplier quality, and operations teams to optimize product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost.
* Serve as the technical authority for hardware architecture, EMC compliance, regulatory requirements, and engineering standards while mentoring and developing engineers.
* Advance engineering effectiveness through continuous improvement initiatives, development of testing and validation strategies, and evaluation of emerging technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline.
* Seven (7)+ years of experience designing analog and digital electronic systems, including leadership of complex product development programs involving multiple subsystems and cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in analog and digital circuit design, including microprocessors, microcontrollers, communication protocols, hardware interfaces, and embedded electronic systems.
* Advanced knowledge of power electronics, hardware architecture development, system-level design, and complex system integration.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale embedded controls or power electronics development programs, providing technical leadership, engineering direction, and sound technical decision-making.
* Expertise in engineering processes and methodologies including design reviews, DFMEA/FMEA, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement practices, EMC compliance, and engineering best practices.
* Experience utilizing schematic capture and PCB design tools (e.g., Altium Designer) and reviewing layouts for signal integrity, electromagnetic compatibility, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Working knowledge of applicable regulatory and product safety standards, including UL, CSA, IEC, FCC, and CE, with demonstrated success collaborating with suppliers, customers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional business teams.
* Strong business and technical acumen, including experience developing technology roadmaps, evaluating emerging technologies, managing product lifecycle considerations, mentoring engineering talent, and understanding engineering’s impact on product cost and business performance.

**Great Reasons to work for Generac**:

* Competitive Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, 401k and many more
* Scheduled events throughout the year that allow our employees, both current and retirees, to gather together and enjoy their time with their families and co-workers
* Pride! When a storm strikes, Generac employees always rise to the occasion. Each time a storm hits, many employees volunteer their time with the customer support team or on the production line, while others go right into storm-affected areas to repair generators
* Make a positive impact. Generac has always been community-minded and dedicated to giving back. The company proudly offers a Volunteer Time Off program, inviting team members to participate in charitable volunteer opportunities on company time.

jobs.title: Platform Hardware Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**What You Will Do:**

We are seeking a Hardware Engineering Manager to lead and develop a group of talented Electrical and Mechanical Design Engineers responsible for designing and sustaining flight-critical avionics for customers worldwide. This position is part of a team that covers all aspects of Hardware Engineering Development for our products and is an ideal opportunity for candidates with strong technical and project leadership abilities who are excited about advancing in a management capacity. You will provide leadership and daily supervision to an engineering team responsible for new projects, maintenance, and modification of legacy products. You will lead and guide engineers and enforce compliance with process objectives for critical safety and non-safety products.

This position is located at our Headquarters in Oak Creek, WI. You will report directly to the Senior Engineering Manager, Platform Hardware (Connected Products).

**How You Will Do It:**

* Mentor, advise, and develop a team of design engineers to ensure the development and sustainment of robust products that meet customer expectations while building the team's skills and capabilities.
* Work with the Chief Engineers and Senior Manager to establish and improve department processes.
* Guide the team in evaluation options and developing effective solutions for assigned project tasks.
* Work closely with Program Managers and Product Engineering Managers to break projects into work packages the team can manage and complete.
* Support work package development and ensure that work packages within their area of responsibility clearly define required inputs, expected outputs (the definition of done), and dependencies on other teams
* Ensure work packages within their area of responsibility are completed correctly, on time, and within budget.
* Advance technology and design techniques for mixed-signal electronics, low voltage power electronics, and embedded system hardware design.
* Lead product sustainment efforts, including design improvements, functionality enhancements, obsolescence management, and coordination of issue discovery and root cause analysis.
* Review and approve development lifecycle deliverables, including planning and requirements documents, schematics, bills of material, and design review artifacts.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required.

**What We Look For:**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or another relevant field from an accredited institution.
* Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Minimum seven years of experience in engineering or engineering leadership.
* High level of experience with the following key areas of Hardware Engineering:
* + Capturing and managing requirements from a wide range of sources, including customer specifications, industry standards, and regulations.
  + Designing and validating solutions that meet customer requirements.
  + Collaborating with other engineering disciplines on product integration activities.
  + Defining and executing verification and validation test campaigns.
* Ability to build and contribute to a a cohesive team environment within and across departments.
* Understanding of project management methodologies.
* Commitment to continuous process improvement.
* Willingness to collaborate across departments to accomplish shared objectives.
* Ability to understand and clearly communicate broad technical objectives, priorities, and direction.
* Ability to provide focus and guidance to team members.
* Ownership and accountability for departmental performance and activities.
* Understanding of aircraft-embedded avionics systems with respect to hardware disciplines.

**Preferred:**

* Preferred experience in hardware design engineering within a safety-critical industry and/or aviation-embedded systems.
* Familiarity with industry standards for DO-160, DO-178, DO-254 and ARP4754A.
* Knowledge of aircraft systems along with integration activities.

**Who We Are:**

We are a team that designs computers, displays and electronic systems for aircraft of the future! * Develop embedded hardware from concept and schematic through bring-up, validation, and documentation, including test plans, procedures, and test cases.
* Design and validate MCU interface circuitry, including analog and digital signal conditioning, filtering, communication interfaces, control circuits, and protection circuitry.
* Understand and troubleshoot MCU peripherals and interfaces, including GPIO, timers, ADCs, and communication peripherals, while partnering closely with firmware engineers.
* Independently troubleshoot embedded hardware and system-level interactions, using hardware modifications and embedded firmware as needed to isolate root cause.
* Evaluate critical electronic components, perform technical tradeoff analyses, and recommend design or requirement changes based on performance, cost, risk, and project needs.

Collaborate effectively with hardware, firmware, systems, test, reliability, product-development teams, and external semiconductor/component suppliers.  

  

**What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field, with approximately 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience.

* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital circuit design.

* Hands-on experience designing, bringing up, testing, and troubleshooting MCU-based embedded hardware.

* Proficiency using laboratory instrumentation including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.

* Experience with schematic capture and the PCB design/layout process using ECAD tools.

* Experience applying circuit simulation and engineering analysis to guide and validate hardware designs.

* Working knowledge of MCU peripherals including GPIO, timers, ADCs, and serial communication interfaces.

Demonstrated ability to systematically troubleshoot hardware and perform root-cause analysis.  

  

**Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:**

* Experience performing PCB rework and circuit modifications to support prototype bring-up, debugging, and design validation.

* Experience using embedded C/C++ to configure MCU peripherals and support hardware bring-up, test, and troubleshooting.

* Experience supporting EMC/EMI testing, troubleshooting results, and implementing design improvements.

Experience evaluating and selecting MCUs, sensors, analog devices, communication ICs, or other semiconductor components.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Take Ownership of Your Career and Shape Your Future!**

Are you ready to become an Employee Owner? At Suburban Enterprises, you not only work for the company you own the company! The ideal candidate is happy where he/she is currently employed but is interested in a more self-directed work environment, increased responsibility, and the opportunity to grow into additional roles. We would like to hire someone interested in a career, not a job, who wants to do the work and be recognized for a job well done!

**The Role – Controls Engineer**

The Controls Engineer is responsible for the design, programming, commissioning, and ongoing support of engineered automation and industrial control solutions at customer facilities. This role provides technical leadership and project oversight throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring control systems are designed and implemented in accordance with customer requirements, applicable standards, project schedules, budgets, and established technical specifications. The Controls Engineer works closely with customers, project managers, technicians, electricians, and other engineering personnel to deliver reliable, safe, and maintainable automation solutions.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Project Estimation & Planning:** Develop accurate estimates, scopes of work, and proposals for customer automation projects.
* **Design & Documentation:** Create detailed electrical schematics, panel layouts, and Bills of Materials (BOMs) using AutoCAD Electrical.
* **Programming & Commissioning:** Program, test, and troubleshoot industrial automation systems—including PLCs, HMIs, and AC/DC drives.
* **Safety & Compliance:** Ensure all designs and panel builds comply with relevant electrical and safety standards (e.g., NFPA 79, NEC, ISO 13849).
* **Customer & Technical Support:** Provide high-level technical support and troubleshooting assistance to internal department technicians and external customers.
* **Project Management:** Lead multiple concurrent automation projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.

  

**What You Bring (Required Experience)**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering or relevant field including electrical engineering and/or electrical engineering technology or equivalent education and/or experience.
* **Experience:** 3+ years of hands-on experience in industrial electrical, controls, automation, instrumentation, or electromechanical systems.
* **Core Technical Skills:**
  + Extensive experience troubleshooting industrial control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, sensors, and motor controls.
  + Experience programming and troubleshooting Rockwell PLCs and HMIs.
  + Experience reading, interpreting, and modifying electrical control schematics and control panel layouts using AutoCAD and/or AutoCAD Electrical.
* **Computer Skills:** Proficient with standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office, email, internet browsers, and basic file management.

  

**Bonus Points For (Preferred Experience)**

* **Project Estimating:** Experience developing project estimates, scopes of work, and budgetary proposals.
* **Standards & Compliance:** In-depth knowledge of industrial electrical and safety standards, including NFPA 79, NEC, and UL 508A panel design guidelines.
* **SCADA & HMI Platforms:** Experience programming advanced SCADA/HMI systems such as Ignition, FactoryTalk SE, or Wonderware.
* **Databases & Data Handling:** Experience utilizing Microsoft SQL Server for data logging, recipes, or reporting.
* **System Integration & Networking:** Understanding of industrial networking (Ethernet and Serial).
* **Robotics & Multi-Platform Programming:** Experience integrating industrial robots or programming alternative PLC/HMI platforms (such as Siemens).
* **Industry Background:** Direct engineering experience within the food, beverage, or paper industries.

  

**What We Offer – Why Choose Suburban Enterprises?**

* **Team Member Ownership**: Work for a company where your contributions directly impact your future

* **Commitment to Safety**: Safety isn’t just a priority; it’s our promise to you and your family

* **Career Growth**: This isn't just a job - it's a career path with opportunities for advancement
* **Continuous Learning**: Investment in your professional development
* **Collaborative Culture**: Work with a team that values respect, integrity, and excellence

* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Competitive pay, ESOP, 401(K) with employer match, and no healthcare premium increases for 4 years

  

**Ready to Join Us?**

Our high standards of service to our customers and clients require that we select only the top team members based on our culture and core values so please read and understand them or come with clarifying questions because we work, live, hire and promote by them. We will choose new team members with great care because the future of Suburban Enterprises rests with them. You are here because we believe in your character and abilities.

If you're passionate about innovation, committed to excellence, and ready to be part of a company that invests in its people, we want to hear from you. Help us create a better future through innovation and automation.

**Job Description**  
**Build a Career Protecting What Matters**
  
Are you a blossoming engineer with a passion for embedded systems and a drive to solve complex technical challenges? Join the **Market Expansion Software Team** at BAE Systems and help us protect those who protect us.
  
We are developing critical seeker, guidance, and control technologies for precision munitions within our Precision Strike & Sensing Solutions (PGSS) business. This is a unique opportunity for an early career engineer to get hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technology and make a tangible contribution to national security from day one.
  
**The Opportunity**
  
As a Software Engineer II, you won't just be writing code—you'll be learning the art of embedded systems engineering. You will be integrated into a high-visibility program, working alongside seasoned Principal Engineers and Subject Matter Experts. You will become a key contributor on a fast-paced program delivering demonstratable value at strategic test events.
  
**What You’ll Do**

* **Develop & Code:** Write high-quality, reliable code in C/C++ for complex embedded systems
* **Work with Cutting-Edge Hardware:** Gain experience with embedded processors, GPUs and military-grade sensors and electronics
* **Explore Operating Systems:** Work across a variety of environments, ranging from bare metal to Embedded Linux
* **Collaborate:** Partner with Systems, Hardware, and Test engineers to help translate requirements into efficient software solutions demonstrated on range
* **Learn & Grow:** Participate in design reviews and collaborate on engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* Strong foundational knowledge of **C/C++**, including an understanding of data structures, algorithms, and memory management
* Exposure to embedded systems development through coursework, internships, or personal projects
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with development boards (ex, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone Black, Arduino Uno, STM32)
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Coursework in signal processing, guidance, or control systems
* Practiced in the training and use of AI models beyond LLMs
* Exposure to Agile workflows, CI/CD tools, or static code analysis
* Experience with Python
* Confident and responsible use of generative AI tools used in the development of software
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $72150 - $122655
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

**Title:**

The ideal candidate will be flexible, self-directed, team-oriented, and capable of managing ambiguity.

* Develop and maintain long-range systems integration strategies, technology roadmaps, and engineering modernization initiatives.
* Oversee system requirements, architecture evaluations, technology trade studies, and performance assessments to guide development paths.

* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, technical trends, and innovative solutions applicable to current and future Integrated Fires challenges.

* Conduct objective assessments of system performance, operational effectiveness, and mission outcomes through scenario development, modeling, simulation, and engineering analysis.
* Lead systems engineering activities including requirements analysis, functional decomposition, architecture development, interface definition, requirements allocation, integration planning, and technical management.
* Guide the development and implementation of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) solutions and ensure alignment with Government Reference Architectures and digital engineering strategies.
* Assist the Government in translating mission objectives, operational needs, and customer requirements into system and capability requirements.
* Effectively communicate technical findings, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to senior Government and military decision-makers.
* Provide engineering leadership and oversight throughout the system lifecycle, from requirements development through fielding and transition to operations.
* Ensure the integrity, quality, completeness, and technical excellence of engineering products, analyses, recommendations, and deliverables.
* Resolve complex technical issues, risks, and conflicts affecting program execution.
* Participate in and lead technical design reviews, architecture reviews, engineering assessments, and study efforts as required.
* Develop and support forward-looking proposals, demonstrations, prototypes, and experiments that advance Integrated Fires capabilities.
* Foster an environment of critical thinking, innovation, technical rigor, and continuous improvement.
* Lead, mentor, and oversee Senior, Mid, and Junior level Systems Engineers supporting the PAE-Fires portfolio.
* Serve as a trusted technical resource for evaluating engineering concepts, approaches, and solutions proposed by staff and partners.
* Promote participation in professional engineering organizations, technical committees, conferences, and industry forums.
* Support strategic recruiting, workforce development, retention, and growth of highly qualified technical personnel.
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Top Secret/SCI (TS/SCI) security clearance with the ability to obtain a Poly required
* 20+ years of technical experience
* Master’s degree or higher in Systems Engineering or in related technical or scientific fields such as engineering, physics, mathematics, operations research, engineering management, or related STEM degree.
* Broad systems engineering skills and background with experience in US Army and/or joint air and missile defense research, development, test, and operations
* Travel 20%
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications in systems engineering such as INCOSE ASEP, CSEP, ESEP.
* Certifications in MBSE and demonstrated experience with MBSE, processes, tools and languages.

jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

* Knowledge in IBCS, PATRIOT, MEADS, THAAD, C2BMC, or AEGIS
* The ability to "move out" and champion your ideas, architectures, and designs

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Brief Summary**:

Senior Electrical Systems Engineers work closely with optical, mechanical, software, and test engineers to develop, verify, and validate requirements for cutting-edge complex optical and electro-optical systems. In the early phases of a project or program, they work to understand the customer's needs, internal capabilities, and participate in technology readiness reviews to identify capability gaps and developmental risks. They specifically lead the analysis in relation to electrical and electronics subsystems including integration of analyses from other disciplines. Senior Electrical Systems Engineers are responsible for understanding all system interfaces and leading the development of rigorous electrical integration and test plans to ensure each system and subsystem requirement is appropriately addressed. Subsequently, they execute on those plans by utilizing their extensive hands-on assembly, integration, and testing (AI&T) skillsets for electrical components and overseeing other disciplines’ AI&T efforts.

A Senior Electrical Systems Engineer leads a wide variety of technical activities during the product realization process for systems involving a high level of complexity, with an emphasis on electro-optic assemblies. Additionally, a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer will be expected to design, build and test custom electronics for testing and/or manufacturing equipment. With an electro-optical systems focus, they are primarily tasked with hands-on integration and testing of electronic components, PCBs, and interconnects. They are charged with leading the planning and execution of activities for projects that may involve precision cleanroom assembly, specialized equipment/fixturing, and custom test bed development. They help in assessing existing Edmund Optics equipment and processes to ensure requirements for a variety of products can be effectively verified. Additionally, a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer plays an important role in training and mentoring more junior engineers.

Responsibilities:

**Primary Responsibilities:**

Electrical:

* Review customer provided and supplier provided electrical and electronic designs, schematics, PCB layouts, and support documentation for suitability against system requirements.
* Evaluate electrical and electronic designs for functionality, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and testability; identify risks and recommend improvements.
* Develop or oversee PCB layouts, fabrication, and assembly for custom electronic hardware.
* Design, build, and test custom electronics and interconnect subsystems and test software for development, integration, verification, and manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and modify basic microcontroller firmware, including Arduino-like applications, for sensor acquisition, device communication, and equipment control.
* Document and support electrical design review findings and coordinate resolution of technical issues with the responsible engineers.
* Develop training materials and procedures for the use and maintenance of custom electronics and test equipment.
* Improve electrical design review, requirements management, integration, and verification processes using lessons learned from project execution.

Systems:

* Translate customer needs and/or technical data package and intended operating conditions into measurable system and subsystem requirements.
* Lead cross-disciplinary development, allocation, and review of system requirements, with specific responsibility for electrical requirements.
* Reviewing, defining and documenting electrical interfaces and coordinating their compatibility with mechanical, optical, and software interfaces.
* Maintain traceability between customer needs, system requirements, subsystem requirements, and verification results.
* Lead electrical architecture development and contribute to system architecture decisions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines.
* Coordinate resolution of technical conflicts between disciplines to maintain overall system performance and compatibility.
* Assess assembly and testing capabilities and recommend equipment and tool acquisitions.
* Understand system interfaces and the impact of each subsystem on top-level system requirements.

AI&T:

* Develop electrical integration plans that define interface checks, integration sequence, prerequisites, and criteria for proceeding to the next project phase.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary integration activities, ensuring that subsystem dependencies and interface requirements are addressed.
* Perform hands-on electrical assembly, initial start-up, integration, and troubleshooting of components, PCBs, wiring, and interconnects.
* Define verification methods and acceptance criteria for electrical and system requirements in collaboration with the engineering team.

General:

* Prepare and review technical documentation, including requirements, interface definitions, design analyses, test plans, drawings and engineering reports.
* Mentor engineers and technicians in electrical troubleshooting, design review processes, systems thinking, and disciplined test practices.
* Facilitate the assembly and modification of test equipment to support short-term project-specific and long-term strategic needs.
* Work closely with cross functional engineers to develop and evaluate interfaces between electronics and existing hardware and software.
* Evaluate and ensure the safety, performance, and reliability of new product designs involving laser diodes, photodiodes, image sensors, and other electronics.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills & Abilities****:**

* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, circuit analysis, interconnect and cabling, and practical electrical design and construction principles.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, laboratory power supplies, function generators, and related electrical test equipment.

**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

**Job Mission**

As a Field Software Engineer I, you help bring ASM's semiconductor equipment to life by supporting the software that drives robotics, valve systems, temperature controllers, and other advanced hardware. You will work closely with global engineering experts and customer teams to troubleshoot issues, refine specifications, and ensure our tools deliver reliable performance in real-world manufacturing environments.

Your work connects our most advanced technologies with the customers who depend on them, enabling the next generation of semiconductor innovation.

**What You Will Be Working On**

* Support Software Design Engineers in developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving software for ASM semiconductor equipment.
* Triage mechanical, electrical, and software issues across complex tool environments.
* Lead customer escalation calls with field support engineers and customers.
* Collaborate with QA and Support teams to incorporate replicated bugs into regression testing.
* Work with customers to define feature specifications and contribute to bug fixes or small feature enhancements.
* Author, review, and update system specifications, software designs, test plans, and related documentation.
* Investigate internal and external inquiries, perform analyses, and propose solutions or alternatives.
* Participate in system design discussions and cross-functional engineering reviews.
* Represent customer needs and priorities to internal engineering teams.
* Support customer software upgrades and validate customer-specific use cases before deployment.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, plus 3 years of experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Software development experience in C++, C#, or Python.
* Ability to read code and work effectively in a debugger or IDE.

**What Sets You Apart**

Experience with any of the following:

* Machine control software, including semiconductor equipment.
* Windows and real-time operating systems.
* Multi-threaded or real-time applications.
* Graphical user interfaces.
* Device drivers or interrupt-driven software.
* Data communications, networking, or EtherCAT.
* Dynamic scheduling algorithms with deadlock avoidance.
* Programming tools such as debuggers, text editors, application builders, and configuration management tools.
* Ability to read and translate software functionality into new implementations.
* Ability to understand specifications, design documents, communication interfaces, and API descriptions.

**Apply today to be part of what’s next.**

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

jobs.title: Space Systems Engineering Integration & Test Engineer - TIDES FPGA (PIE)
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

Department of Defense TS/SCI security clearance is preferred at time of hire. Candidates must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance within a reasonable amount of time from date of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:**

As a Systems Engineering Integration & Test Engineer - TIDES FPGA, you will be a member of the Payload Integration and Evolution (PIE) team within SEIT’s organization. The PIE team develops and evolves the Payload Verification Platform (PVP), a hardware development environment made up of COTS and custom FPGA boards, development kits, and supporting infrastructure used to emulate spacecraft payload behavior for early integration, risk reduction, and test software development.

In this role, you will help define, architect, and lead FPGA-enabled capabilities for the PVP, from early requirements and microarchitecture through RTL implementation, simulation, timing closure, interface integration, and lab bring-up. Your work will mature reusable test infrastructure that bridges test equipment with units under test, enables real-time functions such as packet timestamping and precision command scheduling, and supports payload programs as they move from early development toward verification and flight readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead FPGA-supported development and integration activities for the Payload Verification Platform (PVP) as part of the Payload Integration and Evolution (PIE) team within SEIT’s TIDES organization
* Architect, design, integrate, and mature COTS and custom FPGA-based development platforms used to emulate spacecraft payload behavior for early integration, risk reduction, and test software development
* Define FPGA and hardware integration approaches that bridge test equipment, payload hardware, and software infrastructure
* Lead RTL development, simulation, interface integration, timing closure support, and lab bring-up for FPGA-enabled test capabilities
* Drive real-time test functions such as payload interface emulation, packet timestamping, precision command scheduling, and protocol translation
* Collaborate with systems, electrical, software, test, and program teams to derive platform requirements and resolve integration issues
* Lead structured debug efforts using lab instrumentation, waveform analysis, software tools, and root-cause investigation
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews, integration planning, technical roadmaps, and platform evolution
* Document architecture, interface definitions, bring-up procedures, release artifacts, and lessons learned

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
* Significant experience with FPGA design, RTL development, hardware integration, and lab bring-up
* Proficiency with SystemVerilog and/or VHDL, simulation, timing constraints, and FPGA vendor toolchains such as Vivado, Lattice Diamond/Radiant, or equivalent
* Experience integrating FPGA interfaces such as Ethernet, SPI, UART, JESD204B/C, high-speed serial links, or custom board-level protocols
* Strong understanding of digital design, clock-domain crossing, reset strategy, synchronous/asynchronous interfaces, and timing closure
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, protocol analyzers, and waveform capture tools
* Experience working across systems, hardware, software, and test teams to define requirements and drive integration closure
* Proficiency with scripting and automation using Python, Tcl, Linux shell, or similar tools
* Experience with Linux environments, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and controlled FPGA artifact release processes
* Familiarity with payload integration, hardware development environments, spacecraft electronics, or verification platforms is strongly preferred

**What Sets You Apart**

* You think at the platform level and understand how FPGA design decisions affect payload integration, test software, lab operations, and program execution
* You can move comfortably between architecture, RTL, simulation, timing, lab debug, and system integration
* You have a track record of taking complex hardware/software integration problems from ambiguity to root cause and closure
* You write clean, maintainable RTL, scripts, documentation, and interface definitions that other engineers can build on
* You are effective in the lab and can isolate whether an issue belongs to the FPGA, board, cable, instrument, software interface, or test configuration
* You mentor others, raise the technical standard of the team, and help shape reusable platform capabilities
* You communicate clearly across disciplines and can translate between systems needs, electrical constraints, FPGA implementation, and test objectives
* You identify opportunities to use automation and AI tools to improve engineering efficiency, debug workflows, and platform maturity

**Our Commitment to You:**

* An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
* Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
* Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
* Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups,

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Design Studies
jobs.description:
Phoenix, Arizona, United States | Full-time

Apply by: No close date

  

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

Our team helps customers with project conceptual development, support during design, equipment selection and assistance with operating issues after COD. We assist with apparatus ratings and specifications development for transformers, circuit breakers, switches, cables, series capacitors, dynamic var devices, etc.

**Minimum** **Requirements:** MSEE (PhD is desirable)15+ year performing most of the studies listed above.Expert user of PSCAD. (knowledge of ATP and EMTP-RV a plus); expert user of positive sequence/phasor domain tools; a professional engineers license is preferred but not required. The successful applicant may be subject to client-mandated drug and background checking. Occasional travel/driving is required; therefore, the successful applicant will be subject to ECI's auto insurance carrier requirements. Applicants must not require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status) now or in the future.

**Salary commensurate with experience and education. Benefits include:**

* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Disability insurance
* 401(k), profit sharing and employee stock ownership plan
* Paid vacation, personal days and holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Continued professional education reimbursement

(ECI) employs over 850 engineers, designers, project managers, surveyors, ROW agents, environmental planners, construction professionals and support staff in 37 offices across the U.S. The firm has more than 40 years of experience in the planning, engineering, and construction of a wide range of power delivery projects including substations, transmission lines, distribution systems, communication systems and industrial facilities.

Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable.

Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.

Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations.
