jobs.description:
### **Description**

We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area.  
  
More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation!  
  
SmartThings is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join the Components and Device Actions (CODA) team. CODA owns the core device and location cloud services that the rest of the SmartThings platform builds on: how devices are described, organized, and managed, and how homes and their contents are represented and handed between owners. You'll join a tight-knit team of experienced engineers running mission-critical services at scale, with a roadmap that spans new platform capabilities, modernization of our stack, and growing demand from enterprise customers. It's a role with real influence over where these services go next.  
  
This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!).

The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.

### **Key Responsibilities**

In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:

* **Technical Strategy:** Chart the long-term direction for one or more CODA domains so our device and location services keep pace with platform growth.
* **Complex Initiatives:** Own large, ambiguous, multi-team efforts from first sketch to well-run production launch.
* **Architecture for Reliability & Scale:** Steer design for the services behind device capabilities, device groups, locations, and ownership transfer, including event-driven state processing and the demands of enterprise customers. Reliability, performance, and security shape the design from day one.
* **Platform Modernization:** Lead the evolution of our stack while balancing security, maintainability, and cost.

* **Partnership Across Teams:** Work alongside global platform, product, and partner teams that build on CODA, keeping priorities aligned with product needs and business goals.

* Sound judgment across data and messaging layers: DynamoDB versus relational stores, and event-driven systems built on Kafka or similar

* Zero-downtime migrations and large-scale data backfills on live systems
* Observability, failure testing, and disciplined release practices

* Agentic coding tools, and a habit of sharing what works

In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance.

jobs.title: OT Systems Engineer (Physical Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

SpaceXSI is looking for a highly skilled and versatile OT (Operational Technology) Systems Engineer to implement and support the backend infrastructure for our next-generation controls and industrial software platforms for our physical infrastructure. This role is embedded within the mission IT organization to provide support to dedicated controls engineering organizations while leveraging adjacent IT expertise, tooling, and technologies. This role will balance support of legacy controls support systems with modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in high stakes settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and combines deep OT expertise with IT technologies such as virtualization, VDI, GitOps, network level redundancy and edge compute solutions to create streamlined and secure ICS environments.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, deploy, and augment next-generation OT environments that support plant and launch systems across multiple sites.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support industry standard controls software platforms as well as internally developed HMIs.
* Integrate established and emergent IT technologies to simplify management, improve security, and create scalable plant environments.
* Deploy and maintain development, test, and staging environments to enable controlled, systematic change introduction.
* Provide direct support during launch, test, and production campaigns.
* Perform systems/software upgrades and maintenance between critical operations (including evenings and weekends as needed).
* Proactively monitor services and respond rapidly to incidents to maintain high availability and performance.
* Leverage automation tools and contribute to infrastructure-as-code and broader DevOps initiatives with a focus on ICS environments.
* Work with internal controls engineers to iterate on simulation and emulation environment to enhance test coverage and augment change control processes.
* Write and maintain standards, architectures, best practices, and documentation (including system overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures), with emphasis on highly reliable and secure industrial environments, especially at data boundaries.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, security, controls, and operations) as well as external customers and integrators to design robust OT architectures and resolve technical issues.
* Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3+ years of experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration.
* Hands-on experience with multiple industry standard controls software platforms and tools.
* Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting OT environments in high-reliability settings.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.
* Experience designing architectures that incorporate hyperconverged, rugged industrial edge, and distributed compute technologies.
* Working knowledge of industrial protocols, controls networks, and OT cybersecurity best practices.
* Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Puppet, Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
* Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and DevOps concepts/tools.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, multi-platform authentication, and identity environments in OT contexts.
* System administration experience managing Windows and Linux servers, rudimentary database administration exposure, and storage/backup experience.
* Network administration experience and understanding of the OSI model, especially Layer 1/2/3 considerations as they apply to industrial and controls networks.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.
* Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.
* Ability to lift 30 lbs.
* Ability to work at heights.
* Ability to drive (active valid driver's license).

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join the power generation engineering team to design, commission, and maintain plant control systems. As a Controls Engineer, you will own BOP PLC/HMI and the control-room SCADA picture that brings generation and balance-of-plant into one operating view — Solar, 6000, and BOP on a single set of screens. You will work from control philosophy through commissioning and ongoing reliability, hands-on at the panel and in the control room. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own BOP PLC and HMI design, programming, and commissioning for power generation balance-of-plant systems (fuel gas, water, compressed/instrument air, HVAC, cooling, electrical auxiliaries, and related process/utility systems)

* Design and maintain the plant SCADA architecture so operators have one operating picture in the control room integrating Solar, 6000, and BOP — graphics, alarms, historian, and situational awareness on a single platform

* Develop control philosophy, control narratives, I/O lists, network drawings, cause-and-effect diagrams, and HMI/SCADA standards for reuse across the facility

* Specify PLC, HMI, SCADA, remote I/O, industrial networking, and interface hardware; define data exchange with OEM turbine/generation controllers (Solar and 6000) and with electrical protection, metering, and plant systems

* Program, test, and troubleshoot PLC logic and HMI applications (IEC 61131 — ladder, function block, structured text as applicable)

* Integrate OEM packages and third-party systems into plant SCADA using industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, IEC 61850, and others as required) so Solar, 6000, and BOP operate as one system

* Commission controls: I/O checkout, loop checks, functional testing, HMI validation, alarm rationalization, and start-up support; stay hands-on with technicians and operators

* Support day-to-day operations: troubleshooting, sequence issues, bad actors, and control changes under MOPs/MOC

* Maintain configuration management for PLC/HMI/SCADA programs, as-left files, firmware, and network documentation

* Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, fluids, protection, and operations so controls scope is fully integrated through construction, commissioning, and turnover

* Apply relevant standards for industrial control systems and electrical work (NFPA 70 / 70E, IEC 61131, and site cybersecurity/ICS practices such as NERC CIP where applicable)

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, controls engineering, computer engineering, or another engineering discipline

* 3+ years of experience in PLC, HMI, and/or SCADA engineering (design, programming, or commissioning) on industrial or power generation systems

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years in a controls role at a power plant, independent power producer, OEM, EPC, or heavy industrial facility

* Hands-on BOP PLC/HMI experience on gas turbine or similar generation projects

* Experience building a unified control-room SCADA/HMI that aggregates multiple OEM controllers (e.g. Solar, 6000, or equivalent turbine packages) with plant BOP

* Familiarity with major platforms (e.g. Ignition, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Emerson, GE, SEL) and industrial networking (IT/OT)

* Experience with IEC 61131 programming and protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, and IEC 61850

* Experience across the project lifecycle: design, programming, construction support, commissioning, and operations

* Experience with alarm management, historian, and control-room graphics that operators actually use

* Working knowledge of how BOP controls interface with electrical power systems (switchgear, protection, metering) without owning relay settings

* Experience managing OEM and contractor interfaces on multi-discipline power or capital projects

* Professional Engineering license, or actively working toward one

* Ability to support technicians in the field and to remain effective during outages, start-up, and event investigations

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to perform hands-on work in the plant and control room, including during outages and commissioning

* Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support power generation operations

* Must be able to work on-site in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other SpaceXSI facilities

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

We offer competitive pay, robust benefits package, wellness programs, and a workplace environment that embraces diversity. Come join our global network of professionals supporting client operations across CBRE. Looking for growth and career advancement? Upon completing six months of successful service, associates may explore career advancement opportunities within the organization!

Read on to learn more!

About the Role

In this vital engineering role, you will be part of a team of controls and maintenance professionals who proactively support operations and provide customers with expert-level support based on the customer’s technical problems related to their automated material handling equipment (MHE). Your expertise will be utilized in the continuous improvement and execution of the preventive maintenance process, with a focus on maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance of equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, SCADA deves and programs.

What You’ll Do

* Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety.
* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.
* Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed.
* Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieves operational conditions prescribed by the client.
* Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems.
* Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation.
* Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.
* Perform controls of systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability.
* Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and the maintenance teams.
* Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members.
* Perform other job-related duties as needed or assigned.

What You’ll Need

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience with Programmable Logic Controls (PLC) programs.
* 2+ years of experience with robotics system components and controls.
* 2+ years of experience with SCADA systems.
* Ability to be available and work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

CBRE Employee Benefits

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision
* Disability benefit program
* 401k company matching
* Paid time off and holidays
* Company paid life insurance
* Pet insurance
* Paid parental leave

Why CBRE?

We invest in our employees’ development. The core of our strategy is the view that development happens through three key activities: on-the-job learning, coaching and formal training. We provide employees with resources that support them in developing skills to enhance performance in their current role as well as for future roles.

jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer, Data Center Infrastructure - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a member of the facility operations team, you will design, build, and activate some of the world's most technically advanced facilities and data centers. As an electrical engineer, you will design and build power systems that directly contribute to new infrastructure projects. You will be able to operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex problems, excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will work with other MEP engineers, trade partners, and internal customers to support these goals and have the opportunity to drive real global impact, ultimately leading to making life multiplanetary.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Work in a team environment with other engineering disciplines to provide detailed electrical design and specification for the installation of the following equipment and systems:
  + Electrical power distribution systems.
  + Switch-gear and motor control centers.
  + Exterior and interior lighting.
  + Ground support system controls and ladder logic.
  + Uninterruptible power supply (UPS) units.
  + Standby and emergency generators.
  + Automatic transfer switches.
  + Power monitoring hardware and software.
  + Data/phone distribution and wiring.
  + Building and site grounding systems.
  + Fire alarm systems and lightning protection systems.
* Provide electrical engineering support to facility technicians to troubleshoot existing electrical equipment and controllers.
* Provide engineering support for the design, operation, and troubleshooting of all the facility's electrical components and systems, including:
  + Load flow analysis of electrical power distribution systems.
  + Electrical equipment evaluation.
  + Building and facility equipment grounding.
  + Power monitoring hardware and software.
* Ensure that all equipment interfaces properly with other mechanical and electrical systems, including compatibility with facility power budgets.
* Coordinate all electrical installations and maintenance activities with local electrical utilities personnel.
* Ensure all electrical designs and installations conform to applicable codes and regulations.
* Provide code review and analysis utilizing NFPA 70E, NFPA 70 NEC, NFPA 497, NFPA 101, Vol 5 & 6 AFSPCMAN 91-710, and IBC.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline.
* 3+ years of professional experience working on electrical projects, power distribution systems, switchgear, UPS's, and/or generators.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years of years of professional experience in a similar role.
* Professional Engineering (PE) license.
* Ability to read and understand power and control schematics.
* Ability to read and understand highly technical equipment operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals.
* Experience with variable frequency drives (VFDs) and industrial pumps.
* Experience with controls in MODBUS communication.
* Experience with medium voltage distribution.
* Experience with control panel design and production.
* Working knowledge of power coordination and arc flash.
* Ability to work on multiple tasks concurrently.
* High level of self-motivation, with the ability to work under minimal supervision.
* Good organizational skills.
* Ability to prioritize and schedule workload.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.description:
Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office.  
  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

The Controls Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automation and control systems within the assembly plant. This role supports production by ensuring reliable operation of PLCs, HMIs, robotics, vision systems, drives, and associated electrical controls. The Controls Engineer works closely with production, maintenance, quality, and engineering teams to improve equipment performance, safety, quality, and operational efficiency.

  
  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Automation and Controls**

* Design, program, modify, and maintain PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems.
* Configure and troubleshoot industrial networks and communication protocols.
* Develop and maintain electrical control schematics and documentation.
* Support startup, commissioning, and validation of new manufacturing equipment.
* Integrate robotics, vision systems, sensors, servos, and motion control systems into assembly processes.

**Production Support**

* Provide technical support for automated assembly equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve controls-related downtime issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance activities.
* Participate in plant shutdowns and equipment upgrades as needed.
* Actively participate with the Process Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, and Leadership team on projects and continuous improvement.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability and production efficiency.
* Lead improvement projects to increase throughput and reduce scrap; not just controls, but plant wide.
* Optimize machine cycle times and equipment performance.
* Lead and support lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure control systems comply with company safety standards and applicable regulations.
* Support machine risk assessments and safety system validation.
* Maintain compliance with electrical and automation standards.
* Promote a safe work environment and participate in safety initiatives.

**Project Management**

* Manage automation projects from concept through implementation.
* Coordinate activities with equipment vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Develop project schedules, budgets, and technical specifications.
* Track project progress and communicate status updates.

* all other duties as assigned

  
  

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 3+ years of controls engineering experience in a manufacturing or assembly environment preferred.
* Experience with automated production equipment and industrial control systems.
* Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing operations.

**Technical Skills**

* PLC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Mitsubishi, or equivalent).
* HMI and SCADA development.
* Industrial robotics programming and troubleshooting.
* Motion controls, servo systems, VFDs, and motor controls.
* Industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet, Modbus, etc.).
* Electrical schematic design and interpretation.
* Root cause analysis and troubleshooting techniques.
* Microsoft Office and engineering software applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in automotive or large-scale assembly manufacturing.
* Knowledge of machine vision systems.
* Experience with MES integration and data collection systems.
* Project management experience.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or automation certifications are a plus.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Effective communication and teamwork.
* Project management and organizational abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Continuous improvement mindset.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

**Working Conditions**

* Manufacturing plant environment with exposure to machinery, noise, and moving equipment. Plant is climate controlled with heat and a/c.
* Ability to walk production areas and work on the manufacturing floor for extended periods.
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work flexible hours and respond to production emergencies when necessary.
  

  

Production is scheduled 4 ten hour days per week, with Friday overtime

  
  

***Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.***

**Benefits**
============

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

jobs.description:

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Lithia Springs, GA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Ridgeville, SC, USA; Cedar Rapids, IA, USA; Clarksville, TN, USA; Columbus, OH, USA; Lancaster, OH, USA; New Albany, OH, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; Red Oak, TX, USA; The Dalles, OR, USA; Fort Wayne, IN, USA; Sterling, VA, USA; Leesburg, VA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Henderson, NV, USA; Lincoln, NE, USA; Lenoir, NC, USA; Kansas City, MO, USA; Muskogee, OK, USA; Moncks Corner, SC, USA; New York, NY, USA; Phoenix, AZ, USA; Pryor, OK, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Reno, NV, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Tulsa, OK, USA; Bridgeport, AL, USA; Papillion, NE, USA; Bristow, VA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in mission critical facility design and construction environments.
* 12 years of experience in electrical design, operations, and commissioning of substations, switchgear, ATP/ATS, emergency power systems, power monitoring, and electrical protection.
* 12 years of experience as a practicing engineer.
* 5 years of experience in leadership roles.
* Experience in electrical infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or other relevant fields.
* Professional Engineering (PE) license.
* Experience with medium voltage systems.
* Experience with cross-discipline teams (e.g., structural, civil, IT/Telecom, security, mechanical, architectural).
* Experience in design, construction, and commissioning of high voltage substations, medium or low voltage electrical distribution systems, Aalternating Current (AC)/Direct Current (DC) systems, and associated power management or Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) tools.
* Experience working with data center equipment and environments (e.g., switchgear, generators, transformers, controls, security monitoring systems, fire safety systems), with an understanding of start up/commissioning processes.

**About the job**
-----------------

Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department - cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements - even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.  
  
With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical).

As a Lead Electrical Engineer (EE) in Data Center Services (DCS) team, you will drive consistency in technical planning/execution across North America. In this role, you will be a technical subject matter expert to our on-site execution teams, sharing best practices, lessons learned, and being a trusted advisor cross-functionally. You will represent DCS in various programmatic initiatives where a construction execution lens is required. You will act as an advocate of continuous improvement, delivery optimization, and closed loop learning, ensuring our facilities are built to the highest standards of safety, reliability, and efficiency.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor - Software Engineering
jobs.description:
The School of Computing (SoC) at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln (UNL) is undergoing strategic expansion and invites applications for a tenured/tenure-track faculty position at the Assistant or Associate Professor rank to begin in Fall 2027. SoC offers a collegial, collaborative culture and broad opportunities for interdisciplinary research across campus. We seek exceptional candidates who can establish a substantial scholarly research and teaching program in Software Engineering focused on improving the dependability, safety, and/or security of AI-based software systems. The successful candidate will join a rapidly growing Software Engineering community with opportunities to collaborate across AI, cybersecurity, robotics, agriculture, health, and data science initiatives at UNL.

  

**Position Description**

The successful candidate will pursue a strong research program in Software Engineering, with particular emphasis on methods, tools, and foundations for improving the dependability, safety, and security of AI-based software systems. We are especially interested in research addressing the design, development, testing, verification, validation, deployment, and evolution of software incorporating machine learning and deep learning models, generative AI and large language models, AI agents and agentic systems, autonomous systems, and cyber-physical systems. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to, testing and debugging of AI-enabled software; verification and validation of learning-enabled and agentic systems; formal methods and software assurance for trustworthy AI; safety, security, and reliability of autonomous and cyber-physical systems; explainability and interpretability as they relate to software assurance; integration of assurance techniques into modern software engineering workflows; and program analysis and other software engineering techniques for improving system dependability. While these areas are of particular interest, we welcome applicants whose research spans the broader field of Software Engineering.

The successful candidate will be expected to establish and maintain a vigorous, externally funded research program in Software Engineering or a closely related area. They will contribute to both undergraduate and graduate education through teaching of core courses in our Software Engineering program, mentoring graduate and undergraduate researchers, and offering courses aligned with their area of expertise. Additional responsibilities include active participation in school, college, and university governance, contributions to curriculum development, and engagement in interdisciplinary collaborations with partners across campus as well as in industry, government, and national laboratories. Candidates at the Associate Professor rank should demonstrate a sustained record of scholarly achievement, research leadership, external funding, graduate student mentoring, and national or international visibility in their field.

To support research success, the position includes a competitive startup package designed to establish a strong research program. This package provides funding for equipment, graduate student support, and research expenses, along with a reduced teaching load during the initial years. The successful candidate will also have access to modern laboratory space in our state-of-the-art facilities and shared departmental resources, including advanced computational infrastructure provided through Holland Computing Center (**hcc.unl.edu**).

**School of Computing Overview**

The SoC is undergoing an exciting period of significant growth and has hired 14 tenured/tenure-track faculty members since 2019. We are committed to promoting excellence among our faculty and seek to attract and retain a high-performing workforce in which employees’ differences are respected and valued to meet the varying needs of the populations we serve.

SoC is recognized for its work in Empirical Software Engineering, Testing, Formal Methods, and Mining Software Repositories, and is expanding into areas such as Software Security, Software Engineering in Robotics, and Human-centered Software Engineering. SoC is enhancing research in Data Science, AI, and Machine Learning, recently introducing a new Data Science undergraduate major, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Master’s degree and Graduate Certificate program, and undergraduate AI minor, aiming to develop impactful programs in health, agriculture, biocomputing, and robotics. The school also leads a Cybersecurity Initiative to tackle security challenges with AI and ML techniques. Additionally, SoC is a leader in IoT and Agricultural IoT, spearheading the Nebraska IoT Initiative through a public-private partnership. This includes collaborations on significant infrastructure projects and the formation of the interlocal agency iLNK. Furthermore, the NIMBUS lab excels at developing Uncrewed Aircraft Systems for agricultural and scientific applications and contributes to the $25 million Heartland Robotics Cluster.

**College Growth**

The College of Engineering has hired more than 70 new faculty members over the past five years and continues to grow its faculty base to support future expansion. The School of Computing is central to advancing the College’s ambitious research goals, supported by state-of-the-art facilities, including newly renovated research facilities for robotics, virtual/augmented reality, wireless communications, and IoT devices. The college recently unveiled a new $75 million research building and a $115 million engineering education building. The College is committed to providing a world-class engineering education through initiatives such as the nationally recognized Complete Engineer® Program. We are seeking an innovative leader with a clear vision for growth and a strong commitment to excellence in research, education, and engagement within the School of Computing.

  
  

**About** **UNL****, Lincoln, and Omaha**

jobs.description:
**ELECTRICAL ENGINEER - R&D**

**Hackettstown, New Jersey | Flexible Hybrid Schedule | Research & Development**

  

**WHY WORK FOR ASTRODYNE TDI?**

Astrodyne TDI develops power technologies and products that people depend on to enhance, protect, and save lives. With more than 60 years of power supply design experience, our technology supports demanding industrial, semiconductor, medical, aerospace, defense, and other critical-market applications.

**Hands-on innovation:** Turn advanced power-electronics and digital-control concepts into working hardware.

**Complete development cycle:** Work across simulation, architecture, circuit design, embedded firmware, prototyping, laboratory testing, and production readiness.

**Advanced technologies:** Gain exposure to digital power control, high-performance conversion topologies, and SiC and GaN devices.

**Technical collaboration:** Solve complex real-world problems alongside experienced engineers who value curiosity and teamwork.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Astrodyne TDI is seeking a motivated R&D Electrical Engineer who is excited about power electronics, digital control, and turning innovative concepts into working hardware. This hands-on role contributes to advanced switch-mode power supplies, digital control systems, and high-performance power conversion technologies. The engineer will work across simulation, circuit design, embedded firmware, prototyping, laboratory validation, troubleshooting, and cross-functional production support.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**Design & Develop Advanced Power Electronics**

* Design, prototype, and evaluate switch-mode power converters, including PFC, resonant LLC, phase-shifted full-bridge, buck, and boost topologies.
* Contribute to power architecture, circuit design, component selection, and design optimization.
* Develop high-reliability power conversion solutions for demanding industrial, medical, aerospace, and defense applications.

**Develop Digital Power Control**

* Implement real-time digital control loops for switch-mode power stages using Texas Instruments C2000 microcontrollers.
* Develop and test C/C++ firmware using TI C2000 peripherals, including ePWM, Type IV PWM, CMPSS, and high-speed ADCs.

* Practical experience with Texas Instruments C2000 microcontrollers, Code Composer Studio, and C2000Ware.
* Solid understanding of classical and digital control concepts, including peak current mode, average current mode, and voltage mode control.

**PREFERRED BACKGROUND**

* Experience with SiC and/or GaN wide-bandgap semiconductors.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Platform Observability and Intelligence
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

**Posting Open Date: 10/05/2026**

**Anticipated Posting Close Date\*: 12/05/2026**

* *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.*

**Software Engineer**

We are looking for a full-stack software engineer to join Fastly’s Platform Observability and Intelligence (POI) team.

The POI team is responsible for:

* Fastly's internal observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and more), spanning cloud infrastructure and physical hardware.
* Fastly's internal developer portal, built on Backstage.
* An internal set of tools and data pipelines that synthesize network and financial data to provide insights into network costs, capacity planning, and related business concerns.

We are specifically looking for someone to contribute to the first two items on this list, though you will work across all of our software.

This is a generalist, mid-level position, ideal for someone with a few years of experience who is seeking to grow their career. We are looking for an engineer who is curious, proactive, and eager to grow into an impactful role. You will work broadly and deeply, contribute meaningfully to projects that affect how Fastly engineers understand and operate their services, and build toward owning larger pieces of work over time.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, build and maintain software and platform capabilities that power Fastly’s internal observability function and developer experience
* Contribute to the development of our internal developer portal, helping engineering teams discover services, documentation, and operational tooling all in one place
* Work with your team to break down project requirements into concrete tasks, and take ownership of your assigned work through to completion
* Debug and resolve issues across the software stack, from datacenter hardware to the browser, often spanning multiple services and data sources
* Communicate clearly about the status of your work and any problems you encounter. Write useful updates, ask good questions, and raise issues early rather than at the deadline
* Collaborate with other engineers on the team. Provide thoughtful code review and share context and knowledge.
* Participate constructively in team planning and retrospectives
* Participate in on-call rotation as required, and respond to incidents within the team's SLA while on-call.

**What We're Looking For:**

Technical skills:

* 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver quality work on reasonably well-defined projects with limited oversight
* Experience in a statically typed, modern back-end language (Go, Java, Rust, etc.)
* Experience in modern front-end frameworks (React, etc.), or a willingness to dive in and become proficient
* Experience with SQL and database-driven applications
* Experience working with Linux systems and the shell
* Experience working with distributed systems or cloud-based services, and an interest in developing deeper expertise in operating and debugging them
* Comfort with large and unfamiliar codebases: jumping into a system you didn't build, figuring out the context, and contributing with confidence. Our stack is broad, and you will regularly work in code you haven't seen before, including code written at Fastly and open-source codebases.
* Strong debugging skills: forming hypotheses and narrowing down causes methodically. You’re willing to step outside your primary area of expertise to get to the bottom of something.

Ways of working:

* Clear, thoughtful writing and communication. You understand that a precise Slack message, a well-written pull request description, or a clear explanation to a teammate is just as important as the code itself.
* A service mindset. The people who use our tools depend on them to do their jobs. You care about their experience, you're approachable when they have questions, and you follow through and close the communication loop
* A proactive disposition. You take ownership of your responsibilities. When you finish a task, you look for the next useful thing. When you see something that could be better, you say so.
* Comfort working within lightweight agile processes. You participate constructively in planning and retrospectives, and you see team rituals as tools for coordination, productivity, and collaboration.
* A desire to grow in your skills, knowledge, and scope. Enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

**We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:**

* Backstage or other internal developer portal frameworks, open-source software in general
* Enterprise-scale observability systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, ELK, or similar
* Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Chef)
* Data science and data engineering, capacity planning, cost modeling, or FinOps practices
* Network protocols and infrastructure, datacenter infrastructure, physical server administration
* Training, teaching, or developing documentation and educational materials for internal tools

This position will require you to be available during core business hours. It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage.

jobs.description:
### **The Position**

**Senior Principal Robotics Engineer - CVRM**

ITOT supports Pharma Technical Manufacturing (PTM), PTM is responsible for managing all aspects of end-to-end drug substance and drug product manufacturing and supply. From the raw material to the final medicine, we contribute to delivering Roche’s ground-breaking therapies to more than 120 million patients around the world. We make our medicines at nine sites around the world and coordinate all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms. To ensure readiness for a step-change in the standard of care that Roche delivers in the area of Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM), PTM will construct a new manufacturing site in the U.S. in Holly Spring, North Carolina. ITOT will own and operate Manufacturing Technology stack at the site working with Global IT. The new site will focus on large volume low-cost Drug Product manufacturing (Component Prep & Compounding, Liquid PFS Filling, Automated Inspection, Autoinjector Assembly, Packaging/Finished Products).

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Principal Robotics Engineer will build, gain approval for, and fully implement the comprehensive robotics program for the Holly Springs Greenfield project. The role is essential for transforming the site's manual operations into a "Smart Factory" model, targeting a state-of-the-art Highly Automated Warehouse and the integration of Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) throughout the facility.

Initially, you will perform a mix of remote and onsite work (first at the General Planner’s office, later at construction site/plant). You will transition to local full-time on-site work once the site buildings are built and equipment delivered. Eventually, you will transition into the site-based robotics systems owner and provide site operations support on robotics. Travel of up to 30% of the time is expected during the project phase.

**What You Will Do**

* **Program Development & Implementation:** Create full context about the Holly Springs Robotics strategy to hone, get approval, and implement the comprehensive Holly Springs robotics program.
* **System Ownership & Support:** Eventually become the dedicated site-based robotics systems owner and provide ongoing, 24/7 site operations support on robotics once the facility goes live.
* **Team Leadership:** Possibly manage a team of robotics engineers in the future, scaling the team based on business needs and commercial filling requirements.
* **Robotics PIT Leadership:** Serve on the Robotics Project Implementation Team (PIT) to focus on robotics and technical enablement, implementation of industry standards, and ensuring seamless compatibility, connectivity, and data integrity.
* **Smart Factory Integration:** Lead the transition of manual operations into a "Smart Factory" model, integrating Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), AGVs (e.g., MiR, Geek+), and ASRS systems across end-to-end flows (kitting, filling, packaging, waste handling).

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).

Junior Software Engineer

* Develop interfaces between software components and external systems
* Support test planning, execution, and analysis for PNT-focused experiments, demonstrations, and evaluations
* Collaborate with systems engineers to align system requirements with software designs and implementations
* Document software implementations, interfaces, and test results to support technical reviews and deliverables
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering
* 0–2 years of professional experience developing software for technical systems (experience can include internships, co-ops, or academic projects)
* Programming experience in C#/C++ or Python
* Experience developing software on Linux and Windows based systems
* Familiarity with PNT concepts (e.g., Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSSs), inertial navigation, timing, sensor fusion)
* Experience integrating software with complex systems, simulations, or external hardware components

* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD security clearance
* Participate in team technical interchange meetings to describe technical activities, progress, issues, improvements, and more
  

  

**Desired Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Copeland is looking for a controls engineer on our Oil Free Centrifugal (OFC) development team. Our OFC compressors are sold to system manufacturers in HVAC and Data Center applications. It is a fast-paced and demanding environment as we adjust to customer requests. The main focus of the job will be development of the Human Machine Interface (HMI) program for the compressor with additional responsibilities supporting the compressor control logic. **The job is based in Sidney, OH with some opportunity for remote work. We will not be able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.**

  

**As a Centrifugal Controls Engineer, you will:**

* Work safely within office and lab testing environments, holding others to safety standards.
* Create, modify and test compressor HMI applications (currently in C#).
* Support compressor test team with lab controls, technician HMI views, and data recording.
* Document and track issue and feature requests in GitHub.
* Support application engineers with customer questions and troubleshooting.
* Support DFMEA reviews for controls and control hardware.
* Modify and test compressor control logic using structured text and function block diagram languages.
* Document control changes in internal specifications and customer manuals.
* Travel to customer locations for system control support and field troubleshooting (minimal time).
* Support compressor development team on control hardware selection and testing.
Support power electronics (variable frequency drive) development team with compressor controller and drive interactions.  

  

**Schedule:**

This role is hybrid eligible with the requirement to be in office at least three days per week. Colleagues are expected to demonstrate a collaboration first mindset, which is the understanding that teams will work together in-person and colleagues should be flexible to adjust their hybrid days based on business needs. You will have an opportunity to work with your team and leader to determine when you should be in office to drive meaningful connections and to best serve our customers.

  

**Required education, experiences & skills:**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering or related discipline.
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in industrial controls, application programming, electronics integration, or similar.
* Experience with programming languages (Industrial PLC/DCS, C#, Python, etc.).
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Ability to balance multiple projects in fast-paced engineering environment.
* Available to travel up to 10%, including internationally.
Legal Authorization to work in the United States - Sponsorship will not be provided for this role  

**Preferred education, experiences & skills:**

* HMI programming experience.
* Embedded controller programming experience.
* Experience in HVACR or Data Center applications.
Experience with compressors or turbomachinery.  

  

#LI-Hybrid #LI-GR1

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave.

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. **Position Title: Systems Engineer, Test & Validation Laboratory Hardware Support** (part-time)

  
  

The Systems Test & Validation Laboratory Hardware Support Engineer will provide part-time engineering support to a KBR and U.S. Air Force Simulation Test and Validation Laboratories. The primary responsibility of this position is maintaining and sustaining lab hardware, simulation infrastructure, and supporting equipment to ensure continuous operational readiness for test, evaluation, and mission rehearsal activities.

The selected candidate will serve as a senior technical resource responsible for hardware troubleshooting, system integration, configuration management, and maintenance of government-furnished and contractor-owned equipment supporting simulation and test environments. This role will work closely with engineers, software developers, simulation operators, and government stakeholders to ensure laboratory systems remain available, reliable, and capable of supporting program objectives.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  
  

**Hardware Maintenance & Sustainment**

* Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and upgrade laboratory hardware systems supporting simulation, testing, and validation activities.
* Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on servers, workstations, networking equipment, displays, racks, storage systems, and associated peripherals.
* Diagnose hardware failures and coordinate replacement or repair activities to minimize system downtime.
* Monitor hardware lifecycle status and provide recommendations for refresh or modernization efforts.
* Support installation, integration, and configuration of new hardware components.
  

  

**Simulation Lab Operations Support**

* Ensure simulation environments remain operational and available for scheduled test events.
* Support setup, tear-down, and reconfiguration of laboratory systems for test execution.
* Assist with system connectivity, equipment checkout, and operational readiness activities.
* Support troubleshooting efforts during test events and exercises.
  

  

**Systems Engineering & Integration**

* Support integration of hardware and software components within simulation and test architectures.
* Document system configurations, interfaces, dependencies, and engineering changes.
* Participate in technical reviews, design discussions, and configuration control activities.
* Evaluate impacts of proposed hardware and infrastructure changes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field.
* 8+ years of relevant engineering experience.
* Experience supporting complex hardware-intensive systems or laboratory environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* An active Secret Security Clearance is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting USAF, DoD, AFRL, AFLCMC, AFOTEC, or similar organizations.
* Experience working in Modeling & Simulation (M&S) environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise computing infrastructure.
* Experience supporting hardware used for test and evaluation activities.
* Experience with rack-mounted systems, networking equipment, and laboratory infrastructure.
* Active Top Secret Clearance.

**Desired Competencies**

* Systems Integration
* Hardware Sustainment
* Technical Troubleshooting
* Configuration Management
* Laboratory Operations
* Customer Engagement
* Technical Leadership
* Communication Skills

**Expected Commitment**

* Approximately 20 hours per week (0.5 FTE).
* Flexible schedule coordinated with laboratory testing requirements.
* On-site presence required to support hardware maintenance and laboratory operations.
  

  

**KBR Benefits**

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

### **Position Summary:**

Rockwell Automation is seeking a senior hardware engineering leader to help shape the next generation of industrial control platforms and the organization that delivers them. You will lead managers and multidisciplinary teams responsible for PLC, I/O, and communication products while influencing technology choices, product investments, engineering practices, and talent strategy across a global development organization.

  
  

This is not solely a program-execution role. You will balance near-term product delivery with longer-term improvements to our technology platforms, development system, and organizational capability. The role is intended for a leader who wants meaningful operating scope and the opportunity to grow into broader engineering responsibility. You will have meaningful autonomy to experiment and drive enterprise-level change in this role. This role is designed for a curious leader who builds fast-cycle experiments to test ideas, learn from evidence with their team, and scale what works.

  
  

This is a high visibility role that will challenge you to work across multiple investments and time horizons to solve problems and deliver product. As such, this role will report to the VP of Hardware Engineering who will serve as an active coach, mentor, and advocate for you and your career.

  
  

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Build organizational depth: Lead and develop 3–4 managers or team leads and their hardware engineering teams, strengthening performance, succession, technical capability, and accountability. Grow talent to take on the next set of complex problems we have yet to encounter.
* Deliver complex products: Own hardware execution from requirements and architecture through validation, certification, industrialization, and release through your management team. Connect pieces across different investments and drive simplicity and reduce overlap whenever possible. Increase reuse.
* Shape consequential decisions: Influence product investments, technology selections, engineering practices, and resource trade-offs across multiple programs and time horizons.
* Improve the engineering system: Remove barriers and improve predictability, quality, cost, speed of learning, and development effectiveness.
* Lead across boundaries: Partner with Product Management, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and global engineering teams to make trade-offs that produce the best customer and business outcomes.

In this role, success means:

* Product investments make visible progress against customer, business, quality, cost, and schedule outcomes. We deliver early and more whenever possible.

* Managers and technical leaders take greater ownership, make stronger decisions, and build deeper teams.

* The broader hardware organization maintains its predictability, but becomes more scalable, efficient, and effective because of improvements you help lead.
  

  

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field or equivalent years of relevant work experience.

* Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, not now or in the future, for this job opening.
* Ability to travel, including internationally up to 10% of time.
  

  

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Typically requires 8+ years of relevant engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple engineering teams or leaders through complex electronic product development, industrialization, and release, or leading a larger single team in a similar way.

* Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

* Experience delivering products in regulated environments (e.g., CE, IEC 61010).

* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (SAFe).

* Experience developing embedded hardware systems.

* Experience with industrial automation products or complex system-level designs.

* Experience working with global, distributed teams.

* Experience with project leadership or program management responsibilities.

* Experience with functional safety (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511) and/or cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443).

* Experience managing external partners or 3rd-party engineering resources.
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision

* 401k

* Paid Time off

* Parental and Caregiver Leave

* Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your leader to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.

* To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com .
  

  

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.
