jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Projects:** KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

* **Collaborative Environment:** Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Semiconductor Device Engineer to join our team researching Gallium Nitride and Ga2O3-based device development. This role is designed for an engineer with a strong foundation in semiconductor physics and a desire to work directly in a cleanroom environment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between virtual modeling and physical realization by fabricating test structures in our state-of-the-art cleanroom, conducting DC/RF electrical testing, performing TCAD simulations, and inspecting devices using advanced microscopy. You will work closely with colleagues to accelerate technology development and optimize device performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**
  

* Cleanroom Fabrication & Process Support: Spend active time in the cleanroom environment assisting with process steps, managing test runs, and operating fabrication equipment (e.g., photolithography, wet/dry etching, thin-film deposition).
* Electrical Characterization (DC & RF): Set up and execute parametric electrical testing. Perform DC measurements (I-V, C-V) and RF/high-frequency measurements (S-parameters) using manual or semi-automated probe stations, parameter analyzers, and network analyzers.
* Microscopy & Metrology: Conduct physical characterization and failure analysis on fabricated devices using advanced microscopy tools, including Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM), and optical microscopes.
* Device Simulation (TCAD): Utilize TCAD simulation tools (e.g., Sentaurus, Silvaco) to model basic device physics, predict electrical behaviors, and guide physical experiments.
* Data Analysis & Reporting: Compile, analyze, and present experimental data. Compare electrical measurements against TCAD simulation results to identify discrepancies and suggest device improvements.
* Documentation & Safety compliance: Maintain rigorous documentation of cleanroom runs, testing protocols, and safety procedures.

**Work Environment:**

* **Location:** Onsite
* **Travel Requirements:** Minimal 0-20%
* **Working Hours:** Standard

**Required Qualifications:**

**Education:** PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Nanoengineering, or a closely related engineering field; or MS degree in the same discipline with 3+ years of microelectronics experience beyond graduate school.

**Experience:** 4+ years of hands-on cleanroom experience (can include graduate research or internships)

Fabrication Skills: Familiarity with standard cleanroom protocols, safety standards, and basic microfabrication processing techniques.

**Testing & Metrology:**
  

* Experience with semiconductor parametric testing equipment (e.g., source measure units, lock-in amplifiers).
* Hands-on experience to DC/RF electrical characterization concepts.
* Direct experience operating optical microscopes; exposure to SEM or AFM is highly desirable.

**Simulation & Software**: Exposure to TCAD simulation software (e.g., Sentaurus, Silvaco, or COMSOL).

**Communication & Teamwork:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a strong publication record

**Security Clearance:** Must possess the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government clearance.

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

=============================

* **CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please** **login to Workday** **to complete the** **internal application process** **. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please** **login to Workday** **to complete the** **student application process.** **Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete** **the application process for external applicants** **.**
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see** **Notice to Out of State Applicants** **.**

**POSITION SPECIFICS**

Working location will be fully on-site, located in State College, PA. This role requires periodic travel to remote locations.

  

We are searching for experienced and dedicated Electric Propulsion and Power Systems (EPPS) Engineers to join the Electrical Power and Control Systems (EPCS) Department within the Undersea Systems Office (USO) at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. You will lead multidisciplinary engineering teams in project development of cutting edge electric and hybrid electric propulsion and power systems for undersea vehicles. Specifically, you will oversee the detail design, documentation, integration, and testing of high-power electric propulsion motors and controllers for undersea propulsion applications along with overall vehicle power system design and control. This will include laboratory and field testing for U.S. military and related applications.

  

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

  

**You Will:**

  

* Participate in full project life cycle design and development to deliver advanced, efficient and reliable electric and hybrid electric propulsion systems and power sub-systems

* Participate in system requirements identification, flow-down, and functional allocation followed by design reviews, design acceptance and documentation packages

* Execute detailed design stages including early design concept development, market surveys, analysis of alternatives, draft interface control and functional design documents, and write test plans/reports.

* Test EPPS subsystems including advanced hardware-in-the-loop test methods to support integration with larger systems of systems

* Use an array of advanced laboratory equipment to demonstrate the design satisfies the identified requirements and expectations

* Capture approved hardware designs using state of the art CAD tools

* Participate in large scale system integration exercises and requirement verification stages

Support laboratory and field testing of prototype EPPS systems to demonstrate and validate the final design  

  

**Additional Responsibilities for Senior Professional and Higher-level Positions Include:**

  

* Conduct independent and collaborative research, development, testing, and evaluation activities to solve complex scientific and engineering challenges supporting Department of Defense sponsors and national security missions

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

jobs.title: OT Systems Engineer (Physical Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

SpaceXSI is looking for a highly skilled and versatile OT (Operational Technology) Systems Engineer to implement and support the backend infrastructure for our next-generation controls and industrial software platforms for our physical infrastructure. This role is embedded within the mission IT organization to provide support to dedicated controls engineering organizations while leveraging adjacent IT expertise, tooling, and technologies. This role will balance support of legacy controls support systems with modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in high stakes settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and combines deep OT expertise with IT technologies such as virtualization, VDI, GitOps, network level redundancy and edge compute solutions to create streamlined and secure ICS environments.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, deploy, and augment next-generation OT environments that support plant and launch systems across multiple sites.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support industry standard controls software platforms as well as internally developed HMIs.
* Integrate established and emergent IT technologies to simplify management, improve security, and create scalable plant environments.
* Deploy and maintain development, test, and staging environments to enable controlled, systematic change introduction.
* Provide direct support during launch, test, and production campaigns.
* Perform systems/software upgrades and maintenance between critical operations (including evenings and weekends as needed).
* Proactively monitor services and respond rapidly to incidents to maintain high availability and performance.
* Leverage automation tools and contribute to infrastructure-as-code and broader DevOps initiatives with a focus on ICS environments.
* Work with internal controls engineers to iterate on simulation and emulation environment to enhance test coverage and augment change control processes.
* Write and maintain standards, architectures, best practices, and documentation (including system overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures), with emphasis on highly reliable and secure industrial environments, especially at data boundaries.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, security, controls, and operations) as well as external customers and integrators to design robust OT architectures and resolve technical issues.
* Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3+ years of experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration.
* Hands-on experience with multiple industry standard controls software platforms and tools.
* Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting OT environments in high-reliability settings.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.
* Experience designing architectures that incorporate hyperconverged, rugged industrial edge, and distributed compute technologies.
* Working knowledge of industrial protocols, controls networks, and OT cybersecurity best practices.
* Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Puppet, Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
* Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and DevOps concepts/tools.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, multi-platform authentication, and identity environments in OT contexts.
* System administration experience managing Windows and Linux servers, rudimentary database administration exposure, and storage/backup experience.
* Network administration experience and understanding of the OSI model, especially Layer 1/2/3 considerations as they apply to industrial and controls networks.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.
* Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.
* Ability to lift 30 lbs.
* Ability to work at heights.
* Ability to drive (active valid driver's license).

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Protection & Controls Engineer - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join the High Power Engineering team to design, set, commission, and maintain protection and control systems for large electrical infrastructure. As a Protection & Controls Engineer, you will own schemes and settings from the transmission interconnection through distribution, on-site generation, and battery energy storage, down to medium- and low-voltage buses serving data halls and other mission-critical loads. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop protection philosophy, one-line and three-line diagrams, DC control schematics, wiring diagrams, and relay panel layouts for the electrical system from the utility interconnection to facility buses.
* Calculate, implement, and maintain protective relay settings and logic for transmission lines, buses, power transformers, distribution feeders, generators, and battery energy storage / inverter-based resources.
* Specify relays, current and voltage transformers, trip circuits, lockout schemes, breaker-failure protection, and communications-assisted schemes (permissive, blocking, transfer trip).
* Perform short-circuit, protective-device coordination, and arc-flash studies; keep settings aligned with the study of record as the system changes.
* Commission protection systems: functional checks, primary and secondary injection, end-to-end scheme tests, and in-service timing checks. Use industry test sets (e.g. Doble, Omicron).
* Collect and analyze fault and disturbance records (COMTRADE and equivalent); recommend setting or scheme changes after events, misoperations, or staged tests.
* Maintain the settings management database, as-left files, and firmware/config control for in-service relays.
* Integrate protection with SCADA, RTUs, and plant/facility monitoring: DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850 (including GOOSE), and IEEE C37.118 synchrophasors as applicable.
* Support NERC PRC evidence and testing where the interconnection or generation/storage fleet requires it (e.g. PRC-005, PRC-019, PRC-024, PRC-027).
* Work with field technicians, operators, and contractors during outages, switching, and troubleshooting. Stay hands-on at the panel.
* Apply IEEE C37 (including line, transformer, bus, and generator protection), NESC, NFPA 70 / 70E, IEEE 1547, and IEEE 2800 as they apply to the assets in scope.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or another engineering discipline.
* 3+ years of protection and controls experience (settings, design, or commissioning) on medium- or high-voltage systems.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years in a protection and controls role at a utility, independent power producer, EPC, relay manufacturer (e.g. SEL), or hyperscale / colocation data center operator.
* Hands-on experience with Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) relays and software (AcSELerator QuickSet, synchroWAVe Event, or equivalent). GE, ABB, Siemens, or Beckwith experience also valued.
* SELogic or equivalent relay logic; settings templates; a formal settings management process.
* Short-circuit and coordination studies in ETAP, ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, SKM, or EasyPower.
* Transmission and distribution protection (line, bus, transformer, feeder) plus at least one of: generator protection, BESS/inverter-based resource protection, or mission-critical facility / data hall medium-voltage protection.
* Commissioning with Doble F6150, Omicron CMC, or equivalent; event-record analysis after faults.
* Familiarity with DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850, IEEE C37.118, IEEE C37.111, and IEEE C37.232.
* Working knowledge of IEEE C37.102 (generator), C37.91 (transformer), C37.234 (bus), IEEE 1547 / 2800 (interconnection and inverter-based resources), and applicable NERC PRC standards.\
* Professional Engineering license, or actively working toward one.
* Ability to support technicians in the field and to remain effective during outages and event investigations.

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.
* Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support construction, energization, and operations.
* Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.
* Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted.
* Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies.
* Willing to work on-site in Memphis, TN. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
* Travel up to 25% for factory witness testing, vendor and OEM engagement, and supporting other sites.
* Valid driver's license.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Power Generation) - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join the power generation engineering team to design, commission, and maintain plant control systems. As a Controls Engineer, you will own BOP PLC/HMI and the control-room SCADA picture that brings generation and balance-of-plant into one operating view — Solar, 6000, and BOP on a single set of screens. You will work from control philosophy through commissioning and ongoing reliability, hands-on at the panel and in the control room. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own BOP PLC and HMI design, programming, and commissioning for power generation balance-of-plant systems (fuel gas, water, compressed/instrument air, HVAC, cooling, electrical auxiliaries, and related process/utility systems)

* Design and maintain the plant SCADA architecture so operators have one operating picture in the control room integrating Solar, 6000, and BOP — graphics, alarms, historian, and situational awareness on a single platform

* Develop control philosophy, control narratives, I/O lists, network drawings, cause-and-effect diagrams, and HMI/SCADA standards for reuse across the facility

* Specify PLC, HMI, SCADA, remote I/O, industrial networking, and interface hardware; define data exchange with OEM turbine/generation controllers (Solar and 6000) and with electrical protection, metering, and plant systems

* Program, test, and troubleshoot PLC logic and HMI applications (IEC 61131 — ladder, function block, structured text as applicable)

* Integrate OEM packages and third-party systems into plant SCADA using industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, IEC 61850, and others as required) so Solar, 6000, and BOP operate as one system

* Commission controls: I/O checkout, loop checks, functional testing, HMI validation, alarm rationalization, and start-up support; stay hands-on with technicians and operators

* Support day-to-day operations: troubleshooting, sequence issues, bad actors, and control changes under MOPs/MOC

* Maintain configuration management for PLC/HMI/SCADA programs, as-left files, firmware, and network documentation

* Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, fluids, protection, and operations so controls scope is fully integrated through construction, commissioning, and turnover

* Apply relevant standards for industrial control systems and electrical work (NFPA 70 / 70E, IEC 61131, and site cybersecurity/ICS practices such as NERC CIP where applicable)

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, controls engineering, computer engineering, or another engineering discipline

* 3+ years of experience in PLC, HMI, and/or SCADA engineering (design, programming, or commissioning) on industrial or power generation systems

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years in a controls role at a power plant, independent power producer, OEM, EPC, or heavy industrial facility

* Hands-on BOP PLC/HMI experience on gas turbine or similar generation projects

* Experience building a unified control-room SCADA/HMI that aggregates multiple OEM controllers (e.g. Solar, 6000, or equivalent turbine packages) with plant BOP

* Familiarity with major platforms (e.g. Ignition, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Emerson, GE, SEL) and industrial networking (IT/OT)

* Experience with IEC 61131 programming and protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, and IEC 61850

* Experience across the project lifecycle: design, programming, construction support, commissioning, and operations

* Experience with alarm management, historian, and control-room graphics that operators actually use

* Working knowledge of how BOP controls interface with electrical power systems (switchgear, protection, metering) without owning relay settings

* Experience managing OEM and contractor interfaces on multi-discipline power or capital projects

* Professional Engineering license, or actively working toward one

* Ability to support technicians in the field and to remain effective during outages, start-up, and event investigations

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to perform hands-on work in the plant and control room, including during outages and commissioning

* Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support power generation operations

* Must be able to work on-site in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other SpaceXSI facilities

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s Data Core organization, you will build and operate high performance networking and storage data path software for DPU accelerated systems. You will work across hardware, firmware interfaces, Linux, and cloud services to improve throughput, latency, reliability, and scale.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer with deep networking data path experience who can turn performance measurements into effective designs and production software. You will lead complex technical work, contribute to engineering practices, and provide direction and mentorship to other engineers.

  

**Required qualifications**

* At least 8 years of software engineering experience, including substantial C or C++ development on Linux.
* Deep hands-on experience building or optimizing high performance networking data paths, including packet processing and hardware offload.
* Experience developing for a DPU or SmartNIC platform, such as AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField, Intel SmartNIC, or comparable hardware.
* Working knowledge of storage virtualization, PCIe SR-IOV, and the NVMe and NVMe-oF protocol family.
* Ability to diagnose throughput and latency issues across software and hardware boundaries, and to improve performance on CPU and memory constrained systems.
* Experience using Go, Python, or another scripting language for development, testing, or operational tooling.
* Ability to lead complex work while contributing directly to implementation and debugging.
* A BS or MS degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with P4 programming and pipelines.
* Experience with SPDK, NVMe drivers, RDMA, or NVMe-oF implementations.
* Experience with data encryption in transit or at rest, TCG Opal, or cryptographic hardware offload.
* Experience building and operating data path software at cloud scale.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re hiring an experienced **Manufacturing Controls Engineer** to join a well-established industrial manufacturing operation in Mascot, TN.

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role focused on improving equipment reliability, automation, manufacturing efficiency, and overall plant performance. You'll serve as a key technical resource for the facility, working directly with production, maintenance, and engineering teams to troubleshoot complex equipment issues, optimize existing automation systems, and implement new manufacturing technologies.

The facility operates a variety of automated manufacturing, machining, assembly, and inspection equipment. We're looking for an engineer who is comfortable working directly on the plant floor, understands industrial electrical systems, and can independently troubleshoot, program, and improve PLC-controlled equipment.

Beyond day-to-day troubleshooting, you'll have the opportunity to **own automation and capital improvement projects from initial concept through installation, commissioning, and implementation.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Controls & Automation Engineering**

* Program, troubleshoot, modify, and optimize PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and support HMI systems, industrial controls, and automated production processes.
* Troubleshoot electrical and controls issues involving PLCs, VFDs, servo drives, motors, sensors, and industrial networks.
* Integrate and improve automated equipment, robotics, machine vision, and motion control systems.
* Support CNC equipment, automated inspection systems, and other complex manufacturing technologies.
* Maintain and update electrical schematics, controls documentation, and equipment standards.

**Manufacturing & Equipment Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve equipment uptime, throughput, quality, and manufacturing efficiency.
* Partner with maintenance and production teams to resolve recurring equipment issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Analyze manufacturing and equipment performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continuous improvement, equipment reliability, and preventive maintenance initiatives.

**Capital Projects & Technical Leadership**

* Lead equipment upgrades, automation projects, and new equipment installations.
* Develop project scopes, technical specifications, budgets, and implementation plans.
* Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, contractors, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Oversee equipment commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and production handoff.
* Provide technical guidance and training to maintenance technicians and production personnel.
* Support electrical safety, machine safeguarding, and compliance with applicable industrial standards.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience working with **industrial controls and automated equipment in a manufacturing environment.**
* Strong hands-on experience with **PLC programming, troubleshooting, and HMI systems.**
* Ability to troubleshoot industrial electrical systems, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, and motor controls.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and modifying electrical schematics.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing equipment, industrial automation, and electrical troubleshooting.
* Ability to independently diagnose complex equipment issues and implement practical solutions.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with production, maintenance, and engineering teams.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

jobs.title: Regional Lead Data Center Electrical Engineer, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Lithia Springs, GA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Ridgeville, SC, USA; Cedar Rapids, IA, USA; Clarksville, TN, USA; Columbus, OH, USA; Lancaster, OH, USA; New Albany, OH, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; Red Oak, TX, USA; The Dalles, OR, USA; Fort Wayne, IN, USA; Sterling, VA, USA; Leesburg, VA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Henderson, NV, USA; Lincoln, NE, USA; Lenoir, NC, USA; Kansas City, MO, USA; Muskogee, OK, USA; Moncks Corner, SC, USA; New York, NY, USA; Phoenix, AZ, USA; Pryor, OK, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Reno, NV, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Tulsa, OK, USA; Bridgeport, AL, USA; Papillion, NE, USA; Bristow, VA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in mission critical facility design and construction environments.
* 12 years of experience in electrical design, operations, and commissioning of substations, switchgear, ATP/ATS, emergency power systems, power monitoring, and electrical protection.
* 12 years of experience as a practicing engineer.
* 5 years of experience in leadership roles.
* Experience in electrical infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or other relevant fields.
* Professional Engineering (PE) license.
* Experience with medium voltage systems.
* Experience with cross-discipline teams (e.g., structural, civil, IT/Telecom, security, mechanical, architectural).
* Experience in design, construction, and commissioning of high voltage substations, medium or low voltage electrical distribution systems, Aalternating Current (AC)/Direct Current (DC) systems, and associated power management or Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) tools.
* Experience working with data center equipment and environments (e.g., switchgear, generators, transformers, controls, security monitoring systems, fire safety systems), with an understanding of start up/commissioning processes.

**About the job**
-----------------

Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department - cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements - even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.  
  
With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical).

As a Lead Electrical Engineer (EE) in Data Center Services (DCS) team, you will drive consistency in technical planning/execution across North America. jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a member of the facility operations team, you will design, build, and activate some of the world's most technically advanced facilities and data centers. As an electrical engineer, you will design and build power systems that directly contribute to new infrastructure projects. You will be able to operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex problems, excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will work with other MEP engineers, trade partners, and internal customers to support these goals and have the opportunity to drive real global impact, ultimately leading to making life multiplanetary.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Work in a team environment with other engineering disciplines to provide detailed electrical design and specification for the installation of the following equipment and systems:
  + Electrical power distribution systems.
  + Switch-gear and motor control centers.
  + Exterior and interior lighting.
  + Ground support system controls and ladder logic.
  + Uninterruptible power supply (UPS) units.
  + Standby and emergency generators.
  + Automatic transfer switches.
  + Power monitoring hardware and software.
  + Data/phone distribution and wiring.
  + Building and site grounding systems.
  + Fire alarm systems and lightning protection systems.
* Provide electrical engineering support to facility technicians to troubleshoot existing electrical equipment and controllers.
* Provide engineering support for the design, operation, and troubleshooting of all the facility's electrical components and systems, including:
  + Load flow analysis of electrical power distribution systems.
  + Electrical equipment evaluation.
  + Building and facility equipment grounding.
  + Power monitoring hardware and software.
* Ensure that all equipment interfaces properly with other mechanical and electrical systems, including compatibility with facility power budgets.
* Coordinate all electrical installations and maintenance activities with local electrical utilities personnel.
* Ensure all electrical designs and installations conform to applicable codes and regulations.
* Provide code review and analysis utilizing NFPA 70E, NFPA 70 NEC, NFPA 497, NFPA 101, Vol 5 & 6 AFSPCMAN 91-710, and IBC.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline.
* 3+ years of professional experience working on electrical projects, power distribution systems, switchgear, UPS's, and/or generators.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5+ years of years of professional experience in a similar role.
* Professional Engineering (PE) license.
* Ability to read and understand power and control schematics.
* Ability to read and understand highly technical equipment operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals.
* Experience with variable frequency drives (VFDs) and industrial pumps.
* Experience with controls in MODBUS communication.
* Experience with medium voltage distribution.
* Experience with control panel design and production.
* Working knowledge of power coordination and arc flash.
* Ability to work on multiple tasks concurrently.
* High level of self-motivation, with the ability to work under minimal supervision.
* Good organizational skills.
* Ability to prioritize and schedule workload.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

**Job Title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems Engineer**

**Location: Arnold AFB, TN**

**Job Family Code: O - Engineering**

**Function/Branch: Engineering/ID&C**

**Directorate: Mission Information Services**

**Position Type: Regular, Full-Time**

**Pay Type: Exempt**

**Grade: L09(TA0913) - L10(TA1015)**

**Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate: L09: $112,000 - $149,500; L10: $131,000 - $174,500/ per year**

  

**Overview**

Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for an HWIL Systems Engineer supporting the Test Operations and Sustainment (TOS) II contract at Arnold Engineering Development Complex (AEDC), Arnold Air Force Base, TN.

  

In this role, you will be the primary operational lead for the Range Systems Support Laboratory (RSSL), an operational facility that provides AEDC with the ability to simulate complex testing environments to develop, test, and validate software and controls logic. You will oversee lab modernization, configuration management, and readiness to ensure mission-critical ground test support for key national aerospace programs. You will also maintain readiness for HWIL systems that have been deployed to test facilities.

  

If you are seeing this posting on an external job board, BNH highly recommends you apply directly on the Careers Center page of our business website (https://careers-bnh.icims.com/jobs). Job board applications are not always compatible with company applicant tracking systems.

  

***Open to internal and external candidates.***

  

**Job Summary**

The HWIL Systems Engineer is responsible for ensuring operational readiness of the RSSL, a critical simulation and testing environment. This includes managing lab configurations, supporting pre-test mission evaluations, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring the facility is prepared for a wide range of validation activities. The successful candidate will interface daily with System Administrators, Controls and Data SMEs, Control Systems Engineers, Facility Modeling Engineers, and external vendors like MathWorks to support development and troubleshooting.

This role is central to reducing risk and cost for AEDC by enabling robust "off-line" analysis and investigation of operational issues without requiring costly "air-on" facility time. Key strategic initiatives for this role include leading efforts in modernization, automated regression testing, reflective memory replacement, and footprint consolidation.

  

**Job Duties:**

* Maintain a stable, structured environment for plant simulation, development, and checkout activities for facilities such as the Engine Test Facility (ETF), Propulsion Wind Tunnel (PWT), and Aerodynamic and Propulsion Test Unit (APTU).
* Work with HWIL users to troubleshoot the simulation environment.
* Lead Lab Configuration Management, ensuring all hardware, software, and simulation models are under strict revision control.
* Direct and prepare lab configurations for testing and validation, including pre-test mission evaluations to ensure readiness.
* Serve as the primary interface with System Administrators, Modeling and Controls SMEs, Data SMEs, Control Systems Engineers, Facility Modeling Engineers, and software vendors (e.g., MathWorks) to support simulation, development, and issue resolution.
* Oversee and drive key lab modernization initiatives, including reflective memory replacement, automated regression testing, authoring the next generation of High-Speed Digital Interface, and footprint consolidation, using software vendors as necessary.
* Work with System Administrators to provide a consistent user experience by managing centralized services, including account management, security control, file servers, and simulation status monitoring.
* Support the training of facility operators and systems engineers on new or revised control systems, contributing to the 'Safe Reliable Effective Operation' (SREO) initiative.
* Maintain readiness for HWIL systems that have been deployed to test facilities
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies to identify and evaluate opportunities for improving the efficiency, performance, and reliability of deployed systems.
* It is a condition of employment to wear company-issued Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.
  

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Computer Engineering from an accredited institution and a minimum of eight (8) years of engineering experience in an aerospace, industrial test, or R&D environment, which includes:
  + Professional experience with the development, integration, or sustainment of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) systems, real-time simulation environments, or industrial control systems (ICS).
  + Experience with configuration management and troubleshooting of hardware and software within a laboratory or test facility.
* OR, in lieu of a bachelor’s degree, a high school diploma or equivalent and a minimum of twelve (12) years of professional technical experience in the same fields, which includes:
  + Professional experience with the development, integration, or sustainment of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) systems, real-time simulation environments, or industrial control systems (ICS).
  + Experience with configuration management and troubleshooting of hardware and software within a laboratory or test facility.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain an active security clearance and maintain authorized user access to the AEDC local area network.
* U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal government contract compliance requirements and the necessity to access secure federal databases and networks on Arnold Air Force Base.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and/or simulation environments.
* Background in a DoD, aerospace, or industrial test/R

* As an Electrical Engineer 1 in our Nuclear Power Group, you will play a vital role on projects that make a real impact. You will help design and modernize critical electrical systems and large power components for existing nuclear plants, first-of-a-kind restart projects, small modular reactors (SMRs), and advanced reactor facilities. You will also support plant life-extension and digital upgrade initiatives. Your contributions will help make nuclear energy safer, more efficient, and more reliable for the communities we serve.
* You will work alongside a project team, receiving daily technical supervision and support from experienced engineers and subject matter experts (SME’s) in nuclear power generation and electrical power systems design. You will benefit from hands-on learning, technical training, and collaboration across engineering disciplines, while leveraging our established system of technical processes — including industry standards, internally developed guidance and standards informed by decades of experience, and our extensive performance improvement database — to help deliver safe and reliable solutions.
* Working under the direction of senior engineers, this position will offer you the opportunity to utilize and expand your academic background in electrical engineering in one or more of the following areas:
  + Assist in the preparation of engineering calculations and design tasks for large nuclear power generating stations, including protection and coordination studies, cable sizing, medium and low voltage system design, DC battery sizing, and analyses that supports electrical designs for safety-related systems.
  + Utilize industry-standard software tools like ETAP to perform power systems analysis and modeling for complex electrical networks.
  + Assist with the design, selection, and integration of major electrical power equipment, such as switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), large power transformers, breakers, relays, and related systems essential to nuclear power generation station operation.
  + Partner with multidisciplinary engineering teams and engage in technical training sessions and reviews.
  + Gain exposure to station-specific procedures and real-world project requirements, with opportunities to interface with client stakeholders such as Operations and Systems Engineering representatives.
  + Collaborate with designers and drafters to translate engineering concepts into detailed drawings, providing practical experience in bringing designs to life and supporting project deliverables.
  + Develop professional skills by working within fixed project schedules and budgets, learning effective time management and collaboration tools to achieve shared objectives. Gain firsthand experience in communicating and coordinating with team members to deliver high-quality engineering solutions on time and within scope.
  + Work alongside experienced professional engineers and gain valuable insight into the pathway to professional licensure, including mentorship and exposure to the career development steps required to become a licensed Professional Engineer (PE).
  + Gain unescorted access to nuclear power generating stations to conduct onsite walkdowns, witness installation and testing activities, and support nuclear refueling outages, as well as participate in the implementation of major projects you helped design.
  + Access client computer systems to review station-specific drawings, calculations, procedures, and other technical information, building expertise in design and licensing basis and electrical power systems for a specific nuclear facility.
  + Obtain qualifications to work under supervision as a preparer for unique engineering deliverables, and have the opportunity to sign off as a qualified preparer on critical project documentation.

Qualifications:

**We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.**

Essential skills and experience:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s of Science degree in Electrical Engineering with a strong academic background in electrical power concepts/power systems analysis
* An understanding of the practical application of electrical engineering and technology including applying systems, principles, techniques, and procedures to a project design
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in the production of technical plans, drawings, and models
* Proficiency with MS Office applications
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills

Valued but not required skills and experience:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s of Science degree from an ABET Engineering Accreditation Commission-approved program
* Completion of power coursework, such as Power Systems Analysis, Electric Machinery, Power Electronics, or similar
* Internship or work experience in performing power analysis, preferably within the power industry
* Experience performing transient analysis of power systems using software such as ETAP or SKM
* Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam, and designation as an Engineer in Training

Technology & Innovation:

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.
  
  
We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.
  
  
Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable application platforms that enable product engineering teams to move safely to production. The focus is on enabling secure, reliable, and operationally mature services through embedded platform engineering. As the Application Platform Engineer, you will work directly inside product engineering groups as a functional team member, participating in design reviews, architecture decisions, and operational readiness assessments.

The role combines deep expertise in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and application architecture. It operates with a platform-as-a-product mindset, enabling self-service capabilities through developer platforms (e.g., Backstage) and internal developer tools to accelerate delivery and standardization.

This is a Hybrid position located in Frisco, TX. You will be required to be on-site on an as-needed basis; when you are not working on-site, you will work from your home office. You must be within commutable distance of Frisco, TX. We are not offering relocation assistance at this time.

* Establish observability standards: distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and alerting using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, or Instana.

* Experience with integration and end-to-end testing frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, Testcontainers).

* Strong knowledge of databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, SQL Server).
* Experience with message queuing (Confluent Kafka, Redis) and distributed systems concepts.
* Security and supply chain knowledge: SonarQube, BlackDuck/Coverity, Dependabot, JFrog, or equivalent; experience with remediation workflows.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are:  
Venus Aerospace is revolutionizing rocket engine propulsion. With the first generational leap in rocket engine technology since Apollo, our proprietary Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine and Venus Detonation Ramjets deliver historic efficiency and performance across aerospace applications. We are building the next generation of propulsion platforms that enable breakthrough capabilities in space, defense, and commercial high-speed flight. Our team thrives on solving the toughest engineering challenges and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in aerospace. At Venus, we’re looking for bold engineers and innovators who want to make history and redefine the future of propulsion.

The Role: Embedded Software Engineer  
We are seeking a talented Embedded Software Engineer to help develop the flight software that powers our next-generation avionics and flight computer systems. You’ll join a small, multidisciplinary Software team that currently spans embedded systems, ground software, hardware test and data acquisition, HIL/V&V, and internal enterprise software. As an early member of our growing Embedded Software team, you’ll have significant ownership in shaping the architecture, processes, and technical direction of this area. As the company grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on technical and people leadership and help build out the Embedded Software organization.

### **What You'll Get To Do**

* Develop Flight Software
* Design, implement, and integrate real-time embedded software for our flight computers and avionics systems.
* Translate system and hardware requirements into robust, maintainable, and testable software.
* Work across the hardware/software boundary to bring up, debug, and integrate embedded systems.

Build for Reliability:

* Develop software with the rigor required for mission-critical aerospace systems, including fault handling, verification, and configuration management.
* Develop automated unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing to verify flight software.
* Collaborate with Avionics, GNC, Test, Ground Software, and QA engineers to identify and solve complex system-level problems.

Shape the Embedded Team:

* Help establish our embedded software architecture, development processes, tools, and engineering practices.
* Take ownership of projects from initial concept through implementation, integration, and flight readiness.
* Grow with the company and, as the team expands, have the opportunity to mentor engineers and lead the Embedded Software organization.

### **What You Have**

Experience-Level:

* Software engineer with 5+ years’ experience developing embedded systems for flight-related systems.
* Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline. Advanced degree a plus. Equivalent professional experience may be considered.

Embedded Software Fundamentals:

* Strong proficiency in C and/or C++ for resource-constrained embedded systems.
* Experience developing software for microcontrollers, SoCs, or embedded CPUs.
* Strong understanding of embedded concepts:
* Interrupts and interrupt handling
* DMA peripherals
* Memory-mapped I/O
* Timers and watchdogs
* Serial communication interfaces
* Concurrency and synchronization
* Memory management and resource constraints
* Ability to read schematics, datasheets, reference manuals, and hardware specifications and translate them into software requirements.

Real-time Systems:

* Experience developing real-time embedded software with deterministic timing requirements
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts, such as scheduling, priorities, synchronization, inter-task communication, and timing analysis.
* Understanding of latency, jitter, deadline misses, and failure modes in real-time systems.
* Experience reasoning about system behavior when multiple asynchronous events occur simultaneously.

Safety/Reliability-Critical Aerospace Software:

* Experience developing software where correctness, reliability, and fault handling are critical.
* Experience with:
* Fault detection and handling
* Redundancy or graceful degradation
* Watchdogs and health monitoring
* Startup/self-test behavior
* Robust state-machine design
* Safe handling of unexpected inputs and hardware faults
* Understanding of the difference between nominal behavior and behavior during degraded or failed hardware/software conditions.
* Experience with Weapons Open Systems Architecture (WOSA) and Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA).

Verification and Testing:

* Experience writing unit & integration tests
* Ability to create test cases from software requirements.
* Familiarity with code coverage and other objective measures of verification.
* Ability to diagnose problems spanning the SW/HW boundary.

Software Engineering Practices:

* Good candidates should be comfortable with:
* GIT and modern code-review workflows
* CI/CD for embedded systems
* Static analysis and compiler diagnostics
* Automated regression testing
* Requirements tracking and traceability
* Issue tracking and defect analysis
* Peer reviews of both code and design
* Writing clear technical documentation

Systems-Level Thinking:

* Collaborate closely with Avionics, GNC, Propulsion, Test, and Ground Software engineers
* Translate system-level requirements into software architecture and implementation
* Understand interfaces between flight software and sensors, actuators, communications systems, and other onboard computers.
* Participate in system architecture and interface definition
* Diagnose problems that may originate in hardware, firmware, software, configuration, or integration.

### **What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience developing or integrating embedded software within modular weapons, missiles, avionics, or other mission-critical architecture.
* Familiarity with defensive programming and failure containment.
* Experience interfacing/developing code for FPGAs
* MIL-STD-1553,

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Core Systems and Capacity Assurance (CSCA) Team is responsible for the journey of a new system from the point of manufacturing to data center delivery. We do this on projects that push the limits of technologies and provide you with an opportunity to make a broad impact across all of Google's product families. The technologies include systems that support machine learning, video transcoding, security, general compute, image processing, and storage. You will be a part of the new emerging technologies and systems that push the limits of computation. Please note this position requires about 20% Travel to Google Data Centers primarily in US, and also to Manufacturing CM partner sites in US, Mexico, and possibly Asia.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage the development of automation, processes, and diagnostics in support of new product introduction to enable the efficient installation, configuration, testing and management of new data center hardware from the time of manufacturing to installation.
* Develop new product test solutions, and will work closely with our hardware and software partner teams to ensure that the end to end data center automated diagnosis and repair systems are working efficiently and integrated properly with the signals generated from our test infrastructure and diagnostics.
* Develop software that executes in thousands of systems in parallel and develop the data insights required to analyze the complex result sets, and optimize repair strategies for fault coverage and fault isolation.
* Manage the new product introduction process to ensure that new hardware platforms turn up from manufacturing to our data centers.
