jobs.description:
**About Neuralink:**

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

**Team Description:**

Neuralink's Information Technology team owns the corporate environment that every engineer, scientist, and clinician depends on to do their work. Within IT, the Compute function is responsible for the physical and server infrastructure that powers neural recording training, data processing, and engineering workloads: the data center floor itself, the GPU and HPC clusters that run on it, and the storage, provisioning, and monitoring that keep those systems healthy. We build this infrastructure from the ground up, manage it as code, and treat uptime for research workloads as production.

**Job Description and Responsibilities:**

Neuralink is looking for a hands-on Systems Engineer with deep expertise in data center design, build, and operations. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our compute and storage infrastructure, from site buildout and hardware procurement through deployment, automation, and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate brings equal comfort on the data center floor and at the keyboard, thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, and has a passion for building reliable, scalable systems from the ground up. The job responsibilities will include:

* Design, build, and operate data center environments including power infrastructure (PDUs, UPS, generators), cooling systems (CRAC/CRAH, liquid cooling), and scalable racking; drive capacity planning for power, cooling, and floor space
* Own the full server and storage lifecycle: hardware selection and procurement, rack and cable, commissioning with BIOS/firmware tuning and integration testing, maintenance, and decommission
* Administer and manage HPC and GPU clusters and high-performance storage systems
* Automate server provisioning using PXE/HTTP boot, scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python), and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Puppet
* Administer Linux and Windows server environments including OS deployment, patching, hardening, and performance tuning
* Operate infrastructure monitoring and alerting; drive capacity planning for compute and storage from the data
* Plan and coordinate maintenance windows, upgrades, and expansions; maintain 24/7 on-call readiness for compute and storage incidents
* Ensure all systems comply with HIPAA, PII handling requirements, and applicable cybersecurity standards (ISO, NIST)
* Author and maintain systems design documents, rack and power diagrams, runbooks, SOPs, hardware inventory, and DCIM records

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience building and supporting HPC or high-density compute environments: GPU clusters, high-performance storage
* Hands-on experience with data center power, cooling, and racking design and operations
* Strong Linux server administration experience; working knowledge of Windows Server
* Experience automating bare-metal provisioning (PXE/HTTP boot) and configuration management with Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet
* Familiarity with DCIM tools and infrastructure monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and NTP as they apply to server deployment and troubleshooting
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field OR equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with cluster resource managers (Slurm, LSF, PBS)
* Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/Proxmox) and storage ecosystems (NAS/SAN, NFS/iSCSI)
* Hands-on experience deploying liquid-cooled GPU racks
* Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry environments
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD for infrastructure pipelines
* Industry certifications such as CDCP, RHCE, or equivalent data center and Linux certifications

**What We Offer:**

Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits listed below.

* An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields
* Growth potential; we rapidly advance team members who have an outsized impact
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan

* Commuter benefits

* Flexible time off *\*Temporary Employees & Interns excluded*

jobs.title: Lead Application Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Overview:

At McAfee, you'll architect and lead platform solutions in a fast-paced environment where innovation shapes enterprise infrastructure. As a Lead Application Platform Engineer, you'll set technical direction, establish patterns and standards for platform teams, and drive architectural decisions that impact multiple product engineering groups. This technical  
leadership role elevates developer productivity and operational excellence across the organization.

The Lead Application Platform Engineer operates as a technical leader — not a manager — bringing depth, influence, and mentorship. This engineer sets the patterns and standards the platform team builds on, serves as the escalation point for production issues, and is the technical voice engineering leaders consult before major commitments. The role combines deep expertise in application architecture, platform engineering, and distributed systems with the ability to mentor and influence other engineers.

  
Position Details:

**About The Role**

  

* Embed with two to three assigned product engineering groups, participating as a functional team member while maintaining a broader platform perspective.
* Own and evolve reference architectures—a curated set of blessed patterns (synchronous services, asynchronous workers, data pipelines) with Infrastructure-as-Code starters, monitoring checklists, runbook templates, and cost models.
* Act as the escalation point for production and architecture problems across multiple engineering groups; lead technical response to major incidents alongside SRE.
* Set the technical standard for the platform team: define the bar for review approach, testing depth, instrumentation baseline, and what 'operationally ready' means in practice.
* Mentor two to four Application Platform Engineers, including onboarding new hires into unfamiliar product domains and codebases; grow the technical capabilities of the team.
* Represent platform constraints and capabilities in architecture discussions with engineering leadership; carry group constraints back into Release Engineering and SRE roadmaps.
* Drive structural fixes after major incidents; lead the analysis of root causes and oversee implementation of preventive measures.
* Evaluate and introduce tooling (AI-assisted development, test generation, performance and security tools); prove value before team standardization.
* Design multi-service architectures and reason about failure modes, blast radius, data consistency, and cost before code is written.
* Contribute meaningfully in at least two of Go, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, or .NET; comfortable in a third at short notice.
* Lead capacity and scalability analysis; interpret profiling and tracing data to locate bottlenecks across service boundaries.
* Build internal tooling and automation frameworks that the rest of the platform team depends on, including AI-assisted migration and review workflows.
* Drive security remediation strategy across the software supply chain; manage and prioritize remediation across multiple teams.

**About You**

  

* 9+ years in software, platform, or reliability engineering with deep hands-on coding experience that is still current.
* Demonstrated ownership of architecture patterns adopted by teams outside your own.
* Experience operating high-traffic distributed systems in production; leadership inincident response and post-incident structural work.
* Track record of raising the technical bar of a team through mentoring and standard-  
  setting.
* Expert-level proficiency in Go (Golang), Python, and Node.js/TypeScript; strong
* competency in Dart/Flutter; able to read and architect in Java, Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C, C++, C, Rust, and C#/.NET.
* Deep expertise in AWS (EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC) and production-grade Kubernetes across multiple deployments.
* Working knowledge of GCP/GKE and multi-cloud architecture patterns.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and Infrastructure-as- Code at scale.
* Mastery of CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions and Harness; expertise in build optimization, artifact management, and security scanning.
* Advanced knowledge of observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing (Tempo), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and alerting (CloudWatch, Datadog, Instana).
* Deep expertise in performance testing, capacity planning, and scalability analysis using K6, Locust, or JMeter.
* Advanced knowledge of databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, SQL Server) and query optimization.
* Expertise with event-driven architectures and message streaming (Confluent Kafka, Redis).
* Security supply chain mastery: SonarQube, BlackDuck/Coverity, Dependabot, JFrog; ability to architect and drive remediation strategies.
* Expert use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and ability to evaluate new AI tooling for team adoption.
* Desired Skills include:
  + Mobile DevOps mastery (Fastlane with Flutter/Dart, Swift, Kotlin builds; mobile testing automation).
  + Advanced experience with Kong API gateway, Okta RBAC, and Backstage-based developer platforms.
  + Deep familiarity with internal service frameworks (Gofr, NodeFr/Zode).
  + LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic AI orchestration experience.
  + Published technical writing or speaking about platform engineering, architecture, or DevOps at conferences.
  + Cloud Solutions Architect certifications (AWS, GCP).
  + Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)
jobs.description:
**Title:** Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)

**Hours:** Full-time

**Location:** Midvale, UT (On-site with occasional remote flexibility) #LI-Onsite

**You report to:** Software Engineering Manager

**Compensation:** A base salary range of $120,000-$135,000 gross per year, depending on candidate experience.

**Our Benefits:**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with BioLite covering 90–100% of monthly premiums, depending on plan selection.
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Paid Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, sick time, and family leave to support work-life balance.
* Equity & Bonus Opportunities: Community bonus plan and stock option eligibility for all full-time employees.
* Adventure Stipend (after two years): PTO to go on an adventure that aligns with BioLite's mission of bringing energy everywhere, whether that's outdoor recreation, climate action, or social impact.
* Employee Product Discount: Employees enjoy generous discounts on BioLite and Goal Zero products.

  

**This Role:**

BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Midvale-based team. In this role, you will develop the firmware that connects our power products to the cloud (AWS IoT) and to our Flutter and React Native mobile apps. You will work on the wireless connectivity modules in our home backup and portable power products. These modules work alongside battery management, inverter, and power conversion subsystems. You will focus on provisioning, OTA updates, device-to-cloud messaging, fleet telemetry, and the protocols among modules in the rest of the system. Our current products use the ESP32, and you will help choose and bring up the wireless platform for our next generation of products. Options we are looking at include embedded Rust (Embassy), embedded Linux, and smart home standards such as Matter and Thread.

A large part of this job is making existing firmware better. You will refactor, add tests, and pay down technical debt so the team ships faster with fewer field issues. You will work with firmware, electrical, cloud, and mobile engineers. You will debug at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and your code will run on devices in homes and in the field.

**You Will:**

* **Develop connectivity-module firmware:** Develop and maintain firmware for our Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity modules, including provisioning, configuration, OTA updates, and device-to-cloud messaging.
* **Improve the codebase you inherit:** Refactor existing firmware, add unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests, and set coding standards that make changes safe and code reviews fast.
* **Build communication protocols:** Develop the protocol libraries that connect our subsystems (battery management, inverter, IoT module) to each other and to the mobile app.
* **Lead the firmware build and release pipeline:** Maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions for firmware builds, tests, and releases for your projects. Make OTA releases reliable and traceable.
* **Work across the device-to-cloud path:** Work with cloud and mobile engineers on device APIs (AWS IoT), fleet telemetry, and app integration. Debug issues end-to-end, from the radio to the app.
* **Use modern tools:** Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up prototyping, debugging, testing, and documentation.
* **Review and document:** Take part in code and design reviews. Document designs for other developers, QA, manufacturing partners, and support.

  

**You Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; OR 5+ years of directly relevant experience.
* 3+ years writing production firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers or SoCs (e.g., Espressif ESP32, Nordic nRF, ST STM32, or other Arm Cortex-M).
* Experience with a real-time operating system (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and a wireless vendor SDK (e.g., ESP-IDF, nRF Connect SDK).
* Working knowledge of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and an IoT messaging protocol such as MQTT.
* Working knowledge of bootloaders, OTA updates, and device provisioning.
* Working knowledge of serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Experience testing embedded code (unit tests, simulation, or hardware-in-the-loop).
* Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for build, test, and tooling scripts.
* Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD.
* Experience with AI coding assistants in your daily work.

  

**Nice to Have:**

You do not need the following skills to apply, but please let us know if you have experience in any of these areas.

* Experience with AWS IoT Core or another cloud IoT platform, including REST APIs.
* Experience with mobile app development (native, Flutter, or React Native).
* Experience with smart home protocols such as Matter, Thread, Zigbee, or Z-Wave.
* Experience with or interest in embedded Rust (e.g., Embassy) or embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot).
* Experience with fleet monitoring, device telemetry, or crash reporting.
* Experience with consumer electronics, batteries, or power conversion.

  

**To Apply:**

* Please include a cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for this position. Feel free to link or describe a relevant personal project, hobby build, or open-source contribution that highlights your firmware or software skills.
* **You must be authorized to work for an employer in the U.S.** BioLite cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position.

  

**About BioLite:**

BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces to power life, anywhere. Together, we provide clean energy solutions that serve two distinct yet connected markets: families living in energy poverty and outdoor adventurers seeking fuel-independent power and light. From solar panels and portable power stations to cookstoves and lighting systems, our technologies help people cook, charge, and stay connect

Develop the firmware and low-level software that bring Juniper Systems’ rugged computers, GNSS receivers, and data collectors to life. **Preferred:**

May act as a technical lead on development projects. Responsible for aspects of software design of new products, with sustaining and support functions of existing products as needed. Responsible for evaluating and mitigating technical design risks. May supervise other engineers or interns.

Office and lab environment. Requires extended computer work and hands-on use of electronic test equipment and prototype hardware.

At Trident Systems, we believe that strong engineering principles are fundamental to driving innovation and solving complex problems. We promote a culture characterized by rigorous engineering practices and a commitment to continuous improvement. We can deliver innovative, high-performance solutions that meet our customers' evolving requirements by integrating our specialized knowledge in aerospace electronic systems with appropriately scaled development methodologies.

We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and evolution of the software platforms that control our automated electronic test and support systems. This role owns the technical direction and architecture of reusable software frameworks that serve both engineering development and production test environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern Python software engineering, asynchronous systems programming, hardware communications, and software architecture. You will define, build, and continuously improve the core GSE software platform that enables reliable, maintainable, and scalable automated test and support systems across multiple programs and product lines.

You will collaborate closely with the Lead Test Systems Engineer, Integration & Test engineers, the Engineering Systems Integration Engineer, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the GSE software platform aligns with organizational needs and supports long-term engineering infrastructure.

* Robustness, stability, and maintainability of the core platform

* Measurable productivity gains for engineering and test teams
* Effective reuse of frameworks across projects and programs
* The ability to support increasingly sophisticated automated GSE and test systems

What Makes This Role Distinct?

This is not a QA automation or web application role. The Senior GSE Software Engineer:

* Defines and owns the reusable software platform that powers automated electronic test systems and Ground Support Equipment.
* Sets the technical direction and architecture for long-lived engineering infrastructure supporting multiple products and programs.
* Operates at the intersection of software engineering, hardware control, and systems integration to enable sophisticated, mission-critical automated test and support operations.

In this role, you will be the technical leader ensuring that our GSE software platform is robust, extensible, and capable of supporting increasingly complex automated systems—directly influencing engineering efficiency, product quality, and production reliability.

* Design and build measurement acquisition, data processing, and results management software integrated with enterprise engineering tools and data systems.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

* Drive continuous improvement in coding standards, design guidelines, and development workflows for the GSE software ecosystem.

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

---------------

Ever wondered how Amazon keeps hundreds of fulfillment centers running at peak performance across the globe? That's where our team comes in.  
  
We build the real-time data platform that gives Amazon's fulfillment network end-to-end visibility — from conveyor belts and robotic systems to software applications and workforce operations. Think of it as the central nervous system for Amazon's physical logistics: we ingest millions of data points per second from equipment and systems across 100+ facilities worldwide, store years of historical data without sacrificing query speed, and serve it all up through dashboards, APIs, and SDKs that help teams detect problems before they happen, optimize processes in real time, and make smarter decisions about how to move packages faster.  
  
What makes this role different:  
  
This isn't a typical web services role. You'll work at the intersection of physical operations and cloud-scale software — solving problems where hardware unpredictability meets distributed systems challenges. The data you help collect and serve directly impacts whether a package gets delivered on time, whether equipment gets serviced before it breaks, and whether an entire facility runs smoothly on its busiest day of the year.  
  
You'll own problems end-to-end, from system design through production operations, and your work will be visible in real-world outcomes across Amazon's global logistics network.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You'll design and build distributed systems that operate at massive scale — processing high-velocity time-series data streams, building storage layers that balance performance with cost, and creating APIs that make complex data accessible to thousands of users. Right now, we're in the middle of a major storage architecture migration, rethinking how we handle hot data to improve reliability and reduce latency. You'll also have the opportunity to work on data ingestion pipelines that collect signals from industrial hardware, robotics, and software systems — and turn that raw telemetry into actionable insights.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Training/Inference (C++)
jobs.description:

We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

* We are building the high-performance inference platform that serves Grok to millions of users every day with lightning speed and perfect reliability.
* As a Member of Technical Staff - Inference, you will design and optimize large-scale model serving systems end-to-end. You will own everything from distributed infrastructure (global KV cache, continuous batching, load balancing, auto-scaling) to deep low-level optimizations (GPU kernels, quantization, speculative decoding, tail latency).
* This is a high-impact role where your work directly determines how fast and reliably users interact with Grok at massive scale

**Responsibilities:**

* Architect and implement scalable distributed infrastructure for model serving (load balancing, auto-scaling, batch scheduling, global KV cache).
* Optimize latency and throughput of model inference under real production workloads.
* Build reliable, high-concurrency serving systems that serve billions of users with 100% uptime, 0% error rate, and excellent tail latency.
* Benchmark, fine-tune, and accelerate inference engines (including low-level GPU kernel work and code generation).
* Develop custom tools to trace, replay, and fix issues across the full stack — from orchestration down to GPU kernels.
* Create robust CI/CD infrastructure for seamless endpoint deployment, image publishing, and inference engine updates.
* Accelerate research on scaling test-time compute, RL rollout, and model-hardware co-design for next-generation systems.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Deep low-level systems programming (C/C++ or Rust)
* Experience with large-scale, high-concurrent production serving.
* Experience with GPU inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, etc.).
* Strong background in system optimizations: batching, caching, load balancing, parallelism.
* Low-level inference optimizations: GPU kernels, code generation.
* Algorithmic inference optimizations: quantization, speculative decoding, distillation, low-precision numerics.
* Experience with testing, benchmarking, and reliability of inference services.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD infrastructure for inference.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$180,000 - $440,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

Our team's software interfaces directly with the core hardware of the supercomputer and its network fabric. Our mission is to expose the full capability of that hardware — limited only by physics — to the rest of the stack, all while retaining the smallest, most robust footprint possible.  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Build and maintain the lean, high-reliability Linux-based operating system that underpins our supercomputer network fabric.
* Write (or rewrite) high-performance device drivers to extract the maximum physical capability from our network and compute hardware.
* Manage deployment, operation, and debugging of our platform in production, including:
* + Rigorous resolution and root-causing of anomalies to ensure the system is constantly improving in reliability.
  + Developing and constantly improving our tools for observability and configuration management.
* Collaborate with our hardware teams and external partners to design the next generation of supercomputer hardware – and then bring up our OS and software stack on it.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Hands-on systems programming experience in C or C++.
* Strong operating systems fundamentals (scheduling, memory management, I/O) — you must be able to articulate in extreme detail how a computer works, from the hardware all the way up to high-level applications.
* Understanding of computer networking, both in the host (OS stack) as well as common network devices like switches and routers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel and its networking stack — transferable experience with another production-grade kernel is okay, too!
* Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more).
* Experience bringing up new hardware from scratch — you have flashed bare-metal software on a microcontroller with JTAG, or bootstrapped a Linux kernel and rootfs on new hardware.

### **Radar Reinvented.**

Echodyne offers the world's first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

**Echodyne is seeking a** **Software Engineering Manager****, Data Platform,** **to join our fast-growing team.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Who You Are**

Our Data Platform connects sensors and radars through EchoWare to cloud services and internal data systems. As Engineering Manager, Data Platform, you will lead the team responsible for building and operating the services, data flows, and interfaces that connect these environments. The team will securely move operational radar data into Echodyne's data platform and turn those capabilities into reusable services that support products and teams across the company.

You stay close to the technology, understand the tradeoffs being made, ask the right questions, and use your experience to support and vet important technical decisions. You create the conditions for engineers and technical leads to own detailed architecture and implementation while ensuring decisions are pragmatic, technically sound, and aligned with business needs.

You have experience building cloud and distributed systems from the ground up and understand that successful 0 1 development requires deliberate choices about what must be built now, what needs a strong foundation, and what can reasonably wait.

You are a strategic thinker who can use the systems being built today as a beachhead for broader services, capabilities, and product opportunities over time.

You are also a team builder and strong cross-functional partner, comfortable leading work across edge and cloud environments and collaborating closely with Analytics, Research, Product, and other engineering teams.

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years managing engineering teams, including hiring, developing talent, setting priorities, and driving accountability.

* Proven experience building new systems, platforms, or products from the ground up in environments where requirements and architecture were still evolving.

* Strong understanding of edge computing and cloud platforms, with practical experience building production services, APIs, distributed systems, and data pipelines, particularly for data-intensive systems with real-time delivery requirements.

* Comfortable evaluating architecture and design choices, identifying risks and unnecessary complexity, and helping teams make pragmatic technical decisions.

* Experience building shared platforms, APIs, or services that other engineering teams depend on.

* Strong understanding of operating production services, including reliability, availability, SLAs or SLOs, deployment, observability, and incident response.

**What Sets You Apart**

* You have a strong track record of hiring and developing the talent needed to build and operate complex systems.

* You have built cloud and distributed systems from the ground up and know how to balance immediate needs with longer-term platform foundations.

* You have the technical depth and judgment to guide, challenge, and vet important engineering decisions.

* You are comfortable leading teams that build processing capabilities at the edge and services in the cloud, and can guide delivery across the boundary between them.

* You think strategically about how today's platform can become the foundation for broader services and capabilities.

* You bring a strong security mindset to system design, including authentication and device identity, encryption, access controls, tenant isolation, auditability, and the handling of sensitive customer data.

* You are naturally inclined to lead with action, thrive in ambiguity, and drive the team toward clarity and execution while maintaining strong strategic alignment.

**What You Do**

* Hire, develop, and organize the talent needed to deliver across edge and cloud systems.

* Stay close to the technology, guide key design decisions, identify risks, and help the team make sound technical choices.

* Turn broad product and business goals into clear technical priorities, balancing immediate needs with longer-term platform investments.

* Lead delivery of cohesive systems spanning edge processing, cloud services, and the interfaces between them.

* Deliver reliable shared services that other teams can depend on, with clear ownership and operational expectations.

* Use today's platform as the foundation for future services, capabilities, and product expansion.

* Establish clear priorities, accountability, engineering practices, and operational maturity as the team grows.

  

**Echodyne's technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant's eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations. Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.**

### **WHAT WE OFFER**

### **This is an exempt role.**

**If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that's a great fit for you!**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend- Security
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer to play a key role in building Rippling's Security program. Rippling's product’s scope provides a unique set of security challenges, but our management is especially supportive of security and compliance as a central function of the business. As an early member of Rippling's security team, you'll have a meaningful impact on the security program’s priorities and direction.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data.

This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. You’ll help make AI capabilities safe, reliable, explainable, auditable, and enterprise-ready, while ensuring customers have the trust, transparency, and control needed to adopt automation at scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the design and implementation of backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities.
* Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems for high-volume workflows across Spend, IT, identity, access, approvals, and compliance.
* Make strategic technical decisions around architecture, infrastructure, data modeling, performance, and operational reliability.
* Translate ambiguous business and customer needs into robust technical solutions in partnership with product, frontend, platform, design, and cross-functional teams.
* Build and evolve systems involving workflows, permissions, policy enforcement, financial operations, device and app management, procurement, and security controls.
* Raise the technical bar through system design, code reviews, design reviews, mentorship, and backend engineering best practices.
* Help create unified product experiences that replace fragmented point solutions for managing employees, spend, devices, apps, access, and business operations.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Go, or a similar high-scale backend language.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization of relational databases.
* You have seen and contributed to systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale.
* Strong understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals and experience with complex project delivery.
* Exceptional communication skills with technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

jobs.title: Manager, Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra's solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Systems Engineering Manager facilitates the execution of strategic product development objectives by providing both technical leadership and direct systems engineering contributions across the product development lifecycle. This role leads a small team of Systems Engineers while actively participating in system architecture, requirements development, risk management, system integration, and verification activities. The Systems Engineering Manager partners closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer, clinical, business, and regulatory requirements into robust medical device solutions while continuously improving systems engineering processes, tools, and best practices.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**  

* Leads and develops the Systems Engineering team.
* Generates and analyzes system architectures, requirements, and risk management artifacts.
* Communicates and coordinates with cross-functional teams.
* Provides technical leadership for system integration, verification, validation, and problem resolution.
* Advises teams on systems engineering tools, methods, and standards.
* Monitors work to ensure technical quality, effective execution, and schedule adherence.

**COMPETENCIES**  

* Passion: Contagious excitement about the company – sense of urgency. Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Integrity: Commitment, accountability, and dedication to the highest ethical standards.
* Collaboration/Teamwork: Inclusion of Team Member regardless of geography, position, and product or service.
* Action/Results: High energy, decisive planning, timely execution.
* Innovation: Generation of new ideas from original thinking.
* Customer Focus: Exceed customer expectations, quality of products, services, and experience always present of mind.
* Emotional Intelligence: Recognizes, understands, manages one's own emotions and is able to influence others. A critical skill for pressure situations.

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Education/Experience Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional engineering teams.
* Direct experience with requirements development, traceability management, risk management, system architecture, and verification activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**  

* Previous people management experience.
* Direct experience developing regulated medical devices.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 14971, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, and FDA design control requirements.
* Experience with requirements management and traceability tools such as IBM DOORS.
* Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and international regulatory submissions.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Directly supervise Systems Engineering team members including conducting performance reviews, providing performance feedback, establishing development goals, allocating resources, and supporting career growth.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  

* Indoor open office environment
* Minimal noise volume typical to an office environment
* Extended hours when needed
* Kestra manufactures and provides life-saving products regulated by the Federal Food and Drug Administration and under contract with Medicare. Kestra maintains a drug free workplace and testing is a condition of employment post-offer.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**  

* Frequent repetitive motions that may include wrists, hands and/or fingers, such as keyboard and mouse usage
* Frequent stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time
* Frequent computer use
* Frequent phone and other business machine use
* Occasional lifting required, typically between 2-15 pounds

**TRAVEL**  

* Occasional travel may be required, 10%

  
**OTHER DUTIES:**  
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Kestra Medical Technologies, Inc does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.description:
Division

Battery & Charger Development

Primary Work Location

Brookfield, WI

Job type

Regular

Time type

Full time

Job Post From

2026-10-12

### **Job Details**

##### **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.***

  
  

**INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

  
  

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

  
  

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

  
  

The Sr. Electronics Engineering Technician will support new product design teams through test development, data analysis and competitor benchmarking. You will independently plan and create test fixtures, configure products for testing, log the measurements for data collection/ graphing, and troubleshoot, repair, and modify circuit board assemblies focusing on the chargers and live batteries. You will assist in the maintenance of lab equipment and operating procedures, as well as being a resource for entry-level technicians.

  
  

**You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:**

* Test chargers and batteries in methods that are consistent with best practices for lithium-ion charging systems.

* Performing hands on mechanical testing of batteries and tools.

* Collect data through various equipment and software programs.

* Perform tests per work instructions and other procedures.

* Prepare reports of test results and make recommendations as needed.

* Provide updates to Engineers on projects.

* Create and edit documents using the Microsoft software suite.

Manage lab space

* - tools/parts/work surfaces/consumable materials.

* Move between lab spaces to execute and monitor testing.
  

  

**What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:**

* Associate's degree in engineering technology or High School diploma accompanied by 4+ years of experience.

* 3+ years of experience with mechanical/electrical principles, test equipment, product life/performance test procedures and methods.

* Knowledge of test concepts in the design and development of products and components.

* Capability to lift and manipulate 50lbs.

* Ability to travel between lab locations on foot or by vehicle if needed.

* Interest and ability to use power tools to simulate consumer usage.

* Ability to reach out to cross functional groups for reference or troubleshooting.

* Strong mechanical mindset and aptitude. Some experience with using hand and shop tools is expected

* Effectively manages multiple tasks to achieve desired outcomes and deliver to deadlines.
  

  

**Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:**

* Experience with Lithium-Ion battery charging system methods and test environments.

* Experience in using data acquisition equipment such as Agilent data buckets.

* Experience in viewing schematics and PCB layout files in an environment such as Altium.

* Operate various lab equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, and e-loads.

* Ability to reach out to cross functional groups for reference or troubleshooting.
  

  

**We provide these great perks and benefits:**

* Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
* Generous 401(k) savings plan.
* Education assistance.
* On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.
* And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.
  

  

**Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.**

*Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

Milwaukee Tool

##### **About Us**

Milwaukee Tool, founded in 1924, is a global leader in delivering innovative solutions to the professional construction trades that increase productivity and safety. Milwaukee® is known for their world-leading M12™, M18™, and MX FUEL™ cordless systems, the ground-breaking performance of their cordless innovations, safety solutions, battery-powered outdoor power equipment, jobsite lighting and clean-up, time-saving accessories, and innovative hand tool and PACKOUT™ Modular Storage Products. The company is dedicated to delivering a steady stream of advanced, trade-specific solutions.
  
  
Milwaukee Tool is a Brookfield, Wisconsin-based subsidiary of Techtronic Industries Co. Ltd. (TTI) (HKEx stock code: 669, ADR symbol: TTNDY). For more information on the full line of Milwaukee® products, please call 1-800-SAWDUST or visit Milwaukee Tool.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Pierce, an Oshkosh company**

**At Pierce Manufacturing, we build trucks that protect people and communities around the world. To our team, there is no room for anything less than providing the absolute best. Since 1913, building truck bodies on Model T Ford chassis in an old converted church has evolved to creating highly customized, carefully designed and engineering pumpers, aerials, tankers and rescue units that have no equal. Today, you'll find more than** **30,000 Pierce apparatuses** **on the road that are making a difference in people's lives, every day. To us, every step in the process of building our trucks is personal. From innovation and expertise, to the customization and service. Our trucks are designed to perform under the toughest conditions.**

Ready to shape the future of Connected Vehicle IoT solutions for mission critical equipment that help our everyday heroes? If you are passionate about building a better world through innovative technology, thrive on technical challenges, and are excited to build next generation connected vehicle embedded solution, we invite you to join us as an Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer. As a technical leader and hands-on engineer, you will design and develop embedded software for connected Fire, Refuse Collection, and Concrete Mixer vehicles.

This is a fully onsite role in Greenville, WI. As the Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer you must be able and willing to perform hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and validation on large vocational vehicles. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available for this position.

**YOUR IMPACT**

* Design and Develop - Design & develop embedded software for connected vehicle solutions including telematics, edge computing, remote diagnostics, over-the-air capabilities, vehicle network integration, and video recording/streaming capabilities.
* Technical Leadership - Serve as technical leader, balancing hands-on development with providing technical direction to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Engineering Excellence - Establish architecture standards and best practices for high-quality, production-grade software while driving technical rigor through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Execution Excellence & Delivery - Drive team accountability, Agile execution, and delivery predictability by improving backlog readiness, removing technical roadblocks, and helping the team consistently meet sprint and release commitments.
* Vehicle Validation – Hands on validation on trucks. This role requires working inside trucks to ensure software performs reliably in real world operating conditions.
* Cross functional Collaboration - Collaborate with embedded, cloud, and front-end engineers and product owner, resolve cross functional challenges and ensure successful end to end solution delivery.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience developing embedded software using C and C++. Standout: Rust.
* Experience developing and testing embedded software on Embedded Linux platforms
* Experience with networking concepts and protocols including TCP/IP and UDP
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and embedded software development best practices.
* Strong technical leadership and collaboration skills, with experience leading technical projects while remaining hands-on in software development.
* Experience developing connected mobile asset (e.g., vehicle or mobile equipment) or telematics platforms, including cloud-connected architectures, over-the-air (OTA) updates, cellular-connected devices, and remote fleet management solutions.
* Ability and willingness to perform hands on testing on vehicles, including working inside vehicle cabs and conducting testing in manufacturing and field environments. Occasional travel to customer sites may be required.

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with automotive or heavy-duty vehicle networks, including CAN, J1939, and related protocols.
* Experience developing portable software solutions across multiple embedded hardware platforms, including cross-compilation, platform abstraction, and migration of applications to new processor architectures or operating system environments.
* Experience porting embedded applications to new hardware platforms, including board bring-up, BSP integration, hardware/software debugging, and platform validation.
* Experience with multimedia frameworks (e.g., FFmpeg, GStreamer) and video recording, streaming, and media processing technologies, including RTP, RTSP, WebRTC, or similar protocols.
* Strong sense of initiative, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and solve complex technical problems.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Wegner CPAs is excited to partner with our client in Verona, WI on their search for a Controls Engineer to join their team!

LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY, PLEASE

**About the Opportunity**

Our client is a growing automation and robotics company that designs and builds custom machinery and robotic integration solutions for manufacturers across North America. With ambitious growth goals and a commitment to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions, the company is looking for talented individuals who take pride in their work and want to make a meaningful impact. This is an opportunity to join a hands-on, collaborative team where your ideas matter, your work makes a tangible difference, and you can grow alongside the business.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, review, and test PLC programs that control automated manufacturing systems and robotic cells.
* Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and assembly teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software.
* Troubleshoot technical challenges, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
* Participate in machine testing, debugging, and commissioning to ensure systems perform as intended.
* Take ownership of your work from initial programming through final implementation, seeing projects through to successful completion.

If you enjoy watching your designs come to life and seeing the results of your work on the production floor, this role offers the opportunity to do just that.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of PLC programming experience using ladder logic and/or structured text.
* Experience with Siemens or Allen-Bradley PLC platforms.
* Background in manufacturing automation, robotics, custom machinery, or machine building.
* Ability to define technical requirements, develop solutions, and validate system performance through testing.
* Comfort working in a hands-on manufacturing or shop environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* A sense of ownership and pride in developing reliable systems that perform in real-world production environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SCADA systems.
* Familiarity with common electromechanical systems and components.
* Hands-on experience with machine testing, debugging, and commissioning.

**You'll thrive in this role if you:**

* Bring energy, initiative, and follow-through to your work.
* Enjoy learning new technologies and taking on increasing responsibility.
* Prefer a collaborative, team-oriented environment where everyone contributes.
* Take ownership of challenges rather than passing them along.
* Care about the quality, reliability, and real-world performance of the systems you develop.

**Interested in building the technology that drives modern manufacturing?** This is an opportunity to put your PLC programming expertise to work on custom automation and robotics projects while growing your skills and making a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer IV
jobs.description:
**About Company:**

Steele Solutions Inc. is the nation’s leading designer and manufacturer of platforms and mezzanines used to support equipment in distribution, fulfillment, and sortation centers throughout the United States. We also design and build structures to support and access equipment in numerous other industries, with installations in every state and throughout the world!

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Electrical Engineer IV is a senior technical expert responsible for leading the design, execution, and continuous improvement of complex electrical systems for industrial automation and material handling projects. This role provides technical leadership across the electrical engineering discipline, ensuring system reliability, scalability, regulatory compliance, and cost efficiency.

Working with a high degree of autonomy, the Electrical Engineer IV establishes engineering standards, mentors team members, collaborates across departments, and contributes to the organization’s long-term technical strategy and innovation.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

*The following duties and responsibilities are not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities as management deems necessary.*

### **System Architecture and Standardization**

* Develop scalable electrical design solutions for complex, multi-system environments.
* Establish and maintain standardized engineering documentation, electrical component libraries, and compliance frameworks.
* Lead system-level design reviews to ensure adherence to engineering standards, minimize risk, and promote design consistency.

### **Technical Leadership and Execution**

* Lead the design of complex electrical systems, including motor control centers (MCCs), variable frequency drives (VFDs), servo systems, and integrated safety circuits.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary design efforts across electrical, controls, mechanical, and project engineering teams.
* Provide advanced field support and resolve escalated technical issues to ensure successful project execution.
* Oversee the preparation, accuracy, and completion of final as-built documentation and certification packages.

### **Team Development and Mentorship**

* Serve as a technical mentor to electrical engineers at all experience levels.
* Provide formal and informal training to strengthen technical capabilities, knowledge sharing, and team performance.
* Support technical recruiting, onboarding, and professional development initiatives.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead cross-functional design alignment for customer programs and standardized product solutions.
* Partner with Project Management on project estimates, resource forecasting, scheduling, and risk mitigation.
* Represent the electrical engineering discipline during executive-level technical reviews, customer meetings, and external stakeholder discussions.

### **Strategic Growth and Innovation**

* Evaluate and implement emerging electrical technologies, including DC power systems and energy-efficient hardware.
* Lead initiatives to improve design automation, engineering efficiency, and bill of materials (BOM) standardization.
* Contribute to long-term departmental planning, technical strategy, and the development of internal engineering capabilities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The qualifications listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

jobs.description:
Madison, Wisconsin, United States | Full-time

Apply by: No close date

  

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**PRINCIPAL SYSTEMS ENGINEER**

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Principal Systems Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of advanced space payloads in support of Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Support the development of system architecture for space-based optical instruments, subsystems, and payloads on airborne and space platforms, with emphasis on electrical architecture and controls integration
* Define, decompose, and manage system requirements with focus on electrical behavior, control functions, subsystem interactions, and overall system performance
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, interface control documents, electrical interface definitions, concepts of operations, state and mode descriptions, test plans, and verification artifacts
* Support development of electrical and functional architectures, including command and telemetry flow, power distribution, control logic, signal paths, timing, synchronization, and subsystem interaction
* Collaborate with hardware, software, firmware, and test teams to ensure the electrical architecture and controls implementation align with system requirements and mission intent
* Support the development, integration, and testing of space payloads to be integrated on spacecraft platforms
* Support hardware and software development teams with system-level test planning, debugging, integration, and execution of verification procedures; analyze data and recommend design refinements
* Participate in hardware and software verification and validation activities related to system behavior, electrical performance, controls implementation, and interface compliance
* Support architecture trades involving sensors, motor control, embedded electronics, power systems, command and data handling, and subsystem interfaces
* Participate in technical interchange meetings and project discussions with internal teams, customers, and external partners as needed
* Identify, assess, and help mitigate technical risks related to electrical architecture, controls implementation, and subsystem integration
* Support travel or off-site work as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS YOU'LL BRING AS PRINCIPAL SYSTEMS ENGINEER:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical, systems, or aerospace engineering; or other technical discipline
* 12+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years supporting development programs and 2+ years in technical leadership, CAM, IPTL, or equivalent role
* Demonstrated systems engineering experience with emphasis on electrical architecture, subsystem integration, and controls focused development
* Strong electrical engineering background supporting complex aerospace, payload, avionics, or instrument systems
* Experience developing system requirements, interface definitions, and verification approaches for complex systems
* Strong background in electrical interfaces, control functions, avionics integration, or subsystem architecture
* Experience with requirements management and modeling tools such as JAMA, DOORS, Cameo, or similar tools
* Experience working across hardware, software, and firmware development throughout the lifecycle
* Familiarity with command and telemetry interfaces, power architectures, signal interfaces, timing, synchronization, and control logic
* Experience supporting integration and test, including troubleshooting electrical or controls-related issues at the subsystem or system level
* Strong ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical, interface, and system technical documentation
* Familiarity with aerospace development standards, environmental testing, and mission assurance practices

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Current SSBI clearance
* EO/IR payload integration experience
* Experience with spacecraft bus interfaces, payload electrical integration, avionics architecture, or embedded electronics
* Experience with pointing, stabilization, gimbals, motion control, focus/control electronics, or other closed-loop control applications
* Experience defining or troubleshooting elec
