jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer, Fulfillment,** at an exciting time — we’ve successfully launched multiple platforms and products, raised over $100m in VC funding, reached profitability, and have a growth trajectory of over 100% YoY.

  

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------

Scan.com's integration layer is mission-critical infrastructure. We interface with hundreds of imaging centers and health systems operating disparate, often decades-old systems — RIS platforms built on legacy protocols, HL7 v2 feeds with idiosyncratic vendor dialects, and hardware gateways running in constrained clinical environments. On the demand side, we connect to modern EHR APIs, third-party referral networks, and portal integrations that must work reliably at scale.

As a **Senior Software Engineer, Integrations**, you will architect and build the systems that make these connections robust, observable, and extensible. This problem area requires genuine passion for legacy system integration patterns, message transformation pipelines, and the operational discipline to maintain high-reliability infrastructure against the entropy of the real world.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Build and maintain REST API integrations with third-party referral sources, attorney platforms, and demand aggregators, including OAuth flows, rate limiting, retry logic, and schema versioning. Design and implement HL7 v2 transformation pipelines — parsing, normalizing, enriching, and routing ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU, and MDM message types across heterogeneous RIS and EHR systems with non-standard vendor extensions.
* Build and maintain integration connectors for modern and legacy imaging center RIS systems.
* Architect fault-tolerant message queuing and delivery infrastructure for inbound and outbound HL7 and API traffic.
* Develop interfaces for demand-side EHR integrations, including mapping from internal data models to FHIR-compliant (and other standards) representations.
* Own the observability layer for the integration infrastructure: structured logging, alerting on message processing latency/failures, and dashboards that surface issues before they reach the operations teams.
* Contribute to the design of integration onboarding tooling that reduces time-to-live for new imaging center and referral source connections
* Provide technical mentorship to mid-level engineers and participate in architecture reviews across the broader Engineering org

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong command of message transformation architecture: you can design pipelines that are observable, replayable, and extensible without requiring a full rewrite every time a new vendor is onboarded
* Proficiency in at least one backend language used in high-reliability integration contexts (Python, Ruby, Java, C# are all relevant; language is less important than architectural rigor).
* Familiarity with RESTful API integration patterns, including schema versioning, backward compatibility, and API contract management
* Strong operational instincts: you instrument what you build, you think about failure modes before they happen, and you treat on-call escalations as a signal about systemic gaps
* Experience in healthcare is a plus, but not required. We care far more about your integration engineering depth and legacy system fluency than your industry background

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
-------------------------

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.

  

**HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU**
-----------------------------

jobs.title: Vision Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Edge team building the software platform behind these products. You will design, build, and operate the distributed edge-to-cloud pipeline that runs on IoT devices on the production floor, ingesting high-rate sensor and controller data and reliably forwarding it to the cloud over intermittent connectivity.

This is a hands-on backend-focused role spanning containerized .NET services, relational and document data stores, pub/sub messaging, and industrial protocol integration. You will own features end-to-end and collaborate closely with Controls, HMI, Manufacturing, and Field Support to ship reliable, production-grade systems to our customers.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

* Design and implement backend services in C# on modern .NET / ASP.NET Core for the edge platform - REST APIs, background workers, message handlers, telemetry aggregators, and long-running device services.
* Own the data pipeline from device ingest to cloud archive: schema design, repository / data-access layer, database migrations, partitioning and retention strategy, and durable store-and-forward upload to cloud object storage.
* Build and maintain containerized services and their deployment manifests, configuration, and orchestration.
* Integrate with industrial controllers over standard fieldbus and industrial communication protocols - designing message contracts, register maps, warning/error codes, and controls-side handshakes for coordinated operation.
* Deliver features end-to-end, from work-item breakdown through implementation, unit and integration tests, CI, code review, deployment, and field validation on live equipment.
* Contribute to architecture: write and review architecture docs, evaluate new patterns, and drive refactors that keep the codebase maintainable as the team and product line grow.
* Mentor and collaborate: raise the bar in code review, pair with junior engineers, and coordinate with Controls, HMI, DevOps, and Field Support to ship releases. Mentor junior software developers and provide guidance on best practices and advanced analytical techniques.
* Communicate complex data insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders effectively.

**Key Competencies & Skills**

**Required**

* Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET building ASP.NET Core REST APIs, hosted / background services, and worker services.
* Solid database engineering skills: relational schema design, indexing, migrations, and query tuning. Comfort writing and reviewing raw SQL is expected.
* Practical experience with containerization
* Comfort with Linux as a deployment target (systemd services, log management, networking, device troubleshooting) and shell scripting.
* Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar), including running unit and integration tests in the pipeline.
* Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals: automated testing, code review, refactoring, API design, and writing clear technical documentation.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, data analysis, and test automation (pytest); ability to move fluently between C# and Python codebases.
* Experience integrating with industrial control systems via standard fieldbus or SCADA protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, MODBUS, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP), or otherwise interoperating with PLCs.
* Azure cloud services: Blob Storage, IoT Hub, Container Registry, Managed Identity, and Azure DevOps. Equivalent experience on AWS or GCP is also welcome.
* Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized workloads, including deployments, services, and Helm charts; lightweight distributions such as K3s or MicroK8s at the edge are a plus.
* Experience building IoT device software - long-lived services on embedded / ARM64 hardware, remote deployment, module or fleet management, and safe over-the-air updates.
* Familiarity with columnar / analytics formats such as Parquet and downstream analytics engines (Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, DuckDB).
* Familiarity with visualization / dashboard tools (Grafana or similar) and time-series data modeling.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering distributed backend systems in production, ideally at the edge or in an IoT / industrial context, with responsibility for reliability, observability, and on-call or field-support obligations.
* Track record of cross-functional collaboration with hardware, controls, or research teams, and of translating ambiguous product requirements into well-scoped, testable engineering work.

**Working Conditions**

Work is performed inside a flex space building consisting of offices, open desk space, laboratory, machine shop, and a manufacturing floor. Level of noise is usually quiet in the office environment and temperature controlled. Noise levels are elevated in the warehouse space where temperatures can vary depending on the outside elements and weather. Travel may be required, including up to 2-8 trips per year to visit suppliers, attend conferences, meetings (customer, investor, and business) and customer sites (hatcheries).

**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Role Purpose**
----------------

Responsible for the design, development, programming, implementation, and optimization of control systems supporting Corning’s cable manufacturing processes. This role provides controls and electrical engineering expertise to improve product, process, and equipment performance, support innovation, and enable new product introduction within the plant. It requires advanced technical leadership in troubleshooting complex automation issues, integrating systems, and improving equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency. The position also leads projects that drive root cause understanding, cost reduction, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration, while mentoring junior team members and maintaining awareness of emerging technologies and intellectual property developed through project work.

* Mentor and train junior controls engineers

Participate in all phases of the project including design, fabrication, off-line integration and testing, installation, production start-up support, training of plant personnel, and technology transfer. Independently follow construction of equipment in vendors’ facilities.

**Work Hours and Schedule:**

• Informal 24/7 coverage for ad-hoc call-in support (3rd Level Subject Matter Expert).  

**Travel**: less than 20%

**Experiences/Education - Required**
------------------------------------

**Preferred**

jobs.title: Hardware Systems Engineer

Meta is seeking a Hardware Engineer to support the validation and production readiness of AI and high-performance computing infrastructure deployed across Meta's global data centers. In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI silicon, server systems, and data center operations, partnering with hardware design, firmware, software, and capacity engineering teams to bring AI accelerators and GPU-based server platforms from new product introduction through full-scale deployment. * Develop and execute test plans covering thermal, power, and electrical characterization of AI server systems at component, board, and rack levels
* Investigate and root-cause complex hardware failures across the full stack, including AI silicon, firmware, system software, and thermal subsystems

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of experience in hardware engineering with a focus on AI servers, GPUs, AI accelerators, or high-performance computing systems in a data center environment

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. **\*This position is contingent upon contract award\***

Amentum is seeking a skilled and driven **Senior Electrical Engineer** to join our engineering team based in Houston, TX. This is a design-focused role that spans the full product lifecycle — from early concept development through hardware design, fabrication, installation, and on-site operation.

The ideal candidate is a licensed or degree-qualified electrical or systems engineer who brings expertise in low voltage electronics, wiring systems, sensor integration, and harness design, and who communicates and collaborates effectively across engineering and operations teams.

This position offers the opportunity to lead and participate in design reviews, work alongside vendors to bring electrical hardware from schematic to reality, and provide direct technical support during field installation and testing. If you are looking for a role where your engineering decisions have real, visible consequences on mission-critical systems, this is the opportunity for you.

This team supports multiple US Navy research and development facilities associated with top priority submarine weapon system development programs. * Coordinate proactively with project managers, fellow engineers, field technicians, and operations staff to plan and execute work efficiently.

* Serve as a technical resource and collaborative partner across disciplines, fostering a team environment built on transparency and shared accountability.

Under the general direction of the Calibration & Combustion Engineering Manager, the Staff Engineer – Electrical & Controls has responsibility for the design, development, and implementation of electrical components, systems, and software to operate associated hardware for engines and engine control systems for Rehlko engine platforms.

  

**Specific Responsibilities:**

* Understand and support software modeling and simulation to develop concepts.
* Integrate software with existing systems including testing and quality assurance.
* Support, maintain, and document software & hardware functionality.
* Perform functional testing along with troubleshooting capabilities.

* Delivery of project work to time, cost, performance, and quality
  

  

**Requirements:**

* ASCET/INCA, MotoHawk/Mototune (or similar platform) experience.
* Two or more years MatLab/Simulink/Stateflow experience (Modeling, simulating, and analysis). TargetLink experience a plus.

* Use of software tools such as compilers and emulators.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the distributed systems that train, serve, and secure our AI models. Every other team at Anthropic depends on these systems.

In this role, you'll work directly with our Research teams to build the reliable, scalable, performant infrastructure our research depends on. This is a cross-functional systems team: you'll scope and lead complex, multi-month infrastructure projects and resolve the performance and scalability bottlenecks that limit how fast we can grow.

Independently scope and lead complex, multi-month infrastructure projects, from an ambiguous starting point through to a production system
Build deep partnerships with researchers and Research teams to understand their needs and deliver for them
Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar for the team

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. Your safety matters to us.

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  
Job Description

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

The **Leidos Defense Electrical Systems Department** is seeking a talented **Lead Electrical Engineer** to join an experienced, high performing, multidisciplinary team to create unique solutions to complex engineering challenges in our Huntsville, AL location. The Electrical Systems Department is a design-focused group specializing in advanced hardware products. The individual selected for this position will be an electrical engineer with project engineering, design engineering, and production skillsets. The individual must be a self-starter with experience working with inter-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will work closely with hardware integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, radars, and space systems.

The selected candidate will be expected to execute in a fast-paced, small team environment through all phases of the hardware life cycle from conceptual development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and customers to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

**If you are up for the challenge of joining this team, then apply today to be considered.**

**Leidos Defense Systems Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

* Leading Failure Review and Corrective Action committees for critical component failures
* Presenting to program leadership and customers in weekly meetings, quarterly IPRs, and CDRs
* Integrating LRUs into larger systems by collaborating with system design teams on design updates
* Coordinating with line management and program management to identify staffing opportunities and accelerate schedules

**Basic Qualifications**

* Candidate must possess a Bachelor's of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
* Candidate must have at least twelve (12) years of experience in the design and test of electronics or ten (10) years with MS degree.
* Candidate must demonstrate experience in the design, test, and manufacture of analog/mixed-signal PCBs or integrated RF/microwave assemblies.
* Candidate must have demonstrated experience leading engineering teams through production transitions from LRIP to full-rate production
* Candidate must demonstrate proficiency in engineering leadership and team management
* Candidate must have hands-on laboratory experience with instrumentation, test equipment, and debug/test methods including use of network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, signal generators, etc.
* Position requires candidates to be capable of performing in a collaborative engineering environment working closely with multi-disciplinary teams.

* Develop and apply approaches and tools for system-level and element-level performance analysis of the complex Missile Defense System
* Produce analysis results and inputs for official SEA test-report products and present findings during mission data reviews

* Support continuous improvement of analytical processes and mission assessment capabilities

* Electrical Engineering

* Related technical discipline

  
  
**YEARS OF EXPERIENCE**

jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support the U.S. Army DEVCOM Aviation & Missile Center (AvMC) Air/Ground Integration and Interoperability Lab (AGIIL) in Huntsville, AL. AGIIL is a fast-paced, rapid prototyping and systems integration laboratory supporting a diverse range of Department of War customers and mission areas. The selected candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams to translate operational and customer needs into technical requirements and practical hardware and software engineering solutions. You will apply a comprehensive understanding of Systems Engineering principles to identify and derive requirements, support software and system architecture development, design, integrate, test, and verify complex systems in a fast-paced R&D environment, contributing independently while also collaborating closely with senior engineers and mentors.

Responsibilities:

* Analyze customer and operational needs and translate them into practical technical requirements, approaches, and engineering solutions.
* Support rapid prototyping, software development, system integration, troubleshooting, laboratory and field testing, demonstrations, and evaluation activities.
* Develop system concepts, architectures, interface definitions, functional/data flows, mockups, and other engineering products used to communicate and mature solutions.
* Coordinate with software developers and other engineering disciplines to refine system behavior, interfaces, and implementation approaches.
* Work with software, hardware, network, test, and integration engineers to develop, evaluate, and improve integrated system solutions.
* Perform technical assessments, trade studies, and gap analyses; document findings, test results, risks, and recommended courses of action for internal and Government customers.
* Reviewing test plans, procedures, and verification and validation activities.
* Independently manage assigned technical tasks and priorities while coordinating with Government customers, internal teams, vendors, and external organizations as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, technical, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 10 years of relevant Systems Engineering, systems integration, or related technical experience.
* Experience supporting the development, integration, and testing of hardware and software systems, including software-intensive or networked solutions.
* Experience working with a multidisciplinary teams providing systems engineering support to develop practical engineering solutions.
* Ability to analyze technical problems, troubleshoot integration issues, and support software/system verification and validation activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work independently with general guidance as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Active DoD Secret security clearance required to start.
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Ability to lift 50lbs.
* 10% Travel.

Preferred:

* Experience with DoDAF architectures, UML/Object-Oriented Design, data flows, interface diagrams, or similar system modeling methods.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps environments and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting DoD/Army rapid prototyping, tactical networking, system integration, laboratory, or test environments.

Knowledge/Skills

* Knowledge of office administration and procedures.
* Exceptional judgment capabilities and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and client service skills; ability to clearly communicate in discussions and written documents, and to deliver feedback clearly and tactfully.
* Interact with a diverse array of customers and staff in a professional and courteous manner.
* Work independently with accountability for accurate and complete results.
* Be extremely organized and exceptionally detail oriented.
* Work well both independently and in a team environment.
* Be energized by a fast-paced work environment.
* Must be able to communicate with others effectively.
* Analyze information and respond appropriately.
* Manage time wisely and prioritize tasks.
* Provide superior customer service.
* Multi-task in a pleasant manner.
* Work well under pressure.

* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required.

We are seeking a Systems Engineer III to lead technical execution across multiple complex military aviation programs, spanning both rotary-wing and fixed-wing platforms. You will serve as a primary customer interface, lead Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), and steer major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR). * Customer Interface: Serve as the principal technical point of contact for military customers, sub-contractors, and external stakeholders.

* Cross-Functional Interface: Serve as the primary technical bridge between engineering, program management, quality, manufacturing, and operations, organizations to ensure seamless design-to-sustainment transitions.

Qualifications:

* **Experience:** Minimum of 12 years of progressive systems engineering experience in the military aerospace or defense industry.
* Leadership & Communication: Proven success leading IPTs and presenting complex engineering data directly to military customers.
* Platform Expertise: Proven background supporting both rotary-wing and fixed-wing aircraft development or modification programs.
* Testing & Integration: Demonstrated experience in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, system integration labs (SIL), and formal qualification testing (QT).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering.

**Preferred Skills**

* Advanced, hands-on experience using Cameo Simulation Toolkit and the 3DExperience ecosystem for Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).
* Strong knowledge of military airworthiness certification processes (e.g., MIL-HDBK-516C, AR 70-62).
* Strong knowledge of military safety (e.g. MIL-STD-882E, SAE ARP 4754/4761)
* Strong Knowledge of Design Assurance Guidelines for hardware and software (RTCA DO-254, RTCA DO-178C)
* Team Leadership: experience formally leading, mentoring, and direct-tasking a team of engineers.

PeopleTec is currently seeking a **Software Engineer (AI Agents & Orchestration)**to support our **Huntsville, AL** location.

PeopleTec is seeking a Software Engineer in Huntsville, AL, to build the software services and instructor interfaces that connect AI capabilities to the H-1 flight simulator. You will develop real-time services that process voice requests, route them to the appropriate AI capability, communicate with the simulator, and provide tools for instructors to review and evaluate system performance.

**Duties:**

* Develop software services that connect voice input, transcription, AI agents, and spoken responses in a real-time application.
* Build the interfaces between AI services and the flight simulator, including support for simulator commands and scenario activity.
* Develop browser-based tools that allow instructors to review system behavior, provide feedback, and support training and debrief activities.
* Implement traceability, logging, and other controls needed to understand system behavior and connect results to the models and software versions used.
* Develop automated tests, troubleshoot problems, and deliver software fixes and improvements.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills/Experience****:**

* Preferred experience range: 5–8 years of software engineering experience using Python and at least one additional language such as C++, Java, or TypeScript. Demonstrated technical ability will be considered regardless of total years of experience.
* Experience building real-time or streaming software services and integrating multiple software components into a working system.
* Experience developing browser-based user interfaces and backend services.
* Experience using containers and continuous integration in a Government or other regulated environment.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen

**Education Requirements****:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant professional or military experience may substitute for a degree.

**Desired Skills****:**

* Experience integrating flight simulators or training devices, including instructor operator station workflows.
* Audio pipeline experience, including capture, voice activity detection, and text-to-speech playback, along with low-latency service tuning.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Helm, GitLab CI, software bill of materials (SBOM) tooling, and development in STIG-hardened environments.
* Familiarity with experiment tracking, model registries, and dataset versioning tools.
* Familiarity with language-model applications and guardrails that control how model outputs are acted on.

Overview:

***People First. Technology Always.***

**PeopleTec, Inc.** is an employee-owned small business founded in Huntsville, AL that provides exceptional customer support by employing and retaining a highly skilled workforce.

The AIRO Group, designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication and display components and integrated systems that equip clients with unparalleled precision and accuracy. AIRO has a proven track record of excellence, with over 600 FAA certifications. Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

**What You Will Do**

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Join the Software Engineering Directorate’s Effectors Center team at Raytheon, where you will develop precision software applications that power the next generation of defense capabilities. In this role, you will design, code, integrate, and test critical real-time embedded software and firmware on missiles, launchers, radars, and naval fire control systems. Working as part of a fast-paced agile team at the leading edge of technology, you will gain hands-on exposure across the full software development lifecycle—advancing real-time systems design, digital signal processing, machine learning, and DevOps methodologies while helping defend our nation and allies.

This position is an onsite role located in Tucson, AZ.

  

* Assist in the derivation of software requirements, architecture design, implementation, and verification of real-time embedded software and application tools.
* Design, code, test, and integrate high-reliability software solutions utilizing C, C++, and object-oriented programming methodologies.
* Execute hardware-software integration, bench debugging, and testing on embedded targets and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments.
* Participate actively in internal peer code reviews, software component design reviews, and technical trade studies.
* Collaborate closely with systems engineers, hardware designers, and project managers to align requirements, constraints, and interface definitions.
* Follow established software engineering processes and configuration management practices to deliver robust, mission-critical work products.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

  

* Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date.
* Experience developing, building, or debugging software applications utilizing C, C++, or another object-oriented programming language.
* Experience with hardware-software integration, embedded system testing, or bench-level software debugging.
* Experience developing software using object-oriented principles and the practical application of common data structures and algorithms.

*Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.*

**Qualifications We Prefer**

  

* Experience with embedded real-time operating systems (RTOS such as FreeRTOS, VxWorks, or embedded Linux) or device driver development.
* Hands-on experience developing low-level code for microcontrollers, microprocessors, or development boards (e.g., ARM, Arduino, Raspberry Pi).
* Knowledge of systems software design, operating system architectures, and assembly language.
* Experience utilizing modeling tools, simulation environments, or scripting languages (such as MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or LabVIEW).
* Familiarity with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation or FPGA design using VHDL or Verilog.
* Familiarity with modern software development workflows, version control (such as Git), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) or scientific data processing tools (NumPy, Pandas).
* Experience creating formal technical documentation, such as architecture diagrams, interface control documents, or API specifications.
* Previous internship or research experience in aerospace, defense, or high-reliability embedded software engineering.

**What We Offer**

  

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX, we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation, if eligible

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.

* Onsite: Employees who are working in onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

The salary range for this role is 68,900 USD - 131,100 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Research and Development
jobs.description:
Onsite:  
Travel: 20%

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary + Bonus Potential!
* Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
* High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
* Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated R&D Electrical Engineer with expertise in low voltage (LV) and medium voltage (MV) power systems to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will drive the design, development, and testing of innovative power system solutions, contributing to the advancement of next-generation energy technologies. This role requires a strong foundation in electrical engineering principles, hands-on experience with LV/MV systems, and a passion for research and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and Development: Design, simulate, and develop electrical systems and components for low voltage (up to 1kV) and medium voltage (1kV–38kV) applications, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL).
* Prototyping and Testing: Build and test prototypes of power system components, including transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and control systems, to validate performance and reliability.
* Research and Innovation: Conduct research to explore new technologies, materials, and methodologies to improve efficiency, safety, and sustainability of LV/MV power systems.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical engineers, software engineers, and product managers, to integrate electrical systems into broader product designs.
* Documentation: Prepare technical reports, design specifications, and documentation to support product development, regulatory approvals, and intellectual property filings.
* Standards and Compliance: Ensure all designs and processes adhere to safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including NEC, NEMA, and OSHA requirements.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues in power systems during development, testing, and field implementation phases.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or minimum of 8 years of qualified work experience may be substituted.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D or design of low voltage and/or medium voltage power systems.
* Strong background in control system design using SolidWorks Electrical.
* Proven track record in designing and testing electrical components such as transformers, switchgear, or power distribution systems.
* Experience with power electronics, protection systems, and control systems is a plus.
* Strong understanding of power system components, including circuit breakers, relays, and busbars.
* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL, NEC).
* Proficient in using CAD tools (SolidWorks Electrical) for wiring schematics and panel layout design.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* Experience with renewable energy integration (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage, microgrids) into LV/MV systems.
* Familiarity with smart grid technologies or IoT applications in power systems.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.

Physical Requirements:

* Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds at a time.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Work Environment:  
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and in commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. The above-noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the applicant a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of this position. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of the position.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Sr. Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low- and high-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety-critical hardware design, incorporating multi-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real-time computer architectures and their OS's

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Automation Controls Engineer (Commissioning)

**Reports To:** Controls Engineering Manager

**Location / Travel:** Hackett, AR with travel

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an Automation Controls Engineer to join our Mission Critical Commissioning team. In this role, you will participate in the design, programming, checkout, and startup of automation control systems with an emphasis on mission critical power or HVAC infrastructure. This position offers significant hands-on field experience validating complex control systems in high-reliability environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Assist in developing and modifying PLC logic, HMI/SCADA screens, and device configurations.

· Review electrical schematics, P&IDs, panel layouts, and sequence of operations (SOO) to verify system intent.

· Perform point-to-point electrical checkouts, instrument calibration, and loop checks.

· Support on-site startup, functional testing, troubleshooting, and integrated system commissioning alongside contractors and field engineers.

· Coordinate with field electricians and engineering staff to verify field wiring by specifications.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical wiring.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot PLC and HMI logic/programs.

· Assist in procurement and tracking of control hardware, field instrumentation, and spare parts.

· Prioritize updates to documents; field modifications (redlines), test results, tasks list, and commissioning reports on a daily basis.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· Education & Experience (one of the following):

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Associate Degree in Industrial Automation, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related discipline with 1–2+ years of hands-on experience.

Equivalent military or trade experience (e.g., industrial electrician, Navy nuclear/electrical, certified instrumentation tech).

· Foundational understanding of PLC ladder logic or basic control loops.

· Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

· Hands-on aptitude with basic electrical testing tools, for example multimeters.

· Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

· Proficiency with standard office tools (Microsoft Office Suite, PDF markup).

· Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to client job sites.

**Preferred / Beneficial Qualifications:**

(Candidates with experience in ANY of the following areas are encouraged to apply):

Industrial Automation & Software:

· Experience programming or troubleshooting Rockwell/Allen-Bradley (Studio 5000 / RSLogix), or similar platforms.

· Experience developing or modifying HMI/SCADA systems (Inductive Automation Ignition, FactoryTalk View).

· Understanding of industrial networking and protocols (EtherNet/IP, Modbus RTU/TCP, Serial).

Power Systems / EPMS:

· Experience with Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS) or Substation Automation.

· Familiarity with low/medium voltage switchgear, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), or emergency diesel generators.

· Exposure to protective relays (SEL, Schneider, Basler) and power meters.

HVAC / BMS:

· Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and protocols (BACnet IP/MSTP, LonWorks).

· Understanding of central cooling and heating systems: chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and air handling units (AHUs).

· Knowledge of sequence of operations for environmental control: differential pressure control, humidity control, and economizer cycles.

**Job Benefits:**

* Full Time
* Competitive Salary
* Health Care Package – Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life

**Summary**  
  
The **Senior Software Engineer (Embedded)** has the opportunity to develop a variety of innovative unmanned and robotic systems for multiple defense and commercial applications. This requires the engineer to design, develop, code, test and debug system software as well as analyze and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of the software on particular devices. jobs.title: Senior Staff Hardware Engineer - Optical
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

AI’s next breakthrough depends on more than compute—it depends on how efficiently data moves. As AI clusters scale out across racks and data centers, optical connectivity becomes essential to delivering the bandwidth, power efficiency, and performance these systems demand.  
  
Join Marvell’s Optics team and help engineer the hardware that makes that connectivity possible. Our platforms bring together high-speed silicon photonics, transmit and receive amplifiers, controller ASICs, Marvell digital signal processors, and embedded firmware to create highly integrated optical solutions.  
  
Our team owns the design, verification, and validation of these components, including system-level testing of hardware, firmware, and control loops across operating conditions. You will work alongside specialists across these disciplines and carry products from initial concept through new product introduction.

**What You Can Expect**

As a Senior Staff Hardware Engineer, you will lead hardware platform development for integrated optical transceiver engines supporting high-speed fiber-optic communications.

Your decisions will shape how advanced semiconductor devices are powered, interconnected, characterized, and prepared for production. You will translate complex electrical and system requirements into robust hardware, resolve challenging analog and RF issues, and build the platforms that enable teams to validate optical performance with confidence.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership at a company advancing optical connectivity for AI and cloud infrastructure. You will influence design direction, guide cross-functional decisions, and see your work progress from the first schematic to production readiness.

* **Lead** **Optical** **module and test platform hardware development from concept through NPI.** Define and deliver integrated optical engines’ test platforms, including device-under-test (DUT) cards, interposers, sockets, and handler boards.
* **Own critical design decisions.** Drive schematic capture, PCB and substrate layout reviews, stack-up optimization, power delivery design, and bill-of-materials management.
* **Engineer for high-speed performance.** Evaluate signal integrity and power integrity simulation results, translate findings into design improvements, and verify compliance with electrical requirements.
* **Bring designs to life in the lab.** Lead optical test platform hardware bring-up, electrical and optical characterization, and debugging using high-speed oscilloscopes, vector or performance network analyzers, signal generators, optical sampling scope, and electronic loads.
* **Validate the complete system.** Partner with optical, silicon, and firmware engineers to investigate hardware behavior, control-loop performance, and interactions across operating conditions.
* **Accelerate engineering through automation.** Develop scripts and tools using Python, C++, and/or MATLAB to improve validation efficiency, measurement repeatability, and correlation between simulations and laboratory results.
* **Balance performance with production realities.** Select components with attention to electrical performance, availability, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Connect development with production.** Collaborate with operations, product engineering, test engineering, applications engineering, manufacturing, and business development to align requirements and support successful product introduction.
* **Provide Senior Staff technical leadership.** Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, communicate tradeoffs, and coordinate technical execution across global teams.
* **Build knowledge that lasts.** Document design rationale, validation methods, and results, and share insights through technical presentations and internal reports.

At Marvell, you can build deep expertise while contributing across a broad semiconductor technology portfolio. This role offers the combination of challenging engineering, end-to-end ownership, and collaboration needed to turn advanced optical technology into products that help AI infrastructure scale.

**What We're Looking For**

* A master’s degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering with **3+ years of relevant experience**, or a bachelor’s degree with **5+ years of relevant experience**.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex O2E and E2O hardware development, with the technical judgment and cross-functional leadership expected at the Senior Staff level.
* Proven experience designing optical transceiver module and test platform hardware design for testing, power delivery, or high-speed communications.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and RF signaling, PCB design and fabrication, schematic capture, and hardware interfaces.
* Experience evaluating signal integrity and power integrity using tools such as PowerDC, PowerSI, ADS, HFSS, or Clarity 3D.
* Proficiency with schematic capture and layout environments, including relevant Cadence tools or comparable platforms.
* Familiarity with communication and control protocols such as SPI, I2C, I3C, SPMI, and UART.
* Hands-on experience using oscilloscopes, VNAs/PNAs, signal generators, and electronic loads to characterize and troubleshoot hardware.

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives communication and data processing transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm ASIC Engineer, you will define, model, design (digital and/or analog), optimize, verify, validate, implement, and document IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power world class products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

OR
  
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
  
OR
  
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field.

The DDRSS Systems Engineer is responsible for validating, tuning, and optimizing the DDR subsystem across pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms. This role requires close collaboration with design, validation, architecture, and software teams to ensure critical power, performance, reliability, and functionality features are successfully enabled in Qualcomm products.

The team is responsible for the development, integration, and validation of low-level DDR subsystem firmware and APIs. Engineers leverage their understanding of system architecture, memory subsystem behavior, and hardware/software interactions to methodically collect and analyze stability, power, performance, and functional data that drive product decisions and optimization efforts.

This is a highly cross-functional role requiring a strong foundation in embedded systems, digital design, and system-level debugging. Responsibilities include firmware development in C, validation of firmware across DV environments, emulation platforms, FPGA prototypes, and silicon, as well as post-silicon bring-up and performance characterization activities.

The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of LPDDR protocols, caches, interconnects, and memory controllers. The candidate should be comfortable working across the entire product lifecycle, from design validation through silicon bring-up and production readiness.

* Develop and maintain low-level firmware and system APIs for DDR subsystem initialization, training, power management, and performance features.
* Validate firmware functionality in simulation, emulation, FPGA, and silicon environments.

* Collect and interpret stability, performance, power, and reliability data to guide design and product decisions.
* Collaborate across design, DV, software, architecture, and product teams to enable and optimize DDR features.
* Perform DDR subsystem bring-up and characterization on pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms.
* Debug memory subsystem issues involving LPDDR interfaces, caches, interconnects, and memory controllers.
* Contribute to the definition and validation of next-generation memory subsystem capabilities and optimizations.

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with a focus on Embedded Systems, Computer Architecture, or VLSI.
* 2+ years of experience in embedded firmware or low-level software development.
* Strong programming skills in C.
* Experience with embedded system debugging and hardware/software integration.
* Understanding of digital design fundamentals and computer architecture concepts.
* Experience using lab equipment and silicon debugging tools to collect and analyze system data.
* Familiarity with LPDDR memory interface concepts and protocol fundamentals.

* Experience with LPDDR4/LPDDR5/LPDDR5X memory protocols, training algorithms, timing parameters, and power management features.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer, Automation
jobs.description:
**Senior Controls Engineer, Automation**

**About the role**

Spring is a nonprofit venture platform building and backing companies that improve animal welfare at scale.

Spring Works, Spring's in-house technology group, designs, prototypes, and welfare-validates the devices the ecosystem needs but no vendor supplies. These technologies are then handed off to our incubated companies for deployment.

The equipment you build is the foundation of better welfare for billions of animals. These machines will be placed on farms, at fisheries, at aquaculture sites, in land-based processing plants, and on boats at sea. Equipment you might work on includes stunning systems for fish and crustaceans, aquaculture water quality and actuation systems, and farm robots, with new categories added as the ecosystem presents a need.

Spring Works products have to run reliably in wet, corrosive, moving environments, often thousands of miles from our shop. Some will run standalone and others in conjunction with equipment already on site. They have to be safe for the people operating them, who may have had minimal training. We design in remote diagnostics and instrumentation from the start. What we hand over to an incubated company is a field-deployable prototype, built to survive real production conditions and to return evidence of how it performed.

We’re hiring a Senior Controls Engineer to lead the controls system architecture and oversee the delegation of all related tasks within our team. This will start with defining the operations of the machine from a controls perspective very early on, scaffolding the machine logic, and providing the mechanical engineering side of the team with the specifications and components they need to incorporate during the concept phase of machine design. You will specify and source controls and electrical related components, design the schematics, program the machine including PCs/microcontrollers, PLCs, motion controllers, and HMI, and be hands-on during machine build with leading the wiring and panel builds. You will be responsible for running the machine during testing and debug, and solving whatever controls issues arise.

This is a full-scope controls role at a machine builder: architecture, code, electrical design package, panel, safety, and commissioning. It is not a maintenance or sustaining role, and it is not PLC programming inside someone else's electrical design.

You should be able to operate without oversight from management, and to judge when to seek input and when to decide on your own, as well as to delegate effectively to junior engineers. You must have a collaborative mindset and demonstrate sound decision-making and judgment.

**What you'll do**

**Scaffold the controls architecture**

* Develop the sequence of operations and control architecture during machine concepting, well before the mechanical design is frozen.
* Develop the I/O list, network architecture, and control philosophy, and drive them through design reviews with mechanical and mechatronics.
* Identify control-side risk early: cycle-time feasibility, sensing ambiguity, safe-state definition, and recovery from fault.

**Own the electrical design package**

* Produce the complete electrical design package: schematics, panel layouts, wiring and interconnect diagrams, I/O layouts, and electrical BOMs.
* Select and specify control components, including PLCs and I/O, drives, safety relays and safety controllers, sensors, contactors, breakers and circuit protection, power supplies, and networking hardware.
* Work with the mechanical design team to give them clear deliverables on which controls components they need to accommodate in the CAD design.
* Lead the machine wiring, including panel build, I/O and sensor wiring, and crimping and connectorizing, either hands-on or by directing a panel shop and wiring technicians. You should be able to build a panel yourself and be credible telling someone else how.
* Source electrical components and manage the vendors who supply them.

**Safety and compliance**

* Design the machine's safety system: E-stop circuits, safety relays or safety PLC, light curtains, interlocks, guard monitoring, and safe-state behavior.
* Perform and document risk assessments, and specify to the required performance level.
* Design to the applicable codes: NFPA 79, NEC/NFPA 70, UL 508A for panels, ISO 13849 or IEC 62061 for functional safety, and ANSI/RIA 15.06 where robots are in the cell.

**Program the machines**

* Program the PCs and microcontrollers, PLCs, and motion controllers for multi-station, multi-axis machinery.
* Write code that is structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable. Build and maintain libraries and standard blocks rather than re-deriving each machine from scratch.
* Configure and tune servo drives and VFDs, and implement coordinated multi-axis motion and robot integration where required.
* Develop HMI interfaces for operation, diagnostics, and maintenance that are robust, easy to operate, and documented in an operations manual.
* Implement machine data collection and any required MES, database, or SCADA integration.
* Work with embedded systems engineers or consultants to connect machine data to ancillary telemetry systems.

**Commission and ship**

* Lead power-on, bring-up, controls debug, and tuning. Own the machine's first run alongside the mechanical team lead.
* Run FAT and support SAT, installation, startup, and production release at customer sites.
* Produce the documentation the customer actually needs: as-built schematics, sequence of operations, alarm lists, operator and maintenance procedures, and code backups.
* Support machines in the field after they ship.

**Raise the bar around you**

* Set and maintain controls standards, including code structure, tag naming, library management, panel conventions, and revision control.
* Set the controls standards now, mentor junior controls engineers as the team grows.
* Be a credible technical voice

Learn more about benefits at Google.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Availability Platform
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**Build the operating system for the AI datacenter**
----------------------------------------------------

Crusoe operates one of the world's largest managed GPU fleets, and it is growing fast. A fleet at this scale cannot be run the way GPU clouds have traditionally been run: runbooks, war rooms, and heroics. It has to be run by a unified platform that senses, reasons about, and acts on the entire fleet, so infrastructure that used to take a team to operate takes a service instead. That is what our cloud platform team builds. You will work on the control plane for one of the largest AI fleets in the world, at a point where fleet autonomy is still an open problem: nobody has fully solved this at this scale, in this market.

**A true platform, not internal tooling:** We want to be explicit about that heading, because it is the thing most infrastructure roles get wrong. Everything we build ships as a product, fleet engineers, SREs, and product teams across Crusoe build their own services and workflows on top of what we ship. A platform team does not scale by doing everyone's work; it scales by making everyone's work self-serve. Concretely:

* **API-first.** Every capability is exposed through well-designed, versioned APIs behind a single gateway. If it isn't an API, it doesn't exist. No side doors, including for us.
* **SDKs and paved paths.** First-class client libraries, workflow templates, and golden paths so a fleet or SRE engineer can ship a new remediation or lifecycle workflow in days without asking the platform team.
* **Micro frontends and a self-serve portal.** Teams plug their own UI surfaces into one developer portal instead of building one-off dashboards. One console for the fleet, extensible by every team.
* **Platform as product.** Internal teams are customers. We own contracts, versioning, deprecation policy, quotas, documentation, and support. Adoption is our success metric: the platform wins when other teams choose it because it is the fastest path, not because it is mandated.

**What this platform is**
-------------------------

Four layers, built as one system:

* **Agents** on every site and host that collect telemetry and execute commands.
* **A distributed infra graph**: Models system connections down to the rack, fabric, power, and cooling layers. By integrating these connections with telemetry signals, the platform can precisely trace events to identify their blast radius and root cause.
* **A reconciliation core**: workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that continuously close the gap between intended state and reality, exposed through the API gateway.
* **Domain services**: Services spanning provisioning, firmware upgrade, validation, deployment, repair and RMA, capacity, power and thermal, and Day-2 operations. Built once, run fleet-wide, consumable by any team through APIs and SDKs.

We operate on a continuous autonomy loop—sense, correlate, reason, act, learn—incorporating guardrails that evolve from recommendation to full automation. We treat every recurring manual intervention as a signal to engineer the next automation.

**You'll thrive here if you**
-----------------------------

* Want to build a platform, not integrate one. This is core distributed-systems engineering: event buses, graph models, reconciliation loops, policy evaluation.
* Treat internal engineers as customers and sweat API ergonomics, docs, and onboarding the way product teams sweat UX.
* Like owning a hard abstraction and defending it as ten teams build on top of you.
* Believe the interesting problems are where physical infrastructure meets software: a firmware counter, a thermal event, and a scheduling decision are one problem, not three.
* Measure yourself by what stops paging humans, and by how fast another team ships on your platform.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and build core platform services: RBAC, tenancy, the workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that drive fleet actions safely at scale.
* Design the public face of the platform: the API gateway, resource model, and versioned API contracts that fleet, SRE, and product teams build against.
* Build SDKs, workflow templates, and golden paths that make the platform self-serve, plus the developer portal and micro frontend framework that let teams bring their own UI surfaces.
* Build the inventory and topology graph as the fleet's source of intended truth, and the pipelines that keep it honest against reality (metadata drift is one of our top verified incident root causes; you will kill it).
* Build site, GPU, and network agents and the event bus that moves fleet telemetry and commands reliably.
* Deliver the platform roadmap: pilot site on the foundation layer, first site deployed entirely through the platform, zero-downtime f

* **API-first.** Every capability is exposed through well-designed, versioned APIs behind a single gateway. If it isn't an API, it doesn't exist. No side doors, including for us.
* **SDKs and paved paths.** First-class client libraries, workflow templates, and golden paths so a fleet or SRE engineer can ship a new remediation or lifecycle workflow in days without asking the platform team.
* **Micro frontends and a self-serve portal.** Teams plug their own UI surfaces into one developer portal instead of building one-off dashboards. One console for the fleet, extensible by every team.
* **Platform as product.** Internal teams are customers. We own contracts, versioning, deprecation policy, quotas, documentation, and support. Adoption is our success metric: the platform wins when other teams choose it because it is the fastest path, not because it is mandated.

**What this platform is**
-------------------------

Four layers, built as one system:

* **Agents** on every site and host that collect telemetry and execute commands.
* **A distributed infra graph**: Models system connections down to the rack, fabric, power, and cooling layers. By integrating these connections with telemetry signals, the platform can precisely trace events to identify their blast radius and root cause.
* **A reconciliation core**: workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that continuously close the gap between intended state and reality, exposed through the API gateway.
* **Domain services**: Services spanning provisioning, firmware upgrade, validation, deployment, repair and RMA, capacity, power and thermal, and Day-2 operations. Built once, run fleet-wide, consumable by any team through APIs and SDKs.

We operate on a continuous autonomy loop—sense, correlate, reason, act, learn—incorporating guardrails that evolve from recommendation to full automation. We treat every recurring manual intervention as a signal to engineer the next automation.

**You'll thrive here if you**
-----------------------------

* Want to build a platform, not integrate one. This is core distributed-systems engineering: event buses, graph models, reconciliation loops, policy evaluation.
* Treat internal engineers as customers and sweat API ergonomics, docs, and onboarding the way product teams sweat UX.
* Like owning a hard abstraction and defending it as ten teams build on top of you.
* Believe the interesting problems are where physical infrastructure meets software: a firmware counter, a thermal event, and a scheduling decision are one problem, not three.
* Measure yourself by what stops paging humans, and by how fast another team ships on your platform.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and build core platform services: RBAC, tenancy, the workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that drive fleet actions safely at scale.
* Design the public face of the platform: the API gateway, resource model, and versioned API contracts that fleet, SRE, and product teams build against.
* Build SDKs, workflow templates, and golden paths that make the platform self-serve, plus the developer portal and micro frontend framework that let teams bring their own UI surfaces.
* Build the inventory and topology graph as the fleet's source of intended truth, and the pipelines that keep it honest against reality (metadata drift is one of our top verified incident root causes; you will kill it).
* Build site, GPU, and network agents and the event bus that moves fleet telemetry and commands reliably.
* Deliver the platform roadmap: pilot site on the foundation layer, first site deployed entirely through the platform, zero-downtime f
