jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely
* You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance

* Experience with HMI and control network components, including maintenance, troubleshooting, programming and design
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components

* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
* Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are dedicated to a culture of safety. This role plays a crucial role in the history of space exploration and demands a dedication and meticulous focus on safe and repeatable spaceflight. **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another technical field

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Defense (BDS), Security, Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems (SI&WS) is seeking multiple **Senior Systems Engineers** to join our Experimental Systems Group (ESG) at **Kennedy Space Center, FL**.

At Boeing, our Systems Engineers drive the innovation, development, evaluation, and end-to-end execution of validation methods and test systems across manufacturing, refurbishment, integrated vehicle testing, and operational checkout. In this role, you will operate across multiple engineering disciplines to verify system-of-systems performance, serving as the technical bridge between design intent, physical hardware validation, and flight readiness through the following responsibilities.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define, decompose, and coordinate system-level test and verification requirements derived from customer, mission, and operational needs
* Integrate cross-functional parameters across electrical, mechanical, fluids, thermal, and software interfaces to verify end-to-end compatibility and functional integrity
* Lead specialized analyses including safety, reliability, maintainability, testability, survivability, and requirement certification to optimize configurations for mission success
* Govern requirements management and verification tracking using formal tools, risk/opportunity frameworks, and readiness assessments to ensure complete verification closure

* Represent the system test organization directly in the factory, test cell, and post-production environments throughout hardware builds, integrated functional testing, and refurbishment cycles
* Lead dynamic system test operations, translating complex flight and ground environments into actionable test procedures, instrumentation strategies, and acceptance criteria
* Author technical dispositions and engineering deviations for hardware non-conformances, operational limit exceedances, or test anomalies to maintain operational cadence without sacrificing safety or quality

* Lead rapid root-cause analysis (RCA), failure investigation, and multi-system troubleshooting to diagnose complex operational anomalies and flight hardware defects
* Identify, develop, and deploy continuous upgrades to test infrastructure, instrumentation setups, and operational processes to improve test cadence, reliability, and mission throughput

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
* Active U.S. Top Secret / SCI security clearance (investigation active or open within the past 24 months; U.S. citizenship required)
* 7+ years of experience in an engineering role
* Ability to analyze and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and parts lists
* Strong skills in engineering analysis, requirements tracing, and technical communication

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Expertise in system-level tests and verification of space vehicles or space systems
* Refined cross-functional leadership skills and experience working with multi-disciplined teams
* Expert in aerospace avionics, electrical systems, and RF equipment
* Subject matter expert for approved repair and testing techniques for electronics and components
* Experience with hardware and software requirements verification using tools like DOORS
* Scripting experience for test automation or data processing (e.g., Python, Tcl/Tk, Perl)
* Experience with configuration management and tracking tools (e.g., Git, SVN, PLM, Jira, MS Project)

**Conflict of Interest:**

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies*.*

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what's already been done, this is where it happens.

**About the Role:**

* Design, develop, test, integrate, and operate launch control and acquisition hardware, instrumentation, and cameras used to support and control the Terran R rocket.
* Work with Beckhoff PLCs or similar systems.
* Support high-speed data acquisition.
* Work with instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, level, accelerometers, solenoid valves, VFDs, and heaters.
* Integrate and operate IP, SDI, and CoaXPress high-speed cameras.
* Assist in the design of electrical systems for use in hazardous areas.
* Collaborate with other groups to gather requirements, plan schedules, and coordinate work.
* Plan, install, and operate wiring and hardware in access-limited areas such as launch mounts and transport erectors.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another related STEM discipline.
* Exposure to data acquisition hardware, PLC-based control systems, complex camera systems, and instrumentation selection and troubleshooting.
* Ability to work with multidisciplinary groups in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Experience with the design and operation of spacecraft and launch vehicle infrastructure.
* Experience working at a rocket launch site.
* Proficiency with electrical schematic design software such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or Zuken E3.

**Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.**

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.***

***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer – Command & Control
jobs.description:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

**About The Role:**  

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Command & Control team in Atlanta. The team is responsible for the design, development, integration, testing, and delivery of software supporting Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), Pilot Vehicle Interfaces (PVI), Command & Control (C2), telemetry, and vehicle communications.

This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers.

This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data.

The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain embedded C/C++ software supporting aircraft communications, telemetry, Command & Control, and vehicle data links.

* Design and implement software that enables reliable communication between aircraft and ground control systems.

* Own and support networking functionality across both vehicle and ground-based systems.

* Develop software interfaces for radios, transmitters, receivers, and other communications hardware.

* Integrate and troubleshoot RF communications systems in collaboration with RF and avionics engineers.

* Develop and maintain network management functionality including Ethernet, TCP/UDP, multicast, and related networking protocols.

* Develop software requirements, system architectures, interface definitions, and technical design documentation.

* Participate in software and system design reviews and communicate technical tradeoffs across multidisciplinary teams.

* Test and debug software on target hardware, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), laboratory, and integrated hardware environments.

* Develop and execute system-level tests to verify communications performance and reliability.

* Support integration, troubleshooting, and testing of aircraft and ground station communications systems.

* Write efficient, maintainable, well-documented software that meets performance and safety requirements.

* Participate in the development and verification of safety-critical software.

* Own technical schedules and roadmaps for assigned software and communications capabilities.

* Support flight test and range operations as required.

* Travel up to approximately 25% to support integration and test activities.

### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Professional experience developing embedded software in C and/or C++.

* Strong understanding of software fundamentals including memory management, pointers, references, and object-oriented programming.

* Experience developing, debugging, and testing software that interfaces with hardware.

* Familiarity with networked or distributed systems and common communications concepts.

* Experience working in Linux-based software development environments.

* Ability to independently troubleshoot complex software and hardware integration issues.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across software, hardware, and systems engineering teams.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and developing or testing software on target hardware.

* Experience with aircraft, spacecraft, robotics, autonomous vehicles, defense systems, or other embedded platforms.

* Experience with vehicle communications, telemetry, Command & Control, or data-link systems.

* Experience with aerospace telemetry standards or protocols such as CCSDS or IRIG.

* Experience with serial communications, CAN, Ethernet, TCP, UDP, or similar protocols.

* Experience with multicast networking, including IGMPv3, Source-Specific Multicast (SSM), or related technologies.

* Experience interfacing software with radios, particularly Software Defined Radios (SDRs).

* Experience writing software used to configure, command, monitor, or control RF communications hardware.

* Familiarity with RF communications concepts and troubleshooting communications links across software and hardware.

* Experience with satellite communications, cellular communications, or other wireless data-link technologies.

**Company Overview:**  
Coreforce is an innovative technology company providing public safety organizations a comprehensive technology suite from dispatch to the courtroom. Coreforce delivers integrated technology designed to support public safety entities, regardless of organizational size. Our products - body cameras, in-car videos, mobile routers, and digital evidence systems- help public safety officers and first responders save lives, strengthen community trust, and enhance accountability.

**Embedded Engineer II****-** Build Your Career with Purpose

Join Coreforce and use your engineering skills to support innovative technology that strengthens communities.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Flexible hybrid schedule.
* Free chef-inspired lunch Monday–Thursday.
* 15 PTO days + floating holiday.
* Competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k). We provide 401(k) matching per the terms of the 401(k) plan.
* Annual bonus.
* Tuition reimbursement.
* Career growth in a fast-growing, mission-driven company.
* Collaborative, purpose-driven culture.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and deliver firmware features end-to-end in C/C++ for bare-metal and embedded Linux platforms with limited supervision.
* Own small firmware subsystems or components — including their testing, documentation, and maintenance.
* Develop, integrate, and debug device drivers for peripherals such as sensors, radios, storage, and communication interfaces (I²C, SPI, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet).
* Perform board bring-up tasks independently — including bootloader configuration, peripheral initialization, and hardware validation for known platform variants.
* Implement and tune interrupt handlers, timers, and low-level scheduling mechanisms to achieve reliable, deterministic behavior. Use debugging and measurement tools — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD, protocol analyzers — to diagnose and resolve hardware/firmware interaction issues independently. Collaborate with hardware engineers to review schematics and identify firmware-relevant design considerations.
* Contribute to board support packages (BSPs), bootloader configuration, and OS integration for embedded Linux and RTOS-based systems.
* Implement error handling, logging, and diagnostic capabilities for field debugging.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests for owned components, using test harnesses and hardware-in-the-loop setups where appropriate.
* Participate actively in design discussions — proposing approaches, identifying tradeoffs, and asking clarifying questions.
* Conduct peer code reviews with attention to correctness, performance, maintainability, and adherence to team standards.
* Break down requirements into technical tasks and estimate work for sprint planning.
* Participate fully in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of team processes.

**Mandatory Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Professional experience developing embedded firmware for production or near-production hardware platforms.
* Solid proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems, including practical understanding of memory management, concurrency, and real-time constraints.
* Experience developing and debugging device drivers for common embedded interfaces (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART, USB).
* Hands-on experience with at least one microcontroller family (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, etc.) and familiarity with bare-metal development patterns.
* Exposure to an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX) or embedded Linux distribution (Yocto, Buildroot).
* Practical experience with low-level debugging tools — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers,JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and understand hardware behavior relevant to firmware development.
* Understanding of real-time systems concepts including interrupt handling, priority inversion, and timing constraints.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD tooling for firmware builds.
* Experience working in an agile/Scrum environment as part of a cross-functional team.
* Good written and verbal communication skills for design discussions, documentation, and code reviews.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with wireless communication stacks (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, LTE, proprietary RF) in an embedded context.
* Experience with Nordic Semiconductor BLE devices and SDK, or similar BLE chipset development environments.
* Familiarity with Android debugging tools (ADB, logcat) for cross-device BLE communication debugging; exposure to Android NDK for native- layer integration.
* Exposure to secure boot, cryptographic libraries, or secure firmware update mechanisms.
* Experience developing firmware for battery-powered or low-power devices, including basic power state management.
* Familiarity with manufacturing test, factory programming, or calibration processes.
* Experience with scripting (Python) for test automation, tooling, or build orchestration.
* Exposure to embedded audio/video capture or camera subsystems.
* Experience integrating embedded devices with cloud services via MQTT, HTTP, or gRPC.
* Experience with rugged, field-deployed hardware or public-safety devices.
* Familiarity with Java or JVM-based languages for companion services, device management applications, or test automation tooling.

**Coreforce is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.**

jobs.description:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About Automated Logic**

At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our products help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets.

**About this role:**

As an Associate Controls Engineer, you will be crucial to ALC’s business through the designing of building automation systems created specifically for each individual customer. We are looking for someone who works well in a team and has excellent problem-solving, time management, and multi-tasking skills. You will work to build new skills and advance existing skills while completing smaller projects on your own.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and program building automation systems, site-specific configuration of control system, and control algorithms.
* Adhere to project requirements and company and customer standards of design, programming, and implementation.
* Create a clear design document for project teams with technical information.
* Document and communicate the building automation system design and revisions.
* Develop graphical and text-based interfaces for building automation systems.
* Test programming and interfaces prior to implementation.
* Provide technical support to sales representatives to ensure customers’ needs are met.
* Identify and communicate project opportunities and risks.
* Support functional testing for building systems.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s Degree

OR

* High School Diploma / GED with 2+ years of HVAC/BMS experience
* Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Basic knowledge of primary functions of building automation system software and associated engineering tools, Automated Logic suites preferred.
* Basic knowledge of Automated Logic software, peripherals, add-ons, services, or hardware design.
* Understanding and/or experience with IP networks
* Understanding and/or experience with Microsoft Visio and/or similar software.
* Ability to understand written sequences of operations, diagrammatic depictions of systems.
* Familiar with third-party communication protocols used in building automation, such as BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, LON, N2, etc.
* Able to translate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Capable of climbing ladders or using other lift equipment over 8 feet above grade, and capable of lifting items up to 50lbs.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $53,000.00 - $106,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
* **Tuition Assistance**

**To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us | Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process**

Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Carrier provides affirmative action in employment for qualified individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with section 503 of Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.

OR

* Able to provide direction and guidance to other team members and lead project teams.

* Extensive knowledge of third-party communication protocols used in building automation (e.g. BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, LON, N2, etc.). Able to design and troubleshoot integrations with the same.

jobs.title: Electrical Controls Engineer (Level I-III) - CCI/Speer
jobs.description:
**Pay Range:**

$96,500.00 - $135,200.00

The actual annual salary offered to a candidate will be based on variables including experience, geographic location, education, and skills/achievements, and will be mutually agreed upon at the time of offer.

  

**Job Description**
===================

CCI/SPEER is seeking an **Electrical Controls Engineer** to join the team. In this role you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting technology to improve equipment, processes, and products. This is accomplished through design requirements, specifications, drawings, procurement of necessary materials and services, and coordination of installation and training for systems including new automation solutions. You will provide expertise in programming and designing industrial controls and interfaces for new and existing equipment and processes. Effectively communicate with team members at all levels of the organization to improve our workplace, manufacturing performance, and customer experience.

This position may be filled at the Engineer I, II, or III level based on education, experience, and demonstrated technical capability. *Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, apprenticeship experience, licensure, military experience, certifications, and directly related controls/automation experience will be considered.*

This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering Manager and will be based out of our **Lewiston, Idaho** office.

**What you'll do:**

* Support the design, development, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing systems.

* Design, program, troubleshoot, and commission PLC-based control systems using platforms such as Allen-Bradley, Omron, or similar technologies.

* Develop and maintain HMI and operator interface systems to improve equipment usability and diagnostics.

* Assist with or lead automation projects involving robotics, vision systems, servo motion, industrial networking, and process controls based on experience level.

* Design, implement, maintain, and improve electrical instruments, equipment, facilities, and systems within the manufacturing environment.

* Participate in capital projects including concept development, design, procurement, installation, startup, and project validation.

* Troubleshoot equipment and process issues using a structured root cause problem-solving approach, identifying underlying causes rather than simply replacing components.

* Collaborate with operations, maintenance, engineering, quality, and IT teams to develop practical and scalable manufacturing solutions.

* Support integration of machine data into manufacturing and business systems for improved reporting, traceability, and decision making.

* Ensure compliance with applicable electrical, safety, and regulatory standards including NEC, OSHA, and machine safety requirements.

* Create and maintain technical documentation, drawings, standards, and training materials.

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members as experience level and business needs dictate.  



**Experience you bring:**

**Engineer I**

* Associate's Degree (AAS) in a related technical discipline with 4-10 years of relevant controls, automation, or manufacturing experience; or Journeyman Electrician license with 4-10 years of relevant industrial controls experience.

* Internship, co-op, project, apprenticeship, or early-career experience with automation, controls, manufacturing equipment, or industrial systems.

* Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, apprenticeship experience, licensure, military experience, certifications, and directly related controls/automation experience will be considered.

* Foundational understanding of PLC programming, HMIs, electrical schematics, and industrial control systems.

Strong troubleshooting aptitude and desire to learn.  



**Engineer II**

* Bachelor's degree in a related engineering field with 2-6 years of relevant experience; or entry-level Master's degree; or Associate's Degree (AAS) with 5-15 years of electrical controls, automation, or manufacturing experience; or Journeyman Electrician license with 15+ years of relevant experience.

* 3+ years of experience supporting automated manufacturing systems and industrial controls.

* Working knowledge of PLC programming, HMI development, industrial networking, and equipment troubleshooting.

* Experience designing, implementing, or improving control systems and automation solutions with limited supervision.

Demonstrated ability to identify root causes of equipment and process issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.  



**Engineer III**

* Bachelor's degree in a related engineering field with 4-10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree with 2-6 years of relevant experience; or Associate's Degree (AAS) with 15+ years of electrical controls and automation experience; or Journeyman Electrician license with 15+ years of relevant experience.

* 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting automated manufacturing solutions.

* Advanced experience with PLC programming, controls architecture, automation troubleshooting, project leadership, and manufacturing process optimization.

* Proven ability to lead complex automation projects, mentor engineers and technicians, and serve as a technical resource for electrical controls systems.

Demonstrated track record of driving root-cause problem solving, equipment reliability improvements, and manufacturing performance gains.  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Allen-Bradley, Omron, Siemens, or similar PLC platforms.

* Experience with robotics, servo motion systems, machine vision, and automated inspection systems.

* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as EtherNet/IP, TCP/IP, OPC UA, and Modbus.

* Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, SCADA systems, and manufacturing data systems.

* Knowledge of machine safety

jobs.title: Electrical Studies, SCADA & Protection Electrical Engineer - Experienced Professional
jobs.description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for an **ESSP Electrical Engineer** for our **Hailey, ID** office. Be involved in projects with our **ESSP (Electrical Studies, SCADA & Protection) Team** and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

WSP brings global expertise in power delivery, power generation, and program management — anchored by the acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. TRC Companies have now joined WSP, deepening our power practice and expanding our energy advisory and intelligent grid services. We're partnering with clients to shape how energy systems evolve around the world — and we need your help.

The successful applicant will be responsible for performing services related to electrical studies, SCADA, and system protection. Depending on project needs and individual expertise, this role may involve supporting a broad range of activities or specializing in a specific area as outlined under “Your Impact. ” Candidates are not expected to be proficient in all listed areas, they are expected to have a fundamental understanding of three-phase power and power system fundamentals. Applicable power systems primarily include conventional and renewable generation facilities, substations, transmission systems, and distribution systems. Activities may include one or more of the following:

**Your Impact:**

* Protective Relaying: short circuit and symmetrical component analysis, time-current coordination, protection scheme and criteria development, relay settings calculation, integration with SCADA systems, NERC compliance, and arc flash analysis. Applicable software: AcSELerator Quickset (SEL-5030), AcSELerator Architect, GE EnerVista, ASPEN OneLiner, Gridscale X (CAPE), SKM-PTW, ETAP, RSCAD/RTDS
* Power System Planning Studies: steady-state real and reactive power flow including outage contingencies, generation interconnect feasibility, P-V and Q-V analysis for voltage stability margins, dynamic stability performance, automation of large batch simulations, working with models from NERC regional entities (WECC, MRO, SERC etc.), NERC compliance. Applicable Software: PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld, DSA Tools, Python Scripting
* Design Studies: substation grounding, corona, electric and magnetic fields, insulation coordination (lightning, switching surge, and contamination performance), transient (time domain) simulation, power quality (harmonics, voltage flicker, over/under voltage, etc.), motor starting, AC interference (transmission line interaction with railroads and pipelines). Applicable Software: CDEGS, ATP-EMTP, PSCAD, POLARIS-EMF, COMSOL Multiphysics, TFlash
* Networking and Communications: design and configure network and communication paths for Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), protective relays, meters, Human Machine Interface (HMIs), PLC’s and other SCADA system equipment; develop basic specifications for fiber optic, microwave, power line carrier, or radio communication paths; travel to project sites to troubleshoot and commission network and communication systems. Applicable network and communication protocols: DNP, Modbus, SEL Communication Protocol, Goose Messaging, IEC 61850
* Logic and Control Systems: develop and implement logic and control schemes for remote and local operation of power system equipment; develop programs on various platforms for implementation of these schemes; travel to project sites to test and commission the control schemes. Applicable Logic and Control Platforms: SEL RTAC, Orion, Cooper SMP, GE-D20
* Write technical reports summarizing analysis with findings and conclusions, generating complete, accurate, and concise documentation using sketches, calculations, electronic systems, spreadsheets, and software.
* Assist technical staff and project managers with risk identification and assessment, offering input and analysis with design concepts, construction, mitigation and improvement activities, and remediation projects.
* Assist with work plan preparation and coordination of field/site work and permitting.
* Complete training on assigned tasks.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP ’ s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.  

**Who You Are:**

**Required Qualifications**

* BSEE (BS Electrical Engineering), BSEET (BS Electrical Engineering Technology), or BSCE (BS Computer Engineering) degree, from an ABET-accredited university
* 3 to 5 years of industry experience performing design or device configuration in technical disciplines described in the Roles and Responsibilities section
* Knowledge of electrical engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to permitting and project work-related issues.
* Analytical mindset with an ability to exercise sound judgement in evaluating situations and making decisions.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
* Capable self-leadership with attention to detail, accuracy, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as part of a team to meet business objectives.

* Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP ’ s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
* Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

**Job Description & Skill Requirement:**

* We are seeking a highly motivated Embedded Software Engineer with expertise in Drive-By-Wire (DBW) systems, Embedded C++, CAN communication, MATLAB/Simulink, and Linux/UNIX-based embedded software development. The engineer will support the development, integration, verification, and validation of autonomous and off-highway vehicle control systems.
* The role requires hands-on experience with safety-critical embedded software, Linux/UNIX environments, vehicle communication networks, model-based development, embedded debugging, and system integration across MIL, SIL, HIL, and vehicle platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Software Development & Integration:**

* + Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for DBW, Autonomous Hauling, and Machine Control Systems.
  + Develop application and middleware software using C++ for real-time embedded control systems.
  + Implement and integrate software features for steering, braking, propulsion, chassis, hoist, and vehicle control.
  + Develop and maintain Linux-based software components and services.
  + Support software bring-up, integration, deployment, and troubleshooting on target hardware and vehicle platforms.

**Model-Based Development:**

* Develop control algorithms and system models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow.
* Perform model verification, validation, and auto-code generation activities.
* Support MIL, SIL, and HIL testing.
* Ensure compliance with MAAB modeling guidelines and model quality standards.

**Vehicle Communication & Diagnostics:**

* Design, develop, and validate communication software using:
  + CAN / CAN FD
  + SAE J1939
  + UDS
  + Automotive Ethernet
* Develop and maintain DBC files and communication databases.
* Analyze network traffic and troubleshoot communication issues using:
  + CANoe
  + CANalyzer
  + CANape
  + CAPL
  + Wireshark
* Support diagnostics, calibration, and software download activities.

**Validation & Verification:**

* Execute MIL, SIL, HIL, System Integration Testing (SIT), regression testing, and vehicle validation.
* Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and regression test suites.
* Perform fault injection, diagnostics validation, fail-safe verification, and communication network testing.
* Analyze test results, perform root-cause analysis, and support issue resolution.

**Linux / UNIX Development & Support:**

* Develop, build, deploy, and troubleshoot software in Linux and UNIX environments.
* Create and maintain Shell/Bash scripts for software deployment, testing, diagnostics, and development workflows.
* Utilize Linux tools for process monitoring, memory analysis, performance tuning, and log analysis.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux-based embedded systems and development environments.
* Support cross-compilation, build automation, and software packaging.
* Debug networking and communication issues using Linux diagnostic and monitoring tools.

**Debugging & Troubleshooting:**

* Perform embedded software debugging using Lauterbach TRACE32 and other target debugging tools.
* Investigate software, communication, integration, and performance issues in HIL and vehicle environments.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 3+ years of experience in Embedded Software Development, Drive-By-Wire Systems, Autonomous Systems, Vehicle Controls, Off-Highway Equipment, or similar domains.
* Strong proficiency in C++ software development for embedded real-time systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux and UNIX operating systems.
* Experience in software integration, system validation, and troubleshooting of complex embedded systems.
* Experience with vehicle communication networks and safety-critical applications.
* Experience with CAN, CAN FD, J1939, UDS, and Automotive Ethernet.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow and model-based development.
* Experience with MIL/SIL/HIL testing and system integration.
* Experience with Lauterbach TRACE32 or equivalent embedded debugging tools.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Middleware (Hybrid - Oak Brook, IL)
jobs.description:

Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51+ million homes, and 14 million+ people rely on the myQ® app daily.

Job Description

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining development platforms for the Chamberlain myQ program. This includes but is not limited to middleware that serves as the foundation for myQ residential and commercial platforms. To accomplish this the Lead Software Engineer will work with other developers as well as other functions such as Engineering, Product Ownership, Marketing, Quality Assurance, Operations, and Customer Service in order to understand and translate product requirements into technical requirements, verify development matches product owner expectations, as well as maintain a high quality code base.

* Work using Agile methodologies such as Scrum to develop middleware
* Serve as primary point person and scrum team representative for interactions with product owner, front end, middleware, DeVos, and firmware functional teams
* Participate in technical assessment, scoping and management of changes to the code-base on new business requirements, product enhancements and other change requests
* Analyze requirements, collaborate with architects and senior engineers to produce thoughtful software designs of moderate scope and complexity
* Maintain domain specific software knowledge of key software application features, frameworks, or components in myQ middleware

Astronics Connectivity Systems and Certification (formerly Telefonix PDT and Astronics Armstrong Aerospace) serves as the experienced, global market leader for in-flight entertainment and connectivity (IFEC) solutions for aircraft. As a systems certification provider, Astronics CSC has worked on over 100 projects for industry partners to upgrade commercial and business aircraft with new passenger power systems, IFEC navigation, communication and flight safety systems. Additionally, Astronics CSC offers proven IFEC hardware systems, flexible design platforms, high customer satisfaction, and long-term relationships with industry leaders to help make the connected aircraft a reality. The company now employs over 300 employees and is a six-time recipient of Chicago's Best and Brightest Employers to Work For award.

  

**Summary**

Develop information systems by designing, developing, and installing software solutions.

***Local 100% onsite position primarily in Waukegan, IL.***

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The essential duties and responsibilities include the following, other duties as assigned.

* Will develop software solutions by studying information needs; conferring with users; studying systems flow, data usage, and work processes; investigating problem areas and following the software development lifecycle.
* Formulate, design, develop, document, test, and maintain primarily acceptance test, functional test, and/or firmware programming software, using industry best practices and standard design frameworks as appropriate.
* Analyze product requirements and design, consulting with hardware engineers and other engineering staff to determine necessary areas of test coverage and pass/fail criteria.
* Support factory manufacturing and customers in troubleshooting and root causing issues related to the test and/or programming software.
* The candidate must be "hands-on," detail oriented, and willing to roll up his/her sleeves to ensure a successful program.
* Responsible for implementing and complying with all ethical and legal compliance requirements.
* Other duties & functions may be assigned to this position as needed.
* Working knowledge of ISO/9001/14000/13485 and AS9100 processes.

  

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  

**Required:**

* BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, and/or Electrical Engineering from an accredited four-year college or university program.

* Possible experience with the development of application software for networked media sharing systems, advanced web pages, web software development languages/frameworks, streaming video, etc. that would be directly used in an In-Flight Entertainment system.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. These systems are designed, developed, built, integrated, and tested by the capable folks at our company to protect the lives of US and Allied warfighters in present and future conflicts. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today. If you are interested in being considered for inclusion on this team, we invite you to apply.

The **Engineering Program Manager (EPM)** is responsible for leading end-to-end engineering execution across the full program lifecycle. The EPM ensures the integrated engineering team delivers on cost, schedule, and technical performance. This role works in close partnership with the Program Manager and Chief Engineer to drive program success and meet commitments. EPMs are essential to strengthening how we execute—bringing consistency, rigor, and visibility across all engineering efforts on a program.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead engineering execution across the entire program lifecycle (capture through delivery)
* Drive cost, schedule, and technical performance with disciplined execution
* Integrate across all engineering functions and partner organizations (GSC, MFG, MA) to ensure cohesive program alignment
* Enable data-informed decisions using program metrics and performance indicators
* Ensure adherence and appropriate rigor to all engineering processes
* Partner with Program Managers and Chief Engineers to align technical scope, staffing, and execution plans
* Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks and issues early
* Drive milestone reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) with clear entry/exit criteria and readiness

**This position will be full-time, on-site at our Rolling Meadows, IL location.**

**This position is contingent upon funding/contract award, special access program, and acquiring and maintaining the necessary U.S. Government security clearance per customers' requirements prior to start.**

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Physics or other STEM field with 8+ years of related experience, MS degree in STEM field with 6+ years of related experience, or PhD in STEM field with 4+ years of related experience
* 1+ years of related engineering experience working in an engineering organization at a defense contractor during EMD and/or LRIP phases
* Experience working collaboratively on complex projects that encompass hardware, software, and firmware
* Experience in development and Earned Value Management (EVM) of cost accounts and schedules
* U.S. Citizenship required
* Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience using metrics to drive decisions and program outcomes
* Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills including presentation experience briefing senior levels of leadership, both internal and external
* 5+ years engineering experience, **including 3+ years** leading multi discipline engineering teams
* Experience in all aspects of the engineering process from proposal / requirements analysis through verification testing and fielding of systems
* Experience in a Systems Engineering Integration & Test environment from one or more of the following specialty areas: EOIR systems, sensors, optics, antenna design, direction finding, geolocation, threat analysis
* Experience decomposing requirements for DoD-based platforms or systems
* Demonstrated expertise in SysML modeling and MBSE tools (e.g., IBM Rational DOORS, Enterprise Architect, Cameo). Ability to develop and maintain system models, traceability matrices, and verification cross‑reference artifacts
* Strong understanding of engineering execution across the full program lifecycle (beyond task tracking or a single discipline)
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions, sites, and stakeholders
* Familiarity with Northrop Grumman processes and operating procedures
* CAM certification with experience in ETCs and CEACs (or demonstrated experience performing CAM responsibilities)
* Demonstrated success guiding teams through proposals and Basis of Estimate (BOE) generation, program planning including start-up, Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs), milestone or gate reviews and through all execution phases
* Active U.S. Government Top Secret security clearance

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level.

In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print

‑and

‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities.

What You’ll Do

* Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety.
* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.
* Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed.
* Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client.
* Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems.
* Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation.
* Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.
* Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability.
* Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams.
* Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members.
* Perform other job-related duties as needed or assigned.

What You’ll Need

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA-based monitoring and control systems.
* Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

You should be proficient in:

* PLC Programming Experience
* SCADA Experience

Machines & technologies you'll use:

* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Allen Bradley)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Chicago based
jobs.description:
Aviture provides custom software solutions for clients, acting as a business partner and technical advisor – sharing and contributing to our client’s vision. We provide full lifecycle software services from concept, implementation and first delivery on to continued maintenance, analysis, and continued adaption to user needs and market forces.

At Aviture we treat our employees as people, not resources. We value their personal & professional growth believing that stronger and healthier individuals are good for both our employees and our clients.

Using our principle of ‘cross pollination’ – we actively share problems & solutions between our project teams and provide ample opportunities for employees to advance to different teams at opportune moments to grow and mentor. The exposure to multiple industries and aspects of technology presents an ideal environment in which you can continue to master your trade skills, as well as be exposed to many developing technologies & interesting problem spaces.

Additionally, we encourage the inter-communication and mingling of our employees – to include company sponsored vacations, quarterly ‘cast away’ weeks where we co-locate our employees to further collaborate, and many social functions and internal interest groups.

We are headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, with remote employees across the nation.

**What is Aviture’s Art of the Possible?**

Along with our mission-driven team’s deep expertise in a wide range of development languages, we employ a disciplined agile approach to define goals upfront, keep organizational value at the forefront, and set the pace for rapid, iterative innovation that transforms organizations. We call this the Art of the Possible.

*The solutions we’ve created have:*

* Saved lives in the California wildfires and southern U.S. flooding
* Provided security for the 2020 Presidential Inauguration, Super Bowl, and post-attack Boston Marathon
* Enabled augmented-reality training environments for surgeons
* Increased transparency and promoted patient wellness in hospitals and senior care facilities
* Combined computer vision and robotics to automate dangerous manual labor tasks
* And much more!

**Why You’ll Want to Live Aviturian**

Aviturians create technology that makes a meaningful difference in someone’s life. We’re a team made up of designers, engineers, developers, and inventors who believe technology’s purpose is to empower users to change the world. Here are the values that guide us:

* Embody integrity
* Seek ownership
* Stay hungry
* Remain grounded
* Create impact
* Challenge with respect

We’ve built our culture around creativity, continuous learning, and our shared values. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, then join us today!

**Aviture is currently hiring a Senior Software Engineer** to join one of our development teams. This position will be based in Chicago, and will be expected to report daily to the customer site.

This role involves working as a part of a mature, cross functional, agile development team with generalized specializations in UX, UI, Mobile, Cloud Engineering (AWS), DevOps and QA. The ideal candidate should have deep experience with .NET, React, React Native, and C#. The greater exposure to these frameworks the better.

**We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who will…**

* Deliver solutions to complex technical challenges both independently and as a part of a cross-functional team.
* Communicate clearly in a timely manner in both verbal and written forms.
* Actively participate in all aspects of our agile development process.
* Assist in establishing and enforcing coding standards within their team.
* Work with project stakeholders to decompose complex requirements into smaller sets of iterative deliverables.
* Recognize and recommend design patterns for developing reliable, highly available, scalable and performant software solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve upon engineering processes within their team.
* Provide technical mentorship and direction to peers.
* Utilize effective debugging techniques to identify and resolve software defects.
* Look beyond the immediate needs of a product and help consider longer-term concerns and/or opportunities for impact from our products.
* Continuously keep themselves up to date on changes in technology, with an emphasis on the tech stacks being used by your team.

  
**Requirements**  

* BS degree in Software Engineering related degree, similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of professional software development experience building and shipping production grade software or services.
* Advanced knowledge of software testing tools, frameworks, and techniques.
* Proficient in at least two modern programming languages (React, React Native, C#, and .NET).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to respectfully challenge the status quo.
* Experience developing and deploying cloud native software on the AWS cloud.
* Experience with UI development using ReactJS and/or React Native.
* Gets excited by the challenge of complex technical problems.
* Competent with relational databases and SQL.
* Excellent grasp of computer science concepts, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Ability to design and provide solutions to complex business problems.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile development processes.
* Passionate about mentoring and training junior software engineers.
* High personal standards for code quality, maintainability, and performance.

  
**Benefits**  

* PPO or a High Deductible Health Plan, HSA eligible plan, Dental, Vision, and Supplemental Life.
* Generous paid time off that starts accruing on day one.
* Quarterly Castaway Week events in the Omaha HQ Office, all expenses paid, from across the country to participate in team-building, collaboration, and fun events.
* Matching 401k with 100% vesting in six months.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Location 9529 - IRIS Automation, Illinois, 60502 Category Engineering JR105451 Automation 9050 Olympus Controls Corp. Regular Job Type Full time

  

Primary functions include specifying a single product, developing a concept, programming, or designing a complete industrial control package. This role will work independently and as a team member to evaluate applications, design control systems, and generate system proposals or project specifications.

All engineering team members may also be responsible for managing projects through the production process and taking necessary steps to maintain schedules. The project management tasks include regular updates to management or customers, daily guidance to assembly technicians, participation in the final inspection, and testing completed systems.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Apply Gibson Engineering's products and technologies to automate client processes and solve their challenges
* Develop, review, and maintain drawings, BOMs, project specifications, and engineering change documentation
* Generate quotations for projects that include cable assemblies, control panels, turnkey systems, and programming services.
* Complete feasibility studies with industrial automation equipment such as machine vision systems, robotics, HMI, or PLCs to specify hardware and software required to solve new applications.
* Design control systems. This includes electrical schematics, component selection, and industrial control panel layouts.
* Configure, program, test, and debug various automation equipment and systems. This includes but is not limited to PLCs, HMIs, motion controls (Servo, Stepper, VFD), robots, data collection, and vision systems.
* Manage engineering or application evaluation projects and regularly communicate status and expectations to management, salespeople, or end customers as required.
* Provide customer education one-on-one, to a small group, or as a subject matter expert in a classroom environment.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and documentation of internal engineering and production processes.
* Communicate project status and expectations to management, sales, and clients.
* Provide technical support and training to colleagues and customers

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, computer or other relevant engineering disciplines
* Prefer 3-5 years of relevant experience in engineering
* Familiarity with industrial control systems, including but not limited to PLC, HMI, Machine Vision and Motion Control Products, is a plus.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical is preferred
* Ability to break down, organize, and manage complex projects
* Strong multitasking, prioritization, and time management skills
* Ability to retain technical details & excellent attention to detail
* Ability to effectively communicate with customers in person, as well as over the phone, email and video calls

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Medical Imaging
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

This is a role well suited for an ambitious engineering professional looking to take the next step in their career. As a Systems Engineer, you will play an important role in the development and delivery of advanced medical imaging systems, working across engineering disciplines and with clinical, product, manufacturing, service, and other stakeholders.

You will take ownership of new system functionality throughout the development lifecycle—from requirements definition and technical risk management through integration, verification, and validation.

**You are responsible for:**

* Owning the realization of new system functionality throughout the development lifecycle.
* Driving the definition, specification, technical risk management, integration, test strategy, verification, and validation of product features in close collaboration with cross-functional project teams.
* Eliciting, analyzing, and documenting high-quality system requirements from clinical, service, manufacturing, marketing, and other key stakeholders.
* Translating and decomposing user and system-level requirements into detailed, complete, and testable technical specifications.
* Developing and maintaining system technical performance requirements and specifications.
* Reviewing and assessing emerging technologies for potential incorporation into current and future products.
* Developing algorithms and executing testing to assess system performance and image quality.
* Developing and executing system-level verification and validation strategies.
* Analyzing test results and preparing clear, comprehensive technical reports documenting system performance.
* Investigating and resolving customer issues related to system performance and image quality.
* Identifying, quantifying, and communicating technical risks and driving mitigation strategies affecting projects and products.
* Championing product quality through rigorous functional verification and clinical validation.
* Translating cutting-edge technologies into commercially viable solutions that advance medical care for customers and patients.
* Ensuring seamless integration of complex hardware and software subsystems designed and manufactured across multiple global locations.

**This position may suit you best if:**

* Have demonstrated knowledge of medical imaging use cases and clinical workflows.
* Have experience applying engineering principles within diagnostic or medical imaging environments.
* Understand system performance testing and validation.
* Have knowledge of key medical imaging technologies and how they apply to clinical imaging systems.
* Are comfortable managing changing priorities and technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment.
* Can effectively bridge communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Have experience working with 510(k) medical devices or within another highly regulated product-development environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 1–2 years of experience in diagnostics, medical imaging, medical devices, or a related engineering field; medical imaging experience is preferred.
* Experience developing and executing system-level verification tests.
* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences, including engineers, product management, clinical stakeholders, and international teams across the U.S., Germany, China, and India.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional team while also operating independently.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven product development environment.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally on an occasional basis (less than 5%).

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing.
