jobs.title: Robotics & Automation Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **Job Description**

The Robotics and Automation Systems Engineer supports and helps drive the robotics and autonomy work behind automation deployments across the organization. This role spans a broad range of robotics and automation projects, including fixed/stationary robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, cobots), mobile/autonomous systems (e.g., AGVs/AMRs, autonomous forklifts, and navigation), palletizing and material-handling applications, and adjacent technologies.

This role assesses sites, programs and integrates robotic systems, commissions systems in live warehouse environments, and troubleshoots deployed automation in production. This role supports robotics and autonomy work from assessment through resolution, and works closely with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer, operations leadership, and robot OEMs or system integrators to keep robotic and autonomous systems running reliably in a live, production-critical environment.

  

##### **Duties and Responsibilities**

* Program, integrate, and commission robotic systems — including industrial robot arms (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Rokae, Universal Robots) and mobile/autonomous platforms — for palletizing, material handling, and related applications.
* Own perception, localization, and navigation for autonomous systems, including LiDAR, SLAM, path planning, and obstacle avoidance.
* Integrate sensors (LiDAR, cameras, IMU) and apply sensor fusion as needed across robotic platforms.
* Integrate robotic and autonomous systems with PLCs, safety systems, conveyors, WCS/WES/WMS, or fleet-management platforms, coordinating with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer and other automation team members on shared electrical and controls interfaces.
* Develop and maintain production-quality robotics software (C++/Python) following standard engineering practices (version control, code review, and testing), and support fleet/robot diagnostics and telemetry.
* Support the application of physical AI techniques — machine learning-driven perception, decision-making, and adaptive robot behavior — to real-world automation problems where practical, in coordination with more specialized resources as needed.
* Support site assessments, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production troubleshooting, prioritizing minimal disruption to live operations and supporting equipment-uptime and service-level targets.
* Document system architecture, safety assumptions, and standard operating procedures for deployed systems.
* Coordinate with robot OEMs and system integrators throughout deployment, commissioning, and warranty periods, including holding vendors accountable to timelines and performance specifications
* Communicate technical progress, system performance, and project status clearly to operations leadership and other non-technical stakeholders
* Stay current on and help evaluate emerging automation and robotics technologies.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of combined hands-on experience with industrial robotics/fixed robotic systems (programming and cell integration) and/or autonomous mobile robotics (AGVs/AMRs, perception, and localization, e.g., LiDAR/SLAM, ROS 2/Nav2 or equivalent); strong depth in at least one domain is required, with working knowledge of the other
* Strong C++/Python skills and Linux experience
* Practical understanding of industrial safety principles for human-robot shared environments, including familiarity with relevant robot/mobile-robot safety standards (e.g., ANSI/A3 R15.06, ISO 3691-4, or equivalent)
* Experience in logistics, warehousing, or industrial automation environments.
* Travel expected to assess robotics and automation opportunities and support initiatives and projects across the organization.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience applying physical AI — machine learning-based perception (e.g., OpenCV, PyTorch), decision-making, or adaptive control — to real-world robotic or automation systems.
* Experience with robot fleet management (e.g., Locus, 6 River, Fetch, Geek+), WCS/WES/WMS integration, or industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, etc.)
* OSHA 10/30 or equivalent safety certification
* Experience with dedicated 3D or machine-vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence, Photoneo) for robotic guidance, picking, or inspection applications, beyond general camera integration
* Experience with robot simulation or offline programming tools (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Process Simulate, Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim) for cell design, testing, or validation prior to live commissioning
* Experience with telemetry, data pipelines, or observability tooling (e.g., time-series databases, dashboards such as Grafana) supporting robot or fleet diagnostics

  

**Location:** Mount Vernon/Evansville, IN or Greenville, SC

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
* You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
* You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

jobs.description:
**Description**

Are you interested in hypersonic and reentry system design and prototyping?

Do you want to make contributions that accelerate the readiness of our Nation’s defenses to support next generation hypersonic and reentry systems?

If so, we are seeking a highly technical senior systems engineer to help assess, design, and prototype next generation hypersonic, reentry systems and enabling technologies. As a member of our team, you’ll be making critical contributions to develop these next generation systems, ensuring the enduring effectiveness of our Nation’s strategic deterrent. You will be joining a complementary team of engineers who work together to provide impactful solutions to system level objectives and challenges. We are passionate about innovation and our team is committed to providing engaging challenging work and supporting continued learning and development.

**As a Senior Systems Engineer you will…**

* Provide systems engineering expertise and leadership to assess weapon system capabilities and support/lead the development of next generation reentry systems, hypersonic systems, and enabling technologies.
* Collaborate and engage with multi-disciplinary project engineering teams within APL, government sponsors, military personnel, and industry partners to develop innovative solutions.
* You will prepare for and participate in major design and requirements reviews.
* Participate in government working groups and/or integrated product teams to evaluate industry concepts, designs, and proposals to provide technical recommendations to government sponsors.
* Engage with senior government, industry, and national laboratory leadership on fast-paced, high-visibility defense programs.
* Produce reports and presentations to communicate analysis results, concepts, proposals and recommendations to leadership, external organization partners, and government sponsors.

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**

* Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
* Have minimum 10 years of relevant experience.
* Have experience with complex hardware / software prototype development.
* Have experience leading highly technical cross-functional teams of engineers.
* Have experience in early concept development efforts to include gap assessments, design trade studies, requirements analysis, and risk assessment.
* Have demonstrated ability to interact effectively with and lead multidisciplinary teams, including industry and government sponsors.
* Have initiative and drive to make meaningful contributions to an important mission.
* Hold an active Secret security clearance and can ultimately obtain Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Have a Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering.
* Have experience in the design or development of reentry, hypersonic, or space systems and relevant technologies.
* Have experience engaging with high level government and/or defense industry leadership on highly technical topics.
* Have experience preparing for and participating in major design reviews such as System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and Test Readiness Review (TRR).
* Have knowledge of the Navy Trident II Strategic Weapon System and/or Air Force ICBM System.
* Hold an active Secret or higher level clearance.

  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. -------------------

Warfare Systems (WS), a division of HII Mission Technologies provides full-spectrum cyber, EW, and space capabilities that address today’s rapidly changing, multi-domain global security threats, and anticipate emerging threats. Engineers will work independently or as part of a team to implement requirements, review and test software components for compliance with design specifications, and document test results. **This posting is to collect applications for current and future openings for HII Mission Technologies. Candidates will be screened as opportunities come available and selected candidates will be contacted about an opportunity.**

* Software Engineer 1: $105,000 - $145,000
* Software Engineer 2: $135,000 - $175,000

----------------------------------

* Analyze user and system requirements to define software design, performance needs, and technical constraints.
* Design, develop, modify, and integrate software solutions, including new features and adaptations for new environments or hardware.
* Debug and troubleshoot software defects, ensuring functionality, performance, and reliability.
* Develop and implement algorithms and database interfaces/queries, ranging from simple to highly complex.
* Conduct system and data flow analysis to support solution design and performance optimization.
* Create, review, and improve software and system documentation, development processes, and standards.
* Collaborate with system engineers, hardware engineers, and users to refine requirements and resolve technical challenges.
* Assist in developing and executing test procedures, performing quality control, and validating software functionality.
* Coordinate software installations, monitor system performance, and ensure operational compliance.
* Recommend and evaluate new technologies, tools, and development processes for complex software projects.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering or related field and nine (9) years relevant experience.

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering or related field and fifteen (15) years relevant experience.
* Three (3) additional years of relevant Software Engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
* Six (6) years of experience programming in Linux/Windows environments and working with DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

***TS/SCI w/ Poly required for consideration***

jobs.description:
**Description**

Do you love diving deep into multi-physics calculations, exploring design limits, and technical trade space to verify whether an integrated system will perform in a complex operational environment?

Are you searching for technically challenging work that directly bolsters the credibility of our nation's strategic deterrent? Are you passionate about first-principles engineering analysis over routine process management?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

We are seeking a Multidisciplinary Systems Engineer (Systems Design Analysis focus) to help us ensure the physical realization, operational durability, and technical credibility of strategic weapon systems. Based within the System Realization and Resilience Group in the Force Projection Sector's Strategic Deterrence Mission Area, you will be joining a dedicated team of engineers and scientists addressing complex, multidisciplinary defense challenges. Our team is committed to delivering objective technical insights that influence the physical design and specialty engineering integration of strategic platforms. We value intellectual candor, technical depth, and collaborative teamwork focused on solving critical engineering problems.

As a Physical Systems Design Analysis Engineer...

* Your primary responsibility will be to perform first-principles engineering calculations and detailed physical design analyses across integrated mechanical, electrical, thermal, nuclear, or fluid subsystems.
* You will execute quantitative trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and margin evaluations to assess physical system behavior under harsh operational and threat environments.
* You will identify systemic design vulnerabilities and cross-discipline interface conflicts, providing data-driven recommendations to guide system design and hardware realization.
* You will link physical analysis results and design constraints back into the digital engineering baseline, collaborating with systems engineers utilizing Cameo Enterprise Architect / MagicDraw.

  
  
**Qualifications**

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

* Possess a BS in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, Nuclear, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related physical engineering discipline.
* Have 2+ years of professional experience performing hands-on engineering design analysis, numerical modeling, or multi-physics calculations on complex physical systems.
* Are skilled in analyzing system engineering technical trade space, interface tolerances, and environmental survivability parameters.
* Have a working knowledge of Systems Engineering methods and practical familiarity with MBSE principles and Cameo Enterprise Architect / MagicDraw.
* Are willing and able to travel periodically (approximately 5–10%), including visits to sponsor sites, test ranges, and contractor facilities.
* Hold an active Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

* Have 5+ years of professional experience performing hands-on engineering design analysis, numerical modeling, or multi-physics calculations on complex physical systems.
* Have an MS in a physical engineering discipline, maintaining an active, hands-on modeling and design analysis focus.
* Hold an active Top Secret security clearance or TS/SCI.
* Have experience with reliability engineering, nuclear surety, or specialty engineering disciplines applied to strategic missiles, reentry systems, or launch platforms.
* Have experience supporting Navy Strategic Systems Programs (such as Trident II D5) or Air Force strategic deterrent programs.

Vertex’s Automation of Machinery and Processes (AMP) Team is seeking a high-impact leader to develop cutting-edge manufacturing solutions for its Cell & Genetic Therapies programs. jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Brooks is a leading provider of automation solutions with over 40 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, offering precision robotics, integrated automation systems, and contamination control solutions that empower chip manufacturers worldwide. Our product portfolio includes a range of automation solutions, including robots, vacuum systems, and atmospheric robots for semiconductor manufacturing ( www.brooks.com ).

Are you looking for a place where you can be part of a transformation? Join us at Brooks Automation and be a part of a dynamic organization that is shaping the future of technology.

Controls Engineer

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Brooks is seeking qualified candidates to work with a team of talented controls engineers to develop industry leading, high performance robot control platforms for the semiconductor industry. The work is both technically challenging and hands-on with new, cutting edge robot arm designs and state of the art control software and electronics that push the envelope in semiconductor wafer handling.**

**What You'll Do:**

**Responsibilities: The candidate will apply digital filtering and control theory to design motion control algorithms and tune the feedback parameters on the robot hardware, characterize the dynamic performance, stability, throughput, payload vibration, design verification testing, software configuration, and documentation/release. The candidate will participate in diverse opportunities to apply the latest principals of robotics and control theory to push the boundaries of performance with tools such as MATLAB.**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **We are looking for an enthusiastic, hands-on engineer with a broad capability in electro mechanical systems who possesses:**
* **Knowledge of control theory, dynamic systems, robotics theory, vibration analysis, backend software development**
* **Including but not limited to related coursework, experience or research in controls, dynamic systems, or robotics**
* **The ability to learn complex systems quickly and create independently**
* **Good troubleshooting and problem solving skills**
* **Competency in MATLAB (controls toolboxes a plus, object–oriented and Java integration preferred)**
* **Excellent technical communication and presentation skill**
* **Skilled in C/C++ programming especially for real-time system**
* **Prior experience with multithreaded and interrupt driven programming preferred.**
* **Handy in the use of dynamic signal analyzers and general lab equipment**
* **BSEE or BSME with 3+ years’ experience or MSEE, MSME or Ph.D. with 1+ years’ experience**
* **Interest in traveling abroad to visit and integrate robots at customer sites.**

**Compensation**

Base Salary Range: $105,593.46 USD to $142,861.74 USD

Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

**Benefits**

At Brooks, we offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Disability Insurance
* 401(k) Plan
* Exempt employees are provided company paid holidays and Flexible Vacation to enjoy personal time off and incidental sickness.

Have a question about our benefits and compensation package? Your recruiter can share more with you during the hiring process.

**Work Location & Flexibility**  
At Brooks, we aim to foster a collaborative and engaging environment while offering flexibility where possible. Work arrangements may include a mix of in-office and remote work, depending on the nature of the role and business needs. Specific expectations will be shared during the interview process.

Brooks is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and proudly serves as an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Diversity enhances our innovative capabilities and strengthens our ability to serve our customers and communities effectively. At Brooks Automation, we celebrate the unique experiences and perspectives each individual brings, believing they are essential to our collective success. Join us in building a workplace where every team member is valued and can thrive.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Robotics is building a brand-new robotics manipulation platform, and we need a versatile software engineer to help bring it to life. In this role, you will own critical software components spanning robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management — systems that must work reliably for a single robot and scale to fleets of thousands. You will work across a broad technology stack, from real-time C++ on the robot to full-stack web applications on AWS, while applying generative AI to automate and streamline operational workflows.  
  
This is a greenfield opportunity where your architectural decisions will shape how Amazon's next generation of robotic systems operate. You will lead multi-engineer projects, influence technical direction across peer teams, and mentor junior engineers — all while writing exemplary code that sets the standard for your team. If you are a curious, adaptable engineer who thrives on solving hard problems across multiple technology domains, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software components for robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management that scale from individual robots to fleets of thousands.
* Lead the technical design and architecture of systems on a new robotics manipulation platform, balancing real-time performance constraints with long-term extensibility and maintainability.
* Collaborate with peer robotics, hardware, and operations teams to define interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and ensure successful end-to-end delivery of integrated robotic systems.
* Apply generative AI tools and techniques to automate workflows, improve developer productivity, and accelerate the team's ability to iterate on new capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality and engineering practices of the team.

  
A day in the life  
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning your projects from concept through production deployment. On a given day you might be writing real-time C++ for robot control in the morning, reviewing a teammate's AWS service design after lunch, and prototyping a generative AI workflow automation by end of day. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across peer robotics and operations teams to align on priorities, unblock dependencies, and share technical insights — while also carving out focused time for deep, heads-down engineering work.  
  
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that assist you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
  
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage  
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options  
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)  
4. 401(k) Plan

If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  
  
About the team  
Our team is developing a new robotics manipulation platform at Amazon Robotics that aims to be as transformative as mobile robots have been for fulfillment operations. We are a 40+ person organization with a dedicated software group of 10+ engineers working alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a willingness to experiment. As the platform grows, you will have the opportunity to scale systems that directly improve the customer experience and shape the future of robotic automation at Amazon.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Expert level skills in C++
* Experience working on software libraries and tools for building robot applications and/or communication middle-ware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience with robotic motion control systems and algorithms.
* Experience with robotic operating environments like ROS.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Test Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer for the Test Infrastructure Team in Somerville, Massachusetts. In this role you will be responsible for the design and delivery of test equipment that enables the execution of critical tests across our iron-air battery systems and supporting hardware. The scope of your work will range from simple fixture development and material handling systems through complex verification test beds used in the evaluation of our battery systems.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the scaling of our battery technology and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Design, build, and deploy custom test equipment used in the electrical testing of battery hardware and software.
* Modify existing designs to accommodate new requirements and test objectives.
* Create electrical schematics to capture complex test system designs including the design of control panels, test racks, custom PCBAs, harnesses, etc.
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on the physical form factor of test stands, optimizing for operability, maintenance and safety.
* Ensure electrical equipment designs meet safety, reliability, and compliance standards for high-power and hazardous systems.
* Document test system designs, usage guidelines, and validation procedures.
* Support troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement of deployed test infrastructure.

### **What you'll bring:**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or related field.
* 4+ years of experience in electrical design and/or test equipment development (battery or energy systems experience is a plus).
* Proficiency with eCAD tools (Altium, AutoCAD Electrical, E-Plan, etc.)
* Experience designing control panels adhering to UL508A standards.
* Experience specifying electronic test hardware (PLC IO cards, power supplies, circuit protection, etc).
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance speed, rigor, and safety.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

* Minimum of 8+ years of design and/or production experience with power systems, power conversion, power distribution, power sub-system design and/or control systems
* Experience in modeling and simulation using PSPICE, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar computer-based tools.
* Experience with a schematic capture CAD package

* Hardware development experience in the Department of Defense (DoD) environment
* Demonstrated ability to lead/manage a technical team to achieve schedule, budget, and technical commitments
* Experience generating technical documentation and reports
* Experience with requirements development and decomposition
* Knowledge of test and production methods for electronics/power system components
* Experience interfacing with procurement and manufacturing as well as external suppliers to ensure proper implementation of product designs

jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**  
Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support the long-term sustainment of a fire control system by identifying and mitigating hardware obsolescence risks. In this role, you will assess the system-level impact of unavailable or end-of-life components, evaluate replacement options, and help implement changes that preserve required performance, reliability, safety, and supportability.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor hardware lifecycle status and identify components at risk of obsolescence.
* Maintain an obsolescence risk register covering affected parts, system configurations, inventory, projected demand, and decision timelines.
* Analyze how proposed substitutions or redesigns affect system requirements, interfaces, software dependencies, reliability, and maintainability.
* Develop and document mitigation options, such as qualified alternate parts, last-time buys, repair solutions, module redesigns, and planned technology refreshes.
* Lead or contribute to trade studies evaluating technical risk, cost, schedule, availability, and verification effort.
* Define requirements and verification approaches for replacement hardware.
* Coordinate with hardware and software engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, reliability, and program management teams.
* Support configuration management and change-control activities, including updates to technical documentation and parts lists.
* Communicate risks, recommendations, and implementation status to program stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in systems engineering, hardware engineering, or product sustainment.
* Ability to analyze requirements, interfaces, and the system-level effects of hardware changes.
* Experience evaluating technical alternatives and documenting engineering decisions.
* Familiarity with configuration management, verification planning, and risk management.
* Strong written communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hardware obsolescence or diminishing manufacturing sources and material shortages (DMSMS).
* Familiarity with electronic component lifecycles, bills of materials, supplier data, and product lifecycle management tools.
* Experience supporting complex, safety-critical, or long-life systems.
* Experience planning qualification activities for component substitutions or hardware redesigns.

**Workplace Options:**  
This position is fully on-site.  
While on-site, you will be a part of the FBM Sustainment Team in OP1 Pittsfield, MA.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, macOS
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
* Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
* Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
* Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
* Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
* Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
* Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
* Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
* Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
* Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
* Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
* Write Python and shell scripts
* Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
* Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
* Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
* Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
* Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
* Have used LLMs to automate ops work

**Description**

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer, iOS to join our mobile engineering team and help build secure, high-performance iOS applications used by millions of customers worldwide. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help architect and evolve the iOS experiences that support Keeper's security platform.

  

**About Keeper**

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer, iOS, you will design, build and maintain secure, scalable and high-performance features across Keeper's native iOS applications. You will work primarily in Swift, with exposure to Objective-C where needed, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA and backend engineering teams to deliver reliable and intuitive mobile experiences. This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership across architecture, implementation, performance, debugging and release quality. You will contribute to technical direction, review code, improve engineering practices and help ensure Keeper's iOS applications remain secure, maintainable and performant as the platform continues to grow.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain secure native iOS applications and features using Swift
* Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions across Keeper's iOS codebase
* Maintain and modernize existing Objective-C components where appropriate
* Build scalable, reusable and maintainable mobile components that support long-term product growth
* Integrate mobile applications with backend services, APIs, authentication flows and secure data storage
* Optimize application performance, responsiveness, memory usage and battery efficiency
* Troubleshoot complex application issues using logs, profiling tools and runtime diagnostics
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to other engineers
* Collaborate with Product, Design, QA and backend teams to define requirements and deliver high-quality features
* Strengthen automated testing, build reliability and release quality across the iOS development lifecycle
* Support App Store release processes, beta testing and validation of new iOS platform capabilities
* Maintain clear technical documentation for architecture, features and development workflows
* Evaluate emerging iOS technologies, frameworks and platform capabilities where they can improve Keeper's applications
* Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve coding, debugging, technical research, testing and documentation

  

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of professional iOS software development experience
* Strong hands-on experience developing production applications using Swift
* Working knowledge of Objective-C and experience maintaining or integrating with existing Objective-C code
* Experience designing and shipping large or complex iOS applications to the Apple App Store
* Experience with AI as it relates to iOS development. Good prompting skills and troubleshooting with AI.
* Strong understanding of iOS application architecture, lifecycle, concurrency and state management
* Experience integrating mobile applications with backend APIs and distributed services
* Strong understanding of mobile performance, memory management, debugging and profiling
* Proficiency with Xcode and Apple development, debugging and diagnostic tools
* Experience with automated build and CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions or similar platforms
* Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows, code review and issue tracking
* Experience writing maintainable automated tests for mobile applications
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on code quality, security, architecture and maintainability
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, Design and QA teams
* Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted development tools effectively to improve coding, debugging, testing and documentation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Due to this role's involvement in GovCloud environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Work Classification:**

  

**Hybrid:** The successful candidate is expected to report to Milford, MI three times per week, at minimum, or as dictated by the business.

  

**The Role** :

  

As a ***Software Engineer*** at GM, you will be a part of the Vehicle Mechatronic Embedded Controls (VMEC) team, working in the Battery and High Voltage (BHV) Agile Release Train (ART). Your focus will be on developing and delivering high-quality software solutions for embedded control systems, specifically for controlling vehicle’s high voltage (HV) battery management, communications, sensing and processing for battery packs within GM’s EV portfolio. Your work will contribute directly to GM's vision of a world with ZERO Crashes, ZERO Emissions, and ZERO Congestion.

  

**What You'll Do** :

  

* Design, develop, and deliver high‑quality embedded software for VMEC Battery Management Systems (BMS), supporting high‑voltage battery controls, wired communication, sensing, and processing.
* Ensure SW deliverables are on time and with quality in support of Wired Battery Management Systems.
* Ensure compliance with safety requirements, government regulations, and GM-internal policies (e.g., MISRA guidelines).
* Apply strong software engineering principles (architecture, abstraction, design patterns) to create scalable, hardware‑agnostic solutions aligned with supervisory control architectures.
* Translate system, physics, controls, safety, and regulatory requirements into robust, modular software designs, including diagnostic strategies and controller communications.
* Implement and validate software using automotive communication technologies (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet, ARXML) and modern vehicle architectures.
* Test & demonstrate software functionality & readiness, ensuring hardware agnostic solutions across all GM owned software.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive diagnostics to enable fault detection, isolation, validation, and field support across controller, system, and vehicle levels.
* Document requirements for design solutions and link them to test cases that can demonstrate software functionality ensuring traceability.
* Verify software functionality through automated testing, HIL, bench, and vehicle testing, ensuring traceability from requirements to test cases.
* Contribute technical leadership within Scrum teams, providing guidance, code reviews, and mentorship to support team execution and software quality: foster collaboration and in inclusive environment.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with Systems & Safety, Validation, Electrical Architecture, SDV, Calibration, and Vehicle Performance teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Embrace software development methodologies to ensure Software Built In Quality, promoting early bug detection, and facilitating collaboration between developers, testers, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Apply Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) and Service‑Oriented Architecture (SOA) principles to enable modularity, reuse, and long‑term platform scalability.
* Leverage CI/CD and DevOps practices to promote built‑in quality, early defect detection, and efficient deployment.
Develop AI-driven diagnostics and predictive analytics to enhance fault detection, prognostics, and anomaly detection within embedded control systems.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications):**

  

* BS in Engineering – Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, Computer Science or related field and technical discipline.
* 2+ years of experience with proven technical and professional skills in embedded software development.
* Strong background in system design, diagnostics strategies, and control systems for embedded software applications.
* Proficient in C, C++ programming and Python scripting.
* Proficiency in testing strategies with hands-on experience in SiL, HiL, and/or Vehicle-Level testing frameworks.
* Understanding of diagnostics strategies, software verification, and validation methodologies.
* Document designs, test cases, and results thoroughly.
* Understanding and experience with SW testing environment.
* High level of integrity, ability to deal with ambiguity, take initiative/self-directed.
Consistent demonstration of innovative thinking that is customer-centric and collaborative.  

  

**What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Skills):**

  

* MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of experience with proven technical and professional skills in embedded software development.
* Demonstrated system‑level understanding with the ability to translate ambiguous or incomplete requirements into well‑defined software designs, including diagnostic design and implementation.
* Strong embedded software development experience, including controller communications, diagnostics, and complex device drivers.
* Solid proficiency in C programming with working knowledge of Python scripting.
* Strong knowledge of Battery Management Systems (BMS), including cell balancing concepts and ASIC integration within the overall system architecture.
* Ability to assess system and diagnostic coverage, identify functional gaps, and drive solutions aligned with vehicle and program needs.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and the ability to flow them into compliant, scalable software designs and implementations.
* Experience with automotive communication protocols and standards (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet, ARXML) and adherence to MISRA guidelines.
* Hands‑on experience with HIL, vehicle testing, debugging, and test case automation.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals beyond coding, including scalable and portable design, modular architecture, and comprehensive testing strategies.
* Experience with system requirements development and HWIO integration.
* Experience working in Agile environments using standard development and collaboration tools (e.g., Git, Jira, SAFe).

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Software Engineer — ADAS Interactive Experience**
==========================================================

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our ADAS HMI team within the Interactive Experience platform. In this role, you will design and deliver production automotive embedded software spanning microcontroller (MCU) and System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms. Your work will connect vehicle signals, sensors, and real-time controls to the services that power driver-facing alerts, controls, and situational-awareness experiences. You will apply strong system design and architecture skills to define clear boundaries, interfaces, and data flows across in-vehicle compute domains while meeting demanding requirements for safety, startup time, determinism, resource use, and reliability throughout the vehicle lifecycle.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and develop production automotive embedded systems spanning MCU firmware and SoC software using C/C++.
* Translate vehicle-level requirements into implementable software architectures, including component boundaries, hardware and software interfaces, communication protocols, data flows, timing budgets, diagnostics, and degraded-mode behavior.
* Participate in architecture reviews and communicate technical trade-offs involving latency, determinism, memory, compute, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
* Build reliable interfaces between real-time MCU applications and SoC services that support driver controls, alerts, chimes, lighting, haptics, and situational-awareness experiences.
* Design software that behaves predictably across vehicle power states, startup and shutdown sequences, communication faults, watchdog recovery, and constrained operating conditions.
* Collaborate with systems, electrical, HMI, ADAS, platform, supplier, and vehicle integration teams through hardware bring-up, bench integration, vehicle validation, and production launch.
* Write clean, efficient, tested, and well-documented C/C++ code that follows embedded software standards and team development practices.
* Debug complex cross-domain issues involving MCU firmware, vehicle networks, IPC, SoC services, operating-system behavior, electrical interfaces, and downstream applications.
* Own major vehicle features through the full development lifecycle, from concept and design through implementation, integration, vehicle validation, production launch, and field maintenance.
* Improve engineering productivity through build, test, debugging, simulation, profiling, or developer-workflow tooling.
* Drive shift-left quality through unit, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, integration, performance, and fault-injection testing.
Mentor junior engineers and serve as a technical resource for system design, C/C++ development, and cross-domain debugging.  

  

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of professional experience developing and shipping embedded software for production products.
* Strong C/C++ development experience on both microcontroller and SoC-based platforms.
* Demonstrated system design and software architecture skills, including decomposition of broad requirements into components, interfaces, and executable technical plans.
* Experience with real-time or resource-constrained MCU software, such as RTOS applications, board-support packages, device drivers, peripherals, or low-level communication stacks.
* Experience with SoC software environments, such as Embedded Linux, QNX, yocto, including IPC and system resource management.
* Experience debugging and testing integrated embedded systems using tools such as in-circuit debuggers, traces, bus analyzers, profilers, SiL, or HiL.
Experience with version control, code review, build systems, static analysis, and CI/CD workflows.  

  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience creating or improving developer tooling, build infrastructure, automated test frameworks, simulation environments, diagnostics, or debugging utilities.
* Experience delivering embedded software for production automotive systems and vehicle program milestones.
* Experience with automotive networks and protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DBC, or UDS.
* Experience designing cross-domain communication between safety-critical or real-time MCU functions and higher-level SoC services.
* Familiarity with automotive engineering practices and standards such as ASPICE, ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, or MISRA C/C++.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to explain architecture decisions and build alignment among senior technical partners.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Advanced Technologies
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Advanced Technology Avionics organization is responsible for the pursuit and execution of business related to advanced military avionics platforms, and the evaluation of opportunities in emerging and adjacent markets.
  
  
A systems engineer inside the Advanced Technology Organization (ATO) will act as a cross-functional engineering leader that considers both business and technical needs with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the customer’s requirements.
  
  
The Senior systems engineer will be responsible for the design, creation, and optimization of systems, which includes identifying and quantifying system requirements, creating alternate design concepts, performing design trade studies, selecting and implementing the best designs, and verifying that the design is properly integrated and executed. This process spans from concept to production to operation. Additionally, the systems engineer will support a variety of Bids & Proposals (B&P) activities for multiple advanced avionics programs.  
  
This position, which offers a blend of onsite and hybrid work arrangements, is based in Grand Rapids and necessitates a presence in the office for 2-3 days each week. An extensive corporate relocation package is also available for eligible candidates.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* **Systems Integration:** Design, develop and integrate software and hardware optimizing performance, cost, quality and inter-operability.
* **Requirements Management:** Gather customer requirements, translate to systems requirements, specifications and flow down to hardware and software teams.
* **Validation and Verification:** Drive validation and verification activities for the overall product/system, including system-level testing.
* **Interface Management:** Manage the interface between components and other systems.
* **Risk Management:** Apply critical thinking toward the proactive identification and abatement of technical risk to minimize project impact.
* **Configuration Management:** Manage the overall product configuration and configuration control system.
* **Technical Expertise:** Develop expertise and knowledge within multiple technical domains in order to drive an analytical approach towards development of a holistic mission focused architectural solution.
* **Best Practices:** Understand and develop best practices the accelerate LEAN operations and differentiators in the market.
* **Problem-Solving:** Propose different solutions outside of set parameters to address complex manufacturing processes with technical variety and/or interdependent production cycles.
* **Decision-Making:** Use multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own teams to make decisions.
* **Resource for Colleagues:** Act as a resource for less experienced colleagues; may lead small projects with low risks and resource requirements.
* Customer Resource:
* **Team Consensus:** Develop skills to bring team members to consensus around topics within the field.
* **Communication:** Report to senior leadership on technical status of ongoing projects.
* **Bids & Proposals:** Respond to requests for information (RFI) and requests for proposal (RFP) providing estimates of resource costs and proposed technical approach.
* **Strategy Deployment:** Support the development of product and technical roadmaps.
* **Customer Engagement:** Work closely with the Program Manager (PM) and Engineering Project Manager (EPM) to collaborate with the customer throughout the project.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a similar field from an accredited university or college
* A minimum of 8 years of experience developing system architectures derived from customer requirements.
* **This position requires U.S. citizenship status.**
* **This role requires the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain DoD Security Clearance. Therefore, this posting is only for US citizens. Note, GE will require proof of status prior to employment.**

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Experience with hardware development of Avionics computing systems is highly desired
* Strong interpersonal and leadership capabilities.
* Exceptional oral and written communication skills.

* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
* Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

* Proficiency with Cameo systems modeling tool
* Knowledge of embedded processing technologies including micro-controllers, micro-processors, and system-on-chip devices
* Awareness of aerospace standards and regulations such as DO-178, DO-254, etc.

The base pay range for this position is $130,000.00 - $173,000.00 USD Annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on 10/31/26.

  

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

jobs.title: Staff Hardware Engineer - ECU Requirements & Specifications
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**About the Team**

Compute & Connectivity Hardware (CCH) is part of GM’s Software & Services organization and owns the hardware foundation for GM’s software-defined vehicles. The team develops and integrates the compute, connectivity, networking, and electronic platforms that support vehicle intelligence, infotainment, ADAS, mechatronic controls, connected services, and over-the-air experiences.

  

CCH work spans architecture, requirements, hardware design, embedded systems, cybersecurity, functional safety, integration, validation, launch, and field performance. Our engineers collaborate across software, systems, controls, vehicle engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing to solve complex technical problems and deliver reliable, production-ready hardware across GM’s vehicle portfolio.

  

**The Opportunity**

Electronic Control Units (ECUs) are central to GM’s Software Defined Vehicle and electrified-vehicle architectures. The ECU Hardware Requirements & Specifications team is seeking a highly experienced Staff Hardware Engineer to provide technical leadership for the development, management, and continuous improvement of hardware requirements, low-level software definitions, and Component Technical Requirements Specifications (CTRS) across GM’s vehicle portfolio.

  

This role is for a recognized technical leader who can operate across hardware, software, vehicle, electrical architecture, diagnostics, safety, sourcing, manufacturing, and external engineering organizations. The Staff Engineer will shape technical direction, establish common solutions, resolve complex system interactions, and influence decisions across the portfolio without direct people-management responsibility.

  

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of automotive embedded control systems with strong requirements-engineering discipline, systems thinking, business judgment, and the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear decisions and executable outcomes. They will help advance common, traceable, high-quality ECU requirements and support the continued modernization of GM’s requirements-management practices, including DOORS Next-Gen, automation, and leveraging AI to improve requirement quality.

  

**The Role**

As a level-8 Staff Engineer, you will serve as a technical authority for ECU hardware requirements and specifications. You will lead complex technical projects, establish alignment across dependent engineering organizations, mentor engineers, and drive decisions through influence, technical rigor, and clear communication.

  

You will support build-to-spec and build-to-print ECU designs across GM’s diverse vehicle and electrical architectures, including electrification and Electric Vehicle applications. Your work will enable standardized hardware designs, component commonization, requirements reuse, seamless software implementation, and effective downstream verification and validation. You will actively use AI tools to enhance and improve our requirement development process.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development, maintenance, and configuration management of ECU hardware electrical and functional interface requirements, including interactions with vehicle electronic and mechatronic devices and low-level software.
* Establish technical direction for embedded-controller requirements across vehicle, electrical/controller architecture, infrastructure software, low-level software, diagnostics, hardware design, safety, and product design release stakeholders.
* Drive standardization of Input/Output interfaces and promote commonization and reuse of components across ECU hardware designs and the CTRS portfolio.
* Lead requirements reviews, design-flow execution, change-control activities, and technical approval discussions to achieve rigor, alignment, timely decisions, and high-quality execution.
* Provide technical leadership for CTRS compilation and build activities supporting product-team sourcing, build-to-print implementation, and post-sourcing design changes.
* Establish and improve traceability between internal and external CTRS requirements and downstream verification and validation activities.
* Identify requirements and design gaps across GM and external engineering implementations, and drive ECU, sub-component, and circuit-level corrective actions when designs do not adhere to common requirements.
* Lead or support the migration, deployment, and continuous improvement of ECU hardware requirements in DOORS Next-Gen and other structured requirements-management environments.
* Support requirements and specifications for ECU manufacturing, remanufacturing, and plant/service programming implementations.
* Apply systems thinking to complex interactions among ECU hardware, low-level software, diagnostics, communications, mechatronics, vehicle systems, and electrical architectures.
* Provide technical leadership for semiconductor and microprocessor functional-safety activities, including requirements aligned to safety-manual use cases and safety-critical embedded-control applications.
* Contribute to ECU circuit-level requirements and safety-related activities, including the interpretation of failure modes and the integration of safety considerations into technical requirements.
* Champion continuous improvement through new technologies, automation, artificial intelligence, competitive benchmarking, and improved requirements-documentation methods.
* Lead cross-functional technical forums and complex projects, resolve ambiguity, mediate competing stakeholder needs, and communicate recommendations to technical and leadership audiences.
Mentor engineers and promote technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and disciplined execution across diverse and global teams.

In addition, this position will be responsible for supporting current technology in use at various Howmet Plants. jobs.title: Building Automation Systems Engineer - Auburn Hills, MI
jobs.description:
Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) Local is a hard services-led, tailored facility management solution. We self-perform hard services while partnering with best-in-class soft service providers to offer custom facility and project management solutions to our clients. We focus on empowering our team with a high-level of downstream accountability, resulting in an agile and efficient service delivery.

  

In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best-in-Class services, including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience.

**What You'll Do:**

As a Systems Engineering Analyst at CBRE, you will serve as the key technical liaison between the CBRE automation maintenance team and the client operations team. This role focuses on analyzing, optimizing, and continuously improving the performance of advanced automated material handling systems. You will work closely with both teams to identify opportunities, refine processes, and drive reliability across Automated Storage and Retrieval System (ASRS) crane racking systems, self-guided vehicles (including Kuka AMRs and Gideon autonomous forklifts), Cognex scan tunnel and camera systems, and related automation assets. The position combines systems analysis, performance monitoring, and cross-functional collaboration to support high-throughput operations and long-term system health.

**What your day-to-day will look like:**
----------------------------------------

* Act as the primary liaison between CBRE’s automation technicians and the client team, facilitating clear communication on system performance, issues, and improvement opportunities.

* Analyze performance data for ASRS crane systems, self-guided vehicles, and Cognex vision/scan systems to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization.

* Support and refine the service and reliability programs for self-guided vehicles, including monitoring uptime, failure modes, and maintenance effectiveness.

* Collaborate with technicians and client stakeholders to develop and implement process improvements, work instruction updates, and best practices that enhance system reliability and throughput.

* Assist in root-cause analysis of complex or recurring automation issues and help translate findings into actionable recommendations for both maintenance and operations teams.

* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to automation assets and prepare clear summaries or reports for client and internal leadership.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on ASRS, autonomous mobile equipment, and vision/scanning systems.

* Maintain strong working relationships across CBRE technical teams and client operations to ensure alignment on priorities and system performance goals.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Technical degree or equivalent (such as Mechatronics, Industrial Technology, Automation, Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related technical field). An engineering degree is preferred but not required.

* Experience working with or supporting automated material handling systems, ASRS, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs/AGVs), self-guided industrial vehicles, or vision/scanning systems.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret system performance data, identify trends, and recommend practical improvements.

* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical (maintenance) and non-technical (client operations) audiences.

* Familiarity with preventive/predictive maintenance practices, CMMS platforms, and continuous improvement methodologies is a plus.

* Experience in a manufacturing, distribution, or industrial automation environment preferred.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving across teams.

**Physical Demands:**
---------------------

This position is primarily analytical and collaborative but is based in an industrial manufacturing environment. The role may require walking the production or warehouse floor, occasional standing for extended periods, and the ability to observe equipment in operation. Some exposure to noise, temperature variations, and typical industrial conditions may occur when working on-site with the automation and client teams.Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
