jobs.title: Principal Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

**Your Role:**

As a Principal Controls Engineer supporting Vantive’s Acute Therapies portfolio, you will be a key contributor in the model-based development and verification of control algorithms for the PrisMax system. Your work will shape how the device interprets sensor inputs, controls electromechanical components, manages operating states, and supports safe, reliable therapy delivery.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can take a complex control problem from system behavior and requirements through algorithm design, simulation, embedded implementation, and verification. You partner with Systems, Software, Hardware, Quality, and V&V develop, verify, and document effective control solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Control Algorithm Design and Model-Based Development**

* Take technical ownership of complex PrisMax control algorithms, from expected system behavior and requirements through model architecture, implementation, integration, and lifecycle changes.
* Develop and refine algorithms using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for functions involving sensors, pumps, motors, valves, alarms, and therapy-related calculations.
* Apply control theory, dynamic-system analysis, and sound engineering judgment to evaluate performance across intended operating conditions, component variation, and foreseeable faults.
* Produce model-generated code and partner with Software Engineering on interfaces, execution behavior, and integration into the device’s embedded software.

**Verify Control Algorithms**

* Define verification approaches for model-based algorithms, including model review, simulation, coverage analysis, interface testing, and testing of integrated software or device behavior.
* Develop and review test cases that challenge nominal, boundary, fault, and difficult-to-reproduce conditions; ensure expected results and acceptance criteria are clear.
* Lead the technical analysis of test results and discrepancies, distinguish model defects from interface or integration issues, and drive robust resolutions.
* Produce clear, traceable design and verification documentation that supports formal test execution, design reviews, and product development records.

**Advance Modeling and Simulation**

* Contribute to fit-for-purpose models of device components and system dynamics so control concepts can be evaluated before and alongside physical-device testing.
* Use model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop methods where appropriate to explore design tradeoffs, characterize performance, and expose integration risks.
* Document model assumptions, interfaces, limitations, and supporting evidence so simulation results can be interpreted and reused responsibly.

**Strengthen Controls Engineering**

* Lead reviews of algorithm designs and verification strategies, making tradeoffs and technical risks visible to cross-functional partners.
* Mentor engineers in model-based design, controls analysis, testability, and disciplined problem solving while remaining directly involved in critical technical work.
* Identify opportunities to improve the controls development practice by introducing reusable models, robust test techniques, and common design practices to enhance the quality and maintainability of control algorithms.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on development of control algorithms for embedded electromechanical products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing and testing executable control models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, or a closely comparable model-based development environment.
* Experience with model-generated code and its integration into real-time embedded software.
* Experience with plant modeling, physics-based simulation, and model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Ability to independently resolve complex technical problems, lead design reviews, and influence complex technical decision making when issues arise.
* Experience developing medical devices or other safety-critical products, including requirements traceability, risk-informed design, configuration control, and formal documentation.
* Experience modeling fluidic, thermal, electromechanical, or physiological-system behavior relevant.

### **Description**

We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area.  
  
More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation!  
  
**About The Team:** The Hub Platform team owns foundational software, infrastructure, and operational practices that power SmartThings hubs in the field, and we're building the architecture that lets us support future hub platforms as they come online. The SmartThings Hub acts as a secure edge gateway that translates and bridges local, cross-protocol IoT devices to the SmartThings cloud, enabling centralized routing and execution across a unified ecosystem. We work across three pillars:

* Hub Systems & Architecture: the embedded Linux OS, secure boot chain, firmware rollout process, and hardware platform abstraction
* Hub to Cloud Connections & Attestation: secure hub-to-cloud connectivity, device claim, and attestation so every hub in the field is uniquely identified and trusted
* Hub Developer Operations: the CI/build infrastructure that keeps the entire hub engineering org shipping reliably and the tooling that keeps engineers developing efficiently

Our work sits at the intersection of embedded firmware and cloud services, and it directly determines the stability, security, and update reliability that millions of connected homes rely on every day.

**About The Role:** We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Platform team. You'll help drive long-term technical strategies for our core domains. You'll operate with autonomy to bring clarity to complex, cross-functional challenges. You’ll act as a go-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives, and partner closely with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams to shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. You'll also mentor engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and help guide how the team adopts AI-assisted development and operational practices.

* **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Act as a technical owner for large, complex, cross-functional projects, architecting scalable solutions for evolving domain needs.

* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs.
* **Mentor & Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, including senior engineers, and help build engineering practices that raise the bar across the org.
* **Operational Excellence & On-Call:** Participate in observability, incident response, and on-call rotations supporting the production firmware delivery, hub connectivity, and attestation services that the global hub fleet depends on.

**Job Title**
=============

Automation Engineer

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

**Job Description**
===================

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that “Better Never Settles.” We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

**C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:**

* Weekly pay
* Comprehensive benefits starting on your first day
* Training, development, and advancement opportunities
* A clean and cutting-edge facility
* A safety-first culture

**About the Role:**

As an Automation Engineer (AE), you will support the site maintenance team to ensure operational performance and efficiency of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) control systems. You will partner with the maintenance team to troubleshoot and maintain equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, control cabinets, and more. The AE provides support to the operations and maintenance teams by implementing solutions for complex problems and tracking related projects. You may lead and/or assist other technicians with their development through continuity of knowledge, all while working in a clean, climate-controlled, modern facility.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Promoting a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
* Providing guidance on maintaining material handling control systems, industrial motor control systems, servo and frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* Using your technical expertise to provide support with troubleshooting and modifying software projects for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC platform utilizing Rockwell’s software package, industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and appropriately escalating downtime situations to vendors and/or network support teams to restore equipment operation.
* Applying subject matter expertise in material handling and electronic control systems to maximize building utilization of systems
* Monitoring MHE metrics and partnering with mechatronics technicians to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies, and performing control systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability
* Partnering with facility Operations leadership, equipment vendors, and parts suppliers to plan and coordinate new technology installations, acting as the technical consultant for capital projects inside the building
* Communicating technical issues and project timelines with building leadership, operations, and the maintenance team, explaining production impacts and working closely with operations and engineering to ensure a thorough understanding of impact to systems

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of cumulative work experience in the following areas, or a relevant 2-year degree plus 1 year of work experience in the following areas:
  + Programming/commissioning of HMIs, PLCs, and VFDs
  + SCADA systems and KPIs
  + Interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
  + Supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems
  + Equipment control components such as relays, motor starters, VFDs, HMIs, etc.
* High school or equivalent diploma
* Positive attitude and ability to effectively problem-solve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree with a focus in Electronic Technology (or similar)
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field
* 4+ years of experience in the electrical field, or in control systems development, troubleshooting, and programming
* 4+ years of experience supporting advanced automation controls systems maintenance and development
* 3+ years of experience supporting a wide range of conveyors and sortation systems
* Leadership and project management experience

Forms are where a huge share of that growth starts. Signup forms, embedded forms, landing page forms, and the pop-ups our customers put in front of their own audiences are the front door to list growth on Mailchimp, and they are rendered across an enormous surface area: inside our own app, and inside millions of third-party websites we do not control. We are looking for a Staff-level frontend engineer to set technical direction for that platform.

This role is about depth, not breadth of headcount. You will own the architecture of a schema-driven, micro-frontend-based forms platform: the contracts that describe a form, the runtime that renders it, the composition layer that lets independently deployed teams ship into a shared experience, and the operational discipline that keeps all of it fast and reliable on somebody else's page. You will do that alongside product, design, and engineers across the Forms, and you will be the person other engineers come to when a rendering, contract, or performance decision needs to be made well the first time.

  

**How you'll work**
-------------------

Our Core Leadership Behaviors are the observable and measurable leadership actions and skills that contribute to our effectiveness and success in our roles.

  

* **Thriving in Complexity:** You unravel and make sense of potentially sophisticated, incomplete, and contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Nimble Learning:** You tackle problems with experimentation, using successes and failures to inform future decisions.
* **Expecting the Best:** You hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Collaborating Courageously:** You build partnerships across the company and work collaboratively with others to meet strategic goals.
* **Cultivating Candor:** You act with integrity and earn the confidence and trust of others through honesty and authenticity.
* **Inclusive Leadership:** You recognize the value diversity brings to our organization and leverage different perspectives to enhance organizational culture and drive performance.
* **Customer Obsessed:** You listen hard to customers, understand their challenges, develop relationships with them, and deliver products that remove their obstacles.
* **Action Oriented:** You initiate new opportunities and face tough challenges with a sense of energy, enthusiasm, and service.

**Responsibilities**

* Set the technical direction for the Mailchimp Forms frontend platform, micro-frontend boundaries, module federation and composition strategy, versioning and rollback, and the migration path off legacy rendering paths in the monolith.
* Own the schema contracts that drive our form experiences end to end: the schema definition, validation, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy, and the renderer that turns schema into accessible, performant UI without a code change per field type.
* Drive operational excellence as a first-class deliverable SLOs and error budgets for a client-side product, real-user performance monitoring, Core Web Vitals, structured client-side telemetry, alerting that pages on customer-visible degradation rather than noise, and blameless postmortems that actually change the system.
* Be the technical lead across the full lifecycle: scoping, design, implementation, testing, documentation, rollout, and long-term maintenance, including the unglamorous parts.
* Raise the bar for other engineers through design reviews, pairing, and written architecture guidance covering integration, performance, accessibility, and scalability and find the balance between writing code yourself and creating room for others to grow.
* Extend and contribute back to our design system: component APIs, design tokens, and theming that hold up when a customer embeds our form into their own brand and stylesheet.
* Own accessibility as a requirement, not a cleanup task — WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, and automated a11y checks wired into CI.
* Use AI coding agents and GenAI-assisted development as part of how you work, and help the team establish what good looks like: where agents accelerate us, where they need guardrails, and how review standards adapt.
* Share production ownership and on-call rotation with the rest of the team.

**Qualifications**

* You have significant experience designing and implementing frontend architectures at scale and writing code that is maintainable, performant, and observable, not just code that ships.
* You have built or substantially evolved a **micro-frontend architecture** in production: independently deployable frontends, shared dependency and runtime strategy, cross-team contracts, isolation and blast-radius control, and the versioning discipline that keeps it from turning into distributed spaghetti. You can speak candidly about what went wrong and what you would do differently.
* You have deep expertise in **schema-driven / config-driven UI;** JSON Schema or an equivalent contract language, dynamic form rendering, declarative validation, schema evolution and backward compatibility, and codegen from contracts. You understand where schema-driven design pays for itself and where it becomes an abstraction tax.
* You hold a high bar on **software engineering fundamentals and operational excellence**: testing strategy that gives real confidence, CI/CD and progressive delivery, feature flags, instrumentation and observability, incident response, and a track record of owning what you ship in production.
* You are fluent in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a major component framework (React preferred), and you understand the browser deeply enough to reason about bundle size, hydration, rendering perf

* Drive architecture and design decisions for robotic software systems, including perception, navigation, motor control, reasoning, and human-robot interaction.

* Define technical roadmaps and drive innovation in robotic software development, including production-level SDKs for developer use.
* Design and implement systems and tools that accelerate development velocity for multi-disciplinary engineering teams.

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

Join TE Connectivity's Passive Optics organization as the Software Engineering Manager for Software Engineering, and build the people foundation for the team that develops and owns the reusable software platform inside Fusion manufacturing stations. This is the one role on the software team dedicated primarily to people leadership, and it is expected to stay hands-on technically alongside the team it leads.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

As this team grows toward its planned size, its long-term health depends on someone whose primary job is the people side of engineering, including coaching, honest performance conversations, hiring, and protecting the team's focus. Every other role on this team is primarily technical. This role is defined around people leadership instead.

  

**This role is based on-site in Rochester, NY. On-site presence is required, given the team's daily use of physical manufacturing and test hardware that cannot be fully replicated remotely, and the importance of in-person collaboration.**

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**People Leadership**

* **Team Health & Growth:** Run regular, substantive 1-on-1s, career development plans, and honest, timely performance conversations for every engineer on the team.

* **Hiring & Staffing:** Own recruiting, interviewing, and staffing plans for the software team as it grows toward its planned size.

* **Culture & Process:** Establish and evolve team processes, including planning, ceremonies, and onboarding, appropriate to a growing engineering team.

* **Business Partnership:** Represent the software team's priorities, constraints, and needs to business leadership, MPDE, FDE mechanical/electrical/controls/vision disciplines, Operations/Site ME, and IT/OT counterparts.

  

**Hands-On Technical Contribution**

* **Technical Credibility:** Personally contribute code and technical work, up to roughly half your time depending on the phase the team is in. Treat this as a minimum level of hands-on technical involvement, and protect the people duties above even when technical work would fill more of your time.

* **Standards Partnership:** Partner with the Staff Software Engineer to set and uphold engineering standards and best practices, including source control, automated testing, code review, secure development, and controlled software release.

* **Systems Foundation:** In the team's current early phase, expect to spend meaningful time helping stand up baseline systems such as source control, CI/CD, requirements and interface tracking, reproducible builds, automated test, release/versioning, and the team's development tooling, including its approach to AI-assisted development. This may reduce hands-on coding time in the near term in service of the team's longer-term technical health

**What your background should look like**
-----------------------------------------

* Education: BS or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience: Typically 10+ years in software development, including experience operating at the Senior or Staff Software Engineer level, plus demonstrated interest in and aptitude for people leadership. Formal management experience is a plus but not required.

* Leadership Foundation: Has coached, mentored, or informally led other engineers, and genuinely wants people development to be the center of the job.

* Software Development Practices: Strong personal grounding in version control, testing, and software lifecycle management, sufficient to hold an informed technical conversation with the Staff Software Engineer as a peer.

  

**Core Leadership Competencies**

* People Development: Skilled at structured feedback, coaching, and difficult performance conversations.

* Hiring & Staffing: Able to assess technical talent, run a fair interview process, and build a staffing plan against real team needs.

* Process & Delivery: Comfortable running sprint or iteration planning, tracking delivery, and reporting transparently on progress and risk.

* Technical Fluency: Enough hands-on technical background in automation, machine/station software, or industrial systems to understand and direct the actual substance of the team's work.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Team Leadership: Prior experience managing or informally leading a small (5-10 person) engineering team.

* Process Ownership: Experience standing up or substantially maturing engineering process, such as source control, CI/CD, or requirements tracking, in a team that previously had little or none.

* Domain Exposure: Background in, or direct exposure to, manufacturing, industrial automation, or hardware-adjacent software.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Since 1892, OPW customers have been able to count on us to revolutionize fluid-handling operations around the world. As a global leader in fluid-handling solutions, the mission of OPW is to be a developer of a comprehensive array of innovative fluid-handling solutions that our customers can consistently and reliably count on. These include loading and unloading systems for high-value hazardous and non-hazardous bulk products; railcar and transport tank-truck valves, gauging devices and tank-monitoring systems; automated storage-terminal controls and systems; and regulators, fittings, valves, vaporizers, vacuum-jacketed piping and gas-handling systems for the safe handling and distribution of cryogenics and industrial gases. OPW has more than 2,000 employees with manufacturing operations in North America, Europe and China, and sales offices around the world. OPW is part of the Clean Energy & Fueling segment of Dover (NYSE: DOV).

  

The Automation Engineer will be responsible for the design, programming, integration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated assembly and testing equipment, including PLC-controlled machinery, robotic work cells, and associated controls hardware. This role will work cross-functionally with manufacturing engineering, maintenance, quality, and production teams to bring automated systems from concept through commissioning (both in-house and vendor) and provide ongoing production support. We are looking for individuals who have knowledge or experience in assembly/testing and automation processes, a keen eye for safety and quality, the ability to solve problems and troubleshoot, and the desire to develop and expand their skills in a production-driven environment. The Automation Engineer will report to the PES Value Stream Manager.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

**Controls Design and Programming**

* Design, develop, and debug PLC programs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or similar) for assembly automation equipment
* Program and integrate industrial robots (FANUC, Universal Robots, etc.) for pick-and-place, path planning, material handling, loading/unloading, dispensing, welding, or assembly applications
* Develop HMI screens and operator interfaces for machine control and diagnostics
* Design and implement vision system integration (Keyence or similar) for part inspection, guidance, and quality verification
* Configure and troubleshoot servo motion control systems, VFDs, and motor drives
Collaborate with mechanical and electrical design engineers during the concept and design phases to ensure controls feasibility  

  

**Equipment Specification & Vendor Management**

* Develop detailed technical specifications (URS/equipment specs) for new automation equipment, including PLC, robotics, and vision system requirements
* Research and evaluate automation equipment vendors, integrators, and component suppliers based on technical fit, cost, lead time, and reliability
* Solicit and review vendor quotes and proposals; lead technical evaluation and vendor selection process
* Manage vendor-built automation projects from kickoff through FAT/SAT and installation, including schedule tracking, budget oversight, and change order management
* Review vendor-supplied design packages, electrical schematics, and controls documentation for compliance with internal standards and specifications
* Act as primary technical point of contact and lead design reviews, progress meetings, and FAT/SAT activities with external vendors and integrators
Ensure vendor equipment meets safety, quality, and performance requirements prior to acceptance and handoff to production  

  

**Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical support for installed equipment, including root cause analysis and corrective action for downtime events
* Identify and implement improvements to improve machine uptime, cycle time, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
* Support preventive maintenance programs and develop troubleshooting documentation for maintenance and production staff
* Analyze production data and machine performance to identify optimization opportunities
Integrate mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and controls subsystems into functioning automated work cells  

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Create and maintain electrical schematics, I/O lists, controls architecture diagrams, and program documentation that complies with all applicable safety standards
* Participate in risk assessments and safety validation for automated equipment
Maintain version control and backups of PLC, HMI, and robot programs  

  
  

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechatronics, Controls Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs in an industrial/manufacturing environment
* Hands-on experience programming industrial robots and integrating them into automated systems
* Working knowledge of electrical schematics, ladder logic, structured text, and function block programming
* Understanding of pneumatics, sensors (photo eyes, proximity, encoders), servo/motion control, and machine safety circuits
* Experience with HMI development platforms
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and software issues under time pressure
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and P&IDs
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  

  

**The Ideal Candidate Will Also Bring**

* Experience with FANUC and Universal Robots programming/certification
* Familiarity with machine vision systems (Keyence or similar)

* Experience with Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, or similar 3D CAD software for reviewing mechanical designs
* Prior experience in high-volume assembly and testing automation, packaging automation, or similar

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Industrial Controls
jobs.description:
Location Charlotte, North Carolina, 28273 Category Engineering JR105329 FCX 9290 FCX Performance, Inc. Regular Job Type Full time

  

**System Engineer – Industrial Controls**

**Position Overview**

FCX Performance, an Applied Industrial Technologies Company, is seeking a hands-on, mid-to-senior level **System Engineer** to deliver industrial and commercial control systems services to local customers. This is a field-heavy engineering role requiring physical site visits, tool utilization, and direct interaction with industrial machinery.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

* **Field Engineering & Support:** Provide local industrial/commercial control systems engineering service for customers relating to SCADA Systems, PLC Programming, CAD Drawings, Industrial Networking, and Systems Calibration.
* **Technician Interfacing:** Support instrument technicians in the field with issues related to interfacing field devices to DCS & SCADA systems, special needs testing, and technical support.
* **Project & Contract Management:** Partner with fellow engineers to resolve project backlogs while maintaining excellent relationships with contract customers.
* **On-Site Upgrades:** Identify opportunities for system and hardware upgrades at customer facilities.
* **Documentation & Safety:** Report job activity and maintain detailed logs about service calls, parts, and orders. Fully comprehend and communicate safety protocols on active job sites.
* **Travel:** Safely operate a company vehicle to travel to and from local job sites daily.

**Required Education & Experience**

* **Experience:** **Minimum 5+ years of direct, hands-on industry experience** programming PLCs (Allen Bradley, Automation Direct, MOSCAD, etc.) and working with process/flow control systems.
* **HMI Proficiency:** 5+ years of experience with computer-based HMI software (Wonderware, VTSCADA, Lookout, etc.).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering (BSEE/BSEET), or an Associate Degree (ASEE) paired with extensive, verifiable field experience. *(Note: Advanced theoretical degrees like an MSEE are not required; this is a practical field engineering role).*
* **Driving Record:** Must possess a valid US driver's license with a clean driving record.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship will not be provided for this position

**Technical & Mental Requirements**

* Strong background in electrical/electronic engineering, process instrumentation, and process engineering.
* High energy, technically competent, resourceful, with extreme attention to detail.
* **Programming & CAD:** Strong skills in PLCs, Microsoft Visual Basic (or basic programming software) and AutoCAD/AutoCAD Electrical.
* **Industrial Networking:** Solid understanding of networks, network structures, radio-based communications, and industrial protocols.
* **Controls Mastery:** Deep understanding of industrial controls, process controls (including PID Loops and pump control), industrial instrument calibrations, and repairs.
* **Electrical Knowledge:** Advanced understanding of analog current loops (4-20mAdc, 1-5Vdc, etc.), their PLC counterparts in numeric counts, and strict adherence to the National Electrical Code (NEC).
* **Tool Proficiency:** Competency with required physical equipment, including hand tools, volt-ohm meters, power tools, and instrument loops.
* **Growth Mindset:** While 5+ years of core experience is required, you will receive ongoing On-the-Job Training (OJT) for company-specific workflows. A willingness to learn daily and teach others is required.
* **Autonomy:** Must be highly self-motivated, self-driven, and able to manage daily schedules.

**Physical & Environmental Requirements**

* **Physical Strength:** Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs regularly.
* **Mobility:** Must be able to stand, kneel, walk for long periods, and climb ladders or stairs.
* **Availability:** Available for occasional emergency call-ins and overnight travel to various customer sites based on business needs.
* **Environment:** Duties are performed indoors and outdoors with direct exposure to weather elements, heavy equipment, earth excavation, power tools, clean rooms, dirt, and noise.
* **National Travel:** Ability to travel nationally when required (infrequent).

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. Our leading brands, specialized services, and comprehensive knowledge serve MRO and OEM end users in virtually all industrial markets through our multi-channel capabilities that provide choice, convenience, and expertise.

**Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

jobs.title: Cyber / DevOps Systems Engineer (Ft. Bragg)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Senior Cyber Security / DevOps Systems Engineer to engineer, automate, secure, and optimize full-stack enterprise solutions supporting mission-critical operations. This role is responsible for orchestrating containerized applications, developing CI/CD pipelines, implementing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions, integrating new software and hardware technologies, and enhancing cybersecurity posture across on-premises environments. The position will support system modernization efforts through automated testing, software quality assurance, proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement aligned with current industry standards and best practices. This position will be located in Fort Bragg, North Carolina, and will be an on-site position

Responsibilities:

Correlates threat data from various sources to establish the identity and modus operandi of hackers active in the client's networks and posing a potential threat. Provides the customer with assessments and reports, facilitating situational awareness and understanding of current cyber threats and adversaries. Develops cyber threat profiles based on geographic region, country, group, or individual actors. Produces cyber threat assessments based on entity threat analysis. May provide computer forensic and intrusion support to high technology investigations in the form of computer evidence seizure, computer forensic analysis, data recovery, and network assessments. Researches and maintains proficiency in tools, techniques, countermeasures, and trends in computer network vulnerabilities, data hiding, and network security and encryption.

* **Engineer and orchestrate containerized applications, CI/CD solutions, and monitoring for full-stack automation**: Engineer solutions using current industry standards for infrastructure as code and automated software quality assurance.
* **Integrate newly procured software and hardware**: Seamlessly incorporate new tools and technologies into existing environments.
* **Assess and advise on cybersecurity measures**: Evaluate and recommend security enhancements for software and hardware platforms.
* **Implement cybersecurity measures**: Deploy security controls to protect systems and data.
* **Test and evaluate cyberspace systems**: Establish processes for thorough testing and assessment.
* **Resolve technical issues**: Troubleshoot and correct complex problems related to on-premises systems
* **Update, configure, and manage system components**: Optimize existing customer solutions.
* **Stay informed**: Keep up-to-date with industry developments, best practices, and standards.

Qualifications:

High School with 9+ years (or commensurate experience)

Required Skills and Experience

* Clearance Required: TS/SCI
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II
* 9 years of experience: Demonstrated expertise in DEVOPS/SYSTEMS Engineering or a related field
* Familiarity with Industry DEVOPS Technology Stacks: Experience with On-Premise GitLab and Offline Registry Management, Rancher and K8s Cluster Administration, and IaC with Terraform and Ansible
* DEVOPS Cybersecurity management and operations: Knowledge of DEVOPS cybersecurity practices, risk management, and operational security
* Secure Python coding and development: Proficient in secure Python programming for automation and scripting
* Git/Github continuous integration and continuous delivery: Experience with version control, automated builds, and deployment pipelines
* Linux administration experience with preference for Debian family: Proficiency in Linux system administration, with a preference for Debian-based distributions
* Understanding of Networking Principles: Familiarity with networking fundamentals
* Software integration into air-gapped environments: Experience in application integration into isolated network environments
* API Integration: Understanding of how to design, build, and integrate APIs into workflows
* In-Depth Troubleshooting Expertise: Experience in quickly identifying technical issues and troubleshooting complex issues to enable expeditious resolution
* Current and active U.S. Passport
* Current and active U.S. Driver's License
* Must have the ability to wear personal protective equipment, including a protective mask, ballistic helmet, body armor, and chemical/biological protective garments
* Travel required and based on availability and mission requirements of the customer to CONUS and OCONUS locations.

Preferred Skills and Experience

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)
* Kubernetes Certifications: KCNA, KCSA, CKA, CKAD, CKS

**Job Description:**

At ITW Food Equipment Group, people and food are our passion. We believe great food brings people together, and the relationships we share feed our inspiration to be the best we can be for one another.

It is our mission to provide food equipment that foodservice and food retail professionals can trust to work hard and deliver quality, consistent results day in and day out, empowering them to focus on what they love most—creating great food for great people.

As one of the premium brands under the ITW Food Equipment Group umbrella, at **Vulcan**, we are dedicated to exceptional commercial cooking equipment. It’s all we do. Chefs and operators around the world recognize Vulcan as the best-in-class supplier for premier, energy-efficient foodservice equipment.

If you’re passionate about building relationships, driving growth, and representing trusted brands that help customers succeed every day — we want to meet you.

As CBI Electrical Engineer you will be part of the Vulcan New Product Development Team (COE) and the Troy-based technical team supporting Vulcan combi products. This role is responsible for electrical and controls development, including electrical system design, component selection and validation, troubleshooting, compliance testing, and support of new and existing products. The position will also serve as a key U.S. technical interface with global software-development teams, translating U.S. product requirements and field issues into clear software requirements and defect reports and tracking those items through resolution.

Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, systems-level problem solving, communication, and project-management skills are required. The successful candidate does not need to be a software developer but should be comfortable working with software-development processes, issue-tracking systems, and globally distributed development teams. Programming or embedded-controls experience is preferred.

**What You'll Do**

* Practicing the ITW corporate strategy, ITW Toolbox, ITW Core Values and Code of Conduct.
* Understanding and applying the importance of CBI – following the CBI New Product Development (Stage-Gate) Process.
* Pioneer new cooking technologies, including advanced controls and heating systems.
* Developing and maintaining software specifications in collaboration with an external vendor.
* Design, develop, test, and evaluate electrical and electromechanical devices and systems.
* Programming of PLC-controlled lab and test setups.
* Coordinate development efforts with internal teams and suppliers to ensure projects meet timeline and cost objectives
* Collaborate with design team members to develop written instructions incl. installation, setup and operation manuals
* Manage and continuously improve electrical in-house testing procedures to improve product quality and worker safety.
* Manage code compliance activities including UL, Energy Star and state level submissions and maintain documentation.
* As requested, work with and support other ITW FEG operations to develop and improve cooking technologies.
* Regular reports on the project progress to management.

**What you Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, 5 years’ work experience.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently as well as within a team.
* Has an aggressive growth mindset.
* Builds strong customer and supplier relationships and effectively resolves conflicts.
* Schematic design and wiring diagram experience required in addition to familiarity with mechanical design practices.
* Ability to create and maintain software specifications.
* Experience working with embedded controls or software-development teams, including requirements definition, defect tracking, and configuration/release processes, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with software issue-tracking/version-control platforms such as GitLab, GitHub, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools preferred.
* Design, set up, and validation of prototypes as well as data acquisition to support lab testing efforts.
* Proven experience in designing control and power supply circuits for food service equipment; experience with commercial, industrial, or similar equipment is also valued.
* Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment where all employees make informed decisions with known risks understood and shared by all.

**Where you will Work**

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee:

* Must be able to stand or walk for a duration of 2 hours.
* Must be able to bend, stoop, lift, reach and twist to complete all job tasks.
* Must be able to wear all required PPE (i.e., safety glasses, gloves, steel/composite toe safety shoes) when required.
* Combination - industrial plant floor, R&D-Lab and office.
* Local travel up to 25%
* Lifting up to 50lbs

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Be part of a respected global company with a reputation for quality and innovation.
* Enjoy a collaborative, people-first culture that values growth and creativity.
* Make a tangible impact with industry-leading brands trusted by professionals worldwide.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Apply today and help shape the future of foodservice and retail equipment with **ITW Food Equipment Group**.

jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you'll collaborate on some of the world's toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

  

As a **Lead Electrical Engineer** you will be responsible for;

* Designing and analyzing analog and RF circuitry, including high-frequency electronics and signal transmission systems.
* Utilizing simulation, modeling, and CAD tools to develop and optimize electrical designs.

* Conducting validation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action investigations for field and production issues.

jobs.title: Critical Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, Field Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:  
  

* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

  

* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.

  

* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.

  

* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

  

* Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.

  

* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

  

* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.

  

* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to  
  
meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:  
  

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.

  

* Are detail and data oriented.

  

* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.

  

* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.

  

* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).

  

* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

  

* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

  
A day in the life  
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, performance, security, and continued improvement of the organization’s enterprise infrastructure. This position manages complex server, storage, backup, virtualization, email, and cloud environments while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and system optimization. The Senior Systems Engineer also serves as a technical leader, supporting IT staff, implementing best practices, and helping align infrastructure solutions with evolving business needs.

  

* Administer, monitor, maintain, and optimize on-premises and cloud-based infrastructure.
* Manage enterprise server, storage, virtualization, backup, and email environments.
* Support cloud services with a focus on security, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor system health and performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and conduct capacity planning.
* Develop automation solutions using scripting and DevOps tools to streamline system processes and deployments.
* Lead disaster recovery and business continuity efforts to ensure system availability and data protection.
* Implement cybersecurity best practices, security hardening, monitoring, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Research, evaluate, and deploy new technologies that support organizational and business needs.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to IT staff and promote infrastructure best practices.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, procedures, and policies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement effective technology solutions.
* Provide advanced technical support for software, hardware, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Travel as needed, work varied shifts including weekends and holidays, and perform other job-related duties as assigned.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or IT infrastructure management; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* Advanced experience with Windows Server, Linux, enterprise storage, backup solutions, and email platforms such as Exchange and Microsoft 365.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud and hybrid-cloud infrastructure strategies.
* Experience with enterprise backup technologies such as Veeam, Commvault, Rubrik, or similar solutions.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to join our server firmware team. In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. Your work will power the backbone of AWS compute infrastructure, including the servers that enable AI/ML workloads for customers worldwide.  
  
The ideal candidate will be an innovative self-starter with deep expertise in Linux kernel internals, device driver development, and embedded Linux systems. You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi-factor problems, including kernel upgrade strategies that minimize customer impact, address security vulnerabilities rapidly, and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.  
  
You will collaborate with engineers across AWS and external partners, leading development efforts that span kernel security, hardware enablement, and platform services teams. Your work will directly contribute to critical initiatives that keep our infrastructure patched, secure, and operationally excellent—ensuring the foundation for tomorrow's AI/ML innovations remains robust and scalable.  
  
AWS Engineers are shaping the way people use computers and designing the future of cloud computing technology – come help us make history!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop firmware solutions for AWS servers, contributing to server designs that power millions of customer workloads.  
Lead the complete development lifecycle from initial conception through production deployment, ensuring robust and scalable firmware implementations across our massive server fleet.  
Architect and implement firmware deployment strategies that minimize customer impact while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.  
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, validation teams, software services to optimize functionality and performance.  
Explore and evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on AWS infrastructure, making recommendations for adoption and integration into our firmware stack.  
Drive technical solutions for problems, balancing security requirements, operational efficiency, and system reliability.  
Tailor firmware solutions specifically for the AWS environment, ensuring seamless integration with our unique infrastructure requirements and operational workflows.  
Mentor team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and best practices.  
  
A day in the life  
Most mornings, you'll dive into code—whether that's developing new security features, optimizing firmware deployment strategies, or debugging a tricky issue that's affecting a subset of servers.  
You'll collaborate a lot. Maybe it's a quick sync with platform teams about an upcoming deployment, or a deeper technical discussion with hardware engineers about a new server design. You might work with internal customers to understand their requirements.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services is establishing a hardware engineering office in Portland, Oregon to accelerate server hardware development, manufacturing, and operations. The Portland site will become a center of excellence for electrical hardware engineering within AWS for board development, server power, system performance, silicon quality, and manufacturing. This is a greenfield site leadership role. The site leader will be the first hire and the single most important investment in the success of this office. You will not simply manage a team. You will own the culture, operational posture, recruiting velocity, and engineering output of the entire Portland site from day one.  
  
As the site leader, you will own the Portland office end to end. You will define the site's identity, set its operational cadence, and establish the cultural foundation before the organization scales. You will drive recruiting velocity across all Portland teams, partner with real estate and facilities to stand up lab-capable office space, and represent the Portland site in cross-site planning with Seattle, San Jose, and other AWS engineering locations. You will be the single point of accountability for the site's hiring trajectory, engineering output, and organizational health. Every team at the Portland site, whether in your direct reporting line or not, will look to you as the senior leader on the ground.  
  
As the functional engineering leader, you will hire, develop, and lead the managers who run each of the Portland engineering teams. Your direct reports will be the engineering managers who own board development, server power, and manufacturing test/quality, and validation of 3rd party silicon. You will be accountable for the output, hiring velocity, and technical judgment of each of those teams through the managers you put in place. You will lead board development managers, server power managers, electrical manufacturing test/quality, silicon qualification, and production yield. These are not adjacent teams doing similar work. You will be expected to set technical direction across all of them, make resourcing tradeoffs between them, calibrate talent across teams, and hold each manager and their team to a unified engineering bar. You will also carry coordination responsibility for firmware disciplines co-located at the site, including BIOS, BMC, and mechanical engineering teams.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The site leader owns all Portland site operations end to end. This includes defining and executing the recruiting strategy to hire and scale multiple engineering teams. You will lead the multiple engineer teams. You will establish and maintain Amazon's cultural standards at the site, operational rigor, and embody Amazon culture to scale the site.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 10 or more years of progressive experience in hardware engineering, including at least 5 years managing managers
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling hardware engineering teams from the ground up, ideally in a greenfield or early-stage site context
* Deep technical fluency across at least two of the following areas: board-level electrical design, server power delivery, manufacturing test engineering, or silicon validation
* Proven ability to hire senior technical talent in competitive markets and to establish a high-performance engineering culture that attracts and retains strong builders

* Master's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Deep connections with the Portland metro technology labor market, including the semiconductor and hardware engineering ecosystem
* Prior experience standing up electrical labs, including board bring-up environments, manufacturing test infrastructure, and silicon debug facilities
* Prior experience building culture in a new site, team, or organization
* Experience managing organizations that span electrical hardware, power delivery, and silicon validation, manufacturing disciplines under a single leadership structure

As the Pacific Northwest’s leading contract packer and co-packer of ready-to-drink beverage products for nearly a century, Portland Bottling Company provides flexibility and responsiveness, with unmatched regional and national reach, as well as the scale to handle the needs of any and all customers. That comes from providing an environment for our employees that is safe and promotes growth, development, and success.

**Job Summary**

Interface with several PBC departments to troubleshoot, improve, upgrade and support manufacturing network systems. As a senior technical engineer, the Senior Robotics Engineer – Industrial Controls position will make hands-on contributions to the manufacturing information system software by editing and troubleshooting Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programming and data acquisition / formatting. The position will liaise with the Process Control Engineer in regard to software architecture design, development of software applications and their integration into enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, configure, test and debug robotics applications, programs and software codes, such as PLC (AB & Siemens) and Human Machine Interface (HMI) software (Ignition) to support operational changes and improvements for the manufacturing operations.
* Develop, design, and write custom software programming, applications and interfaces to control and monitor systems, including both PLC code (ladder logic) and programming, HMI code and development,
* Install, commission, and deploy robotic programs, ensuring smooth integration with existing manufacturing infrastructure.
* Diagnose other robotic systems, such as advanced displays, advanced sensing, and robotic programs.
* Create detailed technical documentation and back ups of system architecture diagrams, PLC programs, and user manuals
* Implement advanced sensing and vision systems to enable robotics to perceive and interact with their environment autonomously. Maintaining calibration of the sensors
* Investigate mechanical failures and maintenance problems for root cause analysis, providing occasional afterhours remote support for 24/7 operation.
* Support Operations and Maintenance by implementing improvements, troubleshooting electronics and program failures
* Provide technical support for robotic systems. Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of robotic systems, troubleshooting issues and implementing improvements as needed.
* Provide training and support to production personnel on the operation and maintenance of systems and programs.
* Work with vendors and internal personnel on projects related to automated solutions to improve plant operations, increase safety, increase quality, reduce cost and increase efficiency.
* Engage in ongoing maintenance activities, supporting software upgrades, diagnostics and troubleshooting.
* Stay updated on the latest advancements in robotics technology and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics Engineering or Controls Engineering.
* Seven years of experience maintaining and programming Krones can bottling and packaging machinery, including installation, commissioning, startup, overhaul, inspection, retrofit, and service.
* Seven years of experience programming and troubleshooting controller interfaces and PLCs using Allen-Bradley, Siemens Step 7, Siemens TIA Portal, ladder logic, SCL, and structured text; and programming HMIs using FactoryTalk, WinCC, TIA Portal, Zenon, and Inductive Automation Ignition.
* Seven years of experience with VODM fillers; CIP/SIP processes using phosphoric and caustic; Transmarket product-preparation equipment and processes; and adjusting blending, preparation, filling processes, and filling programs—including mechanical fillers, weight filling, and PFIR filling valves—to operational requirements.
* Seven years of experience with tray packers, palletizers, dry-end machinery, and peripherals, including Videojet tray coders, Nordson glue-injection systems, and Toledo weight checkers; and with can/bottle, case, and pallet conveyors, LCT4 systems, and bottle liners/separators.
* Seven years of electrical experience interpreting American and European (German) prints; and seven years of experience with Profibus, AS-i Bus, CAN bus, Ethernet, Powerlink, and Profinet networks; Danfoss, Allen-Bradley, and B&R frequency inverters, including model and brand conversions and upgrades; servo drives, stepper motors, and general motor control; and programming and addressing AS-i Bus and AS-i safety devices such as buttons and Evoguard, SPX, and Burkert valves.
* Seven years of experience with empty-can, full-can, tray-code, and vision inspection systems; and with Anton Paar equipment, including digital and analog sensors, flow meters, temperature and pressure transmitters, and mass flow meters.
* Seven years of mechanical experience performing major overhauls, replacing worn parts, and rebuilding filling valves, manifold distributors, filler main bearings, conveyor belts, and process valves—including flap, seat, double-seat, double-seal, diverting, shuttle, and sampling valves—and replacing and referencing servo motors.
* Seven years of experience with line control and balancing; adjusting can- and case-conveyor speeds to optimize motor use; and creating, adjusting, and tuning formats for new can sizes, can inspections, package arrangements, and pallet patterns.
* Seven years of experience developing SOPs for equipment upgrades and changes

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

At KLA, we develop industry-leading equipment and technologies that enable innovation across the semiconductor industry. Our teams solve complex engineering challenges that help customers manufacture faster, more powerful, and more efficient electronic devices.

  
  

We are seeking a hands-on position support multiple semiconductor process equipment platforms, including advanced etch and deposition systems. This role combines electrical system design, product safety, regulatory compliance, sustaining engineering, and new product development. The ideal candidate is a hands-on electrical engineer that has a strong interest in and willingness to lead product safety and compliance efforts.

  

**What You'll Do**

As a key member of the engineering team, you will be responsible for the electrical design, product & safety compliance, and long-term support of electrical systems in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

  

**Electrical Systems Design & Sustaining**

* Design and sustain electrical systems for semiconductor process equipment
* Specify and integrate electrical components including power supplies, sensors, relays, circuit protection devices, heaters, temperature control hardware, and motion-control elements
* Develop equipment protection strategies and electrical safety functions such as emergency stops, safety interlocks, and grounding systems
* Evaluate new technologies and alternative components to improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost
* Support field electrical troubleshooting escalations when required
  

**Product Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead product safety and compliance initiatives across multiple equipment platforms
* Interpret and implement industry standards including SEMI, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, and customer-specific requirements
* Conduct compliance assessments, design reviews, gap analyses, risk assessments, and hazard evaluations
* Partner with certification bodies and testing organizations to achieve product certifications and maintain compliance documentation
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience designing electrical systems for semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, manufacturing equipment, or other similar electromechanical systems
* Demonstrated ability to assess and design electrical systems and equipment to regulatory standards (i.e., 60204-1, NFPA 79, UL 508A)
* Strong understanding of electrical design principles, power distribution, controls, and electrical safety
* Experience selecting, integrating, and troubleshooting electrical components and subsystems
* Travel requirement for 15 to 20%
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a liaison with 3rd party assessors to achieve and maintain equipment certifications (i.e., CE mark, EMC)
* Experience assessing and designing safety interlock circuits with performance levels required by ISO 13849

Description:

ARM EnerTech Associates, LLC (AETA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of ARM Group Enterprises Inc. * Manage and coordinate the development, design, and execution of multiple projects simultaneously.
* Develop project scopes, objectives, proposals, and budgets while effectively communicating with key stakeholders.

* Effectively communicate with key stake holders including project manager, project engineers, and other members of the project team.
* Pro-actively recognize conditions and problems of non-routine nature, develop solutions, and seek guidance when needed.
* Communicate and interface with clients and vendors.
* Writing technical documentation such as: Functional Descriptions, Functional Specifications, Test Documents, Reports, etc.
* Provide mentorship to junior engineers and contribute to technical knowledge-sharing within the team.

Requirements:

* 10+ years’ expertise in industrial control systems, PLC/PAC programming, HMIs, VFDs, and SCADA systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with AutoCAD or equivalent engineering software.
* A self-starter possessing strong communication, planning and organizational skills.
* Comfortable working around energized power distribution equipment and related control systems.
* Requires travel to job sites including overnight stays to provide on-site commissioning, troubleshooting, customer support and training.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex projects.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to interact with clients and team members effectively.
* A proactive, problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.
* Experience in Siemens and Allen-Bradley automation components.
* Knowledge of UL508A Control Panel design and standards.

We invest in our team's well-being and future through a comprehensive benefits package with a range of offerings designed to support you holistically. Our health and wellness offerings include two Health Insurance options (Traditional PPO and QHDHP with an HSA), vision and dental coverage, life insurance, disability protection, accident and critical illness coverage. To enhance your future financial security, we provide a 401(k) with company match, HSA/FSA accounts, and 529 college savings plans. Work-life balance is prioritized through our generous PTO starting at 15 days per year and 10 paid holidays per year, giving you ample time to rest, recharge, and attend to life outside the office. An Employee Assistance Program is provided to you and your household with resources to assist you in managing a variety of situations. We invest in your professional growth through our Tuition Reimbursement program and continuing education opportunities. After 6 months of employment, all team members become eligible for quarterly bonuses, providing additional avenues for financial growth. This robust package is designed to foster a workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally, underscoring our dedication to your overall well-being and future success.

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Power Electronics PCB Design
jobs.description:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most, in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems, the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

**About the Role**

**Valinor Dispatch** builds modular charging infrastructure that keeps unmanned systems (drones, ground robots, surface vessels) powered and operating autonomously in the field. We're seeking an **Electrical Engineer** specializing in power electronics and PCB design to own power flow for our AC/DC systems in low-voltage applications. This is a hands-on, on-site role for someone who can take a design from prototype and proof of concept through production-ready manufacturing, working directly with our engineering team to build rugged, high-reliability power systems for austere environments. You'll own the board-level design for DC/DC conversion, protection, and health monitoring, and set the standard for power electronics quality as the team scales.
