jobs.title: Datacenter Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the organization that builds, operates, and continuously evolves the infrastructure behind the Microsoft Cloud, powering services used by more than 95% of Fortune 500 companies. CO+I is responsible for the full datacenter lifecycle from global planning and site acquisition through design, construction, deployment, operations, and eventual decommissioning, spanning 400+ datacenters across more than 70 Azure regions, connected by over 600,000 kilometers of fiber. As the engine that enables Microsoft’s cloud-first mission, CO+I delivers reliable, trusted, secure, and sustainable cloud and AI infrastructure, ensuring capacity is available on time, every time, to meet customer growth and support Microsoft’s broader mission to empower every person and organization to achieve more.

The Systems Engineering, Test, and Integration (SETI) team serves as Microsoft's technical proving ground for next-generation datacenter infrastructure. As a **Datacenter Electrical Engineer** in SETI, you will evaluate emerging power and electrical infrastructure technologies, determine whether they can meet Microsoft's requirements for reliability, scalability, and operational readiness, and help mature promising concepts into deployment-ready solutions. Projects may include medium-voltage architectures, HVDC distribution, power electronics, energy storage systems, advanced protection schemes, grid-interactive technologies, and other first-of-a-kind infrastructure innovations.

Success in this role requires more than technical analysis. You will be expected to define ambiguous problems, design and execute validation strategies, identify technical and operational risks, work directly with suppliers and internal engineering teams, and provide clear recommendations that influence Microsoft's long-term datacenter architecture. Our team is expected to develop evidence-based recommendations regarding technology readiness, deployment suitability, technical risks, and investment priorities. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on learning quickly, solving complex technical problems, and helping Microsoft make informed decisions about the future of datacenter infrastructure.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Employees come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive.

  
**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate, develop, and integrate next-generation electrical infrastructure technologies for Microsoft's datacenter portfolio.
* Define system requirements, technical specifications, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies for emerging power and infrastructure solutions.
* Develop design documentation, engineering specifications, schematics, analysis, and technical recommendations that support technology maturation and deployment.
* Create and execute test, validation, and verification plans to assess system performance, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
* Perform technical due diligence on new technologies, supplier solutions, and industry developments to inform engineering and deployment decisions.
* Analyze complex technical issues using modeling, testing, data analysis, and root cause investigation to improve system performance and reliability.
* Evaluate design alternatives and make engineering recommendations based on technical performance, risk, cost, schedule, reliability, and operational impact.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, suppliers, partners, and research organizations to develop and mature new electrical infrastructure solutions.
* Support prototype development, laboratory testing, and system integration activities for first-of-a-kind infrastructure technologies.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/ Minimum Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field AND 3+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field AND 5+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Additional/Preferred qualifications:**

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineeringor related field AND 12+ years power systems and utility experience in mission critical environment OR equivalent experience.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* Experience with power system modeling and analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or similar platforms.
* Experience with datacenter electrical infrastructure, critical power systems, utility-scale power systems, or industrial power systems.
* Experience with power distribution, power electronics, HVDC, medium-voltage systems, energy storage, protection systems, or emerging power architectures.
* Experience developing technical specifications, design documentation, testing, or verification plans for complex electrical systems.
* Experience evaluating, integrating, or qualifying new technologies and translating them into scalable, deployment-ready solutions.

**Job Requirements**  

**Who We Are:**

Quest Global delivers world-class end-to-end engineering solutions by leveraging our deep industry knowledge and digital expertise. By bringing together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals and their areas of expertise, we are able to solve problems better, faster. This multi-dimensional approach enables us to solve the most critical and large-scale challenges across the aerospace & defense, automotive, energy, hi-tech, healthcare, medical devices, rail and semiconductor industries.

As a team of remarkably diverse engineers, we recognize that what we are really engineering is a brighter future for us all. If you want to contribute to meaningful work and be part of an organization that truly believes when you win, we all win, and when you fail, we all learn, then we’re eager to hear from you. The achievers and courageous challenge-crushers we seek, have the following characteristics and skills.

**What You will Do:**

* Own assigned firmware features or components from requirements analysis through design, implementation, integration, verification, and defect resolution.
* Independently learn existing code, hardware interfaces, development tools, and system behavior; identify the right technical resources and ask focused questions when needed.
* Develop maintainable embedded software in modern C++ using sound object-oriented design, clear interfaces, and appropriate error handling.
* Collaborate with systems, hardware, FPGA, software, and architecture teams to clarify requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and resolve cross-functional issues.
* Use debuggers, emulators, analyzers, logs, and other diagnostic methods to isolate complex software and hardware interaction problems.
* Create unit and integration tests, contribute to automated testing, and support continuous integration to improve software quality and regression coverage.
* Participate in design and code reviews; provide constructive feedback and incorporate review input promptly.
* Estimate, plan, and track work through user stories; communicate status, risks, dependencies, and technical blockers early and clearly.
* Follow applicable quality processes and produce clear technical documentation that supports design traceability, testing, and long-term maintenance.
* Work effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to consistent design and architectural improvements.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience, in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded or firmware software.
* Strong C++ programming skills, including object-oriented design, memory management, concurrency fundamentals, debugging, and writing maintainable production code.
* Hands-on experience developing software that interacts with hardware, real-time systems, device interfaces, or resource-constrained embedded platforms.
* Proven ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and codebases independently, break down ambiguous problems, and deliver results with minimal guidance.
* Experience with embedded development and diagnostic tools such as debuggers, emulators, protocol or logic analyzers, and system logs.
* Experience with Linux-based development environments, source control such as Git, and build or container-based workflows.
* Experience with continuous integration, automated testing, and disciplined software review practices.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, raise risks, and collaborate across functions.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a real-time operating system and multi-threaded or concurrent software.
* Experience with hardware bring-up, board-level debugging, device drivers, communication protocols, or FPGA and firmware integration.
* Experience working in a regulated, safety-critical, or quality-controlled product-development environment.
* Experience working in Agile teams and planning work through user stories and iterative delivery.

**Pay Range****: $55-$65/hr on C2C**

**Work Requirements:**

This role is considered an on-site position located in **Waukesha, WI**

* You must be able to commute to and from the location with your own transportation arrangements to meet the required working hours.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Numerical Computing
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a software engineer who is fluent in numerical computing to build the software foundation of our electromagnetic warfare product line. Our Spectrum Sensing team is transforming CHAOS radar systems into distributed sensing systems that detect, classify, and geolocate RF emissions — and the algorithms that do it only matter if they run correctly, quickly, and reliably in production.

This is a software engineering role first. You will own how our numerical and signal processing code is architected, integrated, tested, and accelerated. You do not need a background in RF or radar; you do need to be the person on the team who knows why a Python implementation is slow, what to do about it, and how to build a codebase that other engineers can safely extend. You will work alongside signal processing and RF engineers who supply the algorithms, and you will be the reason those algorithms become dependable software.

**Responsibilities:**

As a key contributor to the Spectrum Sensing team, you will shape the software architecture and engineering practices behind our sensing stack. The day-to-day will be diverse, engaging, and intellectually stimulating, with direct impact on pushing the boundaries of sensing technology and application. Key responsibilities include:

* Design, develop, and maintain production-quality numerical software in Python, with an emphasis on clear interfaces, composability, and long-term maintainability
* Integrate third-party software and hardware into the CHAOS platform via APIs, and own the abstractions that keep those integrations from leaking into the rest of the codebase
* Profile and accelerate signal processing implementations — through vectorization, array-programming frameworks, JIT compilation, GPU offload, or bindings to compiled code — and quantify the improvement
* Define and drive test and CI hygiene for numerical code: numerical regression tests, tolerance and reproducibility strategy, property-based and reference-implementation testing, and automation that catches breakage before a field demonstration does
* Partner with signal processing engineers to turn algorithms from papers, prototypes, and MATLAB into software that ships
* Contribute to overall software architecture decisions for the sensing product line, including how components compose across the platform
* This role will require periodic travel, up to 30%

**Minimum Requirements:**

* B.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
* 5+ years of professional software development experience
* Demonstrated proficiency in Python for numerical computing, including writing, maintaining, testing, and debugging production-quality codebases — not analysis scripts or notebooks alone
* Strong command of array-based numerical computing (NumPy, SciPy, or equivalent), including an understanding of where and why Python performance breaks down
* Demonstrated experience making numerical code fast through at least one of: array/tensor DSLs and JIT compilation (JAX, Numba, PyTorch, Triton, Halide, or similar), GPU-accelerated computing (CUDA or equivalent), or bindings between Python and compiled languages (pybind11, nanobind, Cython, or similar)
* Demonstrated experience contributing to a large, multi-team codebase — working within existing architecture, navigating unfamiliar code, and shipping changes that other teams depend on
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: version control workflow, code review, automated testing, and CI
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical details and present findings
* Must be able to work on-site 4 days per week in Washington, D.C.
* U.S. citizen
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

**Preferred Requirements**

* M.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
* Meaningful open-source contributions to numerical, scientific computing, or signal processing software (we will read your commit history, not just your repository list)
* Exposure to digital signal processing — filtering, FFT-based processing, detection and estimation, or beamforming — whether from coursework, research, or industry
* Experience with software-defined radios (SDRs) or associated signal processing toolkits (e.g., GNU Radio)
* Experience with real-time, streaming, or throughput-constrained data processing systems
* Experience designing APIs or libraries consumed by other engineering teams
* Familiarity with MATLAB, sufficient to read and port existing algorithm prototypes
* Current U.S. security clearance
* Experience with agile development tools like JIRA and Confluence
* Experience in DoD, military, or other Government environment in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

The Role

Code Metal is strengthening Quality Engineering across its code-transformation platforms, language toolchains, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Our teams already have meaningful validation practices in place. As the first dedicated Software Engineer in Test (SDET) hire for this space, reporting to the Director of Quality Engineering, you will build on those foundations - identifying gaps, establishing scalable practices, improving consistency and coverage, and creating clearer quality signals and trustworthy release evidence in partnership with Engineering, Research, and Solutions.

Core Responsibilities

Assess existing validation practices, identify material gaps, and establish scalable quality strategies for code-generation, transpilation, and software-transformation workflows.
Strengthen quality practices for AI-assisted and agentic workflows, with sound judgment about reliability, reproducibility, risk, and appropriate oversight.
Build automated quality and regression infrastructure for AI-assisted software workflows that produces reproducible engineering evidence.
Strengthen and standardize quality signals and release evidence, including regression trends, failure attribution, validation results, and documented readiness criteria.
Diagnose complex failures across C/C++, Rust, Python, build systems, generated code, and heterogeneous target environments; make focused corrections where practical and partner with owning teams on deeper fixes.
Integrate validation suites and quality gates into delivery workflows while collaborating with, rather than replacing, the team responsible for shared CI/CD and developer infrastructure.
Lead quality practices for this space, establish technical standards, mentor engineers, and help shape the Quality Engineering function’s roadmap, operating model, and cross-team interfaces.

Required Qualifications

Significant experience in systems software, compiler or language tooling, developer tools, embedded software, or low-level execution environments.
Production-grade programming proficiency in Python and C++, plus the ability to read and debug unfamiliar C and Rust code.
Experience designing and scaling automated test frameworks, distributed execution systems, or evaluation pipelines for complex systems software.
Strong understanding of memory models, concurrency, runtime performance, and architecture-dependent behavior across CPU, GPU, embedded, or other constrained targets.
Hands-on experience with Linux, containerized environments, continuous integration platforms, and modern build systems.
Ability to translate ambiguous quality risks into measurable validation plans, explain tradeoffs clearly, and lead technical work across team boundaries.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, including partnering with Product to align validation strategies with the product value proposition and customer expectations.
Experience validating AI-assisted or nondeterministic software systems, with sound judgment about AI limitations, reproducibility, independent test evidence, and when deterministic controls or human oversight are required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience improving and scaling quality practices for complex, nondeterministic, or high-consequence software systems.
Experience evaluating agentic or AI-assisted systems and translating their risks into practical quality controls.
Deep hands-on experience with compilers, language tooling, intermediate representations, ABI compatibility, or cross-language semantic validation.
Experience establishing repeatable validation environments and traceable engineering evidence.
Familiarity with formal verification and experience translating research methods into practical engineering checks.
Professional experience in regulated, safety-critical, or high-assurance domains such as defense, aerospace, automotive, medical devices, industrial systems, or semiconductor platforms.

jobs.title: Field Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Field Electrical Engineer (Remote) - This position is full time remote based in California.

NV5 owner representatives act as a dedicated advocate, alleviating project complexities and mitigating risks effectively. Utilizing the latest project controls and project management software, NV5 owner representatives plan and monitor project performance, identifying deviations from the plan and implementing corrective actions in a timely, cost-effective manner.

Our expertise in strategic planning, cost estimation, project controls, and transition management ensures on-time, within-budget delivery to the highest quality standards. Whether it’s, facilitating site assessments, or coordinating facility shutdowns, owners can confidently trust our team to achieve project goals while experiencing peace of mind.

As our Field
Electrical Engineer
, you will serve as an owner’s representative providing field inspections, construction quality assurance, oversight of electrical testing and commissioning activities at multiple sites during various phases of construction. Tasks include completion of checklists, adherence to established processes, identification of code compliance issues and common deficiencies, escalation of energization blockers and documenting as punch list items. Electrical systems are varied but include commercial electric vehicle charging infrastructure and commercial facility power upgrades.

You will actively participate in internal weekly program syncs and work closely with the Project Managers to ensure necessary field documentation and checklists are completed. During weekly syncs all team members proactively participate to ensure client satisfaction and identify program efficiencies, review lessons learned and align on upcoming schedule for the week.

The successful candidate will work virtually when not travelling to project sites.

Responsibilities

Other responsibilities include:

Convey overall project status to clients by means of discussions, presentations, and project reports.
Manage assigned site schedule, travel, communication with Client and onsite representatives and project budgets.
Ability to engage with multiple stakeholder groups while onsite. Responsible for the effective management of own time and effort.
Frequent travel within the United States to attend site walks and Owners Rep onsite services at commercial customer sites (Approximately 50-75% travel).
Inspect, oversee NETA vendor testing, and onsite verification of installed low, medium (480 Volt) and potentially high voltage electrical systems.
Assess power transformer testing results - Doble, TTR, Insulation Resistance, etc.
Oversee NETA vendor testing of both electro-mechanical and solid-state relays.
Verify acceptable cable testing results provided by NETA vendor - Tan Delta, Power Factor, VLF, DC Hipot.
Identify and create punch list of deficiencies observed while onsite.
Oversee onsite activities to ensure compliance with Client processes and procedures.
Automatic transfer switch troubleshooting oversight.
Low, Medium and High voltage switchgear and circuit breaker experience.
Relay calibration and power metering knowledge.
Able to attend customer sites in a timely manner.

Requirements

We are seeking the following experience & qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field.
5+ years of field electrical maintenance experience within engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of commercial projects or similar.
Ability to identify onsite deficiencies and energization blockers. Can recommend resolution and identify root cause.
Experience working with NETA qualified testing vendors, ability to assess pass/fail of test results.
Proficient with Medium Voltage infrastructure including functional testing of relays.
Ability to work in small teams and coordinate onsite activities during outages (for preventative maintenance or power upgrades).
Experience developing and conveying findings to public or private entities.
Proficiency with Microsoft programs including Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, Adobe / Bluebeam and Smartsheet.
Must have excellent communication skills.

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $135,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional compensation may include restricted stock units, performance-based bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package covering medical, dental, PTO, 401(k), unlimited FTO (Flexible Time Off) and professional development opportunities.

NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

: NV5 Inc does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than passive & active candidates and employee referrals. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement and given permission to represent NV5 to candidates on a particular search, NV5 will not owe any referral or other fees with respect to the unsolicited submission.

jobs.description:
KE2 Therm Solutions seeks to save energy, preserve the environment, and improve profitability for our customers by delivering energy-saving electronic solutions to the Heating, Ventilating, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration (HVAC&R) industry. We are recognized for having high quality, technologically advanced products that are easy to use, and for providing superior technical applications support before and after the sale .

KE2 Therm Solutions is part of Distech Controls Inc. which is owned by Acuity Inc.

Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) is a market-leading industrial technology company. We use technology to solve problems in spaces, light and more things to come. Through our two business segments, Acuity Brands Lighting (ABL) and Acuity Intelligent Spaces (AIS), we design, manufacture, and bring to market products and services that make a valuable difference in people’s lives.

We achieve growth through the development of innovative new products and services, including lighting, lighting controls, building management solutions, and an audio, video and control platform. We focus on customer outcomes and drive growth and productivity to increase market share and deliver superior returns. We look to aggressively deploy capital to grow the business and to enter attractive new verticals.

Acuity Inc. is based in Atlanta, Georgia, with operations across North America, Europe and Asia. The Company is powered by approximately 13,000 dedicated and talented associates. Visit us at www.acuityinc.com .

Job Summary

Join a team building the software platform that connects commercial refrigeration systems in the field to the cloud. Our engineers solve complex problems across IoT, device networking, edge connectivity, distributed systems, cloud services, APIs, data pipelines, and web applications—with software that directly operates at the intersection of physical equipment and digital systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll own services and capabilities end to end, shape architecture and technical direction, and solve challenging problems involving thousands of connected devices, unreliable field networks, high-volume telemetry, scalability, security, and system reliability. You’ll work across the technology stack, lead technical design discussions, and help build systems that are robust in the field and scalable in the cloud. This is an opportunity to have meaningful technical ownership while working on a real-world IoT platform where software decisions directly impact how commercial refrigeration systems are monitored, managed, and optimized.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities (Essential Functions)

Software Development

Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software applications and services.
Build scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, and web applications.
Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex software, networking, and system-level issues.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

Web Application Development

Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications using modern frontend technologies.
Implement secure backend services supporting authentication, authorization, and session management.
Design APIs that enable seamless integration between frontend, backend, and third-party systems.
Optimize system performance through caching and efficient API design.

Systems and Infrastructure

Deploy and support applications in Linux-based environments.
Monitor system performance and analyze application and system logs.
Diagnose network, connectivity, and infrastructure-related issues.
Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to improve system reliability and scalability.

Skills And Minimum Experience Required

Linux Administration

Comfortable Working In Linux Environments, Including

Command-line proficiency
Shell scripting (Bash)
File system and permissions management
Process and service management
System monitoring and troubleshooting
Log analysis and diagnostics
SSH and remote system administration

Modern Web Development

Frontend Development

Experience With

HTML5
CSS3
JavaScript (ES6+)
Responsive web design
React.js or equivalent modern frontend framework

Backend Development

Experience Designing And Implementing

RESTful APIs
Authentication and authorization mechanisms
Session management
Secure application development practices
API integration and service-oriented architectures

Web Architecture

Strong Understanding Of

Client-server architecture
API design principles
Data flow between frontend and backend systems
Application scalability considerations
Caching strategies and performance optimization
Distributed application architectures

Programming Skills

Demonstrated proficiency in multiple programming languages, including experience with at least several of the following:

Go
C/C++
Python
Java

Candidates Should Demonstrate

Strong software design principles
Data structures and algorithms knowledge
Debugging and troubleshooting expertise
Ability to quickly learn and adopt new languages, frameworks, and technologies
Adaptability across different technology stacks

Preferred Skills And Experience

TCP/IP, UDP
DNS, DHCP
HTTP/HTTPS
SSL/TLS fundamentals
Routing and switching concepts
Firewalls and network security basics
VPNs and secure communications
Troubleshooting network connectivity issues
Understanding of software security best practices

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.description:
Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by relentlessly prioritizing the user experience. As a Senior Frontend Engineer in the Flights group, you will play an essential role in building and scaling Navan’s flagship product—a next-generation flight platform that drives global business growth and gets people where they need to be.

This is a high-scale, highly complex engineering environment where your work will directly impact travelers worldwide. You will solve challenging architectural problems, collaborate with a global team of elite engineers, product managers, and designers, and write code that powers a platform trusted by the world's largest enterprises. If you are passionate about developer experience, system performance, and building flawless user interfaces, this is your place to build.

What You’ll Do

Own the End-to-End Experience: Drive complex features from inception to launch. Partner closely with product and design to ship impactful features, monitor their real-world impact, and iterate based on data.
Architect for Scale: Lead application design and implement critical portions of our frontend architecture. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality technical frameworks.
Champion Operational Excellence: Set the gold standard for frontend reliability, performance, and measurability. You will define the team's approach to application performance monitoring (APM) and continuously optimize the user experience.
Supercharge Developer Velocity: Build and refine internal frameworks and frontend pipelines that drastically improve developer experience (DX), code health, and time-to-ship for the entire engineering organization.
Mentor and Elevate: Establish credibility quickly through high-quality code and rigorous design reviews. You will mentor fellow engineers on best practices, modern design patterns, and system architecture.
Bridge the Stack: While this is a frontend-focused role, you will have the autonomy to work full-stack. A strong understanding of backend systems and APIs will allow you to drive holistic, cross-system improvements.

What We’re Looking For

Deep Experience: 5+ years of dedicated UI/frontend development experience in high-growth, agile environments.
Technical Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with strong hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, specifically React and Angular.
System-Level Thinking: A comprehensive understanding of the technical intricacies of large-scale frontend systems, with a sharp eye for identifying and executing architectural improvements.
Leadership & Influence: A proven track record of driving positive technical change within engineering organizations. You know how to motivate peers, instill technical accountability, and achieve measurable results.

Position Summary

Credence has an immediate opening for an Avionics Hardware Engineering Support at the senior level who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.
F-16 "Viper" AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base.  The F-16 "Viper" is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.
The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries.  Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding.  Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 200.

Support System Design and Development by researching, designing, developing, and testing computer systems and their components
Support next-Generation mission computer procurement and integration, including recommending best practices for implementing new software and hardware solutions and applying a thorough understanding of industry computer, firmware, memory, CPU, GPU, and middleware solutions

Provide ongoing technical support for computer systems, including troubleshooting and resolving issues

Support software system testing and validation procedures to ensure quality and performance
Prepare reports and correspondence concerning project specifications, activities, and status

Requirements

Working knowledge of a federal compliance framework — FISMA / NIST 800-53 / RMF and what it takes to support an ATO

Software Engineer, Consensus - Anza

Who We Are

Anza is a Solana R&D lab pushing the boundaries of blockchain performance and scalability. Anza was founded by experienced executives and core engineers solving the toughest problems in Web3. Crypto ecosystems rely on robust protocols, and we believe those are best built out in the open, with multiple contributors. We pioneer advanced solutions to meet the evolving demands of decentralized applications.

The Role

As a Software Engineer specializing in consensus, you will play a critical role in fortifying Anza's Agave client and the broader Solana network. Your work will directly improve the efficiency and reliability of our blockchain infrastructure, ensuring robust, timely consensus mechanisms. You will focus on optimizing the processes that underpin the agreement on block validity and order, ensuring they are secure, performant, and scalable to support future growth.

Responsibilities

Develop and Optimize Consensus Mechanisms: Design, implement, and optimize the mechanisms for consensus to enhance the throughput and stability of the Solana network
Efficient Coordination: Develop and refine algorithms to ensure fair and efficient agreement on block production among validators
Ensure Security and Integrity: Identify and mitigate potential security vulnerabilities within the consensus mechanisms, ensuring robust protection against emerging threats
Scalability and Performance: Work on improving the scalability of the consensus system to handle increasing transaction volumes and validator participation without compromising on performance
Testing and Validation: Create and execute comprehensive tests to validate the reliability and efficiency of the consensus mechanisms, including stress tests, fault injection, and performance benchmarking
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including core protocol engineers, security experts, and infrastructure teams, to ensure the seamless integration and functioning of the consensus components
Documentation and Code Review: Maintain thorough documentation of the consensus protocols and conduct peer code reviews to uphold high standards of code quality and consistency

Requirements

What You'll Bring

Experience: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience and 3+ years of hands-on experience with core infrastructure software and distributed systems
Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in systems programming languages such as Rust or C++. Experience with consensus algorithms, distributed systems, and blockchain technology is highly desirable
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex systems, identify potential issues, and develop effective, flexible solutions
Security Mindset: Knowledge of common security threats and best practices in securing consensus processes
Growth Mindset: Actively consuming research papers, designing, and investigating new solutions
Performance Optimization: Experience with performance profiling and optimization techniques
Collaboration and Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Linux, systems automation tools, and systems architecture
Understanding of networking, architecture, and principles underlying distributed systems
A knack for designing secure protocols, software, and algorithms that minimize trust requirements
Self-driven, research oriented, and the ability to learn independently
Active participation in Bitcoin/Ethereum/Blockchain projects or the open-source community is highly desirable

Benefits

Why Join Anza?

We offer a dynamic, fast-paced environment where innovation and problem-solving are at the heart of everything we do. Here, your work will have a direct impact on the security and scalability of blockchain technology, contributing to the foundation of decentralized applications worldwide.

We're excited to welcome individuals who share our passion for pushing the boundaries of blockchain technology. If you're ready to take on the challenge and contribute to the next generation of blockchain infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
Senior Software Engineer

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Blink, you'll take on some of our most critical technical challenges and drive high-impact product development. You’ll lead the design and execution of solutions that ensure millions of customers have seamless, affordable access to prescription medications. You’ll work hands-on, but also shape our technical strategy, mentor engineers, and partner cross-functionally with product, design, data, and operations to accelerate Blink’s growth.
We believe in pragmatic engineering using trusted tools like AWS, Python, JavaScript, MySQL/Postgres, and Linux. We value simplicity, bias for action, and a deep focus on customer impact. This is an opportunity to be both a strategic leader and a builder.  

What Success Looks Like

You lead architecture and execution for complex features or systems across multiple teams or domains.
You consistently raise the bar for code quality, reliability, and system design.
You are a trusted partner to product and business leaders, shaping roadmaps and identifying opportunities to scale impact.
You mentor and support senior and junior engineers alike, helping grow both technical skills and product intuition.
You build with urgency and care, keeping customer experience and long-term maintainability in balance.

Key Focus Areas:

You’ll own one or more strategic initiatives, which may include:

Our telemedicine platform
The home delivery experience
Growth experimentation and personalization
Core pharmacy infrastructure
Development of entirely new product lines

What You’ll Do:

Technical Leadership & Execution

Design and evolve backend and frontend architecture for scalable, high-performance systems
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code
Lead code reviews and promote engineering best practices
Investigate and resolve complex performance or reliability issues
Drive the release of new features end-to-end with testing, documentation, and monitoring

Team Development & Mentorship

Provide technical guidance and coaching to senior and junior engineers
Help shape our engineering culture by modeling ownership, curiosity, and high standards
Foster strong cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment between engineering, product, and business

Innovation & Learning

Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and technologies—and bring them back to the team
Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on ideas with a learning mindset
Champion experimentation and data-driven decision making

Communication & Feedback

Communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
Give and receive feedback with empathy and honesty
Build trust within and across teams to unlock high-impact collaboration

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in software engineering, with increasing scope and impact
Proven experience owning significant systems or product areas from design through launch
Strong expertise in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.)
Experience in distributed systems, API design, and performance optimization
Passion for mentoring and helping teams grow
Track record of influencing without authority and aligning stakeholders across functions
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Why Join Us:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - NBA
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Software Engineer to design, implement, and operate mission-critical stateful services that form the backbone of real-time, automated decisioning and personalization platforms. These systems are responsible for maintaining authoritative state, orchestrating lifecycle transitions, and ensuring reliable downstream effects—often in high-concurrency, low-latency environments.

This position is ideal for engineers with a strong grasp of state machines, idempotency, distributed systems, and “exactly-once” execution semantics. You will also employ advanced AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools to drive correctness, velocity, resilience, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

State Machine Architecture & Implementation

Design, build, and maintain explicit state machines governing:
Lifecycle transitions (e.g., open → in progress → completed → suppressed)
Validation of permissible transitions
Time-based and event-driven changes

Ensure state machines are:
Clearly modeled and not hidden in code logic
Deterministic, reproducible, and auditable
Easily understood and testable
Robust against illegal or duplicate transitions through comprehensive validation

Transactional State Memory & Exactly-Once Processing

Architect and manage transactional state stores serving as the single source of truth
Support safe, high-concurrency read/write operations
Uphold system invariants across partial failures and recovery scenarios
Implement robust idempotency controls so:
Requests can be safely retried
Commands execute at most once
Duplicate events do not compromise state integrity

Develop APIs and workflows resilient to retries, restarts, and replay events

Reliable Side Effects via Outbox Pattern

Employ the outbox pattern to guarantee atomicity of state updates and event publication
Prevent loss or duplication of side effects
Maintain clear separation between state mutation and downstream event delivery
Facilitate replay, backfill, and recovery operations without breaching state guarantees
Integrate seamlessly with messaging and streaming platforms, ensuring fault tolerance

Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management

Design for correctness under concurrent updates, network partitions, partial failures, and service redeployments
Apply expertise in:
Idempotency keys
Optimistic and pessimistic locking strategies
Event ordering and causality

Balance rigorous correctness with performance and latency requirements

AI-Assisted & Agentic Engineering Practices

Leverage AI-powered and agentic tools to:
Automatically generate and validate state transition tests
Probe edge cases and concurrency challenges
Assist in code reviews, refactoring, and documentation
Accelerate debugging, incident analysis, and root cause discovery

Use AI responsibly to enhance productivity while maintaining clarity and system integrity

Observability, Auditability & Trust

Engineer services with robust observability through:
Structured logging, metrics, and alerting
Distributed tracing

Ensure all state transitions and emitted events are:
Fully traceable and reproducible
Auditable for compliance and investigative needs

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

Partner with platform, data, and quality engineering teams to assure end-to-end reliability
Participate in architecture and design reviews to elevate system quality standards
Mentor and guide engineers on best practices for safe, reliable, and maintainable distributed systems

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
6+ years of experience in backend or platform engineering
Demonstrated hands-on expertise with:
State machine modeling and lifecycle management
Transactional state stores
Idempotent API and workflow design

In-depth understanding of:
Exactly-once or effectively once processing
Failure modes in distributed environments

Proficiency in one or more contemporary languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Go, Python)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools for productivity and code quality

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with outbox, transactional messaging, or event sourcing patterns
Familiarity with low-latency, high-throughput architectures
Operational experience in systems requiring strict auditability and correctness
Background in regulated or mission-critical domains

Success Indicators

State transitions are precise, deterministic, and resilient to retries
Side effects reliably occur exactly once, even during failures or replays
Systems recover gracefully from crashes and redeployments
AI-driven tooling decreases defect rates and expedites debugging
The state layer is trusted as the definitive source of truth across engineering teams

Why This Role is Critical

In contemporary automated platforms, correctness and reliability hinge on the integrity of state, not just requests. This role ensures that every state transition and side effect is executed once—and only once—providing a solid foundation for trust, reliability, compliance, and scalability throughout the system.

Qualified candidates are required to currently live in, or be willing to move to, a commutable distance for a hybrid (~3 days in-office) work arrangement

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Software Engineer to design, implement, and operate mission-critical stateful services that form the backbone of real-time, automated decisioning and personalization platforms. These systems are responsible for maintaining authoritative state, orchestrating lifecycle transitions, and ensuring reliable downstream effects—often in high-concurrency, low-latency environments.

This position is ideal for engineers with a strong grasp of state machines, idempotency, distributed systems, and “exactly-once” execution semantics. You will also employ advanced AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools to drive correctness, velocity, resilience, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

State Machine Architecture & Implementation

Design, build, and maintain explicit state machines governing:
Lifecycle transitions (e.g., open → in progress → completed → suppressed)
Validation of permissible transitions
Time-based and event-driven changes

Ensure state machines are:
Clearly modeled and not hidden in code logic
Deterministic, reproducible, and auditable
Easily understood and testable
Robust against illegal or duplicate transitions through comprehensive validation

Transactional State Memory & Exactly-Once Processing

Architect and manage transactional state stores serving as the single source of truth
Support safe, high-concurrency read/write operations
Uphold system invariants across partial failures and recovery scenarios
Implement robust idempotency controls so:
Requests can be safely retried
Commands execute at most once
Duplicate events do not compromise state integrity

Develop APIs and workflows resilient to retries, restarts, and replay events

Reliable Side Effects via Outbox Pattern

Employ the outbox pattern to guarantee atomicity of state updates and event publication
Prevent loss or duplication of side effects
Maintain clear separation between state mutation and downstream event delivery
Facilitate replay, backfill, and recovery operations without breaching state guarantees
Integrate seamlessly with messaging and streaming platforms, ensuring fault tolerance

Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management

Design for correctness under concurrent updates, network partitions, partial failures, and service redeployments
Apply expertise in:
Idempotency keys
Optimistic and pessimistic locking strategies
Event ordering and causality

Balance rigorous correctness with performance and latency requirements

AI-Assisted & Agentic Engineering Practices

Leverage AI-powered and agentic tools to:
Automatically generate and validate state transition tests
Probe edge cases and concurrency challenges
Assist in code reviews, refactoring, and documentation
Accelerate debugging, incident analysis, and root cause discovery

Use AI responsibly to enhance productivity while maintaining clarity and system integrity

Observability, Auditability & Trust

Engineer services with robust observability through:
Structured logging, metrics, and alerting
Distributed tracing

Ensure all state transitions and emitted events are:
Fully traceable and reproducible
Auditable for compliance and investigative needs

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

Partner with platform, data, and quality engineering teams to assure end-to-end reliability
Participate in architecture and design reviews to elevate system quality standards
Mentor and guide engineers on best practices for safe, reliable, and maintainable distributed systems

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
6+ years of experience in backend or platform engineering
Demonstrated hands-on expertise with:
State machine modeling and lifecycle management
Transactional state stores
Idempotent API and workflow design

In-depth understanding of:
Exactly-once or effectively once processing
Failure modes in distributed environments

Proficiency in one or more contemporary languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Go, Python)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools for productivity and code quality

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with outbox, transactional messaging, or event sourcing patterns
Familiarity with low-latency, high-throughput architectures
Operational experience in systems requiring strict auditability and correctness
Background in regulated or mission-critical domains

Success Indicators

State transitions are precise, deterministic, and resilient to retries
Side effects reliably occur exactly once, even during failures or replays
Systems recover gracefully from crashes and redeployments
AI-driven tooling decreases defect rates and expedites debugging
The state layer is trusted as the definitive source of truth across engineering teams

Why This Role is Critical

In contemporary automated platforms, correctness and reliability hinge on the integrity of state, not just requests. This role ensures that every state transition and side effect is executed once—and only once—providing a solid foundation for trust, reliability, compliance, and scalability throughout the system.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - NBA
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Software Engineer to design, implement, and operate mission-critical stateful services that form the backbone of real-time, automated decisioning and personalization platforms. These systems are responsible for maintaining authoritative state, orchestrating lifecycle transitions, and ensuring reliable downstream effects—often in high-concurrency, low-latency environments.

This position is ideal for engineers with a strong grasp of state machines, idempotency, distributed systems, and “exactly-once” execution semantics. You will also employ advanced AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools to drive correctness, velocity, resilience, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

State Machine Architecture & Implementation

Design, build, and maintain explicit state machines governing:
Lifecycle transitions (e.g., open → in progress → completed → suppressed)
Validation of permissible transitions
Time-based and event-driven changes

Ensure state machines are:
Clearly modeled and not hidden in code logic
Deterministic, reproducible, and auditable
Easily understood and testable
Robust against illegal or duplicate transitions through comprehensive validation

Transactional State Memory & Exactly-Once Processing

Architect and manage transactional state stores serving as the single source of truth
Support safe, high-concurrency read/write operations
Uphold system invariants across partial failures and recovery scenarios
Implement robust idempotency controls so:
Requests can be safely retried
Commands execute at most once
Duplicate events do not compromise state integrity

Develop APIs and workflows resilient to retries, restarts, and replay events

Reliable Side Effects via Outbox Pattern

Employ the outbox pattern to guarantee atomicity of state updates and event publication
Prevent loss or duplication of side effects
Maintain clear separation between state mutation and downstream event delivery
Facilitate replay, backfill, and recovery operations without breaching state guarantees
Integrate seamlessly with messaging and streaming platforms, ensuring fault tolerance

Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management

Design for correctness under concurrent updates, network partitions, partial failures, and service redeployments
Apply expertise in:
Idempotency keys
Optimistic and pessimistic locking strategies
Event ordering and causality

Balance rigorous correctness with performance and latency requirements

AI-Assisted & Agentic Engineering Practices

Leverage AI-powered and agentic tools to:
Automatically generate and validate state transition tests
Probe edge cases and concurrency challenges
Assist in code reviews, refactoring, and documentation
Accelerate debugging, incident analysis, and root cause discovery

Use AI responsibly to enhance productivity while maintaining clarity and system integrity

Observability, Auditability & Trust

Engineer services with robust observability through:
Structured logging, metrics, and alerting
Distributed tracing

Ensure all state transitions and emitted events are:
Fully traceable and reproducible
Auditable for compliance and investigative needs

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

Partner with platform, data, and quality engineering teams to assure end-to-end reliability
Participate in architecture and design reviews to elevate system quality standards
Mentor and guide engineers on best practices for safe, reliable, and maintainable distributed systems

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
6+ years of experience in backend or platform engineering
Demonstrated hands-on expertise with:
State machine modeling and lifecycle management
Transactional state stores
Idempotent API and workflow design

In-depth understanding of:
Exactly-once or effectively once processing
Failure modes in distributed environments

Proficiency in one or more contemporary languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Go, Python)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools for productivity and code quality

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with outbox, transactional messaging, or event sourcing patterns
Familiarity with low-latency, high-throughput architectures
Operational experience in systems requiring strict auditability and correctness
Background in regulated or mission-critical domains

Success Indicators

State transitions are precise, deterministic, and resilient to retries
Side effects reliably occur exactly once, even during failures or replays
Systems recover gracefully from crashes and redeployments
AI-driven tooling decreases defect rates and expedites debugging
The state layer is trusted as the definitive source of truth across engineering teams

Why This Role is Critical

In contemporary automated platforms, correctness and reliability hinge on the integrity of state, not just requests. This role ensures that every state transition and side effect is executed once—and only once—providing a solid foundation for trust, reliability, compliance, and scalability throughout the system.

Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products.

As a Senior Lead Software Engineer- Platform / Linux Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Corporate Sector- Infrastructure Platforms, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.

As a Senior Platform Engineer within Electronic Trading Services Platforms, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and tuning the Linux-based compute and infrastructure platforms that power our low-latency electronic trading businesses. This is a deeply technical, engineering-first role: you will write code and automation, design new systems, architect novel deployment models, and drive latency out of the stack at the hardware, kernel, and network layers. You will also harness modern Agentic AI tooling to accelerate delivery and multiply your impact.

You will work directly with the Electronic Trading Lines of Business to align technical strategy with business goals, solve complex compute and performance-engineering challenges, and mentor partner technical teams. You will serve as an expert, hands-on advisor to peers, leadership, and stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

Design, build, and operate high-performance Linux platforms for low-latency electronic trading, engineering from the hardware and kernel level up
Architect new system designs and next-generation deployment models — including immutable infrastructure, containerization, and automated provisioning pipelines
Perform deep performance engineering and latency optimization: kernel tuning, CPU isolation/pinning, NUMA awareness, IRQ affinity, kernel-bypass networking, and precision time synchronization
Write production-quality code and automation to build tooling, eliminate manual toil, and improve platform reliability and speed
Leverage Agentic AI tools and workflows to accelerate engineering tasks, automate research and remediation, and deliver against goals faster
Drive adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain

Make decisions that influence teams' resources, budget, tactical operations, and the execution of processes and procedures
Carry governance accountability for engineering decisions, control obligations, and measures of success such as cost of ownership, maintainability, and portfolio operations
Deliver reusable technical solutions that can be leveraged across multiple businesses and domains and mentor and influence SRE, peer engineers, and senior stakeholders across business, product, and technology teams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Strong programming skills with the ability to build production-grade tooling and automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash)
Deep, hands-on Linux engineering expertise — administration, internals, performance tuning, and benchmarking, in areas such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux and proven experience engineering for low-latency, high-throughput environments (kernel tuning, CPU/NUMA optimization, precision timing)

Solid understanding of IPv4 networking, including the OSI model, unicast/broadcast/multicast, routing, and network segregation mechanisms
Experience designing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and practical cloud-native and container/orchestration experience (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience leading cross-functional teams of technologists, and hiring, developing, and recognizing talent

Familiarity with observability and telemetry stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and understanding of standard cryptography (certificates, key pairs, secure communication, etc.)

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Forward Deployed Software Engineer - TS/SCI Cleared
jobs.description:
About The Company

America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our IP, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life runs on. They’ve learned—correctly—that those attacks rarely produce consequences.

Twenty was founded to change that, by making our adversaries think twice before they attack us. Our vision is American and allied primacy in cyberspace—a future where they cannot contest us, deterrence is assured, and the free world remains secure.

Founded in 2024, Twenty Technologies (www.twenty.io) industrializes offensive cyber operations for the U.S. and its allies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty has raised $168M from Khosla Ventures, Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends & Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In-Q-Tel.

Mission | On Site
| Full Time | Active TS/SCI with Full Scope Polygraph
OR Active TS/SCI with CI Polygraph

Role Summary

You'll be on the ground at a government customer site, serving as a generalist engineering presence for Twenty's mission-critical platform in a restricted, air-gapped environment. Twenty builds software for cyber operations, and the applications you'll extend and operate are used by operators and analysts working against hard national security problems.

This is the broadest engineering role at Twenty. In a given month you might build a customer-specific feature, integrate a new data source, get an extension through the customer's deployment process, chase down a production failure, tune the monitoring that would have caught it sooner, and prototype an AI-backed capability with support from Arlington. You won't be an expert in all of it, and the role isn't designed to require that. For specialist work like data engineering and AI engineering, you'll deliver with guidance from the Arlington engineers who specialize in it. What the role does require is range: the ability to pick up an unfamiliar part of the system, get productive quickly, and produce work that holds up in production.

The office-based team can't access this environment, so you are the engineering presence where the software actually runs. Problems reach you first, and the judgment calls are yours: what's wrong, what's urgent, and what Arlington needs to know. When customer work is quiet, you'll build features for Twenty's core product applications, carrying what you learned in the field directly into the product.

You'll report directly to the VP of Engineering. You'll be part of a small forward deployed team, working closely with other on-site colleagues, the Arlington-based product engineering and DevSecOps teams, and the customer's own technical staff.

If you're a strong generalist who wants your work in the hands of operators the same day you build it, and you'd rather own a production system end to end than ship features into a backlog, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Customer-Specific Features & Extensions

Design and build features, extensions, and integrations that adapt Twenty's applications to this customer's mission, workflows, and environment.
Work directly with customer users and technical staff to understand what they actually need, then scope and deliver it, making pragmatic trade-offs between speed, robustness, and what the environment allows.
Write code that is testable, debuggable, and maintainable by engineers who can't access the environment in which it runs. Tests carry unusual weight here: they're how Arlington trusts a change they'll never see run.
Write code that meets the security standards of classified environments: no hardcoded secrets, disciplined credential handling, and audit-ready practices throughout, so your work moves through the customer's approval process without friction.

Data Integration & AI-Backed Capabilities

Build software extensions that retrieve, parse, transform, and load new data sources into Twenty's applications, working with forward deployed data engineers where present and Arlington data engineers where not.
Investigate unfamiliar source systems and data formats, working with customer stakeholders to understand semantics, access patterns, and constraints before writing code.
Extend and field-test AI-backed capabilities in Twenty's applications with guidance from Arlington AI engineers, and report back what actually works against real data and real users.

Deployment & Site Reliability

Work with the customer's deployment team to get software approved, deployed, and running in the high-side environment, and execute deployments and updates in coordination with Arlington engineering.
Monitor the health of the platform and its data flows on-site using the LGTM stack (Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir); identify anomalies and degradations before they become incidents. In an air-gapped environment, efficiency compounds.
Diagnose and resolve production issues where they happen, escalating to Arlington with a clear picture of what you found, not just what triggered the alert.
Drive root cause analysis and post-incident reviews in partnership with the Arlington engineering team, and turn findings into runbooks, fixes, or upstream design changes.
Participate in on-call rotation using PagerDuty, with clear escalation paths to the engineering team. The environment is air-gapped, so off-hours incident response may require returning to the customer facility rather than remoting in.

Product Engineering

When customer-driven work is quiet, build feature capabilities for Twenty's core product applications alongside the Arlington product engineering teams.
Surface patterns from the field that should become platform capabilities, and advocate for them with the product engineering team. What you generalize from one customer makes every deployment after it faster.

Customer & Team Liaison

Serve as a consistent engineering presence for the government customer: professional, reliable, and clear under pressure.
Relay operational observations, capability gaps, and customer feedback to the Arlington team accurately and promptly.
Work alongside other forward deployed engineers and analysts, sharing context and coverage across the on-site team.

Who You Are

You independently identify the right solution to ambiguous, open-ended problems. Problems reach you before they're fully defined, and the environment's constraints are discovered, not documented; you investigate, form a design, and deliver without waiting for a spec.
You have real range. You've shipped across more of the stack than your title suggests, and you get productive in unfamiliar systems quickly. You'd rather be effective at many things than perfect at one.
You know the difference between what you can do alone and what you should do with help, and you actively use Arlington specialists as a resource without being dependent on them for every decision.
You respond with urgency to operational issues and own resolution within your sphere. You're unafraid to call an incident when the signal warrants it.
You proactively create and update runbooks and documentation for the components you own. In an environment the rest of the team can't access, what you write down is what they know.
You understand the customer and the mission well enough to know which work has the greatest impact, and you redirect your focus when what you're doing isn't moving the needle.
You tailor your communication to your audience, whether that's a product engineer in Arlington, a DevSecOps teammate, or a non-technical customer stakeholder, and you proactively share information so the right people stay informed and aligned.
You're comfortable operating in secure environments where tooling is limited, internet access is not a given, and the stakes are real.

Must Have

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial time owning services or applications running in production.
Strong generalist programming ability in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, writing code that remote teammates can review, extend, and trust.
Experience building and shipping backend services or full-stack features end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operation.
Experience debugging production systems: reading logs, tracing failures across components, and root-causing issues under time pressure.
Working operational fluency: Linux command line, containerized environments (Docker, Docker Compose), and enough observability tooling skill to monitor and operate what you ship.
Demonstrated range: you've delivered production work outside your core specialty, such as data pipelines, integrations, infrastructure, or ML-backed features, and you're comfortable doing so with support from specialists.
Experience in a forward deployed, field engineering, or embedded customer-facing engineering role, including deploying and operating software in air-gapped, classified, or otherwise restricted environments, with demonstrated ability to work independently and sound judgment about when to decide and when to escalate.
Ability to work on-site full-time at a government facility in Northern Virginia, with travel to Arlington, VA (typically 4 days per month).

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines or data integrations (example technologies: Airflow, NiFi, AWS Glue, or equivalent custom pipeline development), and solid SQL and schema design skills.
Experience building LLM-backed application features or operating AI/ML systems in production.
Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar).
Experience with streaming and message queue technologies (example technologies: Kafka, NATS, Kinesis, RabbitMQ).
Background in a military, intelligence, or defense contracting environment.

Tech Environment (You Might Work With)

Cloud: AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, CloudWatch) in closed enclave environments
Containers: Docker, Docker Compose
Observability: Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir (LGTM stack)
Alerting / on-call: PagerDuty
Messaging: NATS
Databases: PostgreSQL
Data integration: Twenty's purpose-built data platform and integration layer (in active development)
Languages in use across engineering: Go, TypeScript, Python

Security / Work Environment

This role requires an active security clearance
. Work is performed on-site at a government facility, with travel to Twenty's Arlington, VA office typically 4 days per month. Access to systems is restricted and tooling constraints apply.

Benefits

What's on the table:

Health. Medical, dental, and vision plan options. Life / AD&D, disability coverage options.
Family. Paid parental leave for eligible full-time employees. 12 weeks for birthing parents, 4 for non-birthing parents, 6 weeks for adoptive, foster, or intended parents through surrogacy.
Vacation. Paid holidays and flexible PTO. Take what you need.
Retirement. 401(k) with pre-tax and Roth options. HSA/FSA options, dependent care FSA.

Benefits vary by location, role, and eligibility. Full plan details provided during the interview and offer process.

If this role sounds like you, apply and share with us your interest

Due to U.S. government contract and security requirements, this role is limited to U.S. citizens
. Some positions may also require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. Any active clearance requirement will be listed in the role description
.

Twenty is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status, consistent with applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we will work with you.

Compensation Range: $192K - $455K

Burns Engineering provides professional engineering design and project management services for transportation, facilities, and infrastructure projects. We help our clients attain their strategic goals and initiatives through successful large-scale infrastructure projects. Burns’ full-service capabilities include mechanical, electrical, civil, structural, transportation, and energy consulting engineering.

We are industry experts, proven leaders, innovative thinkers, and team players. We put our clients’ successes and best interests first, because their success is our success. We have fun at work because we love making a difference in the world. We are looking for high-energy, bright, collaborative individuals who want the opportunity to “write their own story” with us.

Burns is currently seeking a licensed Senior Electrical Engineer
to join our Railroad & Transit
team in Washington, D.C.

Provides supervision and guidance related largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts and policy matters. Develops solutions for larger and highly complex engineering projects. Develops innovative technical solutions and engineering methods to enhance efficiency, quality and production
Make and/or supervise the scoping, implementation and design of plans.

Professionally Licensed Engineer with a Bachelor's (B.S.) Engineering degree and at least 10 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum of 6 years of electrical design experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Professional Engineering License is required at this level.

Preferred Qualifications

Progressive engineering experience working on tasks of high complexity on projects of various scales.
Experience producing Electrical Engineering deliverables, including design drawings, specifications, basis of design reports, calculations, and site assessment reports.
Proficient in performing Electrical Studies and Calculations (short circuit, selective coordination, arc flash, Load flow, Voltage Drop, C Photometric lighting, Ground Grid, etc.)
Proficient knowledge in the use of industry standard engineering software and tools such as AutoCAD or Revit, and other specialized design software as required.

Knowledgeable in various industry codes and standards, including NEC, NESC, ANSI, and IEEE.
