At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedom and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

  

The Raytheon Electronic Warfare \- Electrical and Electronics Engineering team in Goleta, California has an immediate opening for a Senior Principal Electrical Engineer to design and develop Electronic Warfare (EW) electronics products for defense applications.  



  

**What You Will Do**

* Lead the design and development of airborne electronic products while meeting attendant size, weight, power, reliability, and cost requirements.
* Communicate with executive leadership regarding matters of significant importance to the organization. May conduct briefings with senior leaders.
* Strive to succeed in an environment where problems and issues faced are numerous and typically undefined where information is difficult to obtain.
* Work in an environment with a broad range of mixed\-signal circuits including but not limited to Power, Analog, Digital, FPGA, SoC and SubSystems.
* Support radar Warning Receivers (RWR) and other Electronic Warfare (EW) products requiring working familiarity with Radio Frequency (RF) circuitry and system interfaces.
* Support multiple programs concurrently and will be responsible for generating requirements documentation, design artifacts, verification and test plans, trade studies, failure root cause and corrective actions, presentations, and other documentation.
* Utilize technical leadership as part of a cross\-disciplinary product development team collaborating with electrical, mechanical, and systems engineers.
* Participate in the creation of proposals for both Cost and Technical Volumes.
* Occasional business travel may be required.

 **Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience or an advanced degree in a related field and minimum 7 years’ experience.
* Experience with modern electronic system design, including high\-performance FPGAs, Flash and DDR memory interfaces, Analog\-to\-Digital (A/D) and Digital\-to\-Analog (D/A) conversion, DC/DC and AC/DC power conversion, and overall mixed\-signal circuit analysis.


Experience with all the following and deep knowledge in at least one of the following:

* Schematic capture, PCB layout support, signal integrity analysis, and validation of FPGA\-based digital and mixed\-signal systems, including power conversion and power delivery network design.
* Electronic design and simulation tools such as Mentor Xpedition (or equivalent schematic/layout platforms), SPICE\-based simulators, MATLAB, and HyperLynx SI for high\-speed signal integrity analysis.
* Experience developing system\-level block diagrams and defining hardware architectures, including creation and management of detailed bills of materials (BOMs) for complex electronic assemblies.

 **Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience designing FPGA\-based circuitry and JTAG programming of FPGA devices.
* Electrical design and analysis with Mentor Graphics XPedition and HyperLynx SI, SPICE.
* Experience with design of CCAs with FPGAs, flash memory, DDR RAM, ADCs, DACs, power conversion integrated circuits, and supporting analog circuits.
* Experience with RF components or specifications and creating POL supplies for RF circuitry.
* Experience with mentoring others.

 **What We Offer**

* A total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, and work/life benefits; career development and recognition programs. Some of the benefits we offer include parental (including paternal) leave, flexible work schedules, achievement awards, educational assistance and child/adult backup care.
* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, Innovation, and Safety.
* Relocation assistance available.

 **Learn More \& Apply Now!**

* Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Data Center, Colocation Regional Engineering - AMER
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Application deadline: Sep 30, 2026  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you an engineer with a passion for data center design and looking for a challenge to chart your own course? If so, we are looking for you to help us make history.  

  

AWS data centers are the foundation upon which our software and services operates to meet the growing demands of our customers. This role provides the opportunity to collaborate with business development, design engineers, data center operations professionals, external vendors and consultants, and other cross\-functional teams to assess and select colocation facilities that meet our business requirements.  

  

You will be able to showcase your in\-depth understanding of data center design, engineering, and operations of infrastructure common to data centers, telecommunications facilities and other critical environment infrastructure.  

  

You will work directly with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability.  

  

You will have opportunities to influence standards for data center products, build and improve processes, and to guide the direction of our colocation data center portfolio on a global scale. So, if you are a strong leader with solid data center mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural (MEPS) infrastructure design engineering experience, Amazon will present a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment that is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional rewarding opportunity for you.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers and telecommunications facilities within the region.
* Reviews vendor critical infrastructure designs and perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit\-for\-use/fit\-for\-service for AWS cloud compute and networking services.
* Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad\-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design\-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
* Lead, Review, and approve designs for existing co\-location (colo) data center upgrades which improve availability/efficiency.
* Interface with internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering site audits within Amazon’s owned or colo data centers.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  

A day in the life  

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.  

  

Colo Regional Engineers:  

* Possess strong engineering judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty.
* Are detail and data oriented.
* Manage engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders.
* Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. jobs.title: Research Software Engineer I - Laboratory of Dr. Talmo Pereira
jobs.description:
The Pereira Lab at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies is seeking a Research Software Engineer to build and maintain the software that turns computer vision models into biological discovery. The lab develops SLEAP, an open\-source deep learning framework for markerless pose estimation used by research groups worldwide, and operates the research software, analysis pipelines, and computing infrastructure that carry model outputs through to published science. Research Software Engineers often come from science themselves — computationally minded researchers who found that they most enjoyed building the tools, software, and infrastructure that make discovery possible. The role sits at the interface of research and software engineering, but it is grounded in the research side: unlike a conventional software engineer who builds to fixed product specifications, a Research Software Engineer works shoulder\-to\-shoulder with scientists to turn their evolving needs into working tools. It is an ideal early\-career role for someone who has done research and discovered that they love to code and build systems, and it can serve equally as the foundation of a long\-term research software engineering career in academia or industry.

  



The Research Software Engineer I will own the research software behind the Institute’s plant root phenotyping program: containerized, GPU\-accelerated pipelines that take raw images from automated scanners, run deep learning pose\-estimation models over them, extract quantitative traits, and deliver analysis\-ready results to collaborating laboratories. The role spans the full path that data travels: the desktop acquisition software running on the scanners, Bloom — the web application and database where images and results live — the open\-source Python packages that extract traits, and the deep learning models at the center of it. In practice this means maintaining full\-stack web and desktop applications, releasing Python packages under rigorous continuous integration, running and improving model training and inference, and working directly with plant biologists to turn their experimental questions into reproducible analyses. The Research Software Engineer I works alongside the SLEAP team that develops the underlying pose\-estimation framework, and contributes to those open\-source tools as part of the role. Including a link to a GitHub profile (or equivalent portfolio) with examples of previous programming work is strongly recommended for full consideration. We recognize that code written for previous employers is often proprietary and cannot be shared publicly, so this is not required; however, candidates who can point to non\-coursework repositories — such as personal projects or contributions to open\-source software will be highly preferred.


**Who We Are**



The Salk Institute is an internationally renowned research institution that values all (https://www.salk.edu/about/our\-community/) members of our scientific community. We seek bold and interactive leaders passionate about exploring new frontiers in science. Our collaborative community embraces perspectives across discipline, professional acumen, and unique life experiences, fostering innovation, and a sense of belonging. Together, we strive to improve the wellbeing of humanity through groundbreaking research.



Founded by Jonas Salk, developer of the first safe and effective polio vaccine, the Institute is an independent, nonprofit research organization and architectural landmark: small by choice, intimate by nature, and fearless in the face of any challenge. Salk's vibrant community has many talented individuals from varied backgrounds, each playing a crucial role in driving our mission forward. From visionary leaders (https://www.salk.edu/about/management\-team/) to dedicated administrators (https://www.salk.edu/administration/) and brilliant faculty members (https://www.salk.edu/science/directory/faculty/), the Institute is united by a shared passion for scientific exploration and innovation.


**What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be**


* Develop, maintain, and release open\-source scientific Python packages for pose\-estimation\-based phenotyping, following professional software engineering practices including version control (Git), code review, testing, type checking, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Maintain and extend Bloom, the lab’s web application and scientific database for plant phenotyping data, spanning backend services, the API, the web frontend, schema design, and deployment on self\-hosted infrastructure.
* Maintain and release Bloom Desktop, the Electron/React application used on the plate and cylinder scanners to acquire images and upload them to Bloom, including its integration with camera and data\-acquisition hardware.
* Stand up, deploy, and maintain self\-hosted systems and services on lab servers and cloud infrastructure, including database backup and restore, object storage, and TLS certificate management.
* Build, operate, and improve containerized, GPU\-accelerated analysis pipelines that carry raw imaging data through deep learning inference to quantitative trait outputs.
* Train, evaluate, and deploy deep learning pose\-estimation models, and maintain the datasets, configurations, and model registries that make training runs reproducible.
* Connect analysis pipelines to Bloom through well\-defined data contracts, provenance tracking, and write\-back of results to the database.
* Run analyses on experimental datasets for collaborating laboratories and deliver the results as documented, reproducible reports and figures.
* Support and make use of shared high\-performance computing resources, including GPU cluster scheduling and containerized job workflows (e.g., Kubernetes\-based schedulers, SLURM).
* Rapidly prototype, build, and iterate on internal applications, command\-line tools, and utilities in response to evolving scientific needs.
* I

We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


The role is part of the In\-Space Systems business unit, which is focused on addressing two of the most compelling challenges in spaceflight today: space infrastructure and increasing mobility on\-orbit.
**Role Overview**

BNS Core Systems and Components is seeking a highly experienced Senior Controls Engineer to lead the architecture, development, integration, and qualification of spacecraft attitude\-control actuators and momentum\-management systems. This role will focus on Reaction Wheel Assemblies (RWAs), associated motor\-control electronics, embedded flight software, FPGA development, and control algorithms.


The ideal candidate brings 15\+ years of direct experience developing reaction wheel systems for aerospace applications, with deep technical expertise spanning controls modeling and implementation, electric motor drives, embedded systems, and hardware/software integration. This engineer will serve as a technical leader across the full product lifecycle, from concept development through flight qualification, production, and on\-orbit support.


**Responsibilities**

* Lead the system architecture, requirements development, design, implementation, integration, test, and qualification of reaction wheels and momentum\-control systems.
* Develop and mature control algorithms for reaction wheel applications, including speed, torque/current, momentum management, fault detection, and safe\-mode behaviors.
* Design motor\-control solutions for spacecraft actuators, including PMSM/BLDC motors, field\-oriented control, space\-vector PWM, commutation, current control, and speed\-control loops.
* Develop real\-time embedded control architectures, including functional decomposition, hardware selection, processor/FPGA partitioning, timing analysis, and software\-layer definition.
* Oversee FPGA design and implementation activities for motor\-control and actuator systems, including multi\-axis or time\-division multiplexed control architectures.
* Lead embedded flight software development, including bootloaders, scheduling, system management, mode control, command/telemetry interfaces, and health monitoring.
* Define and implement Fault Detection, Isolation, and Recovery (FDIR) strategies for actuator electronics and software.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

  


We are seeking a hands\-on Electrical / Electronics Engineering Technician to support the development, integration, testing, and operation of advanced uncrewed maritime systems.


This position will work closely with electrical, mechanical, software, and systems engineers to build, install, troubleshoot, test, and maintain electrical and electronic systems aboard uncrewed surface vessels (USVs), associated test platforms, and integrated payload systems.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working both at a lab bench and aboard a vessel, can build high\-quality electrical assemblies from engineering documentation, and is capable of systematically troubleshooting electrical and electronic systems in laboratory, dockside, and field environments.




**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Assemble, install, modify, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic systems used on uncrewed surface vessels.
* Support the electrical and physical integration of mission payloads, sensors, communications equipment, and other customer\- or program\-specific systems onto USV platforms.
* Assist engineering teams with payload power, communications, cabling, mounting, installation, checkout, and functional testing.
* Build cable and wire harness assemblies from schematics, wiring diagrams, cable drawings, and engineering instructions.
* Perform wire preparation, crimping, soldering, connector termination, labeling, routing, and harness installation.
* Install and integrate electrical enclosures, sensors, actuators, power distribution equipment, communications equipment, navigation equipment, and other vessel electronics.
* Support integration of DC power systems, including batteries, circuit protection, power distribution, DC/DC converters, relays, contactors, and associated wiring.
* Assist engineers with prototype assembly, system integration, design changes, hardware modifications, and rapid development efforts.
* Perform electrical troubleshooting using multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, current probes, CAN/network diagnostic tools, and other test equipment.
* Diagnose wiring faults, power issues, communication problems, intermittent connections, sensor issues, and component failures.
* Support integration and troubleshooting of CAN bus, NMEA 2000, Ethernet, serial, and other vessel and payload communication interfaces.
* Perform continuity, insulation, voltage, current, and functional testing of electrical assemblies and installed systems.
* Support dockside, on\-water, and field testing of USVs and integrated payloads.
* Document test results, discrepancies, repairs, modifications, and as\-built configurations.
* Maintain organized wiring, labeling, workmanship, and configuration control throughout prototype and production builds.
* Provide feedback to engineering regarding manufacturability, serviceability, installation, and recurring hardware issues.
* Assist with maintaining laboratory equipment, tools, components, cables, and electrical inventory.
* Follow established safety practices when working around batteries, energized electrical systems, machinery, vessels, and marine environments.

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in electrical/electronics assembly, integration, maintenance, manufacturing, field service, or a related technical environment.
* Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, pinout tables, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.
* Experience with wire harness fabrication, connector termination, crimping, and soldering.
* Comfortable using a digital multimeter and standard electrical/electronic test equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to systematically troubleshoot electrical and electronic systems.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to perform hands\-on installation and integration work.
* Ability to work independently from engineering drawings and instructions while effectively communicating questions, discrepancies, and technical issues.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to high\-quality workmanship.
* Ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, operators, and other team members in a fast\-paced development environment.
* Ability to successfully complete required employment and program\-related background screening.
* Must be eligible and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance if required by program or customer needs.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

* Marine electrical or marine electronics systems
* Payload integration or integration of customer\-furnished equipment
* Uncrewed vehicles, robotics, autonomous systems, or defense systems
* 12 VDC, 24 VDC, or 48 VDC power systems
* CAN bus, DroneCAN, or NMEA 2000
* Ethernet and serial communications
* GPS/GNSS, IMUs, navigation sensors, or autopilot systems
* RF, communications, cameras, or other mission payload systems
* Motors, motor controllers, actuators, pumps, or steering systems
* Battery systems and DC power distribution
* Environmental sealing and marine\-grade electrical installation practices
* Prototype development and low\-rate production
* PCB rework, modification, and component\-level troubleshooting

jobs.description:
AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations.  



  

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.  



  

AutoStore – moving things forward.  



  

  

**The Role:**

  

AutoStore is hiring a Senior Electronics Engineer who has carried new products to market. We are looking for an Engineer with experience taking a product from 0 \- 1, someone who has felt the consequences of their own design decisions at 10,000 units, not 10\. The successful engineer will have owned PCBAs through the messy parts: EMC chamber failures two weeks before certification, yield drops at the EMS partner, and the design trade\-offs required to recover without compromising long\-term reliability.  



  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

  

**PCBA Ownership – Concept Through to Serial Production Ready**

* Set hardware architecture, component strategy, and BOM cost/risk profile for assigned boards.
* Schematic design and layout; own signal integrity, power integrity, and thermal outcomes.
* Lead bring\-up and root\-cause analysis.
* Own EMC and safety compliance, from design\-for\-EMC through pre\-compliance and formal certification.
* Lead DFM/DFT/DFx with EMS partners; define production test strategy and coverage.
* Own NPI, pilot builds, and 0\-series.
* Partner with firmware on control discussions, implementation and fault handling.
Design robust technology with the noise immunity a moving robotic platform demands.  
* 

  

**System and Organizational Contribution**

* Contribute to electronics design standards, reusable building blocks, and design review practice in functional excellence groups.
* Assess how your designs could impact the wider AutoStore portfolio through a platform approach, and flag cross\-product benefits and drawbacks.
* Working within a cross\-functional NPD team and foster multidiscipline collaboration between functional disciplines.
Mentor to mid\-level and junior engineers; you review their designs and help raise the bar of the team, not just your own output.  
* 

  

**Key Qualifications:**

* Master's in Electronics or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in electronics engineering spanning analog, digital, and power electronics.
* How owned design for high\-volume manufacturing with global EMS suppliers.
* Dealt with sensor interface design and embedded communication bus design in electrically noisy, electromechanical environments.
* Experienced with CAN, SPE/Ethernet, I2C, RS\-485, etc.
* Architected and designed advanced motor driver PCBAs and power electronics.
* Experience designing embedded electronics and systems ranging from resource constrained microcontroller platforms to Linux based embedded systems.
* Dealt with safety and compliance issues around fault detection, safe state designs and diagnostics.
* Deep and practical EMC competence — design\-for\-EMC, not just test attendance.
* DFM \& DFT for high\-volume electromechanical products.
* Battery\-powered systems and system power budgeting.
Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction for others, reviewing designs, and mentoring.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

  

This onsite, entry\-level role located in Atlanta, GA

 **Job Summary:**

  

The Advanced Airborne RF Sensors department within the Space and Airborne Systems Engineering and Test Capability (SE\&TC) Center seeks talented Systems Engineers. Our team located in Atlanta, Georgia integrates hardware and software, develops test plans and procedures, debugs and evaluates system functions and interfaces, and verifies system requirements in support of final sell\-off to the customer. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab and in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. Every day is a different set of challenges to overcome. You'll be expected to collaborate across disciplines and partner to implement solutions. In this role, you'll get to know a little bit about every aspect of the system and have a direct hand in making it all work together supporting teams of engineers engaged in integration and test efforts.

  

You will support Electronic Warfare product development, engineering testing, integration and flight\-testing, production, system deployment, and post deployment support across the product lifecycle. Through Digital Transformation (DTx) you will perform these functions using a variety of methods and enabling technologies, including Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Agile product development.

  

This position is an onsite role in Atlanta, Georgia and Test event support activity may require travel which is not expected to exceed 20%.

 **What You Will Do:**

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to developing innovative solutions to technical challenges in signal processing design. Your responsibilities will involve assisting in the creation or modification of electronic warfare signal processing and control algorithms, as well as supporting the development and execution of test plans, simulations, and lab tests to verify system capabilities. You will help evaluate the functional performance of RF systems, including signal processing subsystems and firmware/control algorithms.


Additionally, you will assist in integration, verification, and troubleshooting activities in lab and field environments, utilizing test equipment to support root cause analyses and corrective actions. You will participate in preparing performance evaluations using tools like MATLAB, maintaining engineering specifications and drawings, and compiling findings for reports and briefings. Working alongside Engineering Integrated Product Team Leads (IPTLs), you will collaborate on team initiatives, attend meetings, and support the implementation of process requirements. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience and grow your skills in the field of systems engineering.

 **What You Will Learn:**

  

After completion of comprehensive on\-the\-job training, the candidate will be a part of a team supporting systems engineering, integration, and test activities across the product development lifecycle.

 **Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Physics or Computer Science (STEM preferred).
* Experience with tools, such as Microsoft Office, MATLAB or Python, for data analysis and automation
* Experience with troubleshooting technical issues with electronics in an academic or internship setting, including the use of common commercial test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, etc.)

  

Experience may be obtained through on\-the\-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

 **Qualifications We Prefer:**

* RF system design, digital and analog signal processing, waveform and signal modulation characteristics and analysis, and/or algorithm implementation and testing.
* Experience with electrical schematics, interface control documentation, and communications protocols
* Experience integrating software and firmware onto electronic hardware systems
* Experience with reading and integrating software routines with hardware/electronics; C/C\+\+/C\# preferred

 **What We Offer:**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation eligible

All About You:

The **Electrical Controls Engineer** will provide electrical and controls engineering to allow the organization to accomplish its objectives \& goals. Work within a team other skilled technicians and engineers to continuously improve and enable manufacturing systems to achieve production objectives. Spearhead innovative solutions and bring forth resources both internal and external to get projects completed on time and on budget. All work must be done in compliance with AS9100, EPD, OSHA, Local, State, and Federal standards, and regulations. Initiate and manage capital projects.

* BS degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or related discipline with supporting experience demonstrating electrical controls engineering competencies.
* Extensive industrial experience may be considered as an alternative to a bachelor's degree.
* 5\+ years' experience in writing PLC programs and design, repair, troubleshooting production equipment.
* Experience performing schematic design, analysis, and simulation.
* Must understand how to apply modern controls systems and robotics automation (I.e., PLC's, Personal Computers, Operator Interfaces) in a manufacturing environment.
* Troubleshooting / failure analysis ability and experience.
* Experience with Allen Bradley PLC Software/Hardware, Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems, Fanuc, Universal, and similar robotics. Knowledge of TPM, 5S, FMEA, RCM etc.
* Management of capital expenditure projects and cost justification methodology . Must be able to manage small to medium capital projects and direct technician level people.


Responsibilities:
* Design and implement reliable, efficient, user and maintenance friendly control systems to meet the requirements of production operations. The design must meet all OSHA general industry safety rules.
* Build and develop and maintain a comprehensive OEE database for all critical manufacturing equipment.
* Perform parts selection, analysis, simulation, and schematic capture for control and power electronics.
* Perform system integration including debugging and troubleshooting
* Assist in direction of maintenance technicians and ensure that they have the appropriate tools, skills, and training to be a world class maintenance organization.
* Fully document all projects and equipment as required to maintain in proper functioning condition.
* Plan for and manage capital and expense related projects. Ensure that all projects remain within allocated budgets.
* Maintain optimal equipment efficiency to stay within process specifications established by Quality and Industrial Engineering.


What We Offer:

Whether you are just getting started or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package to include generous compensation based on market standards, healthcare, wellness, adoption assistance, discounted stock purchase, career development and recognition programs. Some of our superior benefits include parental (maternal and paternal) leave, 401K retirement contribution match at 7%, educational assistance (tuition reimbursement), Short\-term Disability (STD), paid holidays, paid vacation, and paid employee referral award.  

We appreciate diverse skills/experience and yours could add immense value to our team. Our customers have varied backgrounds and so do our employees. Our batteries and battery systems make a different in every market sector they serve.  

Established in 19 countries and supported by our 16 production sites, Saft has more than 4,300 employees around the world and more than 3,000 customers across a range of industries.  

Since 2016, Saft is a wholly owned subsidiary of TotalEnergies, a global integrated energy company that produces and markets various forms of energy, including oil, biofuels, natural gas, green gases, renewables, and electricity. jobs.title: Senior Linux Software Engineer (US Citizenship Required)
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**


Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.


We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

  



**Job Description**

  



***\*\* US Citizenship is required for this position. We are unable to hire Green Card Holders, individuals who need a work visa, are currently on a work visa, or individuals who will require work visa sponsorship in the future. \*\****

 **Job Summary**


The Sr. Linux Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain applications and embedded software for advanced analytical instrumentation systems. This role spans the full software development lifecycle and requires expertise in Linux\-based embedded systems, application development, instrument control, and software architecture for complex scientific products.

 **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and embedded systems throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Develop software solutions ranging from instrument control and user interfaces to data processing and analytical algorithms.
* Implement innovative user interfaces, data analysis capabilities, and instrument troubleshooting and debugging
* Support new product development and sustain existing products through troubleshooting, enhancements, and defect resolution.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, scientific, project management, and manufacturing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Participate in software design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field strongly preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* 8\+ years of software development experience.
* Hands\-on experience with embedded Linux development, including Linux system configuration, Bash scripting, Yocto/BitBake, Linux kernel and driver development, device trees, U\-Boot, software package management, and deployment/update frameworks such as SWUpdate.
* Strong proficiency in C\#, .NET, and object\-oriented software design.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices.
* Experience developing software for embedded systems and distributed architectures.
* Strong understanding of multi\-threaded programming, debugging, and software security principles.
* Programming experience in C and C\+\+; Rust experience is a plus.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, if required.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Blazor, WebSockets, and GraphQL.
* Experience with Docker or other containerization technologies.
* Experience with instrumentation control, scientific instruments, or mass spectrometry systems.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Familiarity with electro\-mechanical systems and hardware integration.
* Experience using Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) in a development environment.

  

Applicants must be either a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, legal permanent resident, asylee, refugee or must be eligible to apply for and obtain the appropriate export control license from the U.S. Departments of State or Commerce.

You will play a critical role in designing, developing, and implementing cutting\-edge signal processing algorithms on FPGA and ASIC platforms. Your work will contribute to the development of advanced aerospace and defense systems, leveraging your expertise in Simulink modeling, algorithm development, and implementation on FPGAs and ASICs.

* Stay updated on the latest advancements in FPGA technologies and signal processing methodologies to ensure RTX remains at the forefront of innovation.

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience.

* U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
* A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in signal processing, FPGA/ASIC development, or related areas.
* Expertise in Simulink and/or MATLAB for modeling and simulation of DSP systems.
* Proficient in VHDL/Verilog for FPGA/ASIC design and implementation.
* Demonstrated experience with algorithm development for signal processing applications such as filtering, modulation, demodulation, and spectral analysis.
* Familiarity with FPGA platforms such as AMD (Xilinx), Intel (Altera), or others, and associated toolchains (e.g., Vivado, Quartus).
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for FPGA/ASIC and DSP systems.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience with high\-speed digital interfaces and protocols (e.g., DDR, PCIe, Ethernet).
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work in a collaborative environment.

* Develop innovative solutions

Continuously improve quality, cost, responsiveness \& safety

Availability to work assigned off\-shifts, including afternoon and/or night shifts.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer/Administrator - TS/SCI w/ Poly
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!  



At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.  



**Job Description:**


Are you ready to apply your Systems Engineering \& Administration expertise to a mission that matters? Parsons is seeking a highly motivated Systems Engineer / Administrator to support a critical customer mission while working alongside experts in iOS development, vulnerability research, reverse engineering, and related technical disciplines.

  

  

This is an opportunity to join an integrated customer\-site team, contribute to prototype development, and help deliver innovative capabilities in support of national security. You will collaborate with experienced subject matter experts, expand your technical skills, and use your creativity to solve complex infrastructure challenges.

  

  

Your work will span systems administration, network engineering, infrastructure design, prototype development, hardware repair, and information systems security. You will help develop, implement, maintain, and improve the systems and capabilities that support our customer’s mission.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Consult and coordinate with external organizations to resolve network, system, server, development, and test infrastructure issues.
* Identify and select IT products, tools, services, and infrastructure components for development and testing environments.
* Design and evaluate architectures, procedures, and technical solutions for complex infrastructure challenges.
* Develop, contribute to, and evaluate technical proposals for changes to CITE facility networks.
* Install, configure, customize, test, and maintain hardware and software components within development and test infrastructure.
* Manage, monitor, and control network systems, including UPS networks.
* Troubleshoot networks, computer systems, servers, and peripheral devices to isolate and resolve failures.
* Conduct site surveys and support IT installation planning.
* Validate testing and quality assurance activities for development and test infrastructure systems.
* Analyze infrastructure problems and determine effective technical solutions.
* Research and evaluate emerging products, technologies, and architectures to address design, development, and testing requirements.
* Perform high\-level system design and define system and component performance, interface, and integration requirements.
* Translate conceptual designs into detailed technical specifications.
* Install, test, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, configure, and improve development and test infrastructure equipment.
* Provide full life\-cycle support for hardware, software, firmware, and configuration upgrades or modifications.
* Perform hardware repair and modification, including:
	+ Micro\-soldering component replacements
	+ Trace repair
	+ System and device restoration
	+ Hardware modifications supporting reverse engineering efforts
* Maintain systems inventories, non\-attributable systems matrices, and rack, elevation, and room drawings.
* Implement and follow applicable safety and security protocols.
* Provide occasional after\-hours pager support.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**


* **10\+ years of IT experience**, including Windows and Linux network administration, and a bachelor’s degree; or **15\+ years of relevant experience** in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
* Experience configuring, managing, and sustaining development and test network infrastructure and computer systems.
* Strong understanding of software, hardware, and network architecture and topology, including WAN, CAN, and LAN environments.
* Knowledge of telecommunications systems, components, protocols, standards, switching, routing, and transmission systems.
* Understanding of network architecture theory, design, implementation, and security.
* Experience designing, developing, evaluating, testing, and securing development and test infrastructure networks.
* Expertise in network connectivity concepts, including routing, switching, and IP addressing.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining applications within an IT environment.
* Experience designing, implementing, and operating telecommunications systems.
* Familiarity with security hardware and software, including encryption, firewalls, antivirus solutions, and intrusion detection and prevention systems.
* Understanding of computer security concepts, principles, and best practices.
* Experience implementing, configuring, and sustaining computer and network security solutions.
* Experience planning, coordinating, and administering the installation, testing, operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of hardware and software systems.
* Knowledge of configuration management principles and practices, including planning, documenting, modifying, and integrating systems.
* Awareness of new and emerging technologies, tools, and trends applicable to mobile and RF development and test infrastructure.

Are you passionate about developing, integrating, and testing large and complex weapon systems?
Are you skilled at working with large, dynamic teams, problem solving, and focusing on technical detail?
Are you eager to make critical contributions to a secure, sea‑based capability that guarantees our nation’s safety and security now and into the future?  

If so, then we want you on our team!  

We are seeking a Mechanical‑Systems Engineer to join the Launcher Systems Engineering section. You will work with a multidisciplinary team that supports our sponsors in developing advanced analysis methods for deployed systems, modernizing existing Navy hardware, and integrating new weapon systems onto Navy platforms. In addition, you will lead the creation of next‑generation systems and drive the transition from traditional Systems Engineering to Digital Engineering.  

As a Mechanical\-Systems Engineer, you will:* Gain a deep technical understanding of submarine launcher systems and other shipboard systems.
* Support system concept development, including traditional Systems Engineering tasks such as Requirements, Functional, and Physical Architecture development for complex systems.
* Engage directly with our Navy sponsor and associated prime and subcontractors to provide oversight of hardware design and production efforts for future weapon systems and Navy platforms.
* Participate in a wide variety of test and evaluation efforts, including full scale system tests conducted at government owned test facilities or onboard Navy platforms.
* Engage with multiple working groups across both government and industry.


  

**Qualifications** **You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...*** Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.
* Have 3\+ years of relevant experience with Navy systems, particularly focused on product lifecycle management, hardware production, or Systems Engineering.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test, Humanoid Robotics
jobs.description:
Boston Dynamics seeks a highly technical **Software Engineer in Test** , to test the Atlas Humanoid Robot. In this critical, hands\-on role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of Atlas’s software systems, focusing heavily on metrics based system testing for reliability and performance.  



  

A key quality to be successful in this role is the exceptional ability to context\-switch and rapidly acquire technical understanding across diverse domains: from web interfaces and network protocols to robot behavior and ML model validation. If you thrive on learning fast, solving cross\-functional problems, and seeing your code directly impact a groundbreaking robot, this role is for you.  



  

Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe\-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.  



  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* **Test \& Automation Design:** Design, develop, and maintain the comprehensive manual and automated overall regression test suite, focusing on integration stability. You will focus heavily on validating our teleoperation systems and action sequencing applications.
* **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) Testing:** Perform automated testing with physical hardware in the loop, executing actual sequencing setups, physical interventions, and real\-time robotic test runs.
* **XR Applications Testing:** Drive the end\-to\-end quality of virtual environments by designing both automated and manual testing strategies for VR and Unity\-based applications used in robot simulation and operator teleoperation.
* **Release Contribution \& Reporting:** Contribute to generating detailed Test Execution Reports for major milestones and releases, clearly documenting coverage and communicating quality status to the manager and development teams.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify bottlenecks and gaps in the SQA process and testing coverage, driving continuous improvement in execution efficiency and reliability.

**Required Experience:**

  

* 3–4 years of experience in Software QA Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Development, with a history of shipping and supporting product releases.
* Hands\-on experience with **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) manual testing** , including physical test setup manipulation and live sequencing execution on robotics, automotive, or embedded systems.
* Strong proficiency in test automation with a solid base in Python, C\#, or a similar language. Direct experience automating **HTTP and WebSocket (WS) APIs** is required.
* Demonstrated experience testing **LLM / VLM systems** , including evaluating model responses via manual prompting, API layers, and setting up quality assessment metrics.
* Experience executing both automated and manual test strategies for **VR and Unity\-based applications** , simulation software, or interactive 3D environments.
* Expertise in designing comprehensive test plans and executing functional, integration, and regression testing with strong manual rigor.
* Expertise in Defect Lifecycle Management using defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira) for precise defect reporting, verification, and analysis.
Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and experience integrating and monitoring automated tests within continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).  
* 

  

**Nice to Have Experience:**

  

* Experience testing real\-time control systems or low\-latency teleoperation hardware/software.
* Familiarity with UI/UX and backend validation for complex workflow sequencing or orchestration applications.
* Operational familiarity with a Linux development environment (e.g., advanced bash/shell scripting).
Experience with Root Cause Analysis on complex, cross\-functional system failures.  
* 

  

*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*

  

*The salary range for this position will be clearly stated in the job posting as required by Massachusetts law. The base pay range for this position is between $88,,000 \- $110,000\. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting.*

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------



Anduril Cyber is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of capabilities to enable offensive cyber missions. Cyber is a new business line at Anduril, and relies upon our fleet of autonomous vehicles, the Lattice operating system, mesh networks, and other hardware products to engage in cyber operations at the edge. We design and build novel solutions to deploy cyber capabilities in unconventional or difficult to reach environments.  

  

The new Lattice for Cyber team will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that allow our Cyber products to operate reliably at scale. This is a founding team working from an unusually blank sheet of paper.

-----------------



As a Software Engineer in Lattice for Cyber, you will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that our offensive Cyber programs rely on. You will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way.  

  

**Above all, Anduril engineers on this team are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset — executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes on\-time and with high quality. Not only will you build the software, you'll have the opportunity to work with the customer's to deploy it.**


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------


* Work with design teams and cyber subject matter experts to build a brand new UX product that enables US and allied nations to perform offensive cyber missions at scale.
* Design and build an extensible React\-based component system as a foundation for other cyber teams to build upon for their customer's use cases and integrations.
* Build the UX that powers our offensive cyber products such as command and control, autonomous cyber behavior trees, SIGINT analysis tools, and data exfiltration pipelines.

* Ability to debug across the full stack, including logs, networking, interfaces, configuration, and hardware/software boundaries.
* Practical experience with Linux and containerized deployment.
* Comfort collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams and translating ambiguous requirements into clean user experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reviews and architecture discussions.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Washington, DC or the Orange County, CA metro areas.
* Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time support program teams and customer events.
* **US security clearance eligible**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------


* Exposure to AI/LLM integration patterns, inference workflows, tool orchestration, or model\-assisted application features.
* Track record of technical leadership, productization work, or direct customer interface in complex engineering environments.
* Prior work delivering into air\-gapped or otherwise constrained deployment environments.
* Hands\-on offensive or defensive cyber background.
* An active U.S. Security clearance.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary** :


The Senior Software Engineer contributes to the design, development, and ongoing support of custom software systems that power Little Caesars and affiliated companies. This role participates across the full software development lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, and production support. The position supports the growth of team capability by providing guidance, mentorship, and day\-to\-day support to less experienced engineers, and may contribute to initiatives across LCE and other Ilitch organizations.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Delivery \& Development**  

Contributes to the delivery of technical projects from design through production support, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and methodologies. Owns the development of large system components and leads the delivery of small projects, while contributing to complex initiatives in collaboration with other team leaders. Produces high‑quality code that is flexible, reusable, and maintainable, and actively participates in build, release, and pipeline automation processes.
* **Software Design \& Problem Solving**  

Designs and develop software solutions by breaking down business problems into scalable, interacting components. Effectively navigates and debugs large, complex codebases, identifies appropriate solutions for ambiguous scenarios, and exercises sound judgment in refactoring decisions. Contributes to system architecture and design discussions, leads research and proof‑of‑concept efforts, and evaluates new technologies to inform engineering direction.
* **Quality \& Testing**  

Ensures code quality and system reliability through the development and maintenance of unit tests and by supporting integration and automated testing efforts in partnership with QA. Promotes engineering excellence through code reviews and adherence to testing best practices.
* **Agile Practices \& Collaboration**  

Actively participates in Agile processes, including sprint planning, estimation, reviews, and demos, and helps drive the creation of clear, actionable technical user stories. Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to identify dependencies, align on delivery, and ensure successful project outcomes.
* **Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing**  

Serves as a senior technical resource by mentoring junior engineers, providing hands‑on guidance through pairing and coaching, and supporting onboarding efforts. Acts as a subject matter expert in key technical areas, promotes best practices, and contributes to knowledge sharing across the team, including supporting intern development.
* **Support \& Continuous Improvement**  

Provides ongoing support for production systems, including participation in an on‑call rotation, and leads root cause analysis and resolution of system issues. Proactively identifies opportunities for system, process, and tooling improvements, maintains support documentation, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance team effectiveness and system performance.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or related field. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a formal education.
* Minimum five (5\) years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting software solutions in a professional environment, using one or more of the following technologies:
* Application development across web, mobile, or service\-based architectures (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, .NET, Java, Python)
* API driven and distributed systems, including RESTful services and microservices
* Data storage technologies, such as relational, NoSQL, or unstructured data stores
* Cloud platforms or hosting environments, such as Azure, AWS, or equivalent
* Platform specific or systems development, such as mobile or embedded environments

**Working Conditions:**

This position may include on\-call responsibilities and occasional work during nights, weekends, or holidays. Work is typically performed in a standard office or remote environment, with some travel to restaurant locations or industry events as needed, in accordance with company travel policies.


**Competencies:**

The following competencies reflect the nature of the role and the environment in which it operates, rather than prescriptive minimum qualifications:


* **Hands\-On Technical Delivery**  

The role centers on individual contributions to complex, well\-scoped software development efforts, with a focus on quality and long\-term sustainable solutions.
* **Independent Problem Solving**  

The role requires identifying and delivering solutions to ambiguous or open\-ended technical problems with limited supervision.
* **Growth Mindset**  

The role requires a self\-motivated, curious, and creative approach to technology, including staying current with evolving tools, patterns, and best practices.
* **Collaboration \& Communication**  

Success depends on working effectively across engineering, IT, and business partners, and communicating technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
* **Mentorship \& Team Contribution**  

The role expects active participation in knowledge sharing, regular pairing with junior colleagues, and contributing to a positive, growth\-oriented team culture.
* **Engineering Practices \& Quality Focus**  

The role emphasizes disciplined engineering practices, including source control, unit testing, automation, code review, and secure development.
* **Agile \& Process Discipline**  

Success in the role includes applying formal software development methodologies, including agile approaches, and actively contributing to continuous process improvement.

**Disclaimer:**

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer – Retail Data
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features.***

***Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.***

  

**The Role**

The AV Fleet Data Engineering team is responsible for the end\-to\-end design, requirements, integration, validation, and execution of AV/ADAS data\-collection capabilities. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will lead the definition and delivery of Retail AV Data Collection solutions that support ADAS and automated\-driving development, fleet monitoring, machine\-learning data collection, regulatory compliance, and product improvement.  



  

You will translate stakeholder and customer use cases into system\-level strategies, feature\-level requirements, functional specifications, architecture concepts, and verification plans. This role will lead hands\-on systems engineering across vehicles, benches, simulation and playback environments, cloud/data pipelines, and connected fleet campaigns. The engineer will work closely with software, platform, vehicle integration, quality, data engineering, ADAS, AV, product, legal, and regulatory teams to deliver scalable and reliable data\-recording solutions.  



  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Gather and analyze stakeholder, customer, ADAS, AV, regulatory, privacy, and machine\-learning use cases.
* Decompose product requirements into stakeholder use cases, feature\-level specifications, system requirements, interfaces, constraints, and verification criteria.
* Define system strategies for recording triggers, signals, topics, recording durations, data quality, compute and storage budgets, data offload, privacy, consent, geofencing, and vehicle compatibility.
* Develop system\-level test strategies, use cases, test cases, functional checks, and validation plans for new functionality.
* Coordinate with software and platform teams to communicate requirements, defects, dependencies, risks, and release impacts.
* Ensure system designs account for customer consent, privacy, legal constraints, geofencing, regional requirements, and regulatory data\-recording needs.
* Support data\-collection request intake by clarifying use cases, identifying available signals, defining trigger logic, assessing pipeline limitations, and determining required software or architecture changes.
* Identify opportunities to improve requirements quality, systems engineering processes, test automation, configuration management, release readiness, and stakeholder communication.
* Make technical recommendations based on analysis, communicate lessons learned, and keep engineering leadership informed of assignment status, timing, risks, and technical issues.
Mentor engineers and contribute to reusable systems\-engineering standard work, documentation, and technical training.  
* 

  

  

**Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

  

* 5\+ years of systems engineering, requirements engineering, embedded systems, automotive software, or related engineering experience.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical activities involving multiple engineering disciplines.
* Experience translating customer or stakeholder needs into system requirements, functional specifications, interfaces, and verification criteria.
* Experience with requirements management and traceability tools, preferably DNG.
* Strong understanding of complex electrical, mechanical, software, and vehicle system concepts.
* High level of analytical ability and demonstrated success solving unusual or complex technical problems.
* Experience defining and executing system\-level test cases and validation strategies.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, including technical presentations and requirements reviews.
Ability to work independently, influence technical decisions, and drive issues to closure.  
* 

  

**What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

  

* Experience with DNG, Jira, Confluence, SysML, UML, or similar systems\-engineering tools.
* Experience with CAN, LIN, GMLAN, FlexRay, Ethernet, SOME/IP, or other vehicle communication protocols.
* Experience with QNX, Linux, Android, Azure, cloud data platforms, or embedded software environments.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Python, shell scripting, or test\-automation frameworks.
* Experience with simulation, playback, SIL, HIL, bench testing, or virtual validation.
* Experience supporting regulatory, privacy, consent, geofencing, or data\-governance requirements.
DFSS Green Belt or Black Belt certification.  
* 

  

\*This position requires the ability to legally operate a motor vehicle on a regular basis. \*

This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1\-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc).\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is categorized as hybrid. jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**The Role:**

  

General Motors is seeking a software engineering leader to modernize and scale the build systems that support software\-defined vehicles. This role will help lead the transition from a legacy Make\-based system to Bazel, Google’s open\-source build tool, improving speed, reliability, and robustness across the engineering organization.The successful candidate will drive this capability at scale, influence technical direction across teams, and help establish lofty platform capability goals.  



  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead software engineering productivity and effectiveness by identifying opportunities, shaping strategies, improving processes, guiding change, and connecting initiatives to deliver greater value through innovation, learning, and simplification.
* Lead high\-impact efforts hands\-on, solve complex and unusual problems, and communicate effectively as a coach and mentor while balancing technical command with empathy.
* Modernize a large embedded\-software build and test system by transitioning legacy Make\- or shell\-based workflows to Bazel and establishing scalable, reproducible, secure, and developer\-friendly infrastructure across repositories, toolchains, CI/CD, testing, and release processes.
* Assess current build, test, dependency, toolchain, and hardware workflows to define a phased Bazel migration strategy and rollout model.
* Design and implement reusable Bazel rules, macros, toolchains, platforms, configuration patterns, and repository standards, while migrating embedded applications, libraries, generated code, firmware, cross\-compilation flows, and platform variants with validated build parity and reproducibility.
* Integrate Bazel with enterprise CI/CD, testing, release, artifact, deployment, observability, security, and infrastructure workflows, and optimize the platform through caching, parallelism, reliability practices, documentation, training, legacy Make retirement, and continuous improvement.
* Measure success through target repositories migrated with validated build and test parity; faster clean and incremental builds, CI queues, and developer feedback; increased reproducibility, approved hermetic\-toolchain adoption, cache effectiveness, and CI capacity; and lower build, pipeline, and flaky\-test rates.
* Improve diagnosis and recovery time while ensuring complete artifact provenance, test evidence, and security\-policy compliance for releases, strong developer adoption, reduced support burden, and measurable productivity improvement.
* Hold a bachelor’s degree in software engineering or have equivalent experience, along with 15 years of software development experience.
* Bring a deep understanding of real\-time software architecture and experience shipping high\-quality, safety\-critical products in automotive, embedded, safety\-related, calibration, or systems\-engineering environments.
* Demonstrate exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, keen attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in fast\-paced, action\-oriented decision\-making environments.
* Bring strong expertise building and maintaining production software systems, proficiency in Python and at least one additional engineering\-tooling language, and experience with AI\-assisted developer productivity, coding agents, code intelligence, knowledge retrieval, or workflow orchestration.

Evaluate AI\-enabled engineering workflows using measurable quality, adoption, and productivity outcomes.  

* 

  

Key Deliverables  



  

* Assess current Make\-based build, test, dependency, toolchain, and hardware workflows, then define a phased Bazel migration strategy and rollout model.
* Design and implement reusable Bazel rules, macros, toolchains, platforms, configuration patterns, and repository standards for embedded software.
* Migrate embedded applications, libraries, generated code, firmware, cross\-compilation flows, and platform variants while ensuring build parity and reproducibility.
* Integrate Bazel with enterprise CI/CD, testing, release, artifact, deployment, observability, security, and infrastructure workflows.

Optimize and operationalize the platform through caching, parallelism, reliability practices, documentation, training, legacy Make retirement, and continuous improvement.  

* 

  

Measures of Success  



  

* Target repositories migrated with validated build and test parity.
* Reduced clean and incremental build time, CI queue time, and developer feedback time.
* Increased reproducibility, approved hermetic\-toolchain adoption, cache effectiveness, and CI capacity.
* Lower build, pipeline, and flaky\-test rates, with improved diagnosis and recovery time.
* Complete artifact provenance, test evidence, and security\-policy compliance for releases.

Strong developer adoption, reduced support burden, and measurable productivity improvement.  

* 

  

**Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications):**

  

* Bachelor's degree in software engineering or or equivalent experience
* 15\+ years of experience in software development
* Deep understanding of software architecture for real time systems
* Experience shipping high quality safety critical products
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work in an action\-oriented decision\-making environment
* Strong expertise building and maintaining production software systems, with proficiency in Python and at least one additional language used in engineering tooling environments
* Automotive, embedded, safety\-related, calibration, or systems\-engineering environments.
* Large\-scale migration from Make or shell\-based build orchestration to Bazel.
* AI\-assisted developer productivity, coding agents, code intelligence, knowledge retrieval, or workflow orchestratio

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

  

OnTrac is seeking highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineers to join a contractor program supporting a healthcare / pharmacy benefit management (PBM) customer. The customer is staffing a team of three to four engineers to build REST API integrations with its Databricks data platform. This role is ideal for a hands\-on engineer who has moved clinical and pharmacy data between systems using healthcare interoperability standards, can write production code in both Python and C\#/.NET, and can become productive on a customer codebase with minimal ramp\-up. The successful candidates will work closely with the Lead Software Engineer, the delivery team, and customer stakeholders to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery.


ENGAGEMENT


* Openings: two to three Senior Software Engineers, working alongside one Lead Software Engineer


* Location: United States, fully remote


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Experience delivering software in the healthcare industry; pharmacy benefit management (PBM) experience strongly preferred


* Hands\-on experience designing and building REST APIs and system\-to\-system integrations


* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, including building pipelines and integrating external services with the platform


* Working knowledge of healthcare data standards: HL7 and CDA / C\-CDA documents


* Experience building data movement and orchestration with Azure Data Factory


* Experience with Azure SQL Managed Instance (or SQL Server), including schema design and query tuning


* Production development in Python


* Production development in C\# / .NET


USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS


* HL7 FHIR experience


* Familiarity with PBM data domains such as claims, eligibility, formulary, and prior authorization


* Experience working with PHI under HIPAA controls


* Prior experience as an embedded contractor on a customer engineering team


SCOPE AND DELIVERY EXPECTATIONS


The following covers the scope of work we anticipate the contractor supporting throughout the project. This scope is in line with our expectations of the project but is subject to change.


* Build REST API integrations between customer and partner systems and the Databricks platform


* Build ingestion and transformation of HL7 messages and CDA / C\-CDA documents into Databricks, orchestrated through Azure Data Factory


* Develop integration services in Python and C\# / .NET against Databricks and Azure SQL Managed Instance


* Work from the technical design set by the Lead Software Engineer, and contribute to design discussions for assigned integrations


* Deliver work to the customer's technical standards, following its code review, testing, and deployment practices


* Onboard rapidly and begin contributing to integration work early in the engagement


* Communicate progress, risks, and blockers promptly to the Lead Software Engineer and delivery stakeholders
