**Job Summary:**

This exciting position will support the development and production of automotive embedded electronic control unit hardware. The duties include supporting analog and digital circuit design through testing, analysis and simulation. Day\-to\-day activities would include developing circuit designs for automotive engine \& traction control systems for quotation and mass production that meet customer specifications requirements. The candidate will also need to communicate new, and existing, design information to various departments/companies (domestic and international) on an as needed basis. This may take the form of preparing presentation material, completing documentation, and attending meetings. Supporting production also includes aiding root cause analysis activities, outlining testing pass/fail criteria. Supporting development also includes supporting automotive validation through preparing test plans, analyzing product specifications, supporting the testing of prototypes, creating test specifications, and following the development through to production. In addition, the position will be responsible for supporting the root cause analysis of modules returned by the customer during the development stage.

The candidate will need to work with minimal direction but would work under the direction of DE management and senior staff members located at both the Farmington Hills, MI and Harrodsburg, KY facilities. * Review \& understand customer specifications for engine and traction control systems
* Develop circuit designs that meet the customers specifications for performance, EMC \& endurance requirements
* Prepare and maintain various engineering documents to support production of existing and new products: RPLs, eBOMs, Material Data Sheets (IMDS), Design Notes \& Presentations related to failure analysis.
* Support prototype builds for new \& existing products
* Support validation testing of new \& existing products with failure analysis as needed
* Investigate and implement automation improvements to the test stands and judgment parameters (Condition files).
* Prepare and present final reports for failure analysis activities to appropriate technicians and engineering personnel.
* Prepare various hardware design documents as necessary.
* Responsible for working with customer engineers, as necessary, to ensure that program goals are met, schedules are maintained, and problems encountered during the development process are satisfactorily resolved.
* Assist other project team members and design engineers, in resolving issues related to the design of the electronic hardware.
* The candidate may be required to travel a limited extent within the U.S and travel to Japan is a possibility.

* Understand analog and digital hardware systems as applied to automotive control systems.
* Understand analysis methods and interpreting the results to convey this information to others.
* Be proficient in setting up and using laboratory test equipment such as multi\-meters, scopes, logic analyzer, power analyzer.
* Conduct investigative circuit analysis using device schematics of products and testing equipment.
* Exercise critical thinking and dealing with complex problems to identify strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions and conclusions.
* Have excellent speaking and writing skills to convey information efficiently and effectively.
* Have experience creating worst case analysis (WCAs) and working with PSPICE
* Be able to coordinate program activities with team members at remote sites;
* Have embedded H/W design experience for automotive applications;
* Poses understanding of, and ability to, program in C or C\+\+ to a limited extent;
* Be familiar with programming in C or C\+\+.
* Be familiar with base2, base10, and base16 conversion.
* Be familiarity with hex editors.
* Be familiarity with CAN, SPI, LIN, UDS, or other communication protocols is a plus.
* Have the ability to perform some minor wire harness and/or loadbox assembly and repair.

Additionally, the ability to work independently with minimal direction is required as are strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience with PCs and application software, such as MS Office tools is also required.


**Education:** Bachelor or Master’s degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering.


**Experience:** Minimum of 1\-3 years applicable experience in automotive ECU development.


Job level determined by various factors such as organization size, responsibility, career stage, and capabilities.

##### **Job Description**


mPower is seeking a Sr. RF/Spectrum Systems Engineer to support our client’s engineering team on a significant FAA project. In this role, you will lead research, testing, evaluation, and spectrum analysis of cutting\-edge UAS detection and mitigation technologies in active airport environments.


This position uniquely bridges hands\-on RF engineering, advanced systems analysis, and national policy development—directly influencing future FAA Advisory Circulars and aviation safety standards.


Key Responsibilities


RF \& Radar Engineering


* Lead radar testing across L, S, C, X, Ku, and Ka frequency bands using FMCW, pulse Doppler, and other waveforms (including Phased Array antenna technologies).
* Lead testing of mitigation devices operating in other frequency bands (VHF/UHF/Microwave).

CUAS Research, Testing \& Evaluation (RD/T\&E)

Systems Engineering \& Strategic Policy


* Conduct thorough RF hazard analyses and safety assessments prior to open\-air testing.
* Translate complex RD/T\&E data into performance specification frameworks using modeling, simulation, and analysis tools to shape FAA Advisory Circulars.
* Utilize technical data tools to model and analyze spectrum environments and system capabilities.
* Create multi\-airport CUAS operational recommendations and best practices aligned with FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) principles.

* Demonstrated success in conducting open\-air RF/spectrum data collection.
* Ability to evaluate the functional capabilities of complex technologies with minimal supervision.
* Highly collaborative with strong technical writing and presentation skills for both technical and non\-technical audiences with teams including other disciplines.
* Ability to independently plan and deliver projects with high\-quality, on\-time results.
* Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Physical ability to lift up to 25 lbs. during field deployments.
* Ability to obtain an FAA Suitability clearance and maintain a valid U.S. passport.

Preferred:


* Direct experience developing or executing structured test plans for aviation or defense technologies.
* Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., MATLAB, Python, JMP, or advanced Excel).
* Familiarity with FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) principles or airport operations.

jobs.title: Junior Electrical & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Aescape is a New York\-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes\-driven practice.


Powered by real\-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day.



Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance.



Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures.

**Aescape** is looking for a **Junior Electrical \& Firmware Engineer** to join our hardware team and work across the electronics and embedded software that make our robot move and sense. You will support schematic and PCB design, write and debug firmware on our embedded platforms, and spend significant time on the bench bringing boards up, instrumenting them, and fault finding across hardware and firmware. This is a hands\-on early\-career role on a small, senior team: you will be mentored closely by experienced engineers, given ownership of meaningful subsystems early, and you will ship hardware that real people experience with their bodies. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

**This role is based out of our NYC office in Chelsea, onsite 5 days per week.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Electrical Design Support:** Support schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout review for motor drive, sensing, power, and control electronics. Read datasheets closely, run the calculations behind a part choice, and help carry boards from design through fabrication and assembly.
* **Firmware Development:** Write, test, and debug embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ on our microcontroller platforms: peripheral drivers, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), sensor integration, and device control. Work within our version control, code review, and release practices.
* **Board Bring\-Up \& Debug:** Bring up new hardware on the bench, and debug across the electrical and firmware boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power supplies, and debuggers. Solder, rework, and instrument your own test setups.
* **Test \& Characterization:** Build bench test setups, collect and analyze characterization data, and report what the data shows. Drive decisions from measured data and physics.
* **Manufacturing \& Supplier Support:** Support production test fixtures, design for testability, and electrical builds with our contract manufacturer and suppliers. Help triage and root\-cause issues found in manufacturing and in the field.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner with Mechanical, Controls, Software, and Operations on motor selection, drivers, sensors, and system bring\-up, and communicate what you find clearly to partners outside your discipline.
* **Documentation:** Produce the documentation others need to use your work: schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, test plans, and test reports.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* **Education \& Experience:** BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, with 0–3 years of professional experience. Internships, co\-ops, research, competition teams, or substantial personal projects count.
* **Circuit Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design, power electronics basics, and schematic capture in a professional tool such as Altium. You can read a datasheet and justify a component choice with numbers.
* **Embedded Firmware \& Python:** Working proficiency in C or C\+\+ on microcontrollers, bare\-metal or RTOS, with familiarity across common peripherals and communication protocols, and in Python for test automation and application\-level work. Comfortable with Git and code review.
* **Lab Skills:** Hands\-on with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench power supplies, and comfortable soldering and reworking your own boards.
* **Debugging Mindset:** You approach a failure with a clear question in mind: what is happening, why, and how would I prove it. You stay with a problem until you find the actual cause rather than a workaround.
* **Cross\-Disciplinary Curiosity:** Interest in how electronics, firmware, and mechanics come together in a working machine, and comfort working with engineers outside your discipline.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal skills. You document what you did and explain what you found so others can act on it.
* **Adaptability:** A driven self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot as priorities shift in a fast\-moving startup; willing to take on work outside your core role when required.
* **Nice to Have:** Experience with brushless motor control or motor drivers, sensor signal conditioning, PCB layout, or robotics projects.
* **Work Onsite:** Ability to work from our NYC office 5 days a week.

**What’s In It For You**
------------------------

* Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery
* The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living
* Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun!
* 100% employer\-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents
* Flexible time off
* Quarterly Wellness Days \- everyone fully unplugs
* Generous parental leave
* Complimentary OneMedical

jobs.title: Automation Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Join Our Automation Engineering Team**
Jam Works Automation is hiring an Automation Engineer I to support the design, programming, testing, integration, and commissioning of custom automated manufacturing systems.
This is a salaried/exempt, early\-career engineering opportunity for someone interested in building hands\-on experience across both controls and robotics. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers while developing skills in PLC/HMI programming, industrial robotics, electrical controls, system integration, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
Candidates may come into the role with stronger experience in either controls or robotics. You’ll have the opportunity to build broader automation experience while continuing to develop your existing technical strengths.
**Why Join Jam Works Automation?**
* Build hands\-on experience across both controls and robotics
* Work on custom automated manufacturing systems from programming through commissioning
* Learn directly from experienced automation engineers through project work, training, and mentoring
* Gain exposure to technologies including PLCs, HMIs, industrial robotics, drives, servos, vision systems, and safety systems
* Develop toward a longer\-term career path in Controls Engineering or Robotics Engineering as your technical skills and experience grow

**What You’ll Do**
* Support the design, programming, integration, testing, and commissioning of automated manufacturing systems
* Develop and modify basic PLC/HMI and robot programs with guidance from experienced engineers
* Work with technologies including Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, AutomationDirect, FANUC robotics, and RoboGuide
* Assist with electrical drawings, control schematics, panel layouts, I/O documentation, equipment selection, and other engineering documentation
* Support the assembly, wiring, installation, checkout, and troubleshooting of control panels, field devices, robotic equipment, and automation components
* Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), equipment start\-up, and commissioning
* Troubleshoot basic electrical, controls, robotics, and system\-integration issues
* Collaborate with Controls, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, and other teams throughout project execution
* Maintain accurate programs, drawings, backups, test records, and project documentation
* Travel to customer locations as needed for installation, commissioning, start\-up, and troubleshooting activities

**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered
* Typically 0–2 years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls, robotics, manufacturing, or a related environment
* Internships, co\-ops, academic projects, and other relevant hands\-on experience are welcome
* Foundational knowledge of PLC/HMI programming, industrial robotics, electrical controls, and automated equipment
* Exposure to Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, AutomationDirect, FANUC, or RoboGuide is preferred
* Ability to read and develop basic electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings
* Basic understanding of sensors, I/O, motors, drives, servos, safety devices, and industrial communications
* Basic electrical and mechanical aptitude with the ability to safely use common hand and power tools
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, teamwork, and organizational skills
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and work in a hands\-on, project\-driven environment

**This Could Be a Great Fit If You**
* Enjoy figuring out how machines, controls, and robotic systems work together
* Want a role that combines engineering work with hands\-on equipment experience
* Are interested in developing skills across both controls and robotics before building deeper specialization
* Enjoy troubleshooting and solving technical problems
* Work well with engineers, technicians, manufacturing teams, and customers
* Are curious, adaptable, and motivated to keep building your technical skills

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**
* Work is performed across office/engineering, manufacturing, assembly, and customer\-site environments
* The role may involve working around operating machinery, electrical equipment, robotic systems, and moving mechanical components
* Hands\-on work may include equipment assembly, wiring, installation, testing, and troubleshooting
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds occasionally, with assistance as appropriate
* Frequent bending, reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching may be required when working around equipment and control panels
* Appropriate personal protective equipment and applicable company and customer safety procedures must be followed
* Travel to customer locations is required as needed for installation, testing, commissioning, start\-up, troubleshooting, and technical support
* Work schedules may occasionally vary based on project, commissioning, or customer requirements

**Position Overview**


Trillium Foods is seeking a hands\-on Electrical Engineer to support capital projects, automation, controls, and electrical systems within our food and beverage manufacturing operations.


This role will be actively involved in the design, development, installation, and improvement of electrical and automation systems supporting food processing, production, packaging, and facility operations. The Electrical Engineer will work directly with equipment and systems on the manufacturing floor, providing technical expertise from initial project concept and equipment specification through programming, installation, commissioning, startup, and ongoing optimization.


The ideal candidate will bring hands\-on electrical engineering, automation, and controls experience within the food and beverage manufacturing industry, along with experience supporting capital projects from concept through commissioning and startup.


This is not a role focused solely on coordinating or delegating engineering work. We are looking for someone who enjoys being directly involved in the technical work, solving problems, developing practical solutions, and taking ownership of projects and assignments.


The Electrical Engineer will work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, EHS, OEMs, contractors, and external engineering partners while maintaining direct technical involvement throughout projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Capital Projects \& Project Ownership*** Take ownership of assigned capital projects supporting food processing, production, packaging, utilities, and facility operations.
* Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, equipment specifications, technical requirements, and implementation plans.
* Provide hands\-on electrical and controls engineering throughout project design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Evaluate new equipment and technologies and ensure electrical and controls requirements are appropriately incorporated into equipment specifications.
* Work directly with OEMs, vendors, contractors, integrators, and external engineering partners while maintaining internal ownership of technical requirements and project execution.
* Review and challenge technical recommendations, drawings, specifications, and proposed solutions to ensure they meet operational, engineering, food safety, and reliability requirements.
* Support equipment installation, testing, commissioning, validation, and production startup directly on the manufacturing floor.
* Track project costs, schedules, risks, and performance while minimizing disruption to production.
* Identify opportunities to improve safety, food quality, equipment reliability, efficiency, capacity, and overall manufacturing performance.
 **Automation \& Controls*** Design, program, troubleshoot, modify, and optimize PLC and HMI systems supporting food and beverage manufacturing equipment and processes.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, VFDs, industrial networks, instrumentation, and process controls.
* Support automation associated with processing, batching, mixing, filling, material handling, packaging, conveying, and other production systems.
* Troubleshoot controls and automation issues directly on production equipment and develop sustainable corrective solutions.
* Support integration between production equipment, controls, instrumentation, and related systems.

 **Electrical Engineering*** Design, specify, troubleshoot, and support industrial electrical systems, including low\- and medium\-voltage distribution.

* Support motor control centers (MCCs), switchgear, transformers, generators, backup power systems, motors, drives, and other electrical infrastructure supporting plant operations.
* Support arc flash studies, short\-circuit analysis, electrical coordination studies, energy efficiency initiatives, and electrical reliability improvements.
* Ensure electrical systems and work comply with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and applicable electrical and safety requirements.
 **Food \& Beverage Manufacturing Support*** Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and provide hands\-on technical support to Operations and Maintenance.
* Troubleshoot complex electrical, automation, controls, and equipment issues affecting production.

* Develop engineering solutions that consider food safety, sanitary design, product quality, cleanability, employee safety, and production requirements.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance initiatives for electrical and controls systems.
* Work effectively in an environment where engineering projects and troubleshooting activities must be coordinated around active production and sanitation schedules.
* Build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization and communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
 **Engineering Standards, Food Safety \& Compliance*** Develop, maintain, and promote standardized engineering practices, hardware, and control platforms.
* Ensure engineering designs and equipment modifications consider applicable food manufacturing, sanitation, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Review contractor drawings and engineering packages and ensure technical documentation is accurate and maintained.

This position will require periodic travel to remote locations (including the Electro\-Optics \& Electronics (EOE) Freeport Office near Pittsburgh, PA) in support of collaboration and testing as part of a small team of researchers, engineers, and technologists.


We are searching for a Research \& Development Engineer to join our EOE Division at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. EOE develops innovative optical solutions for imaging, high\-energy laser (HEL) delivery, and sensing systems, and maintains the design and testing capabilities required to build and fully characterize all aspects of optical performance – from image quality to HEL coating damage testing. This role will lead and conduct basic and applied research of advanced electro\-optical designs, including metasurfaces, photonic structures and other emerging material and nano\-science applications. You will have the ability to take on challenges where the path the research may take is not clear, and the outcome is not known or guaranteed.


ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.


You will:


* Act as part of team leadership that operates in this ambiguous space and develops the executable plan for the rest of the team
* Perform physics\-based modeling to predict the performance of imaging system concepts and designs
* Drive system level trade studies to develop architectures and allocate system level requirements across subsystems and engineering disciplines
* Routinely interface with sponsors, customers, end\-users, and collaborators to understand their problems, brainstorm solutions, scope research, communicate the technical aspects of research execution, and convey the significance of results
* Provide input to the strategic direction of the department’s research pursuits by helping to establish the appropriate core competencies and evaluating where our capabilities best align with a sponsor’s needs

Additional responsibilities of the higher\-level include:


* Leverage prior first\-hand experience with building and testing advanced, state\-of\-the\-art electro\-optic systems
* Track the latest developments in electro\-optic systems and advise on how and when to integrate them into on\-going and future research opportunities.
* Perform project planning, budgeting, and scheduling
* Manage vendors and suppliers, from purchase orders through statements of work
* Lead other engineers in day\-to\-day tasking to satisfy stakeholder’s requirements and expectations
* Independently manage multiple and/or large electro\-optic projects
* Develop and propose solutions for new applications
* Perform the role of Trusted Agent to the government to assess and validate state\-of\-the art electro\-optic systems and solutions

Required Skills/Experience areas include:


* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment and meet project schedule requirements
* Direct experience with the design, analysis, procurement, assembly and testing of components and complete electro\-optic and infrared (EO/IR) systems for military applications
* Microelectronic systems and detector fabrication processes
* Success in a multitude of optical and electrical materials and systems
* Success operating as a systems engineer for imaging systems
* Familiarity with photonic structures and other optical metamaterial designs approaches
* Active security clearance, at the secret level, with eligibility for TS/SCI

Preferred Skills/Experience areas include:


* Experience within an organization responsible for manufacturing EO/IR systems
* Direct experience with visible and infrared imaging system design and characterization
* Strong knowledge of electro\-optical metamaterial designs approaches
* Radiometry (analysis and laboratory measurements), development of link budgets, prediction of sensor response, and image quality metrics
* Significant experience with electro\-optic designs that extend the electro\-optic state\-of\-the\-art
* Significant experience bringing together distributed teams to achieve multiplied results
* Active security clearance at the TS/SCI level or higher

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Network \& Controls Engineer designs, configures, integrates, and supports the secure communication paths that connect Nextracker’s field\-deployed tracker controllers, data hubs, SCADA systems, and customer networks to the Nextpower cloud environment.


This is an early\-career engineering role for a hands\-on problem solver who can work across network engineering, OT/SCADA connectivity, customer onboarding, systems integration, and process development. The role will support new project deployments and the operating fleet, working with Network Engineering, Controls and Software Engineering, Technical Services, Remote Monitoring, Field Services, Project teams, and customer IT/OT organizations.


The position is intended to build on the responsibilities of the Network Engineering Intern and expand them into full\-time ownership of defined network, SCADA, integration, and operational improvement workstreams.  



**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Network engineering and site connectivity**

* Design and review site connectivity solutions for new and existing solar projects, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, cellular gateways, leased\-line connections, and related network services.
* Review customer IT/OT standards, network diagrams, IP plans, routing requirements, segmentation requirements, and firewall policies.

* Configure and test network equipment using approved templates, standards, and change\-management procedures.
* Establish and maintain reliable communication between field devices, customer networks, and Nextpower data centers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - HIL
jobs.description:
**About Neuralink:**



We are creating devices that enable a bi\-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

**The Role**



Neuralink's next generation surgical robot will perform brain surgery at scale, installing hundreds of tiny threads into the brain to enable brain computer communication.



You will own the robot's Hardware In the Loop (HIL) test system. Exercise the production surgical robot, controllers and firmware against controlled inputs, reproduce faults, and automate verification. Your HIL will enable unattended test \& verification to run day and night. Your work will help deliver reliable surgical robots at scale, bringing Neuralink to more people.


**What you'll do**


* Build and maintain robot HIL — real hardware running production software and firmware.
* Write automated HIL tests for integration, timing, faults, and bring\-up.
* Define pass/fail, coverage, and acceptance criteria.
* Wire software\-in\-the\-loop tests, HIL tests, and hardware acceptance into one CI pipeline with logs, traces, and reproducible results.
* Own release\-gating tests. When a failure escapes sim or HIL, you reproduce it and close the coverage gap.


***Note: The team is hiring engineers at all levels, both junior and senior. What matters most is evidence of exceptional abilities and a drive to succeed.***


**What we're looking for**


* Strong Rust skills; Python for test tooling and analysis. Comfortable close to drivers, firmware, and buses.
* Experience with HIL, test rigs, or system\-level verification on robots, vehicles, or similar hardware.
* Experience debugging async and concurrent systems, RPC, telemetry, and timing failures across software and firmware.
* Experience building automated test pipelines. Bazel experience is a plus.
* Effective at using AI agents to accelerate work while maintaining quality.
* Obsession with repeatability, edge cases, and traceability.

* Experience with hardware architectures such as GPUs, TPUs, or custom AI accelerators

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
The Systems Engineer is responsible for analyzing, designing, and managing complex systems throughout the system lifecycle. This role translates customer and mission needs into technical requirements, system architectures, and engineering solutions while ensuring that systems meet performance, operational, and reliability objectives. The Systems Engineer collaborates across engineering disciplines to evaluate system requirements, develop technical solutions, manage system interfaces and dependencies, and support system verification and validation. The role may also support Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), digital engineering, and systems modeling activities.  



  

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long\-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical \- Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.  



  

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug\-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.  



**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS**

The ability to obtain, maintain and access classified information at the Public Trust level.  



  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Analyze customer, mission, and operational needs and translate them into clear, measurable system and subsystem requirements.
* Develop, decompose, allocate, and maintain system requirements throughout the system lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain system architectures, functional analyses, system models, and technical baselines.
* Perform functional decomposition and allocate system functions to appropriate subsystems and components.
* Define system interfaces, dependencies, data flows, and interactions between subsystems and external systems.
* Conduct technical analyses and trade studies to evaluate system performance, capabilities, risks, and design alternatives.
* Support the development of system concepts, technical specifications, design documentation, and engineering artifacts.
* Establish and maintain requirements traceability from customer needs through system design, implementation, and verification.
* Support system\-level verification and validation activities and ensure requirements are appropriately verified.
* Participate in system requirements reviews, preliminary and critical design reviews, technical interchange meetings, and other engineering reviews.
* Identify and assess technical risks, constraints, dependencies, and opportunities throughout the system lifecycle.
* Collaborate with software, hardware, cybersecurity, network, integration, test, and other engineering teams to ensure system\-level requirements and objectives are addressed.
* Evaluate proposed technical solutions and assess their impact on system performance, interfaces, requirements, and overall architecture.
* Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment activities as required.
* Develop and maintain system engineering documentation, including requirements specifications, architecture documentation, interface documentation, and technical reports.
* Support configuration management and technical change control processes.
* Use requirements management, systems engineering, and modeling tools to develop and maintain technical artifacts.
* Support MBSE and digital engineering initiatives, including development and maintenance of SysML\-based system models when applicable.

Ensure engineering activities and deliverables comply with applicable customer requirements, industry standards, and program processes.

Reality Labs (RL) focuses on delivering Meta's vision through Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and Wearable AI Devices. The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of our AI devices require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. Our chips will unlock personalized on\-device AI capabilities and blend virtual, physical worlds on wearable devices. You will be part of our efforts to architect, design and implement a clean slate compiler for this activity and will be part of a team that includes compiler, machine learning algorithms and software, firmware and ASIC experts. * Work with hardware architects to co\-design compiler features that maximize performance, power efficiency, and programmability for edge devices
* Analyze and improve the efficiency, scalability, and stability of compiler toolchains, ensuring they can be extended to new hardware targets
* Lead technical roadmapping for compiler infrastructure initiatives, coordinate execution across teams, and mentor engineers on compiler design patterns
* Conduct design and code reviews, evaluate code performance, and drive resolution of compiler and cross\-disciplinary system issues
* Interface with other compiler\-focused teams (PyTorch, ExecuTorch) to evaluate and incorporate innovations

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience in developing compilers, toolchains, or code optimization software
* Experience with LLVM, MLIR, or similar compiler infrastructure frameworks
* Experience in designing intermediate representations and implementing compiler optimization passes
* Experience with hardware architectures such as GPUs, TPUs, or custom AI accelerators
* Experience in software development using C\+\+ for compiler and systems\-level programming
* Experience leading end\-to\-end technical design and delivery of compiler infrastructure initiatives across multiple teams

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing in ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow at the system level
* Experience co\-designing software and hardware features with silicon architecture teams

About Evergreen Goodwill
  
  

Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization founded in 1923 that helps people get jobs across Northwest Washington by offering high\-quality free job training, education and job placement. Goodwill empowers individuals to overcome barriers to working, by providing comprehensive support and connecting them with life changing job opportunities, ensuring they are career\-ready and can support themselves and their families.
  
  

The organization employs over 2,000 people, operates five job\-training centers, 23 nonprofit retail stores and more than 27 donation sites in King, Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom and Kitsap Counties. Every day, Evergreen Goodwill connects people with the jobs, services and skills they need — because Jobs Change Lives. We are committed to creating and sustaining a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion (DEI) and are focused on creating a joyful, inclusive and successful organization.
  
  

Sr. Systems Engineer
  
**Reports to:** Sr. Manager, IT Services
  
**Supervises:** None
  
**Location:** Evergreen Goodwill Administration \- Hybrid, 3 days required in office
  
**Band:** $85,000 – $90,000
  
  

Position Summary
  
Evergreen Goodwill is seeking a Sr. Systems Engineer to own how technology works across our 26 locations — the infrastructure, the store technology, and the service model that keeps 2,000 people working.
  
This is the senior technical seat on our systems engineering team. You will own a domain rather than a queue: the coverage model for how we support locations, the standards for how systems get built and maintained, the lifecycle of the technology in our stores, and the architecture decisions inside your scope. When something in that domain breaks at scale, it is yours.
  
We are in the middle of significant infrastructure modernization — virtualization platform migration, identity rollout, endpoint modernization, and a point\-of\-sale replacement touching every store. You will be designing and building that, not inheriting it finished.
  
You will also raise the technical bar on this team. Our systems engineers are strong operators; we need someone who sets the standard they work to, reviews their designs, and develops them toward this level.
  
Where your authority sits. You decide within the domain you own — how systems are designed, what the coverage model is, what "correctly built" means for store technology. Standards that span the whole technology estate sit with our Enterprise Solutions Architect, and you are a peer in shaping them. Inside your domain, the calls are yours.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Domain ownership
  
* Own the architecture for a domain of the infrastructure estate — some combination of server and virtualization platform, identity and access, network, endpoint fleet, and store technology
* Own the service and field coverage model across 26 locations: how work gets routed, what response looks like, and what we staff for
* Own the store technology lifecycle — standards, refresh planning, deployment, and retirement
* Own reliability for the systems in your domain, including incident command when something significant breaks


Standards and engineering practice
  
* Set the build, configuration, and operational standards the systems team works to. Write them down
* Review designs and significant changes before they reach production
* Define what "production\-ready" means for infrastructure work, and hold work to it
* Work within enterprise architecture and change management standards, and help shape them


Infrastructure and modernization
  
* Lead infrastructure projects: virtualization migration, identity rollout, endpoint modernization, store technology deployment
* Design and build, hands\-on. This is not a review\-only role
* Automate at the level of the environment, not just your own tasks — configuration management, provisioning, and infrastructure\-as\-code where it earns its place


Security and resilience
  
* Own security posture within your domain: patching discipline, access model, hardening standards, and vulnerability response
* Own backup, restore verification, and disaster recovery testing. Prove the restores work


Vendor and asset management
  
* Manage vendor relationships for platforms and hardware in your domain, including evaluation and selection input
* Own asset standards and lifecycle planning, and the budget input that follows from them


Multiplication
  
* Raise the capability of the systems engineering team through review, standards, and teaching
* Mentor Level I and II engineers, and be explicit with them about what reaching the next level requires
* Document your work so someone else can carry it


Job\-Specific Qualifications
  
* 8\+ years in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, with demonstrated ownership of a domain rather than a task queue
* Deep Windows Server and directory services experience: Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificates, and the failure modes of each
* Strong virtualization experience — VMware, Proxmox, or Hyper\-V — including design, build, and migration, not only operation
* Strong networking: VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPN, and multi\-site connectivity design
* Identity and access architecture experience: SSO, MFA, conditional access, and access lifecycle
* Automation and scripting at a level that changes how the environment is managed — PowerShell, Bash, Python, or configuration management tooling

* Experience owning infrastructure across multiple physical sites
* Experience owning security posture: patching, hardening, access, and vulnerability response
* Clear written communication. You will write standards other people have to follow, and explain a constraint to a non\-technical audience

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description
We’re entering an exciting phase of hypergrowth and transformation as we build the systems that will support our journey toward a $1 Billion business. We’re introducing new manufacturing technologies, modernizing legacy platforms, and expanding automation across our operations. To support this work, we’re looking for a Senior Electrical & Automation Systems Engineer
to serve as a technical anchor for our automation and electrical systems.
In this highly specialized role, you’ll bring deep hands-on expertise in industrial automation, electrical systems, and IT/OT integration to support the startup of a new sauce manufacturing area while strengthening and modernizing automation across the broader factory. You’ll work closely with Operations, Maintenance, IT, and Engineering to translate complex technical systems into reliable, safe, and supportable solutions that perform in real-world manufacturing environments.
Reporting to the Principal Automation & Controls Engineer
, you’ll act as a technical leader, owning automation and electrical system design, commissioning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support. You’ll also mentor junior engineers, guide contractors and integrators, and help establish standards and best practices that build long-term capability across the Engineering team.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
You’ll be part of a growing organization that values innovation, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement. The company is committed to developing its people, adopting new technologies, and building reliable systems that support long-term growth.
Success Factors (First 12–24 Months)
Automation & Electrical Systems Leader:

You’ve played a critical role in the successful startup and stabilization of the electrical and automation systems supporting a new manufacturing area. From power distribution and control panels to PLCs, SCADA, and industrial networks, you ensured systems were designed, implemented, and commissioned to meet performance, safety, and reliability expectations. You brought strong technical judgment to both new installations and upgrades of aging equipment, helping the plant scale capacity while reducing risk and downtime.
IT/OT Integration Specialist:

You served as a key bridge between manufacturing operations, maintenance teams, and IT partners—bringing clarity and practical solutions where traditional IT or OT approaches alone were not sufficient. By applying strong IT/OT integration skills, you supported secure and reliable connectivity across PLCs, SCADA, historians, databases, managed switches, and enterprise systems. Your work ensured data flowed effectively from the factory floor to business systems while maintaining appropriate cybersecurity and operational safeguards.
Project & Contractor Leadership:

You successfully led electrical and automation scopes within capital and improvement projects, managing timelines, budgets, technical deliverables, and change control. You coordinated system integrators, panel builders, and installers by reviewing designs, overseeing installations, and ensuring documentation and standards were met. Through clear communication and technical leadership, you helped projects transition smoothly from engineering into operations with minimal disruption.
Operational Support & Reliability Partner:

Following startup, you became a trusted technical partner to Operations and Maintenance by supporting day-to-day troubleshooting, system optimization, and lifecycle management of automation platforms. You helped teams understand system behavior, supported root cause analysis of complex failures, and implemented improvements that increased reliability, maintainability, and efficiency. Your presence helped ensure automation systems were not only sophisticated, but also practical and supportable.
Continuous Improvement & Technical Evolution:

You actively identified opportunities to modernize and improve automation platforms, addressing reliability gaps, simplifying architectures, and extending the useful life of critical systems. You contributed to automation standards, object-oriented programming practices, documentation, and asset management strategies that improved consistency across the plant. Through data analytics, historian tools, and system insights, you supported continuous improvement efforts tied to performance, quality, and operational excellence.
Technical Mentor & Team Multiplier:

You shared your expertise generously, mentoring junior automation engineers and serving as a technical resource to the broader Engineering team. Through coaching, design reviews, and hands-on problem-solving, you helped elevate technical capability, reinforce best practices, and promote knowledge transfer. Your leadership strengthened the team’s ability to support complex systems independently and sustainably.
What You’ll Bring
BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent combination of degree in a related technical field plus industry experience.
10+ years of experience in electrical and industrial automation engineering.
5+ years of experience embedded in a manufacturing plant environment supporting live production systems.
5+ years working with or for system integrators delivering automation solutions.
Proven experience leading automation and electrical scopes for medium-to-large capital projects.
Deep hands-on expertise with Rockwell Automation platforms (ControlLogix, CompactLogix).
Strong PLC programming skills using Structured Text, Ladder Logic, SFC, and modular design.
Experience with FactoryTalk View SE SCADA and manufacturing historians (e.g., Historian SE, OSI PI).
Working knowledge of industrial networks and protocols (EtherNet/IP, DeviceNet, AS-i, VFDs).
Experience integrating OT systems with IT infrastructure (SQL databases, Active Directory, managed networks, virtual environments).
Familiarity with food manufacturing processes and utilities (HTST, CIP, RO water preferred).
Experience with automation commissioning, validation, and startup support.
Strong understanding of electrical codes and standards (NFPA, NEC, ISA).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Operations, Maintenance, IT, and external vendors.
A safety-first mindset with experience supporting compliance and risk assessments.

Why People Love Working Here
Become an Owner:

Employees have opportunities to participate in programs that support long-term financial growth and recognize individual contributions.
Growing with Purpose:

The company continues to grow, creating opportunities to develop new skills, work with new technologies, and take on new challenges.
Better Together:

jobs.title: Senior HPC and Quantum Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking a Senior HPC & Quantum Systems Engineer to help architect, deploy, and operate a first-of-its-kind Accelerated Quantum Computing Center in the Boston area! This role sits at the intersection of data center infrastructure, high-performance computing, and emerging quantum systems, and will be essential to turning experimental quantum hardware into a reliable, high-impact research platform. You will lead all aspects of the day-to-day technical ownership of a tightly coupled GPU supercomputing environment coordinated with multiple quantum modalities. This is not a pure research role nor a traditional HPC admin role—it is a systems engineering position dedicated to exploring quantum computing integration with classical systems. This role is ideal for someone who has built and operated production HPC environments, understands low-level systems and networking, and is excited to work hands-on with quantum hardware as it transitions from lab prototypes to operational infrastructure.

What you'll be doing:
:

Hybrid Quantum–HPC Platform Engineering

Build, deploy, and operate a hybrid computing platform combining large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters with physical quantum processors (neutral atom, trapped ion, superconducting, and future modalities).
Integrate quantum control systems and access nodes with HPC infrastructure using APIs, scientific applications, and orchestration frameworks such as CUDA-Q, cuQuantum, NVQlink, Slurm, and related toolchains.

HPC Systems & Operations

Be responsible for the reliability, performance, administrations, and lifecycle management of the Quantum environment, including Linux systems, QPU hardware, job schedulers (e.g., Slurm), networking, containerized applications, and storage.
Work closely with networking and facilities teams to ensure power, cooling, timing, environmental controls, and low-latency connectivity meet quantum hardware requirements

Vendor & Partner Collaboration

Serve as a technical interface to quantum hardware partners, collaborating on system bring-up, connectivity, control interfaces, and co-design opportunities.
Help define hosting, systems architecture, and integration requirements for new quantum systems entering the facility.

Application Enablement & Performance

Partner with internal researchers and engineers to deploy, optimize, and benchmark hybrid workloads across simulation, quantum error correction, calibration, optimization, and machine learning.
Prototype, document, and evaluate end-to-end workflows that demonstrate the capabilities of the platform.
Support researchers with application solving and standard methodologies.

What We Need To See

12+ years of hands-on experience operating HPC or large-scale compute infrastructure in production environments.
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree with equivalent experience in Physics, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science (PhD a plus).
Strong background in Linux systems administration, job schedulers (Slurm or equivalent), and computing environments committed to reliable operation.
Proven experience working in data center environments, including networking, storage, power, and operational constraints.
Familiarity with quantum computing concepts and hardware architectures (neutral atom, trapped ion, superconducting, photonic).
Experience with or strong interest in quantum software environments including CUDA-Q, Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, Braket, or similar.
Comfort working across system boundaries: control systems, APIs, networking, and performance tooling.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Direct experience integrating or hosting physical quantum hardware in a data center or HPC environment.
Deep knowledge of quantum–classical orchestration, low-latency data paths, scientific application support, and/or real-time control considerations.
Experience working with NVIDIA tools and frameworks.
Experience bridging experimental research teams and production infrastructure.

This position plays a central role in bridging quantum research and operational computing infrastructure. You will directly influence how quantum systems are coordinated, scaled, and made usable by researchers, crafting both internal capabilities and external partnerships. Your work will help transform quantum computing from experimental hardware into a dependable, accelerated computing resource. It will operate alongside one of the most advanced GPU platforms in the world! This will materially impact the future of scientific computing. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Skyward.
That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission. We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them. Integrity:
We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors. Compassionate:
If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally. Inquisitive:
We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions. Unconventional:
For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two. Authentic:
Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand. Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We Need a Software Engineer Who Does It All.

Would your friends say you can dissect a complex problem until it quietly gives up? Have you been told (more than once) that you care suspiciously much about modernizing the crusty old systems powering public services ? Good. We’re not bored, we’re impressed.

Here’s the thing: we don’t want an engineer who only writes code and tosses it over the wall. We want the rare one who writes it, automates the pipeline that ships it, and builds the tests that prove it works, and then sleeps soundly because of it. If you believe “done” means tested, deployed, and monitored (not “it runs on my laptop”), then we want you.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What You’ll Do

Build things that matter. Write effective, scalable code supporting CMS as it merges systems into one AI-driven platform - reducing manual effort, improving data accuracy, and bringing cutting-edge NLP and LLM techniques to public services.
Automate all the toil. Own CI/CD pipelines end to end, automating build, test, and deployment workflows with tools like Jenkins, plus Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) so deployments are boring in the best possible way.
Test like you mean it. Build and maintain automated test suites - unit, integration, regression - wired straight into the pipeline as quality gates, and provide real test-coverage analysis instead of crossed fingers.
Containerize and ship. Package and deploy workloads with Docker (and friends) for repeatable, scalable, what-you-build-is-what-you-run environments.
Hunt the bugs. Investigate and debug test failures throughout the lifecycle, update tests or file bugs as needed, and keep the build green and honest.
Bake in security. Integrate code-quality checks and security gates (think SonarQube, Snyk) into the pipeline so problems get caught before they ship, not after.
Design with humans in mind. Work closely with human-centered design experts to build solutions that are intuitive, responsive, and personalized to each user’s needs.
Make things faster. Develop and tune back-end components to improve responsiveness and overall performance.

What we’d like you to have:

3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong coding chops in Python (and friends).
Real DevOps / DevSecOps / DevTestOps experience. You know CI/CD isn’t a buzzword; you’ve actually automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
Test automation skill. You’ve built automated tests and integrated them into pipelines with code-quality checks and security gates, not bolted them on at the end.
A feel for good pipelines. Scalable, maintainable, and integrated with testing frameworks. You know, the kind that make the whole team faster.
Containerization experience (Docker or Kubernetes) and comfort with REST APIs.
Fluency in an agile flavor or two - Scrum, Lean, or SAFe.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across a busy mix of stakeholders.

What Would Blow Us Away

You’ve got AI chops, experience with NLP, LLMs, or ML-driven applications.
You’ve previously supported CMS or another federal agency.
Bonus unicorn points if you’ve worked inside a FISMA boundary or supported an ATO/cATO effort.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And Now The Important Part. What We Offer You

Medical, dental, vision insurance
15 days of paid leave
7 days of sick leave
2 days bereavement leave
11 paid Federal holidays
Up to 40 hours for jury duty
401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
Company provided laptop
$5,000 per year for professional development
$600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
$2,000 referral bonus
Life and disability insurance
HSA and FSA
Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!

$115,000 - $130,000 a year

We believe great work deserves great pay. That’s why we ensure our compensation is not only competitive but also fair and transparent, as required by Maryland law. Expect a salary that matches your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the table — because you’re worth it!

At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees. Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.
Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance due to the nature of our work as a government contractor.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer – Cell Therapy Automation
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for IT, automation, and robotics? Would you like to join a winning team supporting the next generation of Cell Therapy manufacturing in one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies? If you thrive in an environment of innovation and change in a fast-growing organization, then this could be the role for you.

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world's most serious diseases.

Introduction to Role

Join us at AstraZeneca, a place that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking, and innovation. We are looking for an integral member to join our Cell

Therapy Supply Chain – Robotics & Automation IT team
. This role has a global remit and will play a critical part in delivering IT infrastructure, software integration, and cybersecurity capabilities for our robotic manufacturing platform.

The role focuses on enabling the deployment and sustained operation of robotic clusters
within a GMP cell therapy manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for ensuring seamless IT/OT integration, supporting automation programming, managing vendor software platforms, and ensuring compliance with pharmaceutical cybersecurity standards. This position supports our strategic partnership with an external robotics vendor and directly contributes to patient-impacting manufacturing timelines.

Accountability

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering reliable IT and software engineering support across the full lifecycle of robotic cluster deployment—from Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)
through Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)
, installation qualification, operational qualification, and ongoing production operations. You will manage integration between robotic systems and enterprise platforms (MES, LIMS, ELN), implement cybersecurity controls aligned with DoD Zero Trust architecture
and ISA-62443
standards, and collaborate cross-functionally with supply chain, quality, engineering, and external vendor teams.

You will serve as the primary technical interface between AstraZeneca IT and the robotics vendor's software and automation engineering teams, ensuring that platform readiness milestones are met and that all software licensing, data integrity, and system availability requirements are fulfilled.

Typical Responsibilities

IT/OT Integration & Architecture: Design and maintain robust OT/IT network segmentation, low-latency connectivity for real-time robotic control, and high-availability infrastructure targeting 99.99% uptime for production-critical automation systems.
Cybersecurity & Compliance: Implement and enforce cybersecurity measures including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), firewall segmentation, endpoint protection, patch management, SIEM integration, and audit logging in alignment with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, ISA-62443, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11.
Software & Automation Support: Support automation programming for robotic platforms, resolve software licensing issues, and coordinate with vendor engineering teams on software development lifecycle (SDLC) activities.
System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of robotic clusters with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) such as PAS-X orTULIP, and with LIMS & ELN platforms to guarantee end-to-end traceability and electronic batch record compliance.
Data Management & Traceability: Ensure all data acquisition systems support electronic records and electronic signatures per 21 CFR Part 11, maintain high-fidelity audit trails, and enable capture of process parameters, batch data, and material genealogy.
IoT & Environmental Monitoring: Support IoT sensor integration for real-time environmental and equipment monitoring, configure automated alerting and escalation protocols, and maintain alarm management systems.
Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity: Develop, test, and maintain disaster recovery plans for cloud-based and on-premise software/data systems; define and meet Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
Vendor Collaboration & FAT/SAT Support: Serve as the IT point of contact during FAT/SAT execution, support qualification activities, manage deviations and mitigation plans related to IT readiness, and ensure documentation alignment with project milestones.
Cloud Platform Management: Support and manage cloud infrastructure associated with the robotic cluster platform (estimated at $2.5M annual cloud fee per cluster), ensuring security, cost efficiency, and performance.

Essential Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (master’s degree preferred).
5+ years experience in IT/OT environments supporting automation, robotics, or advanced manufacturing systems.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks including Zero Trust architecture, ISA-62443, and NIST standards.
Demonstrated experience with MES platforms (e.g., PAS-X or TULIP), LIMS, and ELN systems integration.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or C#, and familiarity with robotic frameworks (ROS, UR platforms, or similar).
Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP compliance requirements, and pharmaceutical data integrity principles.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and IoT integration in manufacturing environments.
Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, vendor timelines, and cross-functional dependencies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders.
Comfort with risk and ambiguous situations in a rapidly evolving, first-of-its-kind program.

Desirable Qualifications

Experience working in advanced manufacturing systems and environments.
Familiarity with ISPE GAMP 5 validation framework for computerized systems.
Experience supporting FAT/SAT and IQ/OQ qualification activities.
Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
Understanding of SEC cybersecurity disclosure requirements (17 CFR Parts 229, 232, 239, 240, 249).

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $122,985.60 - $184,478.40. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we ignite ambitious thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca

Here, courage, curiosity, and collaboration fuel a relentless focus on transforming cancer outcomes, powered by a pipeline that fuses innovative science with advanced technology. You will work in an environment where unexpected teams come together to fuel bold ideas, backed by meaningful investment and a clear path from discovery to impact. We value kindness alongside ambition, and we empower leaders at every level to ask sharp questions, take smart risks, and turn data into decisions that help patients sooner.

jobs.title: DevSecOps / Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the delivery pipelines, automation, and environments that carry federal systems into production. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. It is a remote position, and a hybrid arrangement is preferred: hybrid means traveling to the client site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, typically one to two days a week. Wherever you work from, occasional travel to DC is part of the role. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your First Project Will Likely Have You Owning Assigned Delivery Pipelines And The Environments Beneath Them. Depending On The Assignment, You May

Work on the integration and deployment of enterprise tools and platforms such as SageMaker, Posit Connect, or on-demand, pre-configured EC2-based Linux virtual machines.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure validation, testing, deployment, and release promotion.
Configure cloud networking, access permissions, storage, and compute resources following established security requirements.
Build and maintain Linux machine images, including software installation, configuration, patching, and validation.
Support analytics and development environments, including user onboarding, access configuration, and software dependencies.
Troubleshoot deployment failures, connectivity problems, permissions, Linux services, and application runtime issues using logs and diagnostic tools.
Write and maintain scripts that simplify recurring operational tasks and improve consistency.
Participate in code reviews, test infrastructure changes, and document implementation details, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks.
Take ownership of assigned changes from implementation through deployment verification, collaborating with senior engineers on architectural decisions and complex incidents.

You deliver CloudFormation templates, Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), and pipelines that provide the required functionality through the enterprise tools and platforms, enforce the required controls, and produce the evidence a release review needs. You automate the manual steps out of the release path, and you build progressive delivery with automated health checks and rollback so that deploying stops being an event.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

5+ years of DevSecOps or platform engineering experience
A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline
Hands-on experience administering Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure with a working understanding of compute, storage, networking, and identity management
Practical experience with infrastructure as code (CloudFormation or the AWS Cloud Development Kit), CI/CD pipeline automation with security gates using GitHub Actions or comparable tools, and hands-on Docker image creation and containerization
Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including packages, services, permissions, and logs
Ability to write and troubleshoot scripts in Python and Bash
Understanding of least-privilege access, zero trust principles, secure configuration, and controlled deployment processes
Experience with Git-based version control
Monitoring and logging
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

Federal security experience supporting Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance, implementing National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-53 (NIST SP 800-53) controls, and providing Authority to Operate (ATO) support
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, Ansible, and software packaging experience
An Amazon Web Services certification
Nexus, Artifactory, CloudBolt, or comparable artifact management and provisioning platforms
OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication, deployment approval controls, and AWS environments spanning multiple accounts
Federal information technology experience

Who You Are

You build security and reliability into the work from the start because they cannot be afterthoughts in a federal environment. You automate what others do by hand and leave an audit trail. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

Hands-on ownership of infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines in AWS environments, together with the knowledge to build and maintain Linux machine images and navigate the intricacies of enterprise tool integrations and deployment.
Python or Bash scripting beyond pipeline configuration, so you can automate the work the tools do not cover.
A working command of cloud networking, access permissions, storage, and compute resources to deliver optimal functionality on budget and in line with security requirements.
Judgment suited to building where security and auditability are not optional.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.
