Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril Cyber is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of capabilities to enable offensive cyber missions. Cyber is a new business line at Anduril, and relies upon our fleet of autonomous vehicles, the Lattice operating system, mesh networks, and other hardware products to engage in cyber operations at the edge. We design and build novel solutions to deploy cyber capabilities in unconventional or difficult to reach environments.

The new Lattice for Cyber team will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that allow our Cyber products to operate reliably at scale. This is a founding team working from an unusually blank sheet of paper.

About The Job

As a Software Engineer in Lattice for Cyber, you will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that our offensive Cyber programs rely on. You will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way.

Above all, Anduril engineers on this team are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset — executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top-of-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes on-time and with high quality. Not only will you build the software, you’ll have the opportunity to work with the customer’s to deploy it.

What You’ll Do

Work with design teams and cyber subject matter experts to build a brand new UX product that enables US and allied nations to perform offensive cyber missions at scale.
Design and build an extensible React-based component system as a foundation for other cyber teams to build upon for their customer’s use cases and integrations.
Build the UX that powers our offensive cyber products such as command and control, autonomous cyber behavior trees, SIGINT analysis tools, and data exfiltration pipelines.
Work directly with program teams and customers as they build real missions on your products.
Contribute to technical leadership, design clarity, and long-term maintainability across a growing software stack.
Incorporate AI/LLM-enabled workflow features where they improve analyst or operator effectiveness without compromising system reliability.
Contribute back to the Lattice software platform core, allowing your products to provide value across the entire company.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production software.
Strong front-end engineering experience in modern TypeScript/React application development, Angular, Vue.js or similar tools.
Ability to debug across the full stack, including logs, networking, interfaces, configuration, and hardware/software boundaries.
Practical experience with Linux and containerized deployment.
Comfort collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams and translating ambiguous requirements into clean user experiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reviews and architecture discussions.
Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Washington, DC or the Orange County, CA metro areas.
Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time support program teams and customer events.
US security clearance eligible

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to AI/LLM integration patterns, inference workflows, tool orchestration, or model-assisted application features.
Track record of technical leadership, productization work, or direct customer interface in complex engineering environments.
Prior work delivering into air-gapped or otherwise constrained deployment environments.
Hands-on offensive or defensive cyber background.
An active U.S. Security clearance.

US Salary Range

$191,000—$253,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Job Summary

Join Caterpillar’s Electric Power Division as a Power Systems Engineer I
, supporting the design, development, and implementation of generator control switchgear systems. In this role, you will deliver automation and control solutions for complex power systems, working both independently and collaboratively to execute retrofit and new system projects from concept through commissioning.

What You Will Do

Identify retrofit opportunities, define project scope, and support proposal development with Dealer and Factory teams
Execute design, programming, testing, and commissioning of low- and medium-voltage generator paralleling control systems
Convert legacy PLC programs to current platforms and validate performance
Develop and modify PLC and HMI applications using standard templates
Partner with CAD designers to produce wiring and assembly drawings
Perform technical risk assessment and support field performance of assigned projects
Provide technical support to AES Sales and Product Support Center teams, including escalation support
Submit project documentation, reports, and expenses in a timely manner
Train and support technicians, customers, and internal teams on maintenance, troubleshooting, and system operation as needed

Degree Requirement

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or Electrical Engineering Technology (BSEET) preferred, or equivalent relevant experience

Customer Focus: Working knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
Service Excellence: Working knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.
Technical Excellence: Working knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Additional Requirements

Experience working cross-functionally with engineers, contractors, consultants, and end users
Knowledge of power systems, including switchgear, ATS, and generator systems, with ability to read electrical schematics and blueprints
Experience with automation and controls, including PLC-based systems, HMIs, and distributed control systems
PLC experience with one or more: Modicon/Schneider, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or GE
HMI experience preferred (e.g., Rockwell FactoryTalk, Siemens, Vijeo, iFix, Wonderware)
Minimum 2 years of related experience with BSEET (or BSEE), or 4 years of equivalent experience without a degree
Valid driver’s license and ability to meet background, drug, and medical requirements

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure - Self Managed Experience (SMX)
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration
, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems
across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide
, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global,
we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform
. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified.
Visionary
in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™
for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026
Most Flexible Companies
, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About The Role

We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX)
— the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure).

This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts
side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time.

SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket.

You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery).

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing

Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers — Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose — along with their documentation.
Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment.
Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized — not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases.
Take part in the team's shared medic rotation and resolve engineering-level support cases, feeding learnings back into development.
Contribute to the shared tooling (review, deployment, and test tooling) that SMX is building so other Camunda teams can adopt it — this is one of the team's current investment areas.

What success looks like (first ~3 months):

Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments.
Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements.
Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality.
Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement.
Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team.
Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description.

What You Bring

Ability and/or willingness to use our product, with genuine curiosity about the customer problem behind a ticket — comfortable asking "should we build this" as well as "how do we build this."
Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams.
A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving.
You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software.

Nice-to-haves

Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker.
Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools.
Working knowledge of the Go programming language.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure/IaC (Terraform, Crossplane) — useful as SMX moves toward shared review capability across installation artifacts and reference architectures.

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

jobs.description:
**Who Are We?**


At Parry Labs we believe the modern combat advantage relies on the speed and scale of open systems. We’re redefining the edge of the ever\-changing and increasingly ever\-changing battlespace by delivering game changing capabilities to our warfighters through digital engineering, software, and hardware solutions that are essential to our core of being a Digital Systems Integrator.


Born digital and agile, Parry Labs is building a winning team to be the premier provider for Next Generation Mission Systems Integration across air, land, sea, space and cyber.


Are you ready to be an instrumental part of experts in the industry? Join us in the innovation of integration at Parry and apply to help develop the technologies of tomorrow while reaching new heights in your career today.

**About the Job**


You will build and test Rust software for distributed mission systems under senior engineer guidance. You will develop defined components, investigate defects and learn systems programming through code reviews and integration work. You will report to a functional software engineering manager, with technical direction from the Chief Engineer.


The target start is November 2026\.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Implement defined Rust components and fixes from agreed requirements with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write unit and integration tests for expected behavior, error handling and boundary conditions.
* Debug software issues using logs, tests and development tools. Document steps to reproduce defects.
* Build simple interfaces, message handling and telemetry features using established team designs.
* Use Cargo, Git and automated checks to build, test and submit changes for review.
* Participate in code reviews and apply feedback on correctness, readability and memory safety.
* Support laboratory integration and test activities with software, systems and security engineers.
* Maintain setup instructions and component documentation. Communicate progress and raise technical blockers early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field, or equivalent training and practical experience.
* Hands\-on programming experience through coursework, internships, personal projects or employment. Prior full\-time engineering experience is not required.
* Working knowledge of Rust ownership, borrowing, basic types and error handling, plus Cargo build and test workflows.
* Understanding of basic data structures, functions and software testing. Ability to explain and debug your own code.
* Familiarity with Linux development tools and Git version control.
* Ability to work from defined requirements, ask focused questions and incorporate code\-review feedback.
* U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust coursework, internship work, open\-source contributions or a personal project with automated tests.
* Exposure to network programming, asynchronous code or concurrency.
* Experience with C/C\+\+, Python, embedded devices or hardware interfaces.
* Familiarity with continuous integration, distributed systems or positioning, navigation and timing (PNT).

**Why Join Parry Labs?**
At Parry Labs, we foster a culture of curiosity and collaboration. Employees are given the autonomy to leverage their skills in creating state\-of\-the\-art tech solutions that aid in the protection of the American Warfighter. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R-EGI Program
jobs.description:
**Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R\-EGI Program**

  


**Position Overview**


IS4S is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test software for the R\-EGI program. R\-EGI brings together GPS/GNSS, inertial sensors, and other navigation capabilities to support resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) for military aircraft.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable developing C/C\+\+ software on embedded Linux systems, bringing up software on hardware, and solving problems at the boundary between software, sensors, and avionics. The engineer will work closely with systems, navigation, hardware, and test teams through integration and qualification.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ software for navigation processing, device interfaces, middleware, and system control.
* Develop and debug software on embedded Linux platforms, including interactions with device drivers, operating system services, and hardware interfaces.
* Integrate GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, and other navigation inputs; work with navigation engineers to implement and evaluate sensor\-fusion and estimation functions.
* Diagnose system\-level issues involving software timing, sensor data, electrical interfaces, and hardware behavior.
* Support hardware bring\-up and software integration in laboratory and system integration lab environments.
* Develop automated tests, diagnostic tools, and scripts that improve software integration, regression testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including evaluation of performance when GPS is degraded or unavailable.
* Translate system and interface requirements into software designs, test procedures, and verification evidence.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect resolution, and software releases.
* Support technical reviews and program milestones, including PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification activities.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help the team resolve complex embedded software issues.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 8 or more years of embedded software engineering experience.
* Strong C and C\+\+ proficiency for embedded or real\-time applications.
* Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on embedded Linux systems.
* Experience working with hardware interfaces, device drivers, or low\-level software and diagnosing hardware/software integration issues.
* Experience using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or debuggers to troubleshoot embedded systems.
* Experience with software requirements, interface definitions, verification, and configuration management.
* Experience with Git, cross\-compilation toolchains, and automated builds.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with military aviation PNT systems, GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, inertial navigation systems, or integrated GPS/INS solutions.
* Experience with navigation estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, or operation in GPS\-degraded and GPS\-denied environments.
* Experience with aircraft avionics interfaces such as MIL\-STD\-1553 or ARINC 429\.
* Experience developing and integrating systems that use modern embedded processing platforms, such as the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+ MPSoC.
* Experience with real\-time Linux, VxWorks, INTEGRITY, or another real\-time operating system.
* Experience with software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system integration labs.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis, or diagnostic tools.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, interface diagrams, and hardware documentation.
* Experience supporting formal software qualification or airworthiness activities.
* Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.


**Benefits**


Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits


Dynamic and collaborative work environment


Employee ownership


Medical, dental, and vision care plans


Paid time\-off and parental leave programs


Group term life insurance


401(k) retirement plan


Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Leidos Defense provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions.

  

Within the Defense Sector, Leidos currently has a special opening for a talented Lead Software Engineer to work onsite in our Huntsville, AL office in support of the IFPC program, developing software for critical counter\-UAS and missile defense solutions. This position focuses on the complete software lifecycle of complex defense systems in a Linux environment using languages such as C\+\+ and Python, developed within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.

  

This is a special, high\-impact leadership role. Beyond delivering mission software, you will serve as the team’s technical lead and the driving force for AI\-assisted software engineering – bringing modern, agentic AI coding practices to the program and coaching the team so that every engineer becomes measurably more productive. The ideal candidate has built real production software with current\-generation agentic AI coding assistants and can adapt those practices to a secure environment where the newest commercial tooling is often restricted. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 12\+ years of professional software development experience (or Master’s degree \+ 10 years / PhD \+ 7 years).

* Experience building AI enablement assets: prompt/agent libraries, custom skills/agents, and automated code\-review and test\-generation pipelines that scale across a team.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join BAE Systems' Infrastructure Management Center (IMC) and help shape National Security. We are seeking a motivated Systems Engineer to join our dynamic, cross\-functional team. In this role, you will support the planning, design, and integration of complex technical challenges that support critical national security missions, including nuclear missions, production facilities, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and ammunition plant infrastructure.
  

This is an ideal role for an early\-career engineer looking to grow within a matrix\-type organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate across multiple departments, leveraging digital engineering tools and Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices to deliver cutting\-edge solutions for the warfighter.
  

  

The Role
  

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the systems integration and analysis of hardware and software systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:
* Systems Integration: Assist in the integration and analysis of military hardware and software systems/processes (or commercial equivalents).
* Technical Analysis: Support the design and analytical efforts required to optimize the management of critical infrastructure programs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work within a multi\-disciplinary team of engineers and program managers to understand customer requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Digital Tool Utilization: Utilize project management software and digital engineering tools, (CAMEO, DOORS, Etc…).
* Documentation: Assist in the creation of technical documentation, system specifications, and reports to ensure program milestones are met.
* Process Improvement: Support the implementation of Agile methodologies and continuous process improvement initiatives within the IMC.
* Requirements Management: Manage the full requirements lifecycle, including the derivation, analysis, and development of comprehensive technical requirements documents to ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and system design.
  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM field (e.g., Mathematics, Physics).
* 2 yrs technical experience 0yrs with MS) with an emphasis in Systems engineering
* Technical Aptitude: Fundamental understanding of systems design, integration, and analytical efforts.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with team members, stakeholders, and customers in a professional environment.
* Secret Security Clearance
  

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Familiarity with Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or other digital engineering tools
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and their application in a technical environment.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret.
* Any foundational certifications in Systems Engineering or Project Management.
  

  

  

**Pay Information**
  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $107359 \- $182510
  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  

  

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  

  

  

  

**About BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security**  

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  

  

Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  

  

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: TAK Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner
jobs.description:
COLSA Corporation is seeking a **Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner** to support the U.S. Army's Threat Systems Management Office (TSMO). This position will design, develop, integrate, test, and troubleshoot software solutions involving the Team Awareness Kit (TAK), including the integration of clients, servers, data pipelines, and other systems to deliver capabilities that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.



Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential functions)



* Design and orchestrate systems of systems, including clients, servers, data pipelines, and other integrated components.
* Design, develop, test, and implement software programs using Java, C\+\+, Python, React, Go, or similar technologies.
* Support software development and delivery using Jira and Kanban\-based continuous flow processes.
* Set up and maintain development environments for Windows and Linux, including containerized environments.
* Perform merge request and pull request reviews to support software quality assurance.
* Develop and implement user\-friendly interface requirements for software clients.
* Collaborate with team members and end users to analyze requirements, troubleshoot software issues, and deliver solutions that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.
* Perform systems modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Perform data analysis and provide input for reports and dashboards, as needed.
* Develop or oversee user training, troubleshooting materials, and step\-by\-step guides.
* Advise hardware design engineers on system characteristics that may affect software systems, as needed.
* Provide input for documentation of new and existing software programs, as needed.


*At COLSA, people are our most valuable resource and centered at our core value. We invite you to unite your talents with opportunity and be a part of our “Family of Professionals!” Learn about our employee\-centric culture and benefits here:* *https://www.colsa.com/culture\_benefits*

  

  

Required Experience  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Minimum of 8\-12 years of related experience.
* Hands\-on experience supporting systems integration efforts.
* Experience configuring and maintaining development environments, including Git\-based version control, Linux operating systems, and Docker containerization.
* Experience with version control software and the Driessen branching model (Gitflow).
* Practical experience with front\-end application development, including the implementation of responsive, user\-focused interfaces.
* Experience designing, developing, and integrating custom interfaces, extensions, or plugins within existing software frameworks.
* Active Secret security clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.


**Preferred Qualifications**



* Previous experience leading software development teams.
* Experience with web development technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP) experience using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Computer vision experience with object detection or gait recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and YOLO models.


Applicant selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. COLSA Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

* Experience in the development and design of electronic circuit designs, and/or multi\-assembly system/unit design

* Experience in taking design concepts from block diagram or requirements level to development of complete hardware designs, with verification via test and integration
* Experience with PCB design process and expertise with design tools (schematic capture) to analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Associate-Mid)
jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking Software Engineers to join tour team in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design, develop, integrate, test, and sustain mission‑critical command and control (C2\) software used by our warfighters and customers around the world.  

In this role, you will support Agile Software Teams, working closely with systems and test engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands‑on development, solving complex technical problems, and collaborating in a highly integrated, Agile environment.
Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications and software systems that implement logical and mathematical solutions that are aligned with program objectives.
* Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Scrum teams to develop and maintain software products across multiple software baselines for the IBCS program.
* Work in a fast\-paced environment with high expectations, diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels of the organization.
* Perform software development and upgrades in multiple programming languages/versions while minimizing changes to the operational behavior of tactical software.
* Support documentation creation and updates using Markdown and other collaboration tools.
* Support testing activities including unit and functional testing, code coverage analysis, and static code analysis; contribute to continuous improvement of test effectiveness and automation.
* Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Education, Experience and Required skills:* This role can be filled at mulitple levels
	+ Associate Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 1 year of relevant experience
	+ Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant experience, Master's degree in STEM field and 0 years of relevant experience
* Strong object\-oriented software development experience with Java and C\+\+
* Proficiency in Linux\-based development and runtime environments.
* Experience with scripting languages and tools including Bash and Python.
* Experience with modern configuration management and source control tools (Git / GitLab).
* Experience with Agile SAFe and Atlassian Agile tools including Jira and Confluence.
* Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain a clearance required.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.


Preferred Qualifications:* Experience with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including Cameo or similar tools.
* Experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to build, integrate, test and deliver software.
* Experience supporting real\-time or distributed systems using RTI/DDS publish/subscribe middleware.
* Engagement: Experience with US Army Systems including PATRIOT, LTAMDS, SENTINEL A3/A4, IFF devices, and M\_SHORAD.
* Experience with Engagement Planning and Execution, PAC2/PAC3, and AIM9x, and Indirect Fires.
* Track Management: Experience with track management including sensors, composite track, IFF devices, and Combat Identification.
* CompTIA Security\+


Physical Demands:* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. \- 5:00 p.m. Monday\-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required.


About i3:

Founded in 2007, Integration Innovation, Inc. (i3\) is headquartered in Huntsville, AL, with additional offices in Orlando, FL, and the National Capital Region. We are a 100% team member\-owned mid\-tier integrator with over 800 employee\-owners, and our culture speaks for itself: we've earned ten Best Places to Work® awards, driven by strong employee engagement, transparent leadership, and a genuine commitment to communication.  

i3 team members operate at the leading edge of national defense across a broad range of technical disciplines, from systems and software engineering to modeling, simulation, and training solutions to cybersecurity, digital engineering, and enterprise IT. We also take products from prototype through production, bringing that same engineering rigor to manufacturing and delivering hardware at scale. For candidates, that means a rare opportunity: the innovation and mission focus of an engineering services company paired with the hands\-on impact of building and delivering real solutions that benefit the Warfighter, all inside an employee\-owned company where your contributions directly shape both the mission and your ownership stake in the business.

---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real\-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today.

  

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a Staff Systems Engineer to join our team. This position will be located at Huntsville, AL to support Special Programs \& Futures in the Strategic Deterrent Systems (SDS) Division.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide systems engineering support across the TMRR phase, guiding requirements development, functional analysis, interface definition, and verification and validation for cruise missile subsystems.
* Decompose and allocate complex system and customer requirements into detailed hardware and software specifications, maintaining rigorous end to end traceability and ensuring compliance with technical, schedule, and cost constraints.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/**

Department: Engineering

Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer

Employment type: Full\-time

Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)

Position Summary

Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building.

As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast.

Key Duties \& Responsibilities

Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works.

What You’ll Work With

* Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant.

Required Qualifications

* 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

*This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.*

Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space\-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi\-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise\-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.
**About This Role**

Blue Origin is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Software Engineering team supporting TeraWave in the Greater Seattle Area. In this role, you build the foundational platform infrastructure, the operating nervous system, deployed across TeraWave satellites, user terminals, and gateways. This position focuses on embedded Linux and low\-level platform infrastructure, spanning fleet management, operating\-system services, hardware integration, security, observability, and networking performance. You will shape reliable, high\-performance systems that operate aboard LEO satellites. Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain Linux kernel modules and device drivers to support custom hardware and platform requirements.

* Work with silicon, electrical, and RF teams to bring up hardware prototypes and optimize kernels for custom SoCs.
* Debug system\-level performance issues, minimize context switching, and tune the networking stack for satellite links.

You will design and execute experiments for modeling and validation, collect and analyze data, and identify potential issues. When challenges arise, you'll be expected to propose thoughtful fixes and architectural decisions to ensure system performance and reliability.

Proficiency in C\+\+.  

  

Experience with software engineering workflows, including Git, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.  

  

Strong knowledge of system identification, estimation theory, and statistical learning methods.

Ability to communicate complex control and algorithmic concepts clearly to cross\-functional hardware and software teams.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science or similar degree.  

  

Experience in control systems development. (Such as modeling, algorithm design, simulation, implementation and/or testing)  

  

Experience in Python or MATLAB.

Experience with optimization techniques and modern control theory.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


Strategic Defense protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air\-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid\-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software\-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale.
### **ABOUT THE JOB**



We're seeking a Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Irvine, CA or Huntsville, AL. As a Software Engineer on the Strategic Defense team, you will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way. Your efforts will ensure that Anduril products seamlessly work together to achieve a variety of critical outcomes. Above all, Software Engineers are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset—executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes correctly, on\-time, and with high quality. This role will focus on the Guam Defense System Battle Manager product. Experience with mid and upper tier Air Defense Command and Control programs is a plus. You will be helping to create a new strategic business line and will work closely with the other strategic Command and Control programs within Anduril.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the software solutions that are deployed to customers
* Write code to improve products and scale the mission capability to more customers
* Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality
* Create and analyze metrics that are leveraged for debugging and monitoring
* Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next steps
* Partner with end\-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints
* Travel up to 30% of time to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
* 3\+ years working with a variety of programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, Rust, Go, JavaScript, etc.
* Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processingand analysis
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* A desire to work on critical software that has a real\-world impact
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Strong background with focus in Physics, Mathematics, and/or Motion Planning to inform modeling \& simulation (M\&S) and physical systems
* Developing and testing multi\-agent autonomous systems and deploying in real\-world environments
* Feature and algorithm development with an understanding of behavior trees
* Developing software/hardware for flight systems and safety critical functionality
* Distributed communication networks and message standards
* Knowledge of military systems and operational tactics
* Experience working with mid and upper tier Air Defense systems in the Army, Navy, Air Force or the Missile Defense Agency

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer, Battery Cell Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Automation Control Engineers are responsible for implementing equipment controls solutions for all cell manufacturing projects. This includes design, architecture and implementation of automated equipment in process and discrete mass manufacturing. Equipment will include mixing, winding, hydraulics, automated storage systems, robotics, automated case and pallet conveyance, automated guided vehicles, etc. Controls Engineers own equipment controls standard, hardware programming, robot programming, commissioning and review process of the project as well as additional functions such as auditing, installation and safety assessment.  

**What You'll Do*** Program and debug structure text and ladder logic code on multiple PLC controller platforms (Siemens, Beckhoff, B\&R, Omron)
* Develop code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable and reusable
* Create robust programs and sequences to control complex, multi\-station machinery to perform processes such as material pick and place, dispense, fastening, welding, testing and material transport
* Use Python scripting and SQL to interface equipment with Tesla Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and to collect data into production databases
* Create intuitive operator touchscreen interfaces using WinCC/MappView/TwinCAT HMI and SCADA dashboards screens using Ignition, Grafana
* Set up and tune servo drives and VFDs for fast and smooth operation (Schneider, B\&R, Beckhoff, Siemens, SEW)
* Design and implement control reliable safety systems for safeguarding robots, gantries, conveyors, and other high\-volume manufacturing equipment as per codes and standards
* Manage electrical cabinet builds, field wiring, pneumatic and fluid plumbing
* Participate in initial equipment conceptual development and carefully balance product specifications, process requirements, layout complexity, cost, and lead\-time limits
* Manage suppliers during specification, design, buyoff and installation of automated manufacturing equipment
  

**What You'll Bring*** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science or 5\+ years’ experience in Control Systems Design and Implementation, or equivalent experience
* PLC (Siemens, Beckhoff or B\&R preferred)
* Human Machine Interface (HMI / GUI – Beckhoff View, WinCC, Ignition)
* Proficiency creating detailed electrical and fluid schematics in CAD (EPLAN preferred)
* Structured Text (IEC 61131\-3\) programming skills
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$91,600 \- $164,400/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Satellites
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next\-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware\-rich, and low\-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high\-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.



Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long\-term space economy.



Vast is looking for a **Senior Avionics Systems Engineer**, reporting to the **Senior Manager, Avionics and Power Systems**, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of high power satellites.



This will be a **full\-time, exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer – Digital/Analog Hardware Design
jobs.description:
Torrey Pines Logic – Sector Optics is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** with strong analog and digital hardware design experience to join a fast\-moving, multi\-project engineering environment. This role will be involved across the full hardware development lifecycle, from component selection and circuit design through PCB development, prototyping, validation, manufacturing, and product release.

jobs.title: JR SYSTEMS ENGINEER
jobs.description:
**Launch Your Engineering Career with Birdi Systems!**

  

Birdi Systems, Inc. (BSI) is seeking a motivated **Junior Systems Engineer** with a background in Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering to support, maintain, troubleshoot, and deploy integrated security, communications, and infrastructure systems across aviation, transportation, and government facilities.


This entry\-level engineering role bridges traditional engineering disciplines, IT infrastructure, and security operations. It is ideal for recent graduates or early\-career professionals seeking hands\-on experience working with mission\-critical systems that support airports, transportation networks, and government operations.


You will work alongside experienced engineers and project teams in both field and office environments, gaining practical experience in systems integration, networking, low\-voltage infrastructure, and client\-facing technical support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Troubleshoot and perform root\-cause analysis across multiple system layers, including power, cabling, networking, software platforms, and end\-user interfaces
* Maintain, repair, and optimize physical infrastructure, including low\-voltage systems, power distribution, communications equipment, and connected devices
* Assist with the installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning of integrated technology systems
* Configure and troubleshoot IP\-based networks, including switches, VLANs, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and connected devices
* Support security and communications platforms, including Video Management Systems (VMS), access control systems, alarm monitoring systems, and situational awareness technologies
* Monitor system performance, review logs and alerts, identify trends, and recommend preventive maintenance actions
* Respond to service requests, perform preventive maintenance, and maintain accurate service documentation and reports
* Participate in site visits, system assessments, testing, and deployment activities
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, network drawings, equipment layouts, and technical documentation
* Assist with the development of reports, procedures, system diagrams, and engineering documentation
* Collaborate with engineers, technicians, project managers, vendors, and customers to resolve technical issues and support project delivery
* Participate in design reviews and contribute recommendations for system improvements and risk mitigation
* Communicate technical information effectively to customers and stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements, security standards, industry codes, and project specifications
* Stay current on emerging technologies and participate in training and certification programs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline
* 0–2 years of relevant experience (internships, co\-ops, laboratory experience, and academic projects are welcome)
* Basic understanding of electrical and electronic systems
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, and network troubleshooting
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and network documentation
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites as required

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to security technologies such as CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, fire/life safety, or communications systems
* Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, or other engineering design software
* Experience with low\-voltage infrastructure, structured cabling, or IT systems
* Understanding of systems integration principles
* Interest in pursuing professional certifications such as EIT, CCNA, BICSI, Security\+, or related credentials

**What You'll Gain:**

* Hands\-on experience supporting large\-scale airport, transportation, and government infrastructure projects
* Exposure to multidisciplinary engineering, networking, security systems, and systems integration
* Direct mentorship from experienced engineers, project managers, and technical leaders
* Opportunities for technical training, professional certifications, and career advancement
* Experience working on mission\-critical systems that have a direct impact on public safety and transportation operations
* A clear path toward future Systems Engineer, Project Engineer, or Project Manager roles

**Why Birdi Systems?**


At Birdi Systems, you'll be part of a team delivering advanced security, communications, and situational awareness solutions that keep critical infrastructure operating safely and efficiently. Early\-career engineers are given meaningful responsibilities, hands\-on field experience, and direct access to experienced mentors, accelerating both technical and professional growth.


We invest in our people through training, certifications, and diverse project exposure, providing a strong foundation for long\-term career success. If you're looking for an opportunity to apply your engineering education, develop practical technical skills, and grow within a fast\-paced technology environment, Birdi Systems offers an exceptional place to start your career.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Project Manager

This experienced person will utilize their professional background to provide project management and design engineering on winery, custom residential, restaurants, apartment buildings and other commercial building type projects.

As an Electrical Project Manager at Summit, you will serve as the firm’s direct contact with the client and will be responsible for developing and maintaining positive relationships with clients. You will be responsible for design team leadership, internal project organization, preparing project proposals, design engineering, scheduling and budgeting, as well as business development and generating new work for the firm. The job requires getting things done quickly, handling a variety of activities, and effectively delegating to others. Being able to purposely drive toward results while problem\-solving and engaging the commitment of others is essential.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

In addition to duties and responsibilities of Project Engineer:

* Responsible for preparation of project proposals.

* Prepares project specifications including conditions of contract and General Conditions.

* Provides input to the Principal in Charge and the Division Manager regarding staffing decisions for a project.
* Maintains close communication with the client, making the client aware of progress, problems, and scope changes. Develops a trusting relationship with the client.

* Responsible for meeting project budget and schedule objectives and provides input to project team and Principal in Charge regarding status of project and budget. Takes action to seek approval for additional services prior to beginning work.
* Performs regular operational tasks that support the overall health of the firm and inform the management team of firm performance (i.e., invoicing, backlog, contract management).
* Provides mentoring and training for staff in Summit systems. Provides training or serves as resource to staff regarding engineering design principles and concepts and/or problem resolution.
* Provides input to the management team regarding staff performance reviews and training needs.
* Coordinates in\-house and/or external consultant\-based design teams as required for the successful completion of the work.
* Effectively manages several projects at one time.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor.

**Qualifications/Skills:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering, with a concentration in power distribution or lighting design.
* Registered Professional Electrical Engineer.
* Minimum five years of related project management and engineering experience.
* Demonstrates a proficient knowledge of AutoCAD, Bluebeam Civil 3D, or Revit.
* Exhibits strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with use of computers including spreadsheets, word processing, and engineering software and ability to prepare electronic design documents.
* Ability to oversee the work of others and delegate work effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and budgets, and meet project deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate in\-house and/or external consultant\-based design teams.

* Short circuit analysis
* Emergency power distribution systems
* Lighting design
* Lighting control systems
* Title 24 Lighting
* Must maintain a valid Driver’s License.
* Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Summit Engineering, Inc. is a multi\-disciplined design engineering firm located in the heart of beautiful Sonoma County, in Santa Rosa, CA. Our Civil, Wastewater, Structural and Electrical engineering and Planning divisions provide consulting services for wineries, high\-end residential properties, resorts, and other private sector projects. Summit Engineering has been voted as a “Best Places to Work” for twenty years. We work a 9/80 schedule, which means you have every other Friday off. * Referral program
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) — Central Security
jobs.description:
You'll be joining Central Security, Meta's first line of defense technology team that manages risk across critical security domains. As part of this organization, you'll work within a cross\-functional team of engineers, analysts, product managers, and program managers, collaborating closely with professionals across Product, Infrastructure and Enterprise Engineering teams. You will develop automated and autonomous security systems using AI/ML in high\-impact security domains including Identity and Access Management, Product Security, Threat Detection, Detection \& Response. This organization operates at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and enterprise security, where you'll help shape how Meta approaches security across our entire technology stack, from custom\-built systems to commercial software such as cloud services and increasingly sophisticated AI/ML systems.  

  

  

### **Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) — Central Security Responsibilities:**

* In this position, you'll drive security solutions that protect Meta's most critical assets while enabling rapid innovation, particularly in the AI/ML space. Your primary focus will be architecting and implementing security frameworks for large\-scale AI/ML products and features, ensuring that secure\-by\-design principles are embedded throughout the entire AI/ML lifecycle from conception to deployment. You'll act as a Senior Individual Contributor in a combined organization of Security Engineers, Security Analysts, and Software Engineers to implement security solutions and platforms that serve the entire company and our billions of users. Your strategic thinking will be essential as you determine the highest\-risk items across all security domains, then guide the team through developing detailed threat models and comprehensive solutions. A significant portion of your role involves identifying, assessing and mitigating security risks that are unique to AI/ML systems and products built on top of them — including classical ML, agentic product features, and the risks associated with frontier models. Your influence extends beyond your immediate team — you'll navigate complex tradeoffs between security requirements and operational friction, ensuring Meta can maintain its pace of innovation while remaining secure. This means representing these critical tradeoffs to senior leadership including VPs and C\-levels, where your recommendations will directly influence company\-wide security decisions.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience leading projects with industry\-wide impact
* Vast experience communicating and working across functions to drive solutions
* Significant experience in mentoring/influencing engineers across organizations
* Proven track record of planning multi\-year roadmap in which shorter\-term projects ladder to the long term vision
* Experience in driving large cross\-functional/industry\-wide engineering efforts
* 12\+ years coding experience in C, C\+\+, Java and/or C\#
* 12\+ years experience building server applications

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Security, or related field
* Expertise in AI/ML security domains (e.g., threat modeling for ML systems, ML system design, secure model development, adversarial machine learning)
* Hands\-on experience with agentic development using Frontier AI models
* Proficiency with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks
* Experience with regulatory frameworks and compliance for AI/ML systems
* Familiarity with Meta's technology stack or similar large\-scale environments
* Passion for securing cutting\-edge systems that impact billions of users worldwide

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com.
