jobs.description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.
  
  

Applications are accepted until further notice.
  
  

Meet The Team
  
The Cisco Wireless Test\& Automation team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next\-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real\-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.
  
  

Your Impact
  
As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands\-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI\-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high\-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:
  
  

* Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
* Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
* Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
* Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
* Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
* Learn and apply AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation


**Minimum Qualification:**  

* Meet one of the following(completed within the past3 years or expected to be completed within the next12 months):
* A Master's degreewith0 years of work experience; or
* A Bachelor's degreewith 2 years of work experience.
* Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineeringor a related field.
* Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills with a detail\-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
* Curious and interested in AI\-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.


**Preferred Qualification:**  

* Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
* Familiarity with setting up small network environments
* Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi\-Fi / 802\.11\)
* Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

---------------

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is seeking a **Manager Manufacturing Systems Engineering 2** to join our Advanced Manufacturing Technology organization in **Palmdale, CA or El Segundo, CA**

  

This leadership position is responsible for managing a team of Manufacturing Systems Engineers focused on the development, implementation, and transition of advanced manufacturing and digital worker technologies that improve production efficiency, affordability, quality, and workforce effectiveness. The role supports manufacturing operations through deployment of innovative solutions across factory environments, including connected worker and digital manufacturing capabilities.


The selected candidate will lead the team in defining and executing technology solutions that support production applications and operational objectives. This includes oversight of solution development, process performance, technology transition, and alignment with program, business, and customer requirements.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead a team in the development, implementation, and transition of manufacturing systems and process solutions for production applications and advanced technologies.
* Oversee digital worker and manufacturing enablement solutions, including digital work instructions, augmented reality/virtual reality, connected worker tools, wearable and mobile devices, edge devices, IIoT, RFID, automation enablement, and data\-driven manufacturing capabilities.
* Ensure requirements are incorporated into development plans and evaluate process, system, and tool performance to confirm effectiveness in production environments.
* Identify and address technical, schedule, cost, and quality issues to support achievement of program and contractual objectives.
* Provide leadership in design concepts, technology maturity, manufacturing readiness, and specification compliance to ensure effective use of resources and manufacturing techniques.
* Collaborate with operations, quality, engineering, digital/IT, program leadership, and executive management to align solutions with business and production needs.
* Oversee project scope, cost, schedule, and execution for team assignments and development efforts.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvement across manufacturing systems and worker\-enablement technologies.

 **Functional Leadership**

* Lead employee development through performance management, coaching, engagement, training oversight, and career development.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, retention, and staffing allocation to support current and projected business needs.
* Prioritize team resources across multiple programs and initiatives.
* Support Bid \& Proposal activities and program gate reviews.
* Provide leadership in resolving technical, financial, staffing, and execution challenges across programs.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performing team environment.

  

We offer a first shift, 4/10 or 9/80 work schedule, flexible work arrangements, strong learning opportunities, broad program exposure, and a collaborative team environment.

  

Our Leaders at Northrop Grumman live our values daily and encourage our teams to do the same. ***We do the right thing:*** upholding the highest ethical standards and facilitating a safe and respectful environment that attracts, retains, and inspires a diverse and engaged team. ***We do what we promise:*** holding yourself and others accountable to meet predictable and balanced results. ***We commit to shared success:***operating as OneNG and removing barriers for our teams. Finally, ***We pioneer:*** setting a vision that shapes the future and inspires others.

 **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 9 years of combined technical and leadership experience in engineering, aviation, systems engineering, aerospace, or manufacturing/production; OR Master’s degree in a STEM discipline with 7 years of combined technical and leadership experience in engineering, aviation, systems engineering, aerospace, or manufacturing/production.
* Experience leading an engineering team, technical team, project, or integrated product team.
* Experience with project/program management, including proposal support, scheduling, budget tracking, and execution.
* Must have an active DoD Secret clearance with a periodic reinvestigation or original adjudication date completed within the last 5 years and the ability to obtain and maintain Special Program Access.
* Ability to travel 10–15% of the time.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Current Special Program Access.
* Experience working with IPTs, stakeholders, and customers such as the Air Force and Navy.
* Familiarity with process development and process controls.
* Experience in manufacturing systems, advanced manufacturing technologies, or digital manufacturing solutions.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, sound technical judgment, and ability to make timely decisions with limited information.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Platform Engineer to support the deployment, validation, and operation of large\-scale solutions. This role focuses on system bring\-up, hardware and firmware validation, and operational reliability across storage, compute, and networking infrastructure.


You will work closely with senior engineers to ensure systems are correctly configured, stable, and performant: from BIOS settings and firmware versions to OS behavior and device health.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Perform system bring\-up and validation, including BIOS configuration, firmware updates, and OS\-level checks.
* Configure and verify platform settings (BIOS, BMC, OS) to ensure systems meet performance, reliability and consistency standards.
* Execute and validate firmware updates across components, including NVMe drives, NICs, and system firmware.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues related to:
* Device initialization and visibility.
* Firmware mismatches or upgrade failures.
* Misconfigurations impacting performance or stability.
* Understand, define and test procedures for:
* Drive swaps and rebuilds.
* Data integrity and system health checks.
* Minimizing impact to running systems.
* Monitor and validate storage device health, including basic performance characteristics and failure indicators.
* Work with Linux systems to verify configuration, collect diagnostics, and assist in debugging issues.
* Collaborate with senior engineers to escalate and help triage complex cross\-layer issues.
* Contribute to documentation and standardization of bring\-up, validation, and operational procedures.

**What will you bring to DDN**
------------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in systems, infrastructure, or platform\-focused engineering roles.
* Comfortable working directly with hardware and firmware, including BIOS, BMC, and device\-level tools.
* Solid understanding of Linux systems administration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with storage and networking fundamentals (NVMe, NICs, basic I/O concepts).
* Experience performing and supporting firmware updates, with awareness of risk and failure scenarios.
* Good scripting skills; familiarity with Go is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, able to verify configurations and catch subtle issues.
* Willingness to learn and grow into deeper system, performance, and debugging responsibilities.
* Curiosity about why systems perform the way they do: investigate, rather than just run scripts blindly.


Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out\-of\-the\-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. Current programs span high\-power, large\-scale ground terminals for missile defense to commercial airline and helicopter connectivity solutions.  

We are looking to add a **Systems Engineer II** to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading\-edge phased arrays for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.



In this position, you will be responsible for leading the systems engineering activities required to define, develop, integrate, verify, and support complex aerospace systems throughout the product lifecycle. This role translates mission objectives, customer requirements, and system architecture into technical solutions that enable successful system integration and mission execution.



Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, the Senior Systems Engineer collaborates with software, hardware, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, integration and test, mission operations, and program management teams to ensure systems meet technical, operational, cost, and schedule objectives. * Develop system verification and validation strategies, including verification methods (test, analysis, demonstration, and inspection), acceptance criteria, and verification levels aligned with program requirements.
* Define verification configurations, including hardware, software, firmware, and test environments required to support verification activities.
* Develop and maintain verification documentation, verification cross\-reference matrices (VCRM), requirements traceability matrices, and verification evidence packages.
* Partner with Integration \& Test teams to plan, coordinate, and support system integration and verification activities.
* Evaluate test results, resolve technical discrepancies, and support corrective actions to ensure compliance with system requirements.
* Support technical planning, Program Increment (PI) planning, staffing assessments, and engineering execution activities.
* Prioritize systems engineering activities to meet technical, cost, schedule, and program milestones.
* Participate in technical reviews, design reviews, customer meetings, and engineering milestone activities.
* Mentor junior engineers on systems engineering best practices, requirements development, traceability, verification, and technical documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, systems engineering rigor, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams to support successful program execution.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.
### **JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
* A minimum of 2 years of experience with an emphasis on space\-based communication payloads.
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering principles and the systems development lifecycle.
* Experience developing, managing, and verifying system and subsystem requirements.
* Knowledge of systems architecture, interface management, systems integration, and configuration management.
* Understanding verification, validation, and systems integration processes.
* Ability to interpret customer requirements, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), and technical specifications to develop engineering solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams.

### **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Familiarity with spacecraft mission planning, launch support, and on\-orbit operations.
* Experience supporting spacecraft system integration, mission readiness, and operational activities.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated engineering programs.

jobs.title: Sr. Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Controls Engineer

Location: Loveland, CO  
Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Approximately 30% Travel

We’re looking for a Senior Controls Engineer who knows industrial automation and can own projects from programming through startup.

This is a hands\-on role. You’ll be working on custom automation equipment, programming PLCs and HMIs, troubleshooting systems, supporting installations, and working directly with customers and the rest of the engineering team.

The biggest thing we’re looking for is someone who is genuinely strong with Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell controls and is comfortable walking into a machine or automation system, figuring out what’s going on, and getting it running.

You do not need to be a robotics expert. Robotics and vision experience are a plus, but strong controls experience is much more important.

What you’ll be doing:

* Programming and troubleshooting Allen\-Bradley PLCs using Studio 5000
* Developing and modifying HMI applications
* Designing controls for new automation equipment
* Debugging and commissioning equipment in\-house and at customer facilities
* Working with drives, servos, sensors, safety systems, industrial networks, and other controls hardware
* Troubleshooting electrical and controls issues
* Supporting projects from design through installation and startup
* Working directly with customers during commissioning and startup
* Helping guide less experienced engineers when needed
* Traveling to customer sites for installations, startups, and service work

Travel is typically around 30% and comes with the territory in custom automation. It won’t be every week, but you should be comfortable getting on\-site when a project needs you.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for someone with solid real\-world controls experience, not someone who has only made minor PLC changes or supported existing equipment.

Ideally, you have:

* Strong Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell PLC programming experience
* Strong Studio 5000 experience
* HMI programming experience
* Experience with industrial automation or custom machinery
* Experience commissioning and starting up equipment
* Strong electrical troubleshooting ability
* Experience with VFDs, servos, safety systems, sensors, and industrial networks
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Good communication skills with both customers and other engineers

Experience with Fanuc robots, Keyence vision systems, or robotic automation is a plus, but it is not required.

Why this role is worth looking at:

This isn’t a plant maintenance controls job where you’ll spend your day keeping the same equipment alive.

You’ll work on different automation projects, solve different problems, and be involved in projects from the engineering stage all the way through startup.

If you like building things, troubleshooting equipment, programming controls, and seeing a project actually come to life, this is the kind of role you’ll probably enjoy.

We’re looking for someone in the Northern Colorado / Denver\-area market, or someone who is seriously planning to relocate to the area.

Pay: $118,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

We are seeking a **Software\-Focused Systems Engineer** in our **Broomfield, CO** location to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements and guide software\-intensive systems from concept through integration, operation, and validation. This role combines requirements engineering, system modeling, interface definition, troubleshooting, change analysis, risk management, V\&V support, and limited software development. This role offers the opportunity to work on a hybrid schedule. Employees are expected to work at their assigned location and may work remotely up to 2 days per week, with approval.

All applicants for placement in safety\-sensitive positions will be required to submit to a pre\-employment drug test.
### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Translate stakeholder needs into clear, testable system and software requirements with end\-to\-end traceability.
* Develop functional flows, block definition diagrams, behavioral models, system architectures, and Interface Control Documents.
* Allocate requirements and functions across software, hardware, users, and external systems.
* Assist troubleshooting by reproducing failures, analyzing logs and system behavior, isolating causes across subsystem boundaries, and recommending corrective actions.
* Perform change\-impact analysis across requirements, architecture, interfaces, implementation, risks, and verification.
* Advise V\&V teams on acceptance criteria, test coverage, failure scenarios, and expected system behavior.
* Lead or support FMEAs, define mitigations, assess residual risk, and ensure mitigations are implemented and verified.
* Support design, integration, technical reviews, defect investigations, and release\-readiness decisions.
* Develop prototypes, simulations, test tools, or production software when needed to reduce technical risk or support delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and mentor junior software developers and systems engineers through design guidance, artifact and code reviews, troubleshooting support, and knowledge sharing.
* Promote consistent engineering practices for requirements, system modeling, software design, verification, risk management, and technical decision documentation.
### **YOU MUST HAVE:**

* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree
* Minimum 8\+ years of combined software engineering and systems engineering experience, with demonstrated responsibility in both disciplines.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience developing requirements, system models, interfaces, and verification criteria.

* Due to national security requirements imposed by the U.S. Government, candidates for this position must not be a People's Republic of China national or Russian national unless the candidate is also a U.S. citizen.
### **WE VALUE:**

* Master’s degree in systems engineering, software engineering, computer science, related field, or equivalent experience preferred.
* Experience troubleshooting complex\-integrated systems using logs, test evidence, software behavior, and structured root\-cause analysis.
* Working knowledge of software architecture, APIs, source code, configuration, and system integration.

The TSI supports warfighter training using the Ground\-based Midcourse Defense (GMD) Fire Control \& Communications (GFC/C) system, on the GMD System Trainer (GST). **Essential Functions:**

* Ensure correct start up and operation of the GFC/C Training System
* Coordinate with contractor and Government personnel to schedule training systems and de\-conflict them with other activities
* Verification/modification of training configurations

* Maintain necessary documentation
* Manage System logs

Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

  

SEL manufactures intelligent electronic devices (IED), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), and logic controllers that provide state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, communication, and protection of power systems in multiple industries.

  

SEL Engineering Services (SEL ES) is the sector of SEL that creates solutions to target applications of SEL equipment for worldwide customers. The SEL ES engineering team designs, develops, tests, and commissions projects to meet our customers’ requirements. Applications include, but are not limited to:

* Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution
* Industrial Plants and Universities– Substation and Switchgear
* Renewables – Wind, Solar, and BESS

  

SEL ES \- Automation projects focus on data collection of system IEDs, logic controls, and the presentation of data for the customer to monitor and control their power system.


Utilizing real\-time logic controllers and communication equipment, the SEL ES Automation engineer owns the planning, design, development, testing and commissioning of the project. Projects often include, but are not limited to:

* Communication network equipment
* Configuration of real\-time controllers to serve as RTUs.
* Human Machine Interface (HMI) or server to an upstream SCADA client.

jobs.title: O&RE Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Overhaul and Repair Engineering (O\&RE) is a large organization that supports the top U.S. Navy priority of fleet readiness by accomplishing overhaul, repair, and modernization work on active duty SEAWOLF, VIRGINIA, OHIO, and LOS ANGELES class submarines. The organization is involved with all aspects of a project starting with planning and development of technical work documents through supporting final system test and ship certification at Electric Boat’s shipyard and various off\-site U.S. Navy shipyards and facilities. Frequent opportunities exist to travel to other submarine repair facilities in support of Electric Boat contracted fleet maintenance work.  

Overhaul and Repair Engineering is cognizant of almost all systems and components on a submarine, functioning as a dynamic multi\-discipline team involving electrical systems, mechanical/piping systems, and structural components. In order to accomplish its mission, the U.S. Navy needs to minimize the time submarines spend in the shipyard being repaired which requires work to be performed in shifts to maximize progress made each day. This posting is focused on applicants seeking to provide real\-time creative, technical leadership and problem resolution to skilled trades working the afternoon / evening shift, directly impacting the submarine’s ability to return to sea. This includes guidance on navigating unforeseen shipboard conditions; tailoring work procedures to meet unique configurations; and accounting for the realities of fabrication, manufacturing, installation, and testing of shipboard systems and equipment.
Common Electrical Systems* Non\-propulsion electronic systems, including fly\-by\-wire ship control, weapons launch control, navigation, sonar, instrumentation and indications
* Power distribution, electrical methods, electrical hull penetrators, and electromechanical actuation.
* Voice communications, interior communication circuits, and fiber\-optic data distribution.


Common Mechanical/Piping Systems* Valves, actuators, main condensers/heat exchangers, pipe and machinery fabrication and welding
* Weapons and countermeasure launching, steering and diving, hatch operability, masts and antennas, shaft and propulsion, hydraulics, and compressed air.


Common Structural Components* Pressure hull boundary and non\-pressure hull boundary ship structures
* Structure fabrication and welding
* Submarine coating and cathodic protection
* Non\-metallic coverings and treatments

  

O\&RE operates in a collaborative and fast paced manner to ensure safety, stealth, maneuverability, and habitability of a submarine are maintained to the highest level. Engineers interface consistently with other Electric Boat departments including scheduling, quality assurance, material sourcing, contracts, cost engineering, system testing, operations skilled trades, and project management as well as U.S. Navy submariners. On the job training as well as training under more experienced engineers or subject matter experts will be provided.  

Job responsibilities:* Planning of submarine maintenance, repair, and modernization work through the development of clear and concise procedures contained in technical work documents. This includes interpretation of shipbuilding specifications, military specifications and standards, maintenance requirements, construction drawings, and contractual requirements.
* Providing in\-person proactive support to shipyard execution efforts onboard submarines and throughout the shipyard.
* Hands\-on troubleshooting to provide timely technical resolutions for execution roadblocks.
* Collaborating with O\&RE system engineers as well as interfacing departments to ensure compliance with Shipyard and U.S. Navy procedures.
* Evaluating technical rationale to support the approval of non\-conforming conditions.
* Supporting test and certification of systems impacted by the technical work documents.
* Assisting with off\-site projects at various Electric Boat and U.S. Navy facilities.
* Developing an understanding of specific non\-nuclear areas and systems of a submarine identified in the technical work documents.


O\&RE has offices in Groton, Kings Bay, Puget, and Hawaii.
  

This opening has potential to work first or second shift in Groton, or any of the sister sites.
Qualifications:

Required:* Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Engineering
* 0\-5 year of post\-graduate engineering experience.
* A strong ability to solve technical problems.
* Aptitude for learning and applying technical requirements.
* The ability to obtain Department of Defense (DoD) Secret clearance.
* Willingness to travel and support extended off\-site assignments as needed.
* Candidates must be willing and physically able to climb steep stairs and ladders to enter submarine and dry\-docks, ascend/descend scaffolding, and enter confined spaces.


Preferred:* Bachelor of Science Degree or higher in Electrical Engineering
* An active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance.
* The flexibility to support critical work and schedule needs in a supportive team environment.
* Willingness to travel and support extended off\-site assignments as needed


Skills:

Candidates must possess strong written and oral communication skills and be able to effectively collaborate with a wide range of internal and external organizations at multiple levels of management. Candidates must be highly motivated and well organized with strong project management skills and be capable of working both independently and in a team environment. The candidate must have a strong fundamental understanding of engineering concepts and basic understanding of relationship between electronic, mechanical/piping, and structural systems/components.
Physical Qualifications: Climbing, Crawling, Kneeling, Reaching, Stooping, Twisting Environmental Attributes: Cold, Hot, Inside, Outside

jobs.title: Systems Engineer III - Ground Electrical Subsystems
jobs.description:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
As a systems engineer with established expertise across the full SE development lifecycle, you will own subsystem requirements for electrical systems on New Glenn's launch pad infrastructure. You will deeply understand and communicate the impacts of design and verification decisions, driving cross\-functional resolution from specification through verification.


This role requires close collaboration with EGSE (Electrical Ground Support Equipment) and DSCE (Data Systems and Controls Engineering) designers, supporting CONOPS development and building strong working relationships with the engineers and operators who design, build, and test these systems. EGSE and DSCE fall within the "C3" discipline \- Command, Communication and Controls. You'll interface regularly with New Glenn Systems Engineering, the Launch Ops Architecture team, and participate in gated design reviews.


We're looking for someone whose core strength is electrical systems, who also brings enough breadth in adjacent disciplines (controls, software, structures, fluids) to understand how electrical subsystems interact with the rest of the vehicle/pad ecosystem.


**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Co\-lead assessment and definition of electrical subsystem solutions for the next\-generation Launch Pad
* Serve as the SE focal point for one or more C3 subsystems — hands\-on collaboration with designers
* Electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) design and documentation
* Own verification planning, tracking, and coordination for electrical systems, while understanding downstream impacts on controls, software, and structural interfaces
* Plan and coordinate subsystem test/activation/commissioning with the Operations Team
* Apply technical expertise to problem solving throughout product lifecycle, including design review support and verification planning and execution, scheduling, etc.
* Conduct strategic subsystem lookaheads, flagging emergent risks related to C3 or cross\-discipline integration issues
* Support milestone design reviews with electrical\-specific technical rigor, while collaborating effectively with controls, avionics, fluids and structural SEs
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on systems or design engineering experience, with a primary emphasis on electrical systems
* Working knowledge of continuity system design/conceptualization — routing, sizing, component selection, testing
* Hands\-on build\-up or testing experience
* Familiarity with at least one additional discipline — controls, software, avionics, fluids, or structures — sufficient to collaborate effectively across subsystem boundaries (this is a plus, not a requirement to exclude strong electrical\-only candidates)
* B.S. degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field
* Robust written and verbal communication skills — ability to translate C3 systems complexity for cross\-functional stakeholders
* Ability to identify, prioritize, and drive systems engineering tasks independently
* Ability to travel up to 25%
* Experience with requirement management tools (e.g., DOORS/DNG) or willingness to learn
* Experience with aerospace or industrial safety standards and verification methods
* Must be a U.S. citizen, national, or permanent resident (Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted refugee/asylee

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with RF systems
* Cross\-disciplinary experience integrating electrical systems with software/controls/avionics and fluids (e.g., valve actuation logic, sensor integration, automated fluid sequencing)
* SE tools: JIRA, Microsoft Project/Visio
* Experience conducting Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
* Graduate degree in related engineering or technical field
* Experience developing and testing complex electronic systems combining hardware, firmware, and software
* Experience with Launch Pad and / or Test Operations
* Knowledge of NFPA or other standards related to electrical systems

jobs.title: Production Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Chromalloy is a global engineering \& solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely \& reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
  
**Video:** What We Do
  
Why work at Chromalloy?
  
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem\-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem\-solvers delivering world\-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
  
Our Total Rewards Program is designed to support you today and in the future.
  
* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development \& progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.


Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.
  
  

Job Summary
  
We’re looking for a Production Automation Engineer to support the reliability, performance, and availability of automated manufacturing systems across our facility. As the site’s technical expert in industrial automation, you’ll troubleshoot and optimize robotics, CNC equipment, PLCs, vision systems, and manufacturing system integrations to minimize downtime and improve production performance.
  
  

Work That Matters
  
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. Whether you're improving processes, supporting operations, solving technical challenges, or driving business performance, your contributions help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
  
  

**Location:** Tampa, FL
  
**Schedule:** Hybrid (3 days a week onsite)
  
  

What You’ll Be Doing
  
* Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize automated manufacturing equipment, including robotic cells, CNC machines, PLC\-controlled systems, vision systems, and material\-handling equipment.
* Diagnose automation and controls failures, restore equipment safely, and implement corrective actions that improve reliability and uptime.
* Support industrial robots, including programming, communications, motion control, calibration, tooling configurations, and system backups.
* Troubleshoot CNC communications, automation interfaces, and integrations with robots, conveyors, inspection systems, and peripheral equipment.
* Modify and support PLC and HMI applications, industrial PCs, sensors, drives, servos, VFDs, safety controllers, and industrial networks.
* Maintain control system documentation, electrical drawings, equipment backups, firmware records, and change controls.
* Support integrations between production equipment and MES, SCADA, historian, database, and other enterprise systems.
* Develop and maintain SQL queries, reports, and data\-extraction tools used to monitor and analyze production performance.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, IT, equipment manufacturers, and system integrators to resolve technical issues.
* Participate in root cause investigations, equipment upgrades, retrofits, obsolescence planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop standards and best practices for automation system maintenance and support.


What We’re Looking For
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting industrial automation equipment in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience troubleshooting PLC\-controlled manufacturing systems.
* Experience supporting industrial robotics and automated manufacturing cells.
* Experience supporting CNC equipment and machine\-tool automation.
* Working knowledge of industrial communication networks and protocols.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases and relational database concepts.
* Experience integrating or supporting automation systems connected to enterprise relational database platforms.

jobs.title: Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
About Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions
  
Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions is a fast\-growing defense technology company headquartered in the Tampa Bay area, Florida. Founded by U.S. and U.K. veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real\-world employment of unmanned systems.
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking a detail\-oriented Junior Electrical Engineering Technician to join our electrical integration team. In this role, you will build, integrate, and test wire harnesses, low\-voltage electrical systems, and autonomy components for marine applications. You will work directly with the lead electrical engineer on marine power distribution, wire sizing, network topologies, and sensitive electronics, ensuring high\-quality standards for marine durability and operational reliability.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
**Harness \& Cable Fabrication:** Build, break out, route, and terminate low\-voltage wire harnesses and custom cable assemblies.
  
**Hardware \& Systems Integration:** Mount and wire autonomy hardware, sensors, marine communications equipment, Ethernet switches, and CAN bus networks.
  
**Physical Installation:** Route cabling neatly through tight marine spaces, bulkheads, and conduits, ensuring proper strain relief, bend radius, and chafe protection.
  
**Testing \& Verification:** Conduct continuity, pinout, voltage, and ground checks; assist engineering with troubleshooting electrical and wiring faults.
  
**Component Assembly:** Perform precision hand soldering, weather\-sealing, heat shrinking, and lug crimping.
  
Required Qualifications
  
**Hands\-on Experience:** 2\+ years of electrical assembly, wire harness building, or technician experience (marine, automotive, robotics, or industrial context preferred).
  
**Electrical Diagnostics:** Experience using Digital Multimeters (DMM), bench power supplies, and signal test equipment for troubleshooting and pinout validation.
  
**Tools \& Assembly Techniques:** Proficiency in precision hand soldering, heat shrinking, weather\-sealing, and operating manual/hydraulic crimpers for heavy\-gauge lugs.
  
**Power Systems:** Practical familiarity working with 12–48VDC and 120VAC electrical systems.
  
**Schematics \& Diagrams:** Ability to accurately read and interpret electrical schematics, pinout tables, and wiring diagrams
  
Preferred Experience
  
2–3 years of experience in marine electrical systems, unmanned surface vessels (USVs), or vehicle prototyping.
  
Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automotive, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
Familiarity with CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANalyzer, Kvaser, Peak PCAN, Vehicle Spy).
  
ABYC (American Boat and Yacht Council) Electrical Certification.
  
Work Environment
  
Primarily onsite at Marcurius facilities in Clearwater, Florida, with direct work in workshops, vessels, docks, and field\-testing environments. The role supports prototype development, electrical integration, and sea\-trial preparation in a fast\-paced setting with changing priorities and close cooperation across engineering, software, operations, and test teams.
  
Why Marcurius
  
Marcurius is a people\-first, execution\-focused organization assembling a small, high\-impact team of engineers and operators. This role offers the opportunity to design and field electrical systems that directly enable real\-world maritime missions and help build the technical foundation of a next\-generation unmanned systems company.

jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Description:
**Seven Seas Water Group**


Seven Seas Water Group (www.sevenseaswater.com) is a portfolio company owned by investment funds managed by EQT. Headquartered in Tampa, with operations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America, Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) delivers annually over 20 billion gallons of water to industrial, commercial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers. SSWG designs, builds, owns, and operates, delivers new facilities, or acquires and upgrades existing facilities, with the goal of optimizing project risk transfer between the public and private sectors.


We have more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants in operations throughout the United States, Caribbean, and Latin America. With an outstanding reputation for decentralized water and wastewater treatment solutions, the SSWG “Water\-as\-a\-Service®” approach seeks to help solve global water and wastewater infrastructure challenges.


SSWG operates two businesses within the water infrastructure space. Seven Seas Water, which provides water treatment and desalination for governmental, hospitality and industrial customers in United States, Latin America and the Caribbean, and the AUC Group (www.aucgroup.net), which provides decentralized water and wastewater treatment plants for industrial and municipal customers in the United States.


EQT is a purpose\-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of more than three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors, and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start\-up to maturity. EQT has EUR 273 billion in total assets under management (EUR 141 billion in fee\-generating assets under management) as of 30 June 2025, within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.


With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long\-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future\-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does.


The EQT AB Group comprises EQT AB (publ) and its direct and indirect subsidiaries, which include general partners and fund managers of EQT funds as well as entities advising EQT funds. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.


More info: www.eqtgroup.com


Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be living in the Greater Tampa Bay area, and be comfortable commuting to the office 3 days/week. Open to remote candidates outside the local area who are willing to travel on\-site.


Candidates will also need to be comfortable with travel throughout our locations in the Caribbean as needed for local project support. The Electrical / Controls Engineer position requires experience in designing electrical power and control systems for process systems. Experience in seawater reverse osmosis (SWRO) desalination industry is a plus, but not required.


This role is responsible for Instrumentation \& Controls Engineering, Power Distribution/Electrical Engineering, and plant PLC/SCADA programming for large SWRO systems. And for supporting existing facilities with network architecture, enterprise\-wide data collection, upgrades, and firewall/security issues. Must be experienced with PLC architecture and programming, SCADA development with FactoryTalk, and general SCADA client/server architecture and implementation. Capable of programming as well as overseeing PLC design and programs of other programmers and engineers.


Design, develop, and lead procurement of power system equipment including MCC, Switchgear, distribution, and VFD’s. Capable of developing electrical single\-line diagrams. Capable of specifying all power distribution equipment including transformers, switchboards, MCCs, drives, panelboards, etc.


Requirements:
* Conceptualize and document the overall system control architecture including hardware selection, remote I/O considerations, major sub\-system integration, and integration with Seven Seas remote monitoring and potentially the owner’s SCADA.
* Review project specifications and incorporate requirements into Seven Seas design and equipment / procurement specifications.
* Prepare engineering documents within specified dates, such as Network Architecture Diagram, Electrical Load List, Instrument list, Instrument Data Sheets, Automated Valve List, Automated Valve Data Sheets, Electrical Equipment List, I/O List, Panel Layouts, Schematic Wiring Diagrams, Single Line Diagrams, Loop Diagrams, and other project deliverables in accordance with established procedures, schedule, and budget.
* Work with other discipline engineers to ensure proper representation of system design in P\&ID’s, Facility Arrangements, and other project documentation.
* Implement electrical and controls designs to support company’s new SWRO plant construction projects and support existing plant operations.
* Design and evaluate electrical installations for compliance with NFPA 70 National Electrical Code.
* Design industrial control panels in compliance with UL 508A.
* Program, commission, and troubleshoot Allen\-Bradley Logix PLC systems using Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View SE software.
* Oversee troubleshooting and resolution of electrical and controls issues in existing plants.
* Support electrical and controls portions of startups of equipment in the field.
* Prepare design and cost estimates for new electrical systems during the bidding phase of new projects.
* Work directly with customer electrical engineers to complete system installation.

jobs.title: Senior PCB Design Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sidus Space® (NASDAQ: SIDU) is an innovative space and defense technology company offering flexible, cost\-effective solutions, including satellite manufacturing and technology integration, AI\-driven space\-based data solutions, mission planning and management operations, AI/ML products and services, and space and defense hardware manufacturing. With its mission of Space Access Reimagined®, Sidus Space is committed to rapid innovation, adaptable and cost\-effective solutions, and the optimization of space system and data collection performance. With demonstrated space heritage, including manufacturing and operating its own satellite and sensor system, LizzieSat®, Sidus Space serves government, defense, intelligence, and commercial companies around the globe.

  

Strategically headquartered on Florida’s Space Coast, Sidus Space operates a 35,000\-square\-foot space manufacturing, assembly, integration, and testing facility and provides easy access to nearby launch facilities. But it’s our people who truly set us apart. We foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and agility, empowering our team to innovate and evolve in a rapidly changing industry. Join us at Sidus Space to be part of something extraordinary and help shape the future of space access!

 **Job Summary**

  

The Senior PCB Design Electrical Engineer will design and develop high‑reliability circuit card assemblies (CCAs) and integrated electronic systems for spaceflight and other mission‑critical applications.


The position is 100% onsite, located in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

 **Essential Duties/Responsibilities**

* Own schematic capture, PCB layout, and documentation for complex, high‑reliability CCAs used in spacecraft and mission‑critical systems.
* Develop subsystem architecture, electrical interfaces, and design solutions for new and existing hardware.
* Lead the design, development, and testing of IRAD/CRAD projects and support transition to manufacturing.
* Generate and review engineering documentation including requirements, specifications, ICDs, analyses, and test plans.
* Support integration, test, and verification of CCAs, electrical assemblies, and related subsystems.
* Collaborate with systems, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and program teams to deliver complete engineering design packages.
* Develop and maintain power budgets, V\&V plans, and electrical test plans.
* Participate in system‑level testing, troubleshoot issues and review test results.
* Present technical findings to peers, leadership, and customers as needed.
* Treat all coworkers with respect and dignity ensuring a collaborative culture is continually developed and maintained.
* Other duties as assigned\*\*

 **Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (or related field) and 5\+ years of relevant experience.
* Significant hands‑on experience with PCB design including schematic capture, layout, verification, and manufacturing support.
* High proficiency with Altium Designer (or similar PCB design tools).
* Strong foundation in power electronics, high‑speed digital design, and familiarity with RF circuits.
* Solid understanding of requirements definition, interface development, verification, and documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams).

 **Desired Skills and Experience**

* Familiarity with spacecraft electrical systems, subsystem interfaces, or space hardware integration.
* Understanding of EMI/EMC, reliability, contamination control, and space environmental effects.
* Experience with acceptance, qualification, and environmental testing for high‑reliability or space‑grade hardware.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience serving as a lead engineer or principal investigator on hardware development projects.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical guidance.

 **Physical Requirements**

* Sedentary Work – occasionally exerting up to 10 pounds of force to carry, lift, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves being stationary most of the time, sometimes requiring moving about the work center on concrete surfaces.
* Computer Work – daily use of laptop, computer monitor screen, keyboard, and mouse, sometimes utilizing a headset with microphone \& speakers.

 **Travel Requirement**

  

Ability to travel \< 10%

 **Shift/Schedule**

  

Onsite work Monday through Friday; day shift generally working 8am to 5pm

 **Drug\-Free Workplace**

  

Sidus Space is a Drug\-Free Workplace where post\-offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria are met as outlined in our policies

 **Total Rewards and Perks**

  

At Sidus Space, we ask a lot of our team members, which is why we give so much in return. In addition to a competitive salary, a Best\-in\-Class benefit program with a generous employer paid portion as well as a matching 401(k) on Day ONE, we offer a lot of perks, including:

  

* Jeans every day
* Regular onsite food trucks
* 5 free company t\-shirts for Manufacturing Staff
* Paid Time Off (vacation and sick days) and 11 paid holidays
* Adjustable stand\-up desks
* Employee referral bonus program
* Educational assistance and professional training opportunities
* Company golf outings and other social events

* All candidates selected will be subject to a background investigation and drug screen

jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

The AI Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and delivering practical artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support internal research, development, and business applications.


This position combines hands\-on software development, deep learning, and systems architecture to translate customer needs and emerging ideas into clear technical requirements, reliable solution designs, and working products. The role will support the development and deployment of advanced AI capabilities, including agentic AI systems operating in secure, air\-gapped, on\-premises, and edge environments.


The ideal candidate is a curious, self\-directed technical builder who takes initiative, enjoys solving complex problems, and can independently drive work from concept through implementation. This individual will own key technical efforts, mentor junior engineers, collaborate with technology leaders, and help strengthen the organization’s broader AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-enabled applications and solutions.
* Create and implement AI systems that leverage LLMs, autonomous workflows, tool integration, and agentic solutions.
* Develop AI\-driven automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* Build and integrate AI agents using commercial and open\-source AI platforms and frameworks.
* Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, developers, and business stakeholders to identify AI use cases and deliver effective solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches to customer challenges.

The Director of Systems Engineering provides leadership and oversight of the company’s Systems and Software Engineering organizations and is responsible for ensuring the engineering organization has the technical capabilities, processes, tools, and resources necessary to successfully execute current and future programs.


The Director establishes engineering priorities and standards, develops engineering leadership and technical talent, resolves cross\-program resource and technical challenges, and promotes effective systems engineering and integration across ASI programs.

* Oversees Software and Systems Engineering personnel, capabilities, processes, and resources to effectively support program requirements.
* Manages engineering staffing, workload, utilization, and resource allocation across programs; resolves resource conflicts and elevates significant capacity concerns to the COO as appropriate.
* Provides guidance and support to Project Engineers in addressing technical challenges, engineering coordination, resource needs, and execution concerns.
* Establishes and maintains engineering standards, processes, tools, and best practices and drives improvements in engineering efficiency, consistency, quality, and technical capability.
* Partners with Human Resources and Group Leaders on workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, performance management, employee development, succession planning, and retention of engineering personnel.
* Develops Group Leaders, Project Engineers, and engineering personnel through coaching, mentoring, cross\-training, knowledge transfer, and professional development.
* Supports proposal activities by providing engineering staffing, labor estimates, technical input, resource requirements, and identification of execution risks.
* Ensures engineering activities comply with applicable company processes, quality requirements, configuration management practices, and technical standards.
* Keeps the COO informed of significant engineering performance, staffing, resource, technical, or capability concerns.

**LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS**

* Provides leadership and direct supervision of Systems Engineering Group Leaders establishing priorities, expectations, and accountability for engineering performance.
* The Director maintains oversight of engineering performance without replacing the technical authority of Project Engineers and ensures engineering teams have the resources, processes, capabilities, and organizational support necessary for successful program execution.


Requirements:
**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible engineering experience in a complex technical environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of engineering leadership or management experience, including responsibility for engineering personnel, resources, and technical execution.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex systems and software development, integration, and test activities.
* Experience within the flight simulation, aerospace, defense, aviation, training systems, or similar complex technical industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with systems engineering principles and practices, including requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration, verification, and validation.
* Demonstrated experience managing engineering resources across multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
* Experience with engineering planning, labor estimating, resource forecasting, technical risk management, and performance monitoring.
* Experience supporting the complete engineering lifecycle from requirements and design through integration, verification, validation, testing, and delivery.
* Demonstrated experience developing engineering leaders and technical personnel.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical estimates, and transition from contract award to execution preferred.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001, configuration management, cybersecurity requirements, and government contracting environments preferred.

jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.

We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.  

  

**What you'll do**  

  

  

As a Software Engineer you will work as a member of the program delivery team and support the product development team. Both teams focus on developing and supporting the delivery of a monitor and control software, ViaControl, for satellite antenna systems. **The day\-to\-day**  

  

  

Your day\-to\-day will vary by program phase, but core activities include designing, developing, testing, and documenting device drivers that integrate ViaControl with satellite antenna systems, and configuring and deploying ViaControl across a variety of hardware platforms. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or currently pursuing)
* 2\+ years of experience writing in Python
* Familiarity with network communication protocols such as TCP, SNMP, or REST
* Familiarity with the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

* Experience with device driver development or hardware integration
* Experience with Ansible or similar configuration management tools
* Exposure to satellite communications, ground systems, or aerospace/defense domains
* Familiarity with agile or waterfall software development methodologies
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams

jobs.title: Senior Data Center Electrical Engineer , Mechanical Products and Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.  

  

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
* Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
* Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well\-thought\-out products.
* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

  

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.  

  

About the team  

Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.  

  

We value collaboration, creative problem\-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you are excited about working on large\-scale infrastructure challenges alongside a talented group of engineers, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation o

**This is a hybrid role base out of our Atlanta or Miami office.**

  

**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

  

* Build, test, and ship features for production AI systems, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, agentic workflows, and model orchestration components.
* Write and maintain evaluation cases and test suites that catch regressions in AI system quality before they reach users.
* Implement and iterate on prompts, tool/function definitions, and guardrails, using eval results to guide changes rather than intuition alone.
* Contribute to the services, APIs, and data pipelines that AI features depend on, including instrumentation, logging, and dashboards.
* Investigate production issues — latency spikes, cost anomalies, quality regressions, failed tool calls — and implement fixes.
* Participate in code review, design discussions, and post\-incident analyses, asking questions and sharing what you learn.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and Data Science teammates to turn requirements into working software and to flag tradeoffs early.
* Keep documentation and runbooks current for the systems you work on.

* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software.
* Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, C\#).
* Hands\-on experience integrating LLM APIs into an application — prompting, structured outputs, and function/tool calling — through professional work, internships, or substantive personal projects.
* Working knowledge of core backend fundamentals: REST APIs, databases, version control, testing, and debugging.
* Curiosity about how AI systems behave in the real world, and a willingness to measure results rather than assume them.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking for help and giving updates.

* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or LangChain.

As part of the Emerging Capabilities Development (ECD) Systems Engineering Integration and Test (SEIT) organization, you will help develop and mature forward\-leaning Radio Frequency Electronic Warfare (RFEW) solutions and products. You will work in a dynamic, innovative environment and collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to create capabilities that meet customer needs and provide a competitive edge.

  

You will join our Radio Frequency (RF) SEIT group within Central Region Engineering in Rolling Meadows, IL, supporting a leading global provider of advanced, secure, and agile software\-defined systems. Our state\-of\-the\-art RFEW systems are designed to protect U.S. and Allied warfighters in present and future conflicts.

  

In this role, you will develop and test RF and digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms, build and validate complex models and simulations, and support integration of these algorithms into prototype systems for lab and field demonstrations, often under aggressive timelines. You will primarily use MATLAB and HFSS for algorithm development and electromagnetic modeling, with C/C\+\+ used to support implementation and integration activities. **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and test RF/DSP algorithms for RFEW applications using MATLAB.
* Develop, validate, and maintain HFSS models and simulations for RF propagation, antenna performance, and RF signal chains.
* Analyze system and subsystem performance and support trade studies to optimize system architectures and algorithms.
* Collaborate with firmware, hardware, and software teams to integrate algorithms and HFSS\-derived designs into prototype hardware and software systems.
* Prepare and deliver clear technical presentations and documentation for internal and external stakeholders.

  

This is a full\-time, on\-site position at our Rolling Meadows, IL location.
