* BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Related technical degree with 2\+ years of Related experience or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Related technical field
* Demonstrated experience in digital signal processing
* Hands\-on experience with MATLAB for modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
* Demonstrated experience creating and delivering technical presentations.
* Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen
* **Clearance:** Ability to obtain and maintain at least a Secret clearance with additional customer\-specified access prior to start date as required.

 **Basic Qualifications for Principal Systems Engineer (Electrical Engineering)**

* BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Related technical degree with 5\+ years of related experience; OR MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Related technical field with 3\+ years related experience; OR, PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Related technical field with 1\+ year of related experience
* Demonstrated experience in digital signal processing
* Hands\-on experience with MATLAB for modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
* Demonstrated experience creating and delivering technical presentations.
* Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen
* **Clearance:** Ability to obtain and maintain at least a Secret clearance with additional customer\-specified access prior to start date as required.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* BS with 5\+ years, MS with 3\+ years, or PhD with 1\+ years; degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM field.
* Strong background in physics and mathematics (e.g., electromagnetics, signals and systems, probability/statistics).
* Academic or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
	+ Computational electromagnetics or wave theory
	+ RF propagation modeling
	+ Antenna design and characterization
	+ RF chain analysis and modeling
	+ Embedded software design and test
	+ Anechoic chamber measurement experience
* Experience with HFSS (or similar full\-wave EM simulation tools) for RF/antenna modeling and analysis.
* Familiarity with C/C\+\+ for algorithm implementation or integration.
* Experience applying RF/DSP algorithms and EM simulations in laboratory or field\-test environments.
* Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 25%.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems (NGMS) is a trusted provider of mission\-enabling solutions for global security. Our Engineering and Sciences (E\&S) organization pushes the boundaries of innovation, redefines engineering capabilities, and drives advances in various sciences. Our team is chartered with providing the skills, innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter. Come be a part of our mission!

  

NGMS is seeking a manager for its Systems Engineering Integration and Test (SEIT) organization at our Rolling Meadows, IL location. The selected candidate will manage a team of SEIT engineers within the SEIT Targeting Department.

  

This is a dual\-role manager position, balancing the overall Functional oversight and management of a Systems Engineering group of 10\-15 engineers, against performance of productive work on a program or several programs. The candidate will spend \~20% of their time on support of the organization (functional duties) and \~80% of their time on technical program work. It is anticipated that the candidate would serve in SEIT Lead / Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead type roles in a restricted program space.

  

The responsibilities associated with managing the team include:

* Functional oversight for a team of SEIT engineers working multiple initiatives including follow\-on contracts, new business growth opportunities, internal research and development, and capital projects.
* Leadership for support and adherence to standard SEIT processes and the oversight of cost, schedule, and technical quality for SEIT execution on supported programs, including functional reviews for major milestone events (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.) and proposals as applicable.
* Staffing and workload forecast; employee inclusion, engagement, mentoring and career development; employee training and identification, and training of skills required to execute on programs; management and execution of employee performance review processes; and leadership and execution for a multitude of functional management processes.
* Recruiting new talent to meet staffing commitments.
* Support initiatives such as Model Based System Engineering (MBSE), Product Line Architecture (PLA), and Agile implementation that provide a competitive advantage for our customers.

  

As a SEIT Lead / IPT Lead, you will provide leadership in applying the core principles of systems engineering to deliver innovative, affordable, highly reliable systems solutions that meet customer needs, key performance parameters, and program execution goals. Responsibilities may include engineering leadership for system architecture development, requirements development, hardware/software design, verification and validation activities, and production program engineering support. A person in this position ensures that the program is adhering to sound engineering processes in the development, production, test and sustainment of products for our customers and that the program and product is compliant with company policy, procedures, and quality standards.

 **This role will be full\-time and on\-site in our Targeting Systems groups in Rolling Meadows, IL.**

* Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering / technical discipline with a minimum of 8 years’ experience or a Master of Science degree in an engineering / technical discipline with a minimum of 6 years’ experience.
* Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* High proficiency in technical problem solving, including decomposition, root cause analysis, solution development, implementation and monitoring.
* Background and understanding in tools and techniques associated with cost / schedule management (especially Earned Value Management).
* This position requires the applicant to be a U.S. citizen.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a relevant technical or management specialty.
* Active Secret / Top Secret Clearance.
* 5\+ years of related engineering experience working in an engineering organization at a defense contractor during EMD and/or LRIP phases
* Management experience leading teams including Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test.

* Experience working in a systems engineering, integration, and test environment on complex projects that encompass hardware, software, and firmware development.

Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer-Mobile Equipment & Wire Harness Design
jobs.description:
Forklift Exchange, Inc. is seeking an **Electrical Engineer specializing in mobile equipment electrical systems and wire harness design**. This position will be responsible for designing, documenting, testing, and continuously improving the electrical systems used across Royal Rig’s heavy\-duty forklift product line.

This is a hands\-on engineering position. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at a computer designing electrical systems and harnesses, but equally comfortable working directly on a prototype machine with technicians and production personnel to troubleshoot, test, and improve the design.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design complete **12V/24V electrical systems and wire harnesses** for heavy mobile equipment.
* Develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, connector pinouts, and bills of material.
* Design harnesses for engines, transmissions/hydrostatic systems, hydraulic controls, operator controls, lighting, safety systems, sensors, and accessories.
* Select appropriate wire sizes, connectors, terminals, relays, fuses, circuit protection, switches, sensors, and electrical components.
* Develop and maintain electrical interfaces with **PLCs/controllers, CAN bus/J1939 networks, engines, Danfoss hydrostatic components, displays, sensors, and other electronic controls**.
* Design harnesses for manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, and straightforward installation.
* Establish proper harness routing, mounting, protection, labeling, connector locations, and service access.
* Work directly with Royal's in\-house harness department to ensure harnesses can be built consistently and efficiently.
* Develop and maintain **harness test procedures and test fixtures** so completed harnesses can be verified before installation on the machine.
* Troubleshoot prototype and production machines and determine the **root cause** of electrical problems rather than relying on temporary fixes.
* Support prototype builds and convert lessons learned during prototyping into permanent engineering changes.
* Work closely with mechanical, hydraulic, manufacturing, assembly, and service teams.
* Maintain accurate engineering documentation, revisions, BOMs, and electrical standards across the Royal product line.
* Help standardize components and electrical architecture across multiple Royal models to reduce part count, inventory, assembly time, and service complexity.
* Support production and field service when electrical troubleshooting expertise is required.

**Primary Objective**

Royal's goal is to develop electrical systems that are **simple, reliable, repeatable, easy to manufacture, and easy to troubleshoot in the field**.

A successful design should allow Royal to:

* Build and test harnesses before they reach final assembly.
* Install harnesses without cutting, modifying, extending, or reworking wiring during production.
* Use common electrical components and design standards across multiple models wherever practical.
* Provide technicians with clear schematics and diagnostic information.
* Reduce assembly time and eliminate recurring electrical problems through permanent engineering solutions.
* Take a prototype electrical system and turn it into a documented, production\-ready system that can be duplicated machine after machine.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience designing electrical systems or wire harnesses for **off\-highway equipment, forklifts, construction equipment, agricultural equipment, trucks, automotive systems, or other mobile machinery** strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of 12V/24V DC electrical systems.
* Experience with CAN bus and J1939 communications preferred.
* Experience with mobile hydraulic or hydrostatic equipment is highly desirable.
* Ability to read and create professional electrical schematics and harness documentation.
* Understanding of electrical troubleshooting, voltage drop, grounding, circuit protection, electrical loads, and component selection.
* Experience working directly with manufacturing and technicians during prototype development.
* Strong practical problem\-solving skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for more than someone who can create drawings. We want an engineer who can **own the electrical system from concept through production**.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission\-enabling solutions for global security. Our Engineering and Sciences (E\&S) organization pushes the boundaries of innovation, redefines engineering capabilities, and drives advances in various sciences. Our team is chartered with providing the skills, innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter. Come be a part of our mission!


We are looking for you to join our team as a Systems Engineering Manager 2 based out of Rolling Meadows, IL. We currently have a System Engineering Manager opening supporting our Electronic Warfare business unit.


This is a dual\-role manager position, balancing the overall Functional oversight and management of a Systems Engineering group of 10\-15 engineers, against performance of productive work on a program or several programs. The candidate will spend \~20% of their time on support of the organization (functional duties) and \~80% of their time on technical program work.

  

The selected candidate(s) will be part of the Systems Engineering Integration \& Test (SEIT) team within our Radio Frequency Electronic Warfare (RFEW) organization. This position leads a Systems Engineering team with general responsibilities below.

**Systems Engineering Leadership**

* Your role as a System Engineering Manager will include a broad range of activities to include system design, requirements management, verification, and IPT leadership
* Day to Day oversight of support to programs in all phases of the engineering life cycle to include development, integration, production and sustainment programs


In addition, you will:

* Oversee a team of engineers working multiple initiatives including follow\-on contracts, new business growth opportunities, internal research and development, and capital projects.
* Guide the team in support and adherence to standard SEIT processes and the oversight of cost, schedule, and technical quality for SEIT execution on supported programs, including functional reviews for major milestone events (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.) and proposals as applicable.
* Work on staffing and workload forecast; employee inclusion, engagement, mentoring and career development; employee training and identification, and training of skills required to execute on programs; management and execution of employee performance review processes; and leadership and execution for a multitude of functional management processes.
* Collaborate with our talent acquisition team to meet staffing commitments.
* Support initiatives such as Model Based System Engineering (MBSE), Product Line Architecture (PLA), and Agile implementation that provide a competitive advantage for our customers.

  

Overall, you will have the opportunity to oversee and mentor junior and senior level engineers while also being a direct contributor to challenging development programs. This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant ownership across backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data processing, partner integrations, and internal applications. You will work across an established .NET and Azure environment while helping design and deliver the next generation of platform capabilities.
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, making technical decisions, collaborating directly with stakeholders, and owning solutions from initial requirements through deployment and production support.
  
  

**Position Duties:**  

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using C\# and modern .NET.
* Build and support high\-volume telemetry and IoT data processing systems.
* Develop REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and real\-time service integrations.
* Design and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, and data access patterns.
* Build and maintain integrations with external customers, technology partners, and third\-party platforms.
* Develop and maintain client SDKs and shared libraries used across internal and external applications.
* Support cloud infrastructure and application services hosted in Microsoft Azure.
* Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging, events, queues, and background services.
* Develop internal web applications and operational tools using Blazor and ASP.NET Core.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and service\-to\-service communication.
* Maintain CI/CD pipelines and support deployments across development, testing, and production environments.
* Monitor production systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and improve platform reliability and performance.
* Work directly with product, support, operations, customers, and integration partners to gather requirements and design solutions.
* Help improve technical documentation and engineering practices across the platform.


**Requirements:** The ideal candidate will have 7\+ years of professional software development experience with strong expertise in C\#, modern .NET and ASP.NET Core, backend API design and development, and SQL Server/T\-SQL, including experience optimizing queries and working with large datasets. Through the power of our combined capabilities, we provide deep expertise in Advanced Engineering; Digital Transformation; Electromagnetic Warfare; Interactive Training \& Simulation; Physical Sciences Research; Platform Lifecycle Support; and Foreign Military Sales. Precise Systems is seeking a **Cellular Protocol \& Software Engineer** to support NSWC Crane's Expeditionary Electromagnetic Warfare mission. This position focuses on the analysis, development, implementation, and testing of 3G, LTE, and 5G cellular protocols in laboratory, simulated, over\-the\-air, and field environments. The engineer must be able to analyze cellular communications beyond RF spectrum observations by breaking down protocol signaling, message exchanges, information elements, state transitions, and interactions between protocol layers. This is not a traditional cellular network optimization or RF performance\-monitoring role. This position requires in\-person support.


**Duties:**


* Analyze 3G, LTE, and 5G protocol stacks, signaling flows, message exchanges, state transitions, and protocol behavior at the packet and message level.
* Decode and evaluate cellular control\-plane and user\-plane signaling, including interactions among RRC, NAS, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers.
* Analyze 3GPP procedures such as registration/attach, authentication, security establishment, session setup, mobility, handover, and connection management.
* Identify protocol fields, information eements, timing relationships, implementation differences, abnormal behavior, edge cases, and potential vulnerabilities.
* Develop, modify, debug, and maintain software in C, C\+\+, and Python to generate, emulate, manipulate, analyze, or test cellular protocol behavior.
* Capture, decode, inspect, and troubleshoot cellular signaling and packet traffic using protocol\-analysis, packet\-analysis, cellular diagnostic, or comparable engineering tools.
* Develop and execute structured test cases that exercise specific protocol states, message sequences, malformed conditions, implementation behavior, and performance characteristics.
* Support software\-defined, simulated, laboratory, over\-the\-air, and field test environments used to reproduce, stimulate, or assess cellular protocol behavior.
* Correlate RF observations and waveform characteristics with protocol\-layer activity to support technically defensible analysis and test conclusions.
* Prepare test procedures, technical reports, protocol analyses, vulnerability findings, briefings, and engineering recommendations for Government review and decision\-making.


**Required Education:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Mathematics with a concentration in computer science

  


**Required Experience:**


* Minimum of three (3\) years of professional experience in computer design, software development, or computer networks
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience analyzing or developing cellular protocols at the protocol\-stack, signaling\-message, or packet level.
* Working knowledge of 3GPP cellular architecture and LTE/5G protocol behavior, including RRC, NAS, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY interactions.
* Ability to analyze signaling procedures, message sequences, information elements, state transitions, and interactions between protocol layers.
* Strong programming skills in C, C\+\+, and Python for protocol analysis, test development, automation, or software integration.
* Experience capturing, decoding, and analyzing cellular signaling or packet traffic using protocol\-analysis, packet\-analysis, diagnostic, or comparable tools.
* Experience developing or executing structured laboratory, simulated, over\-the\-air, or field test activities.
* Strong technical\-writing and communication skills with the ability to document findings, conclusions, vulnerabilities, and engineering recommendations.


**Desired Experience:**


* Experience with cellular protocol development, modem or baseband software, UE/eNB/gNB protocol implementation, protocol conformance testing, or telecom research and development.
* Experience with cellular vulnerability analysis, protocol exploitation, malformed\-message testing, or wireless cyber test environments.
* Familiarity with software\-defined radio and open cellular test platforms or frameworks such as srsRAN, OpenAirInterface, or comparable environments.
* Experience with Wireshark or other cellular protocol decoders, packet\-capture tools, diagnostic logging tools, or signaling\-analysis platforms.
* Experience with Digital Signal Processing, FPGA\-based systems, waveform analysis, RF signal generation, or RF test infrastructure.
* Experience supporting Department of Defense, Navy, Electronic Warfare, cyber, spectrum, or secure laboratory programs.

Global multi\-billion dollar company about 30 minutes north of downtown Lexington, KY area has a need for a Robotics Engineer. This is a direct hire role with a full benefits package.


The primary responsibility of this role is to develop and implement innovative activities, improving manufacturing competitiveness and reducing fixed costs in North America


Reporting to the Engineering Manager the person in this role will support the Advanced Technology department's objective to learn and confirm innovative technologies for vehicle manufacturing.

 **What you'll be doing**

* Integrate and deploy AI\-enabled robotic solutions to improve manufacturing capability, flexibility, and performance.
* Develop and implement computer vision, machine learning, and sensor fusion solutions for real\-world manufacturing applications (e.g., bin picking, part handling, inspection).
* Build and optimize AI models for robust performance on industrial hardware, balancing latency, reliability, and compute constraints.
* Bridge the gap between modern AI Python scripts and standard industrial automation.
* Utilize simulation tools (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or equivalent) to support concept validation, synthetic data generation, and Sim2Real deployment.
* Lead and support equipment trials, debugging, and performance validation from proof\-of\-concept through production deployment (yokoten).
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with robotics engineers, controls engineers, and plant manufacturing teams to integrate AI into production systems.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement emerging Physical AI technologies through benchmarking, supplier engagement, and industry events.
* Ensure solutions meet safety, reliability, and manufacturability requirements, including alignment with applicable standards and internal risk assessments.
* Present technical concepts, results, and recommendations to stakeholders, management, and executive leadership.
* Manage contractors to design and construct testing cells.
* Produce clear, detailed documentation to support future scaling and customer enablement.

 **Requirements**  

Qualifications

**What you bring**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation deployments.
* Experience in robotics, AI/ML, or advanced automation development.
* Having a full\-stack mindset while working in team environments building complete solutions, not just independent AI algorithms, demonstrations, and experiments.
* Strong hands\-on experience in at least two of the following:

  

* Computer vision (e.g., detection, segmentation, 3D perception)
* Machine learning / deep learning
* Robotics
* Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, ROS\-based systems; strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Deep understanding of different sensor types (RGBD cameras, LiDAR, Time\-of\-Flight sensors, etc.) and the ability to tune for image quality accuracy and performance.

* Short Term \& Long Term Disability
* Training \& Development

jobs.title: Embedded Software Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
As an **Embedded Software Test Automation Engineer**, you will join our Instrument Development team and help build the test automation frameworks, infrastructure, and tools that ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of IDEXX diagnostic instrumentation. You will play a key role in advancing reusable test automation capabilities across multiple product lines, designing solutions that can be leveraged across instruments rather than rebuilt for each individual platform. Experience with AI\-assisted, spec\-driven development workflows is required.  



  

At IDEXX, our diagnostic instruments directly support veterinary professionals in delivering real\-time clinical care to companion animals around the world. As part of a highly collaborative engineering organization, you'll work alongside software, electrical, mechanical, systems, and biological engineering teams to develop and maintain premium point\-of\-care analyzers. Your contributions will help ensure our instruments meet the highest standards of quality throughout their lifecycle while enabling teams to develop and deliver innovative products more efficiently.

  

Why does this role matter? Test automation is critical to scaling the development of complex embedded systems while maintaining quality and reliability. In this role, you'll help establish reusable automation frameworks, data pipelines, and CI/CD integrations that improve engineering efficiency across multiple instrument platforms. You'll have the opportunity to contribute both strategically and hands\-on, influencing technical direction while continuing to solve challenging engineering problems that ultimately support veterinary professionals and the animals they serve.

**In this role:**
-----------------

* You will design and build reusable automated test frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that can be leveraged across multiple embedded instrument platforms.
* You will develop, maintain, and continuously improve automated test code used to validate embedded software systems.
* You will define and maintain automated test strategies across the software development lifecycle, ensuring appropriate test coverage and scalability.
* You will integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and support the operation of automated test environments, including hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) systems.
* You will collaborate with engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and improve testing efficiency, quality, and reliability across products.
* You will contribute to technical direction, standards, and best practices for test automation while supporting and mentoring other engineers as needed.
* You will participate in reviews of test architectures, automation designs, and engineering solutions to promote maintainability, scalability, and long\-term success.
* You will design data pipelines and tooling to parse, validate, transform, and manage test telemetry and configuration data.
* You will help establish scalable approaches to test data management that support the introduction of new instruments and data sources.
* You will contribute directly to embedded software and product development efforts as project priorities require, applying strong engineering judgment and software development fundamentals.
* You will work as a self\-directed team member who values collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering high\-quality engineering solutions.

**What you need to succeed:**
**Required**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in embedded software test automation, including designing test infrastructure or frameworks that support multiple product platforms.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated test frameworks and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing environments.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes.
* Strong programming skills in at least two of the following languages: C, C\+\+, Python, Lua, Go, or Rust.
* Experience working with Linux operating systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Experience using Generative AI development tools to support software engineering activities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts across cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and in collaborative team environments.
* Ability to balance responsibilities across test automation, software quality, and hands\-on embedded software development as business needs evolve.

 **Strongly Preferred**

* Experience with AI\-assisted and spec\-driven development workflows, including tools and approaches such as OpenSpec.
* Familiarity with microcontroller\-based embedded systems.

 **Preferred**

* Familiarity with VHDL.

**Our tech stack:**
-------------------

This role supports embedded software platforms developed using a variety of technologies, including C, C\+\+, Python, Lua, Go, and Rust running on Linux\-based systems. The environment includes automated test frameworks, hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) systems, CI/CD pipelines, telemetry and test data processing workflows, and modern AI\-assisted development tools. We look for engineers who bring strong software engineering fundamentals, a passion for quality, and the ability to design scalable solutions that can be applied across multiple products and technology stacks.

--------------------------------

* Base salary range starting at $125,000 based on experience
* Opportunity for annual cash bonus
* Performance\-based merit increases
* Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One
* 5% matching 401k
* Additional benefits including but not limited to fina

jobs.description:
**Description**  

Are you passionate about applying signal processing, communications, detection, and estimation theory to solve challenging RF problems?

  

Do you enjoy developing novel approaches to characterize and build communication systems for unique and challenging problems?

 **If so, we're looking** **for someone like you to join our team at APL.**  

We develop end\-to\-end RF communications and sensing systems from idea to fielded capability for challenging national security problems. We seek an engineer to analyze communication links and propagation environments, guide design choices, and develop hardware and software solutions that realize sophisticated RF sensing and communication systems. In collaboration with a team of embedded and FPGA developers and hardware designers, you’ll turn novel concepts into deployable capabilities.

 **As an RF Communications Systems Engineer, you will...*** Analyze wireless communication systems by developing link budgets and modeling RF propagation and channel effects.
* Evaluate system performance across realistic operational environments to develop transmitter, receiver, and system design requirements.
* Analyze documented and undocumented systems, waveforms, and protocols to characterize their operation and develop new communication and sensing approaches.
* Contribute to algorithm, hardware, software, and software\-defined radio development, from concept through implementation, integration, and test.
* Plan and conduct field evaluations to assess and validate system performance and improve designs.
* Collaborate with sponsors and engineering teams to understand mission challenges, develop technical requirements and solutions, and transition successful designs to the field.


  

**Qualifications** **You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...*** Possess a Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or another relevant field.
* Bring experience in RF or electronic hardware design, communication system software development, or RF systems engineering in support of the build and integration of RF communication systems.
* Have deep understanding of signals and systems and digital communications, including modulation, estimation, and detection techniques with experience in link budgets, RF propagation, system performance analysis, and translating analysis into system requirements.
* Are proficient in developing communication system models and algorithms using MATLAB, Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages.
* Have demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and develop solutions.
* Are able to obtain a Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Have a Master’s or Ph.D. in a related technical field with a focus on communications or RF systems.
* Have broad experience spanning multiple aspects of RF system development, such as RF hardware, system software, embedded systems, software\-defined radios, or signal processing implementation.
* Have experience providing technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams.

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world\-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. jobs.title: Robotic Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Mowze’s commercial robotic lawn mowers are deployed in the field. However, a skilled operator on a manned mower still has a speed edge over our product, and we believe most of that gap is in the controller.

You will own the robot's motion stack, covering state estimation, planning, and control. That includes building and refining a dynamics model of the mower from real telemetry, and using it to drive smoother and more precisely on slopes and uneven turf. Your goal is to exceed a human's efficiency.

Hybrid, based in Gaithersburg, MD. On site 2\-5 days a week, as needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the motion stack: state estimation → planning → control → actuator commands. Choose the architecture and own the migration.
* Build, refine, and validate a dynamics model of the mower (mass properties, tire/turf interaction, slope effects, controller response) and fit it to real telemetry.
* Design model\-based control (MPC or equivalent) that holds line on slopes and varying turf, slows for sharp corners, and maximizes ground speed subject to cut quality and safety limits.
* Own coverage planning: detect missed or partially cut strips and re\-plan to cover them. Optimize path for throughput.
* Stand up simulation\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test infrastructure.
* Define what telemetry the mower must log to close the loop on model fidelity, work with other engineers to implement logging.

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years shipping control systems on physical vehicles or mobile robots — ground vehicles, agricultural/construction equipment, AMRs, off\-road platforms. Not drones\-only, not simulation\-only.
* Demonstrated system identification on real hardware: has fit a model to logged data, found it was wrong, and fixed it.
* Hands\-on with model\-based control in production (MPC, LQR/iLQR, or equivalent) — not just a course project.
* Strong state estimation (EKF/UKF, IMU \+ GNSS \+ wheel odometry fusion).
* Comfortable in C\+\+ and Python; has worked inside a real\-time embedded control loop, not only in a notebook.
* Has built a vehicle control stack from scratch or substantially rewritten one; understands what ArduPilot/PX4 do and do not model, so the replacement doesn't lose the parts that worked.
* Has built or substantially extended a vehicle simulator and can articulate where sim diverged from reality.

Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Do you have real world experience with a production fleet of robots / vehicles? (How many were in the fleet? Did the robots operate outdoors? Roughly how much did the robots weigh? What was and how long was your role?)
* How do you model a vehicle that is crabbing while driving sideways on a slope? While not sliding completely, there is some nonzero sideways slip.
* How do you fuse visual odometry, wheel odometry, IMU, and intermittent GPS for accurate pose estimates in GPS poor environments? About how far could the robot travel without GPS while still staying on the path? (State your assumptions about the system)
* Describe a time a model you identified from real data turned out to be wrong. How did you find out, and what did you change?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gaithersburg, MD 20879

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.


WHOOP is hiring a Staff Electrical Engineer to play a critical technical leadership role in the development of our next\-generation wearable platform. As part of the Hardware Engineering team, you will develop a deep understanding of electrical system behavior through rigorous test, characterization, analysis, and hands\-on debugging, then translate those insights into architecture, schematic, and design improvements. You will work across Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Systems, Manufacturing, and Software teams to identify performance limitations, resolve complex system\-level issues, and accelerate the path toward robust, production\-ready hardware.


This is a hands\-on player\-coach role for an engineer who combines deep electrical expertise with exceptional systems thinking and technical judgment. jobs.title: Senior Undersea Robotics Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Team:**  

  

The Sensors Division within STR focuses on the development and analysis of advanced sensor systems in the RF, acoustic, and electro\-optical domains. This includes the design and development of novel sensors and advanced information processing techniques from ideation to prototype implementations. The Subsea and Seabed Systems (SSS) Group develops and delivers advanced undersea sensor and signal processing systems, including bespoke undersea vehicles to deploy those systems. We apply those products to to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) and counter\-ISR applications to deliver missions success to our customers.


**The Role:**



We are seeking an Electrical Engineer with a strong interest and some experience in undersea robotics to design, develop, and implement the electrical systems that enable next‑generation uncrewed undersea vehicles, sensor systems, and command and control (C2\) systems. In this role, you will be the responsible for the full range of development for electrical systems in our products: from board‑level design and sensor integration through bring‑up, test, and support in the lab and at sea.



You will work closely with mechanical, software, and systems engineers as well as other electrical engineers. An ideal candidate would have exposure to control systems, embedded software, mechanical engineering as undersea vehicle and system design is inherently multi\-disciplinary. Ideal candidates are hands‑on engineers who are comfortable with analog and digital circuit design, can take a circuit board from concept through fabrication, and are adept at troubleshooting and resolving hardware issues.



Candidates with more experience are welcome and will be considered for greater responsibility, but the position is intended for an engineer early in their career who has solid, practical experience with electronics.  

  

**What you will do:**


* Design, implement, and document analog and digital circuitry for uncrewed undersea vehicles, including power distribution, signal conditioning, communications interfaces, and sensor integration
* Develop and lay out printed circuit boards (PCBs), including component selection, schematic capture, layout, and preparation of fabrication and assembly packages
* Bring up new boards and electronic modules: perform bench testing, debug hardware issues, and iterate designs based on test results and field feedback
* Integrate and interface onboard sensors (e.g., IMUs, depth sensors, navigation systems, acoustic sensors) with vehicle processors and control systems
* Work with embedded software engineers to define hardware‑software interfaces, support driver development, and ensure reliable real‑time operation
* Collaborate with mechanical and systems engineers to ensure proper packaging, environmental protection, thermal management, and compliance with undersea operational requirements
* Support hardware‑in‑the‑loop and system‑level testing in lab, pool, and at‑sea environments, including preparation, operation, and troubleshooting of vehicle electronics
* Contribute to the development of system‑level requirements and electrical architectures for novel undersea vehicles and sensor payloads
* Maintain design records, test reports, and configuration documentation to support the full lifecycle of undersea vehicle electrical systems
* Stay current with relevant technologies in electronics, embedded systems, and undersea robotics, and apply them to improve reliability, performance, and manufacturability


**Who you are:**


* Ability to obtain Top Secret security clearance with eligibility to support special access programs, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field with at least 5\+ years of relevant hands‑on experience, or a Master's degree in one of these fields with significant practical experience in electronics design and debug (equivalent experience will be considered)
* Practical experience designing and testing analog and digital circuits, including:
	+ Schematic capture and PCB layout using common EDA tool
	+ Board bring‑up, lab testing, and hardware debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related equipment.
* Familiarity with embedded systems and real‑time control applications (e.g., microcontrollers, single‑board computers, FPGAs, or similar platforms)
* Experience integrating sensors and actuators into electronic systems, including understanding of signal integrity, noise mitigation, and power considerations
* Basic proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in embedded or robotics applications (e.g., C/C\+\+, Python) sufficient to interact productively with software teams and perform simple test and diagnostic scripts
* Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and communicate clearly about electrical design decisions, trade‑offs, and limitations
* Strong problem‑solving skills and a hands‑on approach to prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting


**Even Better:**


* Experience designing electronics specifically for marine or harsh environments (pressure, corrosion, moisture, vibration) or other rugged applications
* Exposure to robotic frameworks such as ROS, MOOS‑IvP, UMAA, or similar platforms, and an understanding of how vehicle electronics support autonomy and control
* Familiarity with control systems, sensor fusion concepts, and their implications for hardware design and timing
* Experience with hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) test setups and system‑level simulation
* Experience with agile development methodologies and version control systems (e.g., Git) for managing design files, firmware, and test scripts
* Experience setting performance expectations for advanced or novel UUV designs or sensor systems using modeling, simulation, or analytical tools
* Experience interacting with U.S. Navy or other U.S. Government organization

jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Robotics)
jobs.description:
**The Company**
We believe general\-purpose, generally\-intelligent robots will be built *in our lifetimes.* Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real\-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop.
As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state\-of\-the\-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy.
**Our Culture**
We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next\-level collaboration and respect.
**About the Role**
Our robots work in customer facilities with people nearby. The code that decides how an arm moves, how fast, and how it stops is what keeps those people safe. We're looking for a controls engineer to own it.
The work is controls: joint limits, speed limits, stopping distances and stopping times, contact and collision behavior, the loop that turns a motion command into torque, and the monitoring that detects when that loop misbehaves. It is also software work. The code lives in a large codebase that changes every week, and the safety\-critical parts of it have to be written, organized, tested, and reviewed so they stay correct through those changes. The person we want has worked in a codebase where a mistake had physical consequences, has written and organized a lot of code there, and is comfortable with the physics underneath it.
You will build the hardware\-in\-the\-loop test bench that runs the control code against real arms and real stop circuits, in continuous integration. You will also keep the evidence current: the measurements and tests that show the arm stops when it should, updated as the code, the arms, and the applications change.
The formal side of safety, risk assessments and the standards customers ask about, is part of the role. We will teach it.
### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the safety\-critical control code for our arms:** Limits, stop behavior, collision response, and the monitoring around the control loop
* **Work on the control loop itself:** Timing, stability, and failure modes, from the motion command down to the drives
* **Organize the code so it can be trusted:** Keep the safety\-critical parts small, separated, tested, and reviewable, and set the rules for how other code touches them
* **Build hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing:** A bench and a continuous\-integration path that run the control code against real arms and real safety hardware
* **Keep the evidence current:** Stopping\-time measurements and the tests behind the safety argument, updated whenever the code or the hardware changes
* **Document the design:** Decisions, limits, and the reasons for them, in a form other engineers follow

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Real\-time control experience on physical systems:** Robot arms, vehicles, aircraft, or similar. You have written control code that moved hardware and handled its failures
* **Experience in a mission\-critical codebase:** You have written and organized a large amount of code where mistakes had physical consequences, and you know what that requires of structure, testing, and review
* **Comfortable with the physics:** Dynamics, torque, inertia, stopping distances, contact. You can reason about what the arm will do
* **Strong systems software:** C\+\+ and Python or similar, real\-time behavior on Linux, and safety\-critical code kept separate from the rest
* **Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing:** You have built or used a rig that put real hardware in the loop with software under test

### **Nice to Have**

* Exposure to safety standards for robots or machinery, such as ISO 10218, ISO 13849, or ANSI/RIA R15\.06
* EtherCAT or other fieldbus experience with servo drives
* Experience with safety\-rated controllers or certified functional safety components
* Experience in warehouses, manufacturing, or other environments where robots and people share space

**About Our Roles \& Titles**
At Tutor, we believe great engineers and researchers are defined by what they build and the impact they have — not where they sit in an org chart or what title they have. Therefore, everyone in our R\&D org holds the title **Member of Technical Staff (MoTS)**. Our job postings use standard titles so you can find us, but if you join Tutor, you'll be a MoTS — with a level that is determined through the interview process.
That also means we hire people, not slots. Work at Tutor evolves every quarter, and we set the expectation of flexibility from day one — it's common for people to start on one thing and shift to another based on where the team needs them most. A high technical bar across the board is what makes that flexibility possible: it's what allows people to contribute meaningfully whatever problem they take on.

jobs.title: Python Software Engineer (Production)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Anduril Imaging team develops state\-of\-the\-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro\-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.


### **ABOUT THE JOB**



As a Production Software Engineer, you'll be responsible for developing product\-agnostic software solutions for our production teams. You'll work cross\-functionally with production and software teams to enhance automation and build efficiencies. Your role will involve hands\-on software development and collaboration with cross\-functional teams to ensure optimal performance and integration of cutting\-edge technologies.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

  

* Develop product\-agnostic software solutions to optimize production efficiency and product quality
* Design and implement hardware testing strategies and tools
* Collaborate across multiple teams, especially software and production, to enhance automation
* Create and maintain documentation for testing procedures and tools
* Analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement
* Provide feedback to design teams for product enhancements
* Conduct root cause analysis to triage production, product, and process issues
* Lead system architecture designs of technical initiatives


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of professional software development experience
* Proficiency in Python
* Excellent problem\-solving/critical thinking skills and attention to detail
* Ability to work and communicate collaboratively in a cross\-functional team environment
* Demonstrated accountability and ownership, team\-player, self\-motivated
* Drove strategic design of scalable system architecture
* Familiarity with Linux, Git, and networking
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Master's degree in a relevant engineering field
* Experience in hardware testing and automated test systems
* Strong understanding of hardware\-software integration
* Experience with data analysis and performance monitoring
* Prior work in a high\-volume manufacturing environment
* Experience with: SQL/databases, C/C\+\+, javascript, nix


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

  

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE\&TC) organization is the central focus for Mission Systems Integration activities within Raytheon, responsible for defining customer needs, functional and product architecture, requirements definition and decomposition, Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), algorithm development and system performance. The Radar Systems Department within the SE\&TC is seeking a Systems Engineer to help in the development of requirements, concepts of operations and algorithms, and the execution of integration and analysis activities. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities to solve complex problems. In this role, you’ll collaborate across disciplines and partner closely with engineering teams to turn ideas into integrated, working solutions. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role where your work directly enables teams to deliver reliable, mission\-ready systems.

 **What You Will Do**


In this role, you will support one or more of the following types of activities:

* Develop concepts of operations for radar systems.
* Develop radar processing algorithm.
* Develop Radar systems/software requirements.
* Be responsible for statistical and numerical analysis of radar performance data.
* Be responsible for analysis tool development in support of problem identification and resolution.
* Collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to develop and implement solutions.
* Present findings and solutions to Leadership and/or Customers.
* This role can be based out of either Tewksbury, MA or Marlborough, MA.
* May require up to 20% travel to RTX facilities, test sites, vendor facilities, and customer locations to support test events and mission execution.

 **Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 2 years of prior relevant experience.
* Experience with systems hardware, systems/software requirements, systems integration, and/or systems test.
* Experience with MATLAB, Python, C/C\+\+ and/or other programming language.

 **Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience with design, development, and analysis of radar system and software architecture.
* Experience with signal processing techniques in complex propagation environments.
* Proven experience in system\-level requirements development, documentation, and maintenance, or design and development of system\-level software architecture.
* Experience with DOORS, Rhapsody, Cameo or other digital engineering tools.
* Experience with evaluating systems using simulated environments.
* Experience with military systems.
* Current/Active DoD security clearance.

 **What We Offer**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  

* Relocation Eligibility– Relocation assistance available

* Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

jobs.title: Scrum Master / Systems Engineer - SWIS
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

 **CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**  

Department of Defense Secret security clearance is preferred at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, **U.S. citizenship is required**.
Responsibilities for this Position:
**ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES:**
As a Systems Engineer \- Scrum Master for the Strategic Weapon Interface Simulator (SWIS), you will perform systems engineering and help a cross\-functional engineering team plan and deliver simulation capabilities supporting the future Columbia\-class submarine fleet.  

SWIS brings together the simulation capabilities needed to support both Fire Control system development and fleet training. It allows engineering teams to develop, integrate, and test Fire Control capabilities in lab environments and helps prepare the fleet to operate those capabilities before they are used aboard a submarine.  

In this role, you will facilitate the team's Agile execution and contribute directly to systems engineering work. You will use Jira to maintain a clear and actionable backlog, plan achievable work, track sprint commitments and team performance, manage dependencies, and provide transparent status to stakeholders. You will facilitate Scrum events, remove impediments, and use Jira data and objective measures to improve predictability and delivery. You will partner with product owners, technical leads, engineering disciplines, and program leadership to connect technical priorities with executable plans.  

You will apply an understanding of Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and Cost Account Management (CAM) when planning and reporting the team's work. You may support CAMs and program leadership by maintaining credible work plans, evaluating actual and forecast performance, contributing to estimates to complete and estimates at completion, supporting variance analysis and change\-control activities, and communicating risks and corrective actions. You may not be the CAM of record for assigned work packages, but you will understand how day\-to\-day engineering execution affects program cost, schedule, and earned value performance.  

You will also contribute to systems engineering activities across the development life cycle, including requirements management, technical planning, integration, verification, test, risk management, and technical documentation. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys creating clarity, helping teams solve delivery problems, and connecting day\-to\-day engineering work to program cost and schedule commitments.  

We encourage you to apply if you have any of these preferred skills or experiences:* Hands\-on experience administering and using Jira to manage backlogs, epics, stories, tasks, workflows, dashboards, queries, sprint metrics, dependencies, and team reporting.
* Experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile team facilitator, project lead, or technical task lead for a cross\-functional engineering team.
* Experience with Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, DevSecOps, or other Lean\-Agile practices in a hardware, software, systems, or integrated product\-development environment.
* Experience supporting Cost Account Management or working with earned value management systems (EVMS), work breakdown structures, integrated master schedules, or program planning and control.
* Experience analyzing schedule and cost performance using measures such as schedule performance index (SPI), cost performance index (CPI), budgeted cost, actual cost, and estimate at completion.
* Experience developing resource plans, forecasts, variance analyses, corrective\-action plans, or inputs to program reviews.
* Experience managing technical scope, risks, dependencies, and changes while maintaining alignment among engineering and program stakeholders.
* Experience with systems engineering activities such as requirements management, system design, integration, verification, test, or technical documentation.
* Experience integrating Jira planning and performance data with Confluence, scheduling tools, EVMS tools, or program reporting processes.
* Experience with defense systems, Fleet Ballistic Missile or Fire Control programs, simulation systems, training systems, or other mission\-critical integrated systems.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile, EVMS, or CAM training or certification.
 **What sets you apart:*** Solid understanding and application of systems engineering principles, concepts, and theories.
* Strong Jira skills and the ability to configure useful team workflows, dashboards, filters, and reports while maintaining reliable planning data.
* Ability to facilitate productive planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily coordination while helping a team continuously improve.
* Ability to translate technical scope into logical work packages, measurable milestones, realistic forecasts, and clear ownership.
* Working understanding of project leadership principles, including SPI/CPI, earned value, Cost Account Management, forecasting, and disciplined change control.
* Ability to identify emerging cost, schedule, technical, and dependency risks and drive practical corrective actions to closure.
* Collaborative leadership style that supports team accountability, constructive problem\-solving, and transparent communication.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain performance, risks, and recommendations to technical and program stakeholders.
* Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle complex assignments efficiently.
* Commitment to ongoing professional development for yourself and others.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**



The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:


* **Data Processing**: We are building state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user\-friendly, and highly fault\-tolerant.
* **Data Discovery**: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
* **Data Lineage**: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.
  


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
* Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
* Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
* Lead and champion high\-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.
  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
* BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
* Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
* Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
* Experience with distributed system design and development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, continuous delivery environment
  


**Bonus Points (not required):**


* Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in cross\-functional development teams
* Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
* Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.
  


**We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.**

  

**\#LI\-AE1**

 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.**


**Our journey is always people first.**



We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.


**Higher purpose, greater impact.**



We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do.


**Scale up, not starting up.**



Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.



Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.


*Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

jobs.description:
**Location:** This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.


**The Opportunity**



You will own and shape how Praxis designs, governs, secures, and operates AWS at scale—from account structure and identity to the platforms and applications that run on them. You will be a hands\-on builder, using your depth in cloud infrastructure and software engineering to create secure, reliable systems that enable our teams to move quickly.



You will work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. You will build and improve the systems that keep our teams moving fast while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and compliance. You will work primarily in TypeScript and Python, use modern AI tooling as part of your daily engineering workflow, and take direct accountability for production operations, including on\-call.



You will be expected to see problems, take ownership, and drive them through resolution. You will move quickly through incremental, well\-controlled changes, question assumptions when there is a better path, and turn operational learnings into durable improvements. Just as importantly, you will raise the bar for the people and systems around you by sharing what you know, communicating clearly, and helping the broader team build and operate better.


**Primary Responsibilities**


* Own and evolve AWS architecture for enterprise workloads, including multi\-account foundations, landing zone / Control Tower patterns, networking, security baselines, and shared platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve AWS governance, including organizational structure, SCPs, tagging, cost controls, compliance, audit readiness, and durable operational standards.
* Design and operate identity and access across AWS, including IAM, IAM Identity Center, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations for SSO, federation, role mapping, access reviews, and least\-privilege access.
* Build, harden, and operate AWS platforms and full\-stack services using TypeScript and Python, including compute, containers, serverless, data stores, messaging, and cloud automation as needed.
* Drive operational excellence across AWS platforms and workloads by building effective monitoring, alerting, dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, runbooks, incident response practices, and durable fixes to recurring problems; participate in the on\-call rotation and own incidents through resolution and learning.
* Automate infrastructure and delivery through Infrastructure as Code—preferably Pulumi and/or SST—and CI/CD using Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions, with an emphasis on safe, incremental delivery and low blast radius.
* Partner across engineering and IT to translate needs into secure, maintainable solutions, improve production readiness and operational practices, mentor other engineers, and use sound judgment to move fast without breaking things.


**Qualifications**


* Senior\-level software engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on experience building and operating production systems on AWS.
* Strong full\-stack engineering capability in TypeScript and Python, including APIs, services, tooling, and cloud automation.
* Deep experience with core AWS services used in enterprise environments, including IAM, Organizations, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudWatch, KMS, Config, and GuardDuty.
* Proven ability to design and operate AWS governance at scale, including multi\-account strategy, policy guardrails, access control, security standards, and operational controls.
* Strong AWS networking fundamentals, including VPNs, peering, Transit Gateway, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with enterprise SSO; Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) federation into AWS is strongly preferred, including SAML/OIDC, IAM Identity Center, application and role mapping, and access lifecycle practices.
* Experience working in regulated or audit\-ready environments, with strong habits around change control, evidence and traceability, least privilege, and durable controls.
* Demonstrated operational ownership: able to establish meaningful alerts and monitors, reduce noise, improve reliability, respond to incidents, and turn operational learnings into engineering improvements.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience; Pulumi and/or SST strongly preferred. Terraform or AWS CDK experience is transferable and welcome.
* Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions.
* Proficient with modern AI coding and productivity tools, with the judgment to validate outputs, test changes, manage risk, and maintain production quality.
* The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**  

  

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and *their* people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company\-paid life insurance, AD\&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar\-for\-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long\-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company\-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let's achieve the impossible together!  

  

**Company Overview**



Praxis

This role is based remotely, but if the candidate lives within a 50 miles radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week (or other frequency dictated by your manager).  



**The Role:**

  

General Motors is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to shape and scale the engineering platforms that build, test, integrate, validate, and deliver embedded software for software\-defined vehicles. This role is for a hands\-on technical leader who can turn ambiguous, cross\-team problems into durable architecture, practical standards, and measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness, release confidence, and product quality.
