jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.

* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.

Job Category: Engineering
Time Type: Full time
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Top Secret
Employee Type: Regular
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%
Type of Travel: Continental US
\* \* \*  

  

**The Opportunity:**

  

CACI/Space’s Radar and Sensor Technologies group is seeking a systems engineer to support one of our primary programs working with the US Government to understand and define requirements for our software staff. In this position, you will be at the forefront of developing the systems that keep our nation safe and work in space emerging technology. This position will work with our team on adapting our architecture to the program requirements, creating a testing approach, and interacting across our program teams to ensure clear understanding during the software development cycle. The position is based in Ypsilanti, Michigan. This work requires candidates to be a US citizen eligible for a Top Secret clearance.  



  

**Responsibilities:**

  

Take algorithm definitions and prototypes and convert them into robust software applications.


Collaborate with radar/electro\-optical and research scientist experts to solve issues and iterate to improve image product quality.


Provide systems engineering and enterprise architecture support to USG customers.


Work with software engineers to translate signals and architecture into working code.


Develop standard and repeatable processes, as appropriate, to support development and integration of new and emerging capabilities.


Support engineering review boards.


Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely and effective manner.  



  

**Qualifications:**

*Required:*

  

US citizenship eligible for a Top Secret Clearance. Work full\-time on\-site. Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline. In lieu of a degree, four years of experience may be substituted.


2\+ years of experience performing all/most aspects of product development, including defining requirements and validating hardware or software Knowledge of signal processing.  



  

*Desired:*

Experience with software and system development projects using model bases system engineering. Experience working with AWS and Microsoft Office. Worked on a team using Agile or SAFe development processes.


Programming experience Experience writing software implementing algorithms.


Desire to learn new technologies.  

  

  

  



* 

**What You Can Expect:** 

**A culture of integrity.**

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high\-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.


**An environment of trust.**

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers \- every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.


**A focus on continuous growth.**

jobs.description:
**About Treetown Tech**



Treetown Tech is an engineering and manufacturing company that takes ideas from a napkin sketch through low\-rate production, under one roof. Our teams work side by side across mechanical, manufacturing, electrical, software, and battery engineering to design, build, and manufacture hardware for clients ranging from early\-stage hardware startups to established aerospace, battery, and semiconductor companies.



Our team has built and shipped hardware behind UAV flight controllers, battery management systems and charging electronics, semiconductor test equipment, and industrial automation and control systems. If you like seeing a design go from a schematic to a working prototype to something that ships, you'll find real variety here.


**About the Opportunity**



Treetown Tech is looking for an on\-site, experienced, full\-time Electrical Engineering Technician. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is experienced in building real hardware alongside diverse engineering teams.



You'll fit well here if you keep an organized work area, are deeply committed to cooperation and communication, take safety and quality seriously as a matter of habit rather than compliance, and are comfortable digging into a variety of tasks in a fast\-paced, multi\-disciplined team.



Treetown Tech offers competitive compensation and benefits including healthcare, IRA matching, and generous PTO and sick time.


**What You'll Do**


**Solder \& Assembly**


* Perform PCB assembly including surface\-mount and through\-hole soldering, using solder pencils, hot\-air reflow, and reflow ovens.
* Handle general and rework soldering across a mix of straightforward assembly runs and more detailed, time\-critical rework or design changes.


**Wiring \& Harness Building**


* Build wiring harnesses and wire for AC and DC circuits, including industrial automation wiring, wire end termination/crimping, and connector assembly.
* Read schematics, wiring diagrams, and eCAD to build to print, working collaboratively with the designer or engineer on the project.


**Electrical Testing**


* Support electrical test activities such as charge/discharge testing and end\-of\-line test.
* Collect and record test data accurately and diligently.
* Follow and complete internal quality control documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**


* Keep your work area organized and follow safety protocols and quality standards on every task.
* Flag issues or quality concerns as they come up rather than working around them.


**PLC Cabinet Wiring (bonus capability – not required)**


* PLC cabinet wiring and fluency with wiring diagram/schematic conventions used in cabinet builds.
* Fabrication and assembly of PLC cabinets.
* PLC cabinet testing and quality control.


**What We’re Looking For**


* Electrical shop experience, and comfort working in a fast\-paced, multi\-disciplined team.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbally, with coworkers.
* A habit of showing up on time and staying on task throughout the day.
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to know when to ask for help rather than guess.
* Eagerness to roll with frequent design changes that come with R\&D and prototypes.
* Openness to receiving direction and training from others, and to navigating changing priorities.
* Genuine care for the wellbeing of the people around them. A true team player.
* Driven to reduce cost, complexity, and time for themselves and those around them.
* Ability to lift loads of up to 50 lbs.


**Additional Nice to Haves, but Not Required**


* Soldering/rework certification (IPC or similar).
* Prior troubleshooting experience on machine or PLC electrical systems.
* Experience with small\-scale line manufacturing.
* Experience with parts ordering and inventory.
* Forklift certification.
* Experience coordinating directly with external vendors.

Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

  

SEL manufactures intelligent electronic devices (IED), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), and logic controllers that provide state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, communication, and protection of power systems in multiple industries.

  

SEL Engineering Services (SEL ES) is the sector of SEL that creates solutions to target applications of SEL equipment for worldwide customers. * Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution
* Industrial Plants and Universities– Substation and Switchgear
* Renewables – Wind, Solar, and BESS

  

SEL ES \- Automation projects focus on data collection of system IEDs, logic controls, and the presentation of data for the customer to monitor and control their power system.


Utilizing real\-time logic controllers and communication equipment, the SEL ES Automation engineer owns the planning, design, development, testing and commissioning of the project. Projects often include, but are not limited to:

* Communication network equipment
* Configuration of real\-time controllers to serve as RTUs.
* Human Machine Interface (HMI) or server to an upstream SCADA client.

jobs.description:
Controls Engineer – Multiple Career Levels
  
PAR Systems designs and builds custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges across industries including medical device, aerospace, and defense. Our solutions are engineered to solve our customers’ most complex challenges, not pulled from a catalog. You will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging systems incorporating robots, vision, complex motion, lasers, and more.
  
  

We're looking for Controls Engineers across multiple career levels. Levels are based on the experience, technical depth, independence, and leadership each candidate brings, not whether they've worked with every technology or tool we use. If your background is in custom automation and you enjoy figuring out how to make complex machines work, we'd like to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't match every technology listed below.
  
  

What You'll Own
  
As a Controls Engineer at PAR, you'll help bring custom automated equipment from concept to production. Depending on your experience, you may contribute to or independently lead the controls scope of a project, including:
  
* Translating customer and system requirements into a controls architecture and technical approach.
* Designing, programming, and integrating PLC, HMI, motion, robotics, vision, and other automation technologies.
* Bringing equipment to life through power\-up, debug, commissioning, and process optimization.
* Troubleshooting complex hardware, software, and system\-level problems.
* Supporting design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing, installation, and Site Acceptance Testing.
* Partnering with mechanical, electrical, software, project management, operations, and quality teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* At more senior levels, owning controls execution for entire production lines, providing technical direction, mentoring other engineers, and helping teams solve their toughest automation challenges.


**Experience \& Requirements:** What You Bring
  
We're looking for a combination of relevant experience and technical capability. The requirements needed to be successful in this role are:
  
* A relevant engineering, computer science, automation, or technical background through education and/or equivalent experience.
* Experience developing and commissioning controls or software for automated equipment.
* The ability to troubleshoot problems across hardware, software, and machine processes.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering or project team.
* Increasing ownership of controls projects or systems appropriate to your career level.
* Openness to use of AI in your workflow
* Ability to travel to customer sites for installation and commissioning, typically 0–10%, with occasional variation based on project needs.
* US Persons


**Some of the platforms and tools you may work with include:**  

* PLC \& Controls: Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Omron Sysmac Studio, Beckhoff TwinCAT
* HMI/SCADA: FactoryTalk View, Inductive Automation Ignition
* Robotics: FANUC, Epson, KUKA
* Vision: Cognex, Keyence
* Software: Visual Studio, C\#, VB
* Motion: Servo and multi\-axis motion control systems
* Electrical Design: AutoCAD Electrical, ePLAN, or similar tools
* Simulation: Ability to envision and pursue virtual commissioning


Technical Careers at PAR Systems \- Where You Could Fit
  
Great engineering careers are not one\-size\-fits\-all. At PAR Systems, engineers grow by taking on bigger challenges, expanding their technical expertise, and increasing their impact. Whether you are building your foundation, leading complex technical work, solving problems across teams, or shaping the future of our capabilities, there is room to grow and contribute at every stage of your career.
  
  

Our engineering career path includes Engineer, Advanced Engineer, Senior Engineer, and Principal Engineer, with increasing scope, independence, technical leadership, and impact at each level. Progression is based on demonstrated technical capability, problem\-solving, leadership, and impact, not simply years of overall experience.
  
  

For our experienced engineering opportunities, you don't need to determine where you fit before applying. We encourage you to start with a conversation. Together, we'll explore your experience, technical depth, and career interests to determine how they align with our engineering levels and opportunities.
  
  

You’ve learned about what you'll be doing, here are the benefits you'll gain when you join our team:
  
* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing
* First\-of\-a\-kind product culture and project exposure
* Training and development from industry\-leading experts
* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) \& matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability \& Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, \& Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement


PAR Systems is an equal opportunity employer and we value individuals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other status protected by applicable law. We use AI to assist with sorting applications, but real humans do all the evaluating and deciding. If selected for an interview, please advise our Human Resources department if you require accommodation during the interview or assessment process and we will support your accessibility needs. We offer market competitive pay and benefits based upon the candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**At Lhoist North America, our core values of Respect, Courage, and Integrity are more than words.** We respect people, encourage courageous innovation, and uphold integrity in everything we do. If these principles resonate with you, you may find your next great opportunity with us.

  

We believe our people make the difference. That’s why we invest in talent by offering meaningful opportunities to grow your skills, expand your knowledge, and pursue your interests. Our work environment prioritizes safety, fosters collaboration across teams, and embraces inclusion. Here, you’ll be challenged to grow, and you’ll be supported throughout your career journey. **Join us and help shape the future of Lhoist North America.**

 **POSITION SUMMARY:**


This position will support the Ste Genevieve Plant directly using existing automation systems and provide technical support as required by the plant. This role will be the liaison between the site management, division and corporate automation teams. Automation technologies will be used to facilitate data\-driven decisions leading to improved production efficiency, safety \& quality.

* Work closely with Capital Programs team as necessary.

**6\. Training and development**

* Develop yourself as a positive learner/professional who participates in cross\-functional communication and training between production and engineering teams.
* Drive culture changes of the plants from reactive to proactive in their approach to asset management and reliability.
* Provide feedback to direct managers and supervisors of those managed through projects.
* Train and upskill electricians and other team members

 **7\. Plant IT support for computers, hardware and software.**

* Install, maintain, and support all plant personal computer hardware and software. Liaison for corporate IT department on computer hardware and software installation, maintenance, and upgrades.

 **8\. Perform other duties as assigned.**

 **ATTRIBUTES:**

* Knowledge of PLC system design (Rockwell Automation preferred) and demonstrated capabilities with computers, VFDs, HMIs, Factory Talk View SE, process instrumentation, supervisory software and networks.
* Must be able perform advanced mathematical calculations, including advanced algebra and statistics.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Develop experience with our Control Systems and HMIs.
* Effective oral, written, and spoken communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and problem\-solving skills.
* Read, write, and interpret documents such as work orders, safety rules, standard operating procedures, electrical drawings, maintenance instructions, and procedural manuals.

 **PHYSICAL DEMANDS INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

* Must be physically able to perform work assigned.
* Must be physically capable of accessing all plant locations.
* Access all areas within a site which could include heights of 150 feet, confined spaces, climbing ladders or stairs, and accessing tunnels.

* Ability to lift/carry up to 50 pounds.

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Instrumentation. Associate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related technical field or demonstrated skills and abilit

jobs.description:

---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

In this role, you will have a challenging and rewarding opportunity to contribute to our enterprise\-wide digital transformation. Through the use of DevSecOps and Agile practices, we continue to evolve how we deliver critical national defense products and capabilities for the warfighter. This position supports the OIX program \- a platform which provides secure messaging and cross\-domain solution (CDS) products and services across the federal agencies and foreign partners. Our multi\-disciplinary team including software, systems, cyber, and test engineers employ the latest cutting\-edge technologies to deliver information across security domains.

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with 5\+ years of relative experience; Master's degree in a STEM discipline with 3\+ years of relative experience; PhD \+ 1 year of relative experience
* **Active Secret security clearance** enrolled in Continuous Evaluation, and ability to obtain TS/SCI
* Ability to meet customer\-specific security screening requirements within a timeframe set forth by management
* Demonstrated ability to analyze system requirements to derive software design and performance requirements
* Proven ability to design and code new software, as well as modify existing software to add new features
* Ability to debug existing software and correct defects
* Experience with open software/system architecture solutions
* Experience with Git\-based or other software configuration management tools

* Experience implementing Cyber Security controls on Linux
* Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with Agile lifecycle process including Scrum and DevSecOps

*This position is contingent upon the successful transfer of an active DoD Secret Clearance and the ability to meet customer\-specific security screening requirements (TS/SCI) within a timeframe set forth by management.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**



The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:


* **Data Processing**: We are building state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user\-friendly, and highly fault\-tolerant.
* **Data Discovery**: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
* **Data Lineage**: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.
  


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
* Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
* Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
* Lead and champion high\-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.
  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
* BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
* Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
* Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
* Experience with distributed system design and development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, continuous delivery environment
  


**Bonus Points (not required):**


* Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in cross\-functional development teams
* Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
* Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.
  


**We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.**

  

**\#LI\-AE1**

 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.**


**Our journey is always people first.**



We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.


**Higher purpose, greater impact.**



We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do.


**Scale up, not starting up.**



Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.



Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.


*Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

jobs.title: Electronic Attack Elwctronic Warfare Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Ready to make a difference? Our employees design, integrate, and test the world’s next generation communication and electronic warfare systems for the United States DoD and international customers. You will be among the brightest minds, working on the aerospace and defense industry’s most difficult problems.
  

Our Systems Engineering group is a high\-performance technical organization comprised of Electronic Attack (EA) Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with backgrounds spanning the Engineering Disciplines. The focus of our group is to provide customers a wide range of services and products acting as the Center of Excellence for EA solutions.
  

  

Software / Firmware engineers encouraged! Thinking about transitioning to a Systems Role? We support this and will guide your success. Some of our best SE’s have SW/FW backgrounds in EW. Most important is a success driven mentality. RADAR engineers also encouraged! Understanding RADAR is paramount to our Electronic Attack Capability.
  

  

We welcome all those who have big ideas, crave innovation, and want to develop, build and work on the world’s most advanced electromagnetic spectrum operations systems – detecting, locating and countering threats for joint and international aircrew. We develop highly sophisticated digital Electronic Warfare (EW) systems and we are looking for motivated and positive minded engineers highly skilled in Electronic Attack to join cross\-functional, multi\-disciplinary teams. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®.” Come build your career with us.
  

  

Roles and Responsibilities (Technical):
  

Key EW program objectives are to improve/enhance air vehicle survivability, through the abilities to detect, deny, deceive, degrade and/or disrupt adversaries Integrated Air Defenses. This position will involve developing new EA capabilities for application in EW systems and performing systems engineering functions such as developing and managing systems level requirements, developing operational systems concepts, performing system architecture trade studies, originating design concepts or performing systems level integration and test for highly complex systems, and preparing and/or delivering basic customer and technical presentations. Bring your enthusiasm and talent with EW Systems and Software and we will ensure you have great opportunities.
  

  

Because of the need for consistent, in\-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed full\-time on site. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time.

  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**

jobs.title: Manager, Embedded Software Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Eos Energy Enterprises**

Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. is accelerating the shift to American energy independence with positively ingenious solutions that transform how the world stores power. Our breakthrough Znyth™ aqueous zinc battery was designed to overcome the limitations of conventional lithium\-ion technology. It is safe, scalable, efficient, sustainable, manufactured in the U.S., and the core of our innovative systems that today provides utility, industrial, and commercial customers with a proven, reliable energy storage alternative for 3 to 12\-hour applications. Eos was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Edison, New Jersey. For more information about Eos (NASDAQ: EOSE), visit eose.com .


Eos is at the forefront of developing advanced embedded solutions for energy storage and management. The Manager of Embedded Software Engineering will lead a team of talented engineers in designing, developing, and optimizing firmware for Battery Management Systems (BMS) tailored to the Eos battery technologies, ensuring safety, reliability, and compliance with industry standards such as UL 1998, UL 60730 Annex H, etc.


The Manager of Embedded Software Engineering is responsible for overseeing the strategic direction, technical execution, and team performance in the development of embedded firmware for the Eos BMS. This role involves managing a team of engineers using the V\-model of software design, driving safety\-critical compliance with UL 60730 Annex H, and ensuring seamless integration of firmware with hardware components like STM32 microcontrollers, CAN/CANFD, RS\-485 protocols, ADC\-s, etc.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead Firmware Development for BMS: Oversee the design, documentation, development, and maintenance of embedded firmware for generations of Eos Battery Management Systems, ensuring adherence to the V\-model and compliance with UL 60730 Annex H functional safety standards.
* Team Management: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of embedded software engineers, setting performance goals, allocating resources, and fostering a collaborative, innovative environment.
* Drive Safety and Compliance: Ensure the implementation of diagnostics, fail\-safe mechanisms, and safety features (e.g., overvoltage/undervoltage protection, electrolyte monitoring) in BMS firmware, aligning with UL 60730 Annex H requirements.
* Strategic Oversight of Communication Protocols: Guide the team in designing and implementing communication interfaces (e.g., CAN/CANFD, RS\-485, I2C) for real\-time data transmission and control of battery systems.
* Collaborate on Hardware\-Software Integration: Partner with electronics engineering leads to ensure robust integration of firmware with BMS hardware, including sensors, ADCs, and power electronics, while overseeing validation and performance testing.
* Hardware\-Software Integration: Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure proper integration of firmware with BMS hardware components, including sensors, and power electronics, conducting safety validation and performance testing.
* Process Improvement: Develop and refine embedded software engineering processes to enhance efficiency, reliability, and scalability of BMS development.
* Documentation and Standards: Oversee the creation of comprehensive technical documentation (e.g., design specifications, test plans, compliance reports) and ensure traceability and quality per V\-model methodologies.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with other departments (e.g., product management, etc.) to align embedded software efforts with company goals and support troubleshooting tools and commissioning processes.
* Roadmap Development: Contribute to the strategic planning of future BMS product features and enhancements, aligning with Eos’ clean energy mission.
* Ensure a safe work environment by following health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Root Cause Analysis: Lead investigations into firmware\-related failures, implementing corrective actions to improve system reliability.
* Champion a culture of continuous learning by staying updated on advancements in BMS design, microcontroller platforms, and safety standards.
* Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Leadership Expertise: Proven ability to lead and inspire a team of embedded software engineers, balancing technical guidance with managerial oversight.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong background in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems, real\-time operating systems (RTOS), and microcontroller\-based development (e.g., STM32 family).
* Safety Standards Knowledge: Deep understanding of IEC 60730 Annex H and its application to safety\-critical embedded systems.
* Communication Protocols: Expertise in CAN bus, CANFD, RS\-485, SPI, I2C, and other protocols relevant to battery systems.
* Problem\-Solving: Exceptional ability to troubleshoot complex software and hardware integration issues and implement scalable solutions.
* Project Management: Skilled in managing timelines, resources, and deliverables in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
* Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and clearly articulate technical concepts.
* Knowledge of embedded security practices (e.g., secure bootloaders, encryption).

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related field required.
* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years' experience.

**Travel**
----------

* Local Travel: Less than 10%
* Overnight/North America: Less than 10%

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Office Environment \- Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time and occasion

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting\-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

World\-changing technologies. Life\-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

Sandia Department 5424 Electrical Flight Systems in the 5420 Strike Systems group is seeking an R\&D S\&E Systems Engineer to complement the Engineering team and help lead concept development efforts for new missile and weapon systems. Opportunities include leading multidisciplinary teams to rapidly identify operational needs for strike and defense applications, translate those needs into mission and technology\-informed requirements, and guide the concept maturation. **THIS IS AN ONSITE POSITION**

 **Summary**

* Parabit Systems, Inc., a leader in security, access control, and self\-service technology solutions, is seeking a highly motivated and hands\-on Embedded Systems Engineer to design and develop innovative products from concept through production. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong combination of hardware design, embedded firmware development, and system integration expertise who thrives in a fast\-paced product development environment.
* The successful candidate will be responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and support of embedded electronic systems deployed in real\-world applications across multiple industries. This position requires a practical engineer who can move seamlessly between hardware design, firmware development, prototype validation, manufacturing support, and field troubleshooting while maintaining a strong focus on quality, reliability, cybersecurity, and product performance.
* You will work closely with software developers, mechanical engineers, quality assurance, manufacturing, and service teams to deliver robust, reliable, and scalable products that meet customer and regulatory requirements.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of embedded hardware and firmware platforms for security, access control, sensing, and self\-service products.
* Define system architecture, hardware interfaces, communication protocols, microcontroller configurations, power distribution, signal conditioning, and overall embedded platform design.
* Design and develop embedded firmware using C/C\+\+ for microcontroller\-based systems, including control logic, communications, diagnostics, and device management functionality.
* Create electrical schematics, select components, perform engineering analysis , derating analyses, and conduct design reviews to ensure reliability, performance, and manufacturability.
* Provide instruction and guidance on necessary PCB layout requirements.
* Develop, test, and validate hardware and firmware designs throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Conduct hardware bring\-up debugging, and root\-cause analysis of system\-level issues.
* Review PCB layouts with emphasis on signal integrity, grounding, EMI/EMC mitigation, thermal management, power integrity, and design\-for\-manufacturing best practices.
* Implement secure coding principles and follow cybersecurity requirements in accordance with applicable standards, including NIST, FIPS, and ISO guidelines.
* Coordinate prototype builds, engineering validation testing, design verification, and product qualification activities.
* Support regulatory testing and compliance efforts, including FCC, CE, UL, EMC/EMI, RoHS, and related industry requirements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation .
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful product development, production launch, deployment, and ongoing product support.
* Evaluate new technologies, components, communication standards, and development tools to support future product initiatives.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in embedded systems design and firmware development.
* Proven experience developing products from concept through production release.
* Strong hands\-on experience in electronic circuit design, hardware integration, and board\-level troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in embedded firmware development using C and C\+\+.
* Experience with Python and Visual Basic is desirable.
* Strong understanding of microcontroller architectures and peripherals including GPIO, ADCs, DACs, SPI, IC, UART.
* Experience working with PIC and/or STM32 ARM Cortex microcontrollers preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics, PCB layouts, bills of materials (BOMs), datasheets, timing diagrams, and interface specifications.
* Experience using advanced testing equipment; oscilloscopes, analyzers, etc.
* Strong understanding of embedded networking and communication protocols, including:
	+ TCP/IP
	+ UDP
	+ Ethernet
	+ RS\-232/RS\-485
	+ Bluetooth
	+ NFC
	+ USB
	+ OSDP
	+ Z\-Wave
* Experience with Altium Designer, KiCad, or other advanced EDA tools.

jobs.description:

Candidate will be required to work with customers to design electrical control systems for automated equipment. We are looking for an applicant with solid work ethics, ability to work with others and a positive understanding attitude to develop unique machinery for our customers.

· Proficient in understanding and drawing 2\-D electrical schematics using Auto\-Cad or Draftsight

· PLC Programming experience (we typically use Rockwell Automation)

· Can work independently and develop solutions to automation challenges

· Experience with electromechanical devices such as servos, pneumatic systems and sensors

· Working knowledge of safety protocols such as Risk Assessment, Sistema, Lockout/Tagout

· Ability to create user manuals for automation equipment

· Good communication skills interfacing with assembly technicians

· Robotic programming a plus

What We Offer

· Competitive compensation and benefits.

· Exposure to a wide variety of custom design and build projects.

· A collaborative, hands\-on environment where ideas quickly turn into real\-world solutions.

Job Type: Full\-time

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Scientist, Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high\-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work\-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.


L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission\-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end\-to\-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title:** Scientist, Systems Engineering  

**Job Code:** 45015  

**Job Location:** Rochester, New York
  

**Job Schedule:** 9/80 (Every Other Friday Off!)  

  

**Job Description:**  

The L3Harris space superiority and imaging systems engineering department is seeking a systems engineer to join our team and support programs that we have recently won. The department specializes in space\-based, small and large aperture visible and infrared telescopes with integrated electromechanical devices used for motion and focus control. The successful candidate will be a program technical lead (Lead or Chief Systems Engineer, IPT Lead) by performing technical analysis, managing specifications, and generating design review and technical documents. Additional responsibilities include leading the test and design verification, requirements sell off, and end item data package (EIDP) generation efforts.  

  

  

  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Lead the development and execution of system architecture and system design plans.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure integration and compatibility of all system components and provide technical leadership and guidance throughout the entire project lifecycle.
* Comfortable negotiating technical and non\-technical scope with customers
* Experience with active and passive remote sensing
* Direct experience leading technical teams
* Experience leading large space programs across the full system lifecycle.
* Systems engineering experience in passive/active electro\-optical hardware
* Perform technical analysis, manage specifications, and generate design review, requirements, specifications, interface, and technical documents.
* Support product test and design verification, requirements sell\-off, risk assessments and mitigations, end item data package generation efforts
* Mentor and train junior engineers to build and strengthen the team’s technical expertise.
* Engage in continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance engineering efficiency and effectiveness.
* Utilize systems engineering tools and methodologies to support model\-based systems engineering (MBSE).
* Contribute to proposal development and program planning activities.
 **Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior related experience.
* 5\+ years systems engineering experience with space\-based payloads, vehicle systems, EO/IR systems with electromechanical pointing and focus control.
* Candidate with an active Top Secret/SCI clearance is highly desirable.

  

**Preferred Additional Skills:**  

* Holds an active Secret or Top Secret/SCI clearance.
* Technical Subject Matter Expertise in optical, electro\-optical, electrical, mechanical, electromechanical, or equivalent engineering discipline.
* Relevant experience with the design, manufacture, integration, test and sell\-off of space\-based EO/IR subsystems.
* Cameo Systems/No Magic Model\-based systems engineering (MBSE), SysML
* Ability to manage multiple and competing priorities.
* Ability to support program milestone reviews (SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR, FCA/PCA, PSR).
* Ability to collaborate across all levels of leadership.
* Work collaboratively with others and complete assignments with a team\-oriented approach.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills – taking complex concepts and sharing with others.
* Ability to architect an end\-to\-end space system with a full understanding of the product lifecycle.
* Experience with project management aspects of technology development programs.
* Experience with estimating and managing costs \& creating and managing schedules
  

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in New York is *$133,000 \- $247,000*. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company\-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer/Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Systems Engineer / Senior Systems Engineer

**Location:** Rome, NY

**Travel:** Up to 30% (CONUS; occasional OCONUS opportunities)

**Security Clearance:** Must be eligible to obtain and maintain the U.S. Government security clearance required for the position. Current U.S. Department of War Secret clearance preferred.

**Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. CoreVault Solutions does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

About CoreVault Solutions

CoreVault Solutions is a growing defense technology company delivering mission\-critical software and integrated operational capabilities for the U.S. Department of War and other government customers.

Our work spans command and control systems, air domain awareness, unmanned systems integration, geospatial visualization, tactical networking, sensor integration, cloud infrastructure, and operational decision support. We build and deploy complete mission systems that support real\-world operations in defense, public safety, and critical infrastructure environments.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and seeing their work deployed in operational environments.

Position Summary

CoreVault Solutions is seeking a Systems Engineer or Senior Systems Engineer to support the design, integration, deployment, and sustainment of mission\-critical systems for Department of War and other government customers.

This position works across software, hardware, networking, cloud infrastructure, sensors, tactical communications, and operational systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across technical disciplines, troubleshooting complex systems, supporting field deployments, and collaborating directly with software engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, customers, and mission partners.

Candidates may be considered at the Systems Engineer or Senior Systems Engineer level based on experience, technical capability, and qualifications.

Responsibilities

* Design, integrate, configure, test, deploy, and sustain complex mission systems.
* Integrate software applications with servers, networks, sensors, radios, tactical systems, and other external systems.
* Configure and maintain Linux and Windows servers, virtual machines, containers, and associated infrastructure.
* Support Kubernetes, Helm, containerized applications, and cloud or on\-premises deployment environments.
* Configure and troubleshoot system networking, connectivity, ports, services, certificates, and interfaces.
* Support integration of sensors, unmanned systems, tactical radios, TAK\-based systems, and other operational technologies.
* Perform system integration, verification, troubleshooting, and acceptance testing.
* Support system hardening, STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity activities in coordination with cybersecurity personnel.
* Develop and maintain system architecture, configuration, installation, test, troubleshooting, and sustainment documentation.
* Participate in site surveys, equipment staging, system installation, demonstrations, exercises, training events, and operational deployments.
* Troubleshoot issues across hardware, software, networking, operating systems, and external interfaces.
* Work directly with customers and technical partners to identify requirements and resolve operational issues.
* Support configuration management and accountability of government and company equipment.
* Assist with equipment receiving, inventory, purchasing coordination, and asset tracking as required.

jobs.description:

----------------------------



What We're Doing  

Do you want to be part of the team that provides test equipment solutions for the world's most advanced fleet of aircrafts? Do you enjoy a dynamic, fast\-paced work environment?  

Join Lockheed Martin's dynamic team working on the cutting edge of aerospace technology. We provide advanced test equipment solutions for the world's most advanced aircraft, including the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter, F\-16 and many more.


The Work  

This position is for a Lead Hardware Engineer Staff role supporting programs in the Automated Test Equipment (ATE) area.  

As a key member of our Test Equipment Hardware Engineering team, you will:

* Lead teams of multi\-disciplined engineers and technicians
* Be responsible for creating accurate Basis of Estimates
* Serve as CAM to the programs that you are assigned
* Ensure that project milestones and commitments are met
* Interface with and mentor Test Equipment Hardware engineers and other Integrated Product Teammates
* Execute a strategy to implement a common test equipment platform for AMS programs.
* Ensure project milestones and commitments are met
* Develop and integrate hardware systems/subsystems


Please Note: This position requires a government security clearance; you must be a US Citizen for consideration.

  

Who You Are  

You're the key team member in managing hardware tracking, procurement of material, developing documentation, and leading engineering efforts, ensuring compliance,  

resolving issues, and supporting project activities.

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other Engineering related discipline
* Experience with electrical design and troubleshooting

* Knowledgeable in Hardware Engineering processes and tools such as CREO or similar tools

* Experience with Engineering Change Control Processes

Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!


**Job Description**
-------------------


Are you looking for a challenging position to drive adoption of new technologies supporting our scientific computing community?

  



The Future Technology team is looking for engineers with a passion to improve our existing high performance computing platforms and drive new hardware and development environments. This position will require you to work closely with scientific computing partners within the Department of Energy and Department of Defense. You will also be expected to interface with internal stakeholders to explore high\-impact opportunities to develop and deploy future computing environments.

**Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill**

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering, science field; or Currently an Advanced Reactor Training Engineer, Refueling Engineer, or Field (RPCO) Engineer at the Company.**Preferred Skills**

Strong capability and knowledge of computing hardware including CPU, GPU, networking, and storage infrastructure.  

Proficiency with software development principles and environments.

Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across multiple disciplines of science and engineering.  

Strong ability to distill and communicate complex technical topics to diverse audiences in written, verbal, and multimedia formats.  

Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently.  

Intellectually curious, creative, and able to proactively engage stakeholders in future technologies.

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Wellness Program
* Visit us online to view all NNL benefits!

$86,100\.00 \- $134,600\.00 annually

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon.  **What You’ll Get to Do:**


Provides custom software design and development of specialized tools and techniques. Designs and develops end\-to\-end data flow and tasking into the tools developed. Program in Assembly, C, C\+\+, Java, Perl, or Python. Develop Windows applications using Visual Studio or .NET environments; UNIX applications using make files or comparable build environments; or, Embedded or mobile platform development using proprietary, GOTS, or open\-source build environments. Provide/author documentation, participate in design, code, and software readiness reviews as prescribed by the Government's software development procedures and processes.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or network engineering with 8 years of experience, Masters degree with 6 years of experience, PhD with 0 year of experience.
* Current/active TS/SCI w/Polygraph (through the MD Customer)
* Experience in Python or C/C\+\+ programming
* Experience with troubleshooting and debugging systems

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience analyzing user requirements to derive software design and performance requirements
* Software analysis or reverse engineering
* CNO development concepts, tools and techniques
* Unit testing frameworks and practices

  

This position description does not represent a current opening but may be used to identify candidates with skills and experience for positions within Northrop Grumman that frequently become available. Candidates who express an interest may be considered for future positions at Northrop Grumman.

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a work environment which encourages your growth and supports the mutual success of our people and our company. Your benefits will include the following: Health Plan, Savings Plan, Paid Time Off and Additional Benefits including: Education Assistance, Training and Development, 9/80 Work Schedule (where available), and much more!

Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Controls Engineer to join our innovative engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, developing, and testing advanced control systems that drive industrial automation and manufacturing processes. Your expertise will help optimize system performance, enhance reliability, and ensure seamless integration of electrical and mechanical components. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects that shape the future of automation technology.

**Job Title: Controls Engineer**

**Experience : 3\+yrs**  
**Visa: Only USC**

**Hybrid position in Michigan**

**Job Summary**

Controls Hardware Designer is responsible for architecting, designing, and validating electrical control systems for automated machinery and industrial processes. This role focuses on panel layouts, power distribution, and integrating programmable controllers, safety systems, and industrial communication networks

Core Responsibilities

**Control Panel Design: Create comprehensive electrical schematics and physical layout blueprints for industrial control panels and enclosures.**

**Power Distribution: Design low\-to\-medium voltage power distribution systems, ensuring correct sizing for circuit breakers, fuses, transformers, and contactors.**

**Component Integration: Select and integrate Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), servo systems, and industrial sensors.**

**Safety System Design: Architect failsafe safety circuits incorporating safety relays, light curtains, E\-stops, and interlocks to protect factory operators.**

**Network Architecture: Design industrial network topologies utilizing protocols like EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus, and EtherCAT.**

**Field Wiring \& Routing: Specify cable types, conduit sizing, and terminal block arrangements for field wiring between control panels and machinery.**

**Testing \& Commissioning: Perform factory acceptance testing (FAT) and provide occasional on\-site support for equipment commissioning and troubleshooting.**

**Required Technical Skills**

**Industrial CAD Software: High proficiency in specialized electrical design tools, specifically EPLAN Electric P8 or AutoCAD Electrical.**

**Regulatory Codes: Deep working knowledge of industrial safety and electrical standards, notably NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 79, and UL 508A (or IEC 60204 for European markets).**

**Motor Control: Mastery of motor control circuits, including direct\-on\-line starters, soft starters, and VFD configurations.**

**Short Circuit Calculations: Ability to calculate short\-circuit current ratings (SCCR) and perform voltage drop calculations.**

**Soft Skills \& Environment**

**On\-Site Adaptability: Comfort working in active manufacturing environments, assembly floors, or construction zones during project deployment.**

**Collaboration: Ability to collaborate closely with Controls/PLC Programmers, Mechanical Engineers, and electrical technicians.**

**Vendor Management: Experience communicating with component suppliers and panel fabrication shops to ensure parts meet specifications.**

**Education \& Experience Qualifications**

**Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.**

**Familiarity with GM GCCH and Ford GVOSS standards.**

**Experience: 3\+ years of experience designing electrical control systems specifically for industrial automation, robotics, or system integration.**

Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R-EGI Program
jobs.description:
**Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R\-EGI Program**

  


**Position Overview**


IS4S is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test software for the R\-EGI program. R\-EGI brings together GPS/GNSS, inertial sensors, and other navigation capabilities to support resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) for military aircraft.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable developing C/C\+\+ software on embedded Linux systems, bringing up software on hardware, and solving problems at the boundary between software, sensors, and avionics. The engineer will work closely with systems, navigation, hardware, and test teams through integration and qualification.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ software for navigation processing, device interfaces, middleware, and system control.
* Develop and debug software on embedded Linux platforms, including interactions with device drivers, operating system services, and hardware interfaces.
* Integrate GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, and other navigation inputs; work with navigation engineers to implement and evaluate sensor\-fusion and estimation functions.
* Diagnose system\-level issues involving software timing, sensor data, electrical interfaces, and hardware behavior.
* Support hardware bring\-up and software integration in laboratory and system integration lab environments.
* Develop automated tests, diagnostic tools, and scripts that improve software integration, regression testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including evaluation of performance when GPS is degraded or unavailable.
* Translate system and interface requirements into software designs, test procedures, and verification evidence.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect resolution, and software releases.
* Support technical reviews and program milestones, including PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification activities.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help the team resolve complex embedded software issues.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 8 or more years of embedded software engineering experience.
* Strong C and C\+\+ proficiency for embedded or real\-time applications.
* Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on embedded Linux systems.
* Experience working with hardware interfaces, device drivers, or low\-level software and diagnosing hardware/software integration issues.
* Experience using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or debuggers to troubleshoot embedded systems.
* Experience with software requirements, interface definitions, verification, and configuration management.
* Experience with Git, cross\-compilation toolchains, and automated builds.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with military aviation PNT systems, GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, inertial navigation systems, or integrated GPS/INS solutions.
* Experience with navigation estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, or operation in GPS\-degraded and GPS\-denied environments.
* Experience with aircraft avionics interfaces such as MIL\-STD\-1553 or ARINC 429\.
* Experience developing and integrating systems that use modern embedded processing platforms, such as the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+ MPSoC.
* Experience with real\-time Linux, VxWorks, INTEGRITY, or another real\-time operating system.
* Experience with software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system integration labs.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis, or diagnostic tools.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, interface diagrams, and hardware documentation.
* Experience supporting formal software qualification or airworthiness activities.
* Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.


**Benefits**


Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits


Dynamic and collaborative work environment


Employee ownership


Medical, dental, and vision care plans


Paid time\-off and parental leave programs


Group term life insurance


401(k) retirement plan


Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Global multi\-billion dollar company about 30 minutes north of downtown Lexington, KY area has a need for a Robotics Engineer. This is a direct hire role with a full benefits package.


The primary responsibility of this role is to develop and implement innovative activities, improving manufacturing competitiveness and reducing fixed costs in North America


Reporting to the Engineering Manager the person in this role will support the Advanced Technology department's objective to learn and confirm innovative technologies for vehicle manufacturing.

 **What you'll be doing**

* Integrate and deploy AI\-enabled robotic solutions to improve manufacturing capability, flexibility, and performance.
* Develop and implement computer vision, machine learning, and sensor fusion solutions for real\-world manufacturing applications (e.g., bin picking, part handling, inspection).
* Build and optimize AI models for robust performance on industrial hardware, balancing latency, reliability, and compute constraints.
* Bridge the gap between modern AI Python scripts and standard industrial automation.
* Utilize simulation tools (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or equivalent) to support concept validation, synthetic data generation, and Sim2Real deployment.
* Lead and support equipment trials, debugging, and performance validation from proof\-of\-concept through production deployment (yokoten).
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with robotics engineers, controls engineers, and plant manufacturing teams to integrate AI into production systems.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement emerging Physical AI technologies through benchmarking, supplier engagement, and industry events.
* Ensure solutions meet safety, reliability, and manufacturability requirements, including alignment with applicable standards and internal risk assessments.
* Present technical concepts, results, and recommendations to stakeholders, management, and executive leadership.
* Manage contractors to design and construct testing cells.
* Produce clear, detailed documentation to support future scaling and customer enablement.

 **Requirements**  

Qualifications

**What you bring**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation deployments.
* Experience in robotics, AI/ML, or advanced automation development.
* Having a full\-stack mindset while working in team environments building complete solutions, not just independent AI algorithms, demonstrations, and experiments.
* Strong hands\-on experience in at least two of the following:

  

* Computer vision (e.g., detection, segmentation, 3D perception)
* Machine learning / deep learning
* Robotics
* Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, ROS\-based systems; strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Deep understanding of different sensor types (RGBD cameras, LiDAR, Time\-of\-Flight sensors, etc.) and the ability to tune for image quality accuracy and performance.

  

**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability
* Training \& Development

Lincoln Electric’s innovative solutions enable higher quality and productivity across a variety of processes including welding, cutting, brazing, machining, process automation, and field repair. The Company leverages proprietary technologies and expertise in materials science, power electronics, automation, and intelligent software to help customers build better and achieve resilience in their operations. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, Lincoln Electric is the essential ‘Linc’ that keeps the economy running. The Company operates 71 manufacturing and automation facilities across 20 countries and serves customers in over 160 countries. -----------

* Strong PLC programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience with robotic automation, control system integration, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience selecting and applying motors, drives, sensors, actuators, safety devices, and industrial control hardware.
* Experience with control panels, power distribution, grounding/bonding, circuit protection, and machine installation requirements.

* Experience supporting build, commissioning, startup, and field\-service activities.

jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience.
