WAG\-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.  

In this role, you will:  

* Assess microelectronics, integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips used in military equipment
* Using experience with lab equipment, assess and exploit circuity, processors, and memory chips and implement methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Collaborate with Service labs and industry partners in assessing current and future weapons systems’ susceptibilities and vulnerabilities to an adversary’s exploitation; evaluate and develop friendly forces lab exploitation capabilities of US weapons systems’ electronic circuitry
* Using expertise in DoD, AF and common engineering and scientific principles, criteria, and procedures; improve planned and existing weapon system manufacture, operations, re\-manufacture and de\-militarization operations and oversight
* Interface with DoD Anti\-Tamper Evaluation Teams to evaluate current designs and identify vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to foreign and adversary exploitation
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Develop plans to assess security features of Government Off\-The\-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off\-The Shelf (COTS) components for CPI susceptibility/vulnerability to exploitation and reverse engineering
* Assist efforts to improve US weapons system anti\-tamper/anti\-exploitation design, development, manufacturing, training, and sustainment
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long\-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:  

* An active DoW Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Program (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* A Bachelor’s Degree in engineering from an ABET accredited program plus 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
	+ OR a Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a Bachelor’s in engineering from an ABET accredited program and a minimum of 8 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum of 3 years of SAP and/or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* The ability to travel up to 10%.

  

Additional desired experience and skills:


* A Bachelor’s in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from an ABET accredited program
* DoW Anti\-Tamper and program protection planning knowledge and experience
* Familiar with electrical and electronic circuits, Institute for Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) standard communication circuits, electro\-mechanical interface design, and software control of electronic circuits

jobs.description:
**About REEcycle**

REEcycle is an American rare earth elements (REE) recycling company focused on recovering rare earths from end\-of\-life NdFeB magnets to bolster U.S. supply chain resilience and reduce dependence on foreign sources of critical minerals. Backed by U.S. Department of War funding, we are establishing production at our facility in Duncan, Oklahoma.

**About the Role**

As we scale toward commercial deployment, we are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to lead the team and optimize our proprietary systems. A key focus will be on the deployment, testing, and further build out of our Drive Disassembly Machine (DDM), a critical component to REEcycle’s future success. This system efficiently extracts magnets from hard disk drives, creating economically viable feedstocks for our processes.

We are looking for an energetic self\-starter who thrives in dynamic environments, brings inventive and solutions\-oriented thinking, and is ready to play a key role in building the future of U.S. rare earth independence.

If you're excited by the opportunity to lead engineering efforts at a high\-impact company with significant room for career advancement, we’d love to speak with you about our Senior Engineer position.

This is a full\-time, on\-site (not remote) position in Duncan, OK.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop deep working knowledge of the company’s proprietary machinery, which integrates hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical assemblies, and PLC\-based control systems.

Deployment and Field Learning

* Support and monitor deployments, ensuring field performance aligns with expectations.

Early Manufacturing Strategy and Vendor Engagement

* Collaborate with operations and supply chain teams to plan for small\-batch production, including component sourcing, assembly workflows, and QA/QC processes.
* Help qualify external manufacturers and assess production feasibility and cost\-efficiency.

* Navigate ambiguity and operate autonomously as the primary in\-house engineer, supported by technical advisors and outside collaborators.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or Manufacturing disciplines).

* Track record of successfully managing small, cross\-functional teams toward technical milestones and deliverables.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience taking custom/prototype industrial machinery from concept to commercialization.
* Familiarity with relevant compliance standards and certification pathways (e.g. UL, CE marking, electrical/mechanical safety standards).
* Comfort working in agile or fast\-moving hardware development environments.
* Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to bridge technical and business functions.

* Develop technical papers/presentations, and clearly communicate concepts to program team.
* Support development and review of the full range of program and contract documentation.

* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans.

PWI R\&D Writing Systems Engineer
**Description \-**

  

A Writing Systems Engineer is an experience individual contributor responsible for **owning system\-level performance of industrial inkjet web presses** , with a strong emphasis on **hands\-on engineering, on\-press troubleshooting, and technical leadership** .


This role leads complex problem solving across ink, printhead, media, firmware, and mechanical systems, driving **print quality, reliability, and robustness** through a combination of **deep systems thinking and direct experimentation** . The specialist serves as a key decision\-maker in resolving ambiguous, cross\-functional issues and ensuring successful product delivery.  



  

  

**Responsibilities**  

**Hands\-on system ownership \& advanced troubleshooting (Primary)**

* Serve as the **technical owner for system\-level performance** , including print quality, reliability, and production robustness
* Lead **hands\-on troubleshooting on industrial web presses** , diagnosing complex print defects (banding, mottle, nozzle behavior, edge effects, etc.)
* Design and execute **on\-press experiments (DOEs)** to isolate root causes and quantify system sensitivities
* Drive **root cause analysis across subsystems** (ink formulation, printhead, firmware, mechanics, media) and implement corrective actions
* Support **press bring\-up, ramp, customer escalations, and field issues** , often in high\-pressure situations requiring rapid, data\-driven decisions
* Translate real\-world press behavior into actionable engineering insights and design improvements

**System design \& integration leadership**

* Define and develop **system\-level solutions** to optimize ink/media interactions, printhead performance, and image quality
* Lead integration of subsystems (ink, printheads, media, firmware, mechanical systems) into a robust, high\-performing writing system
* Establish system requirements, performance targets, and tradeoffs across quality, reliability, and cost

**Testing strategy \& validation**

* Define comprehensive **test strategies and validation plans** for system performance (IQ, durability, reliability)
* Architect and guide execution of experiments, ensuring high\-quality data and clear conclusions
* Establish and evolve **system\-level metrics and characterization methods**

**Performance optimization \& technical depth**

* Apply advanced data analysis and modeling to improve system performance and robustness
* Identify key sensitivities and failure modes, driving design changes across subsystems
* Balance competing requirements (print quality, throughput, cost, manufacturability)

**Cross\-functional technical leadership**

* Act as the **system\-level authority** across R\&D, manufacturing, quality, and field teams
* Provide clear technical direction and influence design decisions across disciplines
* Mentor junior engineers and guide team problem\-solving approaches
* Communicate complex technical issues, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders

**Program execution \& ownership**

* Lead system\-level aspects of **NPI programs** , from concept through qualification and release
* Define technical milestones, risks, and mitigation strategies
Drive closure of critical issues impacting product readiness and customer satisfaction  
* 

  

  

**Education \& Experience Recommended**  

* Four\-year or Graduate Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Materials Engineering, Physics, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
* Typically has 4\-7 years of work experience, preferably in inkjet writing systems, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3\-5 years of work experience.

  

**Knowledge \& Skills**  

* Extensive experience in hands\-on engineering, system integration, and troubleshooting of complex products
* Strong expertise in fluidics, heat transfer, materials, and/or electro\-mechanical systems
* Proven ability to lead root cause analysis and DOE\-driven problem solving
* Experience with industrial inkjet, imaging systems, or printing technologies strongly preferred
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (Python, MATLAB, JMP, etc.)

  

**Cross\-Org Skills**  

* Effective Communication
* Results Orientation
* Learning Agility
* Digital Fluency
* Customer Centricity

  

**Impact \& Scope**  

* Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.

  

**Complexity**  

* Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

* This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.description:
**About Treeswift:**


In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.


We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.


Since our first pilot with a utility in June 2024, we've grown fast, now working with three of the five largest utilities in the US. To date, our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.


To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.


We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.


Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

**About the role**


As a senior robotics engineer you will drive outcomes across perception, mapping, sensor fusion and calibration that directly contribute to the expansion of our business. As our business grows these needs will change; first priorities for this role will include:

* **Improving the quality and consistency of our product in an increasing breadth of operating conditions.** For example, you will lead SLAM development including incorporating new sensor evolutions and exploring innovative approaches to improving performance in GPS degraded environments.
* **Accelerating our time to delivery by leveling up our sensor fusion and calibration.** This includes fusing multi\-user, multi\-session point cloud maps and automating alignment of LiDAR and imagery data to produce consistent large\-scale scenes.
* **Power scalability and reliability** by eliminating the need for extrinsic measurements on our vehicle sensors in the field and improving our ability to catch and correct potential data quality issues at their source.
* **This role will be hybrid, with 2\-3 days in office,** based out of our New York, Philadelphia, or San Francisco offices.

**Experience / Skills**

* 5\-10 years of experience in perception for robotics
* Comfortable in a fast\-pace and high\-ownership environment. You’re excited to collaborate, but also comfortable developing your own opinions.
* Proficient in C\+\+ and Python
* Extensive experience developing SLAM solutions, ideally involving ground\-based LiDAR
* Experience with extrinsic and intrinsic sensor calibration, including automated data\-driven calibration
* Prior experience with ultra\-wide angle cameras is a nice\-to\-have

**What We Value**

* **Mission first.** We value team members who are focused on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business.
* **Curiosity.** We are constantly learning – from each other and from our customers.. We aren’t afraid to learn we were wrong in the process and adapt our approach accordingly.
* **Owners mindset.** If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity package

* Flexible, unlimited paid time off

* Commuter benefits

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:
  

  

1\. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  

2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  

3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan

jobs.title: 929 - Automation Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Controls Engineer**
=====================

Our client is seeking a hands\-on **Controls Engineer** to support, develop, and improve the automation and control systems within our automotive manufacturing operations. This position will be responsible for PLC programming, robotic systems, electrical controls, troubleshooting, equipment launches, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment.


The ideal candidate has experience working in a fast\-paced automotive manufacturing environment and is comfortable troubleshooting equipment directly on the plant floor. Experience with injection molding, automated assembly, robotics, vision systems, and auxiliary equipment is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Program, troubleshoot, modify, and maintain **PLC\-based control systems** for manufacturing equipment.
* Support **Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell Automation** PLCs, HMIs, drives, networks, and related control hardware.
* Troubleshoot electrical, controls, automation, and communication issues on production equipment.
* Program and troubleshoot industrial robotic systems used for material handling, assembly, inspection, and other automated processes.
* Support injection molding machines and associated automation, including robots, conveyors, fixtures, sensors, auxiliary equipment, and secondary assembly systems.
* Develop and modify PLC logic, HMI screens, control sequences, alarms, and machine interfaces.
* Troubleshoot servo systems, VFDs, sensors, safety circuits, industrial networks, and machine control panels.
* Support new equipment installation, commissioning, debugging, and production launch activities.
* Work with equipment suppliers and integrators during machine design, build, runoff, installation, and acceptance.
* Review electrical schematics, control panel designs, and equipment control standards.
* Support integration of new equipment into existing plant infrastructure and manufacturing processes.
* Assist Engineering and Maintenance with root\-cause analysis of equipment downtime and recurring controls\-related failures.
* Identify opportunities to improve equipment uptime, cycle time, reliability, quality, and operator safety.
* Maintain backups and documentation for PLC programs, HMI applications, robot programs, and other control systems.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance activities related to automation and controls.
* Provide technical support and training to maintenance technicians and production personnel.
* Ensure equipment modifications comply with company safety requirements and applicable electrical and machine\-safety standards.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent hands\-on controls experience will be considered.
* 3\+ years of controls, automation, or manufacturing engineering experience preferred.
* Strong experience with **Allen\-Bradley PLC programming and troubleshooting**.
* Experience with Rockwell Automation software such as Studio 5000/RSLogix and FactoryTalk preferred.
* Experience programming or troubleshooting industrial robots such as **FANUC, ABB, Yaskawa/Motoman, or similar systems**.
* Working knowledge of HMIs, VFDs, servo systems, sensors, safety circuits, industrial networks, and machine controls.
* Ability to read and troubleshoot electrical schematics and control\-panel drawings.
* Experience with Ethernet/IP and other industrial communication networks preferred.
* Automotive Tier 1 manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
* Injection molding and automated assembly experience is a plus.
* Strong hands\-on troubleshooting and root\-cause problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Maintenance, Production, Quality, suppliers, and equipment integrators.

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


The successful Controls Engineer will be someone who enjoys being on the manufacturing floor and solving equipment problems. This individual should be equally comfortable working on a laptop modifying PLC logic, reviewing an electrical schematic, troubleshooting a machine at the control panel, and working with an equipment integrator to launch a new automated manufacturing process.


This position requires a strong sense of urgency, technical curiosity, and a commitment to improving equipment reliability and manufacturing performance.

jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Datacenter Power Management
jobs.description:

Our data\-center platforms bring together GPUs, CPUs, networking, systems, and software to solve some of the world’s most exciting computing problems. We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join NVIDIA’s Datacenter Performance and Power Management Software team. You will be responsible for architecting production software for datacenter power management controllers. Your work will also cover cluster\- level dynamic provisioning and power\-management control system technologies for next\-generation data\-centers.

  

You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. Your responsibilities will span the entire product lifecycle—from initial architectural design and pre\-silicon validation through silicon bring\-up, productization, and deployment in extensive data\-center infrastructures. This is an outstanding chance to influence how next\-generation NVIDIA GPUs provide top\-tier performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.

 **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Architect, build, implement, and debug data center power and performance\-management software, with particular emphasis on end\-to\-end power management at racks and data halls.

* Drive features across the full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre\-silicon validation, silicon bring\-up, productization, and production support.
* Collaborate with GPU architects and hardware designers to define hardware\-software interfaces and influence the power\-management capabilities of next\-generation processors.
* Analyze complex interactions among workloads, clocks, voltages, power limits, thermals, telemetry, and system\-level policies.
* Lead the investigation and resolution of complex power, performance, stability, and reliability issues spanning firmware, drivers, hardware, and platform software.
* Develop validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance\-per\-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.
* Build clear architecture, interface, and compose specifications for new power\-management features.
* Partner with geographically distributed architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data\-center systems teams.

* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
* At least 12\+ years of extensive industry experience crafting system software, embedded firmware, device drivers, or other hardware\-related production software.
* Strong programming skills in C, including experience developing, debugging, and maintaining complex low\-level software.
* Deep understanding of operating\-system fundamentals, device\-driver architecture, embedded or real\-time software, concurrency, interrupt handling, and hardware programming.
* Experience interpreting hardware specifications and developing software interfaces for registers, telemetry, interrupts, and control mechanisms.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture and hardware\-software interactions.
* Proven ability to independently debug complex problems across multiple software and hardware layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across organizational and geographic boundaries.

 **Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd:**

* Background with architecting, designing, or implementing datacenter provisioning, monitoring, and managing power at a CSP/NCP.
* Hands\-on experience with GPU, CPU, accelerator, or SoC power and performance management.
* Background with crafting or implementing P\-state selection, DVFS, clock\-control, voltage\-control, power\-capping, thermal\-management, throttling, or workload\-aware control policies.
* Experience developing real\-time feedback controllers, including reasoning about stability, responsiveness, hysteresis, latency, and noisy telemetry.
* Understanding of electrical and platform considerations such as voltage\-frequency relationships, transient power, thermal limits, power delivery, and system\-level power budgets.

**Description**


Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.


Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About The Role:**


We are seeking a Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our high\-performance engineering organization as a full\-time, hands\-on individual contributor. In this role, you will be embedded within a cross\-functional team owning critical segments of our consumer ecosystem.


Our engineering organization is structured so that each domain team owns its vertical stack end\-to\-end—from backend microservices and APIs through frontend and DevOps. We are looking for an engineer with genuine depth across all layers of the stack who can move seamlessly between backend logic and rich frontend experiences, contributing independently within their first few weeks.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Lead Electrical Engineer serves as a technical leader responsible for the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of advanced electronic systems for downhole drilling and measurement technologies. This position leads electrical engineering efforts across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and survivability in harsh high\-pressure/high\-temperature (HPHT) downhole environments.

The role provides technical leadership throughout the product lifecycle, from concept development and system architecture through qualification, commercialization, and field support. The successful candidate will collaborate with global engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and operational groups to develop innovative technologies that enhance company capabilities, improve reliability, and drive profitability.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITES:**

* Lead the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of electrical and electronic systems for downhole drilling, measurement, and control technologies.
* Develop system architectures, design specifications, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
* Own PCB and electronic hardware development from concept through production release, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, testing, troubleshooting, and manufacturability considerations.
* Design and qualify electronic systems capable of reliable operation in harsh downhole environments including high\-pressure, high\-temperature (HPHT), shock, and vibration conditions.
* Lead technical decision\-making and provide engineering guidance throughout all phases of product development while collaborating with mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
* Develop and execute verification, qualification, environmental, and reliability test programs to ensure product performance, durability, and commercialization readiness.
* Lead root cause failure investigations, reliability improvement initiatives, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance product performance and field reliability.
* Manage multiple concurrent domestic and international engineering projects, ensuring technical, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
* Support field trials, product launches, customer demonstrations, and operational deployments while providing technical support to customers, sales, manufacturing, and field operations personnel.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement new technologies, products, and intellectual property opportunities that support strategic growth objectives and expand the company's technology portfolio.
* Collaborate with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic partners to ensure component availability, product quality, manufacturability, and long\-term supportability.
* Serve as a technical liaison between global engineering teams, customers, and stakeholders while effectively communicating project status, technical risks, and development plans.
* Contribute to technology roadmaps, project planning, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and strategic business initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and development support to engineers and technicians while promoting a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, engineering standards, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS****:**

· Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline

· Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in electrical engineering, R\&D, or product development

· Experience designing and validating electrical systems

· Hands\-on experience with board\-level design and ruggedization, bring\-up, and debugging

· Valid driver’s license

· Valid passport and the ability to travel both domestically (frequently) and internationally (occasionally)

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS (PREFERRED)****:**

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline
* Experience with
* embedded electronics and microcontroller\-based systems.
* high\-temperature electronic component selection and qualification.
* power management, battery systems, and low\-power electronics.
* EMC/EMI design and testing
* (PLM) systems and engineering change processes
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, and telemetry systems.
* Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), and design for testability (DFT).

For MWD/LWD specifically:

* Experience with downhole telemetry systems including mud pulse, electromagnetic, wired drill pipe, or rotary steerable technologies.
* Understanding of drilling dynamics, shock, vibration, and downhole environmental effects on electronics.

Join us to lead transformative projects that shape the future of electrical engineering! We value innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence—if you’re ready to make an impact in a fast\-paced environment dedicated to engineering advancement, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

* Do you currently reside in the greater Houston area?

* Cypress, TX 77429 (Required)

----------------------------



Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) is seeking a motivated entry\-level Electrical Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. MFC is a recognized designer, developer, and manufacturer of precision engagement aerospace and defense systems for the U.S. and allied militaries. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career professional looking to develop hands\-on electrical engineering skills in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.

* Supporting hardware operations and providing assistance to engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  


### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large\-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety\-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands\-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands\-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. 3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan

As a Senior Test Automation Engineer , you will make an impact by leading test automation initiatives for mission\-critical loan servicing applications. You will be a valued member of the Quality Engineering team and work collaboratively with product teams, software development leads, architects, business partners, and other stakeholders to improve software quality and accelerate delivery.

Develop and execute an enterprise test automation strategy aligned with software development, quality engineering, and business objectives.
  
Design and maintain scalable automation solutions for regression, smoke, sanity, API, mobile, and performance testing, ensuring appropriate test coverage, traceability, and reusability.
  
Establish automation success metrics, measure automation effectiveness and return on investment, and communicate results to management.
  
Define approaches for test\-data management, stable automation environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and integration with DevOps tools.
  
Partner with cross\-functional product, engineering, architecture, and business teams to prioritize automation, support in\-sprint testing, estimate delivery efforts, and drive process improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
Work model

Prior experience with Qualitia.

*We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.*


*Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.*


  
**About Fluidstack**
====================


We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.  

  



We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**


**How We Operate**
==================


* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Capacity Delivery Team**
------------------------------


**Examples of key problems the team is working on**


* **Engineer gigawatts from drawing to energized, in months not years.** Capacity Delivery owns technical execution across every build: the drawings, the field questions, and the engineering calls that keep multiple concurrent gigawatt sites moving.
* **Engineer data centers that go up in months, not years.** At that pace rework is not an option: problems get caught on paper or they cost a data hall.
* **Design it once, build it a hundred times.** Every site's lessons roll into the reference design on the way to 10s to 100s of GWs, so each build starts ahead of the last.

**Role Scope**
--------------


* Own controls engineering for assigned sites: BMS and EPMS design review, integration oversight, and commissioning support.
* Review controls submittals against the standard: architecture, points, sequences, graphics.
* Oversee integrator programming quality before it reaches the field.
* Support Level 3 through 5 commissioning with engineering answers in hours.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
* You've engineered building or industrial controls on mission critical projects.
* You read and write sequences of operations.
* You've reviewed integrator work and sent it back with specifics.
* You debug controls issues from the points list up.
* Bonus: Niagara or Ignition. EPMS platforms. Networking for controls. Commissioning experience.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**HARDWARE TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER, SATELLITES (STARLINK)**



At SpaceX we're leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world's most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation with over 9,500 in\-orbit and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We've only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink's potential global impact and are looking for best\-in\-class engineers to help maximize Starlink's utility for communities and businesses around the globe.



As a Hardware Test Automation Engineer you will design, build, and automate test systems to support the development and qualification of satellite payloads, propulsion systems, mechanisms, and more. This role encompasses design, analysis, and manufacturing disciplines, with the ability to spearhead large\-scope projects from early design through implementation. Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here – engineers on this team are curious, collaborative, love to learn new things, and work effectively in a dynamic environment to deliver high\-impact technology on a massive scale.

* Develop, document, and implement cross\-functional automation solutions to improve test capability, coverage, and safety.
* Design and implement test and ground support equipment (GSE) to include flight hardware fixtures, automated test equipment, facilities infrastructure, vacuum systems, etc.
* Design user interfaces that make complex machines easy to use and troubleshoot.
* Create electrical, pneumatic, and fluid schematics.
* Provide innovative solutions to unique requirements and challenges faced by the team, which can range from specialized equipment to difficult installation locations.
* Perform electrical installation of valves, limit switches, potentiometers, transducers, etc.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
* 1\+ years of experience automating test systems.
* 1\+ years of experience with instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ) system design, or electronics test engineering.


**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**


* 1\+ years of programming experience using Python, MATLAB, or C/C\+\+.
* Experience with one or more of the following electrical test equipment: oscilloscopes, digital multimeters (DMM), DAQs, power supply, electronic load, spectrum analyzer, source measurement unit.
* Experience with programmable logic controllers (PLC).
* Experience in one or more of the following: electronics test rack design and build, DAQ setup and field measurements, build of electronic systems or test systems for local assembly or industrial applications.
* Extensive knowledge of various digital and analog interfaces including but not limited to: USB, VISA, TCP/IP, CAN bus, SPI, I2C, Modbus, analog\-to\-digital conversion.
* Experience troubleshooting interactions between software and hardware.
* Experience with the design, build, and activation of fluids, thermal, vacuum, structural or electromechanical systems.
* Understanding of metrology, sources of measurement error, and uncertainty analysis.
* Able to collaborate with a wide range of people and effectively work in a team.
* Sound verbal and written communication skills.


**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**


* Willing to work weekends and extended hours as needed.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**


* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Field Services Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**EPD Mission**



The mission of Electronic Power Design, Inc. is to craft quality electrical equipment for our clients and uphold a standard of excellence in the engineering, design and manufacturing process. We strive to improve the quality of life of our employees by creating a work environment conducive to personal development, success and fulfillment. We are driven by our vision of being the preferred manufacturer, electrical systems integrator and worldwide service company by providing our clients with value\-added solutions that power their lives.


**About Us**



At Electronic Power Design, Inc. (EPD), we don't just build electrical equipment—we power industries and change lives. Our mission is to deliver top\-quality electrical solutions while fostering an environment where employees thrive. We believe in innovation, collaboration, and empowering our people to reach their full potential.


**The Opportunity**



EPD is seeking a motivated and technically skilled **Field Services Engineer** to join our growing Field Services team. This role is responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintaining, and supporting electrical power distribution systems at customer locations throughout the United States and internationally.



This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, traveling to customer sites, and working directly with customers to ensure reliable operation of mission\-critical electrical equipment.


**What You'll Do**


**Field Engineering \& Technical Support**


* Install, commission, test, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain electrical power distribution systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, protective relays, breakers, and automation systems.
* Analyze system performance and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability and minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.


**Customer Service \& Project Support**


* Serve as a professional representative of EPD at customer locations.
* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project updates with customers and project stakeholders.
* Provide customer training and operational guidance as needed.
* Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service and professionalism.


**Safety \& Compliance**


* Follow OSHA, NFPA 70E, customer site requirements, and EPD safety policies.
* Utilize proper PPE and safe electrical work practices.
* Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas while promoting a culture of safety.


**Documentation \& Continuous Improvement**


* Complete service reports, commissioning documentation, startup records, and technical reports.
* Document troubleshooting activities and recommended corrective actions.
* Participate in technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support manufacturing and engineering teams when not assigned to field service projects.


**What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* 0–2 years of engineering experience; internships and co\-op experience welcomed.
* Knowledge of electrical power systems and industrial controls.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
* Willingness to travel up to 80% domestically and internationally.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with electrical commissioning, startup, or field service.
* Familiarity with switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, and protective relays.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E, and electrical safety practices.
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, renewable energy, utilities, or power generation.
* First Aid/CPR certification.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.


**Physical Requirements**


* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to safely lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to lift bulky or awkward materials with or without assistance.
* Ability to work in varying indoor and outdoor environments, including heat and cold.
* Ability to travel extensively and work safely at customer facilities.


**Why Join EPD?**


**Work on Critical Infrastructure**



Support projects that power industrial facilities, manufacturing plants, energy operations, and critical infrastructure.


**Accelerate Your Engineering Career**



Gain hands\-on experience with complex electrical systems while developing valuable field engineering expertise.


**Travel \& Professional Growth**



Work in diverse environments and gain exposure to advanced electrical technologies and customer applications.


**Collaborative Culture**



Join a team that values safety, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.


**Competitive Compensation \& Benefits**



EPD offers competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, travel experience, and a comprehensive employee benefits package.


**Ready to Power the Future?**



If you're an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, working directly with customers, and making a measurable impact in the field, we encourage you to apply and become part of the EPD Field Services team. Add job description when creating a specific template.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Solutions), AI & Data Platforms (AiDP)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. **Description**  

  

We engineer high\-quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems on cloud that power data exploration, analytics, reporting and production models. Our core systems are diverse and come with an unusual intersection of high data volumes with systems distributed across cloud and on\-premise infrastructure.  

  

This role will build solutions that integrate open source software with Apple’s internal ecosystem. You will drive development of new components and features from concept to release: design, build, test, and ship at a regular cadence. You will work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements and workflows, and propose new features and ecosystem changes to streamline their experience of using the solutions on our platform.  

  

This is a challenging software engineering role, where a large part of an engineer's time is spent in writing code and designing/developing applications on cloud, with the remainder being spent on tuning and debugging codebase, supporting production applications and supporting our application end users. This role requires in\-depth knowledge of innovative technologies and cloud data platform with the ability to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

3 or more years of experience building enterprise\-level data applications on distributed systems  

  

Hands\-on experience in designing and development of cloud\-based applications that include compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services.  

  

Experience in cloud data warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued  

  

Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus  

  

Understanding of fundamentals of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving  

  

Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud  

  

Data Visualization Tools: experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker  

  

Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like Snowflake or Big Query  

  

Programming experience in building high\-quality software with at\-least one of the following programming languages \- Python, Scala or Java.  

  

Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures \& semantic process for distributed data applications.  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.description:

***Job Title:*** Manager, Systems Engineering

***Job Code:*** *44524*

***Job Location:*** *S**alt Lake City, UT*

***Job Schedule:*** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days\- totaling 80 hours worked\- and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**


L3Harris Spectrum Superiority (S2\) is seeking a **Manager, Systems Engineering** to lead an engineering team supporting Electronic Warfare (EW) and the Next Generation Jammer (NGJ) program. This L5 leader will manage technical execution for assigned program scope and ensure the team delivers high\-quality systems engineering products through development, integration, test, fielding, and sustainment.


The Manager, Systems Engineering will report to an L6 Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, and will work closely with Program Management, Chief Engineers, customers, and functional engineering teams. The role includes team leadership, EW system architecture support, requirements management, technical planning, design and development oversight, integration and test execution, risk management, and technical staffing and mentoring for the NGJ program.

**Essential Functions:**

* Manage and develop a systems engineering team supporting assigned EW and NGJ program scope, including resource assignment, work prioritization, employee development, and performance management.
* Execute assigned technical work under the direction of the L6 Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, partnering with Program Management, customer stakeholders, and Chief Engineers to meet NGJ program objectives, EW mission needs, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements.
* Provide systems engineering leadership across the assigned EW system life cycle, including concept development, architecture, requirements analysis, design synthesis, integration, verification, validation, qualification, deployment, and operational support.
* Contribute to system architectures and technical roadmaps for EW, electronic attack, RF, and airborne mission\-system capabilities, including NGJ growth and modernization efforts.
* Oversee requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification planning across RF hardware, software, firmware, networking, and subsystem interfaces.


Oversee subcontractor requirements decomposition, statements of work, design, verification, and validation activities.

* Ensure development of high\-quality technical artifacts including specifications, interface control documents, test plans, procedures, verification cross\-reference matrices, and other customer deliverables.
* Lead assigned internal and external technical reviews, customer briefings, milestone assessments, and NGJ program status reviews; elevate significant technical risks and decisions to the L6 Senior Manager.
* Drive technical risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and opportunity management across assigned NGJ development and production efforts.
* Coordinate cross\-functional engineering execution among systems, RF, electrical, software, mechanical, test, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams.
* Support proposal strategy, basis\-of\-estimate development, technical volume creation, technical interchange meetings, and customer demonstrations for EW, NGJ, and related classified mission pursuits.
* Implement disciplined systems engineering processes, tools, and metrics to ensure technical quality, configuration control, and compliance with company and customer standards.
* Lead staffing, mentoring, succession planning, and development of a high\-performing systems engineering team supporting NGJ and other EW programs.
* Active Secret clearance required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance; ability to access additional classified programs as required.
* 

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or another relevant engineering or technical discipline and a minimum of 12 years of prior related experience, or a Graduate degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of technical leadership, functional leadership, or engineering management experience leading cross\-disciplinary teams on complex EW, defense, or aerospace programs.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Active Top Secret clearance preferred; TS/SCI eligibility or access is strongly desired.
* Demonstrated experience leading systems engineering for Electronic Warfare, electronic attack, RF, airborne mission systems, or other classified mission technologies; NGJ experience is strongly desired.
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes spanning EW mission requirements, architecture development, interface definition, integration, verification, validation, and qualification.
* Experience leading teams through complex customer engagements with DoD, IC, or other national security customers.
* Ability to guide technical strategy and investment planning for EW capabilities, including technology maturation, transition to production, and mission\-relevant roadmap development.
* Experience with risk management, earned value or schedule\-driven technical execution, and coordination across internal teams, subcontractors, and suppliers.

**Date Posted: September 21, 2026**  

  

Join the Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) team, where you'll contribute to groundbreaking innovations! We are seeking applicants for a Systems Engineerto join our Strategic and Military Space Division.  

  

The Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) is seeking a motivated Multidisciplinary Systems Engineer.The successful candidate will play a key role in defining system architectures, coordinating interdisciplinary engineering efforts, managing requirements, risks, interfaces, and configurations, and ensuring cohesive technical execution across multiple teams. This role is ideal for candidates with a broad technical foundation across multiple engineering disciplines, strong analytical and communication skills, and a desire to contribute to team\-based problem\-solving in a dynamic, mission\-driven environment.  

  

The Strategic \& Military Space Division delivers advanced satellite and sensor systems that support the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Our division is a key component of national security, providing technological solutions and expert mission support. Become part of a team dedicated to making a tangible contribution to our nation’s defense capabilities.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leads or independently executes systems engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle, including requirements development, architecture, design, integration, verification, validation, and test
* Identifies and manages technical risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies
* Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation required for effective planning, execution, and technical reviews
* Coordinates engineering activities to ensure technical deliverables satisfy requirements and remain aligned with program objectives
* Provides systems engineering oversight of design, integration, verification, and test activities
* Advises Program Managers and engineering leadership on technical requirements, system impacts, risks, alternatives, and execution considerations
* Serves as a technical interface with customers, stakeholders, vendors, and subcontractors as appropriate
* Leads portions of technical reviews and support proposal and planning activities
* Provides technical guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced engineers
* Supports technical planning by providing inputs to program cost, schedule, staffing, and resource estimates

  

**Required Qualifications:*** Must be a US citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain US Government security clearance
* Bachelor’s in engineering or related science and 8\-15 years of relevant experience or a master’s and 6\-13 years of relevant experience
* Strong working knowledge of systems engineering processes across the system lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience with requirements development and verification, system architecture, interface management, risk management, configuration management, and trade studies
* Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and understand their impacts on system performance, cost, schedule, risk, and implementation
* Proficiency with systems engineering tools and analysis methods
* Ability to provide technical direction and influence engineering teams without requiring direct supervisory authority
* Experience supporting technical planning, cost estimating, and schedule development
* Strong organization and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with customers, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams
* Ability to travel as required

  

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Existing TS/SCI clearance
* Experience implementing Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and processes
* Experience leading small\- to medium\-sized multidisciplinary engineering teams or technical efforts
* Experience with small satellite programs including risk mitigations, hardware development, and testing
* Understanding of the space environment

  

**Salary Range:*** $110,000\-$175,000
* This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range displayed in the job advertisement reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries across all US locations. Specific salary details for a candidate’s preferred location can be provided by the recruiter or HR manager during the hiring process.

 **Why Join SDL?**  

  

SDL offers competitive salaries and **a comprehensive benefits package**. Visit our **Benefits Page** to learn more about what we offer.  

  

SDL delivers advanced multi\-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.  

  

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners.

  

For questions, assistance, or accommodation with the application process or the DoD SkillBridge program, please contact employment@sdl.usu.edu.
